structure.name: Twisted_Fate
structure.quote: *"It's not gambling if you can't lose... "*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Born to the nomadic river folk of the Serpentine Delta, Tobias Felix quickly learned what it was to be an outsider. Tolerated for the exotic goods they peddled, but shunned for their strange traditions, his people found only short welcomes wherever they berthed their colorful river barques. His elders would shrug, and say this was just the way of the world, but the obvious prejudice always stuck in Tobias' craw.

He found his true calling in the gambling tents, between games of chance and skill like Mortwheel and Stabberscotch, when he first picked up a deck of playing cards. Many years earlier, his superstitious grandfather had shown him how to read omens in the shuffle and cut, while his aunt had later taught him how to read all an opponent's tells. Between the two, Tobias took to the high-stakes game of Krakenhand like an old master. He could almost feel each card's place in the deck, and follow their movements through each successive hand. He was often accused of cheating, but it was difficult for anyone to explain exactly how.

Finally, one night, a group of men who'd lost their fortunes to young Tobias returned in the dead of night to settle the score. They came bearing cudgels and, emboldened by cheap rotgut, went from tent to tent in their search for him, beating down any of the river folk who got in their way. Fearing for his life, Tobias turned and fled into the darkness.

When dawn came, the lad sheepishly crept back to find his people breaking down the camp. No one would look him in the eye. He had thought only of himself and left others to face the consequences of his actions.

Though he begged and pleaded with them all, Tobias was exiled for what he had done. With his whole world falling apart around him, he watched helplessly as the barques left, leaving him alone on the riverbank with nothing but his grandfather's worn deck of cards clutched in his hands.

He grew to manhood as a drifter, trawling the gambling halls of every settlement he came to, using his preternatural skill to earn enough coin to survive. That Tobias was able to relieve the boastful, the arrogant, and the cruel of their cash was just an added bonus—though he was always careful to let his marks win at least a few hands, here and there.

Across one table, he met a deplorable fellow named Malcolm Graves.

Each recognizing a kindred soul, Tobias and Graves quickly joined forces. On the southern borderlands of [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Valoran "Valoran"), they set two renowned noble houses of [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Noxus "Noxus") at each other’s throats as cover for the rescue of a kidnapped heir. That they pocketed the reward money, only to ransom the vile young man to the highest bidder, should really have come as no surprise to their original employer. In [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Piltover "Piltover"), they still hold the distinction of being the only thieves ever to crack the supposedly impenetrable Clockwork Vault. Not only did the pair empty the vault of all its treasures, they also tricked the guards into loading the loot onto their hijacked schooner, for a quick getaway through the Sun Gates.

In almost every case, only once they and their accomplices were safely over the horizon were their crimes even discovered—usually along with one of Twisted Fate’s trademark calling cards left where it would be easily found.

With every con, swindle, and heist, Tobias felt the pull of the cards growing stronger, and he knew it was more than mere gambler's luck that guided him. His people had always waved away concerns over primitive magic and “cartomancy”, but now Tobias began to seek out ever more dangerous means to bend the cards to his will.

That search ended badly Graves was taken alive and sent into The Locker while Tobias and the rest of the crew ran free. Though he tried to break Graves out, he failed. Instead, seeking to begin again, he returned his birth name to the river's waters and took another: Twisted Fate.

### Burning Tides

:   *Main article: [Burning Tides](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Burning_Tides "Burning Tides")*

In the years after, Twisted Fate continued conning people solo, one-time evading capture by Miss Fortune. She would later hire him by proxy to sneak into Gangplank’s warehouse to steal and return a Crimson-Coil dagger, where he would reunite with Graves, who broke out from The Locker and was tipped off by the Bounty Hunter herself about Twisted Fate presence.

Flamed with rage at his partner's apparent betrayal, Graves started shooting at Tobias in an effort to settle the score with him. With Gangplank's warehouse burning and with the pirate captain's thugs swarming, the resolution of Graves' and Twisted Fate's long-simmering feud threatens to engulf the entire city in flames. Informed by the destruction of his warehouse, Gangplank set off the catch both of the perpetrators of this act.

Both Graves and Twisted Fate tried to flee from the wrath of the Pirate King but with no success. Gangplank tortured them until he tried to publicly execute them in front of the whole city for their misbehavior. Hearing the news of this event, Sarah Fortune's plans set in motion and along with her crew, started to make preparations to blow up Gangplank’s flagship so all Bilgewater could witness the death of their Reaver King.

Graves managed to hide one of Twisted Fate's cards, snatched during their previous fight around the city, from the pirate thugs, and so, Twisted Fate breaks free but Graves gets dragged to the bottom of the ocean. Twisted Fate then jumps after him and saves Graves from drowning but almost dies in the process. Graves manages to save Twisted Fate and after they successfully survive the explosion, both men settled their dispute and resolve to pick up their joint hustling.

As Graves had lost his shotgun Destiny, they head to Piltover so he can get a new one. Even though Graves and Twisted Fate are tempted to reconcile their relationship, both know it may take a while for Graves to completely trust Twisted Fate again, still, the latter is happy to have his old friend back.

### Destiny and Fate

:   *Main article: [Destiny and Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Destiny_and_Fate "Destiny and Fate")*

After running jobs in Piltover and Zaun for a while, they go back to Bilgewater in search of the Abyssal Crown. Along with the story, Twisted Fate actively tries to regain Graves' trust, staying despite the danger and giving the Crown to Graves since the latter still keeps some distance from him.

They end up angering a sea witch in the process. Later on Miss Fortune springs a trap for Twisted Fate and Graves. Despite the latter's success in cornering her, she manages to trap them and hand them to the sea witch in exchange for her quartermaster. In the end, she helps Twisted Fate and Graves escape as well.
structure.appearance:
Twisted Fate is described as a tall, handsome male with tanned skin, trimmed beard and long dark hair. He's got sharp features and a strong jaw. He is usually depicted wearing a dandy wide-brimmed hat with golden ornaments along with a long black coat, a salmon vest, and a white button-up shirt with black tight pants and boots. Although he wears his hair loosely, in the [Double-Double Cross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Double-Double_Cross "Double-Double Cross") cinematic he has shorter hair kept in a small ponytail and doesn’t wear his jacket.

His eye color remains inconsistent, being blue in some depictions and brown in others. T.F. also has a Bilgewater-themed tattoo on his right arm seen on his lore-based skin  [Cutpurse Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twisted_Fate/Cosmetics "Twisted Fate/Cosmetics").
structure.personality:
Twisted Fate rarely takes things seriously, greeting each day with a mocking smile and an insouciant swagger. He’s prone to brag and has an overall smug yet charismatic personality. He's an opportunistic and hedonistic person that enjoys the thrill of danger and adventure. However, he does seem to have some roguish honor, since he tends to steal mostly from rich people and it is mentioned that he enjoyed conning arrogant and cruel people, as shown in his short story. Even though he usually appears laid-back and playful, he rarely shows genuine emotions and has tight control of his expressions.

Twisted Fate is analytical and a strategist, being the brains in his partnership with Graves, usually in charge of planning out heists. He’s also superstitious and theatrical, since it’s mentioned he enjoys putting on a show and communicates artistically at times.

He used to have a history of taking off when things started to get complicated but changed his ways after starting to work with Graves once again. Twisted Fate is also a stickler for appearance even having a “concerned face” he only uses when dealing with a really bad hand of cards or when he finds a new stain on his jacket. He’s very protective of his hat, to the point he checks the state of his hat first instead of his broken ribs after falling off a building. Twisted Fate is also plagued by the fact that he's a riverman that can't swim, drowning being his worst nightmare.
structure.abilities:
- **[Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Tobias was born with natural magical abilities, which might grow the more he trains and expands his knowledge about magic.
  - **Cartomancy:** Twisted Fate uses magical cards for various effects. His cards are a family heirloom and are specifically described as old magic. Without him having one to focus on, he can't cast magic at all, though it's unclear if the cards are magic or if they are only magical for him. Yellow cards stun and deals some damage, since Bambolini got some heavy bruising when Twisted Fate hit him with a yellow card. Red cards are know to explode but the blue card ability is still unknown.
  - **Teleportation:** Twisted Fate is capable of teleportation from one place to another while gaining complete visual access while he casts the spell.
  - **Divination**: like other riverfolks, Twisted Fate is able to read cards and look for omens among them.

relations.relationship_description:
Their partnership started when they recognized a kindred soul in one another across a table during a high-stakes game in Mudtown.

They both shared the same reckless passion for danger and adventure, which is what encouraged them to form their partnership. Graves being the brawn, and T.F. being the brains they were an unusually effective team from the outset. Their mutual sense of roguish honor grew into genuine trust, and together they hustled across Valoran.

They were forced apart when a heist went south, with Graves getting sent to The Locker despite Twisted Fate’s efforts to save him. Graves endured years of torture and solitary confinement, during which time he nursed his bitter anger toward his old partner, and, convinced T.F. had betrayed him, Graves was determined to have his revenge.

Graves reunited with T.F. again when Miss Fortune set them up, yet they were forced to put aside their differences in order to escape almost certain death in the ongoing conflict between her and Gangplank. Even though Graves and T.F. were tempted to reconcile their relationship, both knew it may take a while for Graves to completely trust T.F. again, still, the latter was happy to have his old friend back.

However, since Graves still kept some distance from T.F., in the short story Destiny and Fate, T.F. proactively tries to show Graves that he can trust him again. T.F. had a history of taking off when things got ugly and so, T.F. wanted to stay and retrieve the Abyssal Crown even if it meant risking his life so he could prove to Graves that he wouldn't leave him to pick up the pieces anymore. In the same story, when Graves shows up next to T.F. bleeding, the latter notices and expresses his concern, something that Graves actually appreciated even if he didn't say it out loud.

During the Burning Tides events, T.F. jumps after Graves to save him from drowning despite not knowing how to swim and being terrified of drowning himself.

Graves seems to like messing with T.F., particularly by calling him Tobias instead of Twisted Fate insisting the latter is a stupid name, or by splashing him with salt water just to mess with TF's carefully oiled and perfumed hair. Similarly, T.F. usually comes up with clever replies to annoy Graves. Their petty bickering is seen many times like at the end of Burning Tides, Double-double cross, and Destiny and Fate.

In the story "The Boys and Bombolini" it is revealed that both Graves and Twisted Fate have romantic feelings for each other.

After some time, Graves captured  [Teemo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Teemo "Universe:Teemo") for the bounty on [yordles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle") while Twisted Fate refuses because "messing with Yordles brings a whole heap of trouble." Graves then fought  [Corki](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Corki "Universe:Corki"),  [Lulu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lulu "Universe:Lulu") and  [Tristana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tristana "Universe:Tristana") who came to save Teemo, which ended up in Graves being  [turned](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lulu#Whimsy "Lulu") into a frog and the Yordles escaping.

structure.trivia:
- He was likely inspired by [Gambit](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gambit_(comics)) from [X-Men](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X-Men) by [Marvel Comics](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marvel_Comics).
  - In his old lore, Twisted Fate's powers came from an experiment conducted by Dr. Xavier Rath, a likely reference to the X-Men's [Professor Xavier](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Professor_Xavier).
- Twisted Fate named his hat "Envy".
- *Sentinel Graves* death animation shows Graves taking out a blue card that gets him teleported to Twisted Fate's location before dying.
- One of the scrapped narrative concepts for Graves was for him to be married or to be an ex-lover of Twisted Fate. The concept of having "palpable sexual tension" between the characters was preserved in their final lore.
- However much his lore is retconned, Twisted Fate is invariably identified as a Serpentine River nomad.
  - In his second lore, he was a Demacian-born nomad who also operated in Noxus.
- As seen in 1 [Pool Shark](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Pool_Shark "LoR:Pool Shark") card's artwork, his bounty in  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater") is 10,000,000.
- His first name *Tobias* was first revealed in [Burning Tides](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Burning_Tides:_Act_1 "Burning Tides: Act 1"). His full name was later revealed to be *Tobias Felix* with his biography update released in conjunction with the global mobile launch of  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra").
  - *Tobias Felix* was originally specific to  [High Noon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:High_Noon "Universe:High Noon") universe before his biography update.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
  - *Tobias* comes from Hebrew טוביה *Ṭōḇîyāh* "My Goodness [is] [Yah](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yahweh)".
- His stories in chronological order are [Double Down](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Double_Down "Double Down"), [Burning Tides](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Burning_Tides:_Act_1 "Burning Tides: Act 1"), [Destiny and Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Destiny_and_Fate "Destiny and Fate") and [Double-Double Cross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Double-Double_Cross "Double-Double Cross").
- In a *Legends of Runeterra* interaction, Vi refers to Graves as Twisted Fate's "better half".
- Graves is the only person who still calls Twisted Fate by his birthname, Tobias.
- [Cutpurse Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twisted_Fate/Cosmetics "Twisted Fate/Cosmetics") and  [Cutthroat Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Graves/Cosmetics "Graves/Cosmetics") depict them in their younger years.
- For the 2022 Pride Month Collection, RIOT decided to release two new emotes featuring Twisted Fate and Graves, consequently acknowledging their relationship, and thus becoming the first canon couple between two male champions.
  - One of the emotes is a reference to the classic scene in the romantic drama film "Brokeback Mountain".

structure.name: Miss_Fortune
structure.quote: *"The bigger the risk, the bigger the bounty."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Sarah Fortune was born to the famous weapons manufacturer Abigail Fortune (her father's name is unknown), and lived with her mother in Bilgewater. Her mother taught her to make weapons of all kinds, the most prominent being firearms. Little Sarah's life was quite happy and pleasant, until the well-known looter Gangplank went to her mother's business to demand that she create two powerful pistols, to which Abigail accepted and said that in a year she would have them made.

After a year Gangplank returned but had no intention of paying Abigail. She finished the pistols and he took them from her, then proceeding to shoot Abigail, her husband, and finally Sarah. He went on to destroy the Fortunes' workshop, but miraculously, Sarah survived. With the little strength she had left, she managed to escape from the fire along with her mother's guns. Her body had recovered, but she began to suffer night terrors and post-traumatic stress from the incident, as well as an intense thirst for revenge.

### Contemporary history

When she reached adolescence, Sarah with her mother's weapons already repaired plunged into the world of crime, committed her first murder which had a great reward, Sarah saw a few other flyers of criminals and after a few days she claimed all the rewards for their heads,little by little Sarah began to build her reputation and began to be feared and respected by the inhabitants of Bilgewater, and they started calling her Miss Fortune.

Sarah, determined to take revenge on Gangplank, began to look for allies and little by little began to gain more power, until she was finally able to face Gangplank, Sarah devised such an ingenious plan which caused the fall of Gangplak and without him she finally took the throne of the city.

### Recent events

Miss Fortune along with her crew try to negotiate with the other captains of Bilgewater who previously served Gangplank, if the captains refused, Sarah killed them and kept her crew.

#### The Ruined King

Miss Fortune tried to negotiate with a captain about joining her, but he refused and Sarah ended up killing him. Although she didn't mind killing captains, she was tired because none of them cooperated with her.
structure.appearance:
Miss Fortune is an incredibly beautiful woman with a slim and voluptuous build, light skin, pale blue eyes and her most prominent feature is her long, wavy scarlet-red hair.

Normally she wears somewhat revealing clothes, consisting of a white blouse with seperate long sleeves, with a dark green vest that reveals her abdomen, black bell-bottom pants, black high-heeled boots and wears a black pirate hat on her head.
structure.personality: Sarah is a born and calculating leader, she usually uses her beauty and wit to get what she wants. She is usually quite flirtatious and lascivious when speaking, but she is really a dismissive and ambitious woman, however, she shows great concern for her followers and allies, being able to give her life for them or even avenge them.
structure.abilities:
- **Expert Markswoman**: Miss Fortune is an extremely skilled marksman being considered the best gunslinger in all of Bilgewater.
  - **Shock and Awe**: They are Miss Fortune's two favorite weapons and they are the ones she usually uses.

relations.relationship_description:
Miss Fortune survived  [Gangplank's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gangplank "Gangplank") murder attempt which killed her mother and plotted to avenge her mother's death. She hired  [Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Fate "Universe:Twisted Fate") to rob  [Gangplank's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gangplank "Gangplank") warehouse while also tipping off  [Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Graves "Universe:Graves") about it. Both men acted as a massive distraction so that she could make final preparations to land the killing blow on  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank"). When they later returned to  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater") in search of the Abyssal Crown, they angered a sea witch in the process. Miss Fortune, who had her quartermaster caught by the same witch, tricked and captured them both and then gave them to the witch in exchange for her quartermaster, but then helped T.F. and Graves escape.  [Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Graves "Universe:Graves") holds a grudge against Sarah but still thinks she is impressive.

Between [Burning Tides](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Burning_Tides "Burning Tides") and [Shadow and Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shadow_and_Fortune "Shadow and Fortune"), Miss Fortune is purging  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater") of all those loyal to  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") after the power vacuum his 'death' caused (she is sure she can make Bilgewater prosper if the people are united under her banner). At one point before  [Gangplank's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gangplank "Gangplank") 'death', him and Miss Fortune struck an uneasy truce in order to fight off the [Harrowing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Harrowing "Harrowing"), right on the shores of the [Serpent Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blue_Flame_Islands "Blue Flame Islands"), in 'The Battle of Knife Straits'. They were successful (despite heavy casualties and their combined fleet scattering), while farther south  [Nautilus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nautilus "Universe:Nautilus") managed to fight off the rest of the undead.

During the events of [Shadow and Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shadow_and_Fortune:_Chapter_One "Shadow and Fortune: Chapter One"),  [Lucian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lucian "Universe:Lucian") and Miss Fortune encountered each other in a recent  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater")'s [Harrowing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Harrowing "Harrowing"). They both fought the undead from the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles") and parted way in friendly terms. She intended to persuade him to help her claim  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater").
She encountered  [Olaf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Olaf "Universe:Olaf") but did not think much of him.

[Illaoi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illaoi "Universe:Illaoi") protected Miss Fortune from the Black Mist and  [Hecarim](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hecarim "Universe:Hecarim"). Unknown to Sarah, Illaoi secretly helped  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") reclaim the city, while also intending to test her in the near future.
During a shootout between Miss Fortune and a rival captain's crew,  [Ryze](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ryze "Universe:Ryze") got caught in their conflict and helped her out.

Based on her [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Legends_of_Runeterra "Legends of Runeterra") voice lines, Miss Fortune may have gone to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") at some point and gotten involved in some accident through which she met  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") and  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn").

During the events of [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruined_King "Ruined King"),  [Ahri](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ahri "Universe:Ahri"),  [Illaoi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illaoi "Universe:Illaoi"),  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"),  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pyke "Universe:Pyke"),  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo") and  **Miss Fortune** travel to the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles") to confront  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") in order to protect Bilgewater. Viego would try to sway her to his side with the promise of power, but her will proved stronger and she sealed him inside a Buhru artifact.

However, Miss Fortune would eventually accept  [Viego's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") offer, when the [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sentinels_of_Light "Sentinels of Light") came to Bilgewater, becoming  [ruined](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Miss_Fortune/Cosmetics "Miss Fortune/Cosmetics") in the process. She had accepted his offer because she had grown desperate after months of fighting against Gangplank.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

structure.trivia:
- Sarah taking the name 'Miss Fortune' for bounty hunting references the old sailor myth that women on ships brought... misfortune.
- Miss Fortune's first shipmate is called Rafen.
- Miss Fortune is based on many [real-life female pirates](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Women_in_piracy), especially [Anne Bonny](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anne_Bonny) & [Mary Read](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mary_Read).
- Miss Fortune's background resembles [Inigo Montoya's](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inigo_Montoya) from [The Princess Bride](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Princess_Bride).
- Her guns were forged by her mother for  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank"), who later killed Sarah's family and destroyed the pistols.
  - Sarah later rebuilt them, became 'Miss Fortune', and finally avenged her family years later (but  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") didn't truly die).

structure.name: Talon
structure.quote: *"The three deadliest blademasters in all of [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valoran "Universe:Valoran") are bound to the house of  [Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Du_Couteau "Universe:House Du Couteau"): my  [father](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau"),  [myself](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina"), and  **Talon**. Challenge us, if you dare."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Talon has no recollection of his family, nor of any warmth or kindness. He scraped out a living through his quick wits and deft thievery in the underbelly of Noxus. He learned to navigate the underground passages of Noxus and attained mastery of the blade. Marked as a threat by the empire, assassins were sent after him. He managed to kill his pursuers, dropping their bodies into Noxus’ moat.

However, when  [General Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau") himself came after Talon, the Noxian General emerged victorious in the duel. He made an offer to Talon – to die or serve the Noxian High Command. Talon chose to live on the condition that he would serve the General alone because he could only respect orders from those he could not defeat.

### Betraying [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina")

:   *Main article: [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Katarina:_Issue_1 "Katarina: Issue 1")*

At some point Marcus Du Couteau tasked Talon with helping him fake his death, without anyone knowing. For years he secretly worked with the General who promised to make him his heir after fulfilling his mission. To achieve that, he got closer to Katarina, pretending to be a good brother. After Katarina was captured by Marcus and tasked to kill king Jarvan III, she returned back to Noxus only to find Talon welcoming her back. Having realized Talon knew about Marcus this entire time, she fought with him and won, injuring his eye.
structure.appearance: Talon is a fair-skinned human man with dark hair and brown eyes. He is usually seen dressed as an assassin, with nearly his full body covered in blue cloth and light metal armor. This outfit features a large hood that shrouds his face and a decorative "cape" composed of five blades dangling from red ribbons. He also sometimes covers his nose and mouth with a cloth mask. His signature weapon is a large silver blade strapped to his right forearm.
structure.personality:
Talon is a cold and deadly perfectionist, valuing swift and clean kills above all else. He is obedient and efficient in his tasks, but despite his generally merciless approach, Talon believes his methodology is the best for all parties involved. In Talon's words, it's more merciful to give targets a quick, painless death than to draw it out, and it is both safer and more efficient for an assassin to avoid combat when possible. If a clean kill is not delivered immediately, Talon already considers that to be failure.

Talon is shown to deeply value his family, taking on their name and greatly respecting Marcus and  [House Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Du_Couteau "Universe:House Du Couteau"). However, Talon's admiration and obedience to his father ultimately leads him down the path of resentment, as Talon desperately works to maintain  [Marcus Du Couteau's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau") approval and comes to view himself as the rightful heir. Because of this,  [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina") sees Talon as a younger version of herself - someone who has lost his independence to become Marcus' pawn - and pities him for it.
structure.abilities:
- **Agile Combat Mastery***:* Talon is both agile and quick, capable of performing acrobatic maneuvers in the midst of battle and traversing urban environments with ease.
- **Stealth Mastery**: As an assassin, Talon is trained to infiltrate heavy security in order to approach his targets. His stealthiness is comprised of part silence and part elusiveness.
- **[Knife Mastery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Talon#Shadow_Assault "Talon")**: Talon's skill with knives is worthy of note, he makes excellent use of daggers to eliminate targets.
- **[Arm Blade Mastery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Talon#Noxian_Diplomacy "Talon")**: Talon possesses a forearm strapped blade with which he is proficient in using to attack unseen and in straight-forward combat if necessary.
- **[Throwing Blade Mastery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Talon#Rake "Talon")**: Talon can fling a fan of several spinning blades that serrate his enemies from afar.
- **Lockpicking Expert:** Katarina declared Talon to be the best lockpicker in all of Noxus, capable of picking a trapped lock that she was unable to breach without using hextech. [[1]](#cite_note-1)

relations.relationship_description: Talon was bested by and consequently served under  [General Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau"),  [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina") and  [Cassiopeia's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassiopeia "Universe:Cassiopeia") father. As his protege, Talon was adopted by the general and became his favorite student. Because of this, Talon believed he had earned the family daggers and hoped to become the new heir to House Du Couteau. He is fiercely loyal to his father and his family, treasuring their status over that of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") itself. [[2]](#cite_note-2)

Talon was assigned the task of killing  [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina") after her first failure by her father,[[3]](#cite_note-3) his assassination failed, which left a scar on her left eye. He decided to bear his failure instead of reattempting, due to the hypocrisy it would be compared to Katarina's case. He named the very blade he used after Katarina, and keeps it in case he is reassigned to kill her. After helping Marcus fake his death, he pretended to be a good brother to her. He hoped to turn her against Swain and instill in her their father's efficient fighting style, only to become frustrated when she would stubbornly refuse take his advice. [[4]](#cite_note-4) When Talon ultimately betrayed her again, he lost the battle again in which Katarina injured his right eye. [[5]](#cite_note-5)

Talon believes Swain is a tyrant and a traitor and would like to end his life. He blames Swain for turning Katarina against him and  [House Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Du_Couteau "Universe:House Du Couteau") and believes Noxus would be better off without him. [[6]](#cite_note-6)

structure.trivia:
- *Talon* is not his actual name, but rather what people called him.
- Although the Katarina comic mentioned his eye wound would scar, he is yet to be shown with it.
- According to Katarina's biography, he was a protege of one of the lesser assassins' guild.
- Although his eyes are most often brown or yellow, he is also shown with blue eyes, as seen in certain chapters of Katarina webcomic.

structure.name: Sona
structure.quote: *"My spies whisper to me of this  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") treasure—that her melody moves the soul, and her silence sunders the body."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

When she was an infant, Sona was left in a monastery in the  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") province of [Galrin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Galrin "Universe:Galrin"). The monks were given no other clue about her origins besides a mysterious stringed instrument that was delivered with her. Even so, these monks were generous and made certain that Sona and the other children under their care lived happy lives. As she grew older, her caretakers later realized that Sona could not speak, but her thoughtful nature brought comfort to the other children, who would frequently smile whenever she was around. As a child, Sona learned how to play the instrument she had been left with. No visiting teachers or musicians had ever seen anything like it before, so she had to teach herself.[[1]](#cite_note-SonaBio-1)

### Adoption by House Buvelle

When  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") began to [land troops](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxian_Invasion_of_Ionia "Universe:Noxian Invasion of Ionia") in the northern provinces of  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), the monastery evacuated the orphans and struck a deal with a  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") trader, who took Sona and her friends on a ship to Demacia, where they would be cared for by the  [Illuminators](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illuminators "Universe:Illuminators").[[1]](#cite_note-SonaBio-1) The  [Buvelle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Buvelle "Universe:House Buvelle") family, led by  [Lord Barrett](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Barrett_Buvelle "Universe:Barrett Buvelle") and Lady Lestara, were prominent patrons of the Illuminators, and they gladly obliged when asked to help care for nine war orphans over three months. The Buvelles were amazed by Sona's musical talent and were almost immediately fond of her, and though eight of the orphans would leave, Sona decided to stay.[[2]](#cite_note-Fragile-2)

Over the next few years, Sona became close with her new family, including her adoptive sister Kahina and especially with Lady Lestara. As Sona was unfamiliar with the Demacian language, the Buvelles developed a personalized sign language so they could better communicate. Out of appreciation for her new home, Sona held recitals so she could share her music with the public. She also studied in the libraries of the Illuminators to learn more about her instrument, and came to believe it was an *etwahl*, a rare [magical](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic") artifact. Her connection to this instrument meant that Sona was a mage, which her mother urged her to keep secret from the other Demacians, especially the  [mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers").[[1]](#cite_note-SonaBio-1)

### Funeral of Lord Barrett

:   *Main article: [Fragile Legacies](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fragile_Legacies "Universe:Fragile Legacies")*

When Sona was a teenager, her father was slain by  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") mages during the Battle of the [Gates of Mourning](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gates_of_Mourning "Universe:Gates of Mourning").  [Lord Barrett](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Barrett_Buvelle "Universe:Barrett Buvelle") had been a much-beloved figure among the  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") people, and the entire kingdom mourned his loss, including King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), who had considered him a close friend. Lady Lestara was especially heartbroken by the loss, and Sona and Kahina did their best to comfort her as they all grieved together.[[2]](#cite_note-Fragile-2)

The funeral for Lord Barrett was held three weeks after the battle, with so many mourners in attendance that the [Great City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_City_of_Demacia "Universe:The Great City of Demacia") was not large enough to hold them all. Many prominent nobles gave eulogies for Sona's father, but she believed none of them described who really he was, save for King Jarvan III. One of the nobles,  [Lord Eldred](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Eldred "Universe:Eldred") of the  [Mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers"), even went so far as to misrepresent Barrett as an anti-magic figure, even though he had known his daughter's secret and protected her for years. After the others had spoken, Lestara announced that she was donating the  [Buvelle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Buvelle "Universe:House Buvelle") residence and their private collection of books to become a public library. At her mother's request, Sona then performed a song she had composed in her father's honor.[[2]](#cite_note-Fragile-2)

Later, after the other guests had left, Kahina disclosed to her mother and sister that she was planning to join the  [Illuminators](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illuminators "Universe:Illuminators") as a knight, which meant Sona was now the sole heir to the Buvelle name. Sona was shaken by the news. Lestara worried that as an adopted child, and one who was not of Demacian blood, it could prove difficult for her. Sona also understood that mages would only be further persecuted after the king's best friend had been killed by one, and with Barrett no longer around to protect her she no longer felt safe in Demacia. Sona tried to run away from home late that night. Her mother caught her, but instead of stopping her, Lestara decided to come as well.[[2]](#cite_note-Fragile-2) The two of them set on a journey together back to  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), withdrawing from all courtly engagements.[[1]](#cite_note-SonaBio-1)

### Return to Ionia

When Sona arrived in the  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), it was undergoing a great "restoration" after the [war](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxian_Invasion_of_Ionia "Universe:Noxian Invasion of Ionia"). The First Lands had changed, however, with the people there having endured much in the time she had been gone.[[1]](#cite_note-SonaBio-1) At some point, Sona traveled with  [Ryze](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ryze "Universe:Ryze") to the [Hirana Monastery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hirana_Monastery "Universe:Hirana Monastery") so he could gather a World Rune. While there, she defended him against the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood"), using her etwahl to defend him against their pursuers.[[3]](#cite_note-CallOfPower-3) After some time in Ionia, Sona decided she no longer belonged there and went back to  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") with her mother.[[1]](#cite_note-SonaBio-1)

### Concert at the Argentine Inn

:   *Main article: [One Last Show](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:One_Last_Show "Universe:One Last Show")*

Despite Sona's decision to return to  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), the problems that had caused her to leave were still very much there. Following the death of King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), Demacia found itself in a period of [rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion") and civil unrest. The power of the  [mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers") had expanded significantly, with many innocents being persecuted as a result.[[1]](#cite_note-SonaBio-1)

One day, Sona received a letter from her old friend Etra, who wanted to perform with her at the Argentine Inn. They took the stage with a drummer named Cal, with Etra as the vocalist and Sona at center stage with her etwahl. The audience grew quickly as soon as Sona started to play, and she tried to soothe their collective worries following the king's assassination. However, a group of mageseekers soon made their way into the audience as well, and they attacked Sona after seeing the magical shapes drifting through the air. The audience fled in the chaos, and to protect Etra, Sona fought the mageseekers with her music, forcing them to painfully dance until they were knocked out cold with no memory of the event. With the mageseekers unconscious, Sona fled the scene through the forest.[[4]](#cite_note-OneLastShow-4)
structure.appearance: Sona is a slender, pale-skinned woman with long blue hair and yellow at the ends. Her robes is a long, elegant gown with a distinctive palette of blue, dark blue, turquoise and gold. The most characteristic ornaments of her attire are the golden diadem on her head between her hair. She also has an  [Etwahl](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sona#Power_Chord "Sona") that floats along with her.
structure.personality: Sona is a very graceful and elegant young woman. She best (and primarily) expresses herself through her music (although she also as the ability to express her thoughts and communicate with others via telepathic speech), which is best known for it's melodious nature. This highly reflects her gracious and refined personality. Sona is a very caring and gentle woman who helps out others in need and comforts those in need.
structure.abilities:
- **[Magical Bonding](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Sona has a special bond with her instrument  [Etwahl](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sona#Power_Chord "Sona"). It seems to possess limited sentience and cannot be removed too far from Sona, as it will teleport back to her. She is also the only person in the world who can play it and can understand it's behavior.
  - **Sound Magic:** Sona is able to send forth blasts of sound energy and create shields.
  - **Empathy Magic:** Sona and her instruments are able to tap into people's memories and emotions and play music that will touch people's souls or that have special meaning to them. She is also capable of controlling people's emotions and actions, forcing  [Mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers") to dance when they were hunting her. She can also heal other with her magic.
  - **Synesthesia:** Sona is able to see music as a visual stimulus rather than just sonorous.

relations.relationship_description: Sona was adopted by  [Lord Barrett](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Barrett_Buvelle "Universe:Barrett Buvelle") and Lady Lestara of House Buvelle, and their daughter Kahina became her adoptive sister. She was very close with all of them, especially her mother Lestara. When they learned she was capable of [magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"), her parents kept it a secret to protect her from the  [Mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers"). Sona was deeply upset by the death of her adoptive father, and his absence led her to leave  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") for a time with her mother. Sona also became the house's sole heir after her sister joined the  [Illuminators](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illuminators "Universe:Illuminators"), as their knights were not allowed to marry or hold titles.[[2]](#cite_note-Fragile-2)

When Sona first came to  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), the Illuminators and their monks cared for her and the other orphans until she was adopted by the  [Buvelles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Buvelle "Universe:House Buvelle"). Her mother Lestara left the order to marry  [Lord Barrett](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Barrett_Buvelle "Universe:Barrett Buvelle"), and her sister Kahina is a current member.[[2]](#cite_note-Fragile-2) Both of her parents were strong supporters of the organization, and Sona was able to learn about her etwahl and herself by studying in the Illuminators' library.[[5]](#cite_note-SonaAudio-5)

After discovering her etwahl was a magical instrument, Sona's mother urged her to keep it secret so she would not be hunted by the mageseekers.[[1]](#cite_note-SonaBio-1) With the death of her  [father](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Barrett_Buvelle "Universe:Barrett Buvelle"), the mageseekers gained significant power by decree of King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"). Sona was afraid of  [Lord Eldred](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Eldred "Universe:Eldred") at Barrett's funeral, and his fanatical hatred of people like her was part of the reason she left  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia").[[2]](#cite_note-Fragile-2) She currently hates and blames the mageseekers as the reason her home no longer feels like home, and despite her gentle nature, she is willing to inflict pain on them to protect her friends.[[4]](#cite_note-OneLastShow-4)

While she was in  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), Sona traveled with Ryze to the [Hirana Monastery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hirana_Monastery "Universe:Hirana Monastery") and fought the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood") who ambushed them.[[3]](#cite_note-CallOfPower-3) She learned about his hunt for "world-ending relics" and wondered if the runes could truly be that dangerous.[[5]](#cite_note-SonaAudio-5)

Despite opposing the  [mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers"), Sona refused to join Sylas' [rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion"), believing he was only creating more problems for mages.[[5]](#cite_note-SonaAudio-5)
Sona was frustrated by Jarvan IV's early reign, believing he could resolve many of the kingdom's problems with a single decree.[[5]](#cite_note-SonaAudio-5)
Sona met Irelia during the "restoration" in  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), but has not seen her since then.[[5]](#cite_note-SonaAudio-5)
Sona knew who Taric was before his exile from  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia").[[5]](#cite_note-SonaAudio-5)
Sona knows the old songs about Fiddlesticks, but does not believe the [demon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demon "Universe:Demon") is actually real.[[5]](#cite_note-SonaAudio-5)
Ezreal once tried attend one of Sona's recitals, but was denied entry.[[6]](#cite_note-Curator-6)

structure.trivia:
- *Sona* comes from Proto-Italic verbal root *\*swen-* "to sound"[[7]](#cite_note-7) plus feminine suffix *-a*
  - *\*Swen-* historically yields Proto-Italic *\*swenos* > Latin *sonus* > French *son* > English *sound*.
  - Her title *Maven* references [her musical skill with her Etwahl.](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maven) & comes from [Yiddish](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yiddish):
    - From Hebrew מֵבִין *meḇin* & מבינה *meḇinah*, active participles of *hebin* < *bān* < Semitic root *b-y-n* "to separate, to discern";[[8]](#cite_note-8)
  - Her instrument's name is based on & pronounced the same as French *étoile* [etʷal] < [PIE](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proto-Indo-European_language) root *\*h₂sters* (> English [star](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/star))[[9]](#cite_note-9)
    - Etwahl's shape is based on the Chinese [Guzheng](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guzheng).
- Sona is [mute](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/muteness). She communicates with others mostly by using sign language.[[10]](#cite_note-10)
  - In [Runeterra Legacy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Runeterra_Legacy "Runeterra Legacy"), she could communicate to [Summoners/players](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Summoner "Summoner") via [telepathy](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/telepathy).
- Sona is possibly in her early - mid 20s.
- Her  [Etwhal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sona#Power_Chord "Sona") is an ancient magical musical instrument that was made thousand years ago.
- Her adoptive parents led a hunt party that hired  [Quinn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quinn "Universe:Quinn") and her brother Caleb to kill a giant tuskvore. The events led to Caleb's death. Later, Lestara sponsored Quinn to be a knight as a repayment for saving her husband's life.
- Her adoptive father died in the battle of the [Gates of Mourning](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gates_of_Mourning "Gates of Mourning"), the loss of which led to  [Jarvan IV](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV") being captured by the  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") army.
- Her adoptive sister Kahina introduced  [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") to the  [Illuminators](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illuminators "Universe:Illuminators").
- [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") sees Sona as an art rival, stating that his form of art leaves longer, more lasting imprints though she doesn't know about him.
- [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") and  [Ezreal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ezreal "Universe:Ezreal") are fans of her performance.  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain") is also interested in her etwahl and potentially a fan.
