She tricked Caitlyn into revealing her position with a series of mirror tricks while taunting them, sending Sevika to attack Caitlyn as she engaged Vi herself, exchanging harsh words before trying to kill each other. Jinx lost the fight and had most of her weapons destroyed, as well as losing a finger to Caitlyn's rifle. However, when Jinx asked Vi to finish her off, Isha intervened, putting herself in the way of Vi's gauntlets and Caitlyn's rifle. Before Caitlyn could kill both Jinx and Isha, Sevika activated a bomb Jinx had set up that blew up the temple, saving their lives and sending the Gray in an explosive, colorful display that painted the entirety of topside.[[14]](#cite_note-203finally-14) This attack, combined with her earlier destruction of the Piltover Council, inspired people across the undercity to adopt Jinx's colors, painting a mural in her honor and viewing her as a symbol of resistance against topside, and they became known as the "Jinxers."

### Martial Law Period

#### Life in Hiding

Believing she should have died in the explosive finale she had set up, Jinx went into hiding in her lair, taking  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha") with her and declaring "Jinx is dead." Despite Jinx's disinterest in being a symbol.  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") and Isha regularly encouraged Jinx to come out of hiding so she could finally unite the undercity. With Jinx believing herself incapable of being a hero, Isha secretly impersonated her, using her gadgets to inspire  [Zaunites](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") in acts of resistance against the  [Piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") forces, who had been cracking down on them hard under martial law for months. Isha's reckless actions would eventually lead to her getting captured, and after learning about this from Sevika, the two of them left for Stillwater Hold to rescue her, with Jinx arming herself with a new hextech shock pistol called  [Zapper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Zap! "Jinx"), which she had upgraded from her old gun. Jinx was able to sneak inside by disguising herself as an Enforcer and eventually freed all the undercity folk, declaring herself their "big fat hero." The people, among them many Jinxers and  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights"), all approached and silently thanked her. Jinx then went to find Isha.[[15]](#cite_note-204paint-15)

Though Jinx had successfully rescued everyone, their respite was short-lived, as  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), a chemtech beast who had been summoned there by his creator,  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed"), began his rampage through the hallway. After directing Sevika to take Isha to safety, Jinx lost the battle and waited to be killed by Warwick. However, the beast seemingly recognized her as "Powder" as he looked into her eyes, and Jinx suddenly realized in disbelief that he was speaking to her in Vander's voice. Warwick suddenly fled from the prison and Jinx gave chase, but ended up losing track of him in the mines.[[16]](#cite_note-205blisters-16)

#### Saving Vander

Jinx sought the help of  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), who had been reduced to a drunken brawler in a fighting ring after being dumped by Caitlyn. Jinx attempted to reconcile with Vi, but encountered some difficulty due to the fact they'd tried to kill each other in their last meeting. Though Jinx informed her that Vander was alive, Vi believed she was either lying or hallucinating as usual, but reluctantly decided to help her. Jinx and Isha led Vi into the mines, where the sisters got into a fight and Isha got a nosebleed, setting Warwick on their trail. Later on, Jinx and Vi found the old home of Vander and Silco, where they learned more about their past as miners and found an old note Vander had left, describing his regrets at having nearly killed Silco all those years ago. Jinx wondered if things could have ended differently if Silco had only found the note. When they returned outside Warwick attacked them, driven mad by the scent of blood. Jinx pleaded with Vi not to hurt Warwick, and when she eventually listened they managed to reawaken Vander's old memories, bringing the man out from within the beast. Vi hugged her father and invited Jinx to join them, and their family experienced a tearful reunion.[[16]](#cite_note-205blisters-16)

Though they had recovered some of their father's memories, Vander's mind was still twisted and tortured by Singed's experiments, and Jinx and Vi began looking for a way to bring him back fully. They received word of a magic healer who could work miracles and brought him to  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), who agreed to help them. While Jinx didn't seem to believe Viktor's efforts would work, the [commune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Church_of_the_Glorious_Evolved "Universe:Church of the Glorious Evolved") had been built near the ruins of her childhood home, and she and Vi both wondered if they could all build a new life there. This would not last, however, as  [Ambessa Medarda's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") army soon marched on the commune, and Jinx and Isha prepared to defend Warwick from being captured by Singed and Caitlyn. Caitlyn suddenly betrayed Singed, and Jinx went to defend her against  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"), Ambessa's right-hand man. Though Rictus defeated Jinx, Vander stepped in and saved her, and she and Vi were both overjoyed to have him back. A few seconds later, however, all the cultists in Viktor's commune suddenly collapsed, and Warwick flew into another rage, killing Rictus and sparking a full-scale battle against Ambessa's forces.[[17]](#cite_note-206message-17)

Jinx attempted to reason with Warwick, but he attacked her violently, and to save Jinx's life Isha overloaded her Zapper with three hextech gemstones, sacrificing herself in a massive explosion. Grieving the loss of both Isha and Vander, Jinx rushed an injured Vi to safety before turning herself in to the authorities.

#### Breaking the Cycle

After turning herself in, Jinx had seemingly lost any will to live, apologizing to Caitlyn for killing her mother before asking to be executed. Her hallucinations returned after losing Isha, and she spoke with the voice of Silco, who explained to her the cycles of vengeance that drove him and Vander to suffering, in their conversation Jinx realized that the only way to end the cycle was to "walk away." Later, when Vi had recovered, she attempted to free Jinx, declaring that she could use her powers for good and "rewrite" her story. Realizing her sister would never give up on her, Jinx sucker-punched Vi and locked her in the cell, declaring that Vi needed to forget about her and go live a happy life with Caitlyn. When Vi asked what Jinx was planning to do, she simply said she would "break the cycle."[[18]](#cite_note-208killing-18)

After cutting off her hair and setting fire to the Last Drop, Jinx attempted to end her own life in her lair using a newly-constructed hextech monkey bomb. However, she was stopped by  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko"), who told her that despite her mistakes, it was never too late for her to build something new.[[19]](#cite_note-209dirt-19) In the lead-up to Ambessa's invasion of Piltover, Jinx joined Ekko and went to the Firelight hideout, where she combined all her old weapons into a new device that she called  ["Rhino"](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx/Cosmetics "Jinx/Cosmetics").[[2]](#cite_note-Jinx_Fixes_Everything-2) She also engineered the propellers of her lair into a painted war balloon and led the charge of the undercity people, including Ekko and Sevika, to aid in the final battle against Ambessa and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), rescuing Vi and Caitlyn from certain defeat.

Though Jinx's attack had turned the tide, Warwick, who had been transformed into one of Viktor's mindless puppets, arrived with Viktor's drones and attacked Vi and eventually Jinx and Ekko as well, crashing her airship into the tower. After a reconciliation between the sisters, Jinx and Vi fought Warwick within the Hexgate and were eventually caught in the  [storm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viktor#Arcane_Storm "Viktor") from Viktor's Anomaly, which threatened to absorb them into the Herald's hivemind. Jayce and Ekko were able to defeat Viktor, finally releasing them from the gravity field, but leaving Vi trapped on a precarious ledge. Jinx begged Vi to jump to safety, but she was too injured and distraught to move as Warwick awoke in a mindless, savage state. Realizing Vi was unable to let Vander go, Jinx chose to sacrifice herself, hurling both herself and Warwick down the tower shaft while hugging him one last time. After this, Jinx activated her monkey bomb, seemingly killing them both.

Jinx was presumed dead after the explosion, and she was mourned by a grieving Vi, Ekko, and presumably the other Jinxers and Firelights. However, Caitlyn would run an investigation of the Hexgate schematics and the destroyed remains of Jinx's monkey bomb, suggesting that Jinx's body had never been found after the explosion, and that Caitlyn suspected Jinx could have faked her death by escaping through a ventilation shaft. As Caitlyn pondered this evidence and spoke with Vi, an airship resembling the one Powder had promised to fly on one day soared over the sea and into the distance, toward an unknown destination.[[19]](#cite_note-209dirt-19)
structure.appearance:
Jinx is a slender and short teenage girl with a narrow build and sinewy arms and legs. She has blue, ankle-length hair that she wears in two thick braids that fall over her mid-back and cascade to her ankles, with a chin-length swoop of hair on the right side of her face. She is normally seen wearing a black sleeveless leather crop top with a leather choker, purple striped trousers often complemented by dark leather accessories with purple accents on her arms, black leather ankle-length boots with purple laces, and a worn crisscross band-aid on her left knee. She also has long nails that are painted blue and pink, and light blue cloud tattoos on her right arm, shoulder, and midriff. While her eyes were originally a blue-grey color, her appearance would change after receiving an experimental [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") procedure from  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed"), where her skin became extremely pale and her eyes changed color to bright pink, with purple vein-like patterns around them. After her next battle with  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"), Jinx lost her left middle finger and replaced it with a mechanical brass-colored prosthetic, with a painted pink smiley face to replace the fingernail.

As a child, Powder had greyish eyes and shoulder-length hair tied back into a single braid with hastily cut bangs accented with intricate silver clips. She normally wore a short-sleeved blue top over a striped pink undershirt, black arm warmers, short brown pants, long lilac socks, and simple brown shoes.
structure.personality:
As a child, Powder was a kind, curious, and creative girl with a reckless streak that led her to often make decisions that negatively affected the people around her. This led Mylo to frequently criticize her for her incompetence and eventually caused Powder to develop an inferiority complex along with a strong desire to prove her worth to her foster siblings and her sister  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") in particular. She also suffered from attachment issues due to losing her parents as a toddler and had a problem with following orders, which was part of the reason why she didn’t listen to Vi’s instructions to stay behind during their mission to rescue Vander from Silco.

After accidentally killing her foster family and being seemingly abandoned by Vi at her weakest moment, Jinx’s trauma became extremely pronounced and caused her to suffer from intense hallucinations of Mylo, Claggor, and Vi in the years after she was taken in by Silco. It also stunted her emotional growth, leaving her with childish tendencies even in her late teens, and prompted her to adopt a bubbly and energetic facade to mask all the pain and guilt that she kept beneath the surface. Over time, her unhealed trauma transformed Jinx into a chaotic and excitable individual who relished death and destruction, and had little remorse for the people that she killed along the way. Her wild behavior earned her a reputation as a loose cannon among the members of Silco’s crew and eventually got to the point where even Silco himself had no way to keep her under control. Her mental instability also caused her to exhibit a sarcastic, sassy, and dark-humored demeanor towards her enemies or people she didn’t fully trust, as seen when she pranked Vi into thinking that she was going to serve her Caitlyn’s head on a platter.

Despite her radical change in personality after accidentally murdering her foster family, Jinx never lost the desire for approval that she had a child and simply transferred it from Vi to Silco after her sister’s disappearance. She was also later revealed to have a very twisted and possessive attitude towards Vi, and was extremely fearful of losing her all over again. As a result, when Vi eventually returned to the undercity to find her, Jinx did everything in her power to make sure that Vi didn’t leave her again and even resorted to kidnapping her and Caitlyn to ensure that didn't happen, only to ultimately let her sister go and reject her old identity as Powder after finally coming to the bitter realization that they would never be able to love each other like they used to.

Jinx's journey from Powder to the "Loose Cannon" was a deep and complex transformation, shaped by loss, loyalty, and identity, accompanied by psychological trauma. As a child on the Day of Ash, she experienced hallucinations after losing her parents, viewing the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") as distorted and monstrous. As she grew up, the hallucinations became more pronounced, especially after she believed Vi had abandoned her. Jinx would see visions of both the living and the dead, including Vi, Caitlyn, Mylo, Claggor, Vander, Silco, and Isha, many of whom had never even done anything bad to her. Jinx's hallucinations ranged from the grotesque, to the humanoid, to childish scribbles.

Jinx held a fierce sentimental attachment to items which were related to important people from her past, kept for a long time and often so she could pretend to speak with the person in question. Among these were Mylo and Claggor dolls she built and argued with in her hideout, Vander's box, Vi's stuffed rabbit, and also Silco's chair, which she left in his old office to come and speak to for advice.

Jinx made frequent attempts to make contact, reconcile with, or even forgive many of the people in her life, assuming they were still alive. She repeatedly tried to make contact with Vi, at first to reunite with her sister, then under the pretext of saving Vander, even after Vi had tried to kill her at that point. Jinx caught Silco more than once trying to conceal important information from her, but remained close to him, and even at the tea party where she removed his gag herself, ready to listen to his opinion. Despite all her aggression and paranoia, she was ready to forgive people and try to reconcile. Jinx was also able to find a common language with Sevika, against the backdrop of Silco's death, and even made her a new arm with drawings in her signature style.

Jinx's trauma was the source of a long-term and intense regret for loss or guilt, with the hallucinations of Mylo, Claggor, and Vander lingering in her mind for the longest time, as she blamed herself for being the direct cause of their suffering. With the death of Silco and appearance of Isha, her hallucinations died down enough that she could not hear his voice. They resurfaced when Isha was arrested, then again after her sacrifice, which brought Jinx so much guilt that she set fire to her childhood home and nearly took her own life.
structure.abilities:
- **Chemically Altered Physiology:** Due to being subjected to an experimental surgery by  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") that used an advanced version of [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") to save her life, Jinx was permanently altered by the drug's effects, giving her superhuman physical abilities through a long and excruciating process.
  - **Enhanced Strength:** Jinx is substantially stronger than the average human. Despite her slender build, she was strong enough to knock  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") out with one punch and lift  [Vi's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") deactivated  [Atlas Gauntlets](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vi#Relentless_Force "Vi") almost effortlessly, a notable feat given that Vi could barely lift even one deactivated gauntlet on her own. She was also strong enough to toss Fishbones, a rocket launcher almost as long as she is tall, into the air as if it were a basketball and easily jump high enough to catch it in mid-air so that she could use it to take a shot at Vi during their temple fight.
  - **Enhanced Speed:** Jinx can move at incredible speeds, as displayed by how she was able to disarm Caitlyn in a split second and knock her out before the latter could react in time to defend herself. She was also able to dodge and parry many of  [Warwick's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") attacks during their confrontation in Stillwater and could move so fast that even he had trouble keeping up with her speed during certain points of their fight.
  - **Enhanced Durability:** Jinx is far more durable than the average human. She was able to tank numerous punches from Vi's Atlas Gauntlets, which are strong enough to easily shatter ribs, without suffering any broken bones and withstand several of Warwick's attacks while only sustaining moderate injuries, a notable feat given that Warwick can easily eviscerate people with his claws.
  - **Enhanced Endurance:** Jinx has an inhumanly high tolerance to pain. Despite all the punches that Vi landed on her during their temple fight, she was able to keep moving and fighting back against her older sister with little trouble. She was also able to withstand the pain of getting her middle finger shot off her left hand, with the injury only slowing her down by several seconds, and inhale large amounts of the Gray for a prolonged period of time without passing out or suffocating.
- **Inventor:** Despite not having any formal education, Jinx is a prolific engineer and inventor, having created numerous contraptions and weapons with her own creativity and ingenuity. She was also able to quickly reverse-engineer the [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") technology originally created by  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") with just the aid of their research journal, making her the first  [Zaunite](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") to build hextech weapons for her own use.
  - **[Pow-Pow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Pow-Pow "Jinx"):** A minigun of her own design, this served as Jinx's primary weapon during her usual escapades around  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and Zaun.
  - **[Fishbones](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Switcheroo! "Jinx"):** Designed from her childhood drawings, this rocket launcher had a [chemtech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chemtech "Universe:Chemtech") payload known as the  [Super Mega Death Rocket](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Super_Mega_Death_Rocket! "Jinx"). At one point, this weapon was modified to use a hextech gemstone as its power source, enabling it to shoot its payload over longer distances with greater power.
  - **[Rhino](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx/Cosmetics "Jinx/Cosmetics"):** An all-terrain heavy weapon that functioned as both a machine gun and a rocket launcher. It was created when Jinx fused the remains of  [Pow-Pow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Pow-Pow "Jinx"),  [Fishbones](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Fishbones "Jinx"), and her  [Zapper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Zap! "Jinx") with with a power source from  [Heimerdinger's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger")  [H-28G Evolution Turret](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Heimerdinger#H-28G_Evolution_Turret "Heimerdinger"), a cooling system from  [Ekko's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko") aeroglider, and a heating pipe from the  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights")' hideout.[[2]](#cite_note-Jinx_Fixes_Everything-2)
  - **[Gun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Blowback "LoR:Blowback"):** A pistol that fires chemtech bullets and is easily capable of injuring any targeted person. Jinx later renamed this weapon as her  [Zapper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Zap! "Jinx") and modified it to use a hextech gemstone as its power source, enabling it to fire blasts of arcane energy at her targets.
  - **[Chompers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Flame_Chompers! "Jinx"):** Inspired by her childhood bomb designs, these grenades have a chemtech payload inside them. Disarming one can prove to be very dangerous, as its inner mechanisms are difficult to go through due to their random scrapheap design, even for highly skilled engineers such as Viktor and Jayce.
  - **[Monkey Bomb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Jinx%27s_Get_Excited! "LoR:Jinx's Get Excited!"):** A clockwork toy monkey filled with several explosive hex crystals, it was the first working bomb that Jinx ever created.[[7]](#cite_note-103base-7)
- **Expert Markswoman:** Jinx is a natural with a gun and could accurately shoot at moving targets from a very young age. As she grew into her teens, she refined her shooting skills even further, making her one of the deadliest fighters in the undercity.
- **Brawler:** Although not as skilled as Vi, Jinx is competent at hand-to-hand combat, as displayed by how she was able to hold her own against her older sister during their fight in the temple.

relations.relationship_description:
Violet was Powder's older sister, and they were close growing up together under  [Vander's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") care. The two of them had lost their parents at a very young age, so Vi took it upon herself to be her sister's protector. Vi was very encouraging of Powder, defending her often against their adoptive brother Mylo's teasing and always being her biggest supporter, and they often sat together looking at the devices Powder had invented on her own. After Vander was kidnapped, Vi told her sister to stay behind so she wouldn't get hurt. Powder misunderstood Vi's intentions, however, and assumed Vi did not believe in her abilities, which led to a mental breakdown. In an effort to prove herself, Powder took the hex crystals she stole, went to the cannery, and built a bomb, accidentally killing their entire family. The disaster led to Vi smacking Powder in the face and calling her a 'jinx' before storming away to cool herself off. Although Vi always intended to return to Powder, she was arrested by  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus"), and as a result of this Powder believed she was abandoned. Jinx would later claim that Vi was what motivated her to become stronger, and she would come to believe that Vi was the one truly responsible for creating "Jinx."

When she was an adult, Vi returned to the undercity in search of her sister, only to find "Jinx" in her place, who was the loyal henchman and daughter of  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco"). Powder's transformation deeply disturbed and troubled Vi; and Vi's new and intimate relationship with  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") upset Jinx. Although Jinx missed her sister, Vi's sudden return from the "dead" left her conflicted and confused, as Vi still claimed to love her, but she also feared that Vi hadn't truly returned for her and was simply manipulating her to try and gain Caitlyn's favor—a notion that was exacerbated by Silco and  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika"). Silco had in turn falsely led Jinx to believe Vi had been dead for years, and the trauma of Jinx's perceived abandonment ran deep, making her became increasingly paranoid and violent in Vi's presence. Ultimately, their reunion was short-lived, and after a few more separations and misunderstandings, Jinx eventually kidnapped Vi, Caitlyn, and Silco to attend a tea party so she could resolve her identity crisis. Jinx accidentally shot Silco while protecting her sister, after which she abandoned "Powder" completely and fully embraced her identity as "Jinx," claiming that their bond had been irreparably changed. Later, Jinx was horrified to learn that Vi had joined the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers")—the very people who had killed their parents—just to pursue her into Zaun. Believing that Vi would never forgive her, Jinx engineered one final trap in the temple, which was intended to result in her own death at Vi's hands. Jinx's plan failed, in large part because Jinx and Vi still loved each other, despite feeling unable to reconcile.

When Jinx and Vi met again, Jinx had discovered Vander in the form of  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), and since some time had passed she once again sought help from her older sister, believing it had been a mistake for them to try and save him alone the last time. While their relationship was still rocky, they were eventually able to forgive each other when they managed to bring back Vander's memories. However, Jinx's past trauma was still very much alive, and the moment they lost Vander again Jinx decided she was unworthy of Vi's love, attempting to cut herself out of her life again as a means to protect her.

In the final battle against the Noxians, Jinx was eventually convinced she could use her inventions for good and returned to save Vi's life, despite all the pain she deemed herself responsible for in the past. During the battle, she declared that no matter what she was always with Vi, even when they were "worlds apart." After the battle, Vi cried in anguish as Jinx activated her bomb, as she seemingly sacrificed herself to save her sister's life.

Felicia was  [Violet](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") and Powder's mother, and she was a miner and strong believer in the nation of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") so that she could create a better life for her children. On some days, she would come home and make soup for Powder and marked her and Vi's heights on the wall of their tiny house in the Fissures. Felicia's close friends,  [Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") and  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco"), both shared her dream for the whole of the undercity, but this would unfortunately lead to Felicia's death in the Day of Ash, where a mass protest by Zaunites turned into a massacre by the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers"), and Felicia and her husband  [Connol](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Connol "Universe:Connol") were among the many people killed. As she was still very young, Powder was frightened by the violence but did not fully comprehend the severity of what had happened, but was able to recognize the Vi's sadness when she saw their parents' bodies and moved to comfort her.

After she grew up, Jinx remembered very little about her mother, besides the fact that she had been murdered by Enforcers (a fact which informed her disgust towards  [Topside](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and led her to view  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") as a traitor for joining them). After Silco's death, Jinx searched a safe in his office and found a photo of him with Felicia and Vander. Jinx barely recognized her mother, but knew it was her due to the striking resemblance between herself and the woman in the image. Jinx also knew of Felicia's favorite song [Our Love](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Arcane_(Soundtrack)#Season_1 "Arcane (Soundtrack)"), which was a song she and Vander used to dance to together in The Last Drop.[[2]](#cite_note-Jinx_Fixes_Everything-2)

[Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") was a close friend of Powder and  [Violet's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") mother,  [Felicia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Felicia "Universe:Felicia"), and as such, they both knew him from a young age. After the Day of Ash left the sisters orphaned, Vander was overcome by guilt and hung up his gauntlets, taking the two of them in as his own children, giving them a room with a bunk bed in the basement of his bar, The Last Drop. Vander raised them both to be better than himself, and although Vi was the one he primarily gave these lessons to, Vander also doted on and was deeply protective of Powder, frequently listening to [Our Love](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Arcane_(Soundtrack)#Season_1 "Arcane (Soundtrack)") on the jukebox and pouring juice into her favorite cup, which she decorated with artwork. She would remember these days fondly years later,[[2]](#cite_note-Jinx_Fixes_Everything-2) and when Vander was kidnapped and brought to  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") hideout in the cannery, Powder was driven to save him with the rest of their family, which led to a tragic accident where  [Mylo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mylo "Universe:Mylo") and  [Claggor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Claggor "Universe:Claggor") were killed by debris, and Vander fell and was left for dead after being stabbed and overdosing on shimmer. The sight of Vander's body and Vi's visceral reaction to the event left Powder traumatized, and for years she was haunted by guilt and images of Vander, eventually declaring that Powder had died that day too.[[20]](#cite_note-The_Adventures_of_Jinx-20)

After several years of blaming herself for Vander's death, Jinx would unexpectedly find him again within Warwick, the chemtech beast that attacked her in Stillwater Hold. While his memories only occurred in flashes, Jinx was determined to bring her father back, possibly as a way to make up for her tragic mistake all those years ago. She risked her life many times trying to calm him down and even mended her relationship with Vi in order to save him. When Vander's mind was eventually saved and their family was reunited, Jinx wept tears of joy as she hugged them both. After this, Jinx and Vi worked to fully bring back his memories and calm his violent urges by bringing him to  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), a healer who was said to work miracles. After her battle with  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"), Warwick saved Jinx at the last moment, declaring that she was his daughter before hurling the Noxian through the glass.

Unfortunately, Jinx's reunion with Vander was short-lived, as he had become connected to Viktor's hivemind and lost control when the Herald was shot by  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce"). The two were separated, and by the time she saw Warwick again, he had already been recaptured by  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") and  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") and transformed into part of Viktor's evolved army, which attacked Piltover and came into conflict with Jinx and Vi. Jinx seemed reluctant to fight her father, but seemed to recognize that he was gone and could not be saved. Jinx managed to finally defeat Warwick while hugging him one last time before activating her monkey bomb, and they seemingly perished in the explosion together.

After her monkey bomb killed her family, as well as her perceived abandonment by  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), Powder was orphaned once again and all alone, sobbing in the rain. She turned to the first person who was there to seek comfort, which turned out to be Silco. To the surprise of Silco's henchmen, he comforted the young girl after learning she had been "betrayed" by her sibling, as he had been by  [Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") all those years ago in the polluted waters of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"). Silco declared that they would both get their revenge one day, and he took her under his wing as his own child. Silco became the most powerful of the  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons"), and Jinx was Silco's precious adopted daughter and most trusted agent. He covered up her messes, and never punished nor blamed her—only rarely remonstrating her when she got way out of hand. He loved her as his own even when other agents disliked her and her tactics, and other barons, like  [Finn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Finn "Universe:Finn"), believed she was making him weak. Silco trusted Jinx to administer shimmer injections to his disfigured eye and to carry out his most important schemes. He sought to mentor and unlock what he saw as her full potential, urging her to let Powder die and fully embrace her "stronger" self, as he had when Vander nearly drowned him. Silco brought Jinx to the same waters where he was "reborn", baptizing her when her past trauma was preventing her from completing a [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") weapon to use against topside.

To gain Silco's favor, Jinx sought to become formidable to gain his approval, seeing him as the only one willing to take her in when everyone else had left her or died because of her. However, her trust in Silco began to waver when she discovered Vi was alive and in Zaun, and that Silco hadn't told her when he found out. Jinx was furious about this and confronted him violently, but she relented when Silco insisted he was protecting her, saying Vi was there for the gemstone and would abandon her again. After Jinx battled  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko") on the bridge, Silco found her left for dead and he hastily rushed to her to check on her condition, despite the danger of being captured by approaching reinforcements from Piltover, ignoring his high status among his subordinates who came with him. To save his daughter's life, Silco was willing to use any means necessary, even if it meant a painful shimmer procedure at the hands of  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed"), who sedated Silco to prevent him from interfering. Jinx finally turned on Silco when she overheard the Piltover Council offered him Zaun's independence if he handed her over, and believing he had betrayed her, she kidnapped and tied him up at the tea party with Vi and  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"). Here, she accidentally killed Silco to save Vi, he still comforted her in his dying moments and told her that he wouldn't give her up for anything, as she realized what she had done. She later held a private funeral for Silco, releasing him into the depths where Vander had tried to drown him, which had given birth to his cunning and ruthlessness.

After Silco's death, Jinx returned to his office at least twice. She also tried to speak to him while sitting in front of his chair, telling him about  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha") and wondering aloud if he had felt the same taking an orphan under his wing. She sought his advice about Zaun making her into a symbol for revolution—a role she was reluctant to accept—but part of her believed she owed it to Silco as she blamed herself for his death. However, Jinx at this point in time had stopped hearing Silco's voice, and she became frustrated that he was not responding to her conversation, believing this meant he was truly gone. Later Jinx eventually found a note from Vander intended for Silco, in which he apologized for trying to drown him. After reading it, Jinx regretted that Silco had never seen it, as it might have allowed things to turn out differently.

When Jinx turned herself in to the Piltovan authorities, she spoke with a hallucination of Silco in her cell as they lamented the tragic cycle of violence that had doomed them both. Silco's voice convinced Jinx to "break the cycle," which she could only accomplish by finding the strength to walk away from the conflict.

Ekko and Powder were childhood best friends, as they were similar age and had similar interests,[[21]](#cite_note-21) like tinkering with their custom-made inventions. They used to play a paintball game together where he would attempt and fail to dodge her shots. After Powder was adopted by  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") and became Jinx, Ekko led the resistance against the  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons") by founding the  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights"), and the two of them became bitter enemies. When the Firelights established their base, they painted a mural of all the people they had lost. Powder was included in the mural, signifying that Ekko believed his childhood friend was gone forever.

Although Jinx remembered Ekko as a significant enough part of her past to remember, she notably did not experience hallucinations of him as she would with the others closest to her, and she also did not attempt to reunite or make peace with him like she eventually would with  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"). She fought against Ekko and the Firelights for many years, often with devastating results, as she killed at least five of Ekko's friends among the Firelights in one battle alone.

At their battle on the bridge, Ekko likened it to their childhood paintball game, and as Jinx played along, he used the vivid memory to accurately predict where she would shoot. Although Ekko usually lost these games when they were children, he avoided Jinx's gunfire and defeated her on the bridge, but seeing his childhood friend beaten and bloody on the ground caused him to hesitate, and he couldn't bring himself to deliver the final blow. That sentimentality distracted him, and she ended up detonating a bomb, injuring Ekko and gravely injuring herself. After the battle, Jinx did not search for or mourn Ekko, and it's unclear if she knew he survived.

The next time the two met was in Jinx's most hopeless moment, when she had decided to take her own life with a hextech grenade. Ekko arrived just in time to stop her and used his  [Z-Drive](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ekko#Z-Drive_Resonance "Ekko") to reverse the explosion repeatedly, trying to find the right words to change her mind. On the first three rewinds, Jinx tiredly ignored Ekko's pleas—telling him to "*Get out of here*", keeping silent on the second rewind, and saying it was "*too late*" on the third attempt—before detonating the grenade each time. On Ekko's next rewind, he reminded Jinx of their old friendship and asked her not to blow them both up. Realizing Ekko would be caught in the blast, Jinx threw herself into the chasm instead of activating the bomb so he would not die with her. After yet another rewind, Ekko managed to convince Jinx that her life was worth saving by saying that no matter what happened in the past, it was never too late to "*build something new, someone worth building it for.*" Jinx seemed confused as to why his attitude towards her had changed so radically since their last meeting, as she was unaware that he had both met and fallen in love with a version of her in a parallel timeline where [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") was never invented, Zaun was thriving, his friends and loved ones were alive and she had never stopped being friends with him.

Ekko invited Jinx to the  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights")' hideout, and the two proceeded to unite the people of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") to save  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") from  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") invasion, with Jinx fighting alongside the Firelights and using their insignia on her outfit and airship. After Jinx's seeming demise, Ekko privately mourned her during the memorial, sitting alone at the spot where he and the alternate timeline's  Powder had kissed.

Caitlyn was one of the surviving enforcers who survived Jinx's ambush during the bicentennial Progress Day attack, after which she made it her goal to untangle  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") conspiracy and recover the [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") gemstone Jinx had stolen. As Jinx was not informed by Silco of  [Vi's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") return, she didn't learn of Caitlyn's existence until later, when she captured and interrogated  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") for information. As their parents had been killed by  [Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Enforcers "Universe:Enforcers"), Jinx's entire perception of Caitlyn was twisted before she even met her, and she initially believed Sevika was lying and was later shocked that this wasn't the case. Vi's intimate relationship with Caitlyn confused Jinx and made her jealous, since she not only felt replaced but also thought Vi was not sincere in wanting her back. Rather, Jinx was worried Vi was trying to undermine her criminal activities in order to please her Enforcer girlfriend. She would be haunted by hallucinations of Caitlyn during her shimmer operation, where she had visions of Vi killing Powder to be with Caitlyn, and  [Singed's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") face being replaced by Caitlyn's as she writhed in pain.

After the procedure, Jinx snuck into the  [Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman") mansion and kidnapped Caitlyn after she was done taking a shower, tying her up at the tea party with Silco and Vi. Here, she offered Vi an ultimatum: kill Caitlyn in exchange for getting Powder back, as she saw Caitlyn as a villain who stole Vi from her. After Vi refused the ultimatum, Jinx proceeded to kill Caitlyn's mother,  [Cassandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassandra "Universe:Cassandra"), in her attack on the Council, though Jinx was not aware that Caitlyn's mother was present in the building until after the fact. After her mother's death, Caitlyn became obsessed with hunting down Jinx, but Jinx had become largely indifferent to Caitlyn, as she was no longer concerned about Vi possibly abandoning her again, even playfully mocking Vi's romantic feelings towards Caitlyn. Their rivalry would continue for some time, with Caitlyn repeatedly trying and failing to find the right leads that would let her capture Jinx, and Jinx having largely given up on attacking  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and simply hiding in her lair. Caitlyn eventually became exhausted from her hatred and obsession, but held firm that she couldn't restore the Council until Jinx had been caught.

After a few months, Jinx and Caitlyn met again in  [Viktor's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") commune when Jinx saved her from being killed by  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"), and though Caitlyn was shocked and angry that Vi had kept Jinx's involvement in the plan a secret, she was unable to confront them about it before  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") forces attacked. After the battle, Jinx and Caitlyn brought Vi to safety, and Jinx turned herself in to the Enforcers, having given up on everything after  [Isha's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha") death. In her cell, Jinx refused any food Caitlyn gave her and seemingly accepted that she and Vi deserved to be happy together, saying she hadn't meant to kill Caitlyn's mother and that she should finally take her revenge by finishing her off. Caitlyn refused, then secretly reduced the number of guards so that Vi could sneak in and free her sister from her cell. After Jinx had seemingly perished in the final battle, Caitlyn appeared suspicious that Jinx was truly gone and began to investigate the Hexgate schematics and the remains of her monkey bomb.

Claggor was Jinx's elder adopted brother back when she was still Powder. Unlike Mylo, Claggor was usually calm, quiet, and caring toward Powder and didn't ridicule her. After the bomb exploded during the rescue mission of Vander, he died. Jinx built a doll version of him, including his signature goggles. She doesn't hear his voice as much as the other ones of her deceased family. After his death, Jinx would sometimes use his goggles while constructing machinery, until they were eventually taken by  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi").

Mylo was her elder adopted brother back when she was still Powder. He'd often ridicule her for her clumsiness and incompetence for completing missions, saying she jinxed every mission, and often compared her to her older sister. They often butted heads, where Mylo struggled with things Powder exceeded in, such as shooting. After Powder was left behind during the rescue mission of Vander, she eventually came to try to help ultimately leading to Mylo's death. Jinx is later haunted by his voice, becoming the embodiment of her doubts, anxieties, and self ridicule. She also dressed a mannequin up in his image to talk to in her lair. After Silco's death, she almost stopped hearing Mylo's voice, finally coming to terms with her identity as a "jinx." Echoes of her ghosts appeared at the moment when Jinx panicked because Isha was captured and thrown into prison.

Isha is a little girl from Zaun whom Jinx saved from  [Chross'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross") chem-goons, after which Isha began to follow Jinx. At first, Jinx treated Isha as a small and fun addition to her life, who simply tagged along as she and  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") fought Vi and Caitlyn. During a fight with Vi and Caitlyn, Isha protected Jinx by putting herself between them, and Jinx was seemingly confused as to how Isha could possibly care about her.

After a while, Isha and Jinx began living together and they would become friends, arranging fighting matches between Jinx's pet bugs Stink Maw and Scuttle Butt. Isha's presence had a good effect on Jinx, making her calmer and happier, and she would put more lights and colors in her previously gloomy lair. They spent a lot of time together while Jinx was in hiding, having fun, dancing, painting grafitti and walking around the city together. Isha was shown to deeply admire Jinx and began to imitate her appearance and behavior. She had drawings in the form of clouds, like Jinx tattoos, and many X marks, similar to the cross on Jinx's chest. Eventually, Isha later asked Jinx to dye her hair blue, similar to the Jinxers.

Jinx showed a lot of concern for Isha's safety. She mentioned in a conversation with Silco's chair that she found a friend whom she would not like to lose. When she found out that Isha was captured by Enforcers and Noxians, Jinx became visibly panicked and experienced hallucinations, and while Isha could be seen among these, she did not appear aggressive like the others. At Stillwater, Jinx was ready to fight Warwick to distract him while Sevika brought Isha to safety. She also stopped fighting with Vi in the mines after Isha got hurt, and would remain close to her while encouraging her. When Isha eventually sacrificed herself to save Jinx from the raging Warwick, Jinx became deeply depressed, believing this proved that the people she cared about were doomed to suffer because of her.

Jinx would eventually memorialize Isha in the design of her war balloon and her costume, with much of the decorative paint job being associated with Isha and Jinx drawings.

After Jinx was adopted by  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco"), Sevika rose to the rank of second-in-command, responsible for making sure her boss's operations went smoothly. However, she and Jinx had a strained relationship, as both competed for Silco's favor and Jinx was responsible for destroying her arm. Sevika saw Jinx as a loose cannon, unhinged and often prone to violent outbursts that result in things going out of control. Still, Sevika's respect for Silco was ultimately stronger than her hostility to Jinx, and they managed to work together for a long time, with Sevika even giving Silco parenting advice on occasion.

After Silco's death, a power struggle between the chembarons began in Zaun, with some of them thinking it'd be better to hand Jinx over to the Topsiders. Despite the difficult relationship with Jinx, Sevika refused, saying that she would not give up her people. Sevika and Jinx met again in Silco's office, and although Sevika initially thought Jinx wanted to kill her, they eventually bonded over the fact that they both missed Silco. As a reconciliation gift, Jinx made a new arm for Sevika, which appeared specially-designed to suit her love for gambling, and Sevika saved multiple times in return, first against  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech") and later against  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") and  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi").

When Jinx became a symbol in the undercity against Piltovan oppression, and Sevika sought to use her newfound image to complete Silco's dream of a united nation of Zaun. However, Jinx was disinterested in being viewed as a hero, in large part due to her low self-image. The matter led to several arguments between Sevika and Jinx, but Sevika still hoped Jinx would change her mind and join her at the rally. Later on, Jinx and Sevika teamed up directly to rescue  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha") and the others from Stillwater Hold, and Sevika obeyed Jinx's request to get Isha to safety as she distracted Warwick, showing faith in Jinx's abilities as a fighter.

While Sevika was initially reluctant to help Piltover in their war against the  [Noxians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), she later arrived as part of the Zaunite force following Jinx's war balloon, suggesting that Jinx was the one who changed her mind by uniting the undercity against  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor").

Jinx and Singed were both notorious henchmen of  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") criminal empire, but did not interact to a great extent, as the doctor was often away working in his laboratory. Still, Jinx was familiar enough with his work to believe he'd be capable of developing a [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") weapon, and asked Silco to give the gemstone to him instead. Silco did not trust Singed as much as he trusted Jinx, and she eventually decided to crack the hextech without Singed's help.[[10]](#cite_note-105enemy-10) Later, when Jinx had been critically wounded in her battle with Ekko, Silco brought Jinx to Singed for treatment. The doctor's procedure was long and excruciating, worsening her already fragile mental state, but Singed appeared largely callous to how much pain he was causing Jinx. When the procedure was finished, Jinx escaped from his lab with new superhuman abilities, and the doctor was simply satisfied that he had "saved her life."[[3]](#cite_note-108oil-3)

Jinx encountered Singed again in Stillwater Hold, but she did not interact with him, nor did she seem to be aware that he was the creator of  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), the chemtech beast that was attacking them. After getting Isha to safety and learning Warwick was Vander, she did not return to free Singed from his cell, indicating she did not care what happened to him.[[15]](#cite_note-204paint-15)

structure.name: Margot
structure.background:
### Early Life

After  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") took over  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), Margot made a name for herself as the boss of the Vyx, an illicit enterprise that specializes in prostitution, and became affiliated with several other crime lords who were also loyal to Silco, creating the first generation of  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons").[[1]](#cite_note-107boy-1) She would also take complete control of the undercity's pleasure industry, with every brothel answering to her influence.

### Border Crisis

After the actions of  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), Silco's adoptive daughter, led  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") to shut down the border between Zaun and  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), trade between the two cities came to a sudden halt, causing Margot's criminal ventures to lose massive profits. Frustrated by the fact that Silco was doing nothing to keep Jinx under control, Margot and the other chem-barons scheduled an assembly to discuss their next move, in which  [Finn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Finn "Universe:Finn") attempted to convince her to join him in a coup against Silco. However, before she could give him an answer, Silco arrived on the scene and unleashed a toxic gas in the air to remind the barons of the oppressive life that he had saved them from, which was enough to convince Margot to fall back in line.[[1]](#cite_note-107boy-1)

### Turf War Period

After the deaths of Silco, Finn, and  [Renni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni"), a massive power vacuum opened across each of their former territories, and sensing opportunity, the three remaining chembarons—Margot,  [Chross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross"), and  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech")—began vying to expand their holdings and seize control of the undercity at the expense of each other. Margot sent her army of chemgoons to fight Chross in particular after he raided her Rapturewalk, and while they were in the middle of fighting, one of her stashes and the number of henchmen guarding it were attacked by a squad of  [Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") using the Gray.

After it became clear the turf wars were only leading to more casualties,  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") called an assembly of the three chembarons in an attempt to convince them to unite against an impending invasion from topside; a direct result of Jinx's recent attack on the Piltover Council. Chross and Margot refused to work together, and Smeech argued that the best solution to appease topside was to hand over Jinx instead of fighting back.[[2]](#cite_note-202watch-2)

Smeech's plan to get topside off their backs failed, and after his death, the strike team led by  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") completely dismantled the criminal enterprises of both Chross and Margot, stripping them both of their chembaron status.[[3]](#cite_note-203finally-3)
structure.appearance:
Margot is a slender and petite woman with pale skin and dirty blonde hair that is dyed black at the tips. She wears dark makeup and lipstick, and wears a revealing outfit made of black leather, red cloth, and gold accessories.

Margot has valves across her body that allow her to tighten her skin to appear younger.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
structure.personality: Not much is know about Margot's personality, aside from the fact that she cares a great deal about her business and was willing to question Silco's leadership when he was indirectly responsible for a Piltovan blockade that cost her huge profits. After Silco's death, she would attempt to take Silco's chair for herself, refusing to work with the other chembarons out of pride or spite.
structure.abilities: - **Leader:** As a chem-baroness and leader of the  [Vyx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Vyx "Universe:The Vyx"), Margot was able to dramatically expand her influence as a crime lord under  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") leadership of the undercity.

relations.relationship_description: Margot was one of the chembarons active during Silco's reign over  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"). Her company, The Vyx, provided pleasure services in the undercity, catering to any impulse, persuasion, or inclination.

Margot and Silco established a business relationship during his rise as leader of the undercity, and Margot would become one of Silco's top lieutenants along with four other  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons"). Margot's enterprise thrived under Silco's leadership, but Silco was also not above using fear to keep his lieutenants in line, gassing Margot and the other chembarons with toxic smog before offering them all gas masks when they appeared to be conspiring against him. After Silco's death, Margot tried unsuccessfully to seize Silco's chair for herself in a series of turf wars.

Sevika was often present with  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") at the chembaron assemblies, and Margot was familiar with her. After Silco's death, Sevika tried unsuccessfully to convince Margot,  [Chross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross"), and  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech") to end their turf wars and unite against topside. Margot rejected Sevika's proposal, as she had little respect for Chross and Smeech and believed she'd be better off fighting on her own.

Margot had a contentious relationship with Chross and Smeech, blaming Chross for starting the turf wars when he raided her Rapturewalk and sending a majority of her henchmen to fight him on the streets. Margot knew Smeech was normally boastful and talkative during the chembaron meetings and immediately noticed something was off whenever he was quiet. She had little respect for either of them, and when all three chembarons were interested in taking  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") chair for themselves, she did not hesitate to try and expand her holdings at their expense.

Caitlyn and her strike team defeated Margot and her henchmen using the Gray, ending her reign as one of the  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons").
