structure.name: Claggor
structure.background:
### Early Life

At some point during his early childhood, Claggor lost his parents and was adopted by Vander as his son. While growing up under Vander's care, he became fast friends with his foster siblings— [Violet](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"),  [Powder](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), and  [Mylo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mylo "Universe:Mylo")—and the four of them often went on heists together in  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") to prove their worth to Vander and get him to treat them like adults.

Despite the incompetence that Powder demonstrated during their robberies, Claggor was on good terms with her and often protected her from Mylo whenever he bullied her for making mistakes and lagging behind. Also, due to his bulky build and his great strength, he eventually became the muscle of their little gang.

### The Robbery

During one particular trip to Piltover, Claggor and his siblings robbed a luxurious apartment in the upper city after being tipped off to its location by their good friend  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko"). On their way out of the apartment, Powder accidentally dropped one of the hex crystals that she'd collected, causing an explosion that destroyed most of the building and alerted the Enforcers to their presence. With no way left to enact their original escape plan, the four children were forced to flee on foot and escaped back to the undercity using one of the sewer tunnels between Piltover and Zaun.

While walking back home, the four children encountered  [Deckard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Deckard "Universe:Deckard") and three other thugs, who wanted a part of their loot for themselves. When Vi refused to give them anything, the two gangs got into a fist fight. Although Vi, Mylo, and Claggor managed to defeat their opponents, they failed to protect Powder from the thug who was chasing her, which ultimately forced her to toss the loot to get him off her tail. While Mylo was enraged that Powder had lost the loot, Claggor didn't blame her for tossing it to protect herself. With nothing left to take back with them, the four children returned to the Lanes and made it back to the Last Drop, where they were scolded by Vander for disobeying his orders to stay away from Topside.

After lecturing Vi for her reckless behavior, Vander took Claggor with him to  [Benzo's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Benzo "Universe:Benzo") shop. Upon arriving at the store, Claggor was immediately greeted by Ekko, who excitedly asked him about how the job went and told him about how he was able to find  [Jayce's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") apartment in the first place. However, before they could continue their conversation, two Enforcers suddenly showed up, forcing Claggor to dash off and leave Ekko behind at the store.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

### The Rescue

Although the four children didn’t have any intention of causing more trouble and agreed to lay low as Vander had told them to, the Enforcers became increasingly aggressive in hunting them down over the next few weeks, which resulted in Powder nearly getting caught twice.[[2]](#cite_note-2) Realizing that something had to be done to de-escalate the situation, Vander decided to offer himself up to the Enforcers in order to shield his children from punishment. However, before Sheriff  [Grayson](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Grayson "Universe:Grayson") and her subordinate  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus") could take him to Piltover, they were ambushed by  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") and Deckard, who killed Grayson and  [Benzo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Benzo "Universe:Benzo"), and kidnapped Vander.

Having witnessed Vander's capture from a nearby window, Vi returned home and told her siblings that their father had been taken and that she was going to rescue him. Although she allowed Mylo and Claggor to come with her, she told Powder to stay home, much to the latter's protests, until they got back. While Claggor was normally on Powder's side when it came to participating in their jobs, he did nothing this time to defend her and agreed with Vi's belief that this particular job was too dangerous for a girl of her age.

Vi, Mylo, and Claggor eventually made it to Silco's hideout and got to Vander without running into anyone along the way, but they didn't realize until it was too late that Silco had deliberately left him unguarded in order to trap them in. While Vi used Vander's iron gauntlets to fight off Silco's henchmen and Mylo got to work on unlocking Vander's shackles, Claggor grabbed his hammer and used it to smash a hole through the side of the room so that they'd be able to break out to safety.

### Death & Legacy

Unfortunately, before they could all escape through the hole that Claggor had made, a makeshift monkey bomb made by Powder, who had secretly followed them to Silco's hideout, suddenly exploded, destroying most of the building and knocking them all off-balance. The force of the explosion struck Claggor in the face with lethal force, knocking his goggles off his head and killing him on impact, and slammed him up against the wall. Right afterwards, a large chunk of the ceiling broke off and collapsed on top of him and Mylo, killing him as well and burying them both under a heap of rubble.[[3]](#cite_note-3)

After Claggor's death,  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko") had him memorialized on a painted mural inside the  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights")' hideout.[[4]](#cite_note-4) His goggles were also later recovered by  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") and placed on a wooden doll of him that she made and kept at her lair. Due to the guilt and trauma that she suffered from accidentally murdering him, Jinx was haunted by vivid hallucinations of Claggor in the years after she was adopted by Silco.[[5]](#cite_note-5) It was not until she was in her late teens that Jinx was finally able to let go of the remorse that she suffered from accidentally killing him and move on with her life. After she joined the Enforcers,  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") recovered Claggor's goggles while pursuing Jinx at the arcade where they all used to play.[[6]](#cite_note-202watch-6) She later kept his goggles as part of her uniform by wearing them on the top of her head.[[7]](#cite_note-203finally-7)
structure.appearance: Claggor was a tall, large, and muscular teenage boy with a round face, brown hair, and fair skin. He wore a yellow and blue shirt over another white long-sleeved shirt, which he kept fastened with leathers belts, buckles, and a large shoulder brace. Over his eyes, Claggor wore a pair of metal goggles with yellow frames and blue lenses.
structure.personality: Claggor was a gentle and good-natured boy who was very protective of his family. He had a mischievous side, as shown when he teased Mylo for his poor shooting skills, and was brave enough to take on several of Silco's thugs and overpower them with ease. He was also the most empathetic and caring of all of Vander's adoptive children, as displayed by how he always defended Powder from Mylo whenever he bullied her for making mistakes on their heists. As revealed by Jinx, he was also a big fan of fantasy novels and his favorite was a book called *"Sump Rat Dreams"*.[[8]](#cite_note-8)
structure.abilities: - **Brawler:** Claggor was a seasoned fighter and ranked second after Vi in fighting skill, as shown by how he easily took down his opponents when he and his siblings fought against Deckard and his thugs.

relations.relationship_description: Vander was Claggor's adoptive father, and Claggor was very obedient to his instructions. He tended to go on jobs for Vander, and as the strongest of the children, he would often help carry items to sell to  [Benzo's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Benzo "Universe:Benzo") shop. Claggor became nervous when  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") suggested breaking Vander's rule by going to rob an apartment on topside. After he found out about the heist, Vander had Claggor fill him in on all the details and they both went to have a word with their informant,  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko"). When Vander was later kidnapped, Claggor accompanied Vi and Mylo to go rescue him, attempting to break through a nearby wall so they would have an escape route.

Claggor was close with Vi, following her lead due to her maturity, but voicing his reservations when she wanted them to disobey Vander. When their robbery failed, Claggor lamented that they never should have left, but continued to follow Vi's leadership regardless. Later on, Claggor assisted Vi in rescuing Vander, which would become their very last mission together.

Years after Claggor's death, Vi would recover Claggor's goggles from  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") as she was following her trail as an enforcer. After collecting the goggles, Vi wore them on her head as an accessory to her uniform, likely as a token to remember him by.

Despite her being the smallest and weakest among them, Claggor had a quiet admiration for Powder's skills in shooting and engineering and did not make fun of her the way  [Mylo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mylo "Universe:Mylo") did. Whenever she and Mylo would argue, Claggor tended to take her side, and would make fun of Mylo for always losing to her at the arcade. After Claggor's death, she felt guilty about killing him and kept his blood-stained goggles, which she attached to a small stitched-up doll and kept strung up in her lair next to her effigy of Mylo.

Claggor and Mylo were adoptive brothers, and they partnered up frequently with  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), acting as her sidekicks on their adventures. Mylo enjoyed showing off and would frequently complain, to the point Claggor would sometimes get annoyed and smack him on the back of the head to shut him up. Claggor also favored  [Powder](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") whenever Mylo tried to argue with her, claiming that she was better at shooting that he was. Despite their bickering, however, Mylo and Claggor were quite close, and they continued to work closely as a team until they ultimately perished together under the rubble of Silco's warehouse.

Ekko, whom Vi's crew would affectionately refer to as "Little Man," acted as an informant on their heists, giving them tips about locations to rob and helping them to escape from the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") on occasion. When the robbery went sideways, Claggor spoke with Ekko outside  [Benzo's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Benzo "Universe:Benzo") shop and engaged in small conversation with him to ask how he found the location for the tip. After Claggor's death, Ekko would have him memorialized along with the rest of the family in the mural at the  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights") hideout.

structure.name: Nidalee
structure.quote: *"The untamed know no fear."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

As a cub, Nidalee was left abandoned in the heart of the eastern jungles that border both  [Ixtal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ixtal "Universe:Ixtal") and  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"). Though her true origins and how she got to the jungle remains unknown, she was eventually found by the mystical pakaa; cougar-like wildcats native to the jungles. The mother of this pack, roaming with her cubs, sensed a mysterious yet familiar scent on Nidalee and accepted her without hesitation, bringing her back to her den.

#### The Pakaa

Raised in the pakaa pack and treated as one of their own, Nidalee learned to hunt with her teeth and claws, becoming a capable huntress an honorary member of the pack. As she grew up, Nidalee would randomly enter strange moments of temporary half-transformation as her form shifted into a vaguely [humanlike](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Human "Human") appearance. One night, Nidalee underwent a transformation that caused her to get a fever. Wandering out of the den and delirious, she followed hazy visions of two mysterious figures whispering comforting words to her before fading away. Though she learned from her pakaa siblings to beware outsiders, she felt a sense of comfort from these mysterious figures despite their outsider appearances.

At the height of the summer rains, a group of [vastayan Kiilash](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kiilash "Kiilash") hunters stalked the jungle in search of prestigious beasts to slay and trophies to collect. Angered by the invasive outsiders on their territory, Nidalee's packmother attempted to chase them away but became wounded by the hunters' blades and spears. Before they could deal the killing blow, Nidalee lunged from the undergrowth and pounced on the Kiilash, howling with rage as she tore into them with her claws. Suddenly, she felt the spirit of another heritage rise within her, completely transforming her pakaa body into that of a humanoid figure. Cornered by the hunters and stuck in a strange new body, Nidalee quickly grasped one of the hunters'  [javelin spears](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Javelin_Toss "Nidalee") and used the weapon agaisnt them. Angered by her interruption of their hunt, the Kiilash spat out curses in their vastayan language, which Nidalee found she could inexplicably understand partialy.

After the Kiilash fled, Nidalee held her dying adoptive mother in her arms and grieved. Her fellow pakaa siblings surrounded her, wary of her new form but calmed by the comforting scent Nidalee carried. With their packmother now dead, the pakaa willingly accepted the mysterious shapeshifting Nidalee as their new leader.

### Modern History

As packmother, Nidalee vowed to protect the jungles from hunters that threatened her pack and her home. Overtime, she learned to better control her mysterious shapeshifting powers, learning to shift between both forms instantaneously. Nidalee also began to grow more adept with her strange humanoid form, learning how to take advantage of the environment to craft new tools,  [traps](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Bushwhack "Nidalee") and even  [healing salves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Primal_Surge "Nidalee") completely unknown to the pakaa. Though she still considers the pakaa as her family, she secretly yearned to discover her true origins and learn more about her shapeshifting abilities, hoping to one day find another being similar to her.

#### Meeting Neeko

When the [Oovi-Kat](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Oovi-Kat "Oovi-Kat")  [Neeko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Neeko "Universe:Neeko") infiltrated Nidalee's pack by curiously taking the shape of a fellow pakaa and leaping across the jungle with them, Nidalee noticed the strange impostor and shifted into her humanoid form. After a tense standoff between the two, Nidalee introduced herself and reluctantly accepted Neeko into her pack.

Neeko lived with Nidalee's pack for months, allowing the two to develop a strong and loving relationship with one another. The two felt a kinship unlike anything before, as Neeko felt a strong connection to Nidalee's vastayan heritage. Nidalee often mentored her new companion on the ways of surviving the jungle, while Neeko shared stories and culture of her Oovi-Kat tribe. The two were inseparable, often exploring the jungle together and enjoying its many wonders. At some point Neeko began to feel strong, romantic feelings for Nidalee, which went mostly unrequited for a time. However, Nidalee still shared a deep love for Neeko that she herself cannot fully understand, possibly blossoming into something more for their relationship.

Eventually, Neeko began to get mysterious visions of her ancestors and sought to follow them. Feeling drawn to the cities and towns of the outsiders that Nidalee despised, she sought to form a new tribe of her own and urged Nidalee to join her. Unfortunately, Nidalee could not be persuaded and the two departed as Neeko sought her own destiny beyond the jungles while Nidalee continued her duty of protecting the untouched wilderness of her home.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

#### The Kashdaji Queen

Continuing her protection of the jungles, Nidalee became infamous within the villages and communities of civilized outsiders that she despised. Because of her reputation for leaving very few alive whenever they trespass in her territory, stories about Nidalee began to circulate, describing her as a frightening, shapeshifting beast woman known as the *Kashdaji Queen.*

While patrolling the jungles one day, Nidalee found a reptilian vastaya caught in a trap laid by a hunter named Percy. Distracting Percy with her human-like appearance, she shifted into a pakaa cougar and pounced on him, threatening Percy to leave the jungles or die. Percy, now injured with a wound from Nidalee's spear, quickly fled the scene alive, frightened by the beast woman he encountered.

Nidalee proceeded to free the vastaya from the trap and heal his injuries, bandaging his tail and shoulder. The vastayan, introducing himself as  [Kuulcan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kuulcan "Universe:Kuulcan"), began to question Nidalee's heritage despite her insistence of being a fellow vastaya. Kuulcan however was not convinced, stating that he has never met a vastaya that resembled her before, which Nidalee brushed off and ignored before inviting Kuulcan to accompany her and her pack for a hunt.

That night, Nidalee and her pack followed Percy to his camp, where he told stories of his encounter to the rest of his colleagues. His fellow hunters however did not believe Percy's accounts of this 'beast woman' and instead pranced around singing lude songs about her. Out of the darkness, Nidalee and her pack quickly killed the rest of the hunters because of their unwillingness to leave her territory before Nidalee herself confronted Percy in pakaa form, stating again that she already warned him to leave before viciously killing him.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

#### The Gentle Flame

Nidalee made another friend with an outsider when she found one of the pakaa cubs taking a nap with a young Ixtali boy under a sunspot. Though initially distrustful of the boy for being a human outsider, she quickly warmed up to him when its revealed that he actually healed the cub with his magic. Learning the boy's name as  [Milio](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Milio "Universe:Milio"), she allowed him to travel with the pack on his journey to [Ixaocan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ixaocan "Ixaocan"), quickly befriending him and considering him another honorary cub of the pack. Nidalee accompanied Milio until he reached a nearby village, where he departed from the rest of the pakaa and continued on his journey. [[3]](#cite_note-3)

### Recent Events

#### Piltovan Poachers

- Nidalee reuniting with  [Neeko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Neeko "Universe:Neeko"), who is warning her of the  [Piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") poachers.
- Nidalee in her pakaa form confronting one of the poachers after ambushing them at their camp.

After Neeko got captured by a band of  [Piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") poachers led by  [Captain Rowain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Minor_Characters "Universe:Minor Characters"), she was quickly freed by the scientist  [Anura](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anura "Universe:Anura") and found herself reunited with Nidalee and the rest of her pack.[[4]](#cite_note-4) Having already encountered the poachers, Neeko warned Nidalee about them, stating that they were scouring the land for rare beasts to capture and hunt.

Wishing to protect her home and the wildlife, Nidalee gathered Neeko and the rest of the pack to plan an ambush on the the poachers' camp. When it turned night, Nidalee and her pack ambushed the camp, killing most of the poachers and freeing the captured wildlife to help them in the battle, such as the mighty towering 6 [pairofants](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Towering_Pairofant "LoR:Towering Pairofant").[[5]](#cite_note-5)
structure.appearance:
Nidalee is a dark-skinned woman with black hair, emerald green eyes, white tribal markings on her body and a green gem on her forehead. She often wears a pair of earrings fashioned from sharp animal teeth, a necklace adorned with teeth and usually wields a spear with markings on its tip adorned with four animal teeth and a rope on the back. Her usual appearance depicts her with her hair tied into a ponytail, a belt fashioned from animal teeth tied together, revealing clothing made from animal hide and thick fur boots.

In her  [cougar form](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Aspect_of_the_Cougar "Nidalee"), Nidalee retains the green eyes, markings and forehead gem shared with her human form, but instead wears a leather collar adored with animal teeth on her neck.
structure.personality: Nidalee is a fearsome huntress who embraces the nature of the wild and takes enjoyment from hunting prey. She is protective towards her pakaa and the jungle they live in, being distrustful towards outsiders who trespass into her tribe's homeland. She usually tries to intimidate them and chase them away, but won't hesitate to kill should they ignore her warnings.
structure.abilities:
- **[Vastayan Heritage:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya")** Though Nidalee's true species and nature is unknown even to her, she is aware that she has some form of vastayan heritage. Because of this, she is granted animalistic features akin to the pakaa cats she grew up with and some shapeshifting abilities. Along with that, her heritage allowed her to inexplicably know the language of the vastaya after her first encounter with a group of [Kiilash](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kiilash "Kiilash") hunters.
  - **[Shapeshifting](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Aspect_of_the_Cougar "Nidalee"):** Because of her vastayan heritage, Nidalee has the ability to shapeshift and alter her form completely. She can utilize this to shift minor changes in her appearance, such as pieces of fur clothing and animal features like cat ears, but she most notably uses this ability to shift between the body of a humanoid woman and a mighty pakaa. She can shift between her two forms with ease, mastering how to utilize her transformations and the skills that come with each form.
- **[Pakaa Cougar Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Takedown "Nidalee"):** Nidalee can take the form of a pakaa, a jungle cat cougar native to  [Ixtal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ixtal "Universe:Ixtal"). As a pakaa, Nidalee gains intense agility and the ability to quickly  [leap great distances](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Pounce "Nidalee") thanks to her new jungle cat physiology as well as feroicious teeth and  [claws](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Swipe "Nidalee") to strike with.
- **[Javelin Proficiency](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Javelin_Toss "Nidalee"):** In her humanoid form, Nidalee uses a javelin spear as her primary weapon. She can easily toss the large spear with precision at her opponents with intense strength and from long distances.
- **[Survival Mastery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Prowl "Nidalee"):** Having lived her whole life in the jungles, Nidalee has learned a multitude of unique survival skills thanks to her humanoid form. Nidalee has learned how to build  [traps](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Bushwhack "Nidalee") and weapons out of natural materials, craft  [healing salves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee#Primal_Surge "Nidalee") out of  [honeyfruit](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Honeyfruit "Honeyfruit") and how to generally utilize the land's seeds and flowers to protect and illuminate her territory.

relations.relationship_description: Nidalee was adopted by a pakaa packmother when she was abandoned as an infant in the jungles. Though her origins are an enigma, she was accepted by the pack as one of their own and she grew up deeply loving the other pakaa as her siblings, or *kupakaa*. After her mother was killed by a party of Kiilash hunters, Nidalee became the pakaa's new packmother, having vowed to protect her family and her home from outside invaders.

Though Nidalee is unsure of what her true nature is, she knows that she has some connection to the vastaya, identifying as such whenever people ask what she is. When she first underwent a complete transformation, Nidalee inexplicably understood the natural vastayan language and retains her shapeshifting abilities from this heritage.

#### Kiilash

A hunting party of Kiilash were responsible for the death of Nidalee's packmother, ultimately causing her first full transformation and allowing Nidalee to take up the mantle of packmother. The Kiilash, angered for their hunt being interrupted, cursed at Nidalee in their vastayan language before running away.

Since then, Nidalee has developed a disdain towards the Kiilash, such as  [Rengar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rengar "Universe:Rengar"), seeking vengeance for the death of her adoptive mother.

#### [Neeko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Neeko "Universe:Neeko")

When Neeko temporarily joined Nidalee's pack, the two became inseparable and formed an intensely loving friendship with one another. Nidalee gladly taught Neeko many survival skills and the two reveled in the many wondrous sights of the wilderness. When Neeko sought to fulfill her own journey, she urged Nidalee to follow but was unable to persuade her, causing them to depart as Neeko traveled outside of the jungles. When Neeko became freed from being captured by a band of Piltovan poachers, she reunited with Nidalee and the two ambushed the poachers under the cover of night.

Neeko shared, and possibly still shares, immense romantic feelings towards Nidalee, but these feelings went largely unrequited for a while as Nidalee remains unsure of what her feelings truly mean. Though she's not sure what her relationship with Neeko could blossom into, she's absolutely certain that she deeply cares for Neeko exclusively in a way she has never felt for anyone else. With them reunited, new feelings are beginning to arise as the two share an even deeper bond.

#### [Kuulcan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kuulcan "Universe:Kuulcan")

Nidalee met Kuulcan when he was trapped by a hunter named Percy. After freeing him and scaring the hunter into fleeing, the two conversed as Kuulcan questioned Nidalee's heritage, unconvinced that she is a simple vastaya and noting her unique nature. That same night, Nidalee invited Kuulcan to join her and her pack on a hunt, following Percy back to his camp and killing the rest of the hunters for not leaving her territory.

Nidalee dislikes almost all outsiders and 'civilized' peoples, most notably humans. Though her appearance is most similar to that of a human, she holds a disdain for them because of their constant hunting and poaching in her territory and actively denies any claims that she herself is just a human.

#### [Piltovans](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover")

Because of the Piltovans' continuous hunt for resources in the jungles, they constantly expand and intrude onto Nidalee's territory, poaching the sacred wildlife for profit. Referring to them as *brass-bones*, Nidalee makes an effort to chase them out of her territory, willing to even kill to do so.

#### [Captain Rowain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Minor_Characters "Universe:Minor Characters")

Most recently, Nidalee has faced off against a band of poachers led by 7 [Captain Rowain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Big_Game_Tycoon "LoR:Big Game Tycoon"), having a vicious hatred for one another as Rowain sees Nidalee as an obstacle in his quest to monopolize the beasts of the jungle. These poachers began capturing and hunting down many creatures in Nidalee's territory, which she only learned of after 3 [Anura](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Anura_%26_Froop "LoR:Anura & Froop") freed a captured Neeko from their captivity and allowed her to alert Nidalee of the poachers. That night, Nidalee and her pack ambushed the poachers at their camp.

#### Percy

Percy is the hunter that Nidalee caught trying to capture Kuulcan, tossing a javelin into his shoulder and threatening him to leave. When he returned to his camp of hunters, they mocked him for his story about a mythical 'beast-woman' in the jungles, eventually leading to them getting ambushed by the pakaa and getting killed.

#### [Milio](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Milio "Universe:Milio")

Nidalee first found Milio resting under a sunspot with one of the pakaa cubs. Though she was initially distrustful of the young human outsider, she instantly warmed up to him when she learned that he actually saved the cub by healing her with his magic. The boy accompanied Nidalee and her pack during his journey to the city of [Ixaocan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ixaocan "Ixaocan"), quickly befriending the pack and Nidalee. Eventually, Milio made it to his next stop at the nearest town and had to depart from the pack.

Milio was aware of Nidalee from stories calling her the fearsome 'Kashdaji Queen,' but was ultimately surprised by how loving she truly is once you get to know her. Milio states in his journals that, because of Nidalee's strong personality, she reminds him of his own grandmother in a way. To Milio, Nidalee expresses a softer personality not normally seen by others, considering him an 'honorary pakiti' and even nicknaming him 'Little Fire-Bug.'

structure.trivia:
- Nidalee's true species is unknown, but she has diluted [vastayan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") heritage that gives her shapeshifting abilities.[[6]](#cite_note-6)
- Nidalee's pack are the pakaa, a species of cougar in  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra"), while the word 'pakiti' refers to the kittens.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
  - Packmates and siblings within Nidalee's pack are referred as 'kupakaa.'[[8]](#cite_note-8)
- The  [Ixtali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ixtal "Universe:Ixtal") and other outsiders call Nidalee's pack the 'kashdaji,' which is seen as somewhat as an insult to the pakaa. The word is akin to referring to a wildcat as a regular house cat.[[9]](#cite_note-9) When Nidalee became packmother, outsiders began to refer to her as the 'Kashdaji Queen.'

structure.name: Neeko
structure.quote: *"The Oovi-Kat are gone. Neeko must build her own tribe, now."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Neeko is a [vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") born in the [Oovi-Kat](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Oovi-Kat "Oovi-Kat") tribe, who lived on a [remote island](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Oovi-Kat_Island "Oovi-Kat Island") far to the east of [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Valoran "Valoran"). The Oovi-Kat retained most of their ancient heritage, tracing their lineage back to the [vastayashai'rei](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastayashai%27rei "Vastayashai'rei")—the ancestors of all vastaya. The Oovi-Kat lived in a peaceful and harmonious paradise that blended into the [spirit realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm"). Because of this, the Oovi-Kat had a talent in sensing the *Sho'ma*, or 'soul' of living beings, creating a society free of secrets. Neeko grew up in this tribe with a fondness for games and trinkets, growing a sense of innocence and curiosity for all things.

#### Cataclysm

When an undisclosed cataclysm devastated the Oovi-Kat, the elders of the tribe sacrificed themselves to allow some of the remaining vastaya to escape with their lives. Neeko, being among them, took the form of a bird and fled the smoldering destruction as her home faded into the border between realms.

Days later, Neeko became exhausted and clung to a plank of driftwood in the [Eternal Ocean](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Eternal_Ocean "Eternal Ocean"). She eventually came across a mercantile vessel travelling for [Harelport](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Harelport "Harelport") and crept aboard, resting where she could and calling into the spirit realm for her tribe. The only response she could get were scattered echoes and images of dead trees laying over the horizon.

#### Arrival In Harelport

When the vessel arrived in the city, Neeko emerged in an unfamiliar world bustling with unique personalities and shapes that were completely alien to her. Neeko became entranced with curiosity and wandered with awe, eventually being spotted by a vastayan sailor named Krete. He demanded to know what tribe she was a member of and, in response, Neeko reached into his Sho'ma and mimicked his appearance; an expression of friendliness and peace in Oovi-Kat culture. Krete became offended and frightened by Neeko's shapeshifting and, overwhelmed by his thoughts, Neeko fled into the crowd.

#### Encounter with Nidalee

Neeko eventually traveled out of Harelport and into the lush jungles of  [Ixtal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ixtal "Universe:Ixtal"). Seeking solace, she spotted a pack of *pakaa* from the trees; fierce and majestic jungle cats native to the forests. By taking their form, Neeko ran with them across the jungles. While enjoying this cougar-like form she took, the leader of this pack unexpectedly shapeshifted into a seemingly [human](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Human "Human") woman named  [Nidalee](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nidalee "Universe:Nidalee"). After a tense standoff, Nidalee reluctantly accepted Neeko into her pack.

Living within the pack, Neeko and Nidalee became inseparable as some sort of relationship blossomed between them, feeling a deep sense of kinship for Nidalee. For months, Nidalee enjoyed mentoring Neeko in the art of survival within the jungles and the two enjoyed wandering the wilds together.[[1]](#cite_note-1) Though Neeko began to feel intense romantic feelings for her new friend, these feelings went mostly unrequited, though still blossoming with lots of potential.

Though Nidalee despised the towns and cities of the civilized people, Neeko constantly felt an urge to curiously explore them and she longed to explore more of the world outside of the jungles. One night, Neeko's Oovi-Kat ancestors came to her in a dream, showing her the pale branches of dead trees and acting as an omen of warning to Neeko of the danger her people are in. With this, Neeko vowed to recreate the Oovi-Kat as an entirely new tribe of her own, wishing to venture out to pursue this personal journey. Though she urged Nidalee to join her, she could not be persuaded and the two parted ways to follow their own quests.

### Modern History

Neeko continued her journey to rebuild the Oovi-Kat in her own way, welcoming all beings whether they be like-hearted vastaya, [yordles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), humans and other creatures. Those that join her tribe are easily befriended by Neeko, who in turn vows to defend their sho'ma with her own life.

While travelling, Neeko found herself at a  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") Outpost at [Kalduga](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kalduga "Kalduga"). Curious to see if the Noxians were friendly, she snuck into the outpost and took the form of Ewaii, one of the patrolling soldiers at the outpost. While disguised, Ewaii's commander Yubbers began to yell commands at Neeko under the impression that she was in fact Ewaii.

Neeko then took a mote of Yubber's sho'ma, shifting her shape into his and confusing the soldiers even more. Eventually, Neeko got caught by the actual Yubbers and disappeared into a crowd of people while changing her shape. Mayhem ensued as the guards began to accuse one another and kill each other out of fear as Neeko snuck away. The soldiers abandoned the outpost completely, each going their separate ways and uncertainty of who was secretly Neeko all along.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

### Recent Events

At some point, Neeko got captured by a band of  [Piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") poachers led by 7 [Captain Rowain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Big_Game_Tycoon "LoR:Big Game Tycoon"). These poachers sought to catch and eventually sell exotic creatures of the jungles in hopes of making a large profit. A scientist who had been hired by the poachers named 3 [Anura](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Anura_%26_Froop "LoR:Anura & Froop"), alongside her pet frog Froop, felt sympathy for the captured vastaya and devised a massive escape plan to free her.[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Successfully freed from her capture by the poachers, Neeko found herself back in the jungles and reunited with her old friend Nidalee. Neeko warned Nidalee of the poachers and the two planned to drive them out of the jungle. Under the cover of night, Nidalee and Neeko ambushed the poachers' encampment alongside the rest of the pakaa pack and some 6 [other wildlife](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Towering_Pairofant "LoR:Towering Pairofant"), driving them out of the forests.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
structure.appearance: Neeko is a female vastaya that has a teen-like appearance and some characteristics of a chameleon, like scales and reptile eyes. She has very colorful hair with glands sprouting out of her head which she uses to capture others' Sho'ma. She wears tribal clothes and walks barefoot.
structure.personality: Neeko has a very jovial and fun-going personality. She is somewhat innocent and unaware the dangers that surround her. She does not comprehend most of human society and relationships, and some of the words, so she usually creates chaotic scenarios thanks to her naivety.
structure.abilities:
- **Vastayan Physiology:** Neeko is a Vastaya, an ancient race of demi-humans changed by magic of the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm"). This connection to the Spirit Realm has increased their longevity and granted them powerful magics, allowing them to live for centuries. Neeko is a member of the Oovi-Kat tribe of vastaya; reptilian vastaya that resemble chameleons.
  - **[Spiritual Magic:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Neeko#Pop_Blossom "Neeko")** Because the Oovi-Kat retained most of their heritage directly connected to the [Vastayashai'rei](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastayashai%27rei "Vastayashai'rei"), Neeko has strong ties to the Spirit Realm and access to lots of magical abilities tied to it. She can utilize this is many different ways, such as firing  [blasts of energy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Neeko#Shapesplitter "Neeko") at her opponent, restraining enemies with  [vine-like energies](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Neeko#Tangle-Barbs "Neeko") or creating a burst of colorful flowers to damage and blind enemies.
    - **[Shapeshifting:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Neeko#Inherent_Glamour "Neeko")** By reaching into a person's *Sho'ma*, or their 'soul' according to Oovi-Kat culture, Neeko can instantly take the appearance of any being who has a soul. When Neeko shapeshifts into someone, she can tap into their inner feelings and memories but is unable to access their abilities.
    - **Spiritual Reading:** Neeko can inherently see the *Sho'ma* of living beings, or their 'soul.' Because of this, she can sense the inner feelings of beings around her and can see the true intentions and emotions of others, granting her a strong sense of empathy.
    - **[Illusion Creation:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Neeko#Shapesplitter "Neeko")** Neeko can create perfect duplicates of herself that last for a short amount of time before fizzling away, allowing her to deceive and confuse opponents.

relations.relationship_description: Neeko has spent some time with Nidalee and her pack. Though Nidalee wouldn't aid her in her further quests, they parted on relatively positive terms. Neeko is in love with Nidalee, and while the romantic feelings were unreturned, their interpersonal relationship is beginning to blossom.[[5]](#cite_note-5)[[6]](#cite_note-6) The two care for each other deeply and Neeko is perhaps the only person outside of her family whom Nidalee would risk her life for.
Neeko mimicked Ezreal in the jungle during his search for [The Elixir of Uloa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Elixir_of_Uloa "The Elixir of Uloa").

structure.trivia:
- Neeko is a few hundred years old, but her maturity is at the level of someone in their late teens or early twenties.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
  - She may be about 180 years old.[[8]](#cite_note-8)
- Neeko is **NOT** a Vastayashai'rei.
  - Neeko is not a pure Vastayashai’rei, but she is closer to it than most of the other vastaya. The Oovi-Kat tribe splintered off from the vastaya tribes very early and have largely lived in isolation, so their magic is more pure and ancient than other vastaya. There is very, very little human blood in Neeko’s lineage.[[9]](#cite_note-9)
  - It is revealed that Neeko being a Vastayashai'rei was a mistake in the script.[[10]](#cite_note-10)
- The Oovi-Kat looked at the shedding tails as milestones in maturity, like birthdays. This does not occur annually, but is linked to growth in the spiritual realm.[[11]](#cite_note-11) Neeko is currently on her fourth tail.
- The flowers on her head are actually beautiful glands, like the pineal gland, which allow Neeko to sense and interact with people's Sho'Ma.[[12]](#cite_note-12)
- Her favorite food is cheese bread.[[13]](#cite_note-Ask_Riot:_Neeko_Edition-13)
  - This is a reference to [pão de queijo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/P%C3%A3o_de_queijo), Brazilian cheese bread, because her voice actress is Brazilian.
- **Neeko** is better, faster at shapeshifting than other Vastaya types thanks to her more powerful connection to magic and being attracted to an animal spirit that is good at changing. Neeko could change her appearance dramatically in 2 seconds and hold it for several days.[[14]](#cite_note-14)[[15]](#cite_note-15) Neeko's size when shape shifting is only limited by the immensity of her shoma. She could become an exact replica of  [Galio](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Galio "Universe:Galio") but wouldn't be able to hold it for long.[[16]](#cite_note-16)
- Neeko has lines showing romantic interest in female champions and was confirmed by her writer, Matt "FauxSchizzle" Dunn, to be the first known lesbian champion.[[17]](#cite_note-17)
  - This can be seen in interactions with other champions in game, like being curious about Evelynn or askin Nami to meet her parents (in Legends of Runeterra)
    - Despite not liking males romantically, she finds some of them interesting, such as [Aurelion Sol](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aurelion_Sol "Universe:Aurelion Sol") saying that look fabulous, [Kled](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kled "Universe:Kled") because of their strange nature, [Ezreal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ezreal "Universe:Ezreal") calling him pretty or too pretty for a boy and [Rakan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rakan "Universe:Rakan") for his colours.
      - She also appears to understand [Dr. Mundo's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dr._Mundo "Universe:Dr. Mundo") mind despite how fractured it is, stating that he may only wants to fit.
