- Serylda † (Potential Previous Incarnation)

structure.name: Teemo
structure.quote: *"Bandle Scout Teemo, reporting for duty!"*
structure.background: Teemo had humble beginnings as a member of the Bandle Scouts, rising up the ranks with his survival expertise. Travelling across the material realm to obtain Bandle Scout badges, Teemo earned countless achievements throughout his career, which led to him being promoted to the Bandle Scouts' new leader. His diligence and enthusiasm inspired other yordles to join the Bandle Scouts, with his leadership garnering awe across Runeterra.
structure.appearance: Teemo is a short yordle with beige fur and brown markings on his eyes, which are always seen closed. He wears khaki gloves and boots, a furry red scarf, a telescope around his neck and his signature hat with red goggles on top. He carries a backpack which holds maps almost the same size as his body. He wields a blowgun with red, blue and yellow feathers tied to it.
structure.personality: A firm upholder of the Bandle Scouts' ideals, Teemo is always full of energy and holds dedication towards his scouting duties. As a role model among the Bandle Scouts and his fellow yordles, Teemo is welcoming towards new recruits and regularly documents his findings as well as the Bandle Scout rules, which he often updates whenever he makes up new ones. He usually has a calm, optimistic mood and is composed at all times.
structure.abilities:
- **Yordle Physiology:** Teemo is a Yordle, a being coming from the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm") and possesses several abilities natural of his species.
  - **Immortality:** Being spiritual beings, Yordles don't age the same way as normal humans, and they can't normally die.
  - **Yordle Magic:** Just like any [Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), Teemo is capable of performing yordle magic, which he utilizes in tandem with his skills as a scout.
- **Scouting Expertise**: As a veteran Bandle Scout, Teemo is well-versed at survival skills, leadership and navigation.
  - **[Stealth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Teemo#Guerrilla_Warfare "Teemo")**: Teemo is skilled at stealth, being able to silently evade detection from his enemies before ambushing them.
  - **Toxicology Expertise**: Teemo is knowledgeable with poisons, gathering Ajunta poison in [Kumungu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kumungu "Kumungu") and cultivating poisonous [puffcaps](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Puffcap "Puffcap") to use as traps.
- **[Enhanced Speed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Teemo#Move_Quick "Teemo"):** Teemo is capable of running at high speeds.

relations.relationship_description: Teemo and Tristana have a strong bond, with him considering her to be an important figure in his life. Whether their relationship is romantic or not is open to interpretation.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
Teemo shows respect towards Kled and is able to memorize his full title, though he expresses bewilderment towards the idea of the Bandle Scouts.

Teemo is friends with  [Corki](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Corki "Universe:Corki"),  [Lulu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lulu "Universe:Lulu") and  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen").

During [one of his mission](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Don%27t_Mess_With_Yordles "Don't Mess With Yordles") in  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater"), Teemo was captured by  [Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Graves "Universe:Graves") to earn bounty for Yordles, while  [Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Fate "Universe:Twisted Fate") did not interfere. He would later be saved by  [Corki](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Corki "Universe:Corki"),  [Lulu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lulu "Universe:Lulu") and  [Tristana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tristana "Universe:Tristana").
As seen briefly in his journal, Teemo may know about  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego").

structure.trivia: - Based on [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Legends_of_Runeterra "Legends of Runeterra") card lore, Teemo uses his Puffcap mushrooms as his  [Noxious Traps](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Teemo#Noxious_Trap "Teemo"), which he gets from the black market of [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zaun "Zaun").

structure.name: Rakan
structure.quote: *"I got freedom. I got a  [lady](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xayah "Universe:Xayah"). I got a cause I'd die for."*
structure.background:
### Early life

The Lhotlan vastaya once lived on the ancient, mystical borders of Ionia’s deep forests, on the eastern island of Qaelin. It was a place where magic was breathed like air, and time had little meaning. To these chimeric creatures, the lands of mortals were an unforgiving desert, virtually devoid of magic—and over the centuries, that desert only grew, encroaching on the vastaya’s territories.

Rakan was born into a tribe in decline, yet he never gave up hope.

Like his brethren, Rakan watched as human settlements continued to expand, damming the flow of Ionia’s wild, chaotic magic for their own safety. Many tribes sent emissaries to negotiate with them, securing treaties to protect the mystical energy the vastaya needed to thrive. Yet over and over again, these promises were broken.

Disillusioned, most vastaya became increasingly isolationist as they clung to their remaining lands. But young Rakan advocated a different path. The battle-dancer believed that mortals could be convinced to let wild magic run free if they could only appreciate its beauty, and he boasted that he was the one to make them see it. For this, he was labeled *mu’takl*—distrusted as a human sympathizer, and collaborator.

Rakan left the Lhotlan tribe, determined to spread the song of his people across Ionia. He was an entertaining rogue, a welcome performer at any tavern or village carnival, but over the years he realized that was *all* he was to mortals—no matter how many dances and songs he performed, no matter how much he enthralled the crowds, he merely provided diversion to drunken revelers.

Rakan grew restless, finding himself without purpose... until he had a chance encounter with Xayah, a fellow Lhotlan, at the harvest festival in Vlonqo.

Seeing her in the crowd, Rakan sang one of his old songs, entrancing the entire town with his gleaming plumage. Though countless human and vastayan women had fallen for him in the past, this violet raven seemed immune to his charms, though not uninterested.

How could she see him and yet choose not to follow him? It was a puzzle with no easy answer.

Intrigued, the battle-dancer approached Xayah and asked after the welfare of their tribe. When she told him that the Lhotlan had lost the last of their lands, Rakan howled with rage. This finally seemed to impress Xayah, and she assured him that there was still hope: she was part of something greater, a rebellion of sorts, to take back what the vastaya had lost. Not just for the Lhotlan, but for all tribes.

Rakan was thunderstruck. Here was a chance for him to redeem his people, a cause he was willing to die for. He implored Xayah to let him accompany her, and she agreed—as long as he carried his weight.

And, as Xayah would soon learn, Rakan’s dances were as impressive in battle as they were on stage. He called himself the greatest battle-dancer in Lhotlan history, a boast that none could refute. His grand entrances and dazzling acrobatics distracted and befuddled enemies, before Xayah felled them with her razor-sharp quills. In any dangerous situation, they fought together with uncanny harmony.

### Contemporary history

During their travels, Rakan became fascinated by how Xayah interacted with the world. She seemed always prepared, aloof, and focused... whereas he was absent-minded, affable, and lacking seriousness. Although Rakan would often forget her carefully laid plans, he made up for it with his ability to read the emotions of others, using charisma and insight to persuade them. The two vastaya were so different, and yet they achieved great feats, each one’s strengths complementing the other’s weaknesses.

Soon enough, Rakan couldn’t imagine life without Xayah, and it was clear that she felt the same for him. The pair pledged themselves to each other in the midst of a raucous tavern brawl.

Yet they did not see eye to eye in all things. Where she viewed the world as black and white, with mortals always the enemy, he had more compassion, and believed some of them were redeemable. Despite this difference, Rakan was certain that his and Xayah’s love for each other would bear them through the storms that lay ahead.

Through Xayah, Rakan has found purpose. Inspired by his partner’s singular drive, Rakan has made her crusade his own, and together they will fight to reclaim the First Lands for the vastaya.
structure.appearance: Rakan has white hair, which is accentuated by a bold red stripe running through it. His small red cape conceals the base of vibrant yellow plumage, which cascades down like a regal cape. Adorning the cape is a single bird skull which keeps the cape in place. Shirtless, he showcases two bracers on his arms, concealing additional yellow plumage underneath. Rakan wears azure pants which secured by a red rope belt adorned with bird skulls. True to his [Lhotlan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lhotlan "Lhotlan") lineage, Rakan bears avian features such as bird legs and pointed, feathered ears.
structure.personality: As his title suggests, he's as charming as they come, being an emotionally aware guy and incredibly graceful. He can be a flamboyant and showy performer, as he is energetic and confident. He is also brave, loyal, and, compassionate, and unlike his lover, Xayah, he tends to act on instinct rather than planning.
structure.abilities:
- **Vastayan Physiology:** Rakan is a Vastaya, an ancient race of demi-humans changed by magic of the Spirit Realm. The connection to the Spirit Realm increased their longevity so they can live for centuries, and granted them powerful magic. The Vastaya are divided into several different tribes, each one defined by an specific animal. Rakan is a Lothlan, a type of birdlike Vastaya.
  - **Enhanced Agility:** Lothlan are much more agile than a normal human.
  - **Magical Plumage:** Rakan has a "wing" on his right shoulder that produces magical feathers that can be used for several purposes. He can throw them at a foe, create powerful gusts of wind that can knock his enemies of the ground, or help others by creating barriers and healing them.

relations.relationship_description: Rakan is a Lhotlan [Vastayan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") who travels [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ionia "Ionia") as a wandering entertainer. After meeting and getting in a relationship with  [Xayah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xayah "Universe:Xayah"), both travel Ionia to preserve Ionia's natural magic from being controlled by humans. They are not married, since  [Xayah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xayah "Universe:Xayah") wants to hear him proposing to her everyday.

Rakan and  [Xayah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xayah "Universe:Xayah") fought  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") and his Order of the Shadow in [Wild Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wild_Magic "Wild Magic") to prevent them from harvesting a magical grove for the Kashuri Armories, the creators of  [Jhin's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin "Jhin")  [Whisper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Whisper "Jhin").

structure.trivia:
- Rakan is confirmed to have [ADHD](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Attention_deficit_hyperactivity_disorder) based on his in-game voice lines and short story.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
  - This was confirmed by [Odin 'WAAARGHbobo' Shafer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Odin_%27WAAARGHbobo%27_Shafer "Odin 'WAAARGHbobo' Shafer"), who explained that they indirectly gave Rakan ADHD through piecing parts of their personality together, as well as events from their friends and family, to create him.
- His tribe's name, Lhotlan, was named after Lhotl, a Vastayashai’rei hero during the war against a race of titans from the sky.
- He was originally intended to be 28 in equivalence to human age, but due to being a young [Vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya"), he is over a few hundreds years old.[[2]](#cite_note-2)[[3]](#cite_note-3)
  - This can be explained that as one enters a vastayan forest, time — as we know it — becomes to be less reliable. This is the border to the spirit world, so time can go strangely; days can become years, or months can become seconds in the world outside of the forest.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
- Rakan's emotional intelligence and self-awareness is through the roof. He is evidently also very *present* at any given time; he lives in the moment. Rakan was aware of his emotional interest in  [Xayah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xayah "Universe:Xayah") as it happened. It's not a singular moment for Rakan, it was a journey.[[5]](#cite_note-5)
  - The Vastayan culture's relationship and marriage rituals are somewhat different than ours, in part because magic is largely integral to them and their landscape. Their culture is big on declarations. Symbolically when you declare something, it becomes true; with Vastayan magic, these sort of declarations also form a weak charm. Reinvoking it maintains its status and makes others aware. From a human perspective, they are not married nor engaged, and would self-describe as a "couple". But for a Vastayan, declaring someone your companion is equivalent: it means you are allowing your magics to entwine.
- [Vlonqo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vlonqo "Vlonqo"), the town where  [Xayah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xayah "Universe:Xayah") and Rakan first met, is a town with a monastery and a Quinlon.[[6]](#cite_note-6)
  - Quinlons are the magical filters and damns scattered around Ionia that attempt to contain the amount of magic released into the region, or limit it to positive and helpful magic, which in turn affect the Vastayan livelihood due to their dependence on magic.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
    - In [Wild Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wild_Magic "Wild Magic"),  [Xayah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xayah "Universe:Xayah") and Rakan destroyed one of the Quinlons that  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") and his  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow") use to create their Ichor which is used to channel Shadow magic.
- Rakan loves chocolate.[[8]](#cite_note-8) He tried to acquire chocolate during the events of [A Piece of Shadow Cake](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:A_Piece_of_Shadow_Cake "Universe:A Piece of Shadow Cake") and [Nothing Rhymes with Tubebow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nothing_Rhymes_with_Tubebow "Universe:Nothing Rhymes with Tubebow").

structure.name: Lissandra
structure.quote: *"So many secrets, buried in ice..."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Lissandra came into existence millennia ago, a time when the barriers between the tangible, physical world and [other](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm") [realms](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Targon_Prime "Targon Prime") were hotly contested and [beings of old magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_God "Spirit God") roamed freely.

In this chaotic epoch, Lissandra and her sisters, Avarosa and Serylda, sought to conquer whatever they could. Lissandra tried to control the mortal world, only to be attacked by the claws of  [Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear"), rendering her sightless.

### War of the Three Sisters

Deprived of her sight, Lissandra walked in dreams instead. Using her magic, she established a connection with powerful extradimensional entities known as the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher"). On behalf of herself and her sisters, she made a deal with them to prepare Runeterra for the impending arrival of the Void.

In exchange, Lissandra and her sisters would be granted near-immortality and the ability to withstand the worst of the numbing frost. Named [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn"), they were promised to be spared until the very end. Lissandra herself became the Watchers' Seeker, mediating their will to the Iceborn.

However, Avarosa and Serylda grew weary of their subservient role and sought to free themselves from their constraints. Caught in the middle, Lissandra tried to soothe her sisters' concerns while appealing to the Watchers for more time, but the Watchers became increasingly impatient. At some point, Avarosa and Serylda beseeched the demi-god  [Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn") to construct an expansive [chasm and bridge](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Howling_Abyss "Howling Abyss"), where they would then lock away the Watchers.

The sisters' conflicts had escalated into a full-scale war. As the war drew to an end, Avarosa and Serylda led their armies up into the mountains to face Lissandra. Despite Lissandra's efforts to remind them of the conquests achieved through their allegiance to the Watchers, her sisters remained indifferent.

At last, the Watchers had arrived in Runeterra. Drawing upon all ancient magic, Lissandra sacrificed her sisters and their amassed armies, before sealing the Watchers underneath a barrier of magical ice at the depths of the Howling Abyss.

### Founding of the Frostguard

Over the passing years, Lissandra slowly realized that the barrier containing the Watchers was insufficient. The monstrous beings she had entombed were merely slumbering, gradually corrupting the True Ice around them into a more sinister essence. Now, they roamed through Lissandra's dreams as easily as she had theirs, and always she would wake, terrified, professing her loyalty to the chilling eternity they promised.

Lissandra rallied her remaining devotees to venerate her departed sisters. Their objective: accumulate as much True Ice as possible to prolong the delay of the Watchers' return, scouring the frozen expanses to enlist those of Iceborn lineage who would join their cause.

Lissandra and the first of her Frostguard exhausted all means to rewrite the history of the Freljord, erasing all records of the true events. Yet, whispers of rumors and prophetic tales endured in folklore and songs, foretelling the return of Avarosa and Serylda. Lissandra would kill silently anyone who had been claimed their reincarnations.

### The Dream Thief

In one instance, Lissandra senses a Watcher trying to wake up. Laying down on the Howlling Abyss, naked, she uses her psychic powers to feed the Watcher dreams of others. She traverses the entire Freljord in astral form looking checking on other's dreams and even remarks on a young girl who appears to be iceborn.

In the final moments of the ritual, Lissandra enters the Watcher own dream, where she sees herself being devoured by them. She awakens horrified and spilling bile out of her mouth. But the Watcher is finally sleeping again. For her, this is a small price to pay for to keep them at bay.

### The Hero of the Frost Moon

On a night of frost moon, Lissandra walked through a sacred sanctum of hears, where she visited numerous ice coffins holding half-dead frozen people whom she uses to feed the Watchers. She visited their dreams as she passed between them.

She remarked two sisters who were frozen together and who were seemingly devoted to each other. She thought their devotion is foolish and mentioned she found it more convenient to lose her sisters.

### Story Hunting

In recent events, Lissandra met a child from the Notai tribe named  [Nunu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nunu "Universe:Nunu"), who had recently survived a raider attack. She questioned the boy about his  [mother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Layka "Universe:Layka")'s stories, specifically looking for information about a *particular* song.[[1]](#cite_note-Nunu-1)

### Song of Nunu

Lissandra started invading Nunu's dreams, attempting to learn more about the Heart of the Blue in order to use its [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice") magic against the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void"). One night, after she questioned the boy posing as his mother and learned that he and the last True Yeti  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump") journeyed to the artifact's resting place, [Ramshara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ramshara "Ramshara"), she ambushed them in their sleep and kidnapped Willump. Intending to use the Yeti's [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice") magic to reinforce the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher")' True Ice seal under the [Howling Abyss](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Howling_Abyss "Howling Abyss"), she imprisoned him in [Frostguard Citadel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Frostguard_Citadel "Frostguard Citadel").

Eventually, Nunu snuck into the Citadel with the help of  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum") and saved the yeti, causing a confrontation between Lissandra and the boy and his friend. Despite corrupting Willump to turn him against Nunu, the boy eventually realized the Heart of the Blue was given to him by Willump when the two first met and used his newfound abilities to save his friend, turn all the Dark Ice Lissandra conjured into True Ice, and temporarily restore her sight. Realizing Nunu is the Heart of the Blue and possesses Yeti magic, Lissandra let the intruders leave in peace with the intention of watching and preparing the boy for the inevitable battle against the Void, claiming he is the savior she thought she was.[[2]](#cite_note-Song-2)
structure.appearance: Lissandra is a towering blue pale-skinned woman with a semblance of a sculpture. She wears a gown that looks like is made of stone or ice. She wears her signature horned headpiece and is always being followed by a trail of [Dark Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice"). Her bluish silver hair is braided into a single pigtail that goes down to her waist. Without her helmet, Lissandra can be seen to have a majestic and expressionless face, with open eyelids showing her blind eyes.
structure.personality:
Lissandra is a very imposing presence. She ports herself like a glorious monolith, always standing above everyone else. Lissandra is very manipulative, frigid, demanding, a perfectionist, and will do anything to achieve her goals. She is a very harsh leader and does not cope well with defeat or failure. She is also a very patient person, observing the Howling Abyss for almost ten millennia, waiting for the beings below to wake up.

Although she has this icy facade, Lissandra is a fearful person. She is in constant dread that her past will catch up to her and perpetually carries a heavy burden. She came to accept that she will find no peace in this life.
structure.abilities:
- **[Iceborn Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn")**: Lissandra is one of the original iceborn, being immortal and resistant to the worst of the numbing frost. She is also capable of wielding True Ice without getting hurt.
- **Master Sorceress**: Lissandra is a very old and knowledgeable sorceress, performing powerful magic even before becoming iceborn.
  - **[Dark Ice Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lissandra#Iceborn_Subjugation "Lissandra")**: Lissandra's signature magic is manipulating dark ice, a corrupted form of True Ice. She is capable of  [freezing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lissandra#Frozen_Tomb "Lissandra") anyone who opposes her, conjuring ice in any shape she desires, such as  [spears of ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lissandra#Ice_Shard "Lissandra"), walls or chain, and others.
    - **[Teleportation](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lissandra#Glacial_Path "Lissandra")**: Lissandra is able to reform herself wherever her dark ice is spread.
    - **Enthralling**: Lissandra can use her ice magic to enslave other beings to her will. She often does this to  [Trundle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trundle "Universe:Trundle")'s minions who fail to obey and fall in line.
    - **Supernatural Awareness**: It is hinted that Lissandra has some sort of magical awareness because, despite being blind, she is capable of sensing her surroundings to perfection. If it is related to her ability to control the temperatures or some sort of extension of her psychic abilities is not known.
  - **Psychic Abilities**: Lissandra possesses telepathic abilities which allow her to mind-travel during her dreams to see things beyond her sight, enter others' dreams, and communicate with the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher").
    - **Dream Manipulation**: Lissandra is capable of entering the dreams of other beings, manipulate those dreams and putting others back to sleep. She does it to the Watchers so they may not try to invade Runeterra again.
    - **Telekinesis**:Lissandra can move and lift objects without even touching them.

relations.relationship_description:
Lissandra and her two sisters, Avarosa and Serylda, were three Iceborn sisters who served the Frozen [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher") until the latter two decided to fight for independence. Lissandra is the youngest of the triplets.[[3]](#cite_note-3)At the final battle on the Bridge above the Howling Abyss, she sacrificed her two sisters. After the fall of the Watchers and the deaths of her two sisters, Lissandra tried to wipe out any historical records of them from the Freljord. She was unable to completely snuff out legends regarding Avarosa and Serylda which still lingered on to the modern day. Seeing a threat in the tales about her past, Lissandra secretly plots the kill any potential Avarosa and Serylda figureheads.

Deep down, Lissandra still loves her sisters and one of the main reasons she has to removed their names from history is because it hurts her to remember them.

She lost her sight to  [Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear") during one of their confrontations in the early days of the Freljord and along with her Frostguard has been actively containing his worship as well as other old demigods' in order to weaken them, though he refuses to vanish and continues to actively expand his influence.

Legend says the Three Sisters asked for  [Ornn's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn") help to build the [Howling Abyss](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Howling_Abyss "Howling Abyss"), though the tale may not be true.

Lissandra is actively trying to contain the worship of  [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia"), sending out allied raiding parties to attack Notai carravans. At some point Anivia herself would battle against the Frostguard army.

The Watchers would give Lissandra and her sisters true [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn") powers. Lissandra was the 'Seeker', the intermediary between the Iceborn and the Watchers. Eventually, after learning about the Watchers true intent, her sisters would openly rebel against them, with Lissandra seemingly still allied with them. During the final day of the rebellion, the Watchers broke out and threatened to consume the world, Lissandra betrayed the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher") and sealed them away under the [Howling Abyss](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Howling_Abyss "Howling Abyss"). At that battle she sacrificed many, including both Avarosa and Serylda. Lissandra and her Frostguard keep watch over the Howling Abyss in an attempt to prevent the release of the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher").
Before becoming the Green Father,  [Ivern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ivern "Universe:Ivern") the Cruel was opposed to the Three Sisters.

Lissandra unleashed an icy cataclysm to seal the [Watcher](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher") which also decimated the Yeti civilization and robbed the Yeti of their magic, resulting in most Yeti descending into  [savagery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nunu#Consume "Nunu"). The Frostguard keep some of the living savage Yetis as military animals.

Lissandra has found an easy ally in  [Trundle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trundle "Universe:Trundle") and the Frost [Trolls](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Troll "Troll"). She would 1 [freeze](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Frozen_Thrall "LoR:Frozen Thrall") many Frost Trolls, eventually turning them into obedient 8 [thralls](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Frostguard_Thrall "LoR:Frostguard Thrall").
Lissandra tried to kill Udyr and other spirit walkers when he was a boy.

Ashe and Sejuani are believed by Freljordians to be the reincarnations of Avarosa and Serylda, but are also possibly their direct descendants, making Lissandra their great-aunt-many-times-removed. Currently Lissandra is the leader of the  [Frostguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Frostguard "Universe:Frostguard") and openly hostile towards  [Ashe's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ashe "Universe:Ashe") and her  [Avarosan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Avarosan "Universe:Avarosan"), and  [Sejuani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sejuani "Universe:Sejuani") and the  [Winter's Claw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Winter%27s_Claw "Universe:Winter's Claw") (as suggested by [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Legends_of_Runeterra "Legends of Runeterra") official artworks, where  [Tryndamere](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tryndamere "Universe:Tryndamere") is battling against the Frostguard forces, as well as the Frostguard openly raiding Avarosan settlements and attacking  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum") when excaping [Da'arvong](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Da%27arvong "Da'arvong") in [The Raid](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Raid "The Raid") cinematic).

During her attempt to find Avarosa's grave, Ashe and her original Avarosans were attacked by Lissandra's followers who were trying to conceal the truth. It is unknown what Ashe thinks of the Frostguard at the moment. Lissandra appears to know about Ashe faking the origin of her bow, as stated by one of their  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra") interactions.

She met  [Nunu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nunu "Universe:Nunu") after raiders attacked his tribe. She questioned him about one of his mother's songs and intruded into his dreams to learn about the Heart of the Blue. She later kidnapped  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump") and fought the two before witnessing Nunu's abilities. She watches the two and intends to prepare them against the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void").

structure.trivia:
**Lissandra, The Ice Witch**

- Lissandra is among the very last living original [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn").
  - Based on the timeline in [Realms of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Realms_of_Runeterra "Realms of Runeterra"), Lissandra is between around 9000 and 10000 years old.
- Lissandra used to tell [the story](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Seeker%27s_Tale "The Seeker's Tale") of the [Howling Abyss](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Howling_Abyss "Howling Abyss") if one waits 30 seconds after winning a game there. It was later removed due to having some details clashing with the current canon.
  - *"Before magic shattered the broken peaks"* might be referencing  [Aurelion Sol](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aurelion_Sol "Universe:Aurelion Sol") unleashing a  [newborn star](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aurelion_Sol#Starsurge "Aurelion Sol") into a mountain to seal a Void rift or the destruction made by the Rune Wars.
  - *"Before the desert swallowed [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima")"* implies she is as or even older than  [Azir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir").
    - Both of the previous statements are confirmed true based on the official timeline.
- Of the Three Sisters, Lissandra is possibly the most worshipped due to the Cult of the Three Sisters which she proliferated. The Ice Witch; however, is one of the most feared and hated figures in Freljord.
- Thematically, Lissandra lost her sight, Serylda lost her voice and Avarosa lost her hearing as Lissandra could see what needed to be done, but was blind to the cost, Avarosa could no longer ‘hear’ Lissandra’s explanations and Serylda’s voice in the matter has been lost to time.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
- Lissandra controls the narrative of what happened to make it easier to bend it to her will as well as to hide the failure of her family.[[5]](#cite_note-5)
- Lissandra might think she’s more clear headed than she actually is due to hearing the whispers of the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher") over millenia.[[6]](#cite_note-6)
- Not all of the original followers of the Three Sisters were [humans](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Human "Human"), which explains the existence of non-human [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn") in the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord").
- Lissandra's eyes were mauled by  [Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear") himself before she became Iceborn. After she became one, she managed to overcome her blindness through ice manipulation.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
  - Lissandra might use echolocation to guide herself (considering how she shouts after using any of her abilities).
  - Her original eyes were crystal-blue in color.
- Lissandra possesses telepathic abilities which allow her to mind-travel during her dreams to see things beyond her sight, enter others' dreams and communicate with the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher").
  - Lissandra uses this ability to feed the Watchers with those dreams.
  - Lissandra seeks those who are [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn") since they could prove useful or dangerous in the future.
  - Lissandra uses dream manipulation to stop those seeking to destroy her and [The Frostguard Citadel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Frostguard_Citadel "The Frostguard Citadel").
  - Each time Lissandra dies in someone else's dream or tries to put a Watcher back to its sleep, she loses part of her spirit.
- The 5 characters appearing in her story [The Dream Thief](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Dream_Thief "The Dream Thief") will potentially play an important role during the 11 [return](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Warmother%27s_Call "LoR:Warmother's Call") of the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher").

**Orginal Lissandra**

- Lissandra and her two sisters, Avarosa and Serylda were three Iceborn sisters who served the Frozen [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher") until Avarosa decided to fight for independence despite Lissandra's objections. Her Iceborn army and  [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia") eventually defeated the Watchers. It is implied Lissandra would later murder Avarosa for revenge.
- Lissandra is her original name, but later became similar to a title for the Frostguard leader. She murdered and stole the identity of a Frostguard leader, then she slowly began to warp the tribe's proud traditions. Whenever her human form grew old, she faked her own death and then murdered her successor to steal her identity.
- The  [Seeker's Armguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Seeker%27s_Armguard "Seeker's Armguard") used to be hers. The gauntlet is now in  [Sejuani's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sejuani "Universe:Sejuani") possession (how the Fury of the North got it is uncertain).[[8]](#cite_note-8)
- The Frostguard appears to be an ally of  [Ashe's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ashe "Universe:Ashe")  [Avarosan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Avarosan "Universe:Avarosan") but is actually preparing for the return of the Watchers, ready to strike both the Avarosan and the Winter's Claw in the process.
- Lissandra met with  [Quinn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quinn "Universe:Quinn") and  [Valor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valor "Universe:Valor") in the  [Frostguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Frostguard "Universe:Frostguard") citadel when they [journeyed to the Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Journey_Into_The_Freljord "Journey Into The Freljord") on a scouting mission at  [Jarvan IV's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV") behest.
  - She later pursued them in her true form (the Ice Witch) after they sneaked out the citadel (neither knows both incarnations are the same person).
- It is implied Lissandra was behind the imprisonment of the fire spirit known as  [Brand](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Brand "Universe:Brand").

structure.name: The_Poro_King
structure.background: Not much is known about mysterious, mythical figure known as the Poro King. The only evidence of his existence on  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") is a homemade plush owned by a young  [Freljordian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") girl named  [Ingvar the Younger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ingvar "Universe:Ingvar"), who is the niece of  [Bjerg the Wanderer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bjerg "Universe:Bjerg"), dismissed by many as a senile old man for his 3 [tall tales](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Tall_Tales "LoR:Tall Tales") and ramblings. Ingvar, taking after her uncle, insists that the Poro King is real—he is the protector of all the peoples of Runeterra, and is the ruler of "a gajillion trillion [poros](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Poro "Universe:Poro")." Ingvar has appointed herself the Freljord's "Poro Supervisor" in search of adventure,[[1]](#cite_note-1) but her mother believes the Poro King is just a figment of her overactive imagination.
structure.appearance: The Poro King is a round white [poro](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Poro "Universe:Poro") with a large white mustache and goatee, bushy eyebrows, a large red tongue, and curly dark brown horns protruding from the top of his head. While larger than the average poro, he retains the same small and fluffy appearance his species is known for. He is often depicted wearing a golden crown with a red gemstone in the center, as well as a red cape, a golden scepter, and fine red-and-gold shoes on his feet.
structure.personality: Like all [poros](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Poro "Universe:Poro"), the Poro King enjoys  [Poro-Snax](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Poro-Snax "Poro-Snax"). While little is known about poro politics, he is noted to be heroic in nature.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
structure.abilities:
- **[Poro Physiology:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Poro "Universe:Poro")** Poros are small, mysterious, magical creatures who exist across  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra"). Their fur is able to keep them warm in harsh climates, such as the cold of the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord").
- **Leadership:** As the leader of all poros, the Poro King can enact a 3 [Council Call](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Council_Call "LoR:Council Call") to summon his many subjects to battle. Though small, the strength in numbers makes the fluft a force to be reckoned with.

relations.relationship_description: Ingvar is a little girl in the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") who owns a beloved homemade plush of the Poro King. She imagines him to be a heroic protector of all the peoples of  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra"), but her mother does not believe the Poro King is real.[[3]](#cite_note-LoRFlavor-3)

structure.trivia:
- While the Poro King is a major character in the  [Snowdown](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Snowdown "Universe:Snowdown") universe, he is only alluded to in  [Runeterra Prime](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra_Prime "Universe:Runeterra Prime").
  - In  [Winter Wonder](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Winter_Wonder_(Universe) "Winter Wonder (Universe)"), the Poro King gleefully rules over the Winterlands in protection of Snowdown festivities.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

structure.name: Nunu
structure.quote: *"Pull the fur outta your earholes, Willump! This is gonna be the bestest story ever!"*
structure.background:
### Life as a Notai

:   *Main article: [The Boy and His Yeti](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Boy_and_His_Yeti "Universe:The Boy and His Yeti")*

Born into the wandering [Notai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Notai "Notai") tribe of the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord"), Nunu grew up surrounded by music, storytelling, and celebration. His mother,  [Layka](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Layka "Universe:Layka"), taught him that every person, place, and moment carried a story worth singing. Together they traveled from village to village, sharing songs of ancient heroes and spreading joy before each winter’s arrival.

On his fifth nameday, Layka gifted Nunu a flute, that he later christened  Svellsongur , so he could learn to play her melodies himself. Several peaceful years went by until raiders attacked the Notai caravan, separating Nunu from his mother. Rescued by the surviving Notai, he waits for weeks for his mother to return.

As time goes by Nunu starts to isolate himself more and more from the other Notai survivors, escaping into the legends and heroes of old he heard in his mother’s songs. Determined to become one of these heroes, Nunu set his sights on a fierce monster that killed all who sought its power, thwarting the local hunters who were sent each year, never to return. Using his flute, Nunu slipped away from camp atop a herd of elkyr.

### Meeting Willump

:   *Main article: [The Boy and His Yeti](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Boy_and_His_Yeti "Universe:The Boy and His Yeti")*

On his quest to prove himself a true hero, Nunu wandered into the [forgotten ruins](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yeti%27s_Vigil "Universe:Yeti's Vigil") of an ancient [yeti civilization](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yeti "Universe:Yeti"). Deep within, he encountered a  [giant creature](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump") standing over a glowing gem. The [Yeti](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yeti "Yeti"), looming out of the ice with fangs and claws, didn’t register to Nunu as danger the way others would. In his mind, this was the moment every great hero faced: the mighty beast guarding ancient power. He imagined dragons, serpents, and the champions of old, and the magic in the glowing gem responded, letting those visions swirl around him. But when he looked at the creature more closely. Instead of a fearsome foe, he saw something confused, lonely, and in need of someone to play with. The creature, still enraged from centuries of isolation, did not expect the first snowball, or the second. Their encounter shifted rapidly into a full snowball fight. As they tumbled and threw snow, Nunu noticed the guardian’s appearance and demeanor changing. The creature grew progressively furrier and friendlier. Its harsh growl gradually shifted into something like laughter.

The moment broke when the guardian accidentally snapped Nunu’s flute, his last connection to his mother. As Nunu cried over his broken flute, the guardian realized that the future of the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") didn’t depend on the gem itself, but on the child who could shape its power. With a gesture from the Yeti, the magic flowed into Nunu, allowing him to bring his imagination to life and repairing his flute, freezing it into [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice"). With his new Yeti friend now named **"Willump"** in tow, they set out across the Freljord, chasing his mother's songs while holding onto the hope of finding her.

### Traveling to the Winged Mountain

:   *Main article: [Song of Nunu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Song_of_Nunu "Universe:Song of Nunu")*

During their voyage, Nunu awakens from a dream of his mother, Layka, and sets out with his yeti companion, Willump, to find the **Heart of the Blue**, a mysterious artifact said to reside in the Winged Mountain and the key to reuniting him with his mother. Along the way, they battle ice wolves covered in a strange purple ice and discover a cave of True Ice, partially corrupted by the Void. By purifying the statue of  [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia") at its center, they unlock a passage and continue their journey.

During their travels, Nunu and Willump set up camp and share moments of music and remembrance of Nunu’s mother. Nunu dreams of Layka, who speaks cryptically about the Heart of the Blue as a weapon of light and warmth against darkness, while  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra") secretly observes and seeks to exploit the artifact to control True Ice and combat the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void").

Their quest brings them to meet  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum") who saves them from a pack of ice wolves and who helps guide them through a fierce blizzard that blocks the way to the Winged Mountain. In search of a cauldron to prepare hero stew, they encounter  [Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn") in [his forge](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hearth-Home "Hearth-Home") and complete a series of trials to gather rare components in order for Ornn to forge the cauldron. Inside the Winged Mountain, they encounter  [the Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear"), who tests their mettle and shows them the way to [Ramshara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ramshara "Ramshara"), the heart of the mountain and the ancestral home of the [Yeti](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yeti "Yeti").

### The Truth of Ramshara

:   *Main article: [Song of Nunu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Song_of_Nunu "Universe:Song of Nunu")*

As Nunu and Willump reach [Ramshara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ramshara "Ramshara"), they discover a city frozen in time. Through murals and spirits, they uncover the history of the yetis: once feral creatures, they were blessed by  [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia") to gain additional arms and the power to create [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice"). The yetis [fought alongside the Three Sisters against the Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:War_of_the_Three_Sisters "Universe:War of the Three Sisters"), but  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra") betrayed them, draining their magic to build her True Ice wall and sacrificing their army, including her own sisters, to secure victory.

[Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump"), the sole surviving yeti, reveals he painted the murals and has been guarding the Heart of the Blue. Nunu helps free him from a trance caused by lingering spirits, and learns that the Heart of the Blue is a part of Anivia’s essence, kept safe by Willump. Meanwhile, Lissandra manipulates Nunu’s mother in his dreams to probe for the artifact’s location. When Willump is taken by Lissandra as her ultimate weapon, Nunu refuses to abandon him, and with the help of  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"), begins planning a rescue.

### Escape from the Frostguard

:   *Main article: [Song of Nunu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Song_of_Nunu "Universe:Song of Nunu")*

**Nunu**, aided by  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"), infiltrates the [Frostguard Citadel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Frostguard_Citadel "Frostguard Citadel") to rescue  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump"). After freeing his friend, the duo escapes across icy terrain, using Willump’s magic to overcome the  [Frostguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Frostguard "Universe:Frostguard").  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra") confronts them, attempting to turn Willump against Nunu, but Nunu’s courage and the guidance of his mother’s spirit help him reach his friend. Together, they counter Lissandra’s attacks, purify Willump, and escape, with Nunu realizing that the true Heart of the Blue is the bond he shares with Willump.

Afterward, Braum departs to follow his own path, while Nunu and Willump test their newfound powers and prepare for future adventures. Lissandra, left to reflect, realizes that Nunu, not herself, is destined to be the savior of the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") and resolves to observe and influence him from afar.
structure.appearance: Nunu is a small Notai boy of eight years, with tanned skin, dark hair and blue eyes. He wears a orange furred cape, with leather gloves and boots, and a hood made in semblance of Willump.
structure.personality:
Nunu is a kind, excitable child, eager for adventures and travelling. Having listened to the stories of his mother since he was born, Nunu dreams of being a mighty hero, fighting against terrible foes and exploring the world.

After the loss of his tribe, Nunu felt great sorrow, but nevertheless remained hopeful. Desiring to help his new caretaker Lissandra, and wishing to fullfill his dreams of being a hero, Nunu went to face a terrible beast and prove himself a hero for his people—only to meet Willump and befriend the yeti, the two forming an intense and loving bond.

Having been protected by Willump for a long time, Nunu is somewhat sheltered from the more complicated and darker aspects of life. He tends to see the best of people, for better or worse, and tries to fit them into his very naive beliefs about the world. Nunu also has a hyperactive imagination, often coming up with fantastic ideas to entertain himself and Willump.
structure.abilities:
- **[Heart of the Blue](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Nunu has consistently shown an affinity for many different [kinds of magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"). After receiving the Heart of the Blue, the essence of  [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia"), from  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump"), he gained the remarkable ability to make his imagination come to life.
  - **Ice Magic:** After receiving the Heart of the Blue, Nunu gained the ability to wield basic ice magic. He can empower his snowballs to freeze enemies in place and unleash them in near-endless barrages, while also shaping icy constructs such as bridges and walls. Paired with  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump"), Nunu can even amplify Willump’s own ice magic, enabling the duo to outmatch the power of  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra").
    - **True Ice Magic:** Like the [Yeti](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yeti "Yeti"), Nunu gained the ability to create [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice"). He is able to repair broken items, like  **Svellsongur**, by enhancing it with True Ice, as well as the ability to purify Dark Ice back to it's original True Ice form.
  - **Sound Magic:** Even before gaining the Heart of the Blue, Nunu was able to tame creatures, like [Krugs](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Krug "Universe:Krug") and elkyr by using song alone.
  - **Healing Magic:** Though not fully aware of it, Nunu was able to temporarily restore  [Lissandra's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra") sight, healing eyes that had been blinded millennia ago when she was struck by the [Freljordian demigod](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_God "Universe:Spirit God")  [Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear").
- **Bard:** As a [Notai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Notai "Universe:Notai"), Nunu is very well-versed in  [Freljordian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") folklore, able to identify people and gods with the lands' history through songs thought to him by his mother. He is a skilled musician, able to compose his own songs on his flute.

relations.relationship_description: Nunu’s mother,  [Layka](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Layka "Universe:Layka"), is the heart of his childhood and the source of nearly every story, dream, and song that guides him. After being separated from her during a raid, Nunu clings to her memory and melodies as his guiding light. Even when  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra") manipulates her image, Layka’s true presence, whether in dreams or spirit, helps Nunu stay brave, kind, and true to himself.

[Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump") is Nunu’s closest friend, protector, and the family he found when he had none left. Their bond quickly deepened into a partnership forged through trust, laughter, and shared imagination. Willump guards Nunu just as fiercely as Nunu brings joy and purpose back into Willump’s long-isolated existence.

[Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia") is a spiritual guide to the Notai tribe from which Nunu hails. While he has never met her directly, her legends, taught to him by  [Layka](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Layka "Universe:Layka"), shaped his understanding of her importance to the land. During his journey, Nunu discovers that the Heart of the Blue is a shard of Anivia’s essence, deepening his connection to the Cryophoenix and placing him within her legacy of protecting the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord").

Nunu has always seen  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum") as something to aspire toward. Meeting the legendary hero in person only strengthens that admiration. Braum treats Nunu with kindness, warmth, and respect, recognizing courage beyond the boy’s size. Their brief adventure together leaves Nunu with a greater understanding of what it means to be a true hero.

[Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra") seeks to control the power within Nunu and  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump"). Though she initially tries to turn Willump against him and uses visions of his mother to probe his heart, Nunu ultimately resists her influence, refusing to sacrifice his closest friend. After their initial battle concludes and Nunu is able to heal her eyes for a moment, Lissandra starts to believe that Nunu, not her, may hold the true power to save the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord"), and chooses to monitor the boy from a distance.

Nunu first meets  [Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn") while searching for a cauldron to make his “hero stew,” stumbling into [Hearth-Home](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hearth-Home "Hearth-Home") with  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump"). Although Ornn is initially irritated by the intrusion, he agrees to help, on the condition that Nunu proves his worth by completing a series of trials. Through these trials,  [Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn") witnesses Nunu’s potential and acknowledges the heavy burden the young boy will have to carry.

Nunu encounters  [Valhir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear") within the [Winged Mountain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ramshara "Universe:Ramshara"), where the great spirit initially assails them in a storm of fury. Once his rage subsides, he tests both Nunu and  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump"), urging them to prove their strength. In an earnest attempt to meet the challenge, Nunu tries to mimic Valhir’s thunderous roar, an effort that greatly amuses the demigod. The Volibear ultimately acknowledges their determination and allows them to continue toward [Ramshara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ramshara "Ramshara").

structure.trivia:
- Nunu suggests that Willump's favorite foods are " [Roasted Raptosaurus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Raptor "Raptor"),  [Pollywog pudding](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gromp "Gromp"),  [Egg popsicles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Anivia#Rebirth "Anivia"),  [Rocks](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Krug "Krug"),  [More rocks](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Malphite "Universe:Malphite"), and  [Bloblets](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zac#Cell_Division "Zac")."
  - Willump doesn't eat human foods as they do not provide magic/arcane power.
- Willump has a different perspective on the world because he's so ancient. He sometimes tones down his wisdom so he can have fun with his best friend, but they have moments of mentorship too.
- Nunu's mother was the singer in  [Ornn's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn") teaser song, [The Path to Hearth-Home](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Path_to_Hearth-Home "Universe:The Path to Hearth-Home").[[1]](#cite_note-1)
- Nunu is 8 years old, while  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump") is much older (possibly old as the three sisters).
  - Nunu was 5 years old when he [obtained](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Frozen_Hearts "Universe:Frozen Hearts") his flute and was separated from his mother and tribe after a raider attack.
  - Svellsongur is Old Norse for "Swell Singer."
- Nunu is theorized to be about 4'2", with  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Willump "Universe:Willump") being about 12'.
- Nunu could develop a crush on  [Annie](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Annie "Universe:Annie"), due to a voice line from the  [Nunu & Willump Bot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nunu/Cosmetics "Nunu/Cosmetics") skin, referring to her as "too pretty".

structure.name: Naafiri
structure.quote: *"We track for a thousand years. None can flee for that long."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

#### Ascension & Icathian Uprising

Naafiri was one of the [Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ascended "Ascended") God-Warriors of  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), having been granted Ascension by the Shuriman empire at an unknown point in the past. As a part of the Ascended Host, Naafiri fought alongside her fellow God-Warriors when the city-state of  [Icathia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Icathia "Universe:Icathia") began their [rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rebellion_of_Icathia "Universe:Rebellion of Icathia"). Just like many of her fellow Ascended, Naafiri personally witnessed the horrors of the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void") as the Icathians attempted to weaponize it, which deeply scarred her mind.[[1]](#cite_note-Hounds-1)

#### Darkin War

After the [Shuriman Empire fell](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fall_of_Shurima "Fall of Shurima") due to the sudden and disastrous death of the emperor  [Azir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir"), the remaining Ascended declared themselves *Sunborn* and violently clashed with one another due to the lack of leadership and purpose. Their battles brought so much devastation that the mortals eventually began to call these Sunborn *[Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin")*, an old Shuriman word which most closely translated to *The Fallen*.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

During this [Great Darkin War](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Great_Darkin_War "Great Darkin War"), Naafiri considered herself more powerful even among her fellow Darkin, having almost led them herself and believing she could easily best any of them in combat. Her pride and vanity got the best of her when she was easily tricked by Myisha, the [Aspect](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aspect_Host "Aspect Host") of  [Twilight](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zoe "Universe:Zoe") at the time, who imprisoned Naafiri inside one of her steel throwing daggers and hid her deep within a Shuriman crypt, unable to move or speak and left to ponder her past.[[3]](#cite_note-NaafiriBio-3)

### Modern History

#### Host Bodies

After the [Shuriman Empire fell](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fall_of_Shurima "Fall of Shurima"), Naafiri remained in the Shuriman crypt for centuries, inert and left to dwell on her shame and regret while waiting for an opportunity to possess a host body. Eventually, Naafiri sensed a [human](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Human "Human") presence nearby as a grave robber opened the tomb, eager to lure him into wielding the dagger. However, the man was well aware of Darkin magic and made careful efforts not to make contact with the blade, using tongs to pick it up and wrapped it in lead-lined cloth without touching the dagger itself.[[3]](#cite_note-NaafiriBio-3)

As the man set off across the desert on his horse, Naafiri despaired at her failure to possess a host body. Suddenly, she sensed the howls of a pack of Shuriman dune hounds carried on the wind and attempted to call out to them, hoping they would be driven to the grave robber and giver her an opportunity to finally possess his body. As the hounds surrounded the man, he carefully wrapped the dagger in one arm while wielding his sword in the other to defend himself.[[3]](#cite_note-NaafiriBio-3) He was ultimately ravaged by the dune hounds as they tore him and his horse to shreds, devouring them completely before going after the dagger as well. Upon contact with it, Naafiri felt the sudden rush of senses return to her after centuries of imprisonment, with the smell of dry air and metallic taste of hot blood. She could even see from the eyes of each separate dune hound. Since several dune hounds made contact with the dagger at the same time, Naafiri's consciousness was shattered and split among the hounds, allowing her to eventually possess the entire pack.[[1]](#cite_note-Hounds-1)

Initially, Naafiri resented her new form and cursed the beasts that encompassed it. She considered the hounds as nothing but feral animals and despised their smell, fleas and their need for companionship among each other. Over time however, Naafiri began to grasp the true nature of her new form, seeing the strength and wisdom that came with being a collective. She learned that a lone hound would quickly starve to death, but together as a pack they were considered apex predators. Naafiri felt a sense of enlightenment and let go of her sense of self, believing in no individuality and instead in the idea that the pack itself is an entity as a collective whole.[[3]](#cite_note-NaafiriBio-3)

### Recent Events

Naafiri continued hunting in the deserts, feasting on whatever game she fancied with vicious efficiency, becoming infamous for the terrifying howls that echoed across the pitch black Shuriman night. Some Shurimans even began to document and study the peculiar behavior of Naafiri's dune hound pack.

With newfound wisdom from her existence as a collective entity, Naafiri began to realize that this philosophy was not limited to only dune hounds but could be applied to all forms of life, such as fish, ants, humans and even the Darkin. Thinking on her past, Naafiri came to the realization that the fall of the Darkin was due to their lack of unity, as personal grudges and petty agendas were the driving force of the Darkin War.[[3]](#cite_note-NaafiriBio-3)

Now, Naafiri seeks to locate the rest of her Darkin siblings in hopes of sharing the wisdom she found through the dune hound pack. Through unity, Naafiri believes that the Darkin can regain their rightful place as apex predators and rulers of Runeterra.[[3]](#cite_note-NaafiriBio-3)
structure.appearance:
Naafiri's "primary" body is that of a monstrous, vicious-looking dog with numerous large, blade-like spikes protruding from her shoulders. Like other Darkin, she appears to have tough, ridged, armor-like skin: primarily black with red accents and an area of white around her lower face. She has bright yellow eyes. Naafiri's most prominent facial feature is the infused dagger. The dagger also has a golden spike ornament dangling from a chain, and she is shown to wear it as an earring on her left ear.

Her packmates are slightly smaller dogs with a simpler color scheme: solid red with areas of black on their tails and the top of their head. They also only have one blade-like spike protruding from their head, similar to Naafiri's Darkin dagger.
structure.personality:
In her original form as a Darkin, Naafiri was fiercely arrogant and ambitious, convinced of her superiority and believing she was destined lead the Darkin. This pride and overconfidence is what led her to her imprisonment, as she became susceptible to being tricked by Myisha the Aspect of Twilight.

Years of isolation eroded her pride, leaving behind bitterness and self-loathing. When she eventually possessed a pack of dune hounds, Naafiri initially clung to her disdainful nature, rejecting the animals as insignificant and unworthy vessels. But as time passed, Naafiri found a sense of enlightenment, completely rejecting her sense of self and seeing strength in the dune hounds and their unified relationship with one another.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

Naafiri's modern personality is shaped by this revelation. She is now pragmatic, focused, and unshakably loyal to this concept of unity. While traces of her former pride remain, they are tempered by a newfound clarity and detachment from ego. She no longer seeks power for herself alone, but for the strength of the pack. Though she is vicious and bloodthirsty, she remains driven by a collective instinct and sense of wisdom in her newfound existence.
structure.abilities:
- **[Darkin Physiology:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin")** Naafiri is a Darkin, originally one of the many [Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ascended "Ascended") God-Warriors of  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") in ancient times trapped within one of her steel throwing daggers. As a Darkin, Naafiri has immense physical strength, size and access to some celestial magics.
  - **Immortality:** Because her consciousness is trapped within her indestructible  [Darkin Dagger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Naafiri#Darkin_Daggers "Naafiri"), Naafiri is immune to aging and dying as there is no known way to permanently kill her.
- **[Dune Hound Physiology:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Naafiri#We_Are_More "Naafiri")** Naafiri's host consists of a pack of Shuriman dune hounds, inheriting their agility, sense of smell, ferocious bites and their pack-hunting behaviors.
  - **[Hive Mind:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Naafiri#The_Call_of_the_Pack "Naafiri")** Naafiri's consciousness is shattered and split across the entire pack of hounds, granting her the ability to control all of her dune hounds and see through their eyes and senses. As a hive mind, Naafiri has reached a sense of enlightenment as she has learned to find strength in her unity.
- **Hemomancy:** Like most Darkin, Naafiri utilizes the magic of *hemomancy* to manipulate the flesh and blood of mortals for her own purposes. Naafiri's use of hemomancy is what allows her to possess multiple dune hounds at once, as well as manipulate their flesh to spawn additional hounds.
- **[Throwing Dagger Proficiency:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Naafiri#Darkin_Daggers "Naafiri")** Naafiri was skilled in wielding a set of throwing daggers, having been one of the stronger Darkin in combat. Even after being imprisoned in one of her blades and possessing the pack of dune hounds, she still utilizes her skills with throwing daggers by firing them out as projectiles, capable of slicing and damaging enemies from a small distance.

relations.relationship_description: During the Darkin War, Naafiri fought against her fellow Darkin with the intent to become their leader. After her epiphany, she believed that strength in numbers could even apply to Darkin as their infighting only weakened them, so she strove to reunite with her fellow Darkin and show them her philosophy, so they could rule over Runeterra.

Naafiri initially resented Myisha for imprisoning her, but since being enlightened by her new hosts she expresses thanks towards Myisha's successor  [Zoe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zoe "Universe:Zoe") after her imprisonment led to Naafiri's own benefit.

While imprisoned in the crypt, Naafiri's dagger was found by a raider whom she intended to make her host, but due to him knowing about the Darkin's assimilation abilities he took precautions to avoid making contact with her. Out of desperation, she called to the nearby pack of dune hounds to make the man slip so he would be able to touch her, but they ended up killing him and so she ended up assimilating the hounds instead.

While Naafiri was being held by the raider, she noticed a nearby pack of dune hounds and influenced them to attack him so she would be freed. Once she ended up assimilating the pack instead in the scuffle, she initially felt disdain towards the hounds for their lack of hygiene and their need for companionship. But over time, she realized that the hounds' cooperation made them more powerful than an individual, which gave her an epiphany to unite the other Darkin in a similar way.

titles.alias: - The Hound of a Hundred Bites

structure.name: Kha'Zix
structure.quote: *"Kill. Consume. Adapt."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Kha'Zix was born like almost all [Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Voidborn "Universe:Voidborn") as a product of the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Watcher "Universe:Watcher") manipulating organic matter to create servants to infiltrate the  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") and provide intel for them. Kha'Zix is a particular Voidborn, a vicious creature seeking to become the ultimate predator in service to the Watchers. At birth, Kha'Zix began as fragile and ravenous, feeding on smaller, weaker creatures that wouldn't allow him to adapt and evolve fast enough. Desiring more, Kha'Zix hunted down more dangerous creatures, risking his life to satisfy his need to consume and evolve. Kha'Zix feasted on every kill, consuming their biological essence and eventually becoming a near-perfect predator roaming the jungles and devouring all types of creatures.

### Modern History

#### Encountering the Kiilash

Roaming the jungles and savannahs near  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), Kha'Zix would encounter some members of a  [vastayan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vastaya "Universe:Vastaya") tribe known as the [Kiilash](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kiilash "Kiilash"); a culture of fearsome hunters living within the jungles. At some point Ponjaf, the tribe's chieftain at the time, would witness the terrifying Kha'Zix but unable to kill him. Kha'Zix would become renown by the Kiilash as a frightening Void-abomination as some of the most fearless would be unable to hunt him down, including Ponjaf.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

#### Hunted by Rengar

At some point Ponjaf's disowned son  [Rengar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rengar "Universe:Rengar") was sent to bring back Kha'Zix's head as a trophy, being the only way Rengar could truly regain honor and return to his people he got exiled from. Searching through the jungles that Kha'Zix is infamous for roaming around, Rengar successfully locates his trail and finds a pack of [jungle raptors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Raptor "Universe:Raptor") being devoured by Kha'Zix. While feasting on the essence of the raptors, Kha'Zix grows a pair of limbs out of his back, which slowly unfurl into dripping wings. While stealthily watching the creature from the trees, Rengar finally lunges for an attack but acts too swiftly, as Kha'Zix is capable of parrying his hunting knife and slashing at his left eye with his claws. Rengar, now missing an eye, sees Kha'Zix hold it up with his claws and devour it tauntingly at Rengar. Angered by this, Rengar triumphantly roars and claws at Kha'Zix with his barehands as the two share a violent, bloody clash with one another.[[2]](#cite_note-adaptation-2)

Though Kha'Zix managed to survive the encounter, Rengar's succesful strikes caused Kha'Zix to feel his blood drip for the first time ever in his life. Because of this defining encounter against the Kiilash hunter, Kha'Zix now sees Rengar as his next target to consume and eventually evolve into a more perfect predator.
structure.appearance: Kha'Zix, the VoidReaver, is a terrifying embodiment of evolution and adaptation. He is a bipedal creature that stalks on clawed feet, his hunched posture conveys the image of a constant threat of violence. His body is encased in a chitinous exoskeleton, the colors of which reflect the unnatural hues of the Void - a chilling mix of purples, blacks, and occasionally disturbing swings of green. Glowing red eyes pierce the darkness of his head, which can take on insectoid or vaguely reptilian features. Sharp blades protrude from his forearms, their shape changing and evolving throughout the creature's hunts. These blades can be smooth and deadly or transformed into serrated instruments of destruction.
structure.personality: When Kha'Zix was created, he was a vicious but unintelligent voidborn that only knew how to kill and eat. However, his mutating abilities allowed Kha'Zix to develop a growing sentience, complete with an intelligent mind, fearless attitude, and a sadistic sense of humor. Kha'Zix has a lot of pride, seeking out "worthy prey" in hopes that he can grow stronger than them and eventually kill them, which was the origin for his rivalry with Rengar, as their previous battle was a stalemate and Kha'Zix now considers him an equal. While hunting the Pridestalker may not be such a wise decision on the surface, Kha'Zix remains determined in his goal, whether it be from arrogance or just as a result of his programming as a Voidborn to seek out and kill the strongest creatures
structure.abilities:
- **[Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Voidborn "Universe:Voidborn") Physiology:** Kha'Ziz is a Voidborn, a creature constructed by the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Watcher "Universe:Watcher") from within the Void by manipulating organic matter. Voidborn creatures are all programmed with the inherent desire to consume and destroy all of reality but are extremely varied in form and function. Kha'Zix has been created specifically with the ability to quickly evolve and adapt based on what he consumes in order to become the ultimate predator.
  - **Adaptive Evolution:** By consuming other beings, Kha'Zix can quickly adapt and evolve by mutating his own body. He has used this ability several times already, evolving with many different biological weapons and tools he can utilize to hunt down any prey. Kha'Zix is constantly evolving however, being capable of amplifying his current mutations even further when he consumes enough material and adapts.
    - **[Claws:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kha%27Zix#Taste_Their_Fear "Kha'Zix")** Kha'Zix possesses incredibly powerful and sharp claws that cut through many things. He has used these claws to easily parry  [Rengar's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rengar "Universe:Rengar") hunting knife and slice his eye out.
    - **[Winged Flight:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kha%27Zix#Leap "Kha'Zix")** Kha'Zix has wings that he can use to fly at great speeds and leap at great distances.
