structure.quote: *"Never question my loyalty. You will never know what I endure for it."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Katarina Du Couteau was born to one of the most respected families in  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). While her younger sister  [Cassiopeia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassiopeia "Universe:Cassiopeia") took after their politically brilliant  [mother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Soreana_Du_Couteau "Universe:Soreana Du Couteau"), Katarina studied the way of the blade under her  [father](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau"), the empire's greatest assassin. But the wily General Marcus was a harsh teacher with many pupils; kinship held no bearing upon his high expectations. Katarina's childhood had little room for rest or kindness, every waking moment was spent honing herself into the ultimate weapon. She stole poisons from the city's apothecaries to gradually build her tolerance, and scaled the tallest towers unseen in the dead of night. For these efforts, Katarina yearned for one day to demonstrate her strength in service to the empire.[[1]](#cite_note-KatBio-1)

To celebrate Marcus' heroism on the  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") front, the Du Couteaus visited the coastal city of [Urzeris](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Urzeris "Universe:Urzeris"). But suddenly, his wife collapsed from an unknown assassin's poison. The general quickly dismissed all of their household staff, leaving the family alone in the empty house. By the time Noxus soon began invading  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), Marcus returned to the homeland with Katarina, while Cassiopeia remained with their mother in Shurima.[[2]](#cite_note-CassBio-2)

Marcus finally put his daughter to the test as they joined the warbands on the western front. Her first mission was to assassinate an enemy line officer known as Demetrius. Seeing the mark as a waste of her talents, Katarina decided to instead ensure a swift victory by eliminating the enemy commander. This proved to be a terrible judgment; Demetrius took command and led a brazen charge against her father's encampment. Dozens of Noxian soldiers were slaughtered, including her father's retinue, and General Du Couteau barely made it out alive.[[1]](#cite_note-KatBio-1)

He was furious beyond words. *"The greatest assassins do not seek recognition or glory,"* he reminded her. *"They do not expect to occupy a place of honor at their master's right hand."* Overwhelmed by her shame and foolishness, Katarina fled back into the woods hoping to complete her original mission. But her distracted thoughts kept her from noticing the assassin after her until he had nearly taken her eye. Unbeknownst to her, Marcus sent after his other protégéa and adoptive son as punishment. The two continued fighting shortly after, but the man had relented; he would accept his own failure to strike true, and allow Katarina to atone for her mistake. She knew all she needed about the man, but asked of his name before leaving:  [Talon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Talon "Universe:Talon").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Six hours later, Katarina presented Demetrius's severed head to the General. She considered taking her father's as well for sending Talon, but begrudgingly acknowledged that he had right to sentence death. Humbled by the consequences, Katarina knew she had lost her father's favor, but hoped to someday redeem herself in both his eyes and the empire.[[1]](#cite_note-KatBio-1)

When Grand General  [Boram Darkwill](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boram_Darkwill "Universe:Boram Darkwill") was deposed by  [Jericho Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), the Du Couteaus were among the the noble houses that honored his coup.[[2]](#cite_note-CassBio-2)

### Infiltrating the Silken Danse

:   *Main article: [Welcome to Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Welcome_to_Noxus "Universe:Welcome to Noxus")*

Some time after Noxus ended its invasion of Ionia,[[4]](#cite_note-4) Katarina was sent an anonymous letter from  [Vladimir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vladimir "Universe:Vladimir") with an invitation to the Silken Danse, and a mark to assassinate.[[5]](#cite_note-5)[[6]](#cite_note-6) Undercover as a  [noblesse](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Katarina/Cosmetics "Katarina/Cosmetics"), Katarina infiltrated the manor of House Kythera and located her target: a man whom  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") intended to use as the host for the  [Darkin Glaive](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen"). However, he was unmoved as her strike was thwarted by  [Elise](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Elise "Universe:Elise"). As the two fought across the ballroom, Katarina was able to outmaneuver Elise and quickly eliminate her mark.[[7]](#cite_note-7)

### Working for Swain

:   *Main article: [Katarina Comic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Katarina:_Issue_1 "Katarina: Issue 1")*

Four years after the coup, Marcus had mysteriously disappeared and was presumed dead. In the three years since, Katarina became the de facto head of the Du Couteau family. Despite Talon's insistence on her own merit, she could not help to feel forever incomparable to her father's legacy. Though her parents never truly accepted her, she felt appreciated by the many assignments under the new regime. Where Talon questions the new Grand General's unnatural rise to power, Katarina quickly retorts that the newly implemented  [Trifarix](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trifarix "Universe:Trifarix") council is a sharp departure from the line of tyrants.[[8]](#cite_note-Kat1-8)

Though the empire had begun to grow beyond its brutality, rogue warbands still sought to drag Noxus back to its past. One such warband was led by General Rache to raze the town of Stelkenmoor. As she picked off his troops, Rache begged for his life, claiming loyalty to her father and the "true" Noxus. Katarina struck him down and said that her father helped build this new Noxus; Additionally, he had failed to kill off Stelkenmoor and that his own house had disowned him, and with his death his entire family and military record would be expunged.

On another mission, Katarina was to assassinate Warmason Khogan within his estate. Once a renowned commander, Khogan had aged into reckless discretion and cost many soldiers abroad. As she broke into his house, Katarina accidentally triggered a silent door trap. Fortunately, she had a key from Piltover to disarm it, satisfied that the empire no longer shied away from tools of other nations. When Katarina confronted Khogan, she had a theory that he merely sought to die fighting a worthy opponent. She decides to honor this wish by challenging him to a duel. Short as it was, she struck him down upon his own sword and thanked him for his service, promising his rememberance as a hero.

At the *Shelter Tea House*, Katarina recounts the tale to Talon as a demonstration of her code of honor. Khogan deserved to die knowing that he had given his life fighting for the empire he believed in; as she would in her own death. Talon argued that this discretion is a complete disregard for their father's training, that it would have been quicker and more merciful to simply kill Khogan. *"I don't know if you're going to die trying to prove father wrong… or die trying to honor him."* Refusing to watch Katarina continue to risk her life so carelessly, Talon departed hoping she would eventually come to her senses.

[Drann](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Drann "Universe:Drann") the tea shop owner brings Katarina a fresh pot of tea, when suddenly a violent explosion fills the room in smoke. As she fought back, Katarina recognized the voice of the assailant before being knocked unconscious.[[8]](#cite_note-Kat1-8)

### Assassinating Jarvan III

When Katarina awoke, she found herself aboard a ship face to face with her  [father](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau").[[9]](#cite_note-Kat2-9) She was furious that he had faked his death, but Marcus revealed it was a cover story that allowed him to lead a covert unit into  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") in hopes to assassinate  [King Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"). However, he discovered that Grand General  [Swain's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain") power traced back to a deal with a demon, and it was only a matter of time that this would jeopardize his leadership. He was pressed to reveal himself after receiving a written order with catastrophic changes to the mission—such as replacing Marcus with Katarina as the chosen assassin. Marcus believed that Katarina's recent successes were a ploy to elevate her, only to send her on a practical suicide mission. Such a failure would ruin their reputation and provide impetus for Swain to wage war against the noble houses, consummating absolute power in Noxus.

It was troubling for Katarina to take her father's word of these incredible charges so suddenly. Torn between loyalties, these doubts stirred in her mind all the way to the [City of Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Demacia_City "Demacia City"), where the king is expected to attend a public execution. Disguised as a peasant, she explored the palace grounds and determined that the prescribed kill from range would not suffice against the royal security; instead she would have to approach her target hard and fast from the crowd. In the meantime, she decided to pursue a secondary mark in the assignment: a patrician named  [Lux Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") whose secret magic powers might become a future problem for Noxus. Katarina approached the estate just as the girl was blasting her way out. She was quickly cornered by guardsmen, but one  [Captain Arrika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arrika "Universe:Arrika") argued against outright killing the young mage. Katarina quickly dispatched the rest of the guards, and claimed that she was a secret agent named Dereen sent by  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") to retrieve Lux. Arrika leaves satisfied, but Lux could immediately see right through the bluff.

Katarina pressed Lux about what she was trying to find, and the girl admitted it was to save her friend  [Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") from execution. He and all mages are outlawed and persecuted in Demacia. Despite being able to hide within high-profile nobility, Lux decided to advocate against this treatment of whom are otherwise good Demacian people; a position that goes against official doctrine.
Katarina was moved by such character—one very much unlike what she already heard about Demacians, yet sharing a devotion to change the nation's ideals for the better. Believing she could serve as a useful distraction, Katarina chose to set her free. As Lux hurried off, she informed that King Jarvan opted out of attending the event amid civil unrest, and would be kept safe in the palace.[[9]](#cite_note-Kat2-9)

Word followed of Sylas's escape from his execution, and the king was evacuated to a secret bunker within the inner chambers. As he sat easy alone in the room, Katarina emerged and struck behind him. As he lay dying, she taunted him for being a ruler who brutalized those who are stronger than himself. *"All Demacians will realize their true strength… under the banner of Noxus."* She then left the chamber, cutting down the king's guards as she escaped.[[10]](#cite_note-Kat3-10)

As Katarina made her way along the rooftops, she was intercepted by  [Garen Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") accusing her as an accomplice in the botched execution. As she remained tenacious against his surprising speed, she mentioned saving Lux from the Crownguard's own soldiers. Garen insisted he still had to take her into custody, but fight was interrupted by an explosion in the streets, and both realized they had no time to continue. Garen rushed off to find his sister, while Katarina resumed her escape.

Riots in the streets prompted the city gates to close shut, so Katarina took a [Silverwing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silverwing "Universe:Silverwing") rider hostage to make her escape over the wall. However, the rider was shot by Captain  [Jaredan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jaredan "Universe:Jaredan"), causing Katarina to plummet into the surrounding forest.[[10]](#cite_note-Kat3-10) As she laid unconscious, Katarina dreamt about saving her father and  [Talon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Talon "Universe:Talon") from  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed"). However, her dream turned into a nightmare as her brother and father morphed into demonic  [ravens](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), waking Katarina from her slumber. Miraculously, she landed on a giant slug that broke her fall, but one of her daggers had shattered.[[11]](#cite_note-Kat4-11)

### Confronting Family

Two weeks later, Katarina returned to Noxus and took shelter in  [Drann's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Drann "Universe:Drann") tea shop. Knowing that her would-be assassin Jaredan had followed her, Katarina took his presence as confirmation that a conspiracy was unfolding against her family. Drann offered to craft her a new weapon, but she declined. Katarina intended to meet with Talon next to ensure he was safe, but was prepared in case he was involved.

Katarina returned home later that night, and  [Talon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Talon "Universe:Talon") awoke from bed to greet her. She firmly asked when he had last seen their father, and Talon replied that it had been before Marcus' death. As Katarina drew closer, her suspicion caught the scent of a  [familiar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau") fragrance on him. She then attacked him, demanding to know how long he had been hiding the truth. Talon was quick to disarm her weapon, and revealed that he had helped Marcus fake his death. Raising the dagger against her, Talon declared that he would replace her as the heir and stand beside Marcus when he kills Swain.

Katarina quickly drew her broken dagger to break free, inflicting the same wound to his eye that he had given her many years ago. As Talon lay wounded, Katarina told him that he had become what she once was: a child desperate to earn their father's approval. She knew Talon would not believe her, convinced instead that he was acting out of loyalty to Noxus. Katarina had learned better than to trust their father, they had always been nothing more than tools to him. As she prepared to leave, Talon lashed out, accusing her as one of Swain's traitors. Katarina hoped that Talon would some day grow beyond what Marcus made him, but warned that she would come for him if he didn't.

Katarina returned to Drann's tea shop and lamented on what her broken family said about her. Drann reassured that it meant she was still good in a world of monsters, and urged rest from her wounds. The next morning, Drann offered to accompany Katarina as she prepared to confront her father, but she tearfully declined, insisting it was family business. Together, they then prepare a ritual to empower a new set of daggers with Drann's hemomancy.[[11]](#cite_note-Kat4-11) Drann drew Katarina's blood and began binding the daggers to it, suggesting Katarina to clear her mind. She needed to focus on a moment when she had felt truly connected to something—by warm instinct rather than cold logic. She recalled her duel with  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen"), and the fleeting amicable moment before parting ways. When the ritual was complete, the daggers were blasted away. At Drann's instruction, Katarina reached out to them. One dagger now answered her will, magically returning to her hand, while the other allowed her to blink to its position. Knowing that Talon would have informed their father by now, Katarina set out to protect the Grand General. Drann questioned whether it was necessary, noting that Swain could easily sense danger. Katarina was certain that if Marcus was moving against Swain, he had already devised a way to kill him.[[12]](#cite_note-Kat5-12)

Katarina was already waiting before he arrived. She confronted him over his betrayal in Demacia, and Marcus revealed that while the mission was genuine,  [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") had never been the secondary target;  [he](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau") was. Cutting the pleasantries short, he hurled a smoke grenade at Katarina and attacked from the shadows. She found quickly that she stood no chance to fight with the same techniques he taught her, so she chose to fight as the Noxian she had become. She taunted Marcus, claiming that she found Talon again and turned him over to be tortured by Swain. This bold-faced lie enraged only a little more than an angry footstep, but the sound was enough mistake for her to strike first. As Katarina pressed the attack, she scolded Marcus' tutelage. *"A true Noxian wants their child to grow up stronger than them."* He taught her everything she knows, but could never bear to witness his daughter surpassing himself. Katarina could only beat him now once she stopped trying to outperform the master, and attained the ingenuity to learn new skills.

As Marcus sat defeated, Katarina held back to declare his arrest. He retorted by priming a devastating Wolf's Maw explosive, intending to kill Swain along with the entire fortress as collateral. Katarina used her daggers to seize the device, but with no time to disarm it, she prepared to hurl herself far enough away to save Noxus in glorious death. Before she could act,  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain") intervened on wings above, wrenching the charge from her grasp and channeling it to kill Marcus in a single blast.

In the aftermath, Swain apologized for arriving late. Marcus' magic had shrouded him from even Swain's demonic sight, but fortunately he had been able to sense the younger Du Couteau. Katarina remarked at his monstrous power, and the Grand General admitted that he was no longer the same man he once was. He thanked her for her service and said she had earned his trust. Even after reforming the nation's politics, Swain needed an assassin that could reach even himself, should his powers compromise him. Katarina assured Swain that she knew exactly how to kill him.

Two months later, Swain named Katarina as the head of the Du Couteau assassins guild, while  [Talon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Talon "Universe:Talon") retreated to  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"). She made her way to the northern  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") and assassinated  [Jaredan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jaredan "Universe:Jaredan"), declaring that the empire's fate was now her's to decide.[[12]](#cite_note-Kat5-12)
structure.appearance:
Katarina is portrayed as a slender woman with peach skin and an athletic feminine physique. Her most prominent features include her long bright red hair and a scar on her left eye.

She usually wears a revealing assassin uniform made of black and gray leather and latex which reveals her abdomen and several dark blue tattoos, she wears leather heeled boots and a small leather jacket.
structure.personality:
As heir to a house of assassins, Katarina had pursued her father's approval for many years, but always remained short of his standards. Having lost the respect of her parents, Katarina developed her own ideals as a Noxian and is deeply loyal to the empire. Rather than chase legacies, she would use her skills to make a Noxus that she believes in. She is a firm believer in individual merit, and recognizes the benefit of having allies, especially those of different skillsets. Therefore, she finds mutual appreciation under the Trifarix.

Katarina embraces the philsophies of the new Noxus under  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), believing the empire is stronger for growing beyond its brutality, and holds disdain for the conservative factions.[[8]](#cite_note-Kat1-8)

As an assassin, Katarina is an agile fighter, can quickly plan her strategies, and has a keen eye for the subtlest of clues. Behind these instincts, her personal code of conduct dictates she would kill targets based on how honorable she regards them, also shows a somewhat flirtatious personality with Garen.
structure.abilities:
- **Agile Combat Mastery**: Katarina is both agile and quick, capable of performing acrobatic maneuvers in the midst of battle and proving difficult to seize when the fight seems over.
- **Stealth Mastery**: As an assassin, Katarina is trained to infiltrate heavy security in order to approach her target. Her stealth is comprised of part silence and part elusiveness.
- **Knife Mastery**: Katarina's ambidexterity makes excellent use of twin daggers.
  - **[Blood Bound Blades](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Katarina#Preparation "Katarina")**: Katarina's blood bond with her blades allows her to retrieve them telekinetically or reappear next to them at the blink of an eye. She possesses twin daggers infused with her blood by a hemomancy ritual conducted by Drann as a gift to replace the old daggers.
  - ~~**Daggers of Du Couteau**~~: Katarina inherited twin daggers for her assassin profession. One shattered during her assignment in Demacia, and she left the other with  [Talon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Talon "Universe:Talon").

relations.relationship_description:
In contrast to  [Cassiopeia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassiopeia "Universe:Cassiopeia"),  [Talon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Talon "Universe:Talon") is the adopted son of Marcus Du Couteau. In youth, Talon was tasked with a mission by Katarina's father: to eliminate her. However, Katarina miraculously survived Talon's attempt, emerging from the encounter with a distinct scar across her left eye. This encounter created an unexpected bond between them, as both had failed in their respective missions.

After their encounter, he adopted a nonchalant demeanor towards Katarina, assuming the role of her composed younger brother. Behind this facade, however, he secretly conspired with his adopted father to overthrow  [Jericho Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), who had recently ascended to power. Talon nursed a deep-seated jealousy towards Katarina, who had been entrusted with the symbolic daggers of House Du Couteau, a clear indication of the rightful heir.

Upon revealing his intentions, Katarina responded with unexpected empathy. She understood that Talon was merely a puppet, obediently carrying out her father's orders without question. The failed assassination attempt, rather than fostering animosity, prompted Katarina to reflect on her family dynamics. As she departed from Talon, she wished for him to break free from her father's control and forge his own destiny. However, with a resolute warning, she made it clear that if Talon remained shackled by her father's influence, she would be compelled to bring an end to him herself.

Katarina interacts very little with her younger sister,  [Cassiopeia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassiopeia "Universe:Cassiopeia"), since both live in different worlds. While Katarina was taught by her father, pushing her to learn the way of the blade, Cassiopeia took after their politically brilliant mother.

Katarina and her father,  [Marcus Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau"), had a very strained relationship. According to Marcus, her daughter always seemed to fail him as an assassin. To him, she was to brash and killed with a sense of passion and not with a cold, mercilessness he believed was necessary for an assassin. Because of this he ordered a young Talon to kill his firstborn daughter. After multiple attempts on her life failed, she confronted her father. She told the general she had considered taking his head instead, but eventually decided—as much as she hated to admit it—that he had done the right thing in ordering her death. She had failed. Not just as an assassin, or as a daughter, but as a Noxian. She knew she had lost her father’s favor, and could never regain it. He would raise others in her place, simply to spite her. Still, she vowed to redeem herself, no matter the cost—to rededicate her talents to the empire, and to become the sinister weapon she always intended to be.

After her father mysteriously disappeared in [993 AN](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Recent_History "Recent History"), she starts taking orders from  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"). Three years later, he reveals himself to her, saying that Swain is going to send her on a mission to  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") to die. After not only completing her mission successfully but coming out of it alive, she returns to  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). Realising that her father is trying to kill Swain, she immediatly moved to stop him.

During their final confrontation, she says to her father that he always wanted her to fail, because he was afraid she would grow to be better then him. As their battle came to a climax, Marcus tried to take both Katarina and Swain with him by using an explosive known as the "Wolf's Maw". Before it could detonate, Swain arrived to redirect the explosion to Marcus, instantly incinerating him.

Katarina interacts very little with her mother,  [Soreana Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Soreana_Du_Couteau "Universe:Soreana Du Couteau"), since both live in different worlds. While Katarina was taught by her father, pushing her to learn the way of the blade, her mother focused her attention on to her younger sister,  [Cassiopeia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassiopeia "Universe:Cassiopeia").

Encountering each other in the midst of the chaos during [Sylas' Mage Rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Great_Mage_Rebellion "Great Mage Rebellion") in Demacia, Garen, acting on misinformation, confronts Katarina under the belief that she is aiding Sylas. After mentioning she saved his sister from capture, she suggested Garen should do the same. After some fierce clashes of steel, an explosion stops their battle. Both combantants agree that they don't have time for their scuffle. Garen and Katarina have a small moment, bonding over their shared grievances with their younger siblings. Before she leaves, Katarina says to Garen she sees a great future for Garen and his sister.

While it is unclear that Garen has any interest in Katarina, Katarina has some interest in him. During her bonding ritual with her weapons, she focused on a moment when she was not trying to figure out every angle, where she just felt something and connected. The moment she chose was her first encounter with Garen, smiling faintly.

Assigned the mission to assassinate Lux and King Jarvan III in Demacia, Katarina deviates from her orders after recognizing Lux's dissent from the corrupt Demacian hierarchy. Sympathizing with Lux's plight, seeing as both women had been rejected by their families. Katarina spares her life. Katarina also notes that she thinks Lux is a threat to the Demacian hierarchy and would actually make a good Noxian.

Initially aligning herself with Swain after the coup that toppled Grand General Boram Darkwill, Katarina becomes one of Swain's most devoted assassins, eliminating political rivals and enforcing the new order. Despite a moment of mistrust when she learns of her father's faked death and Swain's alleged betrayal, Katarina chooses to continue working for Swain to secure her family's safety. During Katarina's battle against her father, Marcus Du Couteau, Swain, recognizing Katarina as his failsafe, intervenes to prevent her sacrifice, cementing her role as his trusted assassin.

The proprietor of a teahouse where Katarina seeks refuge and counsel, Drann, is a close friend and ally of Katarina's. She bound Katarina to her weapons with blood magic. This bond allows Katarina to teleport to her weapons. Drann is a stabilizing force in Katarina's otherwise painful and complicated life. She offers Katarina guidance, a sense of understanding and provides her with a source of solace.

structure.trivia:
- It is no secret that Katarina and Garen are in a relationship; almost everyone knows about them and their "secret".
  - To name some: Jarvan does not get what he sees on her, Tiana Crownguard (Garen's aunt) does not approve, Maokai has stated to stop carving on his back because "***Everyone knows G <3 K***" and Lux hopes they are just holding hands or she is telling.
    - Though many of these may be hypothetical cases.
  - There was going to be a cinematic that had Garen and Katarina working together while he had her as a prisoner; a possible alternate way of them meeting. This was changed later with the release of numerous comics that illustrated the moments where they met.
  - Their relationship may be a parallel to the classic novel Romeo and Juliet, as they are lovers from two factions that are confronted between them.
- Out of the two biological Du Couteau sisters, she is the only one we have seen the hair from, as Cassiopeia always has her hair covered.

structure.name: Janna
structure.quote: *"Do not fear the winds of change—they will always be at your back."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Most of what is known about Janna is known through secondhand accounts and stories. Since ancient times, there were those who prayed to the winds. Some said that the winds would even answer sometimes. Seafarers said that they would spot a  [bright blue bird](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Janna#Zephyr "Janna") just before heavy winds, and others would say that they'd heard a whistling in the air right before a storm, as if to warn them of its approach. These stories spread and gained reverence among people all across  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra"), with some saying that they had seen a bright blue bird transform into a woman with tapered ears and flowing hair. This mysterious figure was said to float above the water and direct the wind with a flick of her staff.

Those that believed in these tales called this wind spirit "Jan'ahrem", an ancient  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") word meaning “guardian,” as she always seemed to appear in times of great need. As time went on, she became known more simply as Janna.

These tales spread across the Shuriman continent, with Janna's most faithful believers residing in what is now known as  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), as they needed calm seas for their city's port. These people made statues and shrines and regularly prayed to Janna, asking for calm seas and favorable winds. Despite decrees suppressing worship of false idols, Janna's devotees remained faithful, wearing amulets with the image of a blue bird in reverence for her.

### Belief in Zaun

After the fall of the Shuriman empire, what was now the Shuriman deserts became enveloped in war. Despite this,  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") remained untouched, as Janna shielded it from the turmoil.

Over time, less and less people in Zaun prayed to Janna, instead becoming preoccupied with machines and advancing technology. However, one day, entire districts collapsed below sea level, and thousands had to fight for their lives against the currents of the River Pilt. This reignited faith in Janna, as the victims prayed to her for salvation and survival. Despite being forgotten for all this time, Janna helped the people. She used her wind magic not only to stop the water of the river from destroying homes so that people could evacuate, but also to quell smoke coming from fires so that people could see and breath better as they ran. While many died, those that survived saw what Janna did, and a belief and faithfulness to Janna was reignited within the Zaunite people, with her faithful once again wearing amulets reminiscent of blue birds and praying to her frequently.

### Deep Breath

:   *Main article: [Deep Breath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Deep_Breath "Deep Breath")*

A  [Zaunite](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") orphan prays to Janna. While he prays, he reflects on his life, including how difficult being a Zaunite is and how he is discriminated against because of his origins in the city. After an outburst of sadness, Janna appears behind the boy. She calms and hugs him, saying that it will be okay in the end. After comforting the boy, Janna throws a  [windy tornado](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Janna#Howling_Gale "Janna") on a  [piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") citizen who had humiliated the boy, and this managed to get a smile from the little orphan.

### Recent Events

While caring for the needy of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), Janna met  [Nilah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nilah "Universe:Nilah") and her crew and helped her face an ancient sea monster called 6 [Lascylla](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Iascylla,_Figurehead_of_the_Deep "LoR:Iascylla, Figurehead of the Deep"), also known as the *Figurehead of the Deep.* Although Iascylla proved to be a worthy foe, the 6 [Tidedancer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Tidedancer "LoR:The Tidedancer") eventually sailed close to the port city of  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and caught the attention of the spiritual goddess  **Janna**, who used her powers over the winds to dispel Iascylla, protecting Nilah and pushing her away from Piltover's shores.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
structure.appearance: Janna is a [Spirit God](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_God "Spirit God") who takes the form of a slender woman with white skin, tapered ears and long, pale blonde hair waving over his head and light teal eyes. She wears light, sacred clothing with a white palette with some orange gemstones. The most distinctive ornament on her attire is the crown that appears to be crystal on her head. She also has a staff that appears to be crystal.
structure.personality: Janna is a benevolent and mysterious individual, but is also extremely protective and caring towards those who believe in her and trust her guidance, she is true to her cause in helping those most in need.
structure.abilities:
- **[Spirit God Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_God "Spirit God"):** Janna is an ancient divine being embodying a particular aspect of the world. In her case, Janna embodies the winds and protection. Janna is empowered and shaped by the faith of her followers and the cultural concept she embodies.
  - **Immortality:** Janna's existence is linked to the belief her followers have in her. As a Spirit God, she is incapable of aging and dying in conventional ways.
  - **[Air Magic:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic")** As Goddess of the Wind, Janna has complete control over the winds and air. Janna is capable of  [creating powerful tornadoes](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Janna#Howling_Gale "Janna") and flying on the currents of the winds. Originally, Janna was focused on helping sailors travel across the sea to their destinations. As time changed, the center of her worship moved to Zaun, and with that, her priorities changed to take care of her worshipers by purifying the poisonous air of Zaun, essentially making her the goddess of clean air. By the way of her domain of air, Janna can cause many different forms of magic.
    - **Healing:** Janna can heal others using her purifying winds.
    - **Shield creation:** Janna can use winds to create a powerful shield around those in need.

relations.relationship_description: Janna has been the protective deity of Zaun since ancient times. While worship of her has diminished during Darkin and Rune Wars, she would once again be called upon after the Sun Gates disaster. Since then Janna has been called upon to clear the air of noxious pollution from the undercity, as well as be a supportive presence for zaunite inhabitants that require it.

structure.trivia:
- *Jan'ahrem* is her ancient name which is an ancient [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima") word meaning “guardian”, as time went by it became *Janna*.
  - Her given name originates from Arabic جنّة‎‎, meaning "paradise, garden, enclosure", < Syriac ܓܢܬܐ *ɡannəθɑʔ*, < proto-Semitic noun *\*Gann-at* (> Hebrew גִּנָּה‏ *ginnâh*) lit. "tract of land protected [by a barrier]", from Semitic root *g-n-n* "protect".
    - However, "Guardian ~ Guarding" would've been *\*\*Jānina < \*Gānin-at* (> Hebrew גּוֹנֶנֶת *gônénet*).
  - Her surname in the old lore is Windforce.
- Janna is a spirit god from pre-imperial [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima"). "Spirit gods" are more like manifestations of cultural ideas, given immense power by the belief of their followers and can wax and wane, depending - or disappear for a long, long time.
  - She is over 6000 years old.
  - At her peak, she was even more powerful than most [God-Warriors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/God-Warrior "God-Warrior"), shielding [Oshra Va'Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zaun "Zaun") from the [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin") war.
  - She was considered a false idol by the ancient [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima") empire.
- Janna appears to be left-handed even though some of her artwork has her holding her staff in her right hand.
- Janna is mentioned and appears in a statue in the episode [Finally Got the Name Right](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Finally_Got_the_Name_Right "Finally Got the Name Right") of the 2nd season of  [Arcane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series) "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)").
  - A part of the song *To Ashes and Blood* is sung in  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), this passage is translated from a prayer to the Goddess Jan'ahrem (Janna).
    - the translated lyrics of the Shuriman portion of *To Ashes and Blood.* "*Bey'fet ihru ga, Ahuni lek'cho, Bey'un hahbab, Ahuni lek'cho, Suhbi al naa yih*" is translated to "*Beyond these walls, the storms fury grows, over land and sea, the storms fury grows, but I have nothing to fear, for the blue bird is with me*", is an ode to Janna to ask for a prayer.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

structure.name: Fiora
structure.quote: *"I have come to kill you for the sake of honor. And though you possess none, still you die."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Fiora was born to  [House Laurent](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Laurent "Universe:House Laurent") of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), and as their youngest daughter, she seemed destined to be nothing more than a political pawn for her house. Irritated by this, the young Fiora made a concerted effort to defy her family at every turn. Though her parents had given her dolls, Fiora studied the blade, taking her eldest brother's rapier and forcing him to give her lessons in secret. The mannequins which were meant for her gowns were instead used as practice dummies, and she became an excellent swordswoman.[[1]](#cite_note-FioraBio-1)

### Crownguard-Laurent Feud

After Fiora's eighteenth birthday, her parents arranged her to be married to an outlying branch of the  [Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") family, which would form a beneficial alliance between their two houses. The summer wedding was to be held in the [Great City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_City_of_Demacia "Universe:The Great City of Demacia"), and King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") himself was scheduled to attend. But when the day arrived, Fiora stood up and declared that she would rather die than marry someone against her will. The outburst publicly shamed her betrothed, and his family demanded the matter be settled in a traditional duel to the death, which Fiora immediately agreed to.[[1]](#cite_note-FioraBio-1)

Distressed that his daughter might be killed, Fiora's father Sebastien pleaded for King Jarvan's intervention. But since Fiora had already accepted, the duel could no longer be cancelled. With no other option, Sebastien invoked his right to fight in his daughter's place. The High Marshal  [Tianna Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tianna "Universe:Tianna") similarly nominated a champion to fight in her kinsman's place: this one a veteran warrior from the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard"). In the face of almost certain defeat, which would lead to Fiora's exile and his house's ruin, Sebastien Laurent attempted to drug his opponent before the duel. He was caught, and arrested for violating  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia")'s most fundamental code of honor.[[1]](#cite_note-FioraBio-1)

On the eve of Sebastien's execution, Fiora visited him in his cell. The exact details of their conversation remain a secret only to her, but the next day, she approached the King with a proposition: instead of a hanging as originally planned, she would personally fight her father in a duel to the death for leadership of House Laurent. The King gave his blessing and watched from the dais as Fiora and Sebastien fought in a swift dance of blades. Both father and daughter were exceptional duelists, but in the end, she drove her rapier through his heart and bid him a tearful goodbye. After the duel, King Jarvan solemnly declared Sebastien's crimes to have been paid for in full, the feud between houses to be resolved, and Fiora the new leader of House Laurent.[[1]](#cite_note-FioraBio-1)

### Restoring the Laurents' Honor

:   *Main article: [A Matter of Honor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:A_Matter_of_Honor "Universe:A Matter of Honor")*

Despite King  [Jarvan III's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") declaration, the scandals surrounding  [House Laurent](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Laurent "Universe:House Laurent") were not quickly forgotten. Rumors and gossip circulated around Fiora and her family, including how she had usurped her brothers' claims to the house, and how she continued to refuse any suitors. To silence her critics, she elevated her cousins and more distant relatives to noble status. Many of these cousins were master swordsmen who dedicated their lives to the art of bladecraft, and with her entire household elevated, the Laurents reputation became one of refined combat, an art which they could offer in service to the kingdom.[[1]](#cite_note-FioraBio-1)

Even so, Fiora could not stand silent if someone disparaged her or her lineage. Any insult to the Laurent name would be met with a challenge in the Hall of Blades, and those who answered such a challenge would prove no match for Fiora's rapier. Fiora killed at least thirty opponents in honorable combat, earning her a fearsome reputation as one of the best duelists in  [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valoran "Universe:Valoran"). One of these opponents was a man named Umberto, who foolishly refused Fiora's offer to only lose his ear, and instead lost his throat after he tried to kill her. Fiora believed each death helped restore her family's honor. She also claimed it brought redemption a little closer, but would not specify for whom.[[2]](#cite_note-Honor-2)

### Dragon at Ehrenmount

:   *Main article: [Before Glory](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Before_Glory "Universe:Before Glory")*

While at a  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") training arena in [Ehrenmount](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ehrenmount "Universe:Ehrenmount"), Fiora and  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") caught two young children, Brit and Aron, playing with the equipment and pretending to be true heroes of Demacia. These children idolized Fiora and Garen respectively, but had difficulty imitating their moves. Garen jokingly asked Fiora if they should consider them for the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard"). She declared that seeking glory was futile without first finding excellence, or else they might suffer a violent death. Garen believed this was harsh and started to scold her, but before they could continue the conversation, a large [dragon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dragon "Universe:Dragon") was spotted by the guards and they went to defend the city.[[3]](#cite_note-Before-3)

### Duel with Jax

:   *Main article: [None Shall Pass](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:None_Shall_Pass "Universe:None Shall Pass")*

[Jax](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jax "Universe:Jax"), who was looking for the finest warriors on  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") to join his fight against the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void"), stood guarding a bridge in  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), snacking on eggs and blocking any soldiers who wanted to pass. He defeated fifteen elite soldiers, then another, wondering if there was no one in the kingdom who could challenge him. Fiora arrived as his next opponent, challenging him for control of the bridge. Upon seeing her, Jax readied himself for battle, believing he had finally found a worthy opponent.[[4]](#cite_note-Pass-4)
structure.appearance: Fiora Laurent cuts a figure of both elegance and lethality. Her lithe frame is clad in gleaming armor, polished to a mirror shine. The armor itself is intricate Demacian steel, adorned with flourishes that hint at her noble heritage. Beneath the armor, glimpses of fine leather undergarments peek through, hinting at her agility. Her most striking feature is her face, framed by a cascade of fiery red hair. Her eyes, a piercing blue, radiate unwavering determination and focus. In her hand, she carries her signature weapon, a rapier named Riposte. The rapier's blade is as sharp and deadly as Fiora herself, its intricate filigree hinting at its legendary status.
structure.personality:
Fiora is a swordswoman with a standoffish demeanor, direct with her words and frequently looking down on those who would seek to challenge her or her House. Since she was a child, her one true passion was studying the blade, and she strives for nothing less than absolute precision and excellence in her own technique. Having defeated numerous opponents, she claims she has no equal in the art of dueling, and has thus far refused all potential suitors. And though the other nobles simply dismissed her as an arrogant child, they have yet to prove her wrong in her conviction.[[1]](#cite_note-FioraBio-1)

As a duelist, Fiora seeks honor for  [House Laurent](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Laurent "Universe:House Laurent"), hoping to restore the family's reputation after numerous scandals and the death of her father Sebastien, where she was forced to slay him for his crimes. Fiora will avoid needless bloodshed if her opponent yields, but she is not averse to killing when she believes it is necessary. Whenever Fiora meets an opponent, or is insulted by a rival, she makes sure to challenge them before cutting them down with ruthless efficiency, but makes sure to give them the opportunity to back down and receive a lesser punishment instead.[[2]](#cite_note-Honor-2) As a  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), Fiora is loyal to her kingdom and is willing to fight in its defense.[[3]](#cite_note-Before-3) She aims to elevate her House by making them useful to Demacia, dedicating her efforts to refinement of bladecraft and the training of the kingdom's swordsmen.[[1]](#cite_note-FioraBio-1)
structure.abilities:
- **Leadership:** Fiora is the leader of  [House Laurent](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Laurent "Universe:House Laurent"), a title she took from her father by slaying him in a duel, and usurping her older brothers in the process. Despite the many scandals surrounding her family, Fiora has managed to salvage much of her House's reputation with an astute political maneuver, granting noble titles to her extended family so they could use their knowledge of bladecraft for the good of the kingdom.[[1]](#cite_note-FioraBio-1)
- **[Master Duelist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fiora#Riposte "Fiora"):** Fiora is the most feared duelist in  [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valoran "Universe:Valoran"), having practiced and perfected her techniques since she was a child using her eldest brother's rapier.[[1]](#cite_note-FioraBio-1) Her  lunges, bladework, and ripostes are deft, precise, and alarmingly quick, giving her opponents no time to even realize they have already been cut down.[[2]](#cite_note-Honor-2) Fiora's techniques are greatly respected in  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), and she is relied upon to train soldiers in the military and protect the kingdom from deadly threats.[[3]](#cite_note-Before-3)

relations.relationship_description: Jax might be the 'worthy opponent' Fiora longs for. He may also be interested in having her join his rebuilt Kohari.[[4]](#cite_note-Pass-4)

Fiora was set to marry a member of  [House Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") but rejected it, leading to her father Sebastien having to participate in a death duel.  [Tianna Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tianna "Universe:Tianna"),  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") and  [Lux's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") aunt, selected a veteran warrior from the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard") to fight for her kinsman so that his defeat would be certain. As a result, she may have some resentment toward their family.

Garen and Fiora know each other, as she helps train the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard"), though they never train together as "the outcome would be obvious". They fought together against the dragon that attacked [Ehrenmount](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ehrenmount "Universe:Ehrenmount").

structure.trivia:
- Fiora has turned down every suitor since she does not want to become a political pawn.
- Based on her appearance, Fiora is between her late 20s to early 30s.
- In the  [Be Mine](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Be_Mine "Universe:Be Mine") universe, it’s implied that she and  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") are in a relationship.

structure.name: Hecarim
structure.quote: *"Break their ranks, and ride them down without mercy. Crush the living. Feast on their terror."*
structure.background:
### Early life

In life, Hecarim had been a lieutenant of the Iron Order, charged with protecting the lands owned by [King Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viego "Viego") of [Camavor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Camavor "Camavor"). Due to his many victories in battle, the Knight-Commander of the Order had considered Hecarim as a potential candidate to succeed him and lead the Order some day, but when the Commander realized Hecarim's growing darkness and lust for personal glory, he concluded that Hecarim should never lead the Order. On being told of this decision by the Commander, Hecarim was furious, but returned to his duties with the Order.

During the Order's next battle, Hecarim found the Commander surrounded by enemies and cut off from reinforcements. Hecarim chose to turn away and leave his commander to die. After the battle, the Iron Order swore allegiance to Hecarim, unaware of his involvement in their fallen commander's death.

### [Ruination of Helia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruination_of_Helia "Ruination of Helia")

On his way to be officially sworn in as the new Knight-Commander of the Iron Order, Hecarim met General [Kalista](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kalista "Kalista"). The General was on a desperate mission to find a cure for the Queen, who had been poisoned by an assassin. The King, overcome by paranoia and seeing traitors everywhere, sent the Iron Order and its new Commander to quell all dissent within Camavor. The Order put hundreds to death and burned entire towns. Eventually, the Queen died, presenting a new opportunity for Hecarim to advance his brutal reputation. He proposed that the King should deploy the Order to attack Camavor's foreign enemies to avenge the murdered Queen.

The King agreed, but while the Order was preparing to ride against the kingdom's enemies, General Kalista returned, having found the antidote to the poison on the [Blessed Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blessed_Isles "Blessed Isles"). Furious that his general had come too late to save his wife, the King had Kalista thrown in a cell. Hecarim, curious about her journey, went to visit the general. He learned of the Blessed Isles, concealed by thick, white mist and home to incredible riches — including the Waters of Life, which may yet be able to heal the Queen.

Hecarim convinced the King to release Kalista so she could lead a fleet back to the Blessed Isles, as she was the only one who could find the way. Soon, Kalista, Hecarim, the Iron Order, and King Viego himself all landed at the Blessed Isles' city of [Helia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Helia "Helia"), along with the body of the dead Queen. The expedition marched toward the city, but were was stopped by the city's leaders, who refused to help. At this, the King ordered Kalista to kill the leaders of Helia. When Kalista refused, Hecarim seized yet another opportunity. He stabbed the general through the back with spear and gave the command for the Order to pillage and plunder the city.

In the ensuing havoc, a  [common custodian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh") agree to give access to the Waters, but Hecarim was too consumed by greed and bloodlust to listen. During the continued ransacking of Helia, an enormous magical shockwave exploded across the city, destroying every building. After the explosion subsided, a whirling storm of [The Black Mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Black_Mist "The Black Mist") tore through the ruined city, engulfing all in its path. Hecarim called for a retreat, but it was too late. Every member of the Iron Order was consumed by the Mist, ending with Hecarim himself. When the Mist took him, it permanently merged Hecarim with his warhorse. He is. now an [Undead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Undead "Undead") monster; a living engine of wrath. He is damned to endlessly patrol the now-renamed [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shadow_Isles "Shadow Isles"), unable to leave except during an event known as a [Harrowing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Harrowing "Harrowing"), when the Black Mist rolls out to find new souls to join the army of Undead.
structure.appearance:
Hecarim is an armored centaur-like wraith with a humanoid upper half and an equine lower half, as a result of him fusing with his horse after transforming into a wraith. His body is composed of metallic armor, connected by a glowing spectral body with visible hooves and tail. His head is a samurai-like helmet with an axe-like crest and skull-like teeth on its mouth. His chestplate and horse armor have skull-like faces adorning them, and has a tattered banner beneath the horse's chest. He is often seen wielding his glaive.

As mentioned when touched by Nagakaboros' powers, Hecarim's appearance as a human was described as being tall and handsome, with silver and gold armor and having dark eyes.
structure.personality: Hecarim is a merciless, bloodthirsty warrior who enjoys raiding cities and killing their inhabitants, mainly to gain a reputation of being feared or simply pure sadism, shown when he was so caught up with slaughtering the Helians that the Ruination took him by surprise. He is obsessed with glory and has no problem with killing his own allies to further climb up the ranks. Hecarim can also be cunning and manipulative to get what he wants, pushing Viego's grief into becoming more unhinged so he could raid enemy settlements on his command, and persuading Kalista to reveal the Blessed Isles for him. After becoming a wraith, he now seeks to kill every mortal being he comes across with the Iron Order by his side.
structure.abilities: - **Wraith:** Hecarim is one of the Shadow Isles's wraiths, created when the Ruinations came to be. The Black Mist consumes one's original personality, leaving only a specter consumed by negative emotions and obsessions. Hecarim has been consumed by his bloodlust and was turned into horrific spirit of war.

relations.relationship_description: Hecarim is a member of the Iron Order which vowed to protect  [the king's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") land, but he does not respect Viego and only follows him as he allows to pillage lands.

Hecarim is being hunted by  [Kalista](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalista "Universe:Kalista") for his betrayal and for helping unleash the Ruination of the Blessed Isles, thus turning them into the Shadow Isles and its denizens into  [Undead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Undead "Universe:Undead") abominations.

Hecarim faced  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") and  [Illaoi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illaoi "Universe:Illaoi") during one of the Black Mist's attack on  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater") but was driven back when Illaoi channeled her god's power.

structure.trivia:
- Hecarim is between 1050 – 1060 years old, born in  [Camavor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Camavor "Universe:Camavor") at some point before the Ruination of the Blessed Isles.
- Hecarim was Kalista's fiancé and betrayer as well as the one of the people resposible for the Ruination of the Blessed Isles and the spread of the Undead.
  - [The Black Spear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Black_Spear "The Black Spear") she uses to bind her Oathsworn is the one he used to run her through.
    - Both of them were some of the first Undead created by The Black Mist right after the Ruination.
- As seen by Miss Fortune when Hecarim was touched by the power of Illaoi's god, he was "*a tall rider, armored in silver and gold. A young man, handsome and proud with dark eyes and a future of glory ahead of him*".
