structure.name: Seraphine
structure.quote: *"This one’s for you!"*
structure.background:
### Early Life

As a young girl, Seraphine developed a passion for music of all kinds. This passion only grew after her Mother's departure, leaving just her and her father in their Piltovian home. As she grew older Seraphine began to develop her magical powers, however her power was so strong that she quickly began to feel overwhelmed and could not hear herself which caused her to begin trying to repress them. Her father, seeing the anguish his daughter was going through, created special hearing aids that would help her stabilize her powers. Seraphine's subtle updates to her stage and "secret" underground trips to Zaun continued throughout her adolescent years, as she grew even more involved with the antics of the war, finding her place in the conflict. Soon it became evident that her father was both aware and proud of her musical antics, seeing his previous dream of sharing his songs with the world in his daughter.

### Concerts in Zaun

At some point, Seraphine met Acorn, her chipmunk companion (otherwise known as "the Hextechnician"), who began accompanying her on her undisclosed trips underground. Seraphine's father began helping her with her equipment, touching up her guitar after long concerts, while she focused on making her disguise as flashy as possible.

Seraphine slowly began building her reputation throughout Zaun, performing soulful concerts and attracting large groups of its citizens, who were dazed and intrigued by her colorful, powerful songs. She actively began competing with other popular performers underground, including the infamous Zaun Diva, Scratch, both impressed with the other's musical capabilities.
structure.appearance:
Seraphine is a beautiful pale-skinned young woman with bright blue sapphire eyes and dyed bright pink hair tipped with dark violet that reaches her knees. She wears bright pink lipstick makeup and a light blue star painted on her right cheek.

Her attire is a mix of Piltovan and Zaunite aesthetics with an added visual flair for her theatrical performances. She wears a brown garb over a leather blue shirt, with leather gloves and a matching leather blue skirt with leather boots.
structure.personality:
Seraphine is a warm, friendly person and very fond of music, when she was a child she liked to play in her parents' workshop when her magic power grew she became somewhat withdrawn as she heard many voices and could not hear herself, her parents created some special hearing aids for her that helped her control that power.

When she came down to the city of Zaun, she was overcome with many emotions, most of them negative due to Piltover's contempt for Zaun. When she sang for the first time at the border of the two cities, she proudly saw how the people of both cities lived in harmony, so she set herself a goal that through her music she would unite the two neighboring cities.
structure.abilities:
- **[Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic")**: Seraphine was born with the magical ability to hear the emotions and souls of others, an ability that might grow the more she trains and expands her knowledge about magic. Due to her initial attempt to suppress her abilities rather than embrace them, she isn't formally trained in her magic but utilizes it nonetheless for her performances.
  - **[Empathetic Sound Magic:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Seraphine#Encore "Seraphine")** Seraphine can magically hear the emotions of others through an intense form of empathy, allowing her to hear the true thoughts and emotions of an individual. Her hearing is so intense and acute that she initially had to use a dampening device to keep from hearing the discordant emotions of the entirety of  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") combined. Eventually, Seraphine began to embrace her magic and is now capable of hearing the thoughts, feelings and memories of entire crowds. Along with that, she can create her own music to influence others' emotions, most notably singing songs of unity and compassion.
    - **Sound Projection**: Seraphine can manipulate sound waves and use them to create concentrated magical energy which she uses to launch energy beams or shape it to create energy shields. Although she does not like violence, she does not hesitate to use her powers to defend herself.
    - **Healing Magic**: Through certain magical songs, Seraphine can heal wounds.
- **Musical Mastery:** Seraphine is extremely musically talented, having a magnificent and beautiful voice along with skill in playing several instruments such as her custom-made hexcoustic guitar.
- **[Hextech Music Platform:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Seraphine#Beat_Drop "Seraphine")** Seraphine often performs on top of her custom made Hextech musical platform as a stage. This device was crafted after Seraphine dismantled her hearing dampener, choosing to embrace her magic as her parents created the platform stage as a Hextech amplifier of her powers, allowing her to more fully hear the thoughts and feelings of people as well as amplify her own magical music. Though she isn't very combative, Seraphine can also use her platform to produce powerful soundwaves.

relations.relationship_description: Seraphine understands the [brackerns](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Brackern "Brackern")' singing language to an extent thanks to her magical hearing, therefore she comprehends the song from the hextech crystal in her platform. She'd probably be the only human able to communicate well with  [Skarner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Skarner "Universe:Skarner"). However, she does not know that they seek help, and they do enjoy her songs of togetherness.
Caitlyn is an adoring fan of Seraphine's singing performance.

Acorn is Seraphine's pet squirrel whom often acts as her companion. Acorn is believed by Seraphine's fans to be the heart of her idol operation, but in truth he is often disobedient and uncontrollable, to her annoyance.

Being an acoustician, Seraphine's father gave her a hextech device to dampen her acute magical hearing. Proud of Seraphine's idol career, he supports her performances even if she withholds details from him and even allowed her to perform in the Undercity.
Millie is one of Seraphine's biggest fans and the leader of her fan club. While she is too shy to engage in conversation before leaving, Seraphine still enjoys talking with Millie.

Scratch has a friendly rivalry towards Seraphine, with both having enjoyment performing together. Judging by her flustered reaction when Acoustician tells her Seraphine talks about her a lot, Scratch's feelings toward Seraphine may be greater than just simple friendship.

structure.trivia:
**Seraphine, the Starry-Eyed Songstress (Old Lore)**

- Seraphine's magical hearing allows her to understand the [brackerns](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Brackern "Brackern")' singing language, becoming the first person with the ability to hear them in hextech crystals. However, she's only capable to communicate with one in particular, her own crystal, as result of their deep connection over the years.[[2]](#cite_note-2) Her [color story](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Standing_Room_Only "Standing Room Only") implies she's only able to hear it when Piltover and Zaun's songs are in harmony.
  - Despite being the first person to achieve this goal in universe, the first champion known to hear the brackern's soul song was  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce").
  - Her biography got tweaked shortly after revealed due to player response to clear up doubts about her characterization. Some of her quotes, especially those about brackern and hextech lore, got some players confused about Seraphine's nature and were removed from her voiceover to avoid misleading connotations.[[3]](#cite_note-3) According to Riot [Jag](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jag "Jag"), Seraphine was never meant to know the true identity of the entity inside the crystals and these quotes were designed only for player immersion ingame.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
  - After  [Skarner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Skarner "Universe:Skarner") received his [rework](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Champion_update "Champion update"), there is no longer any connection between the brackern and [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hextech "Hextech"), which has led to some canonical inconsistencies regarding Seraphine.
- The song she performs in her color story is implied to be [her own champion theme](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O11UcwRctAE).[[5]](#cite_note-5)
  - Champion themes are what Sera would hear when near them, but whatever version she performs would be a fan cover, different from official themes. [[6]](#cite_note-6)
- [Stage Presence's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Seraphine#Stage_Presence "Seraphine") double cast represents a technological overcharge of her stage.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
- Seraphine's spells are her sound and voice amplified, her basic attacks come from the sound waves of her fingers snapping.[[8]](#cite_note-8)
- Seraphine is 17 in 996 AN, according to Riot Reav3.[[1]](#cite_note-Reav3Age-1)
- Seraphine has [chromesthesia](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/chromesthesia), a perceptual phenomenon in which auditory stimulation leads to visual experience, being able to see colors and shapes in sounds.
- Seraphine's favorite flavor of ice cream is cotton candy.[[9]](#cite_note-9)
- Despite having no feature in [Arcane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series) "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)"), Seraphine's Hextech platform was featured in the Showdown game mode as "Echoes of the Heart".

structure.name: Dr._Mundo
structure.quote: *"Me must be good doctor. Patients never come back."*
structure.background:
### Early life

The man now known as **Dr. Mundo** was born and raised in  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"). He grew up to be a large man, able to physically intimidate others. He had a friendly and good-natured personality and would often use nicknames for people. As an adult, despite his friendly conduct, he worked as henchman and enforcer for a chem-baron.

### Torture at Osweld Asylum

:   *Main article: [The Madman of Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Madman_of_Zaun "The Madman of Zaun")*

After making a mistake that infuriated his boss, the chem-baron decided to make an example out of the enforcer. He was committed to Osweld Asylum, where he was experimented on. Suffering through the cruel treatments, the enforcer's body grew muscular than he already was, yet his brain deteriorated. Eventually, he lost all memories of his previous life, including his name and that of his boss. Instead he constructed a new reality from his surroundings, mistaking his restraining jacket for the coat of a doctor, and took on the name and profession  **Dr. Mundo**.

Over time, Mundo 'treated' everyone in the asylum, killing and dismembering them. When the chem-baron returned to collect his enforcer, Mundo treated him as well, killing him on an operating table. After the man tragically died during the surgery, Dr. Mundo stepped outside for the first time and recognized many potential patients that need to be 'cured'.

### Do No Harm

:   *Main article: [Do No Harm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Do_No_Harm "Do No Harm")*

One day, **Dr. Mundo** fought  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko") on the [Sump Level](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zaun#Sump_Level "Zaun"), who he thought of as a carrier of a virus. After hours, he managed to harm the boy, but the damage was  magically reversed and the patient managed to escape. After the fight, Mundo returned to his hospital.
structure.appearance: Dr. Mundo is a towering man enhanced by Chemtech medicine and implants. His already large body gained even more muscles during his torture at the asylum, which also led to his purple skin and blue tongue. He currently wears a ragged restraining jacket, even though it is much too small for his figure.
structure.personality: Mundo believes himself to be a doctor and everyone else to be his patients. This is a psychotic delusion/escapist reality, and he often injures, dismembers, or even kills his 'patients' without realizing it. Despite all this, Mundo seems to care for his 'patients,' becoming sad when his 'cures' don't work. He works tirelessly to cure these people of these supposed 'diseases' and is a generally caring but crazy person.
structure.abilities:
- **Chemically Altered Physiology**: At some point in the past, Dr. Mundo was forcefully injected with large quantities of purple liquids, which drastically altered his mind and entire body.
  - **Accelerated Healing**: Dr. Mundo's fast muscle growth can quickly heal his wounds, including gunshots.[[1]](#cite_note-Dr._Mundo_Biography-1)
  - **Physical Strength**: Dr. Mundo was naturally a strong person working as an enforcer and bodyguard for a chem-baron. The treatments he was exposed to amplified his muscle growth, making him stronger than regular humans.
- **Limited Cognitive Capabilities**: Dr. Mundo was traumatized while subjected to torture, and now lives in an escapist reality. He believes himself to be a doctor that has to 'treat' other citizens, but in reality is hurting, dismembering or even killing them. He is known to randomly assault people on the street.[[2]](#cite_note-Dr._Mundo_Color_Story-2)

relations.relationship_description: Dr. Mundo [fought against Ekko in the Sump level](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Do_No_Harm "Do No Harm"). However, he only perceived him as 'patient' in need of 'treatment', and it is unclear Mundo even remembers him.

structure.trivia:
- "Mundo" isn't his real name and is instead him misreading the name on his straight jacket.
- Mundo believes he is a doctor because he thinks his straight jacket is a lab coat.

structure.name: Twitch
structure.quote: *"They threw this away? But it’s so shiny!"*
structure.background: Twitch was born a plague rat in  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), though not much else is known about his past. Over time, he would become a collector of garbage in the sewers, which he considered to be priceless treasures. In a H.I.V.E. incident report, investigators recorded an encounter with Twitch in an industrial facility, where he attacked several scientists and killed several members of the response team. The team recovered a number of items belonging to Twitch, which consisted entirely of garbage. Since then, the rat has become one of many local bogeymen rumored about in the area.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
structure.appearance:
Twitch is a disheveled anthropomorphic rat with faded, moss-green fur, a hunched posture, and a prehensile tail. His jagged claws and buck teeth are a dirty, washed-out yellow. He has pink eyes as well as pink skin visible on his nose and the inside of his ears.

His attire is ragged and torn, most notably a green overcoat with the sleeves ripped off. It has a faded gold trim, twin tails, and a wide, flared collar. He has numerous straps and pouches carrying flasks of green poison and other miscellanea. He also wears a cracked pair of goggles. There are rusted metal plates armoring his right arm where he carries his crossbow. The makeshift mechanical crossbow is fastened with a chamber that loads his bolts with green chemicals.
structure.personality: Twitch considers himself a "connoisseur of the finer things", by which he means garbage and filth thrown into the Sump by  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"). He behaves pretentiously around others and doesn't believe in "sharing", combining a collector's spirit with unabashedly disgusting habits. He has an unpredictable, sneaky, and mischievous side, taking pleasure in scaring people and harming [scuttle crabs](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Scuttle_Crab "Universe:Scuttle Crab") with his  [vile sewer concoctions](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twitch#Venom_Cask "Twitch"). He doesn't seem to have any regard for human life, being responsible for a number of industrial homicides in the Sump works with no clear motive.
structure.abilities:
- **[Camouflage:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twitch#Ambush "Twitch")** Twitch has the ability to disappear into clouds of smoke and blend into his surroundings, which he uses to sneak around and take people by surprise.
- **[Deadly Poisons:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twitch#Venom_Cask "Twitch")** Twitch is the inventor of many toxic concoctions, which he claims to have developed by blending "burnt sewage" and "green sludge".  [Contamination](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twitch#Contaminate "Twitch") from these toxins is so corrosive that it can liquefy human bodies.
- **[Chem Crossbow:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twitch#Spray_and_Pray "Twitch")** Twitch's prized possession is a gleaming chemtech crossbow. He is a skilled marksman, and uses this crossbow to fire caustic bolts into his enemies.

relations.relationship_description: Twitch doesn't respect Piltover, referring to them as "Topside fools" for throwing away what he considers priceless treasures.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

structure.trivia: - With the reveal of [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shimmer "Shimmer")-dosed rats in  [Arcane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series) "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)"),[[3]](#cite_note-3) some have speculated that shimmer may be how Twitch is brought into the modern lore.

structure.name: Tyari
structure.background:
### Before the Journey

**Tyari** is a Rakkor resident on  [Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Targon "Universe:Targon"). Originally training to be part of the  [Solari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Solari "Universe:Solari") since childhood, Tyari eventually decided that this was not their path, instead believing that the answers they seek can be found by taking the climb up [Mount Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mount_Targon "Mount Targon"). They and their people believe in the  [the Protector](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taric "Universe:Taric"), who can bless people when they wear 1 [Gems](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:03MT092T1 "LoR:03MT092T1"). During the Farewell Ceremony Tyari undertook, two Travelers reach a Rakkor outpost. They are Haley, a Noxian, and Emir, a Demacian. The three agree to work together to reach the peak.

### Journey to the Peak

During the trip, the three have encountered many people and danger on their way. A 4 [Mountain Scryer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Mountain_Scryer "LoR:Mountain Scryer"), a 4 [Crystal Ibex](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Crystal_Ibex "LoR:Crystal Ibex"), 3 [Mentor of the Stones](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Mentor_of_the_Stones "LoR:Mentor of the Stones"), 5 [Sneaky Zeebles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Sneaky_Zeebles "LoR:Sneaky Zeebles"), 5 [Fused Firebrand](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Fused_Firebrand "LoR:Fused Firebrand").

### At Targon Peak and After

At the end of the Journey, only Tyari makes it to meet Taric. Taric leads their way to the peak to meet 10 [Arbiter of the Peak](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Arbiter_of_the_Peak "LoR:Arbiter of the Peak"), where they transcended into 4 [The Traveler](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Traveler "LoR:The Traveler"), a celestial. As the Traveler, she helps to aid travelers to start their journey and use her light to guide their way.
structure.appearance:
In they human form, Tyari has purple hair and brown skin. They wear light leather armor with pink robes over it, a blue hood, and a few metal accessories with gems embedded in them, which they also wear on a necklace.

When she transitions into her Traveler form, her appearance changes to that of a blue and violet star entity, just like the color of the gems.
structure.personality: *(TBA)*
structure.abilities:
- **[Sorcerer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Born with innate magical abilities, Tyari is able to wield magic such as protective barriers.
- **Climbing:** As a necessity due to living on Mount Targon, Tyari would learn how to climb mountains from a very young age. An ability that would prove useful during their climb up to the peak of Targon.
- **Weapon Proficiency:** Due to training to be a Solari warrior, Tyari has some combat abilities with the sword.

relations.relationship_description: Anua was a close cousin to Tyari who initially was skeptical of Tyari's sudden need to climb the mountain. However, when the time came for the Farewell Ceremony, Anua would come and give her farewells to Tyari, as well as her blessings in the form of a Targonite necklace and a prayer to The Protector for a safe journey up the mountain.

Meeting them during the Farewell Ceremony, Emir and Haley would be Tyari's companions during most of the climb on top of Mount Targon. Eventually they would split during unforseen events, with only Tyari reaching the top while the other two end up back at the foothills of the mountain due to mischievous [Zeebles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zeeble "Zeeble").

Raduak was a distant cousin to Tyari (a cousin of a cousin) who knew them since for 10 years. It was his reading of the stars that helped Tyari realize what their future has in store. Later on they would meet again with Emir and Haley during the climb on top of Mount Targon.

**Tyari** is a Traveler to the peak of Targon, therefore, they seeks Taric as guidance. At the beginning of their journey, they were given a necklace of gems, which are believe to made and hold the Guardian magic. On their journey, Tyari also have met Taric.

A close friend of Tyari since childhood, they were both training to become Solari warriors. While initially taken aback by Tyari's decision to climb the mountain, nevertheless they would eventually respect that decision and wish them best of luck with their climb. The two played tellstones together.
During their climb on top of Mount Targon, Tyari would meet the Starchild which would give them assurance for their efforts.

structure.trivia:
- Tyari identifies as *[non-binary](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/non-binary_gender)* [transgender](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/transgender). She previously used *[he/him](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/he_(pronoun))* or *[they/them](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/singular_they)* [pronouns](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/personal_pronoun) before her ascension and now uses *[she/her](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/she_(pronoun))* pronouns after becoming The Traveler.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
  - Tyari's journey of ascending the mountain is an allegory for her transition.
- 2 [Tyari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Tyari_the_Traveler "LoR:Tyari the Traveler") and 4 [The Traveler](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Traveler "LoR:The Traveler") are voiced by [Maddie Taylor](https://twitter.com/MaddieTaylor418), a transgender actress.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

structure.name: Yunara
structure.quote: *"The [War of the False Kanmei](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Darkin_War "Universe:Great Darkin War")—a name bestowed by those who know nothing of which they speak."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

As a child, Yunara's parents entrusted her to the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") to be raised under their tutelage. She trained under Master Bhinan, the Eye of Twilight, and Master Lao,[[1]](#cite_note-Unbroken-1) the *Fist of Shadow*, who wielded a sacred relic known as the  Aion Er'na.[[2]](#cite_note-2) By the time she matured into an acolyte, a scourge had begun to plague the land, and the Kinkou prepared for war. Corrupted god-warriors from  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), known as the  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin"), had invaded the First Lands, masquerading as benevolent Kanmei.[[1]](#cite_note-Unbroken-1)

The Kinkou fought back against the invader gods and their armies but suffered heavy losses. One evening, Yunara saved Master Lao from one of the fallen one's followers, before he realized the true nature of their foe. He smeared the blood from her hands onto his robes and told her to run, before facing  [Xolaani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xolaani "Universe:Xolaani") and perishing.[[1]](#cite_note-Unbroken-1) Yunara took up his duty as the Fist of Shadow and inherited the Aion Er'na.

The Kinkou were eventually pushed back until only their stronghold in Koeshin remained. As they struggled to defend it, they were saved by another god-warrior, one who was uncorrupted. He met with the Kinkou's leaders and introduced himself as  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen"), explaining that he had come to Ionia to end the bloodshed caused by his siblings. He offered his aid, and though the Kinkou were wary of accepting it, they had no alternative and agreed to an alliance after Bhinan judged his intentions.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)

Zaahen shared arcane teachings from Shurima, revealing how to defeat and seal the Darkin, and for nearly three years he fought alongside the Kinkou against the invader gods. During this time, Yunara was assigned to monitor Zaahen and, if necessary, eliminate him should he betray them. Together, they ultimately defeated and sealed  [Varus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Varus "Universe:Varus"),  [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast"),  [Xolaani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xolaani "Universe:Xolaani"),[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3) and 9 [Praa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:06IO023T1 "LoR:06IO023T1").[[1]](#cite_note-Unbroken-1)

After the last Darkin had been defeated, Bhinan judged Zaahen once more and deemed him safe to depart in peace. However, Zaahen felt that he too was succumbing to the darkness and feared what he might become. He voluntarily sealed himself within his glaive, which was then kept within the Temple of Twilight. Yunara swore to be his guardian and was cast into the Spirit Realm as well,[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3) relinquishing her role as the Fist of Shadow.[[1]](#cite_note-Unbroken-1)

To help their nation heal, the Kinkou spun Yunara and Zaahen's tale into a wholesome fable about how a shrine maiden and a mighty spirit fought back against malevolent pretenders in the War of the False Kanmei.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)[[4]](#cite_note-Devoted-4)

During their confinement within the Spirit Realm, Yunara often visited the Temple of Twilight, though she never crossed its threshold. Zaahen believed she wished to free him, but they both knew she could not.[[5]](#cite_note-5) His presence often attracted azakana to the temple, but Yunara would repel them. Being in the Spirit Realm reminded her of the departed—Master Lao often coming to mind, along with the lessons he had taught her. With endless time to train, Yunara experimented with non-combat applications for the Aion Er'na, learning to dance with them and using them as stepping stones between her chambers and the temple.[[1]](#cite_note-Unbroken-1)

One day, while meditating, Yunara experienced a vision of a  [stranger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao") dressed in foreign robes. Surprised, Yunara pondered its meaning, as the temple was warded against all intrusions, even dreams.[[1]](#cite_note-Unbroken-1)

### Return to the Material Realm

Centuries later, a disturbance in the Spirit Realm sent Yunara and the Temple of Twilight back into the material realm.[[4]](#cite_note-Devoted-4) The temple's sudden return sent the local demonkin into a frenzy, causing them to attack the nearby town of Koeshin. Yunara left her post to repel the demonic assault and encountered  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"), who was also fighting the demons. Xin was surprised to meet another Kinkou, having believed that only  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") was in the area. Yunara asked to speak with her old friend, but Xin informed her that Kennen was currently conferring with Master  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"), the current Eye of Twilight. Though wary of her, Xin agreed to fight beside Yunara after she assured him that her skill in battle would earn his trust.[[6]](#cite_note-Battle-6)

Together, they made their way through the forest, dispatching demons along the path. They encountered a strange creature— [Atakhan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Atakhan "Universe:Atakhan")—lurking in the woods but chose to leave it be. They eventually defeated a demonic pretender who had taken on the visage of the  [Grovemother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Morgana/Cosmetics "Morgana/Cosmetics"), though Xin Zhao's spear was destroyed in the conflict. With the demons defeated, they regrouped with Kennen, who was shocked to see Yunara returned and her post abandoned. Soon after, they were alerted that the Temple of Twilight’s defenses had been breached and hurried back toward it.[[6]](#cite_note-Battle-6)

As they made their way to the temple, Xin Zhao was plagued by a vision of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") in ruins.[[7]](#cite_note-7) Unable to go further, he demanded to know what they were facing. Kennen was hesitant to reveal the truth, but relented after Yunara vouched for him. They explained that  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen") laid within the temple and recounted how he had helped the Kinkou repel the Darkin invaders centuries ago. Kennen and Yunara urged Xin to return to his ship and warn Demacia that the Darkin have returned, but he refused to abandon them.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)

By the time they reached the temple, it had already retreated back into the Spirit Realm, with Atakhan inside. With the Spirit Realm being the Eye of Twilight's domain and Master Shen still far away, Xin Zhao and Yunara resolved to undergo the Trials of Twilight to reach the temple. As the Kinkou armorers outfitted Xin Zhao, Yunara explained that the trials were a series of tests created by the temple to judge the honor and strength of those who entered. Once they were prepared, Kennen opened a portal to the Spirit Realm.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)

The two were separated and forced to complete their own trials. When they finally reunited, Xin Zhao revealed that Zaahen had warned him not to take up a Darkin weapon, allowing him to pass his trial. Surprised that Zaahen had intervened, Yunara believed there was still good left in her old friend, and the two rushed onward to save him.[[8]](#cite_note-Warning-8)

When they finally reached Zaahen's glaive, it was too late, the weapon had already been claimed by  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") and embedded into Atakhan's shadowy flesh. The two charged the demon in an effort to free Zaahen, but Atakhan's power was overwhelming. Yunara used the Aion Er'na to pummel the creature while Xin Zhao shielded her from LeBlanc's chains. One chain managed to strike Yunara, causing her to falter and allowing the demon to bear down on them. As Atakhan assaulted them, Xin reached for the glaive to commune with the spirit trapped within. Inside Zaahen's mindscape, Xin pleaded for aid, but Zaahen refused, insisting that mortals should not meddle with the power of gods. Xin insisted they had no other choice and reminded Zaahen that he had once sacrificed himself to save their world, begging him to let him do the same. As Xin's strength waned, Zaahen finally relented and took him as his host. Returned to the world once more, Zaahen destroyed Atakhan with a single strike of his glaive, forcing LeBlanc to flee, while Yunara looked on.[[9]](#cite_note-9)

### Honoring Xin Zhao

When Yunara returned to the material world, she decided to honor  [Xin Zhao's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao") sacrifice by returning his spear to  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"). As she made her way through the forests of Demacia, she was caught in a stampede. The beasts knocked her off her horse and Yunara was forced to run towards the Great City of Demacia. Upon reaching the Great City's borders, Prince  [Jarvan IV](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV") and a platoon of Silverwing riders dove forward and defeated the creatures. When the prince landed, Yunara presented him his uncle's spear.[[10]](#cite_note-10)

Jarvan IV offered Yunara a ride on his Silverwing and flew her to the royal palace. He presented her to his father, King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), and informed him of Xin Zhao's passing. Though Yunara had practiced what she would say, upon meeting the king she understood why Xin Zhao had dedicated his life to him. Jarvan III asked how Xin had fallen, and Yunara revealed that he had died fighting a demon. The king then brought her to Xin's quarters, explaining that he had chosen a room near the gardens because it reminded him of his homeland. He asked where Xin Zhao's body lay, but Yunara was unable to tell him that he had fallen to a Darkin. Seeing that she was mourning his loss as well, Jarvan told her that the burden was not hers alone and urged her to stay and see the nation that Xin Zhao had loved. As Yunara gazed upon Xin Zhao's armor, she prayed that  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen") would prove worthy of his sacrifice.[[11]](#cite_note-11)
structure.appearance: Yunara is a slender, fair-skinned woman with purple eyes and lavender hair. She wears elegant, traditional  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") robes with a distinct palette of white, blue, and brown. Yunara wears ceremonial paint on her forehead.
structure.personality:
In [ancient legend](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Devoted_Shrine_Maiden "Universe:The Devoted Shrine Maiden"), Yunara was depicted as a kind and careful maiden who worried about her people and land, almost to the point of sacrificing herself for it.

Having been exiled to the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_Realm "Universe:Spirit Realm") for more than 1000 years, Yunara has returned to an  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") she does not recognize with modern customs she does not understand, and has also shown a lack of trust in the modern  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order")'s indecision and unwillingness to fight enemy invaders. As a fighter, her demeanor has become somewhat harsh towards both herself and others, but she remains faithful to her promises—the trait she became renowned for after the [Darkin War](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Darkin_War "Universe:Great Darkin War"). Yunara is also frequently hungry and believes a lack of food makes people "ornery".
structure.abilities:
- **[Spirit Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Yunara has a deep connection to the Spirit Realm created through training and spiritual practices, allowing her harness it's magic for several purposes.
  - **Telekinesis:** Through her spiritual training, Yunara is able to levitate the legendary  [Kinkou](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") relic, the  Aion Er'na and use them in combat.
  - **Spiritual Manifestation:** Yunara can manifest her spirit outwardly, granting her heightened speed and reflexes or enabling her to unleash her spiritual energy in powerful outward blasts.

relations.relationship_description: Zaahen met Yunara when he came to help defend  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") from the Darkin and their followers. Zaahen's power impressed the Kinkou, but also made them wary, so they assigned their Fist of Shadow Yunara to keep an eye on him and be ready to eliminate him if he betrayed them. In time, Yunara came to respect Zaahen as a trusted ally and hero of the First Lands, but he had grown to distrust himself and asked the Kinkou to seal him away in the Temple of Twilight, which was then hidden in the [spirit realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_Realm "Universe:Spirit Realm"). Yunara stood guard in the temple for over a thousand years as its protector to ensure Zaahen would not be freed by malevolent forces. When the temple was eventually breached by  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") and  [Atakhan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Atakhan "Universe:Atakhan"), Yunara and  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao") went to go stop them, at first believing the Darkin had returned to free Zaahen.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3) After her trial, in which Yunara heard Zaahen's voice, she decided there was still good in Zaahen and went to rescue him from the invaders.[[8]](#cite_note-Warning-8)

As they were both high-ranking members of the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order"), Yunara was old friends with Kennen and knew him before she went into her self-imposed exile. Yunara also promised she would stop Kennen if he ever lost his way.
Rhaast and Varus were among the  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin") that Yunara fought and eventually defeated with the help of the Great Spirit.

Yunara met Xin Zhao during his pilgrimage to the [Temple of Koeshin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Temple_of_Koeshin "Universe:Temple of Koeshin"), where she and her shrine were unexpectedly returned to the mortal realm.

Although she recognizes how dangerous she is, Yunara does not hate or fear Syndra; more than anything, she feels compassion for her after learning that it was the Ionians themselves who turned her into a wounded and explosive being.

structure.trivia:

- Yunara was first teased as the next champion in the [Here, Tomorrow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Here,_Tomorrow "Universe:Here, Tomorrow") cinematic.

She and  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") were as colleagues, as he is the first and only Heart of the Tempest.
  - Yunara's master was Lao, a shopkeeper on [Koeshin's Crossing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Koeshin%27s_Crossing "Koeshin's Crossing") who once held the same title.

  - When responding to another champion's taunt; Yunara asks if they have eaten due to their ornery.

  - This is due to them fighting hand to hand against the darkins in Ionia.
  - As well, if in game she kills Zaahen she prays he may find the peace he looked for and that she can't cry more for him as probably she did when he got imprisoned in his weapon.

structure.name: Camille
structure.quote: *"Precision is the difference between a butcher and a surgeon."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Most of the family’s wealth came through harvesting a rare crystal from the brackern, a creature native to Shurima. These hex-crystals—or “first crystals”—contained power normally only wielded by those born with innate magical ability. After Camille’s great-great aunt lost an arm during an early expedition, her sacrifice inspired the Ferros family motto: *“For family, will I give.”*

The brackern were a limited resource, and Camille's family had to augment the crystals they’d accumulated. Utilizing shadow investments in chemtech and runic alchemy, they developed less powerful, but easier to make, synthetic hex-crystals.

Yet there were consequences—synthetic crystal manufacturing has long been rumored to heavily contribute to the Zaun Gray. Furthermore, it was only through espionage, intimidation, and murder that Clan Ferros held its monopoly on this priceless commodity, and ensured its uninterrupted production in Zaun, maintaining the family’s place in Piltover’s illustrious Bluewind Court.

As the eldest surviving child of Clan Ferros’ masters, Camille received every educational advantage. She had exceptional tutors, learning to speak several foreign languages and play the cellovinna at a concert-master level. Camille also learned to read and write Ancient Shuriman while assisting her father on digs in the Odyn Valley.

Traditionally, one of the younger children would become their family's principal intelligencer, working with the clan master to secure their family’s success by any means necessary. However, Camille's younger brother, Stevan, had a weak constitution, and so Camille took his place. He jealously watched her embrace her additional training, and she became quite adept in combat, reconnaissance, and interrogation.

When Camille was twenty-five, augmented Zaunite thugs attacked her and her father, intent on stealing lucrative trade secrets. Camille’s father succumbed to his wounds, and in anguish, her mother died soon after. Stevan became clan master, and he doubled the clan’s research in human hextech augmentation, eager to prove himself as a strong leader.

After a year of mourning, Stevan oversaw the induction of Hakim Naderi—a promising young crystallographer from the Shuriman coastal city of Bel'zhun—as the family’s lead artificer.

Camille requested hextech augmentation from Hakim to push her beyond her human limitations. Hakim was instantly enamored with her, and they bonded over the preparations and late night stories of Shurima… and eventually, Camille returned Hakim's feelings. Their affair grew reckless, as they knew the surgery would conclude their time together. Hakim would move onto other projects, and Camille would once again be fully committed to the principal intelligencer’s duties. More than that, Hakim worried that in carving away Camille's heart, he might remove her humanity.

Days before Camille's operation, Hakim proposed marriage and begged her to run away with him. For the first time in her life, Camille was torn.

Stevan had no such conflict, as he needed Camille to execute his vision. When he learned of the secret proposal, he devised a plan—the next time Camille and Hakim were together, Stevan set himself up to be attacked. When she saw her brother bruised and bloodied, Camille recognized what could happen when her attention was divided.

Hakim pleaded with Camille, but she wouldn’t listen. For family, she would give. She ended her relationship with Hakim, insisting her surgery go forward.

He was the only one who could safely perform the operation, and so he excised Camille’s heart and replaced it with hextech—then resigned. When she awoke, the lab she and Hakim had shared was abandoned.

Camille focused on her work. She took on further refinements, including bladed legs, grapple-spindled hips, and other, minor hex-augmentations, leading some to wonder how much of the woman was left. And as Clan Ferros amassed more power and wealth, Camille’s missions became darker and more deadly.

Thanks to her hextech heart, she did not age—but the years were not so kind to her brother. Yet even as Stevan's body grew more frail, his iron grip on the clan remained.

### Contemporary history

Eventually, Camille uncovered the depth of Stevan's betrayal, and realized his machinations were no longer in the family’s best interests. In that moment, she discarded the last sentiment she felt toward her brother.

After installing her favorite grand-niece as clan master, Camille now runs the family's public affairs as well as its more shady operations. As a solver of… *difficult problems*, she embraces her more-than-human transformation and the cutting judgment it affords her—but a strange, mournful keening in her hextech heart may yet prove a troubling portent.

Regardless, Camille refuses to sit idle, and gains invigoration from well-executed industrial espionage, a fresh-brewed cup of tea, and long walks in the Gray.

### Convergence

During the events of Convergence, Camille is entrusted with a mission which is to stop the Poingdestres, a chymobarons family which has carried out illegal and extremely dangerous experiments at the expense of the Hextech crystals of the Ferros clan.

After finding out that [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ekko "Ekko") was getting into the Poingdestres' investigation, she herself went to confront him and tell him that the only way to stop him from interfering further was to kill him and the two began to fight.Ekko managed to incapacitate Camille. Future Ekko at that moment telling her that he had met Camille, she immediately deduced that there were two Ekkos, who were trying to stop the Poingdestres chemobarons just like her and proposes that they work together. Future Ekko, upsetting Present Ekko , to which Camille proceeded to leave to find the remaining Poingdestres.

During the fight against Jinx, she was about to throw explosives at Ekko but at that moment Camille appeared and cut the explosives with her legs leaving Jinx very surprised, then Camille proceeded to attack Jinx. At first Jinx took the lead hitting camille on the head, but Ekko used his Z press to rewind that moment to tell Camille to protect her head, then after a few hits she managed to incapacitate Jinx but due to a slight distraction she managed to escape .

Camille asked Ekko if there was any way to contact his Future Self and Ekko told him that there was a way and to play along, Ekko called his future self and told him that Camille was going to kill him for letting the Poigndestres go, Camille proceeded to pretend to attack him with her blades and Future Ekko appeared at that moment to stop Camille from landing the final blow on Ekko.

Future Ekko asked what was happening and realized that he had been set up, Camille proceeded to threaten him to reveal his plan unless he wanted her to get the information out of him herself. Future Ekko said that the only way to avoid the catastrophe was to destroy the reserves of Syntixi and the reserves of Hextech crystals in the Ferros clan vaults at the same time, which horrified Camille and Ekko. Future Ekko subsequently escaped to search for more Syntixi, Ekko asked Camille to go with him to Zaun to try to find Future Ekko's hideout and discover his plan.
structure.appearance: Camille is an elegant-looking woman with beautiful human and robotic features; she is very tall due to having, instead of legs, large prosthetic blades; her hips are exaggeratedly large, housing her grappling lines; her facial features are pale white skin, high cheekbones, thick lips, short platinum white hair, and piercing electric blue eyes. She wears a cyborg armor of black, dark blue and dark gray colors that covers the entirety of her body aside from her face.
structure.personality:
Camille is obsessed with her work, enhancing her body to levels far from a normal human through hextech body augmentations. She's cold and ruthless, not allowing any emotion to interfere with her duties. Being born into one of the most powerful families in Piltover, Camille is an aristocrat with an intense loathing of carelessness and mistakes. The virtues she values most are: Patience and Precision.

Despite her lack of emotions, Camille can still show signs of empathy and teamwork, even collaborating with Zaunites.
structure.abilities:
- **Hextech Cybernetic Enhancement:** Camille has been given extensive cybernetic augmentations. These enhancements gradually culminated when her human heart was replaced with a hextech heart.
  - **Enhanced Longevity:** Camille's aging has been severely halted. She has lived for 80 years while still looking like a woman in her early forties.
  - **Cybernetic Prosthetics:** Camille's legs have been substituted with prosthetics with powerful abilities.
    - **Leg Blades:** The "feet" of Camille's legs are sharp blades capable of cutting through most materials.
    - **Hookshots:** Her tights have two hookshots attached that can be used as grappling hooks to move more easily across the city.
  - **Hex Energy Manipulation:** Camille emits powerful hex energy that can be used in several ways.
    - **Energy Coating:** Camille can "coat" her blades with energy, strengthening their cutting power.
    - **Energy Fields:** Camille can create energy fields around herself and others to protect herself or imprison others.
  - **Deduction Skills**: Camille is incredibly skilled at gathering information to solve cases.
  - **Multilingual**: Camille was educated in languages, being able to speak fluently and understand Ancient Shuriman, Targonian, and Ixtali.

relations.relationship_description: She has encountered and fought against  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") during his assassination mission in [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zaun "Zaun") which affected her clan's business. What happened to Camille afterward is still unknown, however.

structure.trivia:
**Camille, the Steel Shadow (Old Lore)**

- Camille is classified as a [Human](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Human "Human") rather than a [Golem](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Golem "Golem"), like  [Orianna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna"). [[2]](#cite_note-2)
- Camille is around 80 years old in 996 AN. [[3]](#cite_note-3)
  - Her Hextech heart has allowed her to age much more slowly than usual.
  - She was 26 when she started experimenting with self-augmentation one year after her parents' assassination.
- Her augmented body, as well as her undercover shadow ops, have earned her the moniker 'The Gray Lady' (the  [Glorious Evolved's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") patron saint).
- Camille takes the role of a 'fixer' in service of the powerful clans, keeping Zaun's power in check from rivaling Piltover.
- The idea of body augmentation is not so strange to the people of Zaun and Piltover, though Camille's particular body mod would be widely considered extreme.
- Camille would never admit to anyone else her doubts about how far she could modify herself while retaining humanity. Her deepest fear is that because she's traded in her flesh for tools, others may see her as little more than a tool to be used.
- Her fighting technique originates from her favorite weapon, the [Shon-Xan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shon-Xan "Shon-Xan") footed glaive.
- Her current grappling line and hook originate from the Western [Serpent Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Serpent_Isles "Serpent Isles").
- She masters several foreign languages such as local [Zhyun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ionia#Zhyun "Ionia") from Southern [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ionia "Ionia") and ancient Ur-Nox from [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Noxus "Noxus"), beside reading and writing Ancient Shuriman.
- She can play the cellovinna at a concert-master level, her favorite spare-time hobby.
- Her great-great-aunt is speculated to be the escaping woman in [Dreamsong](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Dreamsong "Dreamsong").
- In [Awaken](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Awaken "Awaken"), Camille's eyes change colour when she approaches  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin"). This changing eye color is an allusion to her in-game passive, where she gains a shield based on the damage type of the champion she's attacking. That shot in the cinematic is her realizing that Jhin has set a trap. Her reaction is to first analyze the threat before jumping into action.[[4]](#cite_note-Game_Modes_and_Metal-4)
- It is hinted that Camille knows who killed  [Vi's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vi "Vi") parents.

structure.name: Necrit
structure.background:
### Early Life

Nunyo Necrit lived as an adviser to Camavoran royalty up until the reign of young  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego"). After the  [queen's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Isolde "Isolde") death, he witnessed the country begin to collapse as the king descended into madness. He accompanied the grieving king on the journey to the  [Blessed Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Blessed_Isles "Universe:Blessed Isles"), and fell victim to the [ruination](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruination_of_Helia "Ruination of Helia") that transformed all souls across the land. Luckily, Nunyo's will remained intact, and he would explore the isles, rounding up other sane souls to establish a safe haven.

### Return of Viego

:   *Main article: [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruined_King "Ruined King")*

Centuries later, Nunyo catches word that  [Thresh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh") seeks to bring forth the Ruined King from slumber. At the same time, a formidable band of interlopers would arrive to the isles in search for answers. After observing their strength, Nunyo appears before them and exposes the state of the land, and the impending doom about to be unleashed. With his supply of information, the warriors manage to triumph over the Ruined King and seal him away.

While he granted permission for the inspiration, the depiction remained a secret during development.
  - The creator himself stated that the name for his channel was inspired by the playble fighter [Necrid](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Necrid) from [Soul Calibur II](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soul_Calibur_II). He played this game when he was younger.

structure.name: Graves
structure.quote: *"We’re here for your gold, not your heads… so don’t nobody decide to be a hero."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Raised in the wharf alleys of [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Bilgewater "Bilgewater"), Malcolm Graves quickly learned how to fight and how to steal. He could always find work hauling contraband up from the smugglers’ skiffs that came into the bay each night—with a tidy side-gig as hired muscle for various other unsavory local characters, as they went about their business in the port.

But the alleys were small-time, and he craved more excitement than they could offer. Still little more than a youth, Graves stole a blunderbuss and smuggled himself aboard a ship headed out of Bilgewater to the [Shuriman mainland](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shuriman_Continent "Shuriman Continent"), where he stole, lied, and gambled his way from place to place along the coast.

Across the table of a high-stakes—and highly illegal—card game in [Mudtown](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mudtown "Mudtown"), Graves met  [Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Fate "Universe:Twisted Fate").

Each immediately saw in the other the same reckless passion for danger and adventure, and together they formed a most lucrative partnership. Between Graves’ raw brawn and Twisted Fate’s brains, they were an unusually effective team from the outset. Their mutual sense of roguish honor grew into genuine trust, and together they stole from the rich, swindled the foolish, handpicked skilled crews for specific jobs, and sold out their rivals whenever they could.

On the southern borderlands of [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Valoran "Valoran"), they set two renowned noble houses of [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Noxus "Noxus") at each other’s throats as cover for the rescue of a kidnapped heir. That they pocketed the reward money, only to ransom the vile young man to the highest bidder, should really have come as no surprise to their original employer. In [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Piltover "Piltover"), they still hold the distinction of being the only thieves ever to crack the supposedly impenetrable Clockwork Vault. Not only did the pair empty the vault of all its treasures, they also tricked the guards into loading the loot onto their hijacked schooner, for a quick getaway through the Sun Gates.

In almost every case, only once they and their accomplices were safely over the horizon were their crimes even discovered—usually along with one of Twisted Fate’s trademark calling cards left where it would be easily found.

During a heist that rapidly turned from complex to completely botched, Graves was taken by the local enforcers, while Twisted Fate merely turned tail and abandoned him.

Thrown into the infamous prison known as the Locker, Graves endured years of torture and solitary confinement, during which time he nursed his bitter anger toward his old partner, and, convinced that Twisted Fate had betrayed him, Graves was determined to have his revenge.

When he finally clawed his way to freedom, with the prison warden’s brand new shotgun slung over his shoulder, Graves began his long-overdue pursuit of Twisted Fate.

### Burning Tides

:   *Main article: [Burning Tides](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Burning_Tides "Burning Tides")*

In the years after, Twisted Fate continued conning people solo, one-time evading capture by Miss Fortune. She would later hire him by proxy to sneak into Gangplank’s warehouse to steal and return a Crimson-Coil dagger, where he would reunite with Graves, who broke out from The Locker and was tipped off by the Bounty Hunter herself about Twisted Fate presence.

Flamed with rage at his partner's apparent betrayal, Graves started shooting at Tobias in an effort to settle the score with him. With Gangplank's warehouse burning and with the pirate captain's thugs swarming, the resolution of Graves' and Twisted Fate's long-simmering feud threatens to engulf the entire city in flames. Informed by the destruction of his warehouse, Gangplank set off the catch both of the perpetrators of this act.

Both Graves and Twisted Fate tried to flee from the wrath of the Pirate King but with no success. Gangplank tortured them until he tried to publicly execute them in front of the whole city for their misbehavior. Hearing the news of this event, Sarah Fortune's plans set in motion and along with her crew, started to make preparations to blow up Gangplank’s flagship so all Bilgewater could witness the death of their Reaver King.

Graves managed to hide one of Twisted Fate's cards, snatched during their previous fight around the city, from the pirate thugs, and so, Twisted Fate teleports behind Gangplank and punches him, but Graves gets dragged to the bottom of the ocean. Twisted Fate then jumps after him and saves Graves from drowning but almost dies in the process. Graves manages to save Twisted Fate and after they successfully survive the explosion, both men settled their dispute and resolve to pick up their joint hustling.

As Graves had lost his shotgun Destiny, they head to Piltover so he can get a new one. Even though Graves and Twisted Fate are tempted to reconcile their relationship, both know it may take a while for Graves to completely trust Twisted Fate again, still, the latter is happy to have his old friend back.

### Destiny and Fate

:   *Main article: [Destiny and Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Destiny_and_Fate "Destiny and Fate")*

After running jobs in Piltover and Zaun for a while, they go back to Bilgewater in search of the Abyssal Crown. Along with the story, Twisted Fate actively tries to regain Graves' trust, staying despite the danger and giving the Crown to Graves since the latter still keeps some distance from him.

They end up angering a sea witch in the process. Later on Miss Fortune springs a trap for Twisted Fate and Graves. Despite the latter's success in cornering her, she manages to trap them and hand them to the sea witch in exchange for her quartermaster. In the end, she helps Twisted Fate and Graves escape as well.
structure.appearance:
Graves is a gruff-looking, broad-shouldered, middle-aged man. He has fair skin, dark brown hair, and brown eyes. He typically wears his hair swept back and his beard in a mustache-and-mutton-chops combo with only his chin shaved, though he has also been seen with a full beard.

He generally wears simple, practical attire, such as a blue shirt and dark brown pants with leather boots and gloves. He wears a number of belts and pouches on his waist, visibly holding shotgun shells. He is also known to wear a blood-red cowl over his shoulders and back.

His signature weapon, Destiny, is an oversized double-barreled shotgun made of black, gold, and brown metal. It houses a glass chamber which glows with orange-yellow energy.
structure.personality: Graves has a free-spirited and hot-tempered personality. His incredibly reckless nature and tendency to commit acts such as stealing and gambling has led to him becoming a wanted criminal in almost every city in existence. More then anything Graves values loyalty and will do good by anyone who does good by him, especially his partner  [Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Fate "Universe:Twisted Fate").
structure.abilities:
- **[Expert Marksman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Graves#New_Destiny "Graves"):** Developed through a life in the dangerous alleys of  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater") and honed during various criminal exploits, Graves possesses exceptional marksmanship skills. Whether wielding his stolen blunderbuss or any other firearm, he displays uncanny accuracy and efficiency with a shotgun.
- **[Explosives Expert](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Graves#End_of_the_Line "Graves"):** Graves has become adept at handling explosives, gained from his experience with contraband, smuggling, and high-risk criminal activities. He is known to use explosives strategically to create chaos or gain an advantage in confrontations. This is most exemplified when running away from the  [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sentinels_of_Light "Universe:Sentinels of Light") in  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), where he uses explosives and smokescreens in order to escape his pursuers.
- **Dumb Luck:** Graves seems to possess an unusual degree of luck, often finding himself in perilous situations only to narrowly escape. This luck, whether a product of fate or his own instincts, has played a role in his survival and success as a rogue and adventurer. A notable example of this luck occurred when attempting to rescue his partner-in-crime,  [Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Fate "Universe:Twisted Fate"), from  [Miss Fortune's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") clutches. Miss Fortune had cleverly set a rope trap, anticipating Graves' intervention. Despite the apparent danger, Graves impulsively charged through the hangar's front door, narrowly avoiding the trap.

relations.relationship_description:
Their partnership started when they recognized a kindred soul in one another across a table during a high-stakes game in Mudtown.

They both shared the same reckless passion for danger and adventure, which is what encouraged them to form their partnership. Graves being the brawn, and T.F. being the brains they were an unusually effective team from the outset. Their mutual sense of roguish honor grew into genuine trust, and together they hustled across Valoran.

They were forced apart when a heist went south, with Graves getting sent to The Locker despite Twisted Fate’s efforts to save him.

Graves endured years of torture and solitary confinement, during which time he nursed his bitter anger toward his old partner, and, convinced T.F. had betrayed him, Graves was determined to have his revenge.

Graves reunited with T.F. again when MIss Fortune set them up, yet they were forced to put aside their differences in order to escape almost certain death in the ongoing conflict between her and Gangplank.

Even though Graves and T.F. were tempted to reconcile their relationship, both knew it may take a while for Graves to completely trust T.F. again, still, the latter was happy to have his old friend back.

Still, since Graves still kept some distance from T.F., in the short story Destiny and Fate, T.F. proactively tries to show Graves that he can trust him again. T.F. had a history of taking off when things got ugly and so, T.F. wanted to stay and retrieve the Abyssal Crown even if it meant risking his life so he could prove to Graves that he wouldn't leave him to pick up the pieces anymore. In the same story, when Graves shows up next to T.F. bleeding, the latter notices and expresses his concern, something that Graves actually appreciated even if he didn't say it out loud.

During the Burning Tides events, T.F. jumps after Graves to save him from drowning despite not knowing how to swim and being terrified of drowning himself.

Graves seems to like messing with T.F., particularly by calling him Tobias instead of Twisted Fate insisting the latter is a stupid name, or by splashing him with salt water just to mess with TF's carefully oiled and perfumed hair. Similarly, T.F. usually comes up with clever replies to annoy Graves. Their petty bickering is seen many times like at the end of Burning Tides' Act 4, Double-double cross, and Destiny and Fate.

After some time, Graves captured  [Teemo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Teemo "Universe:Teemo") for the bounty on [yordles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle") while Twisted Fate refuses because "messing with Yordles brings a whole heap of trouble." He then fought  [Corki](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Corki "Universe:Corki"),  [Lulu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lulu "Universe:Lulu") and  [Tristana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tristana "Universe:Tristana") who came to save Teemo, which ended up in Graves being  [turned](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lulu#Whimsy "Lulu") into a frog and the Yordles escaping.

Graves respects  [Vayne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vayne "Universe:Vayne") for being the only person among the  [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sentinels_of_Light "Universe:Sentinels of Light") to stand up to him.

structure.trivia:
- [Cutpurse Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twisted_Fate/Cosmetics "Twisted Fate/Cosmetics") and  [Cutthroat Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Graves/Cosmetics "Graves/Cosmetics") depict them in their younger years.
- Graves' mother had been dead for five years before the events of [Burning Tides](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Burning_Tides "Burning Tides").
  - Graves and  [Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Fate "Universe:Twisted Fate") used to have a crew when hustling all over the world, but they all died trying to get the Outlaw out of the Locker.
    - Members include Kolt, Wallach, and The Brick.
- According to 4[Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Twisted_Fate "LoR:Twisted Fate"), Graves had quit smoking. This likely happened after [Burning Tides](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Burning_Tides "Burning Tides"), when the two reunited.
- Graves originally wielded a gun named Destiny (sharing the name with his partner's ultimate). However after the events of Burning Tides it got destroyed and was replaced with New Destiny, an exact replica of the gun.
  - Destiny is a double barrelled shotgun with a [break action](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/break_action) [cylinder](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/cylinder_(firearms)) chamber, which seems to be a fantasy design.
  - In game, Destiny has the power to launch smoke grenades.
    - In universe, Graves has to still manually light and throw his smoke grenades.
- Graves was given a Blue Card by Twisted Fate during [Rise of the Sentinels](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rise_of_the_Sentinels "Rise of the Sentinels"), it could instantly teleport him to Twisted Fate's location in case of an emergency.
- Graves is the only person who still calls Twisted Fate by his birthname, Tobias.
- One of the scrapped narrative concepts for Graves was for him to be married or to be an ex-lover of Twisted Fate. The concept of having "palpable sexual tension" between the characters was preserved in their final lore.
  - For Pride 2022, it was revealed that Graves is Gay in [The Boys and Bombolini](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Boys_and_Bombolini "The Boys and Bombolini").
  - One of the emotes for Pride 2022 is a reference to the classic scene in the romantic drama film "Brokeback Mountain".

structure.personality: Tristana has a very rowdy and impulsive personality. She's very excitable (especially when it comes to fighting) and more often than not tends to act without much forethought, in spite of how much she truly means well. One of Tristana's most defining traits is her ambition towards becoming a hero and creating her own adventure, being the reason why she became the feisty and strong-willed powerhouse she is today in the first place. Tristana is also incredibly selfless in spite of how scatterbrained and wacky she is otherwise, as she has protected Bandle City's gateways from mortals of Runeterra to the point of inspiring other yordles to protect the city as well.
structure.abilities:
- **Cannon Proficiency:** There's a reason why she carries a cannon around.
- **Yordle Physiology:** Tristana is a Yordle, a being coming from the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm") and possesses several abilities natural of her species.
  - **Immortality:** Being spiritual beings, Yordles don't age the same way as normal humans, and they can't normally die.
  - **Yordle Magic:** Just like any [Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), Tristana is capable of performing yordle magic, which she utilizes in tandem with her skills as a gunner.

relations.relationship_description: Tristana, [Teemo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Teemo "Universe:Teemo"),  [Lulu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lulu "Universe:Lulu") and  [Corki](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Corki "Universe:Corki") are friends. Tristana finds  [Lulu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lulu "Universe:Lulu") to be quite a handful and a bothersome yordle, but appreciates her willingness to help.  [Rumble](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rumble "Universe:Rumble") has an obvious crush on Tristana, having named his mech 'Tristy' after her.

[Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven") had [encountered](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Whispering_Doodad "The Whispering Doodad") both  [Lulu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lulu "Universe:Lulu") and  **Tristana**, fought and fled from them during his return trip from [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blood_of_Noxus "Blood of Noxus") to Noxus Prime.

Graves captured  [Teemo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Teemo "Universe:Teemo") for the bounty on [yordles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle") while  [Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Fate "Universe:Twisted Fate") refuses because "messing with Yordles brings a whole heap of trouble."  [Corki](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Corki "Universe:Corki"), Lulu and  **Tristana** fought  [Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Graves "Universe:Graves") when trying to save Teemo, which ended up in Graves being  [turned](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lulu#Whimsy "Lulu") into a frog and the Yordles escaping.
