Mentioned:  [Benzo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Minor_Characters/Zaun#Benzo "Universe:Minor Characters/Zaun"),  [Cassandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassandra "Universe:Cassandra"),  [Chross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross"),  [Claggor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Claggor "Universe:Claggor"),  [Deckard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Minor_Characters/Zaun#Deckard "Universe:Minor Characters/Zaun"),  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko"),  [Grayson](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Minor_Characters/Piltover#Grayson "Universe:Minor Characters/Piltover"),  [Heimerdinger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger"),  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus"),  Mylo,  [Renni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni"),  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco"),  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech"),  [Tobias](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tobias "Universe:Tobias"),  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"),  [Warden](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warden "Universe:Warden"),  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"),  [Ximena](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Minor_Characters/Piltover#Ximena "Universe:Minor Characters/Piltover")

structure.name: Salo
structure.background:
### Early Life

Salo was born and raised into one of Piltover's ruling houses. At some point during his life, he would inherit his family's position on the Council of Piltover.

### Councilor of Piltover

#### Discovery of Hextech

When the workshop of rogue Academy student  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") was robbed and accidentally blown up in the process, his unauthorized research into the Arcane was exposed and he was put on trial to be judged by the Council. Salo agreed with  [Bolbok's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bolbok "Universe:Bolbok") proposal to banish Jayce, but  [Heimerdinger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger") was able to convince enough of the other councilors to expel him from the Academy and destroy his ["hextech"](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") research instead.[[2]](#cite_note-102mysteries-2) After this, Salo and the other councilors ordered the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") to begin a large-scale search of the  [undercity](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") to find the thieves responsible for the robbery, with Salo being particularly irritated by  [Grayson's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Grayson "Universe:Grayson") attitude and lack of progress.

Later, with the help of  [Mel Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), Jayce perfected his research in Heimerdinger's laboratory, and the Council gave him the authority to continue working on it. In time, Salo became one of the many nobles in Piltover to benefit from Jayce and Viktor's creation of the Hexgate.[[3]](#cite_note-3)[[4]](#cite_note-104progress-4)

#### Piltovan Bicentennial

Years later, after a bombing on the Academy Square and the theft of one of Jayce's hextech gemstones by a  [terrorist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") from the undercity, Salo supported Mel's proposal to add Jayce to their table as a councilor so that he would have the power to defend the Hexgate from a future attack. Jayce's new position made him aware of the deep corruption that occurred amongst the many of the merchants who used the Hexgate and he attempted to root it out by himself, causing a number of powerful figures — including Salo, Bolbok,  [Hoskel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hoskel "Universe:Hoskel"), and the guild merchant  [Amara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Amara "Universe:Amara") — to plot against him. Mel later convinced Jayce to relax his regulations, and Jayce was able to win back each of them through a series of backdoor deals in the opera house.[[5]](#cite_note-105enemy-5) Thanks to this, Salo was quick to support Jayce when he moved to expel Heimerdinger from the Council and force the [yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yordle "Universe:Yordle") into early retirement.[[6]](#cite_note-106walls-6)

Following Jinx's second attack on Piltover and the discovery of Sheriff  [Marcus'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus") treasonous actions against them, the Council convened to discuss their next move. At the meeting, they learned from  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"), a rookie Enforcer and  [Councilor Kiramman's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassandra "Universe:Cassandra") daughter, about the all the horrible things she'd seen in the undercity and how an undercity crime lord named  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") was responsible for almost all of them. Although Jayce wanted to go into the undercity and retrieve his stolen hextech gemstone by force, the other councilors, including Salo, decided to negotiate with Silco instead after Mel suggested that a war should only be their last resort.[[7]](#cite_note-108oil-7)

After he ventured into the undercity to take down a [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") production factory, Jayce later informed the Council that he had offered Silco the undercity's independence in exchange for the hextech gemstone and Jinx. Although Salo quickly objected to his proposal, he eventually agreed to it alongside the other councilors after Mel supported the measure. However, before the councilors could finalize their decision to grant Zaun its independence, the Council room was bombed by  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") with  [Fishbones](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Switcheroo! "Jinx"), her signature rocket launcher.[[8]](#cite_note-109monster-8) The  [rocket](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Super_Mega_Death_Rocket! "Jinx") killed Councilors Kiramman, Bolbok, and Hoskel, with Mel and Jayce being the only ones to escape the explosion unharmed.

#### War and Conspiracy

Although Salo was fortunate enough to survive the subsequent explosion, his lower body was crushed by a large piece of rubble, preventing him from ever being able to walk again. After his brush with death, Salo was assisted by Mel's mother, the  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") warlord  [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"), and became wholly unsympathetic to all the people of Zaun, despite Caitlyn's report that the attack was caused by Jinx, a single deranged individual. After consulting Ambessa as an "experienced veteran" of war, Salo entered the destroyed chamber and offered the remaining Council members a proposal for their retaliation: A full-scale invasion of Zaun by Enforcers armed with hextech weapons. Although Mel objected, Salo managed to convince Councilor  [Shoola](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shoola "Universe:Shoola") to support the measure, and they outvoted her two-to-one. However, when Mel offered to support the invasion as long as hextech weapons were not used, Shoola sided with Mel, to the annoyance of both Salo and Ambessa.

At a memorial for the councilors who had died in the explosion, the city was attacked again by a Zaunite  [chembaroness](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons") named  [Renni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni"), and although Salo, Mel, and Shoola survived, they were forced into a makeshift Council room in the underground dungeons of their capital. Believing he now had proof the problem ran much deeper than Jinx, Salo again tried to put forward the use of hextech weapons, but his entire invasion plan was abruptly shut down by  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") when she revealed her intention to lead a strike team into Zaun with the objective of destroying all remaining shimmer factories, capturing Jinx, and eliminating the rest of Silco's loyalists.[[9]](#cite_note-201heavy-9)

Having been prevented from invading Zaun twice now, Salo continued to conspire with Ambessa, complaining that the only reason their plan had failed was because Caitlyn was a  [Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman"), and her influential family name had "bewitched" people into doing as she asked. After this, Ambessa informed him that it was "time" to enact their plan to take over the city, which would involve gathering all the mercantile clans into a single meeting and using Amara's death as an excuse to enact martial law. Salo, under the impression that he would be nominated as the city's commander, gathered the clans for the announcement, but was blindsided when Ambessa nominated Caitlyn as commander instead of him. After this, Salo became powerless in his own city as Caitlyn and Ambessa continued to hunt down Jinx without him.[[10]](#cite_note-203finally-10)

#### Fall from Grace

In the months that followed the declaration of martial law, Salo slowly faded into obscurity, with many of his former colleagues abandoning him for having lost his political power and the use of his legs. When the shimmer-based remedies he'd been using on his legs for the past few months started to become ineffective, he received advice from his healer,  [Lest](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lest "Universe:Lest"), to seek out a healer far down in the fissures, who could supposedly work miracles.[[11]](#cite_note-204paint-11)

Salo eventually took Lest's advice and found  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), who used his powers to fully heal his legs and enable him to walk again. Feeling indebted to Viktor for restoring him from his "broken" state, Salo joined the likes of  [Huck](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Huck "Universe:Huck") and the other former shimmer addicts as one of Viktor's loyal, fanatical followers, who sought to help him to enact his " [Glorious Evolution](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viktor#Glorious_Evolution "Viktor")."[[12]](#cite_note-205blisters-12)

### Death

While collecting power cells underneath the Hexgate one day, Salo encountered  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") when he suddenly returned from a violent, several-month trip through the horrors of the anomaly. When Jayce expressed confusion as to how he was able to walk after the Council bombing, Salo revealed that Viktor had "healed" him, and allowed Viktor to momentarily possess him so that he could converse with Jayce. However, despite Salo and Viktor believing they had nothing but good news for Jayce, Jayce didn't approve of any of it and claimed that hextech was a "curse" and needed to be ended entirely for the good of Piltover. Viktor did not heed Jayce's warning, and when he summoned Salo to return to him with the corrupted power cells, Jayce responded by brutally killing Salo with his corrupted  [Mercury Hammer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jayce#Transform_Mercury_Hammer "Jayce").[[12]](#cite_note-205blisters-12)
structure.appearance:
Salo was a pale thin man with slicked-back blond hair, green eyes, and sharp, angular features. He frequently wore a lavish, white aristocratic coat with red sleeves, gold-trim, and a tall collar, as well as white pants and boots. After being caught in the  [terrorist attack](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Super_Mega_Death_Rocket! "Jinx") that destroyed the entire Council chamber, Salo was paralyzed from the waist down and was forced to move around using a motorized wheelchair, which was sometimes pushed by  [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"). Salo also had a series of linear markings on the skin of his legs and lower torso, which would be traced by his healer,  [Lest](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lest "Universe:Lest"), during their weekly sessions.

Salo eventually developed a heavy addiction to [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer"), and after months of living in obscurity his appearance had become noticeably haggard, unkempt, and unhealthy. In an effort to repair his broken body, Salo was healed by  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), who left arcane fingerprints on Salo's forehead and metal markings that curled around his previously useless legs. After joining Viktor's cult. Salo began wearing a plain white hooded robe with metal belts; an outfit identical to the Herald's other followers.
structure.personality:
Like the stereotypical politician, Salo was a vain and self-centered individual who only cared for his own interests. He was also shown to be corrupt and out of touch with his own people, and appeared to have a disdainful view towards Zaunites. Salo was also a known hedonist, hosting galas, enjoying illegal goods like  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") spirits and [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer"), and hiring servants specifically to stroke his own ego. Despite looking down on others, however, Salo would often fall short of the lofty image he hoped to portray for himself, failing to gain  [Hoskel's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hoskel "Universe:Hoskel") favor the same way  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") had and remaining remarkably easy to find at a time when the city was in an ongoing crisis. When  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") attack killed half the Council and left Salo bound to a wheelchair, his personality became noticeably more belligerent than before, despite previously supporting a diplomatic solution with Zaun. Salo quickly became the most hardline advocate for war on the Council; however, he was said to be little more than a puppet for  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"), and he foolishly agreed to her plan to enact martial law after being promised that he would be instated as the city's commander. Salo eventually faded into obscurity, and he became noticeably more tired, hopeless, and desperate to restore his former prestige.

After being "healed" by  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), Salo's personality was altered significantly, losing his previous arrogance, belligerence, hedonism, his hatred of Zaunites, and even his fear of death. He referred to his old self as "broken" and adopted a serene and servile attitude, with his newfound gratitude and fanaticism towards the Herald being his only defining characteristics.
structure.abilities:
- **Diplomacy:** As a member of the Council, Salo held great sway over influential figures in Piltover, allowing him to make backdoor deals with  [Hoskel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hoskel "Universe:Hoskel") and  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce"), as well holding a great deal of influence over Piltovan trade and law enforcement. After a terrorist attack left half of the Council dead, Salo used his influence to organize a meeting of all the mercantile clans on  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") behalf, allowing her to convince them to enact martial law.
- **[Evolved:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viktor#Glorious_Evolution "Viktor")** After being "healed" by  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), Salo's physical form was restored, allowing him to walk again. In addition to this, Salo's mind was also altered, making him immune to human emotions like vanity or fear.
  - **Hivemind:** Like all of Viktor's followers, Salo's mind was connected to Viktor's through their hivemind. This allowed the Herald to control Salo for limited periods of time, see through his eyes, and even speak through him.

relations.relationship_description: Salo liked to be on Hoskel's good side, even if it meant bribery, but seemed to know very little about his fellow councilor, as he was unaware of Hoskel's birthday or his nut allergy. The two of them argued enough that  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") believed they hated each other; however, the two of them both enjoyed illegal  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") spirits and were willing to employ corrupt tactics to regularly smuggle the drink to Piltover for themselves.[[4]](#cite_note-104progress-4)

Salo did not respect Mel, believing she had only acquired her seat on the Council because she was a  [Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda").[[10]](#cite_note-203finally-10) The two of them quietly fought for influence over their other colleagues, especially  [Councilor Hoskel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hoskel "Universe:Hoskel"), with Mel being more adept at gaining his favor.[[2]](#cite_note-102mysteries-2) Still, they managed to work together for a number of years, with Salo being swayed by a number of Mel's proposals, even voting for the undercity's independence after she voted for the measure and convinced the others to vote with her.[[8]](#cite_note-109monster-8)

After  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") terrorist attack, Salo and Mel became political rivals, as he was manipulated by her mother  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") to support a full-scale invasion of Zaun with [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") weapons. Mel repeatedly blocked Salo's proposals,[[9]](#cite_note-201heavy-9) and he eventually became convinced that she and  [Shoola](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shoola "Universe:Shoola") had to be removed from power, forming a plan with Ambessa to instate himself as Piltover's general under martial law.[[10]](#cite_note-203finally-10) After Salo's plan backfired and he lost his status and power, he remained jealous of all the attention people gave to Mel's disappearance, stating that she almost certainly wasn't coming back after being gone for so long.[[11]](#cite_note-204paint-11)

When Jayce's workshop was robbed and destroyed, Salo was unsympathetic to the young inventor and his  [mother's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ximena "Universe:Ximena") pleas, agreeing with  [Councilor Bolbok](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bolbok "Universe:Bolbok") that he should be banished for violating the Ethos.[[2]](#cite_note-102mysteries-2) After Jayce proved his [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") experiment was viable, however, Salo and the other councilors approved his research and eventually profited immensely from the invention of the Hexgate. Salo later voted in favor with the rest of the Council to elevate Jayce to their august body,[[4]](#cite_note-104progress-4) and even supported Jayce's proposal to remove  [Heimerdinger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger") for failing to properly handle the recent crisis with the undercity.[[6]](#cite_note-106walls-6) Even so, as was the case with most of the councilors, Salo's political alliance with Jayce was merely transactional, and he immediately turned on Jayce when he proposed giving Zaun their independence.[[8]](#cite_note-109monster-8)

Salo did not see Jayce very much after the memorial ceremony for the fallen councilors, as Jayce had withdrawn from politics and would later disappear for months after being trapped in the anomaly. After Salo joined  [Viktor's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") cult, he greeted Jayce calmly and allowed Viktor to speak to Jayce through his body. Jayce was shocked that Salo could walk again, and he could see from his visions that Salo now resembled one of the metal creatures he had encountered in the apocalyptic future. Salo showed no signs of fear when Jayce killed him with his hammer.[[12]](#cite_note-205blisters-12)

After  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") attack on the Council, Salo felt a reignited hatred of the people of Zaun, which was taken advantage of by the Noxian general. With  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") gone from the Council and no longer interested in continuing war with the undercity, Ambessa decided to manipulate Salo instead, orchestrating an attack at the memorial that put his life at risk, and pushing him further into his hardline stance so that he would further seek her advice as an "experienced veteran" of war. Eventually, Ambessa schemed with Salo to sideline the other Council members, and they formed a plan to instate him as the city's leader under martial law. Ambessa's plan excited Salo, and he foolishly obeyed her request to arrange the meeting; however, Ambessa had become frustrated with his incompetence, his [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") addiction, and his repeated failures to start a full-scale war against Zaun. At the gathering of all the mercantile clans, Ambessa suddenly betrayed Salo and instated  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") as the city's commander instead, discarding him as her pawn and leaving him powerless in his own city.

As a haughty Piltovan aristocrat, Salo looked down on the undercity and was largely unsympathetic to their suffering, supporting aggressive measures to crack down on civilians when a Kiramman workshop was robbed, but neglecting to do anything to help regular Zaunites against  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") and his violent criminal empire. When  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") came to the Council with a brokered peace proposal in exchange for Zaun's independence, Salo was vehemently against the measure, only later voting for it after much convincing from  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel"). Even so, the terrorist attack that followed quickly changed Salo's mind, as his brush with death and his debilitating injury necessitated a swift and bloody retribution against  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") and everyone else who opposed Piltover's rule in the underground.

Instead of opening his eyes to the Council's negligence towards the people of Zaun that led to the attack in the first place, Salo doubled down on his belief that the undercity could not be controlled and became radicalized by  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") into supporting an unprecedented show of force: a full-scale invasion of the city led by Enforcers, regardless of the civilian casualties. Mel and Caitlyn ultimately hindered his efforts, and Salo would unintentionally give away all his status and political power trying to make this invasion happen. After losing everything, Salo lost his will to fight Zaun, and traveled to the fissures to have his legs healed by the supposed  ["healer"](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") he had heard about from  [Lest](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lest "Universe:Lest").

Despite the fact that she was a councilor's daughter, Salo did not respect Caitlyn, as she repeatedly intruded on Council meetings that, to Salo's judgment, she did not belong in. The first two times, Caitlyn had been invited by other councilors, and on the third intrusion, she had not even been invited at all, simply barging in and foiling Salo's plan to begin a full-scale invasion of the undercity. Salo later complained that the only reason Caitlyn was allowed to behave in this manner was because she was a  [Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman"), a name that granted her special privileges in Piltovan society. Unfortunately for Salo, this complaint convinced  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") to discard him as her puppet, as she attempted to mold Caitlyn into the city's commander in his place.

After Salo's legs were irreparably ruined by the terrorist attack, he hired Lest to treat his legs with [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") ointments, knowing she was excellent at stroking her clients' egos. Lest had secretly been recruited by  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") to spy on Salo, but Salo remained unaware of this, and they continued their weekly sessions for several months, during which time Salo developed a heavy shimmer addiction. Lest believed Salo had "peculiar tastes," but believed she could handle him. She was also aware of his scheme to take over the city, but believed he would be nothing more than  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") puppet if he were to succeed. Eventually, when Salo demanded they make their meetings more frequent, Lest became uncomfortable and directed him to another healer she had heard rumors about, which turned out to be  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor").

While he was a councilor, Salo did not interact much with Viktor, who was often summoned to the Council chamber alongside  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") but very rarely spoke up. Eventually, Jayce and Viktor arrived the Council chamber with a proposal for Zaun's independence, which sparked outrage among the entire body, including Salo. Salo and Viktor were later among those injured in  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") attack, leaving their bodies broken beyond repair.

Months after Salo had lost all his political power and prestige, Salo remained unable to walk and had developed an addiction to [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") that took a toll on his body, his appearance, and his emotional state. Having lost all hope,  [Lest](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lest "Universe:Lest") suggested he seek out the mysterious "miracle healer" down in the fissures, and in his desperation, Salo found Viktor, who restored him using the  hexcore. The process restored not just Salo's legs, but altered his mind as well, removing his emotions, his fears and petty hatreds, and even his signature arrogance. Salo was grateful to Viktor for mending him from his "broken" state and became fanatically loyal to him, even allowing the Herald to control and speak through his body for periods of time.

structure.name: Trundle
structure.quote: *"Outsmart anyone you can't beat, and beat anyone you can't outsmart."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Trundle was born in a cave in the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") with fifteen brothers and sisters, most of whom died due to the harsh climate and scarce resources in their home. When he grew strong enough, he joined his chieftain's warband for his very first winter of raiding. After numerous victories, the tribe feasted on the spoils, and the old chieftain declared they should circle back and raid the same lands again, as it would be easier the second time. Trundle, however, believed this was a bad idea, as these lands had nothing left for them to pillage. The other [trolls](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Troll "Universe:Troll") did not understand Trundle's reasoning, and the chieftain beat and exiled Trundle from their warband for being a "coward" and a "fool." Having been cast out of his own tribe, Trundle traveled far from his home, avoiding other troll tribes and feral [yetis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yeti "Universe:Yeti") as he survived the harsh conditions.

### Alliance with Lissandra

After some time wandering on his own, Trundle stumbled upon the [Howling Abyss](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Howling_Abyss "Universe:Howling Abyss") where he met  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra") on a dark, frozen lake in the labyrinth under her citadel. Since Trundle was still alive after standing on [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:True_Ice "Universe:True Ice"), Lissandra realized he was an [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Iceborn "Universe:Iceborn") and offered Trundle a home as one of her  [Frostguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Frostguard "Universe:Frostguard"). However, Trundle explained that the only thing he desired as a powerful weapon, which he could use to return to his tribe and become a mighty troll king like Grubgrack the Wise from the ancient legends. After hearing Trundle's story, Lissandra offered to help Trundle in exchange for an alliance, giving him a club of True Ice called  [Boneshiver](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Trundle#Pillar_of_Ice "Trundle"), which he could use to return to his people and become the king of all trolls.

When Trundle returned home to his tribe, he killed the old chieftain with his club, freezing him solid with its magic and then shattering him into a million pieces. Trundle told the other trolls about his new alliance with the Ice Witch, and impressed that he had been chosen to wield great power, they made Trundle their new king.

### Recent History

#### Uniting the Trolls

:   *Main article: [A Feast Fit for a King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/A_Feast_Fit_for_a_King "A Feast Fit for a King")*

Some time after Trundle declared himself "king of all trolls," another troll in the far north, Yettu, decided he wanted to be a king as well. Few began to oppose Yettu's rule after he killed the northern chieftains, and Trundle, angered that another troll was copying him, went to go speak with Yettu in his cave. To decide who would be the one true king, Trundle challenged Yettu to a battle of wits, where they would both eat copious amounts of food until the other one dropped dead. During their feast, Trundle secretly stuffed some of his uneaten food in a leather sack beneath his cloak. When they were both feeling full, Trundle pretended to "make room" in his stomach by cutting his cloak and letting the meat fall onto the floor. Yettu copied Trundle's trick and used the knife to cut open his own stomach, killing himself. Having bested his rival, Trundle was recognized as the true king of the trolls.

#### Encounter with Darius

:   *Main article: [Welcome to Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Welcome_to_Noxus "Universe:Welcome to Noxus")*

During one of the  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") campaigns to the Freljord,  [Darius](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darius "Universe:Darius") and his soldiers attempted to pass through lands that were guarded by Trundle and his trolls. The two leaders fought, and although Trundle physically overpowered Darius and stripped off most of his armor, Darius managed to knock him unconscious using his battle axe, which had been frozen by Boneshiver. Trundle was carried away by his warriors, and Darius survived after suffering freezing damage to his arm.
structure.appearance:
Trundle is a hulking behemoth of a troll, appearing to humans as a giant. He has rugged, light blue skin, glowing blue eyes, and a flare of swept-back red hair. He also has a medium-length beard with no mustache. Like other trolls, he has three digits on each limb, pointed ears, and several upward-pointing tusks on his lower jaw.

He usually wears simple, tribal attire: a loin cloth strapped to a shoulder pad and bracers on his forearms and shins. His clothes are brown leather and lined with pale fur, sometimes decorated with red cloth or blue metal plates. Trundle's club, Boneshiver, is a massive cudgel of jagged, blunt [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:True_Ice "Universe:True Ice"). In the far north, Trundle has been known to wear a patchwork fur cloak to shield him from the cold. After Trundle's feast with his rival, Yettu, he learned what a crown looked like and began wearing one made of dark iron on his forehead.
structure.personality: Trundle is straightforwardly aggressive, antagonistic, and territorial. Ambitious and power-hungry, he is the self-proclaimed king of all frost trolls. While he may seem brutish to humans, he is quite clever by troll standards.
structure.abilities:
- **Troll Physiology:** Frost trolls generally have a hardy constitution and are able to heal more quickly than other mortal races, especially humans.
  - **Strength:** Trundle is incredibly large and strong for a troll, with even mighty human warriors like  [Darius](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darius "Universe:Darius") being dwarfed by him in size.
  - **Thick Hide:** Adult trolls have exceptionally thick skin, which helps them to survive in harsh climates and withstand injuries.
  - **[Powerful Jaws](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Trundle#Chomp "Trundle"):** Trolls have sharp teeth and powerful jaws which are strong enough to crush their prey.
  - **[Regeneration](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Trundle#Subjugate "Trundle"):** Troll can heal themselves from non-life threatening injuries relatively quickly.
- **[Iceborn:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Iceborn "Universe:Iceborn")** Trundle possesses a rare magical alteration that makes him more resistant to the cold than an average troll. As a result of this, he is able to wield weapons of [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:True_Ice "Universe:True Ice").
- **Boneshiver:** Trundle's club is an enormous chunk of [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:True_Ice "Universe:True Ice") attached to an obsidian handle, which he can use to bash and freeze his enemies.
  - **[Frozen Domain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Trundle#Frozen_Domain "Trundle"):** Trundle can control ice in the tundra of the Freljord, which allows him to summon jagged,  [frozen pillars](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Trundle#Pillar_of_Ice "Trundle") from the ground.
  - **[Life Drain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Trundle#King's_Tribute "Trundle"):** Trundle can drain the life force of those who have fallen.
- **Intelligence:** Trundle is smarter than the average troll and can easily outsmart larger trolls who would overpower him physically.
- **Leadership:** Trundle was able to unite and command an army of trolls for  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra").

relations.relationship_description: After being cast out from his tribe, Trundle met Lissandra in the labyrinth beneath her citadel, where she took interest in the fact that he was an [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Iceborn "Universe:Iceborn"), believing he should work for her. At his request, Lissandra gave Trundle his club of True Ice, "Boneshiver". In exchange for it, Trundle agreed to muster a troll army to fight alongside the  [Frostguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Frostguard "Universe:Frostguard").
In his search for the World Runes,  [Ryze](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ryze "Universe:Ryze") confronted Trundle and his trolls.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

Trundle fought a young Darius during a  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") campaign in the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord"). Trundle would not allow Darius to pass through his lands and nearly killed him in their battle. Darius' axe was frozen by Trundle's club, but he was able to use it to knock Trundle unconscious, with his arm sustaining heavy damage from the [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:True_Ice "Universe:True Ice").[[2]](#cite_note-Welcome_to_Noxus-2)

Trundle has been in direct conflict with the  [Avarosan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Avarosan "Universe:Avarosan"), having raided and destroyed their tribelands for defying him.[[3]](#cite_note-Trundle_Flavor_Text-3) Due to the hostility between their two factions, [Ashe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ashe "Universe:Ashe") believes trolls are the "enemy of mankind" and should all be killed.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

structure.trivia:

- Riot Runaan explains Trundle's [lore change.](https://www.surrenderat20.net/2013/04/riotrunaan-explains-trundles-lore-change.html?m=1)
- Trundle's interaction with  [Nocturne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nocturne "Universe:Nocturne") in  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra") reveals that his biggest fear is his club melting.

structure.name: Soraka
structure.quote: *"Two paths lie before you, but you can only take one."*
structure.background:
### Early life

As the Starchild and one celestial being,  **Soraka** and the inhabitants of the [celestial realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial_realm "Celestial realm") watched the [mortal realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Physical_realm "Physical realm") and regarded the fledgling races of  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") with growing concern. The guidance and fates that had been woven by the [celestials](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial "Celestial") into the night sky through [constellations](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Physical_realm#Constellations "Physical realm") often went unseen—or worse, were misinterpreted by the simple mortal minds, leading to chaos, uncertainty, and suffering.

No longer able to merely watch, Soraka chose to descend to the mortal realm, determined to untangle the knots in the tapestry of the world.
And so Soraka came to be, and set upon her journey to soothe the mortals she encountered.

### Contemporary history

Soraka quickly learned the capacity for cruelty that the peoples of Runeterra possessed. Whether on the battlefields of inescapable conflicts, in the seedy underbellies of sprawling cities, or on the frontiers of the untamed wilderness beyond them, there seemed to be no end to the fighting, betrayal, and suffering Soraka witnessed. She watched, helpless, as mortals ignorantly broke the threads of destiny they could have woven together. Their lives were too short, she reasoned. They were simply unable to see the greater patterns, now lost.

But as Soraka lived among them, as one of them, trying to repair what little of the damage she could... something incredible and wholly unforeseen happened.

Soraka noticed a new, unintended design emerging—intertwined, and of a staggering complexity.

Unintended and wild, the mortals were forging new and unknown futures for themselves. From the celestial realm above, it had seemed like pure chaos; but with her new perspective, and blessed by the stars to stand against the erosion of time, Soraka now beheld an almost perfect beauty. Just as mortals had the deepest capacity for cruelty, so too did they possess infinite potential for kindness, and inspiration to rival anything among the stars.

Soraka realized her place was not to repair or replicate the celestial pattern. While a part of her craved the fixed, comforting destinies of the stars, she knew in her heart that static fates could not contain the unbridled, dynamic potential of mortality.

And so her work took on renewed vigor, driven to unlock the untapped possibilities of all she met. Soraka sought now to inspire and guide rather than shepherd, to see what unblazed trails each mortal would discover for themselves in their brief, radiant moment.

### Recent Events

Over the millennia, legends of the Starchild have filtered through all the lands of Runeterra. Some tribes of the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") still speak of a far wanderer, a horned healer who soothed the icy bite of the most brutal winters. In the depths beneath  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), rumors float of a lilac skinned medic who would purify weary lungs from the ravages of the alchemical Gray. In troubled  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), the oldest myths of the [Vastayashai'rei](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastayashai%27rei "Vastayashai'rei") recall a seer who communed with the stars themselves, and called upon their light both to heal the wounded and scorch those who would do further harm to the First Lands.

Currently, Soraka calls the westernmost peaks of  [Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mount_Targon "Universe:Mount Targon"), [Astral Grove](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Astral_Grove "Astral Grove") her home. There she created 2 [Star Spring](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Star_Spring "LoR:Star Spring") a huge source of healing waters where she watches over [an isolated tribe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ottrani "Ottrani") of [vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya"), teaching them her healing ways, and tending quietly to her own needs as well as shepherding [Stellacorns](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Stellacorn "Stellacorn"), alicorn creatures that fall from the celestial realm. They would aid them until maturity when they would send them back to the celestial realm—though what brings her so close to the great mountain, or how long she will stay, only Soraka knows.

Many times, she has watched entire civilizations dance close to the brink of destruction, and she has learned that she cannot save those who do not wish it, nor force them to see what they will not.

All the same, Soraka is determined never to stop trying.

### Halfway Between the Stars and Earth

:   *Main article: [Halfway Between the Stars and Earth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Halfway_Between_the_Stars_and_Earth "Halfway Between the Stars and Earth")*

**Soraka** meets a little  [Rakkor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rakkor "Universe:Rakkor") girl who in the middle of the night was trying to climb the summit of  [Mount Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mount_Targon "Universe:Mount Targon") to prove to her family that she was not "weak". Soraka then tells her about  [A young woman with pale hair](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Diana "Universe:Diana"). Her counterpart,  [a woman whose face burned as brightly as the sun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Leona "Universe:Leona"). And  [a warrior with a spear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pantheon "Universe:Pantheon").

“All of these mortals ascended to the peak. But they had chosen that path with all their soul.” She turned to the girl and spoke slowly, taking no delight in her words. “You have not truly chosen the mountain. And Targon will not choose you. You would walk to your death. Don’t do this.”

then calling the girl to warm up and have tea, where she could leave at dawn, not to climb the mountain, but to start over and find a new path in her life.

### The Dreaming Pool

:   *Main article: [The Dreaming Pool](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Dreaming_Pool "The Dreaming Pool")*

A [Vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") named Kalan travels to [Fae'lor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fae%27lor "Fae'lor") Castle, home of Dael'eh Ahira, or the Dreaming Pool, a spiritually magical pool that previously imprisoned  [Syndra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Syndra "Universe:Syndra"). After an accident, Kalan eventually freed  [Syndra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Syndra "Universe:Syndra"), Kalan knelt, motionless and silent, as he waited for  **seer** to speak.
 **Soraka** told Kalan about [Fae'lor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fae%27lor "Fae'lor") and their possible future fates.
Currently, Kalan is imprisoned in Dael'eh Ahira, or Lake of Dreams.
structure.appearance: Soraka is a [celestial being](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial "Celestial") slender of lilac skinned, long pale blonde hair with a single horn on the forehead, golden eyes and with goat-like legs. She wears simple wanderer outfits with a distinct palette of red, orange and some brown touches, including her cape. The most distinctive ornament on her attire is the 1 [Gems](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Gem "LoR:Gem") adornments. It also has a golden  [Celestial Staff](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Soraka#Salvation "Soraka") shaped like a moon at the tip. While having the appearance of the [ottrani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ottrani "Ottrani"),  **Soraka** only took the form of one, with her one horn being a key distinction from the [vastayans](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya").
structure.personality:
Soraka is a very kind and humble individual, but she is also extremely protective and caring for [those who follow her and who rely on her guidance](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ottrani "Ottrani"). She is faithful to her cause in wanting to help those in need and always seeks to help those who seek help.

Despite this, Soraka believes in free will above everything else. Although she offers guidance, the offered must accept being guided and healed for her to be capable of helping. She offers numerous paths to mortals, but only they may choose the way they will walk.
structure.abilities:
- **[Celestial Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial "Celestial"):** As a [celestial being](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial "Celestial"), Soraka does not have a natural physical body and must create one to enter the physical realm. In this case, she chose the appearance of the [ottrani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ottrani "Ottrani") tribe which she cares for, with her one horn the distinction between her and the vastaya. She also experiences reality in a different manner than mortals and has innate access to celestial magics to use for various purposes.
- **Celestial Magic:** As a Celestial, Soraka has access to her species' powerful celestial magic, being able to use it for many purposes.
  - **Healing Magic:** Soraka is able to physically heal individuals. However, doing this brings her pain, as the physical body she fashioned cannot withstand her celestial powers.
  - **Star Magic:** As a celestial, Soraka is able to control celestial magic in the form of  [starcalls](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Soraka#Starcall "Soraka") and  [celestial zones](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Soraka#Equinox "Soraka").
  - **Seer:** As Soraka does not experience reality in linearity, she is able to predict possible futures for an individual, guiding them in what choices they can take.

relations.relationship_description: Soraka, being a celestial being, knows of Aurelion Sol and seems to know him personally. While Aurelion sees Soraka as having lowered herself, she disagrees with him and sees beauty in being in the mortal world.

Pantheon once told Soraka "If only your kind could see what you see, Soraka, they would weep for you as you weep for us."
Soraka refers to  [Pantheon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pantheon "Universe:Pantheon") as "Warrior with a spear" and he refers to her as 'The Seer'. Soraka once designed Pantheon in a constellation of stars.

Taric is quite generous to Soraka. For example, when Soraka tells him "Your star shines brightly," and he replies "There is no one as brilliant as you." Both also seem to share the vision of looking to mortals with kindness, such as when Soraka says "This world has great potential," and  [Taric](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taric "Universe:Taric") nods, saying "Each life is uniquely faceted."

Soraka knows the pain of the  [Lunari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lunari "Universe:Lunari") twins, but tells them not to feel it. What  [Alune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Alune "Universe:Alune") considers would be to deny her and her  [brother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aphelios "Universe:Aphelios") their existence.

Diana met a [Celestial](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial "Celestial") being descending from the [Astral Grove](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Astral_Grove "Astral Grove"). Soraka refers to  [Diana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Diana "Universe:Diana") as the "Pale-haired Woman"/"Sable-haired Girl"
Soraka refers to  [Leona](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Leona "Universe:Leona") as "Woman whose face burned like the sun"
During their climb on top of Mount Targon, Tyari would meet the Starchild, who would give them assurance for their efforts.
Soraka personally knows the Arbiter of the Peak and is on good terms with him.

Soraka watches over [an isolated tribe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ottrani "Ottrani") of [vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya"), teaching them her healing ways and tending quietly to her own needs as well as shepherding [stellacorns](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Stellacorn "Stellacorn") — alicorn creatures that fall from the celestial realm. She is a mentor to all in the tribe like **Illi**, 3 [Hakan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Spring_Guardian "LoR:Spring Guardian"), 4 [Lidari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Stargazer "LoR:Stargazer"), and 4 [Vin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Broadbacked_Protector "LoR:Broadbacked Protector").

structure.trivia:

- Soraka knows of  [Bard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bard "Universe:Bard"), and as a Celestial Being, she has deeper ties with him as well.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

structure.name: Cassandra
structure.background:
### Early Life

Cassandra was born to the wealthy and influential  [Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman") family, and inherited her family's position on the Piltover Council as an adult. Eventually, she married a man named  [Tobias](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tobias "Universe:Tobias") and had a daughter named  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"). At some point after she became a politician, Cassandra saw ambition in  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce"), a young prodigy and aspiring scientist at Piltover Academy, and decided to fund his education and research as his patron. In order to help him with this, she also granted him access to one of her family's buildings in the city's Academy district to serve as his workshop.[[4]](#cite_note-102mysteries-4)

### Councilor of Piltover

#### Discovery of Hextech

Several years later,  [Jayce's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") workshop exploded after a break-in by undercity robbers. As they all considered Jayce a family friend and protégé,  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") urged her parents to speak up for him, and Cassandra agreed to help so that the boy would not be punished too severely. Unfortunately, Jayce revealed during the trial that his research had involved meddling with the arcane, which was highly illegal, dangerous, and demanded Jayce's immediate banishment from Piltover. After Jayce's mother  [Ximena](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ximena "Universe:Ximena") spoke up for him, Cassandra supported a motion by  [Heimerdinger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger") to have Jayce expelled from the Academy and remanded to the care of his parents—a much more lenient sentence that passed with only a narrow majority. After the trial, Cassandra and the rest of the Council sent Sheriff  [Grayson](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Grayson "Universe:Grayson") and her deputy  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus") to capture the undercity criminals, as retribution for destroying a Kiramman building.[[5]](#cite_note-5)[[4]](#cite_note-102mysteries-4)

Although Jayce had been successfully rescued on account of Heimerdinger and Cassandra's efforts, his outburst during the trial had left his name disgraced in Piltover, which in turn brought great shame to the Kirammans. Jayce lost the support of Cassandra and Tobias, who cut the funds to his research and ordered him to stay away from Caitlyn, leaving him with nothing and driving him to the point of suicide.[[4]](#cite_note-102mysteries-4) Soon, however, Jayce's research would be vindicated as he successfully completed his [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") experiment with the help of  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), proving that it was viable to harness magic through science after all.[[6]](#cite_note-6) After learning this, the Council voted to approve Jayce's research, restoring both his reputation and the Kirammans' favor and patronage towards him. Eventually, the entire city, including Cassandra, benefited greatly from Jayce's creation of the Hexgate.[[7]](#cite_note-104progress-7)

#### Piltovan Bicentennial

Years later, when  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") was an adult, she joined  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") as a junior officer. This was against her parents' wishes, as Cassandra believed such a career was not appropriate for someone of Caitlyn's station. Cassandra would try to protect her daughter during this time, using her influence as a councilor to have Caitlyn placed in minor roles away from any danger, undermining her desire to see the real world. At the celebration of Piltover's bicentennial Progress Day, Caitlyn was nearly killed by an explosion caused by  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") on the Academy Square, and Cassandra used her influence to have the Sheriff,  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus") remove her from the force for her own safety.

After it was revealed that Jinx stole a hextech gemstone from Jayce and Viktor's lab, the Council agreed to grant Jayce a seat at their table as a councilor.[[7]](#cite_note-104progress-7) Jayce's new position made him aware of the deep corruption that occurred between many of the merchants who used the Hexgate and he attempted to root it out all by himself, causing some of the other councilors to plot against him. After being convinced by Mel, Jayce earned back their favor by forging his own deals with each of them, which included Cassandra.[[8]](#cite_note-105enemy-8) Cassandra was later present at the meeting where Jayce put forth a motion to forcibly dismiss Heimerdinger from the Council, and although Cassandra was shocked, she ultimately sided with Jayce and the other councilors, forcing the [yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yordle "Universe:Yordle") into early retirement.[[9]](#cite_note-106walls-9)

Despite the fact that Caitlyn had lost her job as an Enforcer, she continued to investigate her theories on  [Zaun's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") criminal underworld with the help of  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") and eventually returned from the undercity a few days later, injured by another explosion caused by Jinx on the Bridge of Progress. Although Cassandra was initially concerned by the fact that Caitlyn had broken several laws, she was eventually convinced to schedule an audience with the Council when Caitlyn explained to her just how horrible the living conditions in Zaun had become and how the Council's passiveness towards the problem had only made it worse. After hearing Vi and Caitlyn's testimony on  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") criminal empire, the Council decided to try negotiating with him in order to avoid a war with the undercity, with Cassandra supporting the decision. Vi and Jayce, however, argued that it was foolish to try and negotiate, and after Vi stormed out of the building, Cassandra encouraged her daughter to go speak with her.[[10]](#cite_note-10)

### Death & Legacy

After he ventured into the undercity to take down one of  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") production factory,  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") later informed the Council that he had offered Silco the undercity's independence in exchange for the [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") gemstone and  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"). Although Cassandra was one of the first to object to his proposal, as it was highly radical and went against the Council's procedures, she eventually agreed to it alongside the other councilors. However, before the Council could finalize their decision to grant Zaun its independence, the Council room was bombed by Jinx with  [Fishbones](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Switcheroo! "Jinx"), her signature rocket launcher.[[11]](#cite_note-11) Cassandra was one of the three councilors alongside  [Hoskel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hoskel "Universe:Hoskel") and  [Bolbok](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bolbok "Universe:Bolbok") to perish in the subsequent explosion. Her funeral was held shortly afterwards and she was eventually immortalized alongside her fellow fallen councilors by a memorial statue in Piltover.[[12]](#cite_note-201heavy-12)

Due to how sudden it was, Cassandra's death left a massive void in her family, and lead both her husband and her daughter to mourn her passing in the months that followed. Caitlyn was also forced to take her Cassandra's place as the head of  [Clan Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman") before she had enough time to process her grief and eventually became dangerously obsessed with killing Jinx in order to avenge her mother's murder, even if it meant resorting to unethical methods and harming innocents in the underground.[[12]](#cite_note-201heavy-12)
structure.appearance: Cassandra was a middle-aged woman with blue eyes, pale skin, and dark brown hair with gray streaks. She was often seen wearing expensive Piltovan attire, with additional accessories such as gloves, earrings, and a bow tie.
structure.personality:
Like the stereotypical politician, Cassandra was somewhat selfish, unreasonable, and shallow, as displayed by how she cared more about the impact of Caitlyn's actions on her reputation over all the horrors that her daughter had seen in the undercity. She was also overprotective and strict towards her daughter, given by how she used her political influence to ensure Caitlyn's safety as an Enforcer.

Despite all her flaws, Cassandra cared deeply about her family, especially her daughter, and generally supported her decisions, as displayed when she used her influence to grant Caitlyn and Vi an audience with the Council. She was also capable of feeling genuine empathy for people of lower status, which was seen in a recording she left to Caitlyn where she declared her belief that the people of the undercity "deserved to breathe" and ordered Piltover's architects to devise a ventilation system that would prevent them from suffering from Zaun's extreme air pollution.[[13]](#cite_note-203finally-13)
structure.abilities:
- **Diplomacy:** As the head of  [Clan Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman"), Cassandra had to become skilled in the art of diplomacy to strengthen her clan's status in Piltovan politics. At some point she would become a member of the Piltover Council.
- **Hunting:** Just like the rest of her family, Cassandra had an interest in hunting as a hobby.
- **Rifle Proficiency:** Like her husband and daughter, Cassandra was skilled with a rifle. She would also use a rifle to defend her home of any would-be invaders.

relations.relationship_description: Cassandra was the matriarch of the family, and Tobias was a supportive husband and father to their daughter,  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"). Tobias often played the peacemaker between Cassandra and Caitlyn, as the two would frequently quarrel. Despite their differences, Tobias loved his wife very much and was stricken with grief after she died, so much that he stopped taking care of himself and would lash out at others.

As her mother, Cassandra always expected Caitlyn to be a good example worthy of the Kiramman name. She thus disapproved of Caitlyn's career path as a Piltover Enforcer, believing it was not a job befitting her station. Cassandra would use her influence as Councilor to make sure Caitlyn was only ever posted in unexciting locations for her safety. When Caitlyn almost died in an explosion caused by  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), Cassandra used her influence to get her fired from her job. Caitlyn was frequently vexed by her mother preventing her from seeing the real world and would actively avoid her because of it. She also believed Cassandra was more concerned about the optics of her actions than helping the victims of  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") criminal activities. Cassandra in turn would disapprove of Caitlyn's misfit behavior, where she would break regulation to investigate Silco's activities. Even so, Cassandra cared about her daughter and appreciated her service to people, despite disapproving of her methods. When Caitlyn asked her to let her present evidence of Silco's conspiracy to the Piltover Council, Cassandra obliged even though her police work was unsanctioned and could reflect badly on the family, and even encouraged Caitlyn to go after  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") when there was trouble in their relationship.

Cassandra's death in Jinx's attack on the Council greatly affected Caitlyn, and she would blame herself for failing to kill Jinx when she had the chance. The absence of her mother left Caitlyn angry and confused and would directly cause her obsession with hunting down and killing Jinx.

When Jayce was a student at the Academy, he caught the eye of Cassandra and Tobias Kiramman, who recognized ambition in the young boy and decided to financially support his research. Cassandra considered Jayce an important protégé of hers, and after the robbery destroyed his lab, she vowed to speak up for him at the trial, despite Tobias' anger with Jayce for putting their  [daughter](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") at risk. Since she was fond of Jayce, Cassandra voted to prevent his banishment from  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"); however, the trial still ended with his expulsion from the Academy and his disgrace in the eyes of Piltovan society, bringing great shame upon both House Talis and  [Clan Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman"). The Kirammans withdrew their support for Jayce and forbid him from visiting them anymore, but Jayce managed to prove everyone wrong when he successfully completed his [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") experiment. Cassandra and the rest of the Council would eventually approve hextech research, redeeming Jayce in the eyes of Piltover and restoring the Kirammans' support for him.

Once Jayce became a councilor himself, Cassandra was one of the many councilors who was enticed by Jayce's quid pro quo deals in exchange for her support of his agendas. She was surprised by how adept at politics he became, and nervously supported him when he called for  [Heimerdinger's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger") expulsion from the Council. Nevertheless, she was willing to push back on his more radical proposals, such as when he proposed giving  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") its independence. However, after further debate, she was convinced to approve the motion.

Although Cassandra was patronizing to Vi, calling her a "stray" when she first caught Vi and  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") sneaking in through the window, she was hospitable to her and recognized that Vi was important to her daughter. After some convincing, Cassandra arranged a Council meeting so that Vi and Caitlyn could present the findings of their investigation, and she even encouraged Caitlyn to go after Vi when there was trouble in their relationship.
