structure.name: Isha
structure.background:
### Early Life

Not much is known about Isha's early life. It is heavily implied that she lost her parents at a young age and spent a large portion of her life on the streets of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun").[[1]](#cite_note-202watch-1)

### Meeting Jinx

Not long after  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") death, Isha got caught in the turf wars between the  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons") and ended up on the run from  [Chross'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross") goons. In her efforts to escape, Isha attempted to jump over a gap to an open drain pipe. However, she lost her grip and landed on top of  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), who just happened to be walking below them at the time.

As the gangsters approached Isha, Jinx protected her by mercilessly shooting them all with her  [pistol](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blowback_(Legends_of_Runeterra) "Blowback (Legends of Runeterra)") before any of them could react in time to defend themselves. After saving the girl, Jinx gave Isha a small lecture about the buzz she would get every time she killed a person and introduced herself by pointing to all the wanted posters plastered with her face on a nearby wall. She then playfully described herself as a "curse" on society before returning Isha's helmet to her and walking away.

Despite the fact that Jinx was a wanted fugitive, Isha secretly followed her and later came to her rescue by tossing a grenade when Jinx was cornered in an alleyway by  [Smeech's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech") henchmen, distracting them long enough for Jinx to shoot and kill one of them. After realizing that Isha was the one who threw the grenade, Jinx gave her a small gunshot salute as a show of thanks. Isha grinned back at her, and the two girls then watched as  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") fought Smeech and brutally mangled him to death with her new mechanical arm.[[1]](#cite_note-202watch-1)

### Battle at the Temple

Isha was present when Jinx and Sevika prepared a trap for  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") and  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") at an underground temple dedicated to the goddess  [Janna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Janna "Universe:Janna"), and watched them engage the two Enforcers in battle when they later arrived at the temple to kill Jinx as retribution for her council bombing. After watching the battle from afar for some time, Isha realized that Jinx and Sevika were gradually losing their struggle against Vi and Caitlyn, and ran down in order to help them. When Vi eventually overpowered Jinx, pinned her down on the altar in the middle of the temple, and prepared to kill her, Isha grabbed Jinx’s pistol, jumped in between them, and put the gun up to Vi’s head.

Isha's sudden appearance led Vi to hesitate, but before Isha could pull the trigger, Caitlyn shot the pistol out of her hands. This caused Isha to fall on top of Jinx and start to cry as she shielded Jinx with her own body, despite Jinx's protests for her to let go and run away. Although Caitlyn remained determined to kill Jinx, Vi stopped her from taking the shot at Jinx, worried that Isha would get caught in the crossfire. This momentary distraction allowed Sevika to activate a paint bomb Jinx had set up earlier, generating giant gusts of wind that blew Vi and Caitlyn out of the temple, pumped massive amounts of the Grey back up into Piltover, and bought enough time for Jinx, Isha, and Sevika to make their escape before the Enforcers could pursue them further.[[2]](#cite_note-203finally-2)

### Martial Law

After their battle with Vi and Caitlyn, Jinx decided to take Isha under her care and set up a blanket fort on the side of her lair so that Isha would have a place to sleep. As time passed, Isha became very close to Jinx and established a tight sisterly bond with her, similar to the bond that Jinx had with Vi when they were children. They went on jaunts around the undercity together, played dozens of games with each other, and even developed their own handshake. Isha’s admiration and loyalty towards Jinx also grew over this period of time and eventually led her to get the same cloud tattoos and change out her clothes to where they aligned with Jinx’s unique fashion style. She also tried to have Jinx paint her hair blue several times, but the latter gently refused every time she asked due to her belief that it wasn’t a good idea.

Although Isha was happy to have found a family with Jinx, she couldn’t bring herself to ignore the oppression and cruelty that their people were facing from  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and wanted Jinx to take her place as the symbol of the rebellion against their occupation. Unfortunately, Jinx wasn’t on board with launching another uprising against Piltover and no matter how many times Isha and Sevika tried to persuade her otherwise, she refused to take part in the rebellion. Even so, Isha came to believe in Jinx as a symbol of hope for Zaun and often admired the graffiti art that her supporters had painted around the undercity in her honor.

Several months after they first went into hiding, Isha finally got Jinx to paint her hair blue after winning a bet over one of their bug fights. However, when Jinx once again refused to play her part in the insurgency against Piltover, Isha took some of her paint bombs and used them to stage a daring stunt on a Piltovan border checkpoint while dressed in a hooded cloak to disguise herself as Jinx. Although Isha's stunt succeeded in tricking the people of the undercity into believing that Jinx had finally returned, it failed to motivate Jinx into participating in the fight for Zaun's freedom, much to her disappointment. As a result, when Sevika later showed up to tell them about the rebel rally she was planning that night at  [Vander's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") statue, Isha decided to attend the rally in Jinx’s place.[[3]](#cite_note-204paint-3)

### Arrest in Stillwater

During the rally, the Zaunites in attendance started to become restless and told Sevika that they’d been expecting to see Jinx. However, just as she was starting to lose the crowd, Isha climbed on top of a nearby building and lit up a blue flare. This caused the people in the crowd -  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights"), Jinxers, and former chemgoons - to raise their left fists in the air to show their solidarity with the rebellion, much to Isha’s delight. However, the rally was suddenly cut short by  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"), who threw a spear that destroyed Sevika's mechanical arm. The Enforcers under his command then attacked the people in the crowd and started arresting everyone in sight.

Despite the fact that she could have easily escaped and made it back safely to Jinx’s lair, Isha refused to run and attacked Rictus instead, but her tiny fists failed to phase him at all. Mildly irritated, Rictus then threw Isha onto the statue's pedestal, knocking her out cold. Isha was then arrested and sent on a transport to Stillwater Hold, leaving Sevika to tell Jinx about her capture. While being transported to the prison, Isha encountered  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed"), who was bleeding from a cut on his right palm. Upon seeing her hiding in the back of the prison cart, Singed told her to keep her chin up and tried to cheer her up by claiming that they wouldn’t be staying at Stillwater for very long, much to her confusion.

At Stillwater, Isha was given her own cell and locked up in the same area of the prison as Singed, who was placed just down the hall from her. Fortunately, not long after being put in her cell, Isha was freed by Jinx, who had come to Stillwater to rescue her and all the other prisoners after being informed of their arrests by Sevika. Overjoyed to see her, Isha rushed forward to hug Jinx and they shared a tender moment together as Isha cried in her arms and Jinx checked to see that she was okay. However, before they could escape the prison with Sevika, a small squad of Enforcers armed with riot gear abruptly walked in through the elevator, ready to arrest them all over again.

Jinx and Sevika moved to defend Isha, but before a scuffle could break out,  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") suddenly smashed through the elevator doors, having followed the trail of blood left behind by Singed, and brutally slaughtered every Enforcer in this path. Jinx then shot at Warwick with her  [Zapper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Zap! "Jinx"), but upon seeing that it had no effect on him, she ordered Sevika to get Isha out to safety while she stayed behind as a distraction. Not wanting Jinx to die for her sake, Isha struggled to escape from Sevika’s grasp as she was carried out of the prison and started sobbing in despair when she realized that there was a good chance that Jinx wouldn’t return home alive. Fortunately for Isha, Jinx survived her battle with Warwick and presumably reunited with her after making it back home safely to Zaun.[[3]](#cite_note-204paint-3)

### Tracking The Beast

Having discovered that Warwick was her adoptive father  [Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") when she fought him in Stillwater, Jinx convinced  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), who had become a pit fighter after her falling-out with Caitlyn, to help her track him down and brought Isha along to accompany them. While searching for Warwick in the mines, Vi and Jinx got into a fistfight over the unresolved resentment from their battle months earlier. When Isha tried to defend Jinx by biting Vi on the arm, Vi accidentally punched her in the face, giving her a nosebleed. Jinx rushed over to Isha to make sure she was okay and after Isha nodded to her that she was fine, the girls continued their search for Warwick, completely unaware of the fact that he had picked up on the scent of Isha’s blood and was already on their trail.

While exploring a deeper section of the mine, the girls discovered a room that Vander and  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") had used as their workshop during their younger years and found a letter that Vander had left for Silco, in which he apologized for attacking him out of rage and grief for the death of their close friend  [Felicia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Felicia "Universe:Felicia"), who was also Vi and Jinx's mother. When Jinx sadly remarked how things could have turned out completely different had Silco managed to read this letter after Vander betrayed him, Isha consoled her. Once Vi put her gauntlets back on, the girls left the workshop to continue their search for Warwick.

Sometime after leaving Vander and Silco’s old workshop, Vi, Jinx, and Isha all realized that something was off, and they all turned around to see Warwick rushing towards them from a distance. Realizing that Warwick was going to attack them, Vi countered his charge with her  [Atlas Gauntlets](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vi#Relentless_Force "Vi"), narrowly preventing him from killing Isha. Terrified, Isha hid behind Jinx next to the wall and they both anxiously watched as Vi clashed with Warwick and tried to beat him into submission to no avail due to his regeneration and superior strength.

As the battle raged on, Warwick eventually overpowered Vi and turned his attention to Jinx and Isha on the other side of the hallway. Although he momentarily recognized Jinx as his adoptive daughter, Warwick’s concentration was disrupted when Vi spit blood onto the ground, re-igniting his intense bloodlust and causing him to go berserk. He charged at Vi again, but before he could attack her, she finally called out his name as “Vander,” abruptly plunging the entire hallway into total darkness.

Confused as to what had just happened, Isha silently watched as Jinx apprehensively lit up her lighter and started slowly walking forward while holding onto her right hand. As the dust cleared and they got closer to the other side of the hallway, they were astonished to see Vi wrapped in Warwick’s embrace and realized that Vander's consciousness had finally resurfaced. When Vi turned to Jinx and invited her to join in, Jinx burst into tears, let go of Isha, and rushed forward to hug them both. Isha then followed suit by hugging Vi and Jinx, allowing Warwick to embrace them all in a heartfelt family reunion.[[4]](#cite_note-205blisters-4)

### The Herald's Commune

Having recovered some of Vander's memories, Jinx and Vi began to seek out a way to bring him back fully. Their search led them to  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), a healer in the undercity who was rumored to perform miracles, and the three of them hoped his powers could be used to restore Vander's mind within Warwick. As they led him to Viktor's [commune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Church_of_the_Glorious_Evolved "Universe:Church of the Glorious Evolved"), a cultist guarding the entrance,  [Huck](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Huck "Universe:Huck"), asked to collect their weapons, the  [Zapper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Zap! "Jinx") and  [Atlas Gauntlets](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vi#Relentless_Force "Vi"). Seeing Jinx had removed the hextech gemstone from her pistol, Isha did the same with Vi's gauntlets, keeping the two gemstones hidden in her pocket.

After they met with the Herald, he agreed to help them on the condition that Warwick stay restrained at night, and Isha spent the next few days watching as Viktor tried to heal him, slowly and without much success. To put Warwick at ease, Isha delivered him food and water, and after much effort, Viktor finally made progress at recovering portions of Vander's mind.

Their progress faltered, however, when Rictus, Singed, and their leader,  [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"), marched on the commune with an army, dropping a battle standard at the entrance as they prepared their attack. After realizing the army had come for Warwick, Vi informed Jinx that Vander was in trouble and posted her to keep watch as she carried out a plan to save him, which involved teaming up with Caitlyn. Jinx sent Isha to steal back her Zapper from Viktor's cultists, and when she returned with the pistol, Jinx told her about how much her perception of life had changed in their time together before leaping down to battle Ambessa's henchmen. Although Rictus defeated Jinx, Warwick saved her at the last moment and hurled the Noxian from the structure, just in time for Isha and Vi to catch up with them and see that Vander had been restored.

Unfortunately, there was a  [blast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jayce#Transform_Mercury_Cannon "Jayce") in the central building of the commune and Viktor's cultists would suddenly let out a bloodcurdling shriek to the heavens before collapsing, seemingly dead on the ground. Warwick too would let out a  [primal howl](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Warwick#Primal_Howl "Warwick") and went berserk, gruesomely murdering Rictus in front of Ambessa, which began a horrific battle between the beast and the Noxian warband.[[5]](#cite_note-206message-5)

### Sacrifice and Legacy

Trapped within the fray, Vi and Caitlyn tried to fight off the Noxians as Jinx tried desperately to calm Warwick down. Vi was injured by a Noxian blade, and Jinx's efforts failed as Warwick attacked her, knocking her to the ground. Realizing Jinx and Vi were under threat, Isha picked up Jinx's Zapper, pulled the two hextech gemstones from her pocket, and in one last desperate act of courage, overloaded the gemstones into the pistol to create a massive, devastating explosion, sacrificing herself to defeat Warwick and save her newfound family. Her death deeply impacted Jinx, pushing her further into despair.[[5]](#cite_note-206message-5)

Isha's sacrifice left an indelible mark on Jinx, whose grief manifested in moments of quiet remembrance. Jinx often alluded to Isha in her creations and musings, referring to her as a cherished memory of innocence lost amidst the chaos she consumed over the years. Eventually, she decided to commit suicide to end her pain only to be stopped by  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko") who reminded her that there was still hope no matter what happened in the past. Taking Ekko's advice, Jinx decided to memorialize Isha as she fought for Zaun's future, building a new hextech weapon and a mighty war balloon, which she decorated with painting's reminiscent of Isha's outfit.[[6]](#cite_note-209nails-6)[[7]](#cite_note-7)
structure.appearance:
Isha was a short and slender young girl appearing to be about 8-10 years old, with big, golden brown eyes, faint freckles scattered across her cheeks, slightly pale skin, and a button nose. She also had a noticeable gap between her two front teeth and short, tousled brown hair. After being adopted by Jinx, she dyed her hair blue and got the same cloud tattoos that Jinx has on her arms and shoulders. As noted by Jinx herself, Isha also greatly resembled her younger self, "Powder."

Isha's original outfit consisted of a short-sleeved, bluish-green vest over a white undershirt, tattered teal pants, long yellow socks, simple brown boots, and a bluish-green hat with orange goggles. While living in hiding, she stylized her clothes to make it look more like Jinx's outfits by adding various Jinx-themed accessories to it, cutting off the sleeves to her vest, changing into dark purple trousers, and adding pink war paint to her face.
structure.personality:
Due to her young age and implied mutism, Isha was a quiet and pure-hearted girl who was always willing to help out the people she cared about, especially Jinx. She also had a great sense of loyalty towards her loved ones and was brave to the point of recklessness, as demonstrated when she risked her life to protect Jinx from getting killed by  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") and shielded the latter with her own body to prevent  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") from getting a clear shot at her.[[2]](#cite_note-203finally-2) However, like any girl her age, Isha still tended to get emotional quite easily, as displayed when she attacked  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"), a  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") warrior far stronger than her, out of anger and later gave Jinx a big, tearful hug when the latter came to rescue her from Stillwater.

Like most Zaunites, Isha had little love for  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and supported the underground rebel movement, which made her somewhat disappointed to discover that Jinx had no interest in serving as the symbol of the revolution. In hopes of motivating Jinx to fight for Zaun's freedom, Isha proved to be very clever and crafty, as she managed to disguise herself as Jinx without anyone ever finding out that she wasn't the real deal and even trick  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") into thinking that Jinx was back in action and ready to lead an uprising against the Topsiders.[[3]](#cite_note-204paint-3)

After Jinx went into hiding, Isha kept her company and established a close sisterly bond to her over the next year, to where she dressed like her, entertained her with countless games and adventures, and dyed her hair blue. She also came to idolize Jinx and treat her like family, as shown when she jumped to Jinx's defense during her fistfight with  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") in the mines and started crying in fear to see Jinx deliberately use herself as a distraction against  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") so that Sevika could take her to safety.[[3]](#cite_note-204paint-3) The deep emotional attachment that Isha had for Jinx led her to never judge her for her past crimes, even when she was accused of them out loud, and ultimately convinced her to heroically sacrifice herself to save Jinx from being killed by Warwick and  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"), despite knowing that doing so would tragically result in her demise.[[5]](#cite_note-206message-5)
structure.abilities: - **Ingenuity:** Despite her young age, Isha was shown to be surprisingly perceptive and intelligent. She was able to convincingly impersonate Jinx during a daring stunt on a border checkpoint between Zaun and Piltover, which subsequently inspired the people of the underground to continue the revolution against the Topsiders, and successfully rally her fellow Zaunites into supporting Jinx as the face of the rebellion against Piltover. She was also smart enough to figure out how to use and replicate some of Jinx's bombs even though she never had any formal education in engineering, which helped trick the Noxians into thinking that she was Jinx.

relations.relationship_description:
From Isha's perspective, Jinx was more than a protector; she was a mentor, a sister, and a source of inspiration. After Jinx saved her from  [Chross'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross") thugs, Isha began following her, forming a bond rooted in admiration, despite Jinx's role as a dangerous criminal and her low self worth. When Jinx was prepared to let herself be killed by  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), Isha put herself between them and stubbornly refused to let her go, despite Jinx's protests. After her battle with Vi, Jinx vanished from the public eye but allowed Isha to move in with her, setting up a corner of her lair to serve as Isha's room.

Jinx brought light to Isha’s bleak life as they lived in hiding, filling their shared space with joy, color, and creativity. Together, they arranged playful fighting matches between Jinx’s pet bugs and spent time exploring  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), creating graffiti, sharing laughs, dancing together, and they developed their own secret handshake. Jinx appreciated having a sister who enjoyed the same activities she did, and remarked that Vi only ever liked "punching" things. Jinx also trusted Isha enough to tell her her old name, "Powder," and said Isha reminded her of her younger self. In turn, Isha idolized Jinx to the extent of mimicking her style, including her tattoos and hair color. Along with  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika"), Isha frequently urged Jinx to step back into the fight for Zaun's freedom, but Jinx stubbornly refused, as she was happy with her new life with Isha and did not want to relive the past. Isha refused to let Jinx stay "dead," however, and her admiration for Jinx drove her to impersonate her at the checkpoint a in large, colorful display of rebellion against the  [Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") and  [Noxians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") as a means to force Jinx back into the spotlight.

Jinx, despite her chaotic demeanor, was deeply protective of Isha, treating her as a valuable companion and expressing a desire not to let her down when she spoke to  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") chair. After Isha was captured by  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus") and brought to Stillwater, Jinx visibly panicked and experienced violent hallucinations that had long since gone away since Isha had come into her life. Tragically, Isha sacrificed herself to save Jinx from  [Warwick's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") rampage, leaving Jinx devastated. In honor of her sacrifice, Jinx immortalized Isha through the design of her war balloon and her costume.

Isha and Sevika were  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") only companions after  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") death, and they first met each other while both trying to save her. They first assisted Jinx against  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech") and his goons, with Sevika doing most of the heavy lifting, and then joined forces with Jinx in full for her battle against  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") and  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"). After the battle ended in Jinx's defeat, Sevika was the one who saved them both, activating a bomb that hurled the  [Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") from the temple as she shielded Jinx and Isha from the blast. Months later, Sevika would protect Isha again after she was sent to Stillwater, enlisting Jinx's help for a rescue mission and later carrying the girl to safety at Jinx's request, despite Isha's reluctance to leave Jinx behind.

Isha and Sevika interacted regularly while Piltover was under martial law, with both of them urging Jinx to use her new status as a symbol to unite Zaun against Piltover's occupation. Though Jinx suspected they might be conspiring together to bring her out of hiding, Sevika was unaware that Isha was impersonating Jinx, as Isha kept her role in the demonstration a secret from both of them. Eventually, Sevika was surprised to see Isha show up in Jinx's place at the rally, she began to raise her arm in solidarity with the rest of the crowd shortly before  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus") attacked them both. It is unknown if Jinx told Sevika about Isha's death before the battle at the hexgates.

Isha viewed Vi with a mixture of fear and respect. Initially, their relationship was tense, as Isha aimed  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") pistol at Vi during their confrontation, and appeared ready to shoot her to protect Jinx. Isha's love for Jinx made Vi reconsider her approach, and when she realized  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") was willing to risk shooting a child to complete their mission, she blocked Caitlyn's shot, inadvertently allowing Isha and Jinx the chance to escape. Several months later, Isha and Vi met again during their search for  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), during which time Vi argued with Jinx and eventually got into a fistfight with her. When Isha tried to stop them, Vi accidentally hit her, and realizing she had given her a bloody nose, Vi quickly ended the fight. Isha shook off the blow and did not show anger towards Vi after the fact, and in turn Vi became less hostile to both of them, as she saw Jinx's softer, more protective side. After recovering Vander's memories within Warwick, Isha joined Vi and Jinx in their family hug, happy to see their bond had started to heal.

Despite starting off as enemies, Vi and Isha grew protective of one another over time, with Vi defending her from Warwick's rampage in the mines. During Warwick's rampage in the commune, Isha saw that Vi had been injured by Noxian blade and went to save her and Jinx in a selfless act of sacrifice. As Vi saw what Isha was doing, she stopped Jinx from running towards her, realizing her sister's impulse was futile and would have only gotten herself killed in the blast as well. Upon returning to Piltover, Vi was haunted by dreams of what had happened, with a vivid recollection of Isha's death flashing over Jinx's screams being burned into her memory.[[8]](#cite_note-208killing-8)

Isha first met Warwick in Stillwater when he began his rampage throughout the prison in pursuit of  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed"). Isha originally saw Warwick as a monstrous threat and was visibly distraught when  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") went to fight him on her own. After Jinx survived the encounter, Isha would eventually learn that the beast was none other than Jinx's adoptive father,  [Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), and she later accompanied Jinx and  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") into the mines to help them find their father. Here, Warwick attacked them once again, driven mad by the scent of Isha's blood. This time, however, both of Vander's daughters were present, which allowed his mind to reemerge from the bowels of the beast. With Warwick now docile, Isha witnessed their reunion and hugged all three of them, being welcomed as a part of their unconventional family.

Isha harbored no resentment towards Warwick for all the times he attacked her in his savage state. Instead, she saw the humanity buried within him and believed he was worthy of compassion. By the time they reached  [Viktor's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") commune, Isha had formed a quiet, friendly bond with Warwick, caring for him and showing concern for his well-being, even filling her helmet with water and food for him in the several days they spent at the commune. Ultimately, however, their efforts to restore Vander's consciousness ended in failure, and in a heroic act, Isha sacrificed herself to rescue Jinx and Vi from Warwick's rampage.

structure.background:
### Early life

The wraith Thresh was born in the  [Blessed Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Blessed_Isles "Universe:Blessed Isles") as Erlok Grael, a monk of [Helia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Helia "Helia"). He served in the order for many years, expecting to be recognized among Helia's masters, but due to his humble background he was delegated to work as a warden to safeguard Helia's magical artifacts which he took as an insult. Grael felt bitter towards his new position as he believed himself more gifted than his noble-born peers who got more prestigious roles, and that his lowly position would stop him from being recognized.[[1]](#cite_note-1) After years of working in the vault, Grael grew bitter and cruel. Growing frustrated over his fellow wardens getting killed by the artifacts, he took interest in a nameless tome claimed to whisper one's darkest thoughts. Grael kept the tome in his possession, but his superior, Head Warden Rastofir, stopped him and threatened to demote him. Angered, he believed that Rastofir was trying to steal his research for his own benefit, so he arranged Rastofir to be killed by a miscategorized artifact so he could manipulate the order into a pragmatic direction.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

### The Ruination

One day, a fleet of ships from  [Camavor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Camavor "Universe:Camavor") invaded the Blessed Isles, led by their king  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") whom wanted to use the Waters of Life to resurrect his wife  [Isolde](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isolde "Universe:Isolde"). When the monks refused,  [Hecarim](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hecarim "Universe:Hecarim") and his knights took the opportunity to slaughter the monks and all of the natives. Grael delighted in the carnage and suffering that ensued, and took it upon himself to lead Viego to the Waters of Life. Isolde's resurrection failed and caused a blast of magic that corrupted the Blessed Isles' protective mist into the Black Mist, turning all of the inhabitants into [wraiths](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wraith "Wraith"). Grael embraced his transformation and took on the moniker Thresh, eager to act out his desires for cruelty without punishment or the limits of mortality. As decades passed, Thresh's spectral form morphed into a reflection of his darkest traits. He roamed the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles") killing people and imprisoning their souls within his lantern, becoming known in the folklore of  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") as a bogeyman figure.

### Capture of Senna

Many years later, Thresh encountered  [Lucian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lucian "Universe:Lucian") and  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna"), a married couple of  [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sentinels_of_Light "Universe:Sentinels of Light"), in a forbidden Helian vault in search of a cure for the latter's curse. Overzealous in his goal to save Senna, Lucian refused to turn back, but his decision cost him Senna's life as she sacrificed herself to save him from an oncoming attack from Thresh. The wraith trapped her soul in his lantern, with Lucian spending years battling his arch-enemy, all while Thresh taunted him by holding Senna's soul ransom.

Eventually, Lucian was able to set Senna's soul free by blasting Thresh's lantern open. While he expected the souls to pass on, Senna re-emerged with her newfound ability to control the Black Mist. Though Thresh was defeated, he decided to let them have their victory as he would toy with them in the future.

### The Ruined King

:   *Main article: [The Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Ruined_King "The Ruined King")*

*(TBA)*

### Unbound

:   *Main article: [A Night at the Inn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/A_Night_at_the_Inn "A Night at the Inn")*

Adopting new human form, Thresh travelled to  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") where he met Bort, a luckless waiter in a Noxian inn who had been cursed with a crustacean arm after trying to steal from a mage and consequently was abused and ridiculed by fellow staff and customers alike for his clumsiness and unfortunate condition. Sensing potential in Bort, Thresh murdered all those who had previously mocked him and offered to free Bort from his deformity. Gladly accepting the offer, Bort became Thresh's phantom carriage driver. Now in command of those who had tormented him, Bort whips and taunts the trapped souls who pull Thresh's carriage as Thresh himself travels deeper into Noxus.
structure.appearance:
As a human, Thresh was a fair-skinned man with a long, bony face and dark brown hair and eyes. After being unbound, he can still assume a human disguise, but with green eyes.

As a wraith, Thresh's head became a twisted approximation of a human skull, floating, fanged, wrapped in green flame, and with three skeletal appendages attached like hair. His clothes were dark blue, extremely tattered, and lined with bones. Most notably, he wore a large overcoat with a flared, oversized collar. He wore black armor on his feet and hands, but his clawed gauntlets glowed a spectral green. He carried a short-handled scythe in his right hand and was known to levitate his lantern with the left hand. The lantern, also seeming to be constructed from bones, glowed and swirled from the souls within. Both implements were attached to chains fashioned from bones. A pair of keys dangled from the front of his belt.

After becoming unbound, his appearance changed once again. He now appears as a pale human with glowing green eyes. Dark symbols appear tattooed onto his forehead and cheeks. His hair features three long pony tails in the same fashion as the once-present skeletal appendages on his head. His clothes are an elegant, black and gold regalia. The chains he carries are golden metal rather than skeletal. His lantern appears to be a large, teal crystal encased in a golden frame. Still, he glows with an ominous green light.
structure.personality:
As a human, Grael dedicated his work to becoming recognized throughout Helia, but was narcissistic and spiteful, seeing himself as being worthy of recognition. He believed himself to be perfect and felt bitter towards anyone who stopped his goals, to the point where he had no problem in causing the deaths of his fellow monks to develop his own progress. Observers described Grael as being unsettling and having darkness within his mind.

After becoming Thresh, he embraced his true cruelty and hatred without anyone to stop him. He is a psychopathic sadist who delights in making others suffer even after death, by tearing out his victims' souls and leaving them to suffer within his lantern, even mocking his victims' loved ones. He enjoys antagonizing  [Lucian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lucian "Universe:Lucian") the most, after imprisoning the soul of his wife  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna") and taunting Lucian with Senna's soul on ransom. When Senna escaped, Thresh decided to let them win so he could torment them in the future. Thresh is also known for manipulating others for his own gain, such as influencing Viego after reviving him so the deaths he caused would empower Thresh to become unbound, freeing him from his perpetual imprisonment in the Shadow Isles and granting him the power to move around Runeterra.
structure.abilities:
- **Wraith:** Thresh is one of the Shadow Isles's wraiths, created when the Ruination came to be.The Black Mist consumes ones original personality, leaving only a specter consumed by negative emotions and obsessions. In Thresh's, interestingly enough, he seems to have changed very little.
  - **Amortality:** Being already dead, Thresh can't die again. He can only be banished and lose his material form for a while.
  - **Spiritual Constructs:** Wraiths can create solid constructs from spectral energy, such as bodies and physical objects. These constructs mainly base themselves around how they looked in life.
  - **Transitory State:** Being ethereal beings, Wraiths can shift from the physical world and spiritual one at will. This means they can become intangible and invisible, and dissapear from one place to another.
- **Soul Snatching:** Thresh' most terrible power, and what makes him so dangerous, is his ability to entrap the souls of others by hooking them with his scythe, and then trapping their souls inside his lantern, where they suffer untold horrors until they become his enslaved thralls.

relations.relationship_description:
Thresh was a member of the Brotherhood of Dusk located in the heart of the Blessed Isles, turned undead when the [Ruination of Helia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruination_of_Helia "Ruination of Helia") struck. Thresh was directly responsible for the Ruination of the Blessed Isles, as he was the one who led  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") to the Waters of Life.

Between conspiring against him with Gangplank and letting  [Senna's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna") soul escape his lantern, Thresh fell out of favor with Viego. In turn, Thresh plotted against Viego and siphoned the excess Black Mist he was producing, in order to become  [unbound](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Thresh/Cosmetics "Thresh/Cosmetics") from the Shadow Isles.

Thresh tricked  [Lucian's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lucian "Lucian") wife  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna"), claiming her soul and storing it in his  [lantern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Thresh#Dark_Passage "Thresh"). Lucian [traveled](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shadow_and_Fortune "Shadow and Fortune") to Bilgewater in pursuit of the [Harrowing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Harrowing "Harrowing") to locate Thresh. It was then he found out Senna's soul is trapped inside the Chain Warden's  [lantern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Thresh#Dark_Passage "Thresh"). Lucian continued to pursue the Mist to free her and finally [succeeded](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shadow%27s_Embrace "Shadow's Embrace").

Thresh made a deal with  [Lucian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lucian "Universe:Lucian") for the vital information that may help him save  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna"). After becoming unbound from the mist with Viego being defeated, Thresh came to the  [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sentinels_of_Light "Universe:Sentinels of Light") for the soul promised by the deal, but they managed to escape. Thresh now plots to capture the escaping Sentinels.

[Lucian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lucian "Universe:Lucian") and  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna") are now dedicated to hunting Thresh.

Thresh clashed with  [Ahri](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ahri "Universe:Ahri"),  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"),  [Illaoi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illaoi "Universe:Illaoi"),  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune"),  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pyke "Universe:Pyke"), and  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo") in [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruined_King "Ruined King"), when they sailed to the Shadow Isles to try and stop him and Gangplank from unleashing Viego.
Thresh and  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") woke Viego up from his slumber, in order to use his power to conquer Bilgewater.

Thresh tried to persuade  [Ledros](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ledros "Universe:Ledros") to give up trying to free  [Kalista](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalista "Universe:Kalista") and has succeeded at obtaining his silver pendant which Ledros may use to remind Kalista of her humanity.

structure.trivia:
- Thresh is between 1050 – 1100 years old, born at some point before the Ruination of the  [Blessed Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Blessed_Isles "Universe:Blessed Isles").
- After the events of [Rise of the Sentinels](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rise_of_the_Sentinels "Rise of the Sentinels"), Thresh is now  [Unbound](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Thresh/Cosmetics "Thresh/Cosmetics") from the Shadow Isles and is able to steal souls across Runeterra.

structure.name: Sett
structure.quote: *"Bein' the boss... is a lot better than not bein' the boss."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Settrigh, or Sett as he would be known, was born in [Navori](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Navori "Navori"),  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") to a vastayan mother and human father out of wedlock, being a crossbreed of the two races. Due to his hybrid blood and being a bastard child, Sett was an outcast among his peers and his parents were ostracized by their respective races. Those who bullied Sett were intimidated by his father's reputation as a pit fighter in  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), but when his father went missing, the bullies spared Sett no mercy. He was constantly beaten up and insulted, being called the "Beast-Boy Bastard". Eventually, Sett had enough of the bullying and began to fight back by punching them into submission. His fights became so notorious that the news reached his mother, who warned him not to go to the pits where his father had fought.

One night, Sett snuck to a local pit while his mother was asleep, and witnessed the battles conducted between numerous fighters as Noxian soldiers in the audience cheered with bloodlust. At the end of the event, Sett asked the staff if they knew his father, and they told him that he had left to fight in pits across other parts of Runeterra to seek greater fortune.

### Recent events

*(TBA)*
structure.appearance: Sett is a tall and muscular man with light tan skin. he has chin-length maroon hair with bangs that swoop to the right, two animal ears on the top of his head of the same color with darker purple fur on the insides, a trait he inherited from his mother, and a long diagonal scar across his nose.
structure.personality: Sett is brash and self-assured, knowing exactly what a formidable fighter he is and openly embracing his title, "The Boss." He prefers raw strength and power over technique and strategy. Outwardly, he seems callous, valuing nothing but violence and money, but he does have a soft spot for his mother, whom he cherishes above all.
structure.abilities:
- **Vastayan Physiology:** Sett is a the son of a vastayan woman and a human man, granting him a unique nature. It's unknown how much of his vastayan heritage he carries within him.
  - **Kinetic Absorption:** Sett can absorb the energy created by attacks thrown at him to strengthen himself, storing that energy to enhance his physical skills to better defeat his foes. Once he absorbs the energy, he can them release it in his attacks, creating destructive waves of energy through his punches easily devastating all his foes nearby.
  - **Magical Pulling:** Sett can "pull" others towards him, immobilizing and rendering them defenseless.

relations.relationship_description: Sett loves his mother more than anything and dedicates all of his goals to supporting her and making her proud of him, to repay her for raising him in the past. He gives her gifts and money that he earned from his illegal activities while lying to keep them secret from her, though he feels guilty for doing so. Even while away from her, Sett tends to display affection towards his mother in private, and gets angered when someone makes fun of her.

Sett barely knew his father due to him leaving the family when he was still a child, so he was curious to meet him. When he found out that his father had abandoned his family to seek fortune in other parts of the world, he grew to hate his father and aspired to fight against him one day.

Though not confirmed, 8 [The Old Timer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Old_Timer "LoR:The Old Timer") is implied to be Sett's father, due to having a personal rivalry towards Sett and knowing many details about his past.

structure.trivia:
- His real name is Settrigh.
- Sett is in his mid to late 20s[[2]](#cite_note-2)
  - Unlike the other [Vastayan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") champions we know of, all of whom are at least 180 years old (including  [Neeko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Neeko "Universe:Neeko")),[[3]](#cite_note-3)  **Sett** is under 30 years old.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
  - Alternatively, Sett has also been stated to be in his early thirties instead.[[5]](#cite_note-5)
- Sett mostly relies on  [brute force](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sett#Knuckle_Down "Sett") with  [kinetic energy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sett#Facebreaker "Sett") and  [a small amount of Vastayan magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sett#Haymaker "Sett") in combat.[[6]](#cite_note-6)[[7]](#cite_note-7)
- Sett's parents fell in love before the Noxian occupation of Ionia.[[8]](#cite_note-8)
- Sett and his mother's tribe are Vastayan [wolverines](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/wolverine).[[9]](#cite_note-9)
  - His furry ears are similar to another [Vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya"),  [Ahri](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ahri "Universe:Ahri"); however, real-life wolverines' ears have more rounded tips than foxes'.

structure.name: Lulu
structure.quote: *"The best path between two points is upside-down, between, then inside-out and round again."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

#### Stumbling into [The Glade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Glade "The Glade")

Lulu, always a deeply empathetic and caring Yordle, once came across an injured bird and instinctively rushed to help. But as she reached for it, the bird transformed into a mischievous [faerie](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Faerie "Universe:Faerie"). Laughing, it flew away, taking Lulu's staff with it, and she eagerly gave chase. As she pursued the faerie, the world around her began to shift and warp. Unbeknownst to Lulu, she had crossed into the spirit realm.

The faerie, who introduced himself as  [Pix](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pix "Universe:Pix"), eventually stopped and, with a flick of his fingers, transformed Lulu’s simple walking stick into a magical staff. He led her to a place of ancient, pure primordial magic, where Lulu’s own powers amplified. He led her to [the Glade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Glade "Universe:The Glade").

[Bandle City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bandle_City "Universe:Bandle City"), Lulu's home, was a strange and magical place that defied logic, where time was unstable, and the natural laws of the material world did not fully apply. Yet the Glade was an even stranger place - it had existed long before the Yordles came into the world, and perhaps it was from the Glade that Bandle City itself arose.

Here, her imagination could manifest into reality, and she reveled in the freedom of creation. Lulu did not know whether Pix had brought her here because of a similarity of souls, or whether the Glade itself had called her, but she fell in love with this place instantly. She was so lost in the magic and wonder that she eventually forgot about existence of everything else. And time lost its meaning in The Glade - what seemed like mere days to Lulu could have been centuries or even millennia.

#### Playing pranks on [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra")

Yet one day, as if awakening from a long sleep, Lulu found herself back in the material realm, unsure of how long she had been gone. To her surprise and delight, she found that some of her newfound power had come with her, allowing her to make small things large, change colours to those more pleasing her, and make creatures spontaneously fall asleep. To Pix's infinite amusement, she turned the most powerful beasts into tiny, confused frogs or squirrels with a single swing of her staff.

While she missed The Glade, Lulu set off on a journey across  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra"), always searching for the elusive way back. Pix, however, claimed to have forgotten the way, but perhaps he did not wish to return yet. Together, they traveled from place to place, pulling playful pranks wherever they went. In lands of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), known for their resistance to magic, she led a group of children away from their dull history lessons and transformed them into toadstools, to the horror of their parents and the local militia. The children eventually returned unharmed, but their wild stories were dismissed as fantasies.

In cold territories of  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord"), she found herself in the middle of a battle between rival tribes and decided to turn their weapons into flowers for her own amusement, creating chaos and confusion. More recently, Lulu has been seen wandering Ionia, playing among the glowing everblooms of [Qaelin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Qaelin "Universe:Qaelin"), and pranking the overly serious acolytes of the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"), who she thinks need to lighten up.

Though Lulu longs to return to the Glade and often misses it, she finds joy in the present, where each day offers new adventures and excitement. Besides, she has come to understand that the Glade is always with her, carried in her heart wherever she goes.

### Modern History

#### [Meeting Tristana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Whispering_Doodad "The Whispering Doodad")

During one of her adventures, Lulu traveled with  [Tristana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tristana "Universe:Tristana") after visiting [Poppy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Poppy "Universe:Poppy"). As they stepped through a Yordle gateway, Lulu misplaced her Whispering Key, an ancient and powerful artifact she affectionately referred to as her "Doodad." Ignoring Tristana’s growing concern about a nearby  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") camp, Lulu eagerly used her magic to track it down. Much to Tristana's dismay, the playful artifact began to elude them, shifting into various forms whenever Lulu tried to catch a glimpse of it.

Before long,  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven") and  [Tamara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tamara "Universe:Tamara") led a band of Noxian forces in a sudden attack on the two Yordles. However, the land itself rose to aid them, as nature spirits joined the battle. While Tristana bravely held off the Noxians, Lulu remained preoccupied with chasing her ever-elusive Doodad, laughing as it transformed into anything but its true form.

Finally, with the help of the spirits, the Yordles emerged victorious as Draven and the remaining Noxians were chased off by a massive enchanted rabbit. Tristana gave a nod of thanks to the creature, while Lulu expressed her gratitude to the spirits and the land itself. With the battle behind them, the two friends continued on their way, ready for whatever the next adventure would bring.

#### [Don't Mess With Yordles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Don%27t_Mess_With_Yordles "Don't Mess With Yordles")

One day, when  [Teemo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Teemo "Universe:Teemo") was captured in  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater") by  [Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Graves "Universe:Graves"), his yordle friends in Bandle City decided to rescue him. Tristana, Teemo's closest friend, insisted on going alone, but Lulu and  [Corki](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Corki "Universe:Corki") wanted to help too. Tristana convinced them to go on diversionary missions: she sent Corki after a made-up threat in  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and told Lulu to keep an eye on a rock by the entrance to Bandle City.

After the others left, Lulu became impatient and pouted, accidentally enlarging Pix's head. Meanwhile, Corki realized he had been tricked and returned to Bandle City, where he invited Lulu to cause some ruckus. By the time they regrouped, Tristana had also been captured. Corki attempted to fly his plane to rescue them, but crashed, landing in a cage.

Lulu, now  [larger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lulu#Wild_Growth "Lulu") than usual and still guarding the rock, approached them, complaining to Tristana that the rock was doing nothing. But when she touched the runic iron cage, she shrank back to her normal size, dropping the rock on Graves' foot and causing him to shoot a rope and accidentally free the other yordles.

In a last-ditch attempt to stop them, Graves grabbed Corki and threatened Tristana, but Lulu playfully and quickly  [turned](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lulu#Whimsy "Lulu") Graves into a small [gromp](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gromp "Gromp"). forcing  [Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Fate "Universe:Twisted Fate"), who knew how this would end, to take his enchanted friend with him. With the danger over, Tristana thanked her friends for their support, and the yordles returned to Bandle City as Teemo showed everyone his new pet: a soul-devouring sea worm named Fluffy.
structure.appearance:
Lulu is a Yordle with lilac-colored skin, and olive-green eyes that have brighter tones closer to the iris. She has straight, long dark purple hair with some lash-grazing pieces in the front.

She wears a vermillion-colored pointy hat and robes with accents of gold. Her shoes are brown with an elf-styled toe tip.
structure.personality:
Lulu had always been a caring and deeply empathetic Yordle, living in her whimsical dreams as if they were as real as the world around her. Her visit to the Glade, a realm of boundless primordial magic, only amplified these traits, transforming her perception of reality forever.

Nowadays, Lulu is an imaginative and carefree Yordle who lives in a constant state of wonder and playfulness, often blurring the lines between reality and fantasy. Her deep connection to the fae spirit Pix and her time spent in the Glade have made her both powerful and unpredictable. Lulu’s whimsical nature means she often acts without thinking of the consequences. Whether she’s turning enemies into harmless creatures or meddling in conflicts for her own amusement, Lulu sees it all as a fun game.

Despite the chaos she causes, Lulu is kind-hearted and means no harm. Still, Lulu’s complete disregard for logic or caution means that her spells can create as much confusion as wonder, tipping the balance between delight and disaster for those around her.

Lulu is fiercely loyal to her friends, even if her antics often leave them bewildered. Beneath her playful exterior, however, lies a hidden vulnerability—despite her cheerful demeanor, Lulu fears deep down that other Yordles don’t truly understand or accept her, and that they may even despise her. It's possible, that this underlying fear of rejection, along with a profound loneliness, lingers beneath her whimsical surface, driving her to seek companionship through her playful escapades.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
structure.abilities:
- **Yordle Physiology:** Lulu is a Yordle, a being coming from the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm") and possesses several abilities natural of her species.
  - **Immortality:** Being spiritual beings, Yordles don't age the same way as normal humans, and they can't normally die.
  - **Yordle Magic:** Just like any [Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), Lulu is capable of performing yordle magic, which she utilizes in tandem with her transmogrification skills.
- **Fae Magic:** Lulu was taken to the Glade, a magical location beyond the Bandlewood, there her magic powers were expanded to an even greater level than that of a average Yordle.
  - **Transmogrification:** Lulu can transform others and herself in many ways, she can increase or decrease ones physical attributes, or change their shape into an animal, or augment their size.

relations.relationship_description: Lulu met  [Pix](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pix "Universe:Pix") in the material realm, where he was disguised as a bird with a broken wing. This turned out to be a prank, and Pix revealed his true form as a [faerie](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Faerie "Faerie") before stealing Lulu's walking stick before leading her to the [the Glade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Glade "The Glade") and transforming her stick into a magic staff. The two became friends shortly after due to their shared love of mischief and fun, with Pix now accompanying Lulu wherever she goes.

Lulu is good friends with  [Tristana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tristana "Universe:Tristana") and is frequently eager to join her on missions. Tristana tolerates Lulu and often tries to distract her with menial tasks, but is simply worried for her safety and ultimately expresses appreciation for her help.

Lulu is friends with  [Corki](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Corki "Universe:Corki") and  [Teemo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Teemo "Universe:Teemo"). She accepts Corki's offer to cause a "ruckus" and is enamored by Teemo's pet soul-devouring sea worm, Fluffy.
Lulu likes  [Poppy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Poppy "Universe:Poppy"), but she sometime finds her too serious for her liking. She and Tristana sometimes go to visit her.

[Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven") and  [Tamara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tamara "Universe:Tamara") have [encountered](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Whispering_Doodad "The Whispering Doodad") both Lulu and  [Tristana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tristana "Universe:Tristana"), fought and fled from them during his return trip from [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blood_of_Noxus "Blood of Noxus") to Noxus Prime.

Lulu,  [Corki](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Corki "Universe:Corki"), and  [Tristana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tristana "Universe:Tristana") fought  [Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Graves "Universe:Graves") when trying to save  [Teemo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Teemo "Universe:Teemo") from his clutches, which ended with Graves being  [turned](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lulu#Whimsy "Lulu") into a frog and the [yordles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle") escaping. While hostile to Graves, they appear to be on friendly terms with  [Twisted Fate](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Fate "Universe:Twisted Fate"), who discouraged Graves' behavior since "messing with Yordles brings a whole heap of trouble."

In the old lore, Lulu was friends with  [Veigar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Veigar "Universe:Veigar"). While this is ambiguous in the current canon, they are still generally portrayed as friends, with Lulu enjoying Veigar's company despite his failed attempts to be evil.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

structure.trivia:
- Lulu may have had a quirky encounter with  [Shaco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shaco "Universe:Shaco") at some point
- After Lulu was released in League of Legends, the community immediately began creating a lot of content featuring her and  [Veigar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Veigar "Universe:Veigar"), which led to Riot Games officially making them friends in the game's old lore.
- As seen in many stories, Lulu appears in company of Tristana more than any other yordle.
  - Despite their teamwork being quite good, Tristana has to be the most careful of them whenever they're on a mission due to Lulu being a bit of an unpredictable tornado of emotions.
- Even when Lulu can't seem to focus right on what she's doing, she's been able to save her friends multiple times.
- Out of all yordles from Bandle City, Lulu seems to be the smallest in natural size (not taking into account hats, helmets, mechs, etc).
  - She could be tied in height with Veigar, but due to the size of his hat, it is difficult to assess his height.
- Up to this day, it is still a mystery what Lulu thinks  tasted purple.

structure.name: Ornn
structure.quote: *"I have said enough."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Not much is known about Ornn's early life, only tales and stories told around campfires persist, and even then the validity of these stories is not known.

One such story tells of when Ornn was young. Looking for a fight with a worthy opponent, Ornn challenged the land around him to a battle. Ornn fought the land, reshaping it with each blow. He headbutted mountains, beat valleys into shape, and shaped the earth into the landscape of what would become known as the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") today. When he was tired, Ornn thanked the land for the glorious match, and in return, the land opened itself to him, showing him its core. This gave Ornn the power of the primordial flame, and Ornn then dedicated himself to forging tools and weapons.

Another story tells of how after his first home burned down, Ornn made a mountain out of ore, and inside was a forge that channeled the primordial flame from deep within the earth. However, the mountain was too hot even for Ornn, who slept through his first home burning down around him, and so he channeled a sea of cold water into the mountain. It took three days for the home to finally cool, and the ocean had dipped a few inches because of how much water was used. So much steam had risen from the cooling that the sky soon filled with dark clouds and burst with snow. It snowed for a hundred years, and that event is what causes the Freljord to have so much snow even today.

### Notable Creations

It is said that one day, Three Sisters came to Ornn for help. They asked him to dig a hole deep and wide enough to lure their enemies into. Ornn said yes, as he was already planning on digging a hole, and the proposed site was a fine spot. After he was done digging the hole, Ornn returned to his work. Several years later, the Sisters, having endured years of war, came to Ornn again. They asked him to forge a bridge over the abyss, made out of a metal that fell from the sky. This metal was so durable and unyielding that only he could forge it. Ornn agreed, accepting the metal itself as payment. He built [the bridge](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Howling_Abyss "Howling Abyss"), and so durable was it that it would have stood until the end of time had  [one sister](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra") not ruined Ornn's work by casting spells onto it.

In the making of this bridge, Ornn had made a tool from the star metal that he called 'hammer', as he had used it to hammer. Ornn grew so attached to this hammer that even when he had thrown away his favorite spade and eating fork, he could not bring himself to throw away the hammer. He still uses the hammer to forge his creations to this day.

One of Ornn's last known creations was made when a troll, Grubgrack the Hideous, challenged him to a drinking contest. Ornn accepted and promised that if Grubgrack won, he would build him a door to protect Grubgrack's riches. When the time came, Ornn lost due to Grubgrack putting a shard of True Ice in his drink, causing it to infinitely melt and put endless amounts of drink in Ornn's cup. Ornn was angry at Grubgrack for cheating, but stuck to his word and built the door. However, once Grubgrack closed the door, he could not get it open, no matter how hard he tried. The door was indestructible, so much so that many years after its creation, [a heroic man](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum") elected to go through the mountain around the door in order to reach a child stuck behind it.

Grubrack could not get it open no matter how hard he tried. Ornn did not care, and considered it justice for Grubrack cheating. To this day, some say that just before an avalanche, you can still hear Grubrack's wails, lamenting on his lost riches.

### The Hearthblood

In time, like many other demigods, Ornn amassed a group of followers. They were legion of some of the best forgers in  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") who came from far and wide to hone their skills under Ornn's guidance. They called themselves the [Hearthblood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hearthblood "Hearthblood"), for they never felt the bitter cold of the Freljord and could bare the intense heat of lava and fire just beneath them, heating up the ground. They presented their work to Ornn, and every so often he would appraise their work, calling the best creations "passable." This was a big compliment from Ornn, as he rarely ever appraised anything, instead electing to let good work speak for itself. He never admitted it, but Ornn secretly cared for the Hearthblood. He admired them for being dedicated to nothing but honing their skills, and not giving him sacrifices or preaching the misconstrued words of their god to people who did not want to hear. They made him smile, though no one could tell because his mouth was hidden behind his beard.

One day, Ornn's closest sibling  [Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear") and his followers came to visit him. Volibear had grown jealous of the love that Ornn's followers freely gave him, and was itching for a fight with Ornn. Volibear came and asked for swords and axes for him and his army of followers, but Ornn refused, not wanting to have anything to do with his brother's warmongering. Volibear threatened to take what his brother wouldn't give, and in return Ornn charged onto Volibear and hit him with his horns so hard that the base of Ornn's mountain shook. They fought for eight days, causing lightning to strike the mountain and molten lava to explode out of the ground. When it ended, the Hearthblood were killed and their home was destroyed. Volibear and Ornn still lived, returning to their individual pursuits. Volibear swore off his brother and shed his rune-inscribed armor, electing to instead fight with tooth, claw, might, and thunder. Ornn returned to his solitary work, continuing to make weapons and armor for years to come.

### Recent events

Ornn continues his work in solitude, not interacting with anybody. His name is still spoken, but not by many. Every now and then, smoke rises from Ornn's mountain. Some say that he is lighting his furnace to stop the fire underneath the world from going out. Others say that he is building a great weapon. And there are some who claim that he is dead, as he has not been seen in the Freljord since his fateful battle.
structure.appearance: Ornn has a large humanoid-like figure with a square shaped torso and muscular arms, chiseled by his endless work of forging and crafting weapons. He has the head of a ram with large horns and a large red beard that covers up most of his face. Ornn's eyes, left arm, and the tips of his horns glow orange with the heat and power of primordial fire, and he wears nothing but a large metal apron around his torso.
structure.personality: Ornn is a quiet and stoic individual, not bothering or interacting with anybody unless they come to him. Ornn often will not do things unless he deems it necessary, even using the shortest sentences he can to get his point accross. Ornn is dedicated to his craft and works day and night, and while he takes satisfaction in his work, he does not appraise it, instead electing to let good work speak for itself. He is apathetic to many things, including the people around him. The only people Ornn has ever truly admired or respected were the Hearthblood, and the destruction of their people hurt his soul more than anything else in this world. He has not cared about anyone or anything else since.
structure.abilities:
- **[Spirit God Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_God "Spirit God"):** Ornn is an ancient divine being embodying a particular aspect of the world, in this case, fire, volcanoes, forging and craftsmanship. Ornn nurtures himself from both his role as a fire and forging god and the belief and memory of worshipers.
  - **Immortality:** As a demigod and the god of fire and forging, so long as those two elements exist in Runeterra and people still believe and remember him, Ornn will continue existing.
  - **Primordial Flame:** Ornn wields the power of the Primordial Flame, magical fire capable of many feats of strength and magic. Ornn is the only known being that can melt True Ice.
  - **Earth Magic:** Ornn has some minor control over the earth, mainly as a god of volcanoes. He can mold the shape of the earth, and create magma in seconds.
  - **Immense Strength:** Ornn posses immense, godlike strength. It is said that he is so strong that he challenged the land to a battle, and in doing so crafted the landscape of the Freljord that exists to this day.
  - **Divine Craftsmanship:** As a god of the Forge, Ornn is divinely gifted in the arts of forging. Many of his creations crafted millenia ago still exist to this day.

relations.relationship_description: Many in the Freljord know of Ornn, yet few worship him or are considered his 'followers'. Once, an entire village of people known as the Hearthblood worshiped him and followed in his ways of forging and crafting weapons. However, the Hearthblood were all killed and their home destroyed during a battle between Ornn and  [Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear").

Ornn has numerous [demigod siblings](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_God#Spirit_Gods_of_the_Freljord "Spirit God"), including  [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia"),  [Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear"), and many others such as  [Ildhaurg](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ildhaurg "Universe:Ildhaurg") and the  [Seal Sister](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Seal_Sister "Universe:Seal Sister"). They were once all close, but soon grew apart due to their own ventures.

#### [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia")

In myths, it is said that Anivia once accidentally burned down Ornn's Horn Hall after trying to get back at him for felling her favorite perching trees in order to make it. Ornn did not know that it was her that did it and believed that it was his own arrogance that caused his home to burn down. He vowed to never again compliment his own work, which contributed to his stoic and quiet personality.

#### [Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear")

Volibear and Ornn were once close, fighting in many battles together. However, as they drifted apart, Volibear grew jealous of the love that the Hearthblood freely gave to Ornn. Volibear and his followers went to Ornn seeking weapons and armor for battle. When Ornn refused, Volibear said that he would take what Ornn would not give, which caused Ornn to attack Volibear. Their fight lasted for eight days and neither of them perished. However, this fight killed the Hearthblood and Ornn has not been seen since.

Legends say that Ornn dug out the [Howling Abyss](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Howling_Abyss "Howling Abyss") and built a bridge over it at the request of Lissandra and her two sisters, Serylda ( [Sejuani's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sejuani "Sejuani") supposed ancestor) and Avarosa ( [Ashe's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ashe "Ashe") supposed ancestor). How truthful the myths are is unknown.

Lissandra and her  [Frostguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Frostguard "Universe:Frostguard") have been trying to sabotage the worship of the old demi-gods, including Ornn, in order to deny them power and influence.

Aurora is a friend of Ornn. They first met when Aurora entered Ornn's home in search of help for the spirit Haestryr, and although Ornn at first saw her as a nuisance, he grew fond of her over time. As a sign of their friendship, Ornn forged a  [magic wand](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aurora#Across_the_Veil "Aurora") for Aurora.

Braum's original tribe has a strong connection to Ornn and hence his magic takes the shape of the ram. Ornn is responsible for making the unbreakable door that is used as a shield by Braum, though he's more annoyed and surprised that Braum managed to take it off the hinges and won't give it back.
As a shaman, Udyr is able to harness the power of Ornn and his siblings. Ornn's power manifests as two lava orange horns on Udyr's shoulders.

structure.trivia:
General

- **Ornn** crafted many things:
  - The [Howling Abyss](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Howling_Abyss "Howling Abyss") and the bridge that was constructed above it. The bridge would have been unbreakable if the Third Sister, Lissandra, had not cast spells upon it.
  - [Enchanted Ram Door](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Braum#Unbreakable "Braum") that later came to be wielded by  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum").[[1]](#cite_note-1)
  - A fork that later came to be wielded as a trident by a mer-king, likely the king of the [Marai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Marai "Marai").
  - The first hammer on  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra").[[2]](#cite_note-2)
- **Ornn** is the physical form of the Great Spirit of the Ram, as such spirit walkers like  [Udyr](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Udyr "Universe:Udyr") can harness a bit of his primal spirit magic.
  - Ornn is one of the spirit gods. "Spirit gods" are more like manifestations of cultural ideas, given immense power by the belief of their followers and can wax and wane, depending - or disappear for a long, long time.[[3]](#cite_note-3)
- Most of Ornn's followers were killed long ago when he fought with his brother Volibear. Ornn's disappearance was partly due to him removing himself from the world's affairs, but also due to the work of his enemies (possibly Lissandra, who tried to erase all information about her near-destruction of the Freljord). This happens in our world, too. Entire mythologies from ancient times (Pre-Roman) are lost or exist in tantalizingly few places. Even books that were once in the Bible are gone and lost. Ornn has been forgotten, and he's honestly just fine with that.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
  - Ornn has been inactive for over 8000 years.[[5]](#cite_note-5)
