structure.name: Veigar
structure.quote: *"You deny the darkness in your soul..."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

#### Search for Knowledge

Veigar's early life in  [Bandle City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bandle_City "Universe:Bandle City"). remains a mystery, but it is known that he grew dissatisfied with traditional Yordle magic. Longing to expand his knowledge, he ventured into the human world, drawn by the ancient secrets of celestial magic. Under the guidance of mortal masters, Veigar quickly excelled in harnessing the power of the stars. However, his talent attracted the attention of the ruthless warlord  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser"), who was then conquering the lands of [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Valoran "Valoran"). Unskilled in the art of war, mages were easy prey for Mordekaiser's cruelty. Seeing potential in the Yordle’s arcane abilities, Mordekaiser captured Veigar and took him into his dark dominion.

#### Enslaved by Mordekaiser

Bound to the physical realm by Mordekaiser, Veigar found himself enslaved, cut off from Bandle City. Forced to twist his magic for the tyrant’s cruel purposes, Veigar was subjected to relentless torment and manipulation, until the once-curious Yordle’s spirit began to fracture. His captor used him as an instrument of terror, pushing Veigar to inflict suffering upon those who opposed Mordekaiser’s reign. Suffering from isolation, Veigar's memories faded, but he clung to them like the last rays of light before an eclipse. And accompanying his torment he saw how Mordekaiser's corrupted actions had led him to something close to immortality. Over time, after decades or centuries, these dark experiences transformed both Veigar’s personality and his appearance, leaving scars he could not erase.

Though Mordekaiser’s rule seemed absolute, it ultimately crumbled under rebellion, as his  [servants](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") and the Noxii tribes—led by their  [god](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vladimir "Universe:Vladimir")—overthrew the tyrant.

#### Breaking Free

With Mordekaiser’s downfall, Veigar finally escaped his enchanted cage. Although he had little interest in the ensuing power struggles, he found himself irrevocably altered, unable to shed the darkness that had consumed him, despite his deep desire for the safety, peace, and freedom that all living beings crave. Instead, he embraced his new identity as an ‘evil’ sorcerer, using his magic as a weapon, harnessing the wrath of the stars and trapping his enemies into the timeless infinity between moments to gain respect and independence.

Unlike his former captor, however, Veigar’s actions often took an ambiguous turn. Though he sometimes scorched farmlands and destroyed barons' estate he also drove out brigands, vanquished dark creatures, and defeated evil warlocks, seizing their powerful artifacts. To the people of Valoran, Veigar’s intentions were murky at best; his deeds seemed to straddle the line between malevolent and strangely beneficial.

### Modern History

#### Rise as a Dark Lord

Veigar eventually seized a fortress of his own, transforming it into a bastion of dark sorcery and gathering a legion of peculiar followers. His court was a theatrical assembly of devoted Yordles and minions, each serving a specialized role in his dark domain. Among them for example, the 2 [Twisted Catalyzer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Twisted_Catalyzer "LoR:Twisted Catalyzer") absorbed the darkness from tainted fairies, freeing them and returning them to their original form. The ancient scrolls and long-lost magics of Runeterra were revived under the care of the 3 [Wizened Wizard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Wizened_Wizard "LoR:Wizened Wizard"), while the 4 [Stilted Robemaker](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Stilted_Robemaker "LoR:Stilted Robemaker") worked tirelessly on the crucial task of outfitting Veigar’s court with sinister style—often boosting Veigar’s stature, if not his height.

Also in his retinue were the 4 [Tenor of Terror](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Tenor_of_Terror "LoR:Tenor of Terror") and his brother, the Bass of Burden, whose voices sang of Veigar’s looming reign. And a mysterious 8 [Mirror Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Mirror_Mage "LoR:Mirror Mage"), that may be intertwined with the past of Veigar himself.

Within his castle, Veigar’s forces grew stronger. Dangerous artifacts and forbidden knowledge accumulated, resulting in monstrous war machines like the Grand Overseer, a combat mecha equipped with the fearsome  **[Rabadon's Deathcap](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rabadon%27s_Deathcap "Rabadon's Deathcap")** and the sinister  **[Morellonomicon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Morellonomicon "Morellonomicon")**. This mechanical marvel embodied Veigar’s grim ingenuity and rising military power, a testament to his quest for unmatched might.

And he also wrote a book ''How to be a Supervillain''.
structure.appearance:
Veigar is a small, even for yordle standards, individual. His form is almost entirely concealed beneath a deep blue and purple cloak, adorned with rows of metallic spikes along the shoulders. Atop his head sits a massive, pointed hat, also studded with spikes. His right glove is unusually large and armored. Veigar wields in his left hand a heavy staff, designed like a wicked axe, topped with a glowing gem that channels his dark magic.

Beneath his cloak, Veigar has black fur and intense, stark yellow eyes that gleam with a sinister, cat-like intensity. [[1]](#cite_note-1)[[2]](#cite_note-2)
structure.personality:
When he first came to Runeterra, Veigar was an enthusiastic and curious Yordle that wished to learn more about magic. This curiosity led him to leave [Bandle City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Bandle_City "Bandle City"), and go to Runeterra in search for knowledge. There he was delighted with the knowledge that he acquired and put all his effort in becoming a powerful mage.

When the warlord Mordekaiser caught him, he was tortured for year under the warlord's brutal watch. This torture broke the Yordle's mind. With his personality broken, he re-imagined himself as a terrible tyrant with a thirst for power.

Under this new persona, Veigar is obsessed with the aesthetics of villainy. He's arrogant, melodramatic, and antagonistic, constantly causing chaos in the hopes of getting the attention from others. This often leads to frustration as most of his attempts of villainy either led to mild annoyances, or instead lead to great good. He is also territorial in his search for power, aggressively going after anyone that he considers a rival in his quest for power, which often times, accidentally leads to him coming in direct blows with (and defeating) other dark sorcerers and other evils, accidentally helping many on his path.

It's possible that Veigar's acts of good might not be as accidental as it might first appear, but instead his subconscious guiding his actions towards good while his conscious mind, too broken by Mordekaiser's cruelty, rationalizes it to fit in his persona of villain.
structure.abilities:
- **[Yordle Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yordle "Universe:Yordle"):** Veigar is a Yordle, a being coming from the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm") and possesses several abilities natural of his species.
  - **Immortality:** Being spiritual beings, Yordles don't age the same way as normal humans, and they can't normally die.
  - **Yordle Magic:** Just like any [Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), Veigar is capable of performing yordle magic, which he utilizes in tandem with other magics he has learned.
- **Master Sorcerer:** Veigar has studied and mastered many types of [magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Magic "Magic"). He learned long-forgotten spells that are many thousands of years old. His  [Will](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Veigar#Phenomenal_Evil_Power "Veigar") is strong enough to learn and grow stronger over the centuries.
  - **Spiritual Magic:** Like any Yordle Veigar has a deep connection with a [spirit world](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm"), but due to the fact that Mordekaiser bound Veigar to the physical plane and forced him to cast grimly enchantments, he learned to use dark spells. Now he controls the 3 [Darkness](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Darkness "LoR:Darkness") itself, so his native Yordle magic has taken a  [Darker Form](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Veigar#Baleful_Strike "Veigar").[[3]](#cite_note-3)
  - **Elemental Magic:** Little is known about what knowledge Veigar has achieved in elemental magic, but he is erudite enough to be aware about  [Dark Matter](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Veigar#Dark_Matter "Veigar") and is able to manipulate it.
  - **Celestial Magic:** Veigar has mastery over the power of the stars. By harnessing [celestial](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial "Celestial") magic, Veigar can create powerful blast of energy, summon meteors of  [Dark Matter](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Veigar#Dark_Matter "Veigar") from the skies - "he would call down the fury of the stars themselves upon his foes[...]"[[4]](#cite_note-4) - and create  [Gravitational Fields](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Veigar#Event_Horizon "Veigar") to "trap them in the timeless infinities between moments"[[5]](#cite_note-5) that paralyze his foes.
  - **Cosmic Magic:** Combining [celestial](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial_Realm "Celestial Realm"), [elemental](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Magic "Magic") and [primordial spiritual magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Glade "The Glade"), Veigar can simultaneously cast spells both of destruction and creation, such as  [Primordial Burst](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Veigar#Primordial_Burst "Veigar").
- **Leader:** Veigar has shown to be a competent leader, being able to lead his small group of Yordles towards his goals. Also, like a true dark lord, Veigar commands an army of [minions](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Minion_(Species) "Minion (Species)").
- **Artifacts:** Despite his magical power, Veigar continues to accumulate dark knowledge and collect magical artifacts. With them equipped, he becomes much more powerful.
  - **4[Grand Overseer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Grand_Overseer_Veigar "LoR:Grand Overseer Veigar"):** By the use of dark magics, Veigar is able to control the Grand Overseer mech, equipped with an enhanced staff, as well as the Morellonomicon and the Rabadon's Deathcap.
  - **[Rabadon's Deathcap](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rabadon%27s_Deathcap "Rabadon's Deathcap")** - depicted in 4[Grand Overseer's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Grand_Overseer_Veigar "LoR:Grand Overseer Veigar") Level 2 artwork
  - **[Morellonomicon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Morellonomicon "Morellonomicon")** - depicted in 4[Grand Overseer's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Grand_Overseer_Veigar "LoR:Grand Overseer Veigar") Level 2 artwork

relations.relationship_description: Mordekaiser tortured Veigar to gain knowledge about other realms. Eventually, Veigar's personality would shape to be more like his captors. However, due to his yordle nature, he could never perfect his masters cruelty, only a caricature of it.
Veigar knew LeBlanc, who was also forced to work for Mordekaiser.[[6]](#cite_note-6)

structure.trivia:
- Veigar is over 1,500 years old, as he was present during  [Mordekaiser's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser") second crusade.
  - He was possibly captured by the Iron Revenant around 400 BN, or 1400 years ago.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
- He was possibly affected by [Stockholm syndrome](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stockholm_syndrome) after being held captive for years by  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser").
- The canonical pronunciation of his name is *"VAY-gar"* (similar to *"Gray Jar"*), as stated in his [short story](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_True_and_Ghastly_Tale_of_the_Beast_of_Boleham_Tower "Universe:The True and Ghastly Tale of the Beast of Boleham Tower") and in  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser") and  [LeBlanc's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") interactions with him.
- It is unknown where Veigar currently resides. In his [short story](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_True_and_Ghastly_Tale_of_the_Beast_of_Boleham_Tower "Universe:The True and Ghastly Tale of the Beast of Boleham Tower"), he is stated to have seized a tower in [Boleham](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boleham "Universe:Boleham"), which is located outside the far reaches of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), just south of the [Argent Mountains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Argent_Mountains "Universe:Argent Mountains"). In [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Legends_of_Runeterra "Legends of Runeterra"), he is shown to own another, larger castle in an unspecified location.
- Veigar appears to suffer from a [Napoleon complex](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Napoleon_complex), as he goes to great lengths to make himself appear taller (using platform boots or a 4[giant mech suit](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Grand_Overseer_Veigar "LoR:Grand Overseer Veigar")) and he hates words like "short" or "little."[[8]](#cite_note-Veigar_LoR_interactions-8)
- Due to her thematic and abilities, the 8 [Mirror Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Mirror_Mage "LoR:Mirror Mage") in Veigar's circle has been speculated by fans to have a possible connection to  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc").
- After the [2014 lore retcon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra_Legacy "Universe:Runeterra Legacy"), the [Minions](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Minion_(Species) "Minion (Species)") on [Summoner's Rift](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Summoner%27s_Rift "Summoner's Rift") did not have a canonical origin until 4[Veigar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Veigar "LoR:Veigar") was released in [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Legends_of_Runeterra "Legends of Runeterra"), where they appeared as his diminutive, obedient, and often mistreated lackeys.
  - In the flavor text of the 2 [Minion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Minion "LoR:Minion") card, it is implied that Veigar likes having minions around because they are shorter than him.
- After  [Lulu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lulu "Universe:Lulu") was released, the community immediately began creating a lot of content featuring her and Veigar, which led to Riot Games officially making them friends in the game's [old lore](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra_Legacy "Universe:Runeterra Legacy"). Later, they were also shown to be somewhat friendly towards one another in the [Riot Forge](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Riot_Forge "Riot Forge") game [Bandle Tale](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Bandle_Tale "Bandle Tale"). It is unknown if they are friends in the current lore.

structure.name: Tianna
structure.background:
### Early Life

Tianna Crownguard was born as the middle daughter[[2]](#cite_note-2) of the three children from  [House Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard"), a noble family charged with protecting the king of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"). In her youth, Tianna was a rebel. One of her pranks involved removing a finger from each statue in the eastern wing of her family's estate.[[3]](#cite_note-Rising-3) She and her two brothers all served in the military, and their father saved  [Jarvan III's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") life at the Battle of Storm's Fang.[[4]](#cite_note-LuxBio-4) She was a teenager when she enlisted, and did so out of a desire to prove herself, toughened by the weight of her family's expectations.[[3]](#cite_note-Rising-3) Pieter and Tianna served as regular troops, while their brother was a  [Ranger-Knight](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacian_Rangers "Universe:Demacian Rangers"). This brother was eventually killed in action by a mage,[[5]](#cite_note-GarenBio-5) but Tianna and Pieter served with impeccable records. Tianna rose through the ranks and was eventually selected to the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard") for her heroic actions.

### Battle of Kalstead

Before  [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") was born,[[4]](#cite_note-LuxBio-4) Tianna was named Sword-Captain of the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard"). Her inaugural battle was at the coastal fortress of [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead"), where she won a decisive victory against the expansionist forces of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). Unlike the Demacians, these Noxians were a ragtag, disorganized group consisting primarily of conscripts, nicknamed "soldiers-of-misfortune" back in the empire. Yet one of the enemy, the legendary  [Reckoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") known only as  ["Viscero"](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"), ended the lives of far more of Tianna's comrades than the rest. As he was the only one to cause her any trouble, Tianna regarded the Reckoner with contempt and imprisoned him separately from the rest.[[6]](#cite_note-Sailed-6)

While Tianna believed the Noxians did not share Demacian virtues, King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") wanted to avoid unnecessary bloodshed and ordered the prisoners released instead of executed.[[7]](#cite_note-XinBio-7) In his tent, King Jarvan met with each of them and allowed them to leave Kalstead in peace, providing them the necessary gold for travel. Tianna stood guard over him and the  [young prince](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV") during this time, but when Viscero arrived, Tianna became visibly irritated, even threatening to draw her sword when he spoke out of turn. At the King's request, Viscero introduced himself as  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"), a native  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") who had been captured and taken to the empire against his will long ago, and made to fight in Kalstead after he was bought out from the arenas. Hearing this, Jarvan declared that he was proud to free Xin Zhao from the bonds of Noxus, and as with the others, Tianna and the guards gave him enough gold for one week of travel.[[6]](#cite_note-Sailed-6)

Xin Zhao refused the gold, however, and to Tianna's outrage, he instead asked to join the King's personal guard. Furthermore, when Jarvan asked how he could trust Xin Zhao was capable, the Reckoner attacked Tianna and her guards stunning them long enough to steal a spear and threaten the King with its blunt end. Tianna was horrified by the display, but Jarvan ordered her to stand down, claiming that his guards could learn from Xin Zhao. At the King's command, Xin Zhao would be returning with them to the [Great City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_City_of_Demacia "Universe:The Great City of Demacia"), where he would be given a change to prove himself and be sworn into his service.[[6]](#cite_note-Sailed-6)

Tianna, unconvinced about the prisoner's intentions or loyalty, later confronted and threatened Xin Zhao in the camp, vowing to keep an eye on him so that the King would not be harmed on his watch. To her surprise, Xin Zhao pledged that if anything were to happen, he would allow her to personally execute him.[[6]](#cite_note-Sailed-6)

### Fall of the Gates of Mourning

:   *Main article: [Fragile Legacies](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fragile_Legacies "Universe:Fragile Legacies")*

Though she commanded the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard") for many years and delivered many legendary victories for Demacia, Tianna's last battle as their sword-captain ended in failure. Many claimed that the battle of the [Gates of Mourning](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gates_of_Mourning "Universe:Gates of Mourning") had been unwinnable, but even so, Tianna felt deeply ashamed and humiliated by her inability to hold back the  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") advance. Her defeat had led to the deaths of not only numerous soldiers under her command, but also a number of high-profile figures, including High Marshal Purcivell Bronz and  [Lord Barrett](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Barrett_Buvelle "Universe:Barrett Buvelle") of  [House Buvelle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Buvelle "Universe:House Buvelle"). Within three weeks after the battle, Tianna resigned from her position, but  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") still believed Tianna an asset and appointed her the new High Marshal in Purcivell's place.[[8]](#cite_note-Fragile-8)

At the funeral for Lord Barrett, Tianna approached Lady Lestara Buvelle to offer condolences to her and her family. Lestara still blamed Tianna for failing to protect her husband, and though Tianna tried desperately to avoid the topic, she still felt a great deal of shame.[[8]](#cite_note-Fragile-8) As a favor to Lady Buvelle, Tianna put in a good word for a young ranger named  [Quinn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quinn "Universe:Quinn") of [Uwendale](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Uwendale "Universe:Uwendale"), who had saved Barrett's life two years prior on a hunting expedition. Within a week, Quinn was sworn in as a ranger-knight of Demacia.[[9]](#cite_note-QuinnBio-9)

Around the same time, Tianna was betrothed to  [Lord Eldred](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Eldred "Universe:Eldred"), the head of the  [Order of Mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers"). Both Eldred and Tianna seemed disinterested in each other, but Eldred took full advantage of the  [Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") reputation to curry favor with the other [nobles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noble_Houses_of_Demacia "Universe:Noble Houses of Demacia") and convince them to expand his organization. As Lord Barrett had been slain by mages, these efforts proved successful, as even the King had decreed at the funeral that he would be taking a firmer stance against magic.[[8]](#cite_note-Fragile-8) However, these new policies would become cause for concern the Crownguards, as unbeknownst to the other houses,  [one](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") of their family was secretly a mage.[[1]](#cite_note-Lux1-1)

### High Marshal of Demacia

#### Trials of Garen Crownguard

:   *Main article: [The Might of Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Might_of_Demacia "Universe:The Might of Demacia")*

With her promotion to the role of High Marshal, Tianna now held the highest military position in  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), representing the entire army on the Silver Council.[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10) She remained a trusted advisor to King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), and soon after her appointment, she recommended her nephew  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") be allowed to join the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard") by completing the necessary trials. Garen, who was already considered an outstanding recruit by his battalion, passed his trials and was summoned before the throne to take his oaths before the King. His proud family was in attendance for the ceremony, and in time, Garen would prove himself worthy of the title sword-captain, eventually replacing the one who had succeeded Tianna.[[5]](#cite_note-GarenBio-5)

#### Crownguard-Laurent Feud

:   *Main article: [The Grand Duelist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Grand_Duelist "Universe:The Grand Duelist")*

After the youngest  [daughter](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fiora "Universe:Fiora") of  [House Laurent](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Laurent "Universe:House Laurent") turned eighteen, an advantageous political marriage was arranged between her and  [House Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") as part of Demacia's grand game of alliances. The wedding was to be held at summer in the [Great City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_City_of_Demacia "Universe:The Great City of Demacia"), and was a large enough event that  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") himself was in attendance. When the day arrived, however, Fiora announced that she would rather die than marry someone against her will. The outburst publicly humiliated her betrothed, and his family demanded the matter be settled in a traditional duel to the death, which Fiora immediately agreed to.[[11]](#cite_note-FioraBio-11)

With the two families now locked in a feud, Tianna used her position as High Marshal to intervene on her kinsman's behalf, nominating a veteran warrior from the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard") to fight in his place. The Laurents similarly intervened on behalf of Fiora, with her father Sebastien fighting for her instead. Even before the duel took place, it was plainly obvious the Laurents were outmatched, and very soon, another scandal occurred when Sebastien was caught trying to drug his opponent, violating the Demacians' most fundamental code of honor.[[11]](#cite_note-FioraBio-11)

As punishment, Sebastien was to fight his own daughter in a duel to the death. Fiora drove a rapier through his heart and took over as head of the family, and King Jarvan solemnly declared the feud between Crownguard and Laurent to finally be settled.[[11]](#cite_note-FioraBio-11)

### Great Mage Rebellion

#### Escape of the Unshackled

When Tianna learned that  [Luxanna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") may have been in a dangerous position, she proposed and organized her marriage to  [Prince Jarvan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV").[[1]](#cite_note-Lux1-1) When the time came, however, Lux did not show up for the betrothal ceremony, and Tianna soon learned of her niece's visits to  [Sylas of Dregbourne's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") cell in the  [Mageseeker](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers") Compound. Believing it would create a scandal for one of their family to befriend a dangerous mage prisoner, Tianna ordered Sylas's execution and had Lux confined to the Crownguard Manor.[[12]](#cite_note-Lux3-12)

Despite Tianna's efforts, Sylas managed to escape his execution after Lux attempted to rescue him.  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen"), who arrived in response to the disturbance, was badly injured by Sylas, and as the situation spiraled into a full-on insurrection in the royal palace, Tianna came to the Infirmary of the Sisters to aid his recovery. As traditional medicine would not wake Garen, Tianna decided to approach the situation as a soldier rather than a healer, giving him orders and a warning that his king and  [country](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") were under siege. Tianna's method successfully woke Garen, but they were unable to prevent the death of  [King Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), nor the [turmoil](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion") that would follow during the next few months.[[13]](#cite_note-Lux4-13) With Prince Jarvan IV elevated to the position of ruler, he swore to rely on the wisdom and experience of his father's chief advisors, including Tianna and others among the nobility.[[14]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-14)

#### Nockmirch Conspiracy

:   *Main article: [Garen: First Shield](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen:_First_Shield "Universe:Garen: First Shield")*

Some months after the [death](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux:_Issue_4 "Universe:Lux: Issue 4") of  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), and almost four years after  [Garen's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") promotion to sword-captain, the Silver Council received a letter from the  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") ambassador to the [Nockmirch](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nockmirch "Universe:Nockmirch"), her Uncle Hargold—the younger brother on her mother's side, whom she considered a highly meticulous and pragmatic man. Having read numerous of Hargold's letters before, Tianna noticed a number of slight irregularities in the language and handwriting and deduced the letter was a forgery, so she summoned Garen to the council room and gave him a mission to check and see if Hargold was alive and well. Garen, who had been distracted and exhausted since the king's assassination, believed he was still needed in Demacia to search for  [Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas"). But to Tianna, the Vanguard's recent casualties on Garen's watch—numbering to thirty-seven total—proved that he needed some time away from the [conflict](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion") so he could return to Demacia at full strength. Garen still disagreed with the orders, but obeyed after Tianna reminded him that she was his superior officer.[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10)

As this was on its surface a diplomatic mission, Tianna allowed Garen to bring only three of the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard")'s companies with him: the First, Fourth, and Eighth Shields. To aid their journey through the border nations, Tianna also [sent orders](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shield_of_Remembrance "Universe:Shield of Remembrance") to the  [ranger-knight](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacian_Rangers "Universe:Demacian Rangers")  [Quinn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quinn "Universe:Quinn") to accompany them, as she was familiar with the landscape and could navigate for them. Later, Tianna would learn that Garen's mission to [Alderburg](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Alderburg "Universe:Alderburg") unearthed a massive  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") conspiracy to turn the Nockmirch into a Noxian ally, which they had accomplished by killing Hargold and replacing him with an  [impostor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"). From the Nockmirch, they would invade and conquer the [Rijenland](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rijenland "Universe:Rijenland"), thereby weakening Demacia's position in central  [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valoran "Universe:Valoran") and allowing them an easy route to encroach on Demacian borders. Garen's efforts prevented the invasion, as the Noxian commander Vigrid was killed and the Nockmirch's lord, Eldwyn, was replaced with his daughter Odelyn, who promised to stand with Demacia and its allies against Noxus for the foreseeable future.[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10)

Upon returning to the [Great City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_City_of_Demacia "Universe:The Great City of Demacia"), Tianna spoke with Garen again regarding the outcome of his mission. Quinn was wounded and recovering, but was strong enough to leave the city despite the healers trying to stop her. Hargold was dead, as were a number of the Vanguard. Even so, Tianna commended Garen, as she believed it was a miracle any of them had survived. She and the Silver Council were still in the process of deciding a replacement for Hargold as ambassador, but she remarked that Garen's choice for an interim ambassador, the Stonehorn [minotaur](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Minotaur "Universe:Minotaur") Kriel, was doing well so far. She was also impressed with his decision to install Lady Odelyn as leader of the Nockmirch; Tianna would have simply imprisoned her and Eldwyn to install a puppet ruler, but Garen's approach had made the Nockmirch into a much stronger ally. Still, Garen worried that the Nockmirchers might one day turn on Odelyn for standing against Noxus, which would make them the front line for a Demacian-Noxian war. Tianna believed this line of thought to be foolish, however. Lord Eldwyn had betrayed his oaths of alliance with Demacia and shamed both his house and land. And for the Nockmirchers as a whole, she believed it was better to die free than a slave to Noxus.[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10)

As a final note, Tianna informed Garen that the Silver Council was unnerved that one of their ambassadors had been replaced with a mage. The revelation had only strengthened the position of the  [mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers") in the royal court, and Tianna feared that  [Jarvan IV's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV") anger made him easy to manipulate so long as Sylas remained at large. Tianna then gave Garen a new dispatch with their latest intelligence, and Garen set out to find Sylas once more.[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10)
structure.appearance: Tianna Crownguard is a tall, lean, pale-skinned woman with blue eyes and long, golden blonde hair, with parts of the back tied into a long braid. She wears a stern and serious expression on her face and frequently stands upright at attention, like a soldier constantly awaiting orders. As the High Marshal, she wears the silver and gold armor that  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") is known for, including a chestplate, tassets, vambraces, and the massive  [Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") battle pauldrons, decorated with the golden [silverwings](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silverwing "Universe:Silverwing") which are the sigil of her House. Around her neck, Tianna wears a fine embroidered blue cloak clasped with a golden brooch with a blue gemstone. The cape extends behind her back and is gold on the edges and the inside. At the Battle of [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead"), Tianna was armed with a Demacian steel sword, which she carried in a sheath attached to her right hip. While not in battle, Tianna is sometimes seen wearing silver boots with pointy heels, making her even taller in appearance.
structure.personality:
Tianna had a stern and uncompromising personality, taking great pride in her dedication to her King, country, and family name. For generations, the  [Crownguards](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") had been devoted protectors of the throne, which led Tianna to expect only the best from herself and her family members. Tianna was harshly critical of those who failed to live up to these standards. This, she believed, was the only way to uphold the honor of the Crownguard name. If the failure was her own, Tianna would feel a deep sense of shame, but she would try her best to maintain a cool and stoic demeanor, pushing herself further into her duties to try and prevent such failures from happening again.

Like many Demacians, Tianna was distrustful of both outsiders and [mages](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"), showing little mercy to those who might be a threat to her kingdom or house.  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"), who had fought for  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") at [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead"), was immediately regarded with suspicion and contempt by the young sword-captain, believing him a threat to  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"). When protecting her family, Tianna proved even more ruthless, willing to execute a  [mage prisoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") to prevent a scandal after learning  [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") had befriended him. She was even willing to spill the blood of other Demacian nobles if they crossed the Crownguards, as was the case in the feud with  [House Laurent](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Laurent "Universe:House Laurent").
structure.abilities:
- **Leadership:** Tianna Crownguard is the High Marshal of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), which places her on the government's Silver Council[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10) and in charge of most of the kingdom's military operations and personnel, including the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard"). She has served as a high-ranking advisor to two Demacian kings, including both  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") and  [Jarvan IV](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV"), with her leadership proving a vital asset against  [Sylas'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") [rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion").[[14]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-14)
  - **Military Expertise:** Tianna is a renowned commander in the  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") military. As sword-captain of the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard"), she delivered many legendary victories for her kingdom, starting with the Battle of [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead").[[6]](#cite_note-Sailed-6) Tianna is recognized for her expertise and is noted as having surpassed her two brothers in the military, and imparted much of her knowledge onto her brother's children,  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") and  [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux").[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10)[[3]](#cite_note-Rising-3)
  - **Statecraft and Diplomacy:** Tianna stands out among the  [Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") family, a name which on its own carries significant weight among even the other nobility. She is highly skilled at navigating power games of the [noble houses](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noble_Houses_of_Demacia "Universe:Noble Houses of Demacia") to defend the Crownguards' interests and reputation, constantly wary of potential scandals[[12]](#cite_note-Lux3-12) and ruthless against rivals who threatened or humiliated them, such as  [House Laurent](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Laurent "Universe:House Laurent").[[11]](#cite_note-FioraBio-11) With regard to geopolitics, Tianna's careful attention to detail helped to uncover a conspiracy in the [Nockmirch](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nockmirch "Universe:Nockmirch"), after the  [Noxians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") covertly replaced the  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") ambassador to the region.[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10)
- **Swordswoman:** Tianna's weapon of choice is a Demacian steel sword, which she carried with her in the Battle of [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead"). As a  [Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard"), she is sworn to serve and protect the King of Demacia, and stood guard and ready to fight at  [Jarvan III's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") side for many years.

relations.relationship_description:
Tianna is Garen's aunt, and they seem to have a close relationship. Tianna approves of Garen's path in life, having been a member of the Dauntless Vanguard herself, and believes he brings honour to the Crownguard name. Their relationship is likely strengthened by the fact that they both shared Lux's [secret](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Binding_Light "Universe:Binding Light"), without her knowledge for the longest time, and both work together to preserve the Crownguard name.

It is heavily suggested that she would be just as ashamed of Garen as she is of Lux if she ever learned of his relationship with  [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina"), in character considering her need to preserve the image of her family.

Tianna is Lux's aunt, and her relationship with her has been portrayed mainly in [the Lux comic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux:_Issue_1 "Universe:Lux: Issue 1") and in quotes from [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Legends_of_Runeterra "Legends of Runeterra"). She has been shown to know of Lux's magic, in [Lux: Issue 1](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux:_Issue_1 "Universe:Lux: Issue 1"), and suggests that she marry Jarvan IV so that she'd be safe from persecution for her magic. She later confronted Lux alongside Garen after it had been found that she had been visiting  [Sylas'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") cell.

Her LoR card's flavour text suggests she's confronted her before, and that she is uncaring about her magic, but does care greatly for the family's reputation, and Lux knows this.

Eldred married Tianna Crownguard some time after she was elevated to High Marshal, and he used her reputation as a  [Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") to convince the [noble houses](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noble_Houses_of_Demacia "Universe:Noble Houses of Demacia") to expand the  [Mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers").[[8]](#cite_note-Fragile-8) Their relationship was somewhat cold and shrouded by formalities, and only became more so after the start of the [mage rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion").[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10)[[15]](#cite_note-LoRFlavor-15)

When the Reckoner  [Viscero](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xin_Zhao/Cosmetics "Xin Zhao/Cosmetics") was captured by  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") army and then spared to start a new life elsewhere, he insisted on becoming a guard of King Jarvan III, who approved his request in spite of Tianna's disagreement. She later confronted Xin to warn him that she would keep watching him, and he gladly took an oath that allows her to kill him should anything happen to the king during his service.

Tianna suggested that Lux marry Prince Jarvan IV so that she'd be safe from persecution for her magic. After  [King Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") was killed, Tianna became part of the counsel for the young prince before he could be crowned king.[[14]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-14) Although he was now leader of the kingdom, the seat on the Silver Council reserved for the royal family remained empty, as Jarvan had not yet received his coronation. Jarvan IV refused to take part in any affairs of the state which were unrelated to hunting down  [Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas"), so he left most matters of governance to Tianna,  [Eldred](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Eldred "Universe:Eldred"), and the six other members of the Silver Council. Tianna feared that Jarvan's anger made him easy to manipulate by the  [Mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers"), and to remedy this, she believed it best to capture Sylas as quickly as possible.[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10)

When Sebastien Laurent stepped up to protect his daughter from a death duel when she publicly rejected marrying an unnamed Crownguard family member, Tianna selected a veteran warrior from the Dauntless Vanguard to fight for her kinsman so that his defeat would be certain, leading to his trying to cheat, then imprisonment and ultimately death. It is unknown whether Fiora may have some resentment toward her.

As thanks for saving her  [husband's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Barrett_Buvelle "Universe:Barrett Buvelle") life, Lestara Buvelle vouched for Quinn to be sworn into the Demacian military, even paying a personal visit to Tianna to petition for her. Within a week, Quinn took her oaths as a ranger-knight of Demacia.[[9]](#cite_note-QuinnBio-9) Tianna would later assign Quinn to escort  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") on a diplomatic mission outside of Demacia.[[16]](#cite_note-Remembrance-16) When they returned, Quinn was recovering from a serious arrow wound she had sustained at [Alderburg](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Alderburg "Universe:Alderburg"). Quinn left the [Great City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_City_of_Demacia "Universe:The Great City of Demacia") as soon as she was able to, against the advice of her healers, and Tianna noted that she admired Quinn's resilience.[[10]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-10)

structure.name: Irelia
structure.quote: *"There was a time when I danced only for myself. Now, I dance for the First Lands."*
structure.background:
### Early life

When she was young, she was fascinated by the grace and beauty of human movement. Under her grandmother’s tutelage, she learned the traditional silk dances of her province—though she was dubious of their supposedly mystical connection to the Spirit of Ionia, Irelia’s love for the dances was real. Seeking to master the art, she eventually left home to study with some of Ionia’s most respected performers at the Placidium of Navori.

Irelia’s people were peaceful and sought harmony with their neighbors, but rumors of foreign invaders sighted off the coast unsettled many at the Placidium. Irelia returned to her village to find it already occupied, with steel-helmed soldiers from distant Noxus shoving unarmed civilians through the streets with the butts of their spears. The Noxian Admiral Duqal had seized the Xan home to quarter his fleet officers.

Irelia’s brothers and her father Lito had evidently protested; her entire family now lay in unmarked graves, in the gardens.

Ravaged by grief, the young girl saw Duqal’s men hauling valuables from the house. Among the loot was a large metal crest, depicting the Xan family emblem. Irelia raced to it, wrenching it from Noxian hands. The admiral himself hurled her to the ground, and had his warriors shatter the crest with a heavy iron maul, before ordering them to dig a fresh grave for this upstart child.

As they surrounded her, Irelia averted her eyes, looking to the pieces of the Xan crest scattered on the ground. From deep within her soul, she felt a strange rhythm begin to beat. The shards of metal began to twitch, to twist, moving seemingly on their own, and Irelia felt the serene joy of the ancient dances once more...

With a sweep of her arm, she sent the pieces flying like ragged blades, cutting clean through two of the Noxians. As Duqal and his officers reeled in shock, Irelia snatched up the shards of her crest, and fled the village.

In the quiet forests beyond, Irelia mourned her family, and thought back to her grandmother’s teachings. She realized that the techniques she had learned were more than mere dances—they were a powerful expression of something far greater.

The Noxian occupation soon began to test the fragile peace of the First Lands. It was said that even the religious leader Karma had been forced to strike back at the invaders with deadly magic, though her followers had now withdrawn to the Lasting Altar and would not condone any further violence. Across Navori, dissenting voices began to band together. A resistance was forming, one that would not rest until Ionia was free once more. Irelia joined their ranks, performing her cherished dances for them in the woodland camps, to preserve some vestige of their vanishing culture.

She was barely fourteen years old when she found herself back at the Placidium. Her band of resistance fighters joined the militia who had sworn to guard the monasteries and wild, sacred gardens.

But Noxus knew only too well what this place represented. A particularly cunning general named Jericho Swain captured the Placidium and took its defenders hostage, hoping to lure the inevitable reinforcements into a trap.

It was in this moment that Irelia rose to meet her destiny. Freed from her bonds, she unleashed the full potential of her ancient blade dance, lashing out with graceful zeal. A dozen of Swain’s veterans fell, sowing chaos in their ranks as the other captives joined her, before she struck down the general himself—the sight of this rebellious girl hefting his severed arm over her head would be the turning point of the war.

This victory, the Great Stand at Navori, ensured that everyone in Ionia knew the name of Xan Irelia, and looked to her for leadership. Reluctantly, she led the growing resistance for almost three years of grueling battle before her triumph at Dalu Bay. There, she finally cornered the defeated Admiral Duqal, and exacted the vengeance she had sought for so long.

Though the war has long since ended, Ionia has been permanently changed by it. The First Lands are now divided, with rival factions fighting each other almost as bitterly as they did the Noxians. Many continue to look to Irelia for answers but, while others might welcome such power, Irelia remains uneasy with it.

At heart, she still yearns only to dance alone.

### Rise of the Sentinels

When the sentinels arrived in Ionia and found Irelia, she was hesitant about the strangers and appeared willing to face them, especially after seeing Riven among them.
structure.appearance: Irelia is a slender, pale-skinned woman with sea green eyes and long dark hair down to her hips. Her clothes are a mix of elegant robes and battle attire with a distinctive palette of red, pink, black, and silver. The most characteristic element of her attire is the silver diadem on her head. She also has several 1 [silver blades](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Blade "LoR:Blade") that float around her.
structure.personality:
Irelia is a passionate, protective individual who dedicates herself to the protection of Ionia and is very fond of dance. She believes that brute force is needed to properly defend Ionia from the likes of Noxus, hence why she considers alliances with Zed and his shadow assassins despite their disagreeable methods. She also demonstrates a kind and caring persona to those close to her, such as the Blossoming Blade, whom she has a soft spot for.

Despite her uptight and serious demeanour, however, Irelia also displays a level of sarcasm at her opponents. This is evidenced by her comments on Garen's fighting technique and his habit of yelling his country's name in battle.
structure.abilities:
- **[Spirit Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Irelia has a deep connection to the Spirit Realm created through meditation and spiritual practices, allowing her to sense the influences of the Spirit Realm and use it's magic for several purposes. Irelia has nurtured that connection with the practice of the dancing arts of her people.
  - **Blade Silk Dance:** Irelia has been trained in the traditional dances of her people. More than simple exercises of artistic expression, these dances connect the dancer to the Spirit Realm, allowing it's power to flow through them.
    - **Telekinesis:** By dancing, Irelia can levitate her Crests Blades to use them in combat. It's unknown if she is capable of levitating objects without dancing, or if she can levitate other objects besides her Blades.

relations.relationship_description: Irelia cut off  [Swain's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Swain "Swain") arm which resulted in him contacting and taming a demon of secrets named Raum, later becoming the Grand General of Noxus. For this reason, he is somewhat grateful for her action.

Irelia was heavily antagonistic towards  [Riven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Riven "Universe:Riven") due to her past actions during the Noxian Invasion, but grew to respect her during their time together as Sentinels of Light.
[Sona's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sona "Sona") in-game voice lines suggest she and Irelia met at some point when she returned to Ionia.

The  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") resistance led by Irelia in the war later sprung into different groups with different ideologies, including the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood") and the Navovi Militia. The Brotherhood, in particular, became more aggressive when she wasn't the hardcore leader they needed and has tried to kill her multiple times.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

Irelia dislikes those with more pacifist attitudes like those of  [Karma](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Karma "Universe:Karma") and  [Ivern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ivern "Universe:Ivern"), or those who do not protect their homeland such as the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") since she believes this would only lead to the fall of Ionia. She may also be willing to side with Ionian extremists like  [Zed's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed")  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"), of even the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood") if necessary despite not approving their methods.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

As told in  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra"), her resistance force includes peasants of Ionia, musicians and dancers. Among those, Irelia appears to have the most intimate relationship with 5 [Liana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Blossoming_Blade "LoR:Blossoming Blade").

structure.trivia:
**Irelia, the Blade Dancer**

- *Irelia* is the feminine version of obscure Latin name *Irelius* , possibly diminutive of *ira* "wrath".
- Irelia mentions and names her entire family, whom were slaughtered during the Noxian invasion. This being her mother, father Lito, O-ma (Grandmother) and her siblings Zelos, Kye, Ohn and Ruu.
  - *Kai* is a common Navorian name with many variants, so Irelia's deceased brother Kye is not the same  Kai living within  [Varus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Varus "Universe:Varus").[[3]](#cite_note-3)
- The blades that she wield come from a prized emblem of her household that was smashed by Noxian soldiers. Now, after all the events of the war and everything she's done, it is also the symbol for an Ionia that will not bow. It's become her medal/Mantle of Decorum, but is also her weapon.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
- Irelia is 24 years old.
  - Young Irelia was just 14 years old when a Noxian Warhost lead by none other than  [General Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), successfully attacked and captured the Placidium of Navori. Swain intended to use the captive villagers to lure Ionian reinforcements into his laid-out ambush, yet Irelia broke free & counter-attacked, killing Swain's veterans & dignitaries as well as severing his left arm, scoring, against overwhelming odds, a strategic victory that'd ultimately turn the tide against Noxian invaders.
- Irelia's favourite soup is pickled lotus.

**Irelia, the Will of the Blades**

- When  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Noxus "Noxus") invaded  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ionia "Ionia") it was  [Soraka](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Soraka "Universe:Soraka") who saved Irelia from the brink of death.
  - As a result, Irelia awakened her ability to control her father Master Lito's blade.
- Rick 'ricklessabandon' Maher once described Irelia as a [Lich](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lich) and her blade as her [Phylactery](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phylactery).
  - According to this,  [Soraka](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Soraka "Universe:Soraka") bound Irelia's soul to her blade, meaning Irelia would die for good if her blades were destroyed.
- The Art of Hiten was a blade style developed by the famed swordsman Master Lito. His art was a highly guarded secret, but it was said that swords would breathe in his grasp. When Master Lito died, his daughter inherited the Hiten style. Irelia has since taken the art form to new heights as she is capable of telekinetically commanding multiple blades.
- Irelia wore a "Mantle of Decorum" on her back, which is the highest decoration an Ionian can receive ( [Karma](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Karma "Universe:Karma") has one).
