structure.name: Taliyah
structure.quote: *"This [world](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") is a tapestry of our own making."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Taliyah was born in the south of Shurima, near the border of Icathia. Her tribe, the Naasaj, were nomadic weavers and herders. Though Taliyah was always taught to appreciate the desert's beauty, she was always most interested in the rock that lay underneath.

After she turned six, Taliyah set off to find a young goat her father - the master shepherd and tribe chief - had placed in her hands. She followed the goatling through the night to a sheer cliff where it had become stuck. The stone of the cliff called to her as she lay a hand upon it, then erupted, bringing both goat and canyon wall down upon her. Her father brought her back to the camp and put her under the care of Babajan, the tribe's grandmother. Days later, she was finally able to explain what had happened, how the stone had called to her, but didn't mention that she had allowed it to fall. Babajan concluded that the Great Weaver watched over Taliyah, telling her parents that there was no reason to worry.

Once a child came of age in the Naasaj tribe, they performed a dance under the full moon - the face of the Great Weaver - to determine what their path in life would be based on their talents, and to apprentice them to a teacher. Taliyah, believing her power to be a curse, watched others use their own skills. When her time to dance finally came, she did not choose to become a weaver like her mother or herder like her father, instead closing her eyes and dancing with the stone. It rose up from the earth in a pillar, evoking startled cries from her kin. Her will broken, the rock crashed to the ground, cutting Taliyah's mother as she rushed to protect her daughter. To Taliyah, this was proof that she was indeed dangerous to everyone around her, and so she ran out into the night.

Her father found her eventually, and Taliyah finally admitted her ability to shape the stone. Instead of being scared or revolted, though, he told her that she needed to face her power, not run from it. She returned to the circle with open eyes. This time, she wove with purpose, creating a memory of those she loved. When it was time for her mentor to stand, the entire tribe did, ready to stand with her. But Taliyah knew that her true teacher was not among them, and so she headed out into the world, promising to learn to control her power.

### Travelling the [world](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra")

:   *Main article: [The Bird and the Branch](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Bird_and_the_Branch "The Bird and the Branch")*

By now in her mid-teens, Taliyah headed west towards  [Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Targon "Universe:Targon"), drawn towards the mountain by her natural affinity for stone. However, while in northern Shurima, it was a band of  [Noxians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") who discovered her. They promised her that Noxus celebrated such power, that she would find a teacher there. Raised to be trusting, Taliyah followed them, into the heart of Noxus. The endless political games were claustrophobic to her, until one captain promised to take her to  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), a place where she could practise her magic freely. But when they docked near a village and she was told to bury the inhabitants in their homes, Taliyah refused, and was tossed overboard to drown, which gave her a lifelong fear of drowning.

After escaping the Noxians, Taliyah came across  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo"), meditating in a shrine. She accidentally brought down an avalanche upon him, but managed to save him and bring him to a cave. He asked her why she had chosen such a path, causing her to leave the cave in frustration. While outside, Taliyah came face-to-face with an Ionian mountain lion. Learning a lesson from a little bird, Taliyah leaned into her power and crumbled the rock beneath both her and the lion. Yasuo saved her, becoming her unlikely mentor in the process. They had another harrowing encounter when some soldiers found them in an inn, accusing Yasuo of murder. With Taliyah's help, he fended them off and they escaped. Not long afterwards, they parted ways, but not before Yasuo told Taliyah to travel to the [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Freljord "Freljord").

### Return to [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima")

:   *Main article: [Bloodline](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Bloodline "Bloodline")*
:   *Main article: [Echoes in the Stone](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Echoes_in_the_Stone "Echoes in the Stone")*
:   *Main article: [Homecoming](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Homecoming "Homecoming")*

Taliyah returned to Shurima at around 17 years of age, passing through Bel'zhun and stopping in Vekaura. Outside the city, however, she found a dying  [Sivir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir "Universe:Sivir"), and decided to help her before going to find her family. While there, an army led by  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") attacked Vekaura, looking for the heir to Azir's lineage - Sivir - in order to kill her.  [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus"), who was also looking for Sivir, found them both and gave Sivir an amulet which would keep her hidden from Xerath, before going to fight the rogue Ascended. Taliyah managed to escape Vekaura with Sivir, but also protected Nasus and the survivors of the attack from Xerath's arcane missiles.

While outrunning a sandstorm, Taliyah ended up right outside the Great City of Shurima, which had risen from the sands. She was ushered into the city to escape the sandstorm, which seemed too dangerous to withstand with the old Shuriman traditions. As she rested, she put a hand out to touch a city wall and was suddenly overwhelmed by memories locked within the stone. There was intense pain seared into the rock by tens of thousands of voices, the city's previous citizens. Azir's failed Ascension and Xerath's betrayal had killed all of them, in the same catastrophe which buried the city millennia ago.

Taliyah spent a while in the desert, travelling with a group of other Shurimans whose families or homes had been destroyed by the Void, including  [Samir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Samir "Universe:Samir"),  [Kadira](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kadira "Universe:Kadira") and  [Zaifa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaifa "Universe:Zaifa"). She considered them her new family. Her quest to find her tribe was complicated by the fact that the seasonal waters no longer flowed, so she could no longer predict their location. The group had decided to travel north to Xolun, a place they believed would be a safe haven from the Void.

### Reclaiming [Xolan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xolan "Xolan")

:   *Main article: [Hollowspun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hollowspun "Hollowspun")*
:   *Main article: [The Call](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Call "The Call")*

When she sensed a person travelling underneath the earth, Taliyah resolved to follow and help them if she could. The person turned out to be  [Kai'Sa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kai%27Sa "Universe:Kai'Sa"), who had been tracing a massive tunnel bored into the earth by an unknown voidborn. Taliyah managed to save Kai'Sa from a group of Lamplights, though didn't destroy them, and a pit collapse. They returned to Taliyah's camp to rest and eat, but Kai'Sa left the next day to continue following the tunnel underground, warning that the [Xer'Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xer%27Sai "Xer'Sai") would stop them before they got to [Xolan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xolan "Xolan"). In fact, their route lay directly above the tunnel, and a little while later it collapsed into a massive pit, taking  [Samir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Samir "Universe:Samir") with it. Taliyah got the other travelers to safety before diving in to save Samir. She found him, and helped Kai'Sa defeat the Lamplights using Kai'Sa's  [speed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kai%27Sa#Supercharge "Kai'Sa") and her  [minefield of stone](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taliyah#Unraveled_Earth "Taliyah"). Thanks to the other travelers, all three made it out alive. Kai'Sa was angry with Taliyah for not taking her advice earlier and pointed out that if the tunnel aligned with the route to [Xolan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xolan "Xolan"), the town was likely [already destroyed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Faceless_God "Universe:The Faceless God"). Taliyah argued that they had managed to defeat the Lamplights together. They decided to try and reclaim [Xolan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xolan "Xolan") from the Void, and so they parted ways with the group of travelers.

Taliyah and Kai'Sa arrived in [Xolan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xolan "Xolan") to find the town abandoned and destroyed. They were then attacked by a group of [Xer'Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xer%27Sai "Xer'Sai"), but fended them off before a sinkhole appeared in the ground.  [Rek'Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rek%27Sai "Universe:Rek'Sai") emerged from the pit, and Kai'Sa lured her back underground. This allowed Taliyah to bring the statue of Xolaani, the 'faceless god', over the sinkhole to prevent Rek'Sai from re-emerging.
structure.appearance: Taliyah wears a red and gold Ionian coat with long sleeves over her lavender tunic, and a golden crown which keeps her hair in place. This crown was lost or destroyed during her travel to Xolun. She has brown eyes, thick eyebrows, light brown hair tied in a ponytail with two protruding strands braided, fringe, and a wide nose.
structure.personality: Taliyah is a kind, compassionate young woman with a strong will. She is deeply devoted to her homeland and the people in it, dedicating herself to protecting them from both Shuriman and outside threats. Her confidence was bolstered by Yasuo, as he taught her how to control her power over stone.
structure.abilities:
- **[Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Taliyah was born with natural magical abilities, which can grow the more she trains and expand her knowledge about magic. Her powers were originally out of control until she learned with Yasuo how to master them.
  - **Stone Magic:** Taliyah has a natural affinity for Stone Magic, the magic of the Earth and the elements within it, that allow her to mold the earth with her mind alone. Even as a child, Taliyah had a connection to the rocks around her, collecting and sensing an energy in them. Some years later, with the help of Yasuo, Taliyah's control over the element has grown greatly, allowing her to perform feats of immense power. Having grown up in a tribe of weavers, she moves stone as if she were weaving a tapestry. She can create massive stone structures and walls in an instant,  [travel quickly using the stone](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taliyah#Rock_Surfing "Taliyah"), cause quakes of varying size and even partially collapse mountains. Additionally, she can sense to some extent past events locked within the stone.

- **Athletic abilities:** Taliyah is a skilled dancer, singer and runner.
- **Multilingual:** Having travelled over much of Shurima and Valoran, Taliyah knows several different languages, including modern Shuriman, conversational and Ur-Noxian, and some Ionian, as well as some ancient Shuriman symbols.

relations.relationship_description: Yasuo became the teacher Taliyah had been looking for, as her people didn't understand her power, and Noxus sought to use her as a weapon. Before parting ways, Taliyah gave Yasuo the thread of handspun Shuriman wool with which he ties his hair back in-game. As an only child, Taliyah sees Yasuo as the older brother she never had.[[2]](#cite_note-Thermal_Kitten_Q&A-2)

Having heard only rumors of both the Ancient [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima") capital and  [Azir's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir") rise from the sands, Taliyah is convinced he is a threat to her family and her homeland when nothing could be further from  [the truth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath").
On the way to find her family, Taliyah encountered a wounded  [Sivir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir "Universe:Sivir") and nurtured her.

[Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus") encountered both of them when looking for  [Sivir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir "Universe:Sivir") in [Vekaura](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vekaura "Vekaura"). Taliyah was at first suspicious of his motives but later came to trust him. When  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") and his army came to decimate the place and find  [Sivir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir "Universe:Sivir"),  [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus") bought time for Taliyah to help others escape.

After her return to Shurima, Taliyah met  [Kai'Sa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kai%27Sa "Universe:Kai'Sa") and they fought the Voidborn together, including some of  [Rek'Sai's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rek%27Sai "Universe:Rek'Sai") [Xer'Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xer%27Sai "Xer'Sai"). Taliyah parted way with the group she travelled with to join  [Kai'Sa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kai%27Sa "Universe:Kai'Sa") in search of the mythical paradise, Xolan.

structure.trivia:
- *Ṭaliyah* טַלְיָה ([Hebrew](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biblical_Hebrew): [tˀa'lija:]) means "young ewe",[[3]](#cite_note-3) from Proto-West-Semitic *\*ṭalay**-at*.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
  - In English localizations, her name is pronounced [tɐˈli:ʲɐ:] *TaLEEyah* with second syllable stressed[[5]](#cite_note-5) like in Hebrew; in other localizations, the stress may fall on different syllables or no syllable is stressed at all.
  - Originally, her name was spelled *Taalea*.[[6]](#cite_note-6)
  - Another inspiration is Arabic *Tāliya* تَالِيَة ~ *Tāliyatun* تَالِيَةٌ "reciter", feminine active participle of root *t-l-w* "to recite".[[7]](#cite_note-7)
- She's portrayed as being about 16 years old,[[8]](#cite_note-8) but several timeline inconsistencies gradually arose after her release and made it clear that she is canonically older than that. Scathlocke has stated that she is 23 as of [996 AN](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Recent_History "Recent History").[[9]](#cite_note-9)[[10]](#cite_note-10)
  - She was 6 years old when she became a Stoneweaver.
  - She was likely in her mid teens when she was conscripted by  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus")
  - She was likely 16 years old during the events of [The Bird and the Branch](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Bird_and_the_Branch "The Bird and the Branch").
  - She was likely 17 years old during the events of [Bloodline](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Bloodline "Bloodline").
- [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo") dubbed her 'Little Sparrow'.
- Her tribe is called the *Nasaaj*, meaning "weaver",[[2]](#cite_note-Thermal_Kitten_Q&A-2) from Arabic نَسّاج *nassāj* < Semitic *n-s-k*[[11]](#cite_note-11) < *s-k-k* "to weave".[[12]](#cite_note-12)
  - Just as [Semites](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semitic_people) formulate surnames from information about the bearer's progenitors, occupation, or origin, whether ethnic or geographical, Taliyah would most likely introduce herself as *Taliyah of the Nasaaj*.
- Taliyah's family is part of one of many nomadic tribes that formed after the fall of Ancient Shurima by  [Xerath's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") hand.
- Taliyah's tribe worships "the Great Weaver," a force of nature said to govern the tapestry of fate and life for every individual.
  - This deity seems to have been inspired by [weaving-associated goddesses](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Textiles_in_mythology_and_folklore), such as Egyptian [Neith](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neith), Semitic [Asherah](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asherah), Indo-European [triple fate goddesses](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triple_deity#Triple_goddesses), etc.
- [ThermalKitten](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ariel_%27Thermal_Kitten%27_Lawrence "Ariel 'Thermal Kitten' Lawrence"), Taliyah's writer, shared several details about her on the boards:[[2]](#cite_note-Thermal_Kitten_Q&A-2)
  - Taliyah stands at about 5'9"/175 cm tall.
  - She is a Virgo. ThermalKitten initially placed her birthday in "mid to late September" but later mentioned it on Twitter as being September 22.[[13]](#cite_note-13)
  - She was canonically named after a specific, lavender-colored, five-petaled, star-like flower that grows in the rocky foothills near the Icathian border. It's called *ta'liyah,* "the rock that flowers."
  - From ThermalKitten on her sexuality: "I think Taliyah is someone who is the midst of finding out who she is and figuring out who you're attracted to is certainly part of that. I'm sure she would find some people more physically attractive than others, but I think the thing that would draw her to someone would be who they are on the inside." In short, Taliyah is still figuring out her sexuality, but personality is more important to her than looks.
  - Her favorite ice cream flavor is rocky road.
  - Her favorite animals are goats, especially fluffy goats.
  - Her favorite color is indigo.
  - Her favorite time of day is dawn.
  - In the real world, she'd enjoy indie/electropop music, Western movies, romance novels, frappucinos, red velvet cake pops, and pineapple and pepperoni pizza. Her favorite subjects in school would be geology, astronomy, and biology. Her favorite Pokémon would be Rockruff.
- Riot Stellari noted her Myers-Briggs personality type is [ENTJ](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ENTJ) (['the Commander'](https://www.16personalities.com/entj-personality)).[[14]](#cite_note-14)
- DanielZKlein additionally mentioned that Taliyah is left-handed.[[15]](#cite_note-15)
- [Freljord Taliyah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taliyah/Cosmetics "Taliyah/Cosmetics") was originally intended to be her canon appearance in the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord").[[16]](#cite_note-16) However, due to the reason behind her dramatic appearance changes (contact with True Ice) being unlikely at the moment, the skin is now likely only a nod to her time in the Freljord. As of right now, it does not show up in the client's Freljord set alongside  [Freljord Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sylas/Cosmetics "Sylas/Cosmetics") which is a canon skin.

structure.quote: *"Here is my eternity… a day the gods will remember!"*
structure.background:
### Early life

**Atreus** was born on the slopes of  [Mount Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mount_Targon "Universe:Mount Targon"), belonging to the tribes of the Rakkor. From a young age, Atreus would train for battle, joining the military unit of the Rakkor, the Ra'Horak. Never particularly talented, nor possessing any innate strength, young Atreus would constantly fail every training regiment and bout he partook in. However, his impressive endurance and relentless fighting spirit always ensured that he would stand back up, in spite of how bloodied and bruised he would be after each encounter. This would earn him the respect of his much more skilled rival and eventual best friend, Pylas, whom Atreus would constantly challenge despite being outmatched in every fight. Through the bloodied and gruesome training circles, Pylas and Atreus would forge a strong bond of brotherhood, a bond that only grew stronger as the two battled proudly for their tribe.

### The Aspect of War

Atreus and his Ra'Horak companions were ambushed by a barbarian incursion looking to make way into Rakkor territory. The battle would leave most of the patrol dead, save for Atreus and Pylas. The two would seek retribution for their fallen comrades from the Aspect of the Sun, but the Aspect refused to lend aid to fight off the trespassers making their way into their homes. Outraged, Atreus and Pylas vowed to end the fight themselves by making the climb to Targon's peak to acquire power.

Similar to the many people that previously attempted to make the climb, the two underestimated the intensity and difficulty of the task. It was a difficult trial, as the two would eventually make their way to the top, but with Pylas dying on the peak of the mountain in Atreus' arms. With Atreus the only one at the peak, the skies opened for the gods to choose their host. Atreus was taken by the Aspect of War, the Pantheon.

Pantheon deemed Atreus too unworthy to wield the power it possessed, but War needed a host body. It took over Atreus' body, stopping Atreus from having any control over the body that Pantheon now inhabited.

What Atreus endured while Pantheon took over his body were visions of Pantheon looking for the  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin") across  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra"), the living weapons that remained after the [Darkin Wars](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Great_Darkin_War "Great Darkin War").

Eventually, Pantheon faced  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox"). Aatrox sought to reach the peak of Targon, with Pantheon arriving to stop the Darkin's ascent. They battled, and it ended with Aatrox driving his blade into the aspect, killing it and erasing its constellation from the skies.

With Pantheon gone, Atreus reawoke, finding himself impaled with the Darkin's blade. Bleeding and on the verge of death, Atreus spit on Aatrox's face as an act of defiance. Aatrox was bemused by this and left Atreus to die.

Atreus stood back up, powered with nothing but bitter rage and regret at his own failings. He stumbled his way into Rakkor territory, until he reached the home of Iula, the widowed wife of Pylas. She nursed him back to health, and as Atreus recovered, he was reinvigorated to keep fighting, finding pride in being a mortal human being instead of a god.

While he recovered, he received news that a barbarian incursion was headed towards the territory that included Iula's farm. Atreus learned that it was led by Aatrox, who convinced the barbarians to invade Targonian settlements. Atreus picked up his weapons and headed to battle to confront Aatrox in an attempt to put an end to the madness.

When Atreus reached the site of battle, Aatrox saw the lack of power flowing through his spear and the scar which seared into both his shield and his body. Despite Aatrox's advantages, Atreus fought him, invigorated by the cries of the people around him. Just before he was about to be defeated, Atreus struck Aatrox's sword arm, detaching the Darkin from its host.

This act brought back Pantheon's constellation into the sky, and Atreus made a vow to be the shield, to protect all mortals against those that wanted to destroy them. Forsaking his name, he instead took the mantle of the Pantheon, the Aspect of War.

### Resurrection of Pantheon

Atreus was present when  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") came to Targon to search for a fetter of queen Isolde's soul. He battled the Ruined King at the peak, but was overwhelmed by the time the Sentinels of Light arrived. Atreus' consciousness was subsumed, but Pantheon was resurrected by the king's magic and had taken control of his body. Pantheon attempted to bury the Sentinels with an avalanche, while Viego continued his search. When the Sentinels retaliated, Pantheon summoned an army of ghouls and leapt into battle. He was eventually defeated by  [Diana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Diana "Universe:Diana"), but Viego had already secured the fetter. Pantheon went to the Shadow Isles and guarded the Sentinels as made their final stand against the Ruined King, where Viego would revive his queen. When Viego was defeated, Atreus was freed, and he reclaimed his body from Pantheon.

### Recent Events

:   *Main article: [In Battle, Broken](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/In_Battle,_Broken "In Battle, Broken")*
:   *Main article: [The Call](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Call "The Call")*

After the Aspect of War was defeated once again, Atreus visited Iula again. While there, he told her that he had finally given up. After the Aspect was defeated, Atreus lost his celestial powers and couldn't go on. He considered himself defeated after having experienced so much and didn't resist Iula when she pointed his own spear to his chest, even pulling it towards himself so that she could finish the job that the Aspect had started. Iula responded to this with anger. She told him that Pylas had died to make him the protector that he had become and the fact that he was throwing everything away was an insult to her and Pylas' memory. Pantheon left in shame, thinking of what Iula said.

Despite his despair, Atreus was reinvigorated by what Iula had said. With unclear motives, Atreus traveled into the territory of the Solari, to the location of a portal that they had constructed that went to the peak of Mount Targon. The Solari, along with  [Leona](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Leona "Universe:Leona"), fought him. Despite fighting valiantly, Pantheon was knocked off of the cliff that they were fighting on by a comet of unknown origin. At the bottom of the cliff, surrounded by the bodies and weapons of fallen soldiers, Atreus sat in quiet reflection. During this time, he found a reinvigorated passion. With this newfound passion, Atreus' celestial powers returned, and he flew into the night sky.
structure.appearance:
Atreus is a physically imposing warrior, with a physique that is carved from a lifetime of training as a soldier. A deep scar runs across his chest, a scar which he received when he was impaled by Aatrox's Darkin blade. He sports the cape of Solstice, a blue ethereal cape with constellations of the sky gleaming from the very fabric. Within certain in-game depictions, when Pantheon has his helmet on, his visage darkens, tying into identity as a faceless soldier of war defending humanity. When his helmet is off, he has a mohawk and sports a thick beard, tied up to keep straight. His face, and much of his body, have golden Solari-based tattoos, which harken back to his Ra'Horak days.

When Pantheon was briefly resurrected after being Ruined by Viego, Pantheon's appearance changed drastically. Like most of the Ruined champions, Pantheon's chest had the dark and green downward facing triangle, signifying his Ruination. The shield he wielded bared a face with some similarity to Atreus. On top of a loincloth, Pantheon wears dark jeans and boots to match. The top of his helmet has a plume with long and thick white fur.
structure.personality:
Stoic and unwavering, Atreus as Pantheon possesses a strong fighting spirit. As the stalwart defender of humanity, Pantheon often feels over-encumbered by his duties and his expectations as an Aspect. Despite his failings, he presses forward stubbornly, and he encourages all of his compatriots to do the same.

He is not very accepting of most god-like beings with immense powers, which include Aspects, Darkins, Ascendants, and demons alike. Given his own experience with War, Pantheon is hesitant in placing his trust with greater powers, preferring to rely on his own mortal will to fight his battles.
structure.abilities:
- **[Aspect Host Physiology:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aspect_Host "Aspect Host"):** Atreus has been chosen as the host of the 5 [Aspect of the War](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Warrior "LoR:The Warrior"), empowering him with celestial magic correspondent with the Aspect's role. In Atreus case, he's been chosen by the Aspect of War. Unlike other Hosts thought, Atreus and the Aspect's personality have not merged, but the Aspect seized the right to control. After Aatrox killed the Aspect, Atreus took back control of his body.
  - **Enhanced Physical Power:** The ascension into an Aspect has greatly increased Atreus strength, resistance and durability to superhuman levels, far above any mortal.
  - **Celestial Magic:** Pantheon can call forth the power of the stars to increase the power of his attacks.
- **Weapon Proficiency:** Pantheon has weapons that he carries with him at all times that help him in battle.
  - **Spear:** Pantheon is gifted with the use of the spear. The spear that he wields is imbued with his celestial magic, making it stronger, more durable, and able to fly back to him in battle.
  - **Shield:** Like his spear, Pantheon's shield is imbued with his celestial magic, making it much more durable.

relations.relationship_description: Pylas was Atreus' childhood friend which he deeply respected. Both would climb [Mount Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mount_Targon "Mount Targon") after the Aspect of the Sun[[1]](#cite_note-1) denied their pleas to fight invading barbarians, with only Atreus surviving the climb.

3 [Iula](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Iula "LoR:Iula") was the wife of Pylas. Inspired by the actions of her husband and Atreus, she would take up a spear and fight for the mortals of Targon against foes such as 6 [Camphor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Camphor,_the_Doubt "LoR:Camphor, the Doubt"). [Years later](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/In_Battle,_Broken "In Battle, Broken"), Iula would remind a broken Atreus of his purpose, reigniting his determination and warrior's spirit.
Atreus would fight Leona while trying to reach the peak of Mount Targon.

5 [The Pantheon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Warrior "LoR:The Warrior") is the Targonian Celestial Aspect of War, a being that (uncommon among Aspects) completely possessed the body of the current host, Atreus. After the death of the Aspect at the hands of  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox"), Atreus would be freed from the aspects control. He would briefly be controlled by a resurrected Aspect during the events of the Ruination. Atreus resents The Warrior for his arrogance towards mortals, an opinion that has shaped most of Atreus' viepoints towards god-like beings. He now prides in the power and resilience of mortals, and opposes the greater powers that threaten the world.

Aatrox is instrumental in killing the Aspect that has shackled Atreus since his ascension. Atreus would survive this encounter (with a scar gowing down his chest as a constant reminder), later succeeding in his second fight against the Darkin Blade, reigniting the Aspect's power.

Atreus inspired many mortals to fight in order to protect others, one of which is 1 [Tor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Saga_Seeker "LoR:Saga Seeker"), a saga seeker that would eventually fight against a demon known as Camphor.

Atreus inspired many mortals to fight in order to protect others, one of which is 4 [Eshiyme](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Blinded_Mystic "LoR:Blinded Mystic"), a revered oracle that was blinded by the demon Camphor, which she would eventually fight against.

6 [Camphor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Camphor,_the_Doubt "LoR:Camphor, the Doubt") was a demon who stalked the lands of Targon for centuries, using the people very own doubt as a tool against them. Atreus and a group of warriors would eventually confront this demon and fight her until she was slain.
Atreus and dozens of Ra'Horak fought against Xerath in [Nerimazeth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nerimazeth "Nerimazeth").

Atreus fought and was defeated by Viego, who resurrected the Aspect of War and subsumed Atreus. He was eventually freed from Viego and the Aspect's control after the Ruined King was defeated with the aid of  [Diana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Diana "Universe:Diana") and the rest of the  [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sentinels_of_Light "Universe:Sentinels of Light").

structure.trivia:
Pantheon, the Unbreakable Spear

- Pantheon is a [Rakkor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rakkor "Rakkor") warrior named Atreus, whose body was possessed by the [Aspect](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aspect "Aspect") of War before being slain by  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox"). Atreus was able to resurface after the Aspect had died.
  - The card 5 [The Warrior](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Warrior "LoR:The Warrior") depicts the Aspect in Atreus' body.
- Pantheon dedicates himself to the protection of mortals against the Darkin, Aspects, and others with great power.
- Pantheon wields the armor and weapons of the previous hosts to the Aspect of War. They were imbued with celestial magic and became holy objects before the Aspect of War was killed.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
  - His spear is named Skyfall and was used by a host named Areion.
  - His shield is named Aegis and was used by a host named Zeonia.
  - His cloak is named Solstice and was used by a host named Astraea.
  - His helmet is named Nova and is used by his current host, Atreus.
- According to Rioters who worked on Pantheon, he stands at 5’9, or 175.25 cm.
- Pantheon's current host shares the same name with Atreus from the God of War series.[[1]](https://godofwar.fandom.com/wiki/Atreus)

Pantheon, the Artisan of War

- Pantheon is the paragon of Rakkor warriors who looks down on people of [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Valoran "Valoran") for installing an organization to replace war and joins the [Institute of War](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Institute_of_War "Institute of War") to show the world a true warrior.

structure.background: This unearthly horror is a monstrous creature that looms in the darkest pits beneath the Shadow Isles. The true origin of  [Vilemaw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vilemaw "Vilemaw") is completely unknown, save for the assumption that the voracious spider god is an otherworldly life-form not originally from the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles").[[1]](#cite_note-1)
structure.appearance: Resembling a spider whose grotesque mass is furred and scabbed with wet, mutant growths. Adorned with venomous fangs and colossal legs used to heave its corrupt body.
structure.personality: *(TBA)*
structure.abilities: - **Immense Physical and Magical Strength**: It has great physical and magical, being able to transfigure  [willing humans](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Elise "Elise") into its servants. It uses its servants to gather fresh food.

relations.relationship_description: [Elise](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Elise "Elise") worships and aids Vilemaw.

structure.trivia:
- The mythical spider god mentioned in  [Elise's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Elise "Elise") lore is **Vilemaw**.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
  - She however also said that as well as  [Baron Nashor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Baron_Nashor "Baron Nashor"), Vilemaw is supremely more powerful in the actual lore than in the game, far more powerful than any champion - or a lot of champions - alone, much like an actual god.
  - Vilemaw is based on [mythological spider gods](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cultural_depictions_of_spiders), like the [Akan](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Akan_people)'s [Anansi](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anansi), Lakota's [Iktomi](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iktomi), Nordic *Loptr* "lofty one = flea > spider" [Loki](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loki)'s epithet, etc.
  - Despite being perceived as male, Vilemaw's body plan is peculiarly feminine, with robust abdomen & his two foremost front-limbs lacking the masculine [palpal bulb](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/palpal_bulb) to inseminate females.

structure.name: Kayn
structure.quote: *"The child is gone. The killer remains."*
structure.background:
### Early life

[Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") by birth, Shieda Kayn was conscripted as a child soldier like many others. When he was no more than ten, he and his comrades were ordered to attack the province of [Bahrl](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Bahrl "Bahrl") in  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"). He and other young soldiers made up the vanguard of the attack. While Kayn’s young comrades fled or were cut down by the defenders before the Noxian regulars came in from the flank, Kayn showed no fear and survived to see the end of the battle.

[Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") and his followers arrived on the battleground two days later. There, they found Kayn on the ground, leveling a sickle at Zed. The Master of Shadows saw potential in the boy and welcomed him into the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow").

After joining the order, the young Kayn was given food and a home to stay. Growing up training as an acolyte of the order, Kayn was able to master all the weapons given to him while other acolytes spent years training with a single weapon. By drinking the Tears of the Shadow, Kayn gained the ability to cloak himself in the shadows to stealthily assassinate enemies. He was able to spread fear among the survivors through his swift kills, using fear as his weapon. As Kayn's power and reputation grew, he gained hubristic ambitions that one day he could be more powerful than even Zed.

### Wielding [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast")

:   *Main article: [The Blade of Millenia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Blade_of_Millenia "The Blade of Millenia")*

Kayn was later sent on a mission to Noxus as his final test: to procure a  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin") scythe recently uncovered in the Noxian city of [Vindor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vindor "Vindor") to stop the weapon from being used against the Ionians. Accompanied by his fellow acolyte Nakuri, he used his shadow magic to sneak up on the three guards defending the noxtoraa, killing two of them before intimidating the last one, whom was killed by Nakuri. After killing several more Noxian soldiers, Kayn approached the weapon where he heard the Darkin  [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast") call to him from within the scythe. One of the Noxians snatched the scythe in desperation, and began to swing it uncontrollably at his comrades as Rhaast's corruption took over. Realizing that the legends were true, Kayn, using a shadow technique, possessed the soldier's body, where he witnessed the atrocities that Rhaast inflicted over millennia. However, instead of destroying it as ordered, he was tempted to wield the Darkin for himself. Ignoring Nakuri's pleas, Kayn took hold of Rhaast and underwent the same corruption, but Kayn was able to resist his will and control his enhanced power. After a final struggle against Nakuri, Kayn killed his fellow acolyte. Since then, Kayn now duels Rhaast over control over his own body, until one of them wins and seizes control.

### Future Scenarios

*These scenarios are not canon to the official timeline, but future possibilities that have been hinted at in the lore and gameplay.*

- Should Kayn fully overcome Rhaast, he will take full control of the scythe's powers, unlocking his full potential as the  Shadow Assassin.
- Should  [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast") overpower Kayn, he will completely assimilate Kayn's body and wield the scythe for himself, using his new body to resume his killing and bloodshed across  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra"). He also hints that Kayn's consciousness has been trapped in the same dimension where he was sealed.
structure.appearance:
Kayn is a young man with a thin, muscular build. He has black hair with a blue streak at the right side and a long braid on the back. He wears nothing but large, baggy pants with a rope around it and leather boots. Due to Rhaast's partial assimilation, his left arm has become bright red muscle with grey plating covering his shoulder, left pectoral and left eye. However, the Darkin's corruption recedes when Kayn is not actively wielding the scythe and he bandages his left arm.[[1]](#cite_note-1) He has a blue tattoo spiraling around his right wrist. His right eye has a yellow iris, while his corrupted left eye has a dark red sclera and a glowing red iris.

As the  Shadow Assassin, he now has pale white skin, glowing pupilless eyes and lacks the corruption on his body. He has dark blue tattoos on his eyes, torso and arms. His braided hair has been replaced with long-flowing hair with a larger blue streak.
structure.personality: Molded by Noxian brutality and tempered in the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"), Kayn carries a deep-seated resentment towards authority while harboring an unwavering confidence in his own abilities. His fearless demeanor masks a simmering anger and a burning desire to prove himself superior, both to his enemies and his mentors. Kayn's arrogance fuels his relentless pursuit of power, driving him to defy tradition and embrace the forbidden allure of the darkin,  [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast"). Yet, beneath his bravado lies a cunning intellect and a calculating nature, always seeking the most advantageous path towards dominating over both his foes and his destiny.
structure.abilities:
- **Weapon Prodigy:** During his training in the Order of Shadow, Kayn was able to master all weapons available to him with ease, whereas most of his fellow acolytes took years to master one weapon.
- **[Shadow Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kayn#Shadow_Step "Kayn"):** Kayn has been empowered with the powers of the Tears of The Shadow, greatly enhancing his abilities, and letting him control the shadows to his wishes.
  - **Intangibility:** Kayn can turn his body into shadow, allowing him to pass through walls.
  - **Shadow Cloning:** Upon becoming the Shadow Assassin, Kayn is able to create shadowy clones of himself to attack.
  - **Possession:** Kayn can temporarily possess others using his shadow magic. He was shown to have possessed a Noxian soldier's body prior to his corruption from Rhaast.
- **[Darkin Weapon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kayn#Reaping_Slash "Kayn"):** Having taken the [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin")  [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast") as a weapon and resisted the Darkin's will, Kayn's physical and magical atributes were greatly enhanced.
  - **[Hemomancy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kayn#The_Darkin_Scythe_R "Kayn")**: Due to the Darkin Rhaast's power, Kayn also gained access to Blood Magic.
- **Resistant Will:** Kayn has a strong will which allows him to resist being taken over by Rhaast, and even allows him to fully overcome Rhaast in order to become the Shadow Assassin. However, his will cannot stop the possibility of him losing the battle against Rhaast.

relations.relationship_description: When Kayn was a child soldier, Zed saw the potential within him and recruited him to be a part of his order, feeding him and giving him a home. Kayn became Zed's favorite and most loyal disciple, trusting him enough to confide valuable information and hoping that Kayn would become the new leader of the Order of Shadow if something were to happen to him. Kayn refused to betray him when Kusho urged him to, because of how he saved him from a hopeless fate and gave him a new purpose in life. Despite his loyalty, Kayn's growing arrogance led him to believe that with Rhaast's power, he would even surpass Zed one day.

Kayn sees his wieldership of Rhaast as being his destiny, risking the Darkin's corruption to unlock his true potential. While Rhaast tries to manipulate him into embracing violence, Kayn defies him just as easily. They both fight against each other over control of his body, with Kayn intending to fully overpower Rhaast and claim his power for himself.
Kayn, along with Zed and other members of the Order of Shadow, were attacked by Jhin.
Kayn may have a crush on Akali. She knows Kayn and finds him hot but too crazy for her taste.
Kusho manipulated Kayn into serving him and ordered him to kill Zed, but Kayn remained loyal to Zed due to the latter being his mentor whom gave him his new purpose in life.
Royce sympathizes with Kayn due to them both growing up as child soldiers of Noxus, considering Kayn as a "brother in blood".

Kayn fought against Master Yi and his Wuju disciples to obtain the 1 [The Darkin Bloodletters](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Bloodletters "LoR:The Darkin Bloodletters") that they were guarding.

structure.trivia:
- Kayn is around 20 years old.
  - He was 'no more than 10' when  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") had taken him in into the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow").
- Rhaast is between 3496 and 4396 years old.
- The blue streak in Kayn's hair is the result of using Rhaast.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
- In [Zed: Issue 6](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zed:_Issue_6 "Zed: Issue 6") it is revealed that  [Rhaast's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast") corruption of Kayn's left arm is able to be reverted back to normal by either Rhaast's or Kayn's will.
- Kayn appears to be left-handed.

structure.name: Chross
structure.background:
### Early Life

Although he was born and raised in Piltover, Chross decided to move to  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") after he realized that his skillset and personality worked better in the undercity. At some point after  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") took over the undercity, Chross made a name for himself as the boss of the  [Hush Company](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Hush_Company "Universe:The Hush Company"), an illicit enterprise that specialized in surveillance, and became affiliated with several other crime lords who were also loyal to Silco,[[1]](#cite_note-conspiracy-1) creating the first generation of  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons").[[2]](#cite_note-107boy-2)

### Double Crossed

At one point, one of his most infamous hitmen, Nero Eso, was apprehended by enforcers. Because he was captured by someone other than Silco's upper city asset,  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus"), the hitman was interrogated, though he refused to give any substantial information on him and Silco. Nero was apparently ordered by Silco to leave Progress Day pins at the sites of his hits as a reminder to Chross of his origins. Another enforcer,  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"), found the records of this and kept it as part of an ongoing investigation into the underground's hidden  [mastermind](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") and his  [mole](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus") in Piltover.[[1]](#cite_note-conspiracy-1)

### Border Crisis

After the actions of  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), Silco's adoptive daughter, led  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") to shut down the border between Zaun and  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), trade between the two cities came to a sudden halt, causing Chross' criminal ventures to lose massive profits. Frustrated by the fact that Silco was doing nothing to keep Jinx under control, Chross and the other chem-barons scheduled an assembly to discuss their next move, in which  [Finn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Finn "Universe:Finn") attempted to convince him to join him in a coup against Silco. However, before he could give Finn an answer, Silco arrived on the scene and unleashed a toxic gas in the air to remind the barons of the oppressive life that he had saved them from, which was enough to convince Chross to fall back in line.[[2]](#cite_note-107boy-2)

### Turf War Period

After the deaths of Silco, Finn, and  [Renni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni"), a massive power vacuum opened across each of their former territories, and sensing opportunity, the three remaining chembarons—Chross,  [Margot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Margot "Universe:Margot"), and  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech")—began vying to expand their holdings and seize control of the undercity at the expense of each other. Chross sent his army of chemgoons to fight Margot in particular, and some of his men began chasing down  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha") before being killed by Jinx.

After it became clear the turf wars were only leading to more casualties,  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") called an assembly of the three chembarons in an attempt to convince them to unite against an impending invasion from topside; a direct result of Jinx's recent attack on the Piltover Council. Chross and Margot refused to work together, and Smeech argued that the best solution to appease topside was to hand over Jinx instead of fighting back.[[3]](#cite_note-202watch-3)

Smeech's plan to get topside off their backs failed, and after his death, a strike team led by  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") completely dismantled the criminal enterprises of both Chross and Margot, stripping them both of their chembaron status.[[4]](#cite_note-203finally-4)
structure.appearance: Chross is a tall, elderly man with pale, wrinkled skin and a fine dark coat with gold trimming over a gray vest and a fancy green shirt. He wears many earrings along with small wiry glasses with dark, circular lenses, and a wide-brimmed hat on his head. He is always seen sitting in a purple and brown metal wheelchair. Telephone iconography is present in his appearance, with telephone-shaped tattoo on the top of his forehead, number tattoos on his fingers, and an old rotary phone dial being worn over his vest like a brooch.
structure.personality: Chross had a calm and collected demeanor, but was known for being incredibly clever and ruthless, as well as excellent at keeping his henchmen "honest." He was also shown to be an organized and logical businessman who was good with numbers, weighing the odds of victory to be slim should the chembarons engage in an armed conflict against topside. Despite being born a Piltovan, Chross came to the undercity because his skill set was well-suited to business opportunities in the undercity, and his henchmen all believed him to be a true Zaunite at heart.[[1]](#cite_note-conspiracy-1)[[3]](#cite_note-202watch-3)
structure.abilities: - **Leader:** As a chembaron and leader of the  [Hush Company](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Hush_Company "Universe:The Hush Company"), Chross was able to dramatically expand his influence as a crime lord under  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") leadership of the undercity.

relations.relationship_description: Chross and Silco established a business relationship during his rise as leader of the undercity, and Chross would rise to become one of Silco's top lieutenants along with four other  [chembarons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chembarons "Universe:Chembarons"). Chross' enterprise thrived under Silco's leadership, but Silco was also not above using fear to keep his lieutenants in line, gassing Chross and the other chembarons with toxic smog before offering them all gas masks when they appeared to be conspiring against him. After Silco's death, Chross tried unsuccessfully to seize Silco's chair for himself in a series of turf wars.

Sevika was often present with  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") at the chembaron assemblies, and Chross was familiar with her. After Silco's death, Sevika tried unsuccessfully to convince Chross,  [Margot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Margot "Universe:Margot"), and  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech") to end their turf wars and unite against topside. Chross rejected Sevika's proposal, as topside outnumbered them four-to-one even if they were to unite their forces.

Chross had a contentious relationship with Margot and Smeech, calling them "aggressors" against his interests, while also looking down on Margot's Rapturewalk as a "boulevard of filth." In reality, all three chembarons were interested in taking  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") chair for themselves, and Chross sent his henchmen to expand his holdings at their expense.

Caitlyn ran an investigation into Chross early in her career as an enforcer as she was working to uncover  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") underground criminal conspiracy.[[1]](#cite_note-conspiracy-1) Later in her life, she and her strike team defeated Chross and his henchmen using the Grey, ending his reign as one of the  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons").

structure.quote: *"I have learned enough to detest all men. Only nations may be revered."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Jericho Swain was born into an affluent Noxian family, among the established houses that trace shortly after the nation's founding. They were also favored by the emperor of Noxus― [Boram Darkwill](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boram_Darkwill "Universe:Boram Darkwill")―having been instrumental in his rise to the throne.[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1)

Yet House Swain was also among many that hungered for power, and as such were part of a secret cabal called the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"). His parents were especially intent on finding some dark power hidden in the depths of the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Immortal_Bastion "The Immortal Bastion"), that which eluded discovery for many years as it cackled in the darkness like a raven's caw.[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1)

Though the cabal had aided Darkwill's political rise, they began to plot against him after he refused their counsel. Swain was informed of their conspiracy by  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), herself the secret matriarch of the organization,[[2]](#cite_note-LBio-2) and he revealed the cult and executed its most prominent members, including his own parents[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1) and LeBlanc herself.[[2]](#cite_note-LBio-2) For exposing this corruption, Swain was granted a commission in the Noxian army, where he would serve for years to come.[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1)

### Discovery of Raum

Swain learned firsthand that the empire's true strength was upheld not by pure Noxian ferocity, but by all its people united in spite of their origins. Nobles and foreign slaves alike were all seen as soldiers on the front lines. Swain carved out his career in securing the western borders, as well as expanding into  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"). But in time, the aging emperor grew more paranoid and unhinged over his own mortality. Fighting wars on too many fronts, lusting over magical relics; greed became the clear motivation of the regime.[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1)

During the invasion of  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), Darkwill retasked many of the warbands to hunt for artifacts that could extend a mortal's lifespan. Swain's forces were soon depleted and it became nearly impossible to engage the enemy.[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1) However, Swain still managed to capture the [Placidium of Navori](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Placidium_of_Navori "Universe:The Placidium of Navori") and took its defenders hostage, hoping to lure in Ionian reinforcements. A young girl,  [Irelia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Irelia "Universe:Irelia"), led the resistance to take back the Placidium. Using her ancient blade dancing technique, she cut down many of Swain's veterans and struck down the general himself, taking his arm.[[3]](#cite_note-3)

What should have been a successful ambush, turned into a failure as his troops were eventually overrun. With his knee shattered and his arm severed, Swain was on the verge of death. He felt a familiar darkness press upon him again as a  raven approached to feed, but he refused to let it take him. Staring into the bird's eyes, he saw a vision of the evil strangling the heart of Noxus: a black rose, a pale woman, and her puppet emperor. Swain realized that he had failed to defeat the cabal from his youth and that they had seduced Darkwill into betraying him. Knowing this vision came from more than just a raven, Swain suspected this was the dark power that his parents once searched for.[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1)

Returning to Noxus, Swain was discharged for his failure in Ionia[[4]](#cite_note-Darius-4) and was regarded as nothing more than a cripple. Despite his fragile state, Swain ventured into the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion")[[2]](#cite_note-LBio-2) in search of the strange power, that which cackled in the darkness like a raven's caw. What he found was Raum, an ancient entity that preyed on the dying and consumed their secrets. But the man solved a puzzle that not even the demon could have anticipated: a way to wield its power.[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1)

### Establishment of the Trifarix

Using the demon's magic, Swain was able to heal himself. Over the course of many years, Swain began to plot his revenge against Darkwill.[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1) Among the people he allied himself with was  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven"), a washed-up gladiator and the brother of the current Hand of Noxus,  [Darius](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darius "Universe:Darius").[[5]](#cite_note-Draven-5) Swain also counted General  [Marcus Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau"), the empire's greatest assassin, an ally as well.[[6]](#cite_note-Kat1-6)

When the time came, Swain and his allies seized control of Noxus in a single night.[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1) He slew Darkwill using magic that had never been seen before so that all of Noxus could bear witness.[[6]](#cite_note-Kat1-6) As part of his coup, Swain lured  [Urgot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Urgot "Universe:Urgot") to  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") to ensure that he didn't aid the emperor.[[7]](#cite_note-7)

The Black Rose attempted to stop Swain's coup by unleashing their living weapons against him, even their barely controlled homunculus  [Briar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Briar "Universe:Briar"). Despite slaughtering everyone in her path, including her handler, Swain managed to escape. Eventually, Swain's guards were able to activate her pillory to restrain her, allowing them to detain her.[[8]](#cite_note-8)

In the aftermath of Swain's coup, General  [Darius](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darius "Universe:Darius") returned to Noxus from a long campaign in the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord"). As the Hand of Noxus, many expected him to avenge Darkwill. However, Darius greatly respected Swain and his duty as the Hand was to serve Noxus, not any one ruler.[[4]](#cite_note-Darius-4) Swain met with Darius, and he was satisfied with the coup against Darkwill and Swain's vision for the future of Noxus. Instead of seizing the throne, Swain wanted to ensure that no one ruler, not even himself, could ever corrupt Noxus. Thus, he established a triumvirate called the Trifarix to rule the empire. Each seat was held by a representative of one of the three guiding Noxian principles: Vision, embodied by Swain himself; Might, embodied by Darius; and Guile, embodied by the elusive "Faceless".[[9]](#cite_note-Proc-9)

This council was made so that no one man could rule Noxus, and if one were to divert from the foundations of strength that Noxus was built on, the other two would be able to keep them in check.[[10]](#cite_note-PoS-10) Moreover, this insurance would also serve as a counterbalance to Swain should he ever fall to the demon's corruption.

Swain immediately pulled back the Noxian forces from Darkwill's untenable ventures.[[1]](#cite_note-SwainBio-1) He also held conventions with the noble houses, detailing his plans for the empire. A number of them honored his coup[[11]](#cite_note-11) and he pardoned those that swore fealty, but many others did not and were allowed to leave the empire[[9]](#cite_note-Proc-9) or were sent to the arena to be executed by  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven").[[5]](#cite_note-Draven-5) A large part of the dissent was over the new policies that grated traditional power systems such as inherited lordship, personal wealth, and ownership of human property.[[9]](#cite_note-Proc-9)

Under the Trifarix's rule, the empire changed its philosophy regarding those they conquered. Rather than crushing those weaker than them, Noxus began to assimilate the nations they conquered. They believed that their diverse talents strengthened the empire, and in turn the empire would support their reconstruction. However, there were still those who clung to the old ways and opposed Swain's vision.[[6]](#cite_note-Kat1-6)

Shortly after the Trifarix ended the invasion of  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), General  [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") headed to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") to investigate a new invention called [Hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech"), and the Black Rose follower her.[[12]](#cite_note-12) Swain dispatched his ravens to keep an eye on them and observed what ensued in the Twin Cities.[[13]](#cite_note-13)

### The Black Powder Plot

:   *Main article: [The Black Powder Plot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Black_Powder_Plot "The Black Powder Plot")*

Secessionists held the mineral-rich [Rokrund Plains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rokrund_Plains "Rokrund Plains"), crafting explosives that deterred Noxian forces from advancing. This prompted Swain to visit the campaign generals and discuss strategy. One of these was General  [Brannin Granth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Brannin_Granth "Brannin Granth"), a secret operative of the Black Rose that plotted to kill Swain. Within the meeting, he proclaimed that the battle was unwinnable without death and revealed an explosive fuse ready to blow. Swain chuckled at the profound suggestion, agreeing that while the soldiers may die anyway, their sacrifice makes way for a greater reinforcement. He then reveals his demon arm and quickly strangles Granth. "Granth and I... we always look for what must be sacrificed in order to win."[[14]](#cite_note-14)

### The Delverhold Affair

:   *Main article: [The Principles of Strength](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Principles_of_Strength "The Principles of Strength")*

Seven years into the Trifarix rule, delegates Oram and Alyssa from [the Delverhold](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Delverhold "The Delverhold") approached the council to negotiate concessions in response to a local crisis. The mineral export quotas became unsustainable with the dwindling reserves in the Ironspike mines, sinking the people into poverty. Furthermore, Oram argued that their treaty to the empire had been invalidated with the death of the emperor, which permits the Delverhold to extricate from the empire if necessary. While Swain agreed to hear the terms, Darius argued that there was no compelling bargain.[[10]](#cite_note-PoS-10)

Some days go by, and the delegates attempted to seize and extort the Faceless One for their vote. But in a deceptive trap, Oram is killed by Alyssa and she is quickly captured by the guards. She is brought before the Trifarix, whom were fully aware of the extortion, but recognize her disaffection in the Delverhold. Swain candidly stated that the Trifarix did not want to encourage other provinces to make demands as well. Alyssa said that she knew the Delverhold governor would use the delegates' deaths to justify secession, but returning Delverhold to the kingdom rule would be a grave mistake long-term. She then suggested to become governor herself in order to maintain relations with Noxus. The council agree to the idea and sent a Trifarian entourage with her back to Delverhold to claim office.[[10]](#cite_note-PoS-10)

### Assassinating Jarvan III

:   *Main article: [Katarina Comic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina:_Issue_1 "Universe:Katarina: Issue 1")*

Four years after the coup against Darkwill,[[6]](#cite_note-Kat1-6) Swain dispatched General  [Marcus Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau") to infiltrate  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") and assassinate King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), leading him to fake his own death.[[15]](#cite_note-Kat2-15) In the three years that followed, Marcus's daughter,  [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina"), took up work for Swain, assassinating his political opponents, and began to earn his favor.[[6]](#cite_note-Kat1-6) However, Swain learned that Marcus had been compromised, and decided to replace him with Katarina as the king's assassin and marked Marcus as her secondary target. In an attempt to turn Katarina against him, Marcus intercepted his orders and revealed himself to his daughter, claiming that Swain had fallen to the demon's corruption. Meanwhile, Swain observed her through the eyes of his ravens.[[15]](#cite_note-Kat2-15)

Katarina remained loyal to Swain's vision for Noxus and was betrayed by her father after assassinating the king.[[16]](#cite_note-16) When she returned to Noxus, Katarina sought to protect the Grand General from her father after he shrouded himself from his sight with the aid of the Black Rose. Marcus planned to detonate wolf's maw explosive within Swain's vicinity, but Katarina was able to wrench it from his grasp. Unable to disarm it, Katarina planned to hurl it, and herself, far enough away to save Noxus. Before she could act, Swain seized the explosive and destroyed it and Marcus with a single blast.[[17]](#cite_note-Kat5-17)

Swain apologized for arriving so late, explaining that he had been unable to sense Marcus, though he was able to see Katarina. He admitted that he was no longer the same man he once was, but argued that this was precisely why Noxus needed an assassin like Katarina, someone capable of reaching even him in case he fell to the demon's corruption. Swain thanked Katarina for her service to the empire and told her that she had earned his trust, to which Katarina assured him that she knew exactly how to kill him. In the aftermath, Swain named Katarina the new head of the Du Couteau assassins guild.[[17]](#cite_note-Kat5-17)
structure.appearance: Swain is a fair skinned man with long, white hair. He wears black armor, black pants, and a black coat. His left arm was restored with the power of Raum, and consequently glows a shade of red.
structure.personality: Swain is cold and calculating, often seeing people's lives as pieces in a bigger game. He is a master tactician and general, able to predict his enemies' next move with his cunning intellect and win battles swiftly and efficiently. Swain does not often act in his own interests, rather doing whatever is best for Noxus, as he knows that the empire is much more important than him, and he is committed to returning it back to its foundations and making sure that it outlasts him.
structure.abilities:
- **[Demonic Bonding](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Swain#Vision_of_Empire "Swain"):** After being defeated in battle, Swain made a pact with  [Raum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Swain#Vision_of_Empire "Swain"), the [Demon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Demon "Demon") of Secrets. This granted him several new powers that very few can match.
  - **Emotional Feeding:** Like other Demons, Raum can feed himself from a specific emotion, in this case, secrets. By absorbing the secrets of others, Raum, and by extension Swain, can sustain themselves for prolonged periods of time. Swain also gains knowledge from these secrets and can use this knowledge for his own benefit.
    - **Life Draining:** The Secrets that Swain collects come in the form of Soul Fragments. Taking a soul Fragment from someone drains them of their energy and gives it to Swain. By doing so Swain can heal himself and strengthen his powers.
  - **Extended Awareness:** Swain has heightened senses, meaning that he can perceive and sense things that few else can. He can see things from far away and perceive supernatural powers that no others can notice.
    - **[Demon Ravens](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Swain#Ravenous_Flock "Swain"):** Swain can summon several demonic Ravens that are connected to his mind. He can use them as a way to gather intelligence and spy on people.
  - **Demonic Energy:** Swain can manipulate powerful dark energies to his liking. Those dark energies come from Raum, and depend on how strong Raum himself is.
    - **Energy blasts:** Swain can summon powerful eldritch blasts.
    - **Limbs Creation:** Swain can create limbs for himself such as hands and wings.

relations.relationship_description: Irelia cut off Swain's left arm during the Battle of the Placidium.

Swain and Darius are two of the three heads of the Trifarix of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), embodying the Noxian values of Vision and Might respectively, along with The Faceless One, who embodies Guile. Prior to the establishment of the Trifarix, Darius greatly respected Swain and argued against his discharge from the army.

When audiences for the [Reckoning arenas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Reckoners "Reckoners") waned and Draven fell into a drunk stupor, Swain found him and offered him a role in his coup against Boram Darkwill. He became integral to Swain's plan to kill Darkwill. He is considered a close ally by Swain and executed the remaining the dissenting houses after the esablishment of the Trifarix.

Katarina serves as an assassin for the Trifarix council, killing people at their command. She earned Swain's trust after she stopped her father from assassinating him and is tasked by Swain with eliminating him should he fall to the demon's corruption.

Urgot was sent away from  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") to  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") as a part of Swain's coup, as he was seen as a liability and a potential threat to Swain's plan.
Gangplank stole The Leviathan, Swain's personal warship and the head of the Noxian fleet. Because of this, Swain despises Gangplank and wishes to see his demise.

Swain is enemies with the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"). The organization is currently trying to either control Swain or kill him in order to take the throne from him. Swain knows this and is trying to take down the organization, but knows that it is unlikely that he will accomplish this goal.

#### [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc")

Swain considers LeBlanc, the head matriarch of the Black Rose, as his rival. Swain and LeBlanc's personal relationship is vague, and they may have been lovers at some point.[[18]](#cite_note-18) When Boram Darkwill first took the throne and refused help from the Black Rose, LeBlanc, unbeknownst to Swain, manipulated Swain into revealing the Black Rose and making it look like she was executed and the Black Rose was dead.[[19]](#cite_note-19)

#### [Sion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion")

Swain obtained Sion from the Black Rose after the organization left Sion in his own tomb for years. Swain now uses him as a living weapon to use against his enemies.

Vladimir has recently brought himself back into the public eye, becoming a vocal opponent against the Trifarix Council, and this has caught Swain's attention. However, Vladimir's previous public identity has not been completely forgotten, and it is hinted that Swain may know of Vladimir's true nature.

structure.trivia:
**Swain, the Noxian Grand General**

- His Demon of Secrets is named Raum as noted by  [Fiddlesticks](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fiddlesticks "Universe:Fiddlesticks").[[20]](#cite_note-20)
  - In real-life *"demonology"*, [Raum](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raum) is stated to be a Great Earl of Hell, ruling thirty legions of demons. He is depicted as a crow which adopts human form at the request of the conjurer.
- Swain's *Trifarix Council* was probably based on the Roman [Triumvirate](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triumvirate), Swain being the Leader of Vision;
  - Possibly based on [Latin](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Classical_latin) *trifārius* "in three parts~places" (cf. Sanskrit cognate त्रिधा *tridhā*), from PIE [*\*tri-*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Reconstruction:Proto-Indo-European/tri-)[*dʰóh₁-*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Reconstruction:Proto-Indo-European/d%CA%B0eh%E2%82%81-).[[21]](#cite_note-21)
- The *[Black Powder Plot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Swain#The_Black_Powder_Plot "Swain")* to assassinate Swain references the [Gun Powder Plot](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gun_Powder_Plot) by English Catholics to blow up [King James I](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_VI_and_I) and the [House of Lords](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House_of_Lords).
- Swain likes to play a [vastayan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") strategy game called Xa'h, which is similar to chess.[[22]](#cite_note-22)
- One of the reasons that the Trifarix was made was because Swain knows that either his demon or his ambitions may potentially overwhelm him and would have to be stopped.[[23]](#cite_note-23)
- The six-eyed ravens around him are not actual ravens but rather manifestations of his demonic power.[[24]](#cite_note-24)
- As revealed in  [Rell's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rell "Universe:Rell") [live Q&A](https://youtu.be/ukA99Hx9EJw):
  - Swain has neglected the power vacuums left behind from his motions to dismantle the previous Noxian government. He was very well aware of the Black Rose academy that  [Rell](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rell "Universe:Rell") was training in, but did not intervene.
  - Swain knows almost all secrets, the ones he has difficulty knowing are those predating Raum (his demon).
  - He knows about [World Runes](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/World_Rune "World Rune"), but not where they've been hidden by  [Ryze](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ryze "Universe:Ryze").
  - Swain is aware of most major threats around Runeterra thanks to his crows, but has decided to deal with them later over more immediate ones.
  - Swain and  [Aurelion Sol](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aurelion_Sol "Universe:Aurelion Sol") are tied for most knowledge about the universe,  [Zoe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zoe "Universe:Zoe") comes very close.
- His crow of his demon Raum, Beatrice, appeared briefly from the  [Arcane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series) "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)") series.

**Swain, the Master Tactician**

- Swain was a member of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"), a dark and mysterious group that controlled Noxus before the rise of the military government. They were thought to no longer exist. However, with the reemergence of their leader  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), the Black Rose are working towards getting the organization back into power.
- During the War of [Kalamanda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kalamanda "Kalamanda"),  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") and his Dauntless Vanguard hindered the progress of Swain and his army's advancement at every turn.
- Swain and  [Jarvan IV](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV"), have a deep, hate-filled rivalry. He has attempted to kill Jarvan IV on several occasions.
  - It is theorized he fought LeBlanc impersonating Jarvan in order to trigger a war with  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia").
- Swain is a fan of  [Sona](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sona "Universe:Sona").
- As a nod to his old lore, Swain has a raven named  [Beatrice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Beatrice "Beatrice").[[25]](#cite_note-25) (< Latin *beatrix* "she who gladdens")
