structure.name: Aurora
structure.quote: *"I see the spirit realm and material realm simultaneously. This blended world is my own, and it's beautiful."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

#### Childhood

Aurora was born in the secluded village of [Aamu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aamu "Aamu") as a member of a [vastayan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") tribe known as the Bryni, a secluded tribe of rabbit-like vastaya that remained isolated from other vastayan tribes, causing their inherent magic to be more diluted.[[1]](#cite_note-Insights-1) Aurora was born with the innate ability to interact much more closely with the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm"), making many 'friends' that only she could see. Aurora's parents believed this to just be her wild imagination, but Aurora's great aunt Havu actually encouraged her unique abilities and passions, allowing her to revel in her own company.[[2]](#cite_note-Bio-2)

As Aurora grew up, she started to understand her ability more, realizing these imaginary friends were actually [spirits](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit "Spirit") and that she had a special ability to peer through the veil between the mortal and spiritual realms. Using this special unique sight, Aurora meticulously documented and studied these spirits to help others understand the world as she saw it.[[2]](#cite_note-Bio-2)

#### Meeting Haestryr

While more and more spirits appeared before Aurora during her studies, she began to discover some that felt lost between the realms, disturbed by mortal affairs. Seeking to help these spirits return to the spirit realm, she continued her research outside of Aamu and began to travel further out of the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord"), nervously leaving her home behind to expand her knowledge on spirits and how to help them.[[2]](#cite_note-Bio-2)

During her travels, Aurora encountered a particularly monstrous spirit in the shape of a twisted elk. The spirit was feral and afraid, lashing out with bloodstained antlers while Aurora tried to calm him down. She eventually managed to gain his trust, but her attempts to heal and help him would only end in failure. Still determined to help the elk spirit, Aurora convinced him to travel with her and used her powers to tuck him away in the spirit realm while she worked to unravel what was afflicting the elk spirit.[[2]](#cite_note-Bio-2)

After encountering a number of powerful spirit walkers; shamans capable of communing with the spiritual demigods of the Freljord, they were simply at a loss at how to help the elk spirit and suggested that she sought out  [Udyr](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Udyr "Universe:Udyr"), the Freljord's most powerful spirit walker. Though Udyr immediately recognized the immense power in Aurora's new friend, he knew that the fearsome elk spirit was simply too lost to commune with and urged her to seek the demigods themselves for answers instead.[[2]](#cite_note-Bio-2)

### Befriending Ornn

:   *Main article: [The Spirit of Hearth-Home](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Spirit_of_Hearth-Home "The Spirit of Hearth-Home")*

Sometime between the [Founding of the Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Founding_of_the_Freljord "Founding of the Freljord") and the present, Aurora ventured into [Hearth-Home](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hearth-Home "Hearth-Home") seeking a way to help her new-found [Spirit](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit "Spirit") friend. When she approached  [Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn"), the Spirit of Hearth-Home, he dismissed her, claiming he was too busy to help. Undeterred, Aurora busied herself by tidying and reorganizing Hearth-Home, which greatly pleased Ornn.[[3]](#cite_note-Spirit-3)

Impressed by her efforts, Ornn apologized for his earlier brusqueness and revealed the location where Aurora could find information about her spirit friend, whose name was revealed to be  **[Haestryr](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hestrelk "Universe:Hestrelk")**. As a gesture of their new-found friendship, Ornn forged a wand for Aurora, granting her the ability to create portals at will.[[3]](#cite_note-Spirit-3)

Aurora eventually left [Hearth-Home](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hearth-Home "Hearth-Home") to seek answers about Haestryr, but she often returns to visit her grumpy friend Ornn and reminisce about the past.[[3]](#cite_note-Spirit-3)
structure.appearance:
Aurora is a slender, pale woman with a freckled face, blue eyes, and orange hair. As a [Vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya"), she possesses a mostly human appearance, apart from long, rabbit-like ears, legs, and tail, all adorned with her signature orange hair. Her freckles coalesce into orange splotches on some areas of her skin, including her shoulders and outer thighs.

She wears a pair of large, circular glasses and has a brass-colored piercing near the bottom of her right ear. Her usual outfit consists of a teal wide-brimmed witch hat, a white fur-lined coat over a teal and white sleeveless tunic, teal shorts, and brown thigh-high open-toed leather boots. She has also been seen draped in a large, dark teal, hooded winter cloak lined with beige fur. She carries a dark brown wooden wand with a brass-colored metal handle.
structure.personality: Aurora is a quiet young woman with a strong appetite for knowledge, though not to the point of obsession. She has a caring nature, evident by her actions, such as tidying up Hearth-Home despite Ornn's initial rejection. She is also determined to help Haestryr, even though they have only recently met.
structure.abilities:
- **[Vastayan Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya")**: Aurora is a vastaya, a race of demihumans transformed by the magic of the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm"). This connection to the Spirit Realm has increased their longevity and granted them powerful magics, allowing them to live for centuries. Aurora is a member of the Bryni, a leporine tribe of vastaya that resemble rabbits and are notably more isolated.
  - **[Spiritual Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aurora#Twofold_Hex "Aurora")**: Unlike the other Bryni, Aurora has a deep and strong connection with the Spirit Realm, being able to communicate with [Spirits](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit "Spirit") and clearly view the Spirit Realm from a young age. Overtime, Aurora has refined her magical skills, allowing her to manipulate spiritual energy in a variety of ways such as placing hexes on enemies to rip out a piece of their souls,  [blasting waves of energy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aurora#The_Weirding "Aurora"),  [exorcising Spirits](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aurora#Spirit_Abjuration "Aurora") and even fully fusing both the Spirit and [Material Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Runeterra "Runeterra") to create a  [rift.](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aurora#Between_Worlds "Aurora")
- **[Masterwork Wand:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aurora#Across_the_Veil "Aurora")** Aurora was gifted a powerful wand by the  [Freljordian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") [Demi-God](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/God "God")  [Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn"), famous for crafting legendary items and weapons. This wand enhances Aurora's spiritual magic, allowing her to even open portals into and across the Spirit Realm at will.
- **Spiritual Knowledge**: Thanks to her innate talents to see into the Spirit Realm, Aurora has become incredibly intelligent in the topic of everything related to the Spirit Realm and all spiritual creatures that inhabit it. She is diligent with her studies, having not only an immense knowledge on the subject but also a boundless curiosity to further her studies.

relations.relationship_description: Aurora and Ornn are friends. They first met when Aurora entered Ornn's home in search of help for the spirit Haestryr. In order to assist her, Ornn forged Aurora's wand.

structure.trivia:
- Aurora is on the [autism spectrum](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/autism), although this concept is not acknowledged in the world of Runeterra.[[1]](#cite_note-Insights-1)
- Aurora and Lissandra are the only two champions who have the title "Witch" in their respective aliases.
- Aurora is the second champion released to wear glasses. The first being  [Vayne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vayne "Universe:Vayne"), who wears shades.
  - It is not known how she wears glasses without [Human](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Human "Human") ears.
- Aurora likes to [crochet](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/crochet).[[4]](#cite_note-4)
- The orange splotches on Aurora's skin follow a [Turing pattern](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turing_pattern), similar to a leopard's spots.[[1]](#cite_note-Insights-1)
- Aurora's sub-race, [Bryni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya"), has a lot of similarity with the [Viera](https://finalfantasy.fandom.com/wiki/Viera) from the *[Final Fantasy](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Final_Fantasy)* saga, as does the custom of their solitary society (only coming together out of necessity) and the etymology of the Slovak word "faith" which matches the Vastaya's custom of seeing spirit on the earthly plane.

structure.name: Taric
structure.quote: *"The best weapons are beautiful."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

:   *Main article: [The Shield of Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Shield_of_Valoran "The Shield of Valoran")*

**Taric** was born and raised in  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") to continue with his family's long tradition of military service. Taric showed martial prowess during his arduous training to become a warrior and yet he would always serve his homeland through other ways during the little free time he had; if not lending a hand volunteering to the  [Illuminators](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illuminators "Universe:Illuminators") then he would be tending the sick or helping to rebuild Demacian homes damaged by flooding. Taric would also lend his artistic perspective and creative talents to stonemasons and craftsmen who raised monuments of  [The Winged Protector](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayle "Universe:Kayle") and the ideals it represented. To Taric, art and life alike would make what Demacia is worth fighting for, even though he wouldn't exactly define nor limit what or whom he was protecting.

### Military Life

**Taric** had a steady climb through the ranks of the Demacian military. Even though he did find criticism from fellow soldiers and commanders, Taric would dismiss their reproaches and continue to live by his ideals of appreciation for life's beauty either by roaming the forests looking for rare animals to gaze upon, skipping his combat drills in a tavern while listening to a bard’s ballad, or being absent during line inspections to ride out and watch the night sky across the hinterlands.

Eventually, Taric was promoted to a position inside the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard") where he was expected to follow a much higher conduct standard. Despite his actual position, Taric would continue to follow his ways and start to feel at odds with himself, a behaviour which soon would be percieved as insubordination by his peers. Upon noticing this,  [Garen Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") (who Taric had previously fought alongside before in his younger days) advised him to take shape on his duty since he saw in Taric the potential for him to become one of Valoran's greatest heroes and so, Taric was assigned to service the Sword-Captain of the Vanguard as a way to keep him from demotion. Both Taric and the Sword-Captain not being particularly fond of this decision. Sometime after, an unnamed battle waged where Taric had abandoned his post to wander a ruined temple nearby, and without knowledge of this battle, the Sword-Captain and dozens of soldiers of his retinue were slain during the time he was absent. When Demacians found out of this tragedy, Taric faced an death sentence for the dishonor of breaking his oath with the Vanguard. Even though Taric knew that neglecting his duties was the reason of his execution, the weight of guilt for those who he had failed and died because of it was greater than the punishment itself.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

Garen then intervened as much as possible, for Taric's affront couldn't be overlooked. Seeking mercy for an old friend and using his position as next Sword-Captain in line he sentenced Taric to the "[Crown of Stone](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Targon "Universe:Targon")", a most ancient Demacian tradition consisting in sending a dishonored soldier to ascend  [Mount Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mount_Targon "Universe:Mount Targon") in search for redemption. Although because of the nature of the punishment it was certainly a death sentence. Traditionally, the Crown of Stone would allow the exiled to start anew far away from their homeland— yet Taric refused, taking sworn on the challenge to atone for what he had done.

### The Ascent of Mount Targon

:   *Main article: [The Ascent](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Ascent "The Ascent")*

**Taric** took the first ship south and climbed  [Mount Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mount_Targon "Universe:Mount Targon"), a journey who would test both his physical body and soul. During the ascent, Taric was haunted by those who he had abandoned in battle, trying to bring his will down. At some point he met the ghost of a Noxian soldier who belittled his Demacian origin, telling him about how the Mountain held nothing but death with no honor involved and how he should give up on his quest. Taric mantained as ever persistent and gave the soldier his own cloak, continuing his ascension to the peak. As Taric pressed on, he was soon plagued by visions of disasters such as the [Alabaster Library](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_City_of_Demacia "Universe:The Great City of Demacia") setting aflame only for him to dive right into the flames and retrieve the poetry [Tung](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Joe_%27New001%27_Tung "Joe 'New001' Tung") once had written, or the last of the dreamstag being thrown by the  [Frostguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Frostguard "Universe:Frostguard") into the [Howling Abyss](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Howling_Abyss "Universe:Howling Abyss") so Taric could leap down in a desesperate attempt to save it; or his worse one yet, the mangled corpse of  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") swinging from a gibbet over the [Inmortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion")'s gates, then Taric would rise his shield and charge into the endless hordes of Noxian soldiers before him. The beauty he much cherised in art and life would die before him in this visions over and over again. These would eventually fade upon the arrival at the top of the Mountain, where a 10 [man-shaped being](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Arbiter_of_the_Peak "LoR:Arbiter of the Peak") with an entire crystalline appearance would loom over him like the stars themselves, speaking truths of the world in a thousand whispers who cut through Taric like a blade, and which Taric somehow had always known. His every decision led him to Targon, where he was meant to bestowed the Aspect of the Protector.

Now he is to fulfill his newfound oath as the Aspect of the Protector, where he would stand as the steadfast Shield of Valoran in great wars yet to come.
structure.appearance: **Taric** is a strapping, tall man with long, dark hair. His chiseled face often depicted with a serene look on his eyes. Taric wears silky dark and blue robes alongside a gem necklace hanging on his chest, with the only visible armor being two large shoulder pads and faulds which shine a dim blue upon powering. He wields the  [Bravado](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taric#Bravado "Taric") as a blunt weapon with fashion sense. There are  [gems](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taric#Bastion "Taric") that hover over his back, which are made of pure starlight rather than being rocks.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
structure.personality: Taric is the assigned protector of the entire planet and all that resides on it. Even before becoming the  **The Aspect of the Protector**, Taric showed a selfless and compassive appreciaton to everything around him. His devotion to protect the fragility of life and safe-guarding of art define what most would percive as innate warm and charm. His disarming demeanor alongside his calm voice make for a soothing prescence to be around with. In one ocassion after becoming the Aspect of the Protector, Taric was willing to wade right through two armies to defend a flower, simply because it is the last of its kind to be protected from being trampled on the battefield.[[3]](#cite_note-3)
structure.abilities:
- **Combat Skills:**  **Taric**'s life before becoming the Aspect of the Protector was one of strict training as a Demacian soldier. Ever praised by his martial expertise and hardworking physique, even though he did push aside most of his military duties.
- **[Bravado](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taric#Bravado "Taric")**: Being Taric's signature weapon, Bravado has the power of the Protector celestial within it. Taric can nimbly wield it to strike a quick sucession of blows upon powering his starlight gems.
- **[Protector's Blessing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taric#Cosmic_Radiance "Taric")**: using his celestial powers, Taric's abilities come from  [gems](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taric#Bastion "Taric") imbued with starlight. These can be used for  [healing wounds](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taric#Starlight's_Touch "Taric") on their touch or wishing for  [protection](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taric#Bastion_2 "Taric") from the stars. Aditionally, Taric can use them offensively by  [dazzling](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taric#Dazzle "Taric") foes with their shine.
  - Taric is also able to summon a  [star's descend](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taric#Cosmic_Radiance "Taric") upon others and himself to become invulnerable to all physical harm or any other kind of damage.

relations.relationship_description: [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") was Taric's lifelong friend. Being next to line of the Sword-Captain allowed him to keep Taric safe from being executed and instead, sentencing Taric to the "Crown of Stone" as a way of showing mercy to his old friend.

Based on  [Sona's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sona "Universe:Sona") in-game voice lines, she has met Taric before his exile. In them, she expresses mixed feeling towards seeing him again and how he remains the same as before becoming an Aspect.

Based on  **Taric**'s and  [Aurelion Sol's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aurelion_Sol "Universe:Aurelion Sol") in-game and [LoR](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra") voicelines, both share a light enmity for each other. Taric despises Aurelion Sol's arrogance while Aurelion Sol resents Targonians all the same, demanding Taric to free him.

Based on  [Pantheon's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pantheon "Universe:Pantheon") in-game voicelines, Pantheon refers to Taric as "the Aspect the everyone used to like". Hinting they have met under uncertain circumstances before.

At the end of  [Tyari's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tyari "Universe:Tyari") climb through  [Mount Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mount_Targon "Universe:Mount Targon"), they are met by Taric. Who guides them before the 10 [the Arbiter of the Peak](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Arbiter_of_the_Peak "LoR:Arbiter of the Peak"), receiving the blessing of 4 [the Aspect of the Traveler](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Traveler "LoR:The Traveler") and transcending into her host.

Taric appreciates the beauty in all life forms alike. Yet because of his role as Aspect of the Protector, he has made  [The Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Void "Universe:The Void") and any  [creature from it](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vel%27Koz "Universe:Vel'Koz") his sworn enemies as they  [corrupt](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Baron_Nashor#Passives "Baron Nashor") the world apart as its known.

structure.trivia:
- [Aurelion Sol](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aurelion_Sol "Universe:Aurelion Sol") hinted at Taric being a  [Targonian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Targon "Targon") Aspect before he was relaunched as such: *" **You**'re an Aspect? Let me guess: tackiness."*
  - The Protector is the source of Taric's power, and produces his gems.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
- Taric is not of  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Demacia "Demacia") nobility, but his family has a long military history of serving the crown.
  - Aside from Taric, the rest of his family line (at least to  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen")) still swears allegiance to king and country.

structure.name: Evelynn
structure.quote: *"What are you doing tonight? How about we get together and unlock that vast well of torment inside you?"*
structure.background:
### Early Existence

What would become Evelynn started as a primordial, shapeless, and barely sentient [spiritual](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit "Spirit") entity, barely a shadow. This entity was left this way for a long time, numb to everything and barely existing for centuries.

### Awakening and Adaptation

When the [Rune Wars](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rune_Wars "Rune Wars") happened, thousands of people suffered and died. This stimulated the entity, and it was affected by the manic vibrations of all the suffering of the people of  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra"). This pleasured and nourished the entity, transforming it into a different creature, a demon that fed on the pain of others.

When the Rune wars ended, the creature was left hungry and desperate for the pleasure that others' suffering provided it. It subsequently decided that it would have to cause the pain that it needed itself.

To catch its prey, people, it would have to form itself into something tangible, but it could never make a form that didn't scare its prey away. It decided to study humans and see what they liked. By watching from the shadows, the demon was able to craft itself a form that attracted prey and learned to talk in a way that was alluring to them. As it amassed victims, it got better and better at attracting prey, until a point where it could lure prey in with ease.

Despite killing dozens, the demon isn't able to completely satiate its hunger and can only hold itself over until its next meal. Because she has never felt a pleasure so great since the Rune Wars, Evelynn dreams of a day when she can plunge the world into anarchy and feel that ecstasy again.

### Recent Events

Evelynn made a cult designed to attract worshipers who would do her bidding. While traveling through [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Valoran "Valoran") with her teacher Frey,  [Vayne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vayne "Universe:Vayne") heard of this and traveled to the meeting place of the cult. Despite being injured by a member of the cult and killing her own teacher on the way, Vayne continued her journey to the meeting place with the intent of finally killing Evelynn.
structure.appearance:
While Evelynn can change her form at will, she often takes the form of a beautiful curvaceous human woman with pink hands and claws, two "lashers" resembling twin tails, light blue skin and pink and white hair. This form includes constantly shifting "clothes" that show off most of her body.

In her shadow form, Evelynn's body becomes pitch black, her lashers obtain magenta tips and she sprouts magenta horns.
structure.personality:
Evelynn is a predatory demon who finds pleasure in other people's pain. She inflicts pain on others to satisfy her never-ending hunger and to experience pleasure. Although she lures her prey with promises of sexual pleasure, she does not actually engage in the creation of carnal pleasures, probably because she finds no entertainment in it of her own. To close this gap, Evelynn prefers to prey on happy people, because they are the only ones with something to lose. Behind her pretty exterior hides a very sadistic, sarcastic, and hilarious nature; after all, for her, killing seduced victims is exactly the same as a love game for people who really love each other.

Under this persona, Evelynn is charming and flirty towards her victims, manipulating others towards her doom. She prefers those that live happy lives, and then brings them to the peak of ecstasy so that their agony is more intense, relishing in her cruelty.
structure.abilities:
- **[Demon Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Demon "Demon"):** Evelynn is a demon, a malevolent spirit that feeds from human emotions. She has no physical form and cannot be harmed by physical weapons (unless it has magical properties). Each demon is linked to a specific emotion, in this case, Evelynn feeds from pain and agony.
  - **Emotional Feeding:** Like other demons, Evelynn can feed herself from an specific emotion, in her case pain and agony. By absorbing the agony of others, Evelynn can sustain herself for prolonged periods of time. Evelynn instinctively knows how to make one suffer.
  - **Immortality:** So long as agony and pain exists, Evelynn will exist in some form.
  - **Shadow Magic:** Evelynn is able to use shadows to form anything she desires, mostly used to form spikes to torture her victims.
  - **Form Shift:** Being a spirit, Evelynn can shift her form to fit any situation she needs, most often turning herself into a form that makes it easy to seduce people.
    - **Invisibility:** Evelynn can turn herself into an almost invisible shadow, visible only by the keenest of onlookers.
    - **Sharp Body Parts:** Evelynn often uses sharp body parts that she gives herself, such as claws and lashers, to torture and kill the people that she preys on.

relations.relationship_description: **Evelynn** killed Vayne's mother and father, who were the patron and matron of House Vayne of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), in their home. Vayne came home while Evelynn killed them, and got a glimpse of her face. Vayne was scarred from this incident and dedicated her life to finding and destroying monsters, with her ultimate goal being to find Evelynn and take revenge for her mother and father.
Like Tahm Kench, Evelynn is classified as a demon, and they seem to know each other. She considers him a rival, as they both prey on humans and do not consider sharing food.

structure.trivia:
- *Evelynn* comes from Norman French [Aveline](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aveline), diminutive of Germanic [Ava](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ava), possibly from Proto-Germanic: *afalan* "strength", *\*agwjō* "island", *\*ahwō* "stream", or *\*awōn* "grandmother".[[1]](#cite_note-1)
  - Famous namesakes are [Frau Ava](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ava_(poet)) and [Ava Gardner](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ava_Gardner).

**Evelynn, Agony's Embrace**

- Her in-game form is likely 164 cm (5’4”) high, much like her  [K/DA counterpart](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Evelynn/Cosmetics "Evelynn/Cosmetics").
- It appears that, while demons can change their forms, this power does have limits. Nocturne himself was able to [change his form](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Shadow_Door "The Shadow Door") but retained his black colour. Evelynn's normal form is attractive but [still not entirely human-colored](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/uncanny_valley), which could be taken as a sign of warning to a would-be victim. The form depicted ingame (her main form) is the one she most prefers/finds the most success with.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
- Evelynn requires a touch with intent in order to harm her victims.[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Evelynn, the Widowmaker**

- Evelynn was initially unaffiliated with any faction, but was later revealed to hail from  [The Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Shadow_Isles "The Shadow Isles"),[[4]](#cite_note-4) although the  [Twisted Treeline](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twisted_Treeline_(League_of_Legends) "Twisted Treeline (League of Legends)") [altars](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Altar "Altar") never had quotes dedicated to Evelynn out of a desire to not reveal much about her.

- The Demon of Agony
- The Demon of Pleasure and Punishment
- The Demon of Pain
- The Widowmaker

structure.name: Jhin
structure.quote: *"Art requires a certain... cruelty."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Jhin is assumed to have spent most of his life into early 20's on the [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ionia "Ionia") province of [Zhyun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zhyun "Zhyun"). Not much is known about his family life, except for his father's martial arts school. His father's career was snuffed out by the success of [Wuju](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wuju "Wuju").

Jhin had been slaughtering farmsteads and scores of travelers for an unknown period of time before he was persued by  [Master Kusho](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kusho "Universe:Kusho"),  [Usan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed"), and  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"). He began his work in the ages spanning from 19-21, working primarily with knives. For a little more than four years, the three men pursued Jhin and were far from the first to have hunted him down. In the final stages of the three men's investigation, they discover that he is a mere stagehand working for [Zhyun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zhyun "Zhyun")'s traveling theatre and opera houses under the name, "Khada Jhin". This is not his real name, the real one remains a mystery.

### Events leading to imprisonment

Master Kusho, Zed, and Shen followed Jhin's movements to [Jyom Pass](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jyom_Pass "Jyom Pass") on the [Ghajan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ghajan_River "Ghajan River") river. Zed chased Jhin down only to get knocked out by the handle of his blade. Jhin captured the young acolyte and tied him to a chair looking out towards the dock. Before Zed wakes up, Jhin takes the amulet off his neck. Zed wakes up to Jhin chiding him to look up, saying that he'll want to see Yevnai before she dies. Jhin goes on about how boring and symmetrycal Yevnai's face is in contrast to the situation which was "glorious" . Zed begins to cry at seeing Yevnai on the dock before her "final moments". After Jhin goes on about the tragic connections between Yevnai, Shen and Usan, the captive Zed begs for Jhin to not harm her, admitting that they were following him and noting that Yevnai, "didn't do anything". After saying he'll do anything, Jhin asks about the amulet that he took from Zed. Zed then concedes that it is a symbol of the [Kinkou](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kinkou_Order "Kinkou Order") and that the amulet allows them to find him. Shen, presumably having found Zed, punches through the wall and pins Jhin's neck to the wall. Zed declares that the whole thing was a set-up, that he was the bait, and takes Jhin's 4th knife, lunging at the man to kill him. Master Kusho appears in the nick of time, saving Khada Jhin's life.[[1]](#cite_note-:1-1) Kusho believes that because Jhin is not a real [demon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Demon "Demon"), he should be locked away at the monestary prison in [Tuula](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Tuula "Tuula").

Khada Jhin was sentenced to life in the Tuula monestary prison. Jhin revealed as little about himself as possible during his many years there. The monks that guarded him said he was a "bright student". He excelled at a myriad of subjects, mostly in the arts, (i.e. smithing, poetry, and dance). Despite this, they could find nothing to cure him of his morbid fascinations. During his time in jail, the Noxian invasion began, and it is due to Ionia's instability during this time that his patrons funded him and released him from jail to terrorize the citizens of Ionia into action.

### Release from Prison

Jhin, post-Tuula, is freely roaming, bound only by his patrons. Those weaponizing Jhin include: the [Kashuri](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kashuri "Kashuri") Armories, as their weapons are relatively moderized for Ionia. Supposedly Jhin has also done performances for the [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Navori_Brotherhood "Navori Brotherhood"), [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Noxus "Noxus"), and most recently [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zaun "Zaun"). Zed, when faced with Jhin's sniper rifle for the first time remarked that it was a "foreigners weapon". He has been described at this point in his life as both an assassin and an instrument of terror.[[2]](#cite_note-:0-2)

### Post-Imprisonment

Jhin was released some time after the war with Noxus. The timeline of his actions right after his release from prison is unclear, but he eventually sends a messenger out to [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zed "Zed"). She, the messenger, rows a small boat (with one of Jhin's lanterns on it!) out to the [Kwol Tavern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Thonx "Thonx") where she finds Master Zed and delivers him a message about a "rich man" wanting to meet him in the village north of the [Thonx outskirts](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Thonx "Thonx"); she gives Zed a blade attuned to his spirit wrapped in a red cloth which was the "rich man's" supposed thank-you-gift.[[3]](#cite_note-3) Jhin kills four people before the Order of Shadow arrive: two unidentified people, the messenger, and the woman whose leg was amputated by Zed and Kusho 16 years prior. This time span makes Jhin about 38 to 39 years old currently.
structure.appearance:
Jhin is a tall, slender, pale-skinned man. He has black hair and brown eyes (he is seen only using one, however his eyes are perfectly fine, he covers one because he enjoys the lack of depth during his "performances").

His most noticeable feature is his theater mask that he wears constantly when performing as Khada Jhin. It is implied that he has an average face that allows him to easily blend in when in a crowd. Typically, he wears a large white cloak as well as elegant Ionian attire. He refers to his attire as his "finery" and at times uses the middle half of his gun as a cane to announce his presence and to rhythmically tap on the ground.[[4]](#cite_note-:2-4)
structure.personality: Despite his theatrics during murders, much of his day-to-day personality is reserved and quiet; it's not very memorable which he takes advantage of with his performances. Within the ranks of the [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Navori_Brotherhood "Navori Brotherhood"), the few that know him consider him a weirdo.[[1]](#cite_note-:1-1) His inner voice is one of attentiveness, almost to the point of obsession, like when he cleans the stock of his gun. When interacting with the people around him, he seems to analyze their attributes. The man is internally self-deprecating, as it is mentioned that "normally, [his appearance] elicited pangs of self-conscious loathing". When it comes to his performances, he's willing to take risks which makes sense due to his psychopathy. He's also notably grandiose, carrying himself with an air of haughtiness.
structure.abilities:
- **Renowned Artist:** Jhin has shown his expertise in expressing himself in multiple artistic medium, like artistic writing, performing with the violin and piano, painting (particularly with oil based paintings) and singing.
- **Serial Killer:** As an infamous murderer, Jhin is well known for his elaborate kills. Using his specialized weapons, he is able to morph his victims into gruesome and warped artistic displays of his own design and madness.
  - **Blades:** Before the Kashuri armories granted him  [Whisper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Whisper "Jhin"), Jhin used to 'perform' with blades using Ki techniques passed down from his father.[[4]](#cite_note-:2-4)
- **Weapon Designer:** Jhin was able to make designs for both his pistol and the accelerator used to empower it. The Kashuri armories reverse engineered Piltovan and Zaunite technology with the addition of Ionian spirit magic and forge the designs provided by Jhin.
  - **[Whisper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Whisper "Jhin"):** A Hextech-inspired pistol with Ionian magic infused within it.
  - **[Mass Accelerator](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Curtain_Call "Jhin"):** The device Jhin carries on his shoulder is a Hextech-powered mass accelerator that in turns powers and loads  [Whisper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Whisper "Jhin") when it's  [fully assembled](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Curtain_Call "Jhin").[[5]](#cite_note-5)[[6]](#cite_note-6)
- **[Magical Artificer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Magic "Magic"):** While he did not forge his own weapons, it is mentioned he crafts and infuses the bullets with his own magic himself.[[2]](#cite_note-:0-2)[[7]](#cite_note-7) Using [shapeshifting magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Magic "Magic"), his bullets are able to reshape a person's body to what Jhin envisions.

relations.relationship_description: Akali tracked Jhin down to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover")- [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") and was captured by him, but was later saved with the help of  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") and  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed").

Even with their creative differences, the virtuoso could recognize that Hwei had been reluctant to push his own artistic potential in front of others. Jhin then encouraged the man to challenge himself, enabling Hwei to unleash decades of suppressed emotions within his art.

As the main reason for his imprisonment, Jhin holds some resentment towards the  [Kinkou](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") master. However, after Kusho fakes his death with the help of Zed and becoming the leader of the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood"), Kusho unleashed Jhin to terrorize and get control of  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"). Jhin knows the truth about the circumstance of Kusho's "death" and could have revealed to Shen if he had wanted to but didn't as he realized Zed was going after Kusho.

Jhin has some resentment towards Shen and Zed for catching him and imprisoning him. During each of his encounters with both Shen and Zed, he would leave a trail of gruesome deaths behind him, which would forever change the two ninjas. After he was released, Jhin would force Zed and Shen to work together so he might kill them both for catching him years before. He attacked Zed, Kayn and their  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"), killing some of the members.

Jhin has some interest in killing Sona for being a very famous  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") artist who is taking the spotlight away from his 'performances'.

structure.trivia:
- - His stagename *Khada Jhin* means "Golden Excellence". As revealed in a "Did you Know" message, Khada Jhin is just a stage name, and Jhin's real name remains unknown.
    - *Jhin* derives from Mandarin 金 *jīn* [t͡ɕin˥] "[gold](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/gold)"[[8]](#cite_note-8) < Old Chinese *\*kəm* "metal < [copper](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/copper), [bronze](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/bronze)".[[9]](#cite_note-9)
      - In Chinese localization, his name is written 烬~燼 *jìn*  [t͡ɕin˥˩][[10]](#cite_note-10) "ashes < remnants", from Old Chinese *\*dzins* < [Sino-Tibetan](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sino-Tibetan_languages) *\*dzin*[[11]](#cite_note-11) (also, *dzinʔ* > 盡~尽 *jìn* "to end, to exhaust"[[12]](#cite_note-12)).
    - *Khada* references the real-life [Khata](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khata) scarf, from [Tibetan](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standard_Tibetan) ཁ་བཏགས *kha-btags*.
    - His release story was originally named "Golden Excellence" before being changed into "[The Man with the Steel Cane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Man_with_the_Steel_Cane "The Man with the Steel Cane")".
  - Jhin shows traits consistent with obsessive-compulsive disorder focused on the number four.
    - The tally marks engraved on  [Whisper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Whisper "Jhin") might be referencing this notation.
    - One of his innates is Death in ***4*** Acts.
    - When he 'performs' in any given nation he makes a number people 'beautiful and perfect'. That number is always a multiple of four.
    - In Chinese and [Sino-Xenic pronunciations](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sino-Xenic_pronunciations), 四 "four" sounds like 死 "death" (albeit with different tones, except in toneless Japanese & Korean), leading to [avoidance](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tetraphobia), though unhistorical. Examples:
      - Middle Chinese: *\*siɪH* 四 vs. *\*siɪX* 死;
        - Mandarin: *sì* [sz̩˥˩] 四 vs. *sǐ* [sz̩˨˩˦] 死;[[13]](#cite_note-13)
        - Vietnamese: *tứ* [tɯ˧˥] 四 vs. *tử* [tɯ˨˩˦] 死;
        - Japanese: *shi* [ɕiꜜ] 四 & 死;
        - Korean: *sa* [sa] 四 & 死.
    - [Whisper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Whisper "Jhin") can hold up to four bullets/fire up to four times before Jhin having to reload, with the fourth shot being the deadliest.
    - [Dancing Grenade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Dancing_Grenade "Jhin") can bounce up to four times.
    - [Deadly Flourish](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Deadly_Flourish "Jhin") marks a target for four seconds.
    - [Captive Audience](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Captive_Audience "Jhin") reveals units for four seconds.
    - [Curtain Call](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Curtain_Call "Jhin") can fire up to four shots, with the fourth being the deadliest.
    - During his joke Jhin drops  [Whisper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Whisper "Jhin") and it fires all four bullets.
    - Other references related to number 4 include:
      - Triggering  [The Collector](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Collector "The Collector") [Death and Taxes](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Named_item_effect#Death_and_Taxes "Named item effect") will cause the damage indicator to display as "4444" instead of "999", which is *four* number *four*.
      - The word "Jhin" has 4 letters.
      - The "J-H-I-N" letter combination creates an italic "4" on QWERTY keyboards.
      - In patch [V13.5](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V13.5 "V13.5"), Jhin's price in the shop was changed to 4444 Blue Essence. When the Blue Essence prices of all champions were reduced by 50% in patch [V25.05](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V25.05 "V25.05"), Jhin's price was cut to 2222. It was then changed in patch [V25.07](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/V25.07 "V25.07") to 1234 to again reference the number 4.
      - Jhin's **Whisper** has another innate named Every Moment Matters which grants him bonus ATK equal to 4%-44% at base modifier.
      - Jhin's fourth shot crits structures at 44% reduced damage.
  - [Mind of the Virtuoso](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mind_of_the_Virtuoso "Mind of the Virtuoso") depicts how 'artistic' Jhin sees his 'performances'.
    - The rose that appears in game is one of the many things he sees when killing someone.[[14]](#cite_note-14)
    - It has been confirmed by a [Rioter](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Riot_Games "Riot Games") that his bullets shapes his victims flesh into his choosing or make it move as well as other effects. This was later reflected in [Zed comic series](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zed:_Issue_1 "Zed: Issue 1").
      - Examples would be the four champions ( [Sona](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sona "Universe:Sona"),  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen"),  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), and  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed")) chosen to be in his teasers. However, these teasers are not canon.
  - Jhin appears to be ambidextrous (he fires regular  [Whisper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Whisper "Jhin") with his left hand but when  [fully assembled](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Curtain_Call "Jhin") he fires with his right one.
  - Underneath the mask Jhin has a fully functional face, and without his usual outfit he doesn't stand out in a crowd.
    - Jhin's face was originally supposed to be revealed in [Zed comics](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zed:_Issue_1 "Zed: Issue 1"), but the idea was scrapped. However, the concept art for his supposed canon face has been accidentally posted.[[15]](#cite_note-15)
  - His favorite food is dumplings.[[16]](#cite_note-16)
  - Jhin has shown to have a certain distaste or boredom to the symmetrical in both the [Zed comics](https://universe.leagueoflegends.com/en_US/comic/zed/issue-2/6/) and his release story ["The Man With The Steel Cane"](https://universe.leagueoflegends.com/en_US/story/jhin-color-story/) .
  - Outside of the  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia")n government, the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"), the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") and a few related people, other Ionians do not know that the Golden Demon was actually a man, and believe that Master Kusho has slain the monster.
  - Jhin is around 38 to 39 years old, 4 years older than  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed").[[17]](#cite_note-17)[[18]](#cite_note-18)

structure.name: Illaoi
structure.quote: *"Wisdom is frequently a kick in the head."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Illaoi was born into the Buhru tribe of the Serpent Islands in Bilgewater, at a very young age she was trained into the priesthood and displayed incredibly high spiritual talent.

Illaoi at some point in her youth met [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gangplank "Gangplank") and fell in love with him, having a long romance, however Illaoi ended up being chosen as the Truth Bearer of Nagakabouros and was therefore forced to end the relationship.

### Spreading the Faith

After her break with Gangplank, Illaoi devoted herself entirely to spreading the faith of Nagakabouros among the Buhru tribe and ensuring the protection of the Serpent Islands.

### Shadow and Fortune

After Gangplank was defeated at the hands of Miss Fortune, Illaoi rescued him from drowning in the sea, she also kept him with her in the serpent islands where she took care of him and helped him recover.

### Return of the Ruined King

Illaoi received a mission from Nagakabouros which was to hunt down the so-called Red Dock Ripper, she along with a group of Buhru warriors left the Serpent Islands and went to Bilgewater.
structure.appearance:
Illaoi is a tall, stocky woman with dark skin with fluorescent green tattoos all over her body, long brown hair tied in a ponytail, and piercing green eyes.

She wears a dark green shirt and brown pants with some gold trim on her neck and arms, grayish black boots, and always carries a golden sphere.
structure.personality: She was known for her indomitable faith, and is above good and evil and will encourage those not to kneel but to fight. She worships [Nagakabouros](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nagakabouros "Nagakabouros"), a spirit goddess, who in turn gave her title of "Truth Bearer of Nagakabourous".
structure.abilities:
- **[Spirit Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic")**: Illaoi is a powerful performer of spirit magic, capable of numerous feats such as invoking the power of her goddess, creating magical barriers, healing others, and projecting spirit energy to decimate her foes.
  - **Soul Manipulation:** As a follower of Nagakabouros, Illaoi can tap into soul energy and draw strength from it,  [test someone's spirit](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Illaoi#Test_of_Spirit "Illaoi") and banish wraiths.
  - **Seer**: The connection with her Goddess makes Illaoi able to see small vestiges of the future, especially of a future to come.
- **Priesthood**: Illaoi is the leader of the Buhru religion, the "Truth Bearer", as such she is very knowledgeable on performing rituals, spell casting, creating wardens of protection, and creating magical items.
- **Formidable Physique**: Illaoi's faith is only rivaled by her enormous strength. She is capable of holding the  [Eye of God](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Illaoi#Harsh_Lesson "Illaoi"), a very heavy artifact, with notable ease.

relations.relationship_description: Illaoi was Gangplank's first love.  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank"), but they went their separate ways over a decade ago. Their past relationship is implied by her liking mangos and him  [oranges](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gangplank#Remove_Scurvy "Gangplank"). Illaoi still has some feelings for him.She chose to save Gangplank after his ship was sunk by  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") and gave him a spirit test which he passed. She then decided to help him retake the city.

Illaoi protected  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") and many others from an attack of the Black Mist, during which she drove off  [Hecarim](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hecarim "Universe:Hecarim") with the power of her god.

Illaoi suspects  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") needs to be tested by her god soon. This test is briefly shown in [The Climb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Climb "The Climb").

Illaoi abhors the undead of the [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shadow_Isles "Shadow Isles") and the Black Mist itself as both embody the very stagnation she seeks to eradicate. This can be illustrated when she tells  [Sion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion") he was 'cheated of rebirth' (his soul has been trapped and unable to reincarnate as new life)[[1]](#cite_note-Illaoi_vs_evil-1)[[2]](#cite_note-Illaoi_and_souls-2)

The undead would fail their test instantly.[[3]](#cite_note-3) She would want to end  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser") the most for being the de facto puppeteer of others' souls.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

Illaoi's dialogue with Braum implies that she finds Braum physically attractive. Over the course of the adventure, Braum and Illaoi develop a friendship. Illaoi would invite Braum to be more intimate and while he isn't averse to her advances, he declines because it is an inopportune time due to him needing to focus on the upcoming battles.

Illaoi's voice lines imply if she were to ever test Braum, he would pass the test very easily as he is doing exactly what Illaoi preaches: living his life as he sees fit.[[5]](#cite_note-Illaoi_Q&A-5)[[6]](#cite_note-6)

Because  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pyke "Universe:Pyke") is a murderous undead, Illaoi initially saw him as a threat against the beliefs of Nagakabourous. However, after testing his spirit, she now believes him to be serving a much larger eddy and therefore staying in motion.[[7]](#cite_note-7) She had casted a spell that made Pyke more benevolent and tamed as a result of Nagakabouros' influence, but he may eventually return back to his murderous state.

Illaoi views 'spirits' ( [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia"),  [Bard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bard "Universe:Bard"),  [Kindred](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kindred "Universe:Kindred"), [Yordles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), etc.) as a useless distraction from the truth.[[8]](#cite_note-8) [Tahm Kench](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tahm_Kench "Universe:Tahm Kench") would avoid her as he probably knows he would perish if Nagakabouros tested him.[[9]](#cite_note-9)

structure.trivia:
- Nagakabouros' religion is meant to speak uniquely to [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Runeterra "Runeterra") and to life on the [Serpent Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blue_Flame_Islands "Blue Flame Islands").[[10]](#cite_note-10)
  - The Kraken is the spirit god of life, chaos, the ocean, and storms.[[11]](#cite_note-11)[[12]](#cite_note-12)
    - The deity's name is a fusion of many mythological elements.
      - *Naga* नाग, originally "snake", later [serpentine deities](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naga);
      - *Ka*: one of five [Ancient Egyptian concepts of soul](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ancient_Egyptian_concept_of_the_soul);
      - *Bouros* to the [tail-devouring snake](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/tail-devouring_snake).
- Illaoi is powerful because she is personally capable of serving her god--- that's actually a rare gift. That puts her on the same level as Moses at the very least. Channeling her god's power (not generating it) is extremely difficult.
- Illaoi in world (as opposed to "in game") is insanely strong against the undead. (After all her religion is about "life" in all its messiness serving the universe's plan).[[13]](#cite_note-13)
  - Illaoi is definitely deeply involved in matters of the soul, but there is an important distinction between her interaction with the spirit world and what the Harrowing represents. 'Healthy' souls move through a constant cycle of transition and rebirth. Losts souls, like the denizens that inhabit the Shadow Isles, are stagnant, and trapped on the mortal plane.
- Illaoi's worldview expresses that everyone must follow their dreams no matter how brutal they might be. Having doubts isn't a "sin" in her religion—failing to take action is.[[14]](#cite_note-14)
  - But if while doing so someone becomes so passive or so demotivated to keep on pursuing their destiny that their soul starts to stagnate, then Illaoi will give them a  [Harsh Lesson](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Illaoi#Harsh_Lesson "Illaoi") in order to encourage them to get back on track. She's a tough lady, so she's a fan of harsh lessons, but the truth is that she has your best interest at heart. If she breaks a few bones in the process, well, then it was probably for your own good.
    - This brand of tough love will end in one of two ways: someone passes their  [Test of Spirit](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Illaoi#Test_of_Spirit "Illaoi") and is back in 'motion' or they fail and, as a result, their energy returns to the universe so that another lifeform might make better use of it.[[1]](#cite_note-Illaoi_vs_evil-1)[[2]](#cite_note-Illaoi_and_souls-2)[[15]](#cite_note-15)
  - While a fiercely intelligent woman, Illaoi is from a far, isolated corner of the world. She often doesn't know who people are—but wants everyone to understand they are below her god.
- Nagakabouros is not even the only god worshipped in Buhru (though it is the most popular on that island). However, Serpent Islanders aren't aware of other religions so they've never needed a name for their faith.[[16]](#cite_note-16) Buhru has other gods. Valoran has other gods.
  - Indigenous creatures from their home isles are used as religious symbols in the same fashion Christianity uses lambs and doves.[[17]](#cite_note-17)
    - They always share food with guests (especially fruit) but eating without offering to share is a huge insult and an overt threat in their eyes.[[18]](#cite_note-boards.na.leagueoflegends.com-18)
- Illaoi's religion is about life serving the universe. But Nagakabouros is seen as bigger than that goal. Illaoi knows, she can not comprehend her god or its plans. So she and her religion are attempting to serve and understand a small portion of that god's idea. She is aware that Nagakabouros is a mental construct based on human's limited perception and intellect—but it is an attempt to illustrate a greater truth (See Brahma vs Para Brahman for an example of this.)[[19]](#cite_note-19)
  - "Is what I'm doing god's will?" Is something she struggles with. That is her test of faith. She absolutely knows her god exists (in a way we cant). But is she doing what it wants? Is she serving its will? That is something her faith must bear. Nagakabouros doesn't give out bibles, or hard rules. It demands you to be self aware, emotionally present, and iron willed. Her faith requires you to approach you're own subconscious with simultaneous questioning doubt and total certainty.[[20]](#cite_note-20)
- When Illaoi conducts a  [Test of Spirit](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Illaoi#Test_of_Spirit "Illaoi") she rips only one of the  [Vessel's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Illaoi#Vessel "Illaoi") many incarnations from throughout their lives.
  - She hits people with Nagakabouros idol (which she is stepping in in her splash art) too. For her and her religion it's a useful thing—built to last—objects and symbols are to glorify motion—they have no value outside of that. If it breaks it was meant to break and has reached the end of its use.
