structure.name: Sevika
structure.background:
### Early life

Not much is known about Sevika's childhood, but she is stated to have had a somewhat rocky relationship with her father. As a resident of Zaun, she eventually became fed up with the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") attacking the undercity streets, and grew to believe that the only way to earn the respect of Piltover was by fighting back in a violent uprising.

### Rise of Silco

After a robbery topside by undercity thieves, the  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") Council sent the  [enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") to crack down hard on the people of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"). Sevika, who had before this been an admirer of  [Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") as the leader of the underground, became dissatisfied with his inaction, and she and a few other patrons at his bar angrily demanded they fight back. Vander's pacifistic and somewhat resigned speech failed to sway her, and she stormed out of the room after calling him "weak."[[2]](#cite_note-2)

Having abandoned Vander, Sevika turned her loyalties to the criminal kingpin  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco"), who was building an army of [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer")-enhanced soldiers to start a violent uprising against Piltover. Silco kidnapped Vander to convince him to join him, but when Vander refused, they had him locked up instead to lure Vander's children into a trap.[[3]](#cite_note-103base-3)

However, this plan would backfire when  [Powder](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") used a bomb made of hexite crystals, which destroyed the entire complex and nearly killed Silco. Sevika was able to protect Silco from the blast, but lost her left arm in the process. Soon afterwards, Silco would adopt Powder as his daughter, who would soon take on the name  ["Jinx"](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx").[[3]](#cite_note-103base-3) Jinx would also become one of Silco's most trusted henchmen and would work closely with Sevika, despite Sevika seeing her as a liability to their cause.[[4]](#cite_note-104progress-4)

### Piltovan Bicentennial

#### Return of Vi

Years later, Sevika had worked her way up to being  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") top enforcer, having acquired a [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer")-infused mechanical arm and overseeing a multitude of operations within the criminal empire, most against an undercity gang who opposed Silco's rule called the  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights"). After working with  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") in several battles, Sevika became skeptical of Jinx's usefulness to their cause and frequently told Silco that she was a liability. However, Silco dismissed these claims, leaving Sevika to clean up all of Jinx's messes.[[4]](#cite_note-104progress-4)

After  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") returned to  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), she attacked Sevika and questioned her on Powder's whereabouts. Sevika informed her that Powder had changed her name to Jinx and now worked for Silco as his henchman, and that they shared an almost familial, father-daughter relationship. Sevika took advantage of Vi's shock and stabbed her, but before she could finish Vi off,  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") damaged her mechanical arm with a shot from her rifle and caused her to retreat. Sevika then informed Silco of Vi's return, and the gang gave chase[[5]](#cite_note-5) but lost track of them. When she came back to report this fact to Silco, she was suddenly caught, gassed, and interrogated by Jinx, who tied her up in Silco's office. Sevika informed Jinx that her sister was still alive and had "replaced" her with a girl enforcer, and in a rage, Jinx knocked Sevika out cold and strung her up to the ceiling, painting her body with deranged scribbles calling Silco a "liar."[[6]](#cite_note-6)

#### Chembaron Coup

When Silco returned, he became concerned by Jinx's disappearance, despite the fact that his lieutenants among the  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons") were becoming increasingly angry as a result of repeated Silco's failures to control her, which had resulted in a recent border closure by Piltover. Sevika reassured Silco that Jinx would return to him when she was "ready," and then accompanied him to the chembaron assembly, where they gassed the room with toxic smog and successfully strongarmed them back in line.[[7]](#cite_note-7) Despite this, Silco's chief dissident at the meeting, the chembaron  [Finn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Finn "Universe:Finn"), continued to undermine Silco and privately urged Sevika to join him in a coup against his leadership, as he was clearly struggling to rein in control of his criminal empire. Finn claimed that Silco had gone soft as a result of Jinx, and that as a result of this, Sevika should cut him loose and help run the undercity without him.[[8]](#cite_note-8) After a shimmer production plant was destroyed by Vi and  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce"), the son of  [Renni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni"), another chembaron, was killed, and as a result of this she joined Finn's plan to have Silco assassinated. After a tense exchange in his office, Sevika proved her loyalty to Silco by killing Finn, which again brought the Renni back in line.[[9]](#cite_note-109monster-9)

Afterwards, Silco left the undercity for a parley with Jayce, leaving Sevika in charge in his absence. During this time, Vi entered the Last Drop in hopes of finding Silco, and once again battled Sevika. While Sevika initially got the upper hand on Vi, the fight ended in her defeat, with Vi ripping off her mechanical arm. Afterwards, Sevika awaited Silco's return, blissfully unaware of his death. Jinx soon fired a  [rocket](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Super_Mega_Death_Rocket! "Jinx") from  [Fishbones](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Switcheroo! "Jinx"), the [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") weapon Silco had ordered her to build, and it destroyed the Piltovan seat of government.[[9]](#cite_note-109monster-9)

#### Alliance with Jinx

When Zaun learned that Silco was dead, his criminal empire quickly crumbled into warring factions, with each chembaron turning to brazen, aggressive action against both topside and each other. Renni launched a second terrorist attack at the Councilors' Memorial, and after she died, the remaining three chembarons— [Chross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross"),  [Margot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Margot "Universe:Margot"), and  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech")—all fought to expand their holdings at the expense of the others, each seeking to take Silco's place as the new undercity kingpin. The turf wars were destructive and led to numerous casualties, and with the Enforcers out for vengeance after the recent attacks, Sevika called an assembly and urged the barons to set aside their squabbles and unite against their common enemy. Her efforts were in vain, with Chross and Margot refusing to join forces and Smeech even suggesting that they sell out Jinx to topside, despite the fact that she was one of their own. Smeech offered Sevika a new chemtech arm to replace the one destroyed by Vi, and said he would only give it to her if she gave him Jinx in return.[[10]](#cite_note-202watch-10)

Frustrated, Sevika returned to Silco's empty office, where she and Jinx lamented the fact that everything was worse now that Silco was gone. Jinx went to build a new arm for Sevika after their conversation, after which Sevika would rescue her from Smeech, who ambushed her in an alleyway. After Sevika killed Smeech with her new arm, she joined Jinx in full, along with a young orphan named  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha"), who had recently started following Jinx after she had saved her life. Together, they made a plan to kill the team of enforcers leading the manhunt for Jinx, who were being led by  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") and Vi.[[10]](#cite_note-202watch-10) Jinx and Sevika set their trap in the old ruins of  [Janna's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Janna "Universe:Janna") temple below the city's pipeworks, which was a equipped with a bomb that would unleash the Zaun Grey back into Piltover.

Jinx tricked Caitlyn into revealing her position using a mirror, after which Sevika attacked her, easily gaining the upper hand on her in close combat. However, Caitlyn's [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") rifle began to fluctuate with arcane energy in the middle of the battle, and she used it to electrocute and subdue Sevika on the floor. After Jinx had lost her battle against Vi and was about to be killed, the injured Sevika managed to activate their bomb, rescuing Jinx and Isha and hurling the enforcers from the temple ruins.[[11]](#cite_note-203finally-11)

### Martial Law Period

#### The Rally

After  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") seized power in  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") with the help of  [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"),[[11]](#cite_note-203finally-11) the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") and  [Noxians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") enacted a ruthless occupation of the city, installing border checkpoints, raiding homes, and carting off innocents to Stillwater Hold. Angered by these recent developments, Sevika repeatedly urged  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") to come out of hiding over the next several months, so she could use her newfound status as a symbol to unite a  [Zaunite](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") rebellion against the occupation. Jinx repeatedly refused Sevika's requests, preferring to remain in her lair with  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha"), whom she had grown attached to. However, Isha also believed Jinx should rejoin the fight, and unbeknownst to Sevika, she impersonated Jinx and launched a stunt and a checkpoint against Ambessa's lieutenant,  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"). The event sparked rumors of Jinx's return, and hoping to take advantage of the excitement, Sevika organized a rally at  [Vander's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") statue, urging Jinx to join her there so they could unite the undercity's disparate factions. Jinx refused, so Sevika and Isha went to the rally without her.

#### Rescue in Stillwater

Although Sevika and Isha's efforts came close to uniting the rallygoers, the gathering was busted by Rictus and the Enforcers, who sent everyone they could arrest to Stillwater Hold to be questioned about Jinx's location. Isha was captured, and Sevika managed to escape to inform Jinx about it in her hideout. After this, the two of them embarked on a rescue mission. Jinx was able to sneak inside by disguising herself as an enforcer and Sevika as her prisoner, and when they reached the prison floor where Isha was being held, they freed all the undercity folk. The people from the rally, among them many Firelights and Jinx supporters, all approached and silently thanked Jinx, and the two of them then went to find Isha.[[12]](#cite_note-204paint-12) Although they had successfully rescued everyone, their respite was short-lived, as  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), a chemtech beast who had been summoned there by his creator,  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed"), began his rampage through the hallway. Sevika, on Jinx's instructions, brought Isha to safety as Jinx held off the beast for them.[[12]](#cite_note-204paint-12)

#### Battle at the Hexgate

Several days later, when Piltover had finally ended their occupation of Zaun and dismantled the checkpoints, former Councilor  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") called an assembly in the rebuilt Council chamber of every major leader across Piltover and Zaun, which included Sevika and Scar. At the meeting, Jayce presented the body of a broken metal creature and declared that an army of "hundreds more" were being led by Ambessa, who was planning to attack the Hexgate in Piltover. Sevika and Scar were unconvinced by Jayce's pleas for support, and they left the meeting without saying a word.[[13]](#cite_note-208killing-13)

By the time of the actual battle, Sevika and Scar were both present among the united Zaunite force led by  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") and  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko"), who came to Piltover's rescue and helped them to briefly get the upper hand on Ambessa's army. Their intervention was swiftly undone by the arrival of the metal creatures controlled by  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), and several of the puppets subdued Sevika, placing her into a trance with a simple touch of their hands. After Viktor's defeat, Sevika was freed from her trance, and the battle had been won for Piltover and Zaun.

### Aftermath

Sevika was present at the funeral on the Bridge of Progress, where she and  [Shoola](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shoola "Universe:Shoola"), the last remaining member of the original  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") Council, collected slips of paper to burn and honor the people who had died. With martial law finally ended, Sevika had been awarded a seat on the Council, which had elected new members from the influential Piltovan mercantile clans. As Sevika took her seat next to Shoola, she and the other councilors stared at each other distrustfully as they convened for lawmaking.[[14]](#cite_note-209dirt-14)
structure.appearance:
Sevika is a muscular, brown skinned woman of middle-age. She has short, black hair and grey eyes. She wears common Zaunite clothing dominated by earth tones with some additional copper elements and accessories. She is often seen wearing a red poncho on top of her regular clothing. Due to a shimmer explosion that took her left arm, Sevika would have it replaced with a copper colored [chemtech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chemtech "Universe:Chemtech") prosthetic. During the martial law period, Sevika would cut her hair shorter than it was previously, and she would use a new mechanical arm built for her by  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") which included loudspeakers, gambling slots, and a large metal claw resembling the jaws of one of her  [chomper grenades](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Flame_Chompers! "Jinx").

Because she used [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") to enhance her prosthetic left arm, the entire left area of her body would show cracked blue and purple scarring and veins (most noticeable are her scars on the left side of her face), which would become more prominent and purple in color every time Sevika injected shimmer into her bloodstream. Her eyes would also temporarily glow purple while using shimmer.
structure.personality:
As  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") second-in-command, Sevika is described as a frightening presence in  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), keeping the other henchmen in line. Her ruthlessness and strength would even catch the attention of  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons") such as  [Finn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Finn "Universe:Finn"). Running a tight ship, Sevika doesn't tolerate weakness or failure, which leads her to see  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") as a liability to Silco's criminal empire, leading to a strong mutual dislike between the two. Despite this, Sevika is not wholly unsympathetic to Jinx, and offered words of encouragement to Silco upon her disappearance.

After Silco's death, Sevika attempted and failed to hold together the pieces of his broken empire, as she lacked his natural charisma and knack for intimidation. Over time, Sevika realized the importance of uniting all of Zaun's disparate factions, not just those loyal to the chembarons, and she held firm that their grievances against each other had to be set aside for the greater good of the undercity. Sevika continued working to unite all Zaunites for some time, even allying with her old enemies in the Firelights to accomplish this.
structure.abilities:
- **Brawler:** Sevika is skilled at hand-to-hand combat, being able to dodge and counter most punches. She would use her fighting skills in tandem with her augmented arm.
  - **[Chemtech Arm:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chemtech "Universe:Chemtech")** After a [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") explosion took her left arm, Sevika began wearing a chemtech prosthetic arm. Out of combat it functions as a regular prosthetic, while in combat it can enhance her punches by injecting shimmer into the device and her own bloodstream. The hydraulic piston enhance the physical force of her punches, while also extend the reach of her mechanical arm. After being damaged, Sevika would modify her arm to include a shimmer injection port (where she could add in vials by herself) as well as an extending blade that, when superheated, is able to dispel waves of energy thats able to cut through most surfaces. After her original arm was destroyed by  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), Sevika started using a replacement arm built by  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), which was equipped with a giant extendable  [chomper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Flame_Chompers! "Jinx") and a slot machine.
- **Leader:** Sevika is a competent leader and well respected and feared in the undercity. She would become  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") second-in-command and be entrusted with most of his businesses and goons.

relations.relationship_description: Sevika joined Silco's cause after her disappointment at  [Vander's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") weak and passive approach towards improving  [Zaun's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") standing. She saw potential in Silco's vision and would become one of his most loyal goons, even saving his life from an explosion that would cost her an arm. During his rise to power Silco would make sure to take into account Sevika's advice and treated her well, though in the matters of  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") she would greatly disapprove of his soft and permissive approach towards raising his adopted daughter. She would sometimes open up to Silco, telling him about her past, often as advice when dealing with Jinx as his child. Even when offered a better (more lucrative) deal by other  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons"), Sevika would stay loyal to her boss, and execute the traitors without question. She would assure him that she never intended to betray him for worms such as them (indicating that if another, stronger person offered a better deal, she would take it). She would ultimately remain loyal to him until his death. In a letter from an unknown individual, it was said that Silco "meant a lot" to Sevika and his death took a heavy toll on her, and she drank a lot in the initial stages of the turf wars.[[15]](#cite_note-Jinx_Fixes_Everything-15)

After Jinx was adopted by  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco"), Sevika rose to the rank of second-in-command, responsible for making sure her boss's operations went smoothly. However, she and Jinx had a strained relationship, as both competed for Silco's favor and Jinx was responsible for destroying her arm. Sevika saw Jinx as a loose cannon, unhinged and often prone to violent outbursts that result in things going out of control. Still, Sevika's respect for Silco was ultimately stronger than her hostility to Jinx, and they managed to work together for a long time, with Sevika even giving Silco parenting advice on occasion.

After Silco's death, a power struggle between the  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons") began in  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), with some of them thinking it'd be better to hand Jinx over to the Topsiders. Despite the difficult relationship with Jinx, Sevika refused, saying that she would not give up her people. Sevika and Jinx met again in Silco's office, and although Sevika initially thought Jinx wanted to kill her, they eventually bonded over the fact that they both missed Silco, and she seemed unaware that Jinx was the one who had killed him. As a reconciliation gift, Jinx made a new arm for Sevika, which appeared specially-designed to suit her love for gambling, and Sevika saved multiple times in return, first against  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech") and later against  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") and  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi").

When Jinx became a symbol in the undercity against Piltovan oppression, and Sevika sought to use her newfound image to complete Silco's dream of a united nation of Zaun. However, Jinx was disinterested in being viewed as a hero, in large part due to her low self-image. The matter led to several arguments between Sevika and Jinx, but Sevika still hoped Jinx would change her mind and join her at the rally. Later on, Jinx and Sevika teamed up directly to rescue  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha") and the others from Stillwater Hold, and Sevika obeyed Jinx's request to get Isha to safety as she distracted  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), showing faith in Jinx's abilities as a fighter.

While Sevika was initially reluctant to help Piltover in their war against the  [Noxians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), she later arrived as part of the Zaunite force following Jinx's war balloon, suggesting that Jinx was the one who changed her mind by uniting the undercity against  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor").

Sevika, like most of  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") henchmen, would frequently deal with  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko") and his Firelights, who would disrupt and sabotage their [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") shipments, angrily referring to them as "brats." After Silco's death, however, Sevika decided she needed to set aside her hatred of the Firelights and later attempted to join forces with them, believing a united Zaun was the only chance they had against topside. Sevika invited the Firelights, now being led by  [Scar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Scar "Universe:Scar"), to her rally at Vander's statue, where she extended an olive branch and attempted to stand in solidarity with them. The entire rally was soon arrested by  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus") and the  [Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers"), and Sevika accompanied  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") to help free them. After this, Sevika and Scar were on friendly terms, and they fought alongside Jinx and Ekko when they formed their united Zaunite force at the battle of the Hexgate.

Isha and Sevika were  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") only companions after  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") death, and they first met each other while both trying to save her. They first assisted Jinx against  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech") and his goons, with Sevika doing most of the heavy lifting, and then joined forces with Jinx in full for her battle against  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") and  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"). After the battle ended in Jinx's defeat, Sevika was the one who saved them both, activating a bomb that hurled the  [enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") from the temple as she shielded Jinx and Isha from the blast. Months later, Sevika would protect Isha again after she was sent to Stillwater, enlisting Jinx's help for a rescue mission and later carrying the girl to safety at Jinx's request, despite Isha's reluctance to leave Jinx behind.

Isha and Sevika interacted regularly while Piltover was under martial law, with both of them urging Jinx to use her new status as a symbol to unite Zaun against Piltover's occupation. Though Jinx suspected they might be conspiring together to bring her out of hiding, Sevika was unaware that Isha was impersonating Jinx, as Isha kept her role in the demonstration a secret from both of them. Eventually, Sevika was surprised to see Isha show up in Jinx's place at the rally, she began to raise her arm in solidarity with the rest of the crowd shortly before  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus") attacked them both. It is unknown if Jinx told Sevika about Isha's death before the battle at the Hexgate.

Sevika used to respect  [Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") and followed his leadership in the undercity, seeing him as the man primarily responsible for building  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") into what it was. After enforcers started to patrol and harass the undercity populace, her and many other concerned citizens looked towards Vander for answers. She confronted him about his soft approach with the police and demanded that he act. When he refused, she left his bar and would quickly join  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") cause and go against Vander's wishes. Years after Vander's downfall, Sevika was shown to still have a begrudging respect for him, and she would choose Vander's statue as a rallying point to unite Zaun against Piltover's occupation.

Sevika was present during Warwick's rampage through Stillwater Hold and saw him as dangerous, fleeing with  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha") as  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") tried to hold him off. It is unknown whether or not Sevika learned later on that Warwick was Vander.

Initially, Sevika was indifferent towards young Vi during  [Vander's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") reign, not knowing that she was the direct cause for most of  [Zaun's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") recent upheavals. She attempted to fight young Vi after she taken out most of  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") goons, but was stopped by him, sending out a [shimmered](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") up  [Deckard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Deckard "Universe:Deckard") instead. When Vi was freed from prison years later, she quickly tracked Sevika down and fought her without asking any questions beforehand, and they quickly became rivals. Vi would lose their first fight when she got stabbed, but would win the second one, besting Sevika in barroom brawl and destroying her cybernetic arm. The two would remain enemies after Silco's death, with Sevika working with  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") and Vi working with  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"). Following the end of  [Piltover's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") martial law period, Sevika earned a seat on the Piltover Council and presumably holds some level of influence over Piltovan law enforcement. It is unknown if she and Vi are still enemies.

Caitlyn was responsible for taking down Sevika and her chemtech arm before she could finish off  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") in their first fight, and she recognized her as an  [enforcer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers"), despite the fact that Caitlyn was working undercover. Sevika would engage Caitlyn more directly later on during the battle at  [Janna's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Janna "Universe:Janna") temple, and Sevika would save  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") life by activating a bomb that blew the enforcers from the area.

After their battle, Caitlyn would rise as the new military commander of Piltover and enact a brutal occupation of Zaun under martial law, which Sevika sought to rebel against with a united Zaun. The occupation persisted for a number of months, and when it finally ended, the Piltovans requested Zaun's support against Caitlyn's longtime military advisor,  [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"). Sevika left the meeting in disgust without promising her support, but would later change her mind, following Jinx into the battle to Cailtyn's rescue. After the battle, Sevika earned a seat on the Piltover Council and presumably holds some level of influence over Piltovan law enforcement. It is unknown if they are still enemies.

Finn referred to Sevika as a "scary lady," recognizing her importance as  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") right-hand woman and the one responsible for controlling all his henchmen. Finn attempted to bargain with Sevika as he was organizing his coup, playing at her ego and planting seeds of doubt about Silco's faltering leadership and favoritism towards  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"). Sevika considered Finn's offer and later pretended to join him in his coup, before abruptly slicing his throat in front of Silco and  [Renni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni"), surprising everyone else in the room. After Finn's death, Sevika called him a "worm," reaffirming her loyalty to Silco.

Sevika and Smeech knew each other from the  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons")' many assemblies during  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") reign, and she seemed to find him annoying. After Silco's death, Sevika tried unsuccessfully to convince  [Chross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross"),  [Margot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Margot "Universe:Margot"), and Smeech to end their turf wars and unite against topside. Smeech made a counteroffer to Sevika, claiming they wouldn't need to worry about topside anymore if they just handed over  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), and he attempted to bribe her with a new chemtech arm to replace the one that had been destroyed by  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"). Ultimately, Sevika refused Smeech's offer on the principle that Zaunites don't hand over their own, and she rescued Jinx before killing Smeech in the alleyway. Sevika mocked Smeech both before and after his death, calling him a "funny-looking rat" who didn't know how to keep his mouth shut.

structure.background:
### Early Life

Akali was born to Master Mayym Jhomen Tethi, the Fist of Shadow, and her partner Tahno of the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order"). Whenever her parents were called away, other members of the Kinkou stepped in as Akali's surrogate family. She grew especially close to Master  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen"), the Heart of the Tempest, spending many hours learning his shuriken techniques. A precocious child, Akali absorbed knowledge like a sponge, and it soon became clear that she would one day follow in her parents' footsteps and help lead a new generation dedicated to preserving balance.[[1]](#cite_note-AkaliBio-1)

When Akali was nine,[[2]](#cite_note-Bow-2) Master Kusho's adopted son and former student  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") returned to the Order after leaving to fight in the [war against Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxian_Invasion_of_Ionia "Universe:Noxian Invasion of Ionia"). He and his followers staged a bloody coup against the Kinkou, usurping their temple and slaying Master Kusho.[[3]](#cite_note-3) While Akali and her mother managed to survive, her father Tahno did not.[[1]](#cite_note-AkaliBio-1)

Kusho's other son,  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"), returned from maintaining Ionia's spiritual harmony and led the remaining Kinkou to safety in the mountains. He took up his father's spirit blade and assumed the mantle of the Eye of Twilight, vowing to rebuild the Order. Following the core tenets, Shen began recruiting and training new members in hopes of restoring the Kinkou's strength.[[4]](#cite_note-ShenBio-4) Kennen helped guide the Order as the new Eye of Twilight struggled to lead, and urged Master Mayym to begin considering Akali as her successor as the Fist of Shadow.[[5]](#cite_note-KennenBio-5)

### Rebuilding the Order

Several months after the coup, the Kinkou retreated to an abandoned temple east of Thanjuul. On the last night of the Spirit Blossom Festival, her mother's apprentice,  [Faey](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Faey "Universe:Faey"), led the other neophytes on an unsanctioned hunt for a silver boar, Akali decided to tag along despite being told to stay behind. Her impatience allowed the boar to escape, and when Faey scolded her, Akali apologetically offered her plum for dinner.[[2]](#cite_note-Bow-2)

When they returned to the temple, Mayym reprimanded them. While the other neophytes blamed Akali, Faey took responsibility for the hunt. Mayym punished them by having to go without dinner tonight and dismissed them, but asked Faey to stay behind to talk further. Though Akali looked up to Faey, she had begun to feel neglected by her mother whenever Faey was present.[[2]](#cite_note-Bow-2)

Later that night, Akali was practicing her calligraphy when  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") returned to see her. He mentioned hearing about her role in disrupting the boar hunt, and Akali explained that she hadn't meant to interfere and wished that Faey had invited her. Kennen then asked whether Mayym had begun teaching her to use the kunai. When Akali said she had not, she confided her feelings of neglect, believing her mother favored Faey over her. Kennen explained that Mayy'’s attention to Faey stemmed from a promise she made after Faey lost her parents. Akali realized that the pain of losing her own father must have been doubled for Faey, and for far longer. Kennen reassured Akali of her potential and promised that her mother would see it one day. He encouraged her to finish her lesson, then departed to attend a meeting.[[2]](#cite_note-Bow-2)

When Faey returned, Akali stayed up waiting for her and offered her a plum for dinner. Faey asked why she had it, reminding her that they had been punished with no dinner. Akali admitted that she had been saving food in case they ever had to flee from enemies again. Faey comforted her, then took a small bite of the plum before insisting that Akali eat the rest and for her to go to sleep.[[2]](#cite_note-Bow-2)

Later, while playing in a nearby valley, Akali and the neophytes encountered members of the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood"). To avoid bloodshed, Faey devised a plan to frighten them away using the sound of grey owls, tasking Akali with warning the adults if necessary. The ruse succeeded, but the valley itself awakened and coalesced into a corrupted spirit, ensnaring the children in living vines. Faey managed to free some of the neophytes and ordered them to flee for help, but Akali stayed behind to distract the creature. When the spirit turned on Akali, Faey tried to save her, but she was caught in a rockslide, crushing her right leg and leaving her unconscious. Akali freed the other neophytes and tried to help Faey, when suddenly Kennen, Mayym, and Shen arrived and destroyed the spirit.[[2]](#cite_note-Bow-2)

As Faey recovered, Akali and the other neophytes tried to comfort her. With her leg gone, Faey lashed out at Akali, berating her for not leaving when ordered. Confused and hurt, Akali left the hut. From the doorway, she watched as her mother comforted Faey. She left with tears in her eyes, unable to remember the last time her mother hugged her like that.[[2]](#cite_note-Bow-2)

When Akali came of age at fourteen, she formally began her Kinkou training with  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"), determined to succeed her mother as the next Fist of Shadow. Though she lacked the magical abilities of many of her fellow acolytes, she was a prodigious fighter and quickly mastered the kama and kunai.[[1]](#cite_note-AkaliBio-1) However, Shen often found himself urging restraint when she faced mortal opponents.[[4]](#cite_note-ShenBio-4)

### Leaving the Kinkou Order

After the Noxian Invasion ended, the Kinkou reached an uneasy accord with the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"). Akali eventually proved that she was worthy and was named the new Fist of Shadow,[[4]](#cite_note-ShenBio-4) allowing her mother to step down and focus on mentoring younger neophytes. However, Akali's spirit was restless. Though Ionia was now at peace, she saw that her homeland continued to suffer and began to question whether the Kinkou were truly fulfilling their purpose. As the Fist of Shadow, her duty was to Prune the Tree, but  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") would always urge restraint. Believing he was holding her back, Akali's youthful precociousness turned into open defiance. Before the entire Order, Akali denounced the Kinkou's inaction, declaring that their devotion to patience and spiritual balance had achieved little. She saw that Ionians were dying in the material realm and chose to protect them, leaving the Order. While Shen did not stop her, knowing this was a path Akali needed to walk alone,[[1]](#cite_note-AkaliBio-1)  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") pleaded with her to stay.[[5]](#cite_note-KennenBio-5)

Now living as an independent assassin, free from the restraints of the Kinkou's teachings, Akali lived as a vigilante, traversing the urban underground of Ionia and killing those that cause her people harm.[[1]](#cite_note-AkaliBio-1)

In the coastal village of [Weh'le](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Weh%27le "Weh'le"), a hidden phantom port with mystical properties, Akali went on a mission to assassinate a councilman from [Puboe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Puboe "Puboe") who had sold out his own people to Noxian invaders in exchange for gold and safe passage through. She visited her tattoo artist Bo'lii, a  [vastayan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vastaya "Universe:Vastaya") artist who ran a tavern in the port. While drawing a tattoo of a dragon on her back, the Puboe councilman walked into Bo'lii's tavern accompanied by three guards. Akali planned to kill them on the spot, but Bo'lii urged her to do her business outside of his tavern this time, to which she agreed. Once outside, Akali approached and killed the councilman's guards by hiding in a  [smoke cloud](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali#Twilight_Shroud "Akali") and firing several  [kunais](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali#Five_Point_Strike "Akali") before finally killing the councilman himself.[[6]](#cite_note-6)

Despite leaving the Order, Akali still aided the Kinkou. She accompanied  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") to Navori Province, where they encountered a young Noxian woodsman cutting down a guardian tree. Intent on teaching him a lesson, Akali destroyed his cart, trapping him beneath it. As she confronted the boy, the tree's sap awakened its guardian, furious at the Noxian. Shen shared his ability to peer into the spirit realm with Akali, revealing the source of the guardian's rage. Despite his warnings, Akali rushed to attack the spirit, but was unable to stop it. Shen insisted that balance had to be restored, but Akali pleaded with him to bend the rules to spare the child. As Akali tried to free the boy, she realized what Shen meant and plucked a nearby seed. Using her kunai, she dug a small trench and instructed the boy to bury it. As the spirit prepared to strike, Akali used one of her charms to water the soil, causing the seed to bloom. Appeased, the guardian stayed its hand. Shen then nurtured the growing tree further, and the spirit settled beneath its roots, returning once more to its slumber.[[7]](#cite_note-7)

### Search for Zed

In [Zhyun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zhyun "Zhyun"), Akali got word that Zed recently assassinated the Kinkou master Althon, a cousin of Shen. Finding Shen in the Olgathee Forest killing corrupted spirits, Akali told him the news about master Althon, stating that she knows the town that Zed is staying in and suggesting she and Shen go confront him, which he reluctantly agrees to.[[8]](#cite_note-8)

Once at a tavern in [Thonx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Thonx "Thonx"), the two found out from the innkeeper that Zed had already left and attacked a blossom festival before heading north to [Shual](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shual "Shual"). Akali suggested they follow him, but Shen stated that he had to travel south to slay demons that have been terrorizing a village. Akali tried to convince Shen to follow her to Shual, but Shen remained dedicated to his duties as the Eye of Twilight, urging his former student not to chase Zed alone. Akali, disregarding Shen's warning, took a boat and sailed down the quickest route to Shual.[[9]](#cite_note-9)

Travelling to an inn near the Kinkou temple of Koeshin, Akali encountered a group of Zed's acolytes, including Zed's apprentice  [Shieda Kayn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayn "Universe:Kayn"). She told a neophyte to head to the nearby Kinkou temple and gather reinforcements while confronted them. Akali asked where his master was, to which Kayn replied he was inside, likely killing Shen. He told her that was working for the wrong side of this conflict and offered her a chance to join, but Akali refused. Zed then exited the inn followed by Shen, who ordered Akali to let the Order of Shadow leave in peace since Zed declared the *Code of Tuonn,* an honorable call for temporary peace that allows them to let each other walk free without combat. Akali however wasn't satisfied with just letting Zed go and dashed in to kill him anyway, which Zed easily avoided by  [shadow shifting](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zed#Living_Shadow "Zed") away while the rest of his acolytes quickly fled the Kinkou temple. Angered by Akali's recklessness, Shen told her never to fight Zed and that he'll fight him alone in the future, officially declaring that the armistice between the Order of Shadow and the Kinkou has ended.[[10]](#cite_note-Zed3-10)

Shen eventually revealed to Akali what transpired in the inn; Zed came to warn Shen that the serial killer  [Khada Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") had escaped and that he seeks to bring him back to prison. Though Zed wanted to ally with Shen and capture Jhin, Shen refused and insisted on catching Jhin on his own without the help of the Order of Shadow, declaring that if he sees Zed interfere then he'll personally kill him and finally settle their scores.[[10]](#cite_note-Zed3-10)

### Capturing Khada Jhin

Akali followed Shen as he investigated a trail of intricate clues in search of the murderer Khada Jhin. Shen's investigation eventually lead him to believe that Jhin was working with the [Kashuri faction](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kashuri "Kashuri"), a radical nationalist group with ties to the Navori Brotherhood. This trail lead Shen to [Nanthee](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nanthee "Nanthee"), believing that the village elder was a potential target of Jhin's murder spree. Once at the scene of the crime, Shen stopped Akali from looking at the corpses, stating that she simply isn't ready to see the horrors that Jhin committed.[[10]](#cite_note-Zed3-10)[[11]](#cite_note-11)

Eventually, Jhin's traps activated as dozens of bombs hidden in lanterns across Nanthee began exploding, killing many and causing massive damage to the city. Akali, noticing the explosion from afar, vowed to kill Jhin for what he'd done. Noticing a small ship in the distance and deducing that that's where Jhin was escaping, Akali demanded to know where it was headed, learning that it was headed to the  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover").[[12]](#cite_note-12)

Deciding to follow Jhin's trail alone, Akali set sail and eventually landed in Piltover. On her search for Jhin, Akali questioned and interrogated many of the locals, which lead her to the undercity of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"). In Zaun, she learned that Jhin had been attacking Piltover merchant clans that did business in exporting weapons to Ionia. By questioning the Piltover enforcers, Akali found herself at a theater in the Zaunite neighborhood of Mistfloor, where Jhin was said to have battled with the Ferros clan and their  [intelligencer agent](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Camille "Universe:Camille").[[13]](#cite_note-Zed5-13)[[14]](#cite_note-:0-14)

At the theater, Jhin revealed an elaborate trap for Akali, wishing to make her the fourth victim in his disturbing art piece as three piltovans hung from Ionian trees strapped to machines. These machines began firing harpoons at Akali, who narrowly dodged them by tossing a  [smoke bomb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali#Twilight_Shroud "Akali") before being hit unconscious by an explosive blast created by  [Jhin's rifle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin#Curtain_Call "Jhin").[[13]](#cite_note-Zed5-13)

Jhin, having anticipated Zed and Shen's arrivals, set a trap by tying Akali up in a tree near a decoy of his. While Jhin tried to kill the two of them with Zaunite machinery, Zed managed to toss a  [shuriken](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zed#Razor_Shuriken "Zed") at Akali, cutting her rope and freeing her from Jhin's trap. While Jhin was ready to fire a shot into Shen's head, Akali burst out of the smoke and punched Jhin to the ground, grabbing his gun and preparing to kill him for his crimes while Shen pleaded for her not to as he needed to bring Jhin to Ionia alive. Before she could kill him, Zed pushed her aside and grabbed Jhin, demanding he tell him how he got out of prison. Jhin simply replied with cryptic riddles, stating that Zed already *knew* who freed him before Zed threw Jhin to Shen and Akali's feet, stating that their bargain is done as he quickly fled Zaun.[[15]](#cite_note-15)

### Possible Future

#### The Second Noxian Invasion

At some point, Noxus began a second incursion of Ionia, sending massive armies accompanied by the [undead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Undead "Undead") juggernaut  [Sion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion"). When the Ionian war hero  [Irelia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Irelia "Universe:Irelia") began a resistance, she requested aid at a seaside village and received assistance from Kinkou members lead by  **Akali** and  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen"), the spiritual leader  [Karma](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Karma "Universe:Karma") and the lone wanderer  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo"). During the defense against the Noxian army, Akali targeted Sion and struck him with her kama and smoke bombs before joining Irelia and the rest of the champions in a final charge against the Noxians.[[14]](#cite_note-:0-14)
structure.appearance:
Akali is a slender but muscular woman with light skin and red-brown eyes. Her thick black hair is often tussled, tied back in a large, messy bun which flares in every direction. She also has a tattoo of a pale blue dragon among white clouds swirling around her arms and across the backs of her shoulders.

Her typical professional attire is various shades of green with brown leather highlights. She wears baggy pants, a crop top, tabi, and a cloth mask that covers her lower face.
structure.personality: Akali is impatient, explosive and determined, preferring to leave the Kinkou Order rather than betray her own ideals and not fight for her people. It is notable that, despite this, she is still loyal to Ionia, being able to do anything, even to become a murderer, to protect the First Lands and her home.
structure.abilities:
- **[Assassin Combat Mastery:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali#Perfect_Execution "Akali")** Akali was trained in the Kinkou Order to be the next *Fist of Shadow,* the head assassin of the order. Because of this, she is an expert in assassination and stealth combat, capable of knowing how to strike a perfect killing blow from the shadows and get out of danger by hiding in her  [smoke shroud](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali#Twilight_Shroud "Akali").
  - **Agility:** As an expert assassin, Akali is incredibly agile with a talent in acrobatics and running. Since childhood, Akali has had an exceptional running speed.
  - **Weapon Mastery:** As part of her training as an assassin, Akali has learned to masterfully wield a large variety of weapons, learning how to use and specialize each one to kill any target.
    - **[Kama Proficiency:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali#Assassin's_Mark "Akali")** Akali is most comfortable using her kama, a short sickle-like blade she can use to strike enemies. In the past, Akali wielded  [dual kamas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali#Twin_Disciplines "Akali") but has resorted to using a singular, specialized kama that is connected to a rope, allowing Akali to detach it from its handle and swing it at further distances.
    - **[Kunai Proficiency:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali#Five_Point_Strike "Akali")** Akali utilizes a collection of kunai daggers, small blades that she can use to either stab up close or toss at a distance. Akali has learned a technique to toss five kunais at the same time, dealing massive damage in a wider area.
    - **[Shuriken Proficiency:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali#Shuriken_Flip "Akali")** Akali was taught how to use a shuriken by  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen"), a Kinkou master most known for wielding shurikens. Training with Kennen has taught Akali how to toss a shuriken from a far distance with great accuracy.

relations.relationship_description: Akali is currently a ninja gone rogue from the [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kinkou_Order "Kinkou Order"). Although still part of it, she operates outside of its rules and regulations.[[16]](#cite_note-16) She and  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") parted on neutral terms. Neither hates the other but both disapprove of the other's methods.[[17]](#cite_note-17) While growing up in the Kinkou,  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") trained her and helped her refine her shuriken techniques.

[Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") might attempt to recruit her for his  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"). Akali; however, wants him dead since many Kinkou members including her father Tahno were killed by him and his order.

Akali and  [Kayn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayn "Universe:Kayn") know each other. He has tried to flirt with her multiple times and Akali finds him hot but too crazy for her taste.

Akali temporarily teamed up with  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") to track down  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") after they were informed of his escape. She later pursued Jhin to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover")- [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") and got captured by him, but was later saved with the help of  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") and  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed").

In the second  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") invasion of  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"),  [Irelia's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Irelia "Universe:Irelia") call for help to defend a seaside village from the Noxian army including  [Sion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion") was met by Akali,  [Karma](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Karma "Universe:Karma"),  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") and  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo") whose arrival turned the tide of the battle.

structure.trivia:
- She was 9 years old during the events of [The Bow, and the Kunai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Bow,_and_the_Kunai "The Bow, and the Kunai").
  - Her  **pre-rework self** depicts her around the age of 17, when she was still the Fist of Shadow.
  - She left the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") between her 17th and 19th year.[[18]](#cite_note-18)
  - When she accompanied  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") to track down  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") during [The Man with the Steel Cane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Man_with_the_Steel_Cane "The Man with the Steel Cane"), she was 'the same age as he when he caught him the first time'.
- Akali is presumably 163 CM (5'3") high.
- Akali was not her mother's original choice to inherit her title of The Fist of Shadow.

structure.name: Lucian
structure.quote: *"Wield the light, endure the pain, and cleanse all shadow from this world."*
structure.background: Lucian was raised in  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), longing to follow in his father's footsteps and become a  [Sentinel of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sentinels_of_Light "Universe:Sentinels of Light"). However, his father Urias discouraged him, wanting to keep him safe. When Urias died in battle, his apprentice  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna") delivered the news to Lucian. Lucian insisted on joining the Sentinels, eventually falling in love with and marrying Senna. Senna was later killed by  [Thresh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh"), though after some time, Lucian resurrected her by freeing her soul from Thresh's lantern. The pair would go on to lead a new band of Sentinels against  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego"), successfully sealing him away within Hallowed Mist.
structure.appearance:
Lucian is a thin man with dark skin and a fierce face. He has yellow-brown eyes and black hair fashioned into long locs with the sides shaved.

His Sentinel regalia is an intricately crafted full-body set of agile leather and cloth armor. It is primarily white, black, and silver with accents of gold and fuchsia.

His large twin pistols appear to be fashioned from white, rectangularly carved stones protruding from a dark metal casing and handle. When they fire, a magical bolt of light erupts from the stone itself.
structure.personality: Lucian is serious and intense, being extremely dedicated to his duties as a Sentinel.  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna")'s death turned him cold and merciless, and while her subsequent resurrection returned some softness to his demeanor, he remains grimly determined in his work.
structure.abilities:
- **[Relic Pistol Proficiency:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lucian#Lightslinger "Lucian")** As a novice [Sentinel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sentinels_of_Light "Sentinels of Light"), Lucian was trained in wielding the relic pistol of his deceased father Urias. After the loss of his wife  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna"), Lucian wielded her pistol as well, learning to wield both masterfully. With these pistols, Lucian is capable of firing  [concentrated rays of light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lucian#Piercing_Light "Lucian") either as single blasts or even in the form of a  [barrage of shots.](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lucian#The_Culling "Lucian") These pistols are uniquely designed to harm the undead [wraiths](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wraith "Wraith") of the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles") thanks to their relic stone material.
- **[Enhanced Agility:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lucian#Relentless_Pursuit "Lucian")** Lucian is capable of dashing moderate distances at incredible speeds, almost to the speed of light. This skill allows Lucian to dodge danger or pursue fleeing enemies. It is unknown what the nature of this ability is but it could potentially be magical or a result of his relic pistols.
- **Undead Hunting Mastery:** As a veteran Sentinel, Lucian is extremely well versed in hunting the undead, particularly the wraiths of the Shadow Isles. Having trained alongside his wife for years, Lucian has become knowledgeable on the weaknesses of these wraiths as well as the best tactics in combatting them.

relations.relationship_description: Lucian and  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna") are husband and wife. Lucian's father Urias saved Senna as a child and later helped her become a Sentinel. Senna met Lucian to deliver the news of his father's death. Love developed between them and they became husband and wife. She also trained him become a Sentinel.  [Thresh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh") killed 3 [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Senna,_Sentinel_of_Light "LoR:Senna, Sentinel of Light") when she tried to save Lucian. This event fueled Lucian's hatred for Thresh and  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles"). Lucian [traveled](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shadow_and_Fortune "Shadow and Fortune") to Bilgewater in pursuit of the [Harrowing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Harrowing "Harrowing") to locate Thresh. It was then he found out Senna's soul is trapped inside the Chain Warden's  [lantern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Thresh#Dark_Passage "Thresh"). Lucian continued to pursue the Mist to free her and finally [succeeded](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shadow%27s_Embrace "Shadow's Embrace"), though he did not expect her to come back to life. Although Senna has been freed, Lucian remains obsessed with exacting vengeance from Thresh, as he is certain the Chain Warden’s machinations have only begun.

During the events of [Shadow and Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shadow_and_Fortune:_Chapter_One "Shadow and Fortune: Chapter One"), Lucian and  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") encountered each other in a recent  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater")'s [Harrowing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Harrowing "Harrowing"). They both fought the undead from the Shadow Isles and parted way in friendly terms. Despite this, she would eventually betray him and the Sentinels of Light to  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego"). She intended to persuade him to help her claim Bilgewater. They also encountered  [Olaf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Olaf "Universe:Olaf") in the same events but did not think much of him. Olaf would eventually forget that he met Lucian.

After Senna was freed, the couple's main goal is now to stop  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") and his Black Mist. Upon finding out about Senna's relation to Isolde, his wife, Viego chased her and Lucian and succeeded in retrieving Isolde in spite of their efforts to stop him.
[Gwen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gwen "Universe:Gwen") allied herself with Lucian and Senna to aid the Sentinels of Light and oppose Viego.

Lucian and Senna recruited multiple Sentinels of Light to aid them against Viego, including:  [Diana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Diana/Cosmetics "Diana/Cosmetics"),  [Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Graves/Cosmetics "Graves/Cosmetics"),  [Irelia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Irelia/Cosmetics "Irelia/Cosmetics"),  [Olaf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Olaf/Cosmetics "Olaf/Cosmetics"),  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Pyke/Cosmetics "Pyke/Cosmetics"),  [Rengar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rengar/Cosmetics "Rengar/Cosmetics"),  [Riven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Riven/Cosmetics "Riven/Cosmetics"), and  [Vayne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vayne/Cosmetics "Vayne/Cosmetics"). Lucian and a Rookie saved Rengar from some wraiths when they traveled to the jungles Ixtal in search of a fetter.

Lucian snuck off to Shurima to find the Absolver and met  [Akshan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akshan "Universe:Akshan"). While initially refusing to join their cause, Akshan would have a change of heart and revived Lucian after he was killed by wraiths.

structure.trivia: - Lucian’s dual pistols were passed down through generations of the Sentinels of Light. One belonged to his father, Urias, and the other to his wife,  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna"); when  [Thresh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh") imprisoned her, Lucian took up the weapon in her honor.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

structure.name: Lest
structure.background:
### Spy for Mel Medarda

Lest was a vastayan healer who was hired by  [Salo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Salo "Universe:Salo") to treat his broken legs with [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer")-based cocktails. Secretly, however, she was an informant for  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") who would keep an eye on and deliver information about the other councilors.

Shortly after  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") attack on the Piltover Council, Mel enlisted Lest's help to spy on Salo, whom Lest claimed she could handle without trouble. However, Lest quickly realized that Mel was really after information about her mother  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"), a  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") warlord who had recently began consolidating power in the City of Progress. Lest overheard Ambessa and Salo's plan to gather the [mercantile clans](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mercantile_Clans_of_Piltover "Universe:Mercantile Clans of Piltover") and put Salo in charge of the entire city after one of her meetings with him.

Having gotten more than she had bargained for, Lest went backstage at the  [Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda") opera house to speak with Mel and back out of her mission, believing the councilor had no intention of keeping her safe and would sacrifice her as a pawn. Mel assured her this was not the case and claimed the information on Ambessa's plans was vital to the safety of Piltover, after which Lest relented and gave Mel the information and evidence she needed to take down Salo for good.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

### Martial Law Period

After Mel was abruptly kidnapped by the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"), Lest continued to work with Salo and apply the same treatments to his legs for the next few months. However, when her treatments started becoming less effective over time and Salo started asking her to visit him daily instead of every week, Lest told Salo about a rumor that she had heard about a  [miracle healer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") down in the fissures of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"). She suggested that he check it out for himself, noting there was no harm in it after all the injuries he had received so far.[[3]](#cite_note-204paint-3)
structure.appearance: Lest was a [vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vastaya "Universe:Vastaya") with gray skin, light fur, dark brown hair, and dark freckles over her face. She had distinct [feline](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cat "Universe:Cat") features, including large pointed fuzzy ears, a long tail, sharp claws on her fingers, and glowing yellow eyes. Lest wore purple attire, including a dress and a head covering which went around her ears and golden adornments. She was often seen with a large purple shawl wrapped around her neck and carrying a silver cigarette holder to smoke.
structure.personality: Lest had a resourceful and quick-thinking personality, despite her soft-spoken demeanor. She was politically savvy but also quick to realize when she was being used, leading her to distrust those who might use her or put her at risk. Her methods were sometimes underhanded, like how she fueled  [Salo's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Salo "Universe:Salo") [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") addiction to keep him under control and have leverage against him in the future, but Lest ultimately placed  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover")'s safety above her own by telling  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") about  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") plan.
structure.abilities:
- **[Vastayan Physiology:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vastaya "Universe:Vastaya")** Lest is a vastaya, an ancient race of demi-humans changed by magic of the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_Realm "Universe:Spirit Realm"). This connection to the Spirit Realm has increased their longevity and granted them powerful magics, allowing them to live for centuries. Lest is a member of an unknown tribe with [feline](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cat "Universe:Cat") features.
- **Spy:** Lest's nature as a vastaya grants her a number of abilities useful to an informant, such as an enhanced sense of hearing and remarkable stealth abilities, allowing her to leave any meeting quickly, soundlessly, and without trace. Her skills in this occupation make her useful to politicians like  [Mel Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel").

relations.relationship_description: Lest was an old friend of Mel Medarda, being trusted as a source for information on Mel's rivals in the Piltover Council. As  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") consolidated power in Piltover, however, Lest realized Mel was using her to get to her mother and tried to back out of the mission, irritated that Mel was treating her as "expendable." Mel was able to convince Lest otherwise by informing her the gravity of the situation and that she was the only one who could save the city from Ambessa. After this, Lest gave Mel the information and one of the [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") ointments she had used on  [Salo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Salo "Universe:Salo"), which could be used to "shut him down."

After Salo's legs were irreparably ruined by the terrorist attack, he hired Lest to treat his legs with [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") ointments, knowing she was excellent at stroking her clients' egos. Lest had secretly been recruited by  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") to spy on Salo, but Salo remained unaware of this, and they continued their weekly sessions for several months, during which time Salo developed a heavy shimmer addiction. Lest believed Salo had "peculiar tastes," but believed she could handle him. She was also aware of his scheme to take over the city, but believed he would be nothing more than  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") puppet if he were to succeed. Eventually, when Salo demanded they make their meetings more frequent, Lest became uncomfortable and directed him to another healer she had heard rumors about, which turned out to be  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor").
