structure.name: Zyra
structure.quote: *"Where are your friends? Mine are all around…"*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Zyra existed thousands of years ago as a collective hive-mind of carnivorous plants that lived together in a place called [Gardens of Zyr](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gardens_of_Zyr "Gardens of Zyr"), somewhere in the  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") jungle. Sometime during the [Rune Wars](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rune_Wars "Rune Wars"), a party of soldiers accompanied by an ambitious sorceress visited the garden and were attacked by the plants. In an act of fear, the sorceress unleashed a magical attack that ignited the fumes of the swamp, causing a magical explosion that destroyed everything in its path. The gardens remained lifeless for hundreds of years after.

### Contemporary history

After centuries without life in the gardens, Zyra emerged from the lifeless ground, not fully plant nor fully human. She struggled to understand her new existence and came to be curious of the new world she was able to explore.

Her plants seem to be slowly expanding westward towards the [Mother of Life](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mother_of_Life_River "Mother of Life River") river system of the [Shurima Capital](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Sun_Disc "The Sun Disc").

### With the Flowers

Zyra's flowers were collected by a flower shop in the market city of [Kumangra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kumangra "Kumangra"). The owner watered one of the flowers and placed it in his study. From the flower bloomed a large mass of vines and flowers that covered the entire study and wrapped the shop owner into a cocoon, killing him. After the shop owner's wife found him, Zyra appeared in the study, stopping the wife from destroying the flower and wrapping her in a cocoon, killing her. As the woman died, she saw visions of a world covered in Zyra's plants with nothing else in sight.
structure.appearance: Zyra is a wondrous vision of a creature, resembling a human woman covered with plants, which seem to be parts of her body. Her eyes are very similar to a panther's, with narrow irises that are common to predators.
structure.personality: Zyra is a vicious, predatory creature. In spite of gaining human intelligence, Zyra still has the natural instinct of consuming and devouring of a vicious predator. Her ultimate goal is to envelop the world with her plants, making it beautiful and ridding it of all that isn't her.
structure.abilities:
- **Unique Physiology:** Zyra is a hybrid of human and plant, something the world has never seen before. She was created on a magical accident during the Rune Wars, a disastrous explosion that mixed the natural elemental magics of  [Ixtal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ixtal "Universe:Ixtal")'s swamps and the careless spells of an unnamed sorceress.
- **Nature Magic:** Zyra can create plant life as she sees fit, and is able to create  [vines](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zyra#Grasping_Roots "Zyra"),  [thorn spitter flowers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zyra#Deadly_Spines "Zyra"), and other types of plants.
  - **Infection:** The spores in Zyra's plants can infect humans and grow into full blooming plants, killing them from the inside.
  - **Pseudo-Teleportation:** Zyra is able to reform wherever her  [flowers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zyra#Garden_of_Thorns "Zyra") have taken root.

relations.relationship_description: She thinks of humans as no little more than prey and thinks they show no respect to the environments they live.
She has expressed animosity towards spirits and thinks they are arrogant.

structure.trivia:
**Zyra, Rise of the Thorns**

- Zyra came to be during a magical catastrophe made by an exploring party from a long-forgotten kingdom during the [Rune Wars](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rune_Wars "Rune Wars"). She doesn't quite understand the world and has yet to demonstrate if she is more rational than instinctive.

**Original Zyra**

- Zyra wants to explore the world she glimpsed when consuming the sorceress, as well as to adapt to her new form, the fragility of which makes basic survival all the more important.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
- Zyra (the predatory plant who relishes her new form) looks down on  [Maokai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Maokai "Universe:Maokai") (the guardian nature spirit who laments his own) and yet they might be the only ones able to show each other the merits of their newfound bodies.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
- Zyra might show some interest in  [Ahri](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ahri "Universe:Ahri") considering the commonality in their acquisition of a humanoid form, but otherwise the Fox is merely a many-tailed snack.[[3]](#cite_note-3)

structure.name: Kled
structure.quote: *"A sane man would run... but I ain't the runnin' kind!"*
structure.background: (TBA)
structure.appearance: Kled is a slender, pale-furred yordle with short white pointy teeth and a violent eye. His robes are composed of a red ribbon holding his hair, a (sometimes invisible) piercing on his left ear, a hat with a steel spike pointing upwards on the front and two arrows pointing forward on the top of the hat, steel shoulder pads, leather sleeves, steel bracelets, a red belt, leather boots with steel plates, and other garments with a distinct palette of red, teal, brown and grey. The most distinctive ornaments of his attire are an axe, a gun, and a hat.[[1]](#cite_note-1) He also has a scar on his face where his right eye used to be.
structure.personality:
Kled is a stereotypical hillbilly, with a distaste for "city folk" and a fierce sense of independence from society. Paranoid and territorial, Kled views all of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") as his property, and will gladly kill anyone he views as a trespasser. Though Kled doesn't answer to the [Trifarix](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Trifarix "Trifarix"), he has fought alongside and inspired Noxian forces with his fearless and violent attitude for many centuries, and has been decorated with many honors. Because of his military titles (which may or may not be made up), Kled takes pride in his accomplishments and uses them as a means to prove his superiority over others.

Kled is very unfriendly, cursing often and is prone to violent outbursts and shouting. Kled shows a greedy side with his insistence on claiming land, and often places signs marking "Property of Kled" whenever he thinks something is his. Because of his short temper, he constantly berates his [Drakalops](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Drakalops "Drakalops") steed,  [Skaarl](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Skaarl "Universe:Skaarl"), for her cowardly and unreliable nature. However, Kled does have a soft spot for his untrusty steed, and is overjoyed whenever she returns to help him in battle. Though his chaotic nature makes others wonder if Kled is mentally unstable, Kled considers himself to be a genius.
structure.abilities:
- **Yordle Physiology:** Kled is a Yordle, (a being from the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm")) and possesses several abilities natural to his species.
  - **Immortality:** Being spiritual beings, Yordles don't age the same way as normal humans, and cannot die naturally.
  - **Yordle Magic:** Just like any [Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), Kled is capable of performing yordle magic, which he utilizes in tandem with his skills as a soldier.

relations.relationship_description: Kled believes  [Darius](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darius "Universe:Darius") has a nice axe and should learn to use it.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

Kled considers  [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina") to have no moxie and to be no more sinister than  [Skaarl's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Skaarl "Universe:Skaarl") farts.[[3]](#cite_note-3)
Kled almost likes  [Riven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Riven "Universe:Riven"), because she is a pure noxian girl.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

Kled fought alongside  [Sion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion") back when Sion still lived, but doesn't think much of the new undead abomination.[[5]](#cite_note-5)

Kled considers everyone (including himself, bizarrely) his rival and he sees  [Skaarl](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Skaarl "Universe:Skaarl") as his only friend.[[6]](#cite_note-OldKledPage-6)

Though they are cute, Kled considers yordles to be unwanted guests, and does not feel remorse for killing them, nor for feeding them to  [Skaarl](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Skaarl "Universe:Skaarl").[[7]](#cite_note-7)

structure.trivia:
- Kled's name resembles Welsh noun *cledd(yf)* /kleːð(ɨv)/ "sword", from Proto-Celtic *\*kladiwos*
  - *Kladiwos* might have been loaned into Latin as [gladius](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/gladius), or both come from same [PIE](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proto-Indo-European_languages) root *\*kelh₂-* "to strike"[[8]](#cite_note-8) (compare  [Brand](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Brand "Universe:Brand")'s  [Pyro***clasm***](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Brand#Pyroclasm "Brand"))
- Skaarl is from a species called drakalops, immortal, unkillable wind spirits that embody the desolation of the Noxian Plains.[[9]](#cite_note-9)
  - Kled's posters call Skaarl the 'pride of Noxus' and a 'decorated veteran of the battle of Bucket Creek', with the drakalops' gender changing depending on the poster; Kled knows that Skaarl is female, yet unaware of the posters' conundrum.
- Kled is over 1000 years old, older than  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") itself as he was present among the Noxii during the Rune War and possibly even earlier than that. He has become a myth and an icon of the empire, even though most are not aware of his true appearance and the fact that he is a [Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle").
  - The battle of [Drugne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Drugne "Drugne") happened around some point between the year 0 and 400.[[10]](#cite_note-10)
    - The General participating in the battle was a member of House Zaavan, which  [Elise](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Elise "Universe:Elise") became a Matron of at some point.
- Kled's relation with Noxus draws parallels with  [Poppy's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Poppy "Universe:Poppy") relation to the founding of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") and a hero's reputation, although Poppy's name is not known.
- Kled is the most distinguished military person to ever live, although most of his titles are made up and/or self-proclaimed.
- Kled's 'mushroom juice' may be derived from the ones  [Teemo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Teemo "Universe:Teemo") uses for his  [traps](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Teemo#Noxious_Trap "Teemo").
- Kled's old champion page featured  [Skaarl](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Skaarl "Skaarl") as his only friend and all [League of Legends](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/League_of_Legends "League of Legends") champions, including himself, as rivals.[[6]](#cite_note-OldKledPage-6)

structure.name: Bolbok
structure.background:
### Early Life

At some point during his life, Bolbok obtained a seat on the Council of Piltover. He also developed a fear of the arcane, as his entire race was apparently almost annihilated by magic.[[2]](#cite_note-102mysteries-2)

### Councilor of Piltover

#### Discovery of Hextech

When the workshop of  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") was robbed and blown up in the process, his unauthorized research into the Arcane was exposed and he was put on trial to be judged by the Council. Bolbok moved to banish Jayce, but  [Heimerdinger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger") convinced him and the other councilors to expel him from the Academy and destroy his ["hextech"](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") research instead. After this, Bolbok and the other councilors ordered the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") to begin a large-scale search of the  [undercity](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") to find the thieves responsible for the robbery, and he ordered  [Sheriff Grayson](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Grayson "Universe:Grayson") to "turn the undercity upside down" if necessary.

Later, with the help of  [Mel Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), Jayce perfected his research in Heimerdinger's laboratory, and the Council gave him the authority to continue working on it. In time, Bolbok became one of the many nobles in Piltover to benefit from Jayce and Viktor's creation of the Hexgate.[[3]](#cite_note-3)[[4]](#cite_note-4)

#### Piltovan Bicentennial

After  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") stole a hextech gemstone from Jayce and Viktor's lab, Bolbok supported Mel's idea to add Jayce to their table as a councilor, fearful that hextech might be weaponized against them. The vote backfired on Bolbok when Jayce began investigating the other councilors and powerful guild merchants for corruption, and Bolbok was one of many politicians who began to plot against Jayce. Jayce won back Bolbok's favor by forging a business deal with him, and as a result, Bolbok eventually supported Jayce when he moved to expel Heimerdinger from the Council and force the [yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yordle "Universe:Yordle") into early retirement.

Following Jinx's second attack on Piltover and the discovery of  [Marcus'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus") treasonous actions against them, the Council convened to discuss their next move. There, they learned from  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"), a rookie Enforcer and  [Cassandra's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassandra "Universe:Cassandra") daughter, about the all the horrible things she'd seen in the undercity and how  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") was responsible for almost all of them. Although Jayce wanted to go into the undercity and retrieve his stolen hextech gemstone by force, the other councilors, including Bolbok, disagreed out of the fear of triggering a war with the underground and decided to negotiate with Silco instead.[[5]](#cite_note-5)

### Death

After he ventured into the undercity to take down a [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") production factory, Jayce later informed the council that he had offered Silco the undercity's independence in exchange for the hextech gemstone and Jinx. Although Bolbok quickly objected to his proposal, he eventually agreed to it after Mel supported the motion, alongside the other councilors. However, before the councilors could finalize their decision to grant  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") its independence, the Council room was bombed by Jinx with  [Fishbones](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Switcheroo! "Jinx"), her signature rocket launcher.[[6]](#cite_note-6) Bolbok was one of the three councilors alongside  [Hoskel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hoskel "Universe:Hoskel") and  [Cassandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassandra "Universe:Cassandra") to perish in the subsequent explosion, with the blast having separated his head from his body. His funeral was held shortly afterwards and he was eventually immortalized alongside his fellow fallen councilors by a memorial statue in Piltover.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
structure.appearance: Bolbok's race is a gaseous species that inhabits a tall, imposing [mechanical golem](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Golem "Universe:Golem") made a golden bronze metal, piloting its movements from within. He speaks in delayed tones through metal gears and valves, with his movements slightly rigid. As an aristocrat, he wears fine  [Piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") clothing with blue fabric and gold trimming, and a tall collar to match his long neck.
structure.personality: Like the stereotypical politician, Bolbok was a shallow and prideful individual who cared for little else aside from his own wealth and power. He was also noticeably short-sighted, as displayed by how he initially refused to believe that Silco was a criminal even though it was obvious that Marcus had been covering for him the whole time. Mel even went as far to tell  [Amara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Amara "Universe:Amara") that Bolbok was a fool and that if she ended up doing business with him, the only thing she'd wind up doing was "investing in the past."[[8]](#cite_note-8)
structure.abilities: - **Diplomacy:** As a member of the Council, Bolbok would frequently discuss backroom deals with  [Piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") merchants like  [Amara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Amara "Universe:Amara"). This granted Bolbok a great deal of influence over Piltovan trade, and he would exercise his power using the law enforcement, especially against the undercity.

relations.relationship_description: After Jayce's illegal experiments into [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") were discovered, Bolbok was the first to suggest Jayce's banishment from  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and refused to relent from this position.[[9]](#cite_note-9) Several years later, after the Hexgate had made the Piltovan upper classes rich, Bolbok seemed to come around to the idea of hextech and came to respect Jayce's scientific expertise, but still doubted his political experience. Eventually, Jayce won Bolbok's support along with the other councilors. He ended up supporting Jayce's proposals to oust  [Heimerdinger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger") and grant the undercity its independence.

Bolbok was frequently seen conversing with Amara, with the two of them later said to have been discussing matters related to trade. Bolbok attempted to turn the Piltovan merchant against Jayce, but ultimately failed to do so.

As they were both members of the Council, Bolbok interacted with Mel regularly and seemed to be swayed by her influence, voting Heimerdinger off the Council and ultimately voting in favor of granting the undercity their independence, even though he was initially reluctant to take either position. Mel was shown to have a low opinion of Bolbok, calling him a "fool". After Bolbok's death, Mel delivered a eulogy for him in her public statement, expressing regret over his passing.

Bolbok was highly unsympathetic to the plight of the undercity, referring to them as "trenchers" and suggesting that  [Grayson](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Grayson "Universe:Grayson") and  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus") crack down harshly on their population. He was concerned when  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") stole the hextech crystal, worrying the undercity might develop it into a weapon. He reacted with outrage when Jayce and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") proposed granting the undercity their independence from Piltover, but was eventually convinced to support the measure by  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel"). Bolbok would soon meet his end at the hands of the undercity after Jinx fired her rocket into the Council chamber.

While Bolbok was always suspicious of the undercity, he was unconvinced of the level of Silco's criminal organization, having been deceived by Piltover's corrupt sheriff,  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus").

structure.background:
### Early Life

Singed was once a revered  [Piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") scholar named **Dr. Corin Reveck**, an unrivaled genius and alchemist at Piltover Academy. Singed was a respected colleague of  [Professor Cecil B. Heimerdinger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger"), and he had a daughter named  [Orianna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna") whom he loved very dearly. However, Orianna would pass away due to unknown causes, and he turned to increasingly unethical and inhumane methods in his attempts to save her life. These experiments ultimately cost him the respect of  [Piltover's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") scientific community, including Heimerdinger, and he was eventually dismissed from the Academy with no mention of his crime.[[1]](#cite_note-205blisters-1) As a direct result of this, Singed would leave both Piltover and Heimerdinger, moving to a new laboratory in  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun").[[2]](#cite_note-107boy-2)

### Disgrace and Exile

#### The Waverider Mutation

Singed would continue his research, now seeking a way to bring his daughter back from death. He built his new lab in a hidden cave, where he kept his daughter  [Orianna's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna") body preserved within a [chemtech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chemtech "Universe:Chemtech") pod in a secret room, where he would sometimes read her bedtime stories.[[3]](#cite_note-206message-3) At a certain point, Singed cultivated a [waverider](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Waverider "Universe:Waverider") specimen named Rio, who had a rare mutation that was beneficial for his research.

One day while he was working with Rio, Singed met a young boy named  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), who had stumbled across his laboratory by the Sump waters. Impressed by a mechanical toy boat that Viktor had built, Singed introduced Viktor to Rio, and explained that he was looking for a way to extend her life. Viktor initially offered to help Singed to save the creature. However, Singed's method in keeping Rio alive involved a series of implants that left her in a constant state of pain, which drove the boy away, leaving Singed alone once again in his pursuits.[[4]](#cite_note-106walls-4)

#### The Invention of Shimmer

Several years after  [Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") became the de-facto leader of the undercity, Singed was hired by a local Zaunite gangster named  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco"), who was attempting to start a violent rebellion against Piltover. Silco was interested in raising an army of physically-augmented soldiers to start his rebellion, and to this end, Singed invented an addictive superhuman drug called [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer"). While initially testing shimmer on rats,[[5]](#cite_note-101welcome-5) the doctor would soon move on to human experimentation by testing it on Silco's least favorite henchman at the time,  [Deckard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Deckard "Universe:Deckard").[[6]](#cite_note-102mysteries-6) The experiment was a success, and the serum was capable of transforming Deckard into a hulking, monstrous mutant for a limited period of time. However, during Silco's battle against Vander, the entire factory would be destroyed by Vander's daughter,  [Powder](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), who was attempting to save him. Singed was caught in the explosion[[7]](#cite_note-103base-7) and suffered severe burns on the right and lower halves of his face, leaving him physically-scarred and forcing him to wear bandages to cover the ruined parts of his skin.

At some point after the battle, Singed collected the bodies of several people who had perished in Silco's factory for his research, including the bodies of Vander and Deckard, who were both heavily-infused with shimmer. The doctor kept Deckard's head in a jar[[8]](#cite_note-Deckard's_head_in_Singed's_lab-8), and kept Vander's body hanging from chains on his laboratory's ceiling for later use.[[9]](#cite_note-109monster-9)

### Piltovan Bicentennial

In the following years,  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") was able to solidify control over the undercity and its  [chembarons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chembarons "Universe:Chembarons"), fueling his empire with Singed's [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") concoction, which had been refined and perfected over time as a commodified, illegal drug.[[10]](#cite_note-104progress-10) Singed continued to work for Silco during this time, and would sometimes be called upon for his scientific expertise.[[11]](#cite_note-105enemy-11)

One day, Singed received a visit from his former pupil,  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), who had become an inventor in  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and was turning to increasingly desperate measures for his scientific experiments. Viktor wanted to consult the doctor on a quandary regarding his latest [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") invention, the  [hexcore](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viktor#Arcane_Storm "Viktor"), which he hoped might hold the key to augmenting human physiology. Singed took an interest in Viktor's hexcore and agreed to help him, giving him a vial of shimmer that would help Viktor to test the device's capabilities on himself and cure his terminal illness.[[2]](#cite_note-107boy-2)

Later, when  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") was mortally wounded in her battle with  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko"), Silco took her to Singed to perform a life-saving surgery. Using a highly experimental shimmer procedure, he was able to save her life and enhance her physical abilities to superhuman levels. However, the procedure also exacerbated her mental instability and hallucinations, permanently changing her eye color to pink. Singed sedated Silco so he would not interfere with the procedure, and when he regained consciousness, Jinx was gone. Silco threatened the doctor and demanded to know what he'd done. Singed simply replied that he had saved her life.[[12]](#cite_note-108oil-12)

### The Wrath of Zaun

#### Engineering the Nightmare

After  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") death, Singed went to examine the body of  [Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"),[[9]](#cite_note-109monster-9) which he had transformed into a savage chimeric beast known as  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") through a series of long and painful experiments. Singed had been able to revive Vander using a combination of [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer"), [chemtech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chemtech "Universe:Chemtech") implants,[[13]](#cite_note-203finally-13) and [murk wolf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Murk_Wolf "Universe:Murk Wolf") DNA,[[14]](#cite_note-201heavy-14)[[15]](#cite_note-202watch-15) which triggered a gruesome and unnatural mutation within the specimen. Vander's extraordinary will to live made him an invaluable subject, and his blood developed regenerative properties as a result of his mutation, at the cost of his mind. Singed attempted to recover Vander's mind, but was unable to find the right catalyst. Still, he considered this experiment to be a remarkable success, believing Warwick's blood held the final key toward his ultimate goal of finding a cure to death.[[1]](#cite_note-205blisters-1)

With Silco dead and the other  [chembarons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chembarons "Universe:Chembarons") gone, Singed was lacking a sponsor for his research and began to roam the streets of the undercity. He came upon  [Sevika's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") rally, where he observed as she and  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha") attempted to unite the  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights"), Jinxers, and chemgoons whose bosses had been eliminated. The rally was quickly busted by a squad of  [Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Wardens "Universe:Piltover Wardens") and  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") soldiers led by  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"), the right-hand man of General  [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"). Most of the chemgoons, Jinxers, and Firelights were captured by the authorities.[[16]](#cite_note-204paint-16)

Though he could have attempted to escape, Singed instead allowed himself to be captured, cutting his palm with a scalpel. The blood dripping from Singed's hand awakened his beast, who broke free from Singed's laboratory and followed Singed's scent, which led directly to Stillwater Hold. After  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") eventually broke Isha and the other prisoners free, Singed locked his cell back up to protect himself from Warwick's rampage,[[16]](#cite_note-204paint-16) and he watched with interest as Vander's mind flickered with the recognition of his daughter. The two of them eventually got away, and Singed was the only prisoner left on the entire floor.[[1]](#cite_note-205blisters-1)

#### Service to Ambessa Medarda

Following the trail of blood,  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") quickly deduced Singed as the culprit responsible for Warwick's attack on Stillwater, and she interrogated him, demanding to know his connection to Jinx. Singed did not crack under the pressure, reacting coldly and indifferently to the young commander's threats. After he'd been returned to his cell, Singed was approached by Ambessa, who was interested in recruiting him so she might use his chemtech weapons and mutant abominations. Singed, who was interested in a new sponsor for his research, accepted Ambessa's proposal and began to engineer a means to figure out Warwick's location.

As Singed was working in his laboratory, Caitlyn ran an investigation into Singed's past, discovering his true identity as Dr. Reveck, a disgraced Piltovan alchemist whose crimes were too unspeakable to be kept on record. Under threat of being killed, Singed showed Caitlyn and Ambessa to the secret room where he kept his daughter, and he explained that his life's work was to find a cure for death so she might live again.[[1]](#cite_note-205blisters-1) Ambessa took an interest in Singed's "cure to death", and her army made plans to recapture Warwick so they could use him as both a weapon and a specimen to complete Singed's research.[[17]](#cite_note-208killing-17)

#### The Transfusion

Using a small chemtech device of his own construction, Singed was able to track Warwick to a large underground [commune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Church_of_the_Glorious_Evolved "Universe:Church of the Glorious Evolved") that was ruled by a Herald with healing powers, whom Singed quickly deduced was actually  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), who had been transformed by the  [hexcore's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viktor#Arcane_Storm "Viktor") power. Though Ambessa had brought an entire army, Singed offered to negotiate on her behalf, and found Viktor, who was attempting to heal Warwick's mind. The doctor explained that the hexcore's power was limited and that in order for Viktor to survive, he would have to use a transfusion of Warwick's blood, which contained regenerative properties. A combination of apex hextech with apex shimmer would theoretically complete both Viktor's transformation and Singed's long-sought "cure to death"; however, Viktor refused Singed's offer, as it would destroy any chance of rescuing Vander's humanity from within the beast.

As the negotiations had failed, Singed reported back to Ambessa and formed a new plan, where he would inject Warwick with a  [serum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Singed#Insanity_Potion "Singed") that would prevent Viktor from restoring Vander's sanity. Singed was accompanied by Caitlyn, who would suddenly betray and incapacitate him, preventing him from injecting Warwick with the serum. However,  [Jayce's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") sudden attack on Viktor caused Warwick to become enraged anyway, and Singed would watch the battle unfold from the burning wreckage of Viktor's commune.[[3]](#cite_note-206message-3)

After the battle, Singed treated the wounded. While Singed was unable to save Rictus, he was able to sustain Viktor by suspending his body in a large purple sphere sustained by shimmer and chemtech tubes, which he attached to Warwick's unconscious body. When Viktor regained consciousness, he thanked Singed for saving his life, speaking through the collapsed bodies of his followers. Singed observed as Viktor transformed the body of  [Huck](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Huck "Universe:Huck") into a metal puppet, and he later assisted in the full transformation of Viktor and his followers by completing the aforementioned transfusion of Warwick's blood using the serum, which erased Vander's memories.[[17]](#cite_note-208killing-17) For Ambessa's invasion of Piltover, Singed would provide her army with massive amounts of shimmer, which would physically-enhance a large number of her soldiers.[[18]](#cite_note-209dirt-18)

### Curing Death

At some point after the battle, after  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") were both gone, Singed finally completed his cure to death, and after administering this cure,  [Orianna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna") awoke in a new [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") body. Singed presented his daughter with a number of gifts, including a music box, a flower with a ribbon, and a wooden horse. Orianna looked at none of these items, instead staring blankly at her own reflection in the mirror.[[18]](#cite_note-209dirt-18)
structure.appearance:
Singed was a tall but extremely thin and pale-skinned, elderly man with balding chestnut hair, brown eyes, and an underbite with crooked teeth. The doctor always wore the same simple green and burgundy clothes, with a plain brown lab coat that hung below his waist. The fire that destroyed Silco's factory burned off all Singed's hair and left many scars over his entire body, especially the right and lower halves of his face, with his lips seared and peeling away and his right eye glowing a sickly green color. After this, Singed started wearing bandages on his face, arms, and torso to cover up the burns and missing skin, as well as a wide burgundy scarf to cover his ruined mouth and nose like a tall collar above his old lab coat. He would also wear a matching metal pauldron over his left shoulder, as well as belts to carry many vials of green chemical liquids.

The doctor often carried a scalpel that could be used as a weapon, and would sometimes bring with him a large glass canister over his shoulder to be used for his experiments. He also carried with him a large circular locket with his  [daughter's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna") portrait, which he would sometimes hold open in his palm.
structure.personality:
Singed has grown to have little faith in humanity, believing ethics to be nothing more than a roadblock to true progress. This cynical mindset was likely developed following the death of his daughter  [Orianna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna") and the ostracization he received from  [Piltover's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") scientific community during his efforts to save her. Singed is very secretive when dealing with others, never divulging his name even to those whom he's worked with closely, including  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco"), and as a result most simply refer to him as "doctor". Still, Singed is proven to make good on his promises, serving both Silco and  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") until their respective deaths.

Despite his callous demeanor, Singed was not always heartless, as he used to have genuinely good intentions since he wanted his experiments to save lives. He felt a sincere kinship with  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") due to their similar pasts as "loners" with a fascination for science, and after the bicentennial Progress Day, helped him try to find a way to cure his illness even though the two of them had not seen each other in years. He was also shown to love and mourn Orianna, and gave Silco a sedative before operating on  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") so he wouldn't have to watch his own daughter suffer. Upon being taken to Stillwater, Singed even offered words of encouragement to  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha"), a complete stranger, and he later expressed regret at his own inability to save  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus") from the wounds he sustained from  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"). Despite this, Singed remained willing to commit "unspeakable" acts in the name of his goal, torturing animals and people for his violent experiments, and working for any criminal or warmonger who offered a fair price for his services.

While there are many geniuses within Piltover and  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), the biggest trait that separates Singed from the rest is his patience. He has lived an extraordinarily long life as a result of his chemically-enhanced biology, and with his age he has learned to act deliberately and with focus, and very rarely making mistakes where others would. This allows Singed to treat every unexpected outcome as less of a despairing defeat and more an experiment in itself, improving on successes while learning from failures, but always making steady progress towards the ultimate goal of his research.
structure.abilities:
- **Chemically Enhanced Physiology:** Despite his advanced age, Singed has chemically-altered his own biology in order to continue his research without loss of energy or interruptions.
- **Doctor:** Singed is an infamous doctor in  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") whose medical procedures are responsible for saving the lives of many, including  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"),  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"), and  [Orianna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna"). He is a skilled surgeon and is able to deploy sedatives and medicines by injection as necessary, which can make both patients and enemies alike lose consciousness. The doctor's treatments are painful and highly-experimental, but often yield results, with a few exceptions. Singed's life's work was to find a cure for death; a goal he would eventually achieve through many decades of painstaking research.
- **Alchemist:** Singed was once one of the most respected alchemists in all of Piltover and is the inventor of numerous potions and chemical concoctions, most of which are engineered toward the goal of human transmutation or the augmentation of human life. Some of the mutant abominations credited to his ability are [Rio](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Waverider "Universe:Waverider") and  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"). While he specializes in chemtech, Singed is also proven to have a grasp of [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech"), having developed a keen understanding of Viktor's hexcore by simply looking through his notes. Singed is able to combine hextech and chemtech to unprecedented results.
  - **[Shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer"):** Singed's most infamous invention, it is a drug-like serum known for enhancing human biology, including physical strength and healing. Shimmer is a potent substance but is highly-addictive, and people who take it frequently suffer withdrawals from its use. Singed generally uses its effects to empower  [others](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Deckard "Universe:Deckard"), or to enable the transformations of his scientific subjects.
  - **[Poisons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Singed#Poison_Trail "Singed"):** Singed keeps bottles of chemical poisons on his person, which he can release as a noxious green gas. Using this, Singed is able to subdue deadly foes such as [murk wolves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Murk_Wolf "Universe:Murk Wolf") all on his own.
  - **[Injected Serum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Singed#Insanity_Potion "Singed"):** Singed developed a serum that would induce madness into his mutant creation, Warwick, and erase his memories. The serum was injected into Warwick during a blood transfusion which seemingly killed him; however, it was later revealed that Warwick survived the transfusion and regenerated into a mindless, savage state.
- **Inventor:** While Singed specializes biochemistry, he is also skilled at constructing mechanical devices, including a large number of chemtech machinery and implants and an intricate, custom-made key and music box which he keeps hidden with a locket with his  [daughter's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna") portrait. Singed is able to recognize great craftsmanship at a glance, shown when he examines the young Viktor's toy boat.

relations.relationship_description:
Singed is Orianna's father, and he loved her very much. She died a long time ago to unknown causes, and Singed would turn to increasingly disturbing and extreme methods to cure and resurrect her. These experiments would cause Singed to be cast out from the  [Piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") academic community, but he appeared to have no regrets in the matter, believing his daughter's life far outweighed his legacy and reputation. His love would become an obsession, and there was soon no line Singed would not cross in the name of completing his research.

Singed kept his daughter's body in a chemtech preservation pod within a secret, well-kept room, where he would sometimes go to read bedtime stories to her. This room could only be unlocked by a key that was hidden in a locket with Orianna's portrait, which would play a haunting lullaby from a music box hidden inside. Singed would carry this key with him always, listening to the melody while looking at his daughter's portrait. His research towards this "cure to death" led to the creation of  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), whose blood he then used to evolve  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"). Singed's attempts to revive Orianna were eventually successful, and she awoke in a new [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") body.

Singed and Heimerdinger used to be colleagues at Piltover Academy and as a result, it can be assumed they were once close. However, as Heimerdinger could not bring himself to accept Singed's increasingly depraved experiments to cure his  [daughter's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna") death, and as a result Singed was dismissed from the Academy with no mention of his crime. Currently, the two scientists do not associate themselves with each other, and it's not clear as to whether Heimerdinger even knows that Singed is still alive.

Singed met Viktor by the Sump waters one day and seemed to view the young boy as a kindred spirit, as both a "loner" and a "gifted mind" like he was. The doctor soon took Viktor on as a pupil and would send him to collect materials which would help to save Rio's life. However, their relationship eventually fell apart when Viktor discovered the disturbing methods Singed was using to keep Rio alive, prompting the boy to abandon Singed and go off on his own. Despite this, Viktor still respected Singed for his expertise as a scientist, and eventually came to understand the reasons for Singed's methods as he too became desperate, looking for a means to cure his terminal illness. Although he had not seen Viktor in years, Singed was still willing to aid him, and took a keen interest in Viktor's  [hexcore](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viktor#Arcane_Storm "Viktor") research, while also warning him about the ostracization he'd receive by going through with his dangerous self-experimentation. After Viktor's hexcore had successfully transformed him, Singed was eager to meet with Viktor again, urging him to sacrifice  [Warwick's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") humanity and stabilize himself through a transfusion of his blood, claiming that Viktor's survival was paramount, as was the completion of his work. Viktor seemed to be aware that Singed was only truly after a cure for his  [daughter](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna"), and initially rejected Singed's proposal.

After Singed saved Viktor's life, Viktor expressed his gratitude as well as his admiration for the doctor's ingenuity. Viktor would soon change his mind about saving Warwick and requested Singed begin the process of his transformation, and Singed sacrificed Vander's memories to remove the limits on Viktor's power. They presumably parted on good terms.

Singed and Silco had a typical business relationship, but Silco's position as a criminal kingpin led him to distrust Singed, as he kept the [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") gemstone from him despite respecting his scientific expertise. Singed was the inventor of [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer"), which became the drug that fueled Silco's empire, and he had a great deal of faith in his abilities, as displayed when he immediately brought  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") to him to heal her after she suffered severe injuries. During the surgery, Singed forcibly injected Silco with sedatives to stop him from seeing the agony Jinx would suffer during the operation, with Singed revealing that he too was a father. When Silco regained consciousness, he attacked Singed with his own scalpel, but let him live when the doctor explained that the procedure had saved Jinx's life.

After Silco's death, and the deaths of the other  [chembarons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chembarons "Universe:Chembarons"), Singed would lose his primary source of funding and would eventually seek employment by the  [Noxians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus").

Singed and Jinx both served  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") during his reign as kingpin of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), with Jinx being familiar enough with the doctor to believe he'd be capable of reverse-engineering  [Jayce's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") notes to weaponize [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech"). When Silco rushed to his lab to save Jinx, Singed warned him that the procedure that could save her would force her into lots of physical and mental pain, or die in the worst-case scenario. When Silco insisted, Singed performed the procedure to save her as he asked, though he callously reminded her of the pain she had to go through rather than reassuring her as he injected chemicals into her.

Singed would later meet Jinx again in Stillwater Hold, where she would battle Singed's beast,  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"). Singed did not converse with Jinx during this time and simply locked the door to his cell, and as he observed how Warwick reacted around her, he realized that she was the missing catalyst he'd been looking for to restore  [Vander's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") mind.

Singed collected  [Vander's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") body sometime after the latter's battle with  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco"), which had heavily infused with and mutated by [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer"). Singed would run experiments on Vander for a number of years, combining him with the blood of [murk wolves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Murk_Wolf "Universe:Murk Wolf") and [chemtech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chemtech "Universe:Chemtech") implants to transform him into a hulking, savage beast known as Warwick. While Singed was responsible for torturing Vander with his experiments, he also expressed pity for him as a "victim of great tragedy", and had been looking for the right catalyst to recover his mind. Even so, Warwick held perhaps the final key for the cure to death Singed had been developing for  [Orianna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna"), and he was more than willing to torture a respected man to achieve this goal.

As his creator, Singed was able to summon Warwick by weaponizing his  [blood tracking](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Warwick#Blood_Hunt "Warwick") ability, which he used with deadly efficacy against the  [Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Enforcers "Universe:Enforcers") at Stillwater Hold. Once Singed fell into  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") service, he attempted to track and capture Warwick so that this "weapon" could be used to her benefit instead. Singed was later willing to erase Vander's memories to complete  [Viktor's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") transformation into the Herald, seeing it as an opportunity to combine apex [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") and apex [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") and complete both their life's work. After the transfusion was complete, Singed no longer needed Warwick and handed him off to Viktor, who had transformed the beast into part of his evolved army.

Singed met Ambessa in Stillwater Hold, after the prison was attacked by his beast,  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"). Realizing he was the mastermind behind the attack, Ambessa and  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") interrogated him for information, and when he would not crack, Ambessa decided to recruit the doctor to have full, unfettered access to his [chemtech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chemtech "Universe:Chemtech") weapons and scientific expertise. Singed was treated as a trusted advisor by Ambessa, and he would both promise her the cure to death he'd been seeking for his daughter and hunt down his beast for her, negotiating on Ambessa's behalf to make sure Warwick would remain useful to her in his savage, mindless state. Singed appeared to be obedient to Ambessa, but not afraid of her, only working for her because it was both convenient for him and she had promised to support his research. He would use his medical knowledge to try to treat the injuries of those Ambessa's warband, including  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"), whom he was unable to save.

When Ambessa expressed interest in acquiring an army of  [Viktor's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") puppet followers, Singed helped to complete their transformation. He also supplied Ambessa with a large amount of shimmer to empower her soldiers for her assault on  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), suggesting he continued to serve Ambessa up until her death.

Caitlyn and Singed have a hostile relationship, as she believes he is a "monster" responsible for countless deaths, due to the  [chemtech beast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") he created and unleashed on Stillwater. While initially suspecting he might be connected to  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), Caitlyn soon ran an investigation into Singed's past and learned he was someone far worse: the disgraced Dr. Reveck, whose crimes were too unspeakable to be kept on record. After she threatened him, Singed showed Caitlyn to his daughter's secret room, believing that she and  [Orianna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Orianna "Universe:Orianna") might have been friends in another life. They worked together briefly in collaboration with Ambessa, until Caitlyn switched sides and joined  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), incapacitating Singed. They would likely be enemies if they met again.
