structure.name: Darius
structure.quote: *"History only remembers the victors. Stand with  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), and be remembered forever."*
structure.background:
### Childhood

Born in [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Basilich "Universe:Basilich"), Darius was as an orphan alongside his younger brother  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Draven "Draven"). He struggled hard to provide for both himself and his brother and protected the latter from anyone who tried to harm him, even the city guard. Darius spent a majority of his childhood fighting for survival, with constant fights leaving permanent scars on himself. He and Draven were friends with a girl named  [Quilletta Varn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quilletta_Varn "Universe:Quilletta Varn"), whom saved him from falling off a cliff that they were climbing. Darius developed a relationship with Quilletta, having ambitions to conquer the world alongside her.

When an  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") army led by their captain  [Cyrus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cyrus "Universe:Cyrus") invaded Basilich, the three children hid atop a rooftop. Quilletta was reluctant towards the harsh choice between joining Noxus or being killed, but Darius contemplated paying the consequences since he didn't want to leave Draven behind. To his horror, Draven attempted to throw a knife to fight them but ended up hitting Cyrus' flag, leading to the three to get apprehended by the soldiers. After hearing Draven's boasts, Cyrus invited the kids to ally with Noxus.

### In Noxus

Growing to adulthood in Noxus, Darius married Quilletta and became a father to two: Decius and  [Invetia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Invetia_Varn "Universe:Invetia Varn"). He and Draven served as soldiers under Cyrus' warhost, engaging in many war campaigns and stopping rebellions against  [Boram Darkwill's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boram_Darkwill "Universe:Boram Darkwill") throne. Darius quickly rose through the ranks, embodying the values of Noxus through his aggression, bravery and patriotism. In one battle, after a general ordered a retreat, Darius saw him as a coward and beheaded him out of defiance, rallying the fearful troops and securing a victory. He was rewarded by being promoted to senior commander, which attracted many Noxians to join his army but he only accepted those with the greatest strength and discipline. Feared to the point where cities surrendered at the sight of Darius' banners, his victory against the Varju got him promoted to the Hand of Noxus by Darkwill himself.

As the new Hand of Noxus, Darius and his army were sent to the Freljord to conquer it, enduring countless assassination attempts, a conflictive territorial dispute between the [trolls](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Troll "Universe:Troll") under  [Trundle's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trundle "Universe:Trundle") command in the steppes at the borders of the icy lands, and a capture from the  [Winter's Claw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Winter%27s_Claw "Universe:Winter's Claw") before ending in a stalemate after a long, grueling conflict. He headed back to Noxus to request a reconsolidation of the military, but found that Darkwill had been assassinated and usurped by  [Jericho Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), as part of his coup which even Draven had backed. Darius began to respect Swain's accomplishments and was prepared to serve him, but he gave Darius a place in the  [Trifarian Legion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trifarian_Legion "Universe:Trifarian Legion"), representing the Noxian principle of Might alongside Swain as Vision and the Faceless as Guile.

However, Quilletta was starting to become disillusioned towards Noxus after witnessing the horrific aftermath of  [Singed's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") chemical bomb in Ionia, which caused her arm to be amputated as a result of the poison, and their son Decius dying in the campaign against the Freljord. Quilletta expressed her worries to Darius, but he dismissed her saying that Noxus required mercilessness and sacrifice because the empire had to conquer and losing one city would be severely detrimental. Finally having enough, Quilletta snapped from her grief towards Decius' death only to be killed by Invetia, believing her to be weak. Horrified, Darius asked Invetia about her merciless act, and she cited the Noxian philosophy and how she learned it from him.
structure.appearance:
Darius is a large, bulky man with a serious, intense face and middle-aged features. He has fair skin and swept-back black hair with a white streak. His eyes are variously portrayed as either red, green or gray. He also has a long, straight scar over his left eye.

Darius wears heavy full plate armor that leaves only his head and his upper arms exposed. It is dark gray, intricately crafted, and accentuated with spikes around the shoulders and thighs. It also features a long cape and loin cloth, both blood red, symbolizing Noxus.

His weapon of choice is a massive two-handed axe, viciously curved and forged with a symbol of a skull where the blade meets the handle.
structure.personality: Stern and warlike, Darius is unwaveringly dedicated to Noxus and its ideals. He is a soldier without parallel, balancing ruthless mettle with sound strategy. He stands confident and firm, showing no tolerance for weakness or cowardice. Despite his intimidating demeanor, however, Darius is also deeply committed to fostering the strength of others wherever he can find it, elevating those he finds deserving and crushing those who have not earned their status.
structure.abilities:
- **[Master Axeman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darius#Decimate "Darius"):** Through his countless battles within the Noxian campaigns, Darius became very adept at using his battle axe in combat. He became so feared that he would make cities surrender by the mere sight of his banners as well as grant him the miltary title of Hand of Noxus.
- **Extreme Resilience:** From a young age, Darius exhibited remarkable resilience to injury and pain. His body bears the visible scars of numerous battles, a testament to his enduring strength. Born an urchin in [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Basilich "Basilich") and the elder brother to  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven"), Darius had to fight not only to survive but also to provide for his sibling. This innate toughness became even more apparent during his military campaigns.
- **Charisma:** Darius is very charismatic in the eyes of the Noxian troops. After a general ordered a retreat, Darius saw him as a coward and beheaded him out of defiance, rallying the fearful troops and securing a victory. He is also known to accept anyone who is willing and able to fight for their ideals, no matter the cost.

relations.relationship_description: Darius was accoladed by Darkwill, but allied with  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain") because he sees in the Master Tactician someone who can make Noxus rise.

In Darius' eyes  [necromancy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion") is cheating death to justify one's undeserved continued survival.[[1]](#cite_note-1) Yet for him,  [Sion's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion") legacy is an example. Though when he gazes upon the Undead Juggernaut, he sees what might become of himself should he no longer be useful to the empire (or rather, too useful, should death come knocking).[[2]](#cite_note-2)

Darius holds no grudge against  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen"). However, he considers him a fool bound by a meaningless code of "honor." Despite this, he would relish killing  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") simply to prove  [Noxian Might](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darius#Hemorrhage_2 "Darius") crushes all, even Demacian  [Perseverance](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garen#Perseverance "Garen"),  [Courage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garen#Courage "Garen"), and  [Justice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garen#Demacian_Justice "Garen")—especially a paragon of said values.[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Darius and his younger brother  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven") are renowned as the "Blood Brothers." Family ties are strong and can serve as the basis for one's strength, yet Darius sees self-serving aristocrats using theirs as a crutch for their weakness, and as a result, the perpetuation of stagnant leadership that needs to be removed and replaced. With this in mind, one cannot tell if Darius providing and caring for  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven") during their childhood came out of love or even mere pragmatism. The comic *Blood of Noxus* seems to imply the former.

He has 2 children (Decius and  [Invetia Varn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Invetia_Varn "Universe:Invetia Varn")) mothered by his former lover,  [Quilletta Varn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quilletta_Varn "Universe:Quilletta Varn"). They never married given the pragmatism of Noxus, and knowing the likely trajectory of their lives at war.[[4]](#cite_note-4) She was murdered by their daughter  [Invetia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Invetia_Varn "Universe:Invetia Varn") during the [Battle of Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Blood_of_Noxus "Universe:Blood of Noxus").

While it was never explicitly confirmed that they are his children, it was heavily implied due to the relationship between Darius and Quilletta as well as some localizations using terms indicative of blood relation.

Seeing the approval of the slaughtering of innocents by  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") and Emystan made  [Quilletta Varn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quilletta_Varn "Universe:Quilletta Varn") grow more disillusioned about the empire's ambitions, which led her to rebel against the empire, among the other events of the story.

During his campaign in the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord"), Darius fought Trundle and was nearly killed by him. Darius' axe was frozen by Trundle's [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:True_Ice "Universe:True Ice") club, but he was able to use it to knock the king of the trolls unconscious, with his arm becoming injured and frozen in the process.[[5]](#cite_note-Welcome_to_Noxus-5)

During a Black Mist attack caused by  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") at the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion"), Darius was temporarily possessed and fought  [Samira](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Samira "Universe:Samira") before the Mist retreated.

structure.trivia:
- He is between his mid and late 30s.
- **Darius**,  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven"),  [Invetia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Invetia_Varn "Universe:Invetia Varn"), and  [Quilletta Varn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quilletta_Varn "Universe:Quilletta Varn") were all born in [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Basilich "Basilich").
- "*Darius isn't a crazed, bloodthirsty maniac but more of a cold-blooded killer moving through the battlefield with powerful, precise movements and striking with deadly force where it matters most. He takes pride in combat, but there's no primal bloodlust needing to be sated. Unpredictable sadists don't always make for the best commanders.*" — [Harrow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iain_%27Harrow%27_Hendry "Iain 'Harrow' Hendry"), narrative writer for Riot.[[6]](#cite_note-6)
- Darius's *Trifarian Legion* is probably based on the [Triarii](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triarii), the elite unit in the [Roman Republic](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_Republic)'s early period ​legions​s;
  - The stem *Trifar-* is possibly based on [Latin](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Classical_Latin) *trifārius* "in three parts~places" (cf. Sanskrit cognate त्रिधा *tridhā*), from PIE [*\*tri-*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Reconstruction:Proto-Indo-European/tri-)[*dʰóh₁-*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Reconstruction:Proto-Indo-European/d%CA%B0eh%E2%82%81-).[[7]](#cite_note-7)
- Having been raised as an orphan, Darius doesn't care for titles or privileges—only to serve his empire through  [Noxian Might](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darius#Hemorrhage "Darius").[[8]](#cite_note-8)
- His armor and axe were likely made with ore from the [Delverhold](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Delverhold "Universe:The Delverhold") of the [Ironspike Mountains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ironspike_Mountains "Universe:Ironspike Mountains").[[9]](#cite_note-9)

structure.background: As a voidborn, it is made to adapt to its surroundings, consuming any life and adding its essence into its form. The Rift Herald at one point consumed a [Scuttle Crab](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Scuttle_Crab "Scuttle Crab"), taking some of the crabs physical features. It is unclear if there are more than one examples of a rift herald on  [Runeterra Prime](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra_Prime "Universe:Runeterra Prime"), as such it should be considered as an endling sub-species of voidborn.
structure.appearance: The Rift Herald takes on some of the [Scuttle Crab's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Scuttle_Crab "Scuttle Crab") physical features such as the back shell, mandible face area, as well as an affinity to watery areas. Unlike a scuttle crab, it is bipedal, with sharp claws for arms and a long barbed tail. Its body emanates a purple glow common among voidborn.

structure.name: Doran
structure.background:
### Taught by [Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn")

Although the birthplace of Doran remains unknown, he received instruction from the God of the Forge,  [Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn"), prior to journeying to [Wuju](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wuju "Wuju"). This may suggest a potential connection to the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord").

### Life in [Wuju](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wuju "Wuju")

At some point, Doran would travel and settle in [Wuju](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wuju "Wuju"), because only they saw his weapons the same way as he did, a tool not to be used for bloodshed. Though he was once an outsider to the village, Wuju’s smiths and masters had embraced him, so legendary was his skill with hammer and anvil.
Every four seasons, he would make a pilgrimage south of the village, to [Mistfall](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mistfall "Mistfall"), a sacred site of a [long forgotten, ancient battlefield](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Titan_War "Titan War"). He would be accompanied three times by Master Hurong, Yi's master, and later by a young  [Yi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Master_Yi "Universe:Master Yi").

Doran would come to [Mistfall](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mistfall "Mistfall") to leave his blades there as a token of his vow to never again to participate in the violence and bloodshed of war. Since Doran never had the intention for his weapons to be used in war, the spirits of [Mistfall](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mistfall "Mistfall") granted his blades blessings that would last.

At some point, Doran, created a  [Staff](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wukong#Crushing_Blow "Wukong") and the  [Seven Lenses of Insight](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Master_Yi "Universe:Master Yi") and gave them to a now  [Master Yi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Master_Yi "Universe:Master Yi").[[1]](#cite_note-1)

### [Noxian Invasion of Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Noxian_Invasion_of_Ionia "Noxian Invasion of Ionia") and Death

During the [Noxian Invasion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Noxian_Invasion_of_Ionia "Noxian Invasion of Ionia"),  [Master Yi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Master_Yi "Universe:Master Yi") followed by the other masters fought of the Noxian troops and tried to help liberate [Navori](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Navori "Navori"). With the village of [Wuju](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wuju "Wuju") unprotected, it was destroyed by  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") and its chemical weapons it gained from  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), corrupting the land on which it once stood. No villager survived, including Master Doran and Yi's parents, leaving Yi the only original surviving member of  [Wuju Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Wuju_Order "Universe:Wuju Order").
structure.appearance: Doran was a old man with a long white beard and his hair tied up into a bun. He wore a loose yellow robe with red hems, tied togheter with a similarly colored red belt. He wears loose light blue pants and long fingerless gloves in the same color, connected between the middle and ring finger.
structure.personality: Doran showed to be an unkempt, absentminded, and eccentric old man. Even though he carried himself with a certain nonchalance, his more deeper wisdom would sometimes still surface during important moments.
structure.abilities: - **Craftmanship:** Doran is responsible for the creation of several items, such as  [Doran's Blade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Doran%27s_Blade "Doran's Blade"),  [Doran's Lost Blade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Doran%27s_Lost_Blade "Doran's Lost Blade"),  [Doran's Ring](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Doran%27s_Ring "Doran's Ring"),  [Doran's Lost Ring](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Doran%27s_Lost_Ring "Doran's Lost Ring"),  [Doran's Shield](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Doran%27s_Shield "Doran's Shield"),  [Doran's Lost Shield](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Doran%27s_Lost_Shield "Doran's Lost Shield"),  [Doran's Lost Idol](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Doran%27s_Lost_Idol "Doran's Lost Idol"),  [Doran's Staff](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wukong#Crushing_Blow "Wukong") and  [Doran's Seven Lenses of Insight](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Master_Yi "Universe:Master Yi").

relations.relationship_description: Doran trained Master Yi by taking him to [Mistfall](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mistfall "Mistfall"), where he learned how to imbue his weapon with spirit energy.
Doran created Wukong's Staff.
Everything Doran knew about crafting weapons and items, he was allegedly taught by Ornn.

structure.name: Lillia
structure.quote: *"When the humans bloom, it's so beautiful… I can help them! Maybe. Possibly? Perhaps…"*
structure.background:
### Family History

When the  [Freljordian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") barbarian  [Ivern the Cruel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ivern "Universe:Ivern") traveled to [Omikayalan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Omikayalan "Omikayalan") and cut down the God-Willow, several seeds of the ancient tree were dispersed and scattered around  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"). One of these seeds took root in what would later be known as the [Garden of Forgetting](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garden_of_Forgetting "Garden of Forgetting") and, after being nurtured by the now reformed Green Father Ivern, sprouted into the Dreaming Tree; a [Spirit Tree](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Tree "Spirit Tree") that spread the magic of mortal desires by attracting and containing their dreams within dream-laden flower buds.

### Early Life

#### Birth

When the Dreaming Tree began to have a dream of it's own, it manifested into a new bud that held this dream. This bud however fell to the ground prematurely, miraculously sprouting into Lillia; an awkward [Fae Fawn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fae_Fawn "Fae Fawn") creature with the flower bud from her birth still attached to her head. Having no company other than her mother tree and the many dreams that drifted to the garden each night, Lillia became a caretaker for the garden and helped her mother by tending to the buds containing the dreams and desires of humans.

During this time, Lillia would learn more about the world outside the garden through these dreams, becoming enchanted by sights of people and places people dream of, experiencing the swirl of emotions in each one and seeing the desires that mortals only think of when they're asleep. Lillia began to feel a deep sense of care for these dreams and the dreamers that made them, longing to one day meet these many dreamers face-to-face. Lillia's dream to explore the world and meet these dreamers eventually manifested into a bud of it's own on a branch of the Dreaming Tree.

#### The Dreaming Tree's Sickness

After the [Noxian Invasion of Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Noxian_Invasion_of_Ionia "Noxian Invasion of Ionia"), fewer dreams began to arrive to the Garden of Forgetting, causing Lillia's mother tree to grew sick and infected with burls and dark ooze. Though Lillia did her best to nurture her mother tree and the remaining dreams contained in its buds, the Dreaming Tree only grew so sick it could no longer protect the garden from outsiders.

#### First Encounter with Humans

One night, around the time of the [Spirit Blossom festival](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Blossom_(Universe) "Spirit Blossom (Universe)"), a band of warriors chased a  [lone figure](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo") into the garden and all the way to the location of the Dreaming Tree itself. During a fight, the branch holding Lillia's own dream bud was cut down by a slash of the lone figure's blade, causing it to fall to the ground and frightening Lillia. Panicked, Lillia used dream dust and forced all the humans to fall asleep.

Having finally met her first humans, Lillia was shocked at how different they were compared to how they seemed from the wonderful dreams she would witness while tending to the garden, seeing them as tangled and confused just like the burls that infected her mother tree. While weeping from the sheer shock of the incident, Lillia noticed the lone figure's dream as it slowly floated toward the cut down branch and into the bud containing Lillia's own dream. Picking up the branch, Lillia soothed the dream within the bud, causing it and herself to grow brighter as the bud on her head unfurled and bloomed with magical sparkling pollen before sneezing and releasing the magic into the forest.

As the humans woke up, Lillia hid behind the tree and watched as they completely forgot how they got to the garden and what they were doing there before leaving. Though relieved to see them go, Lillia still saw the potential for dreams within these humans despite how tangled and violent they were on the surface.

#### Leaving the Garden of Forgetting

While caring for her mother tree, Lillia saw more dreams of mortals that depicted several [Spirits](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit "Spirit") of Ionian mythology. Through her encounter with the human warriors, Lillia realized that the only way she can truly save the Dreaming Tree is by bringing the dreams to the garden herself. Finally gaining the courage, Lillia took up her branch and left the garden to enter the unfamiliar and frightening world outside as she looked over an Ionian village celebrating the Spirit Blossom festival.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

### Recent Events

:   *Main article: [The Garden of Dreaming](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Garden_of_Dreaming "The Garden of Dreaming")*

While shy and hiding just out of sight, Lillia now helps mortals realize their own dreams, bringing forward glimpses of the potential she sees in them. In doing so, Lillia realizes she's finally fulfilled her own dream to explore the world and meet these dreamers, occasionally causing the bud on her head to bloom with joy.

On one occasion, Lilia encounters a lonely girl in the forest. The girl's dream seems elusive until Lillia realizes it's not what the girl wants, but what she needs—a connection to her absent sister. Through a heartfelt exchange, Lillia helps the girl release her dream, teaching her the power of dreams to provide comfort and solace.

#### The Dewdrop Harvest

At some point, a large amount of dewdrops containing glimpses into dreams from all over  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") began to gather around the Dreaming Tree in preparation for a massive harvest. Lillia travelled back to the Garden of Forgetting to help nurture the dewdrops during the harvest, encountering the garden's other caretakers such as a [Vastayan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") gardener of the Ophelis tribe named 3 [Aisha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Ophelis_Gardener "LoR:Ophelis Gardener"). Along with that, the harvest attracted many 1 [Spritelings](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Spritelings "LoR:Spritelings") watched over by the 4 [Sprite Mother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Sprite_Mother "LoR:Sprite Mother"), who kept these fickle spirits in line as they entered others' dreams and guided the dreamers.

During this harvest, Lillia saw into other dreams carried to the garden by the dewdrops. Looking into one dream, she saw the [Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle")  [Vex](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vex "Universe:Vex") attending a joyful birthday party planned by her 'friend' 3 [Allay](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Allay "LoR:Allay"), which Vex considered more of a nightmare.

#### Lux's Illuminated Dream

Lillia peered more closely into a different dream belonging to  [Luxanna Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux"), who dreamt of a utopian version of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") where her magical gifts were celebrated rather than feared. During this wondrous dream however, Lillia witnessed it corrupt with darkness as Lux encountered a 5 [mageseeker](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Aberrant_Mageseeker "LoR:Aberrant Mageseeker") and walked into a 4 [petricite hall](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Petricite_Hall "LoR:The Petricite Hall") filled with darkness and grasping hands. In an effort to save Lux and her dream of a better Demacia, Lillia fought off the corruption, which manifested in the form of mysterious crows.

Lux's dream was seemingly saved by a sprite who took the form of a young mage named 8 [Alina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Dreamlight_Alina "LoR:Dreamlight Alina").
structure.appearance: Lillia is a pretty slender [Fae Fawn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fae_Fawn "Fae Fawn"), with brownish fur, long hair with a distinct palette of lilac and blue, large ears,big blue eyes and four deer legs. She doesn't wear clothes, just a plain top made of leaves with a green palette. The most distinctive ornament on her attire is the flower bud on her head. She also has the magical branch in hand. Despite looking similar to a [Vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya"),  **Lillia** is not one.
structure.personality: Lillia is a very shy and kind individual, but is also extremely protective and determined in her cause to help her Mother tree. She is very passionate and devoted to her mission to save the Mother tree's life. Lillia is very curious, with a broad imagination and an everlasting sense of wonder. She is both clumsy and competent.
structure.abilities:
- **[Fae Fawn Physiology:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fae_Fawn "Fae Fawn")** Lilia is a Fae Fawn, a wholly unique entity born from the dream of her mother the Dreaming Tree. Though born from a plant, she is more spiritual in nature and takes a cervine form resembling a humanoid woman with four deer legs and a magical flower bud attached to her head. Being more tied to the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm"), Lillia has increased longevity and access to some spiritual magics.
  - **[Enhanced Speed:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lillia#Prance "Lillia")** Due to her cervine physiology, Lillia has enhanced agility and speed compared to normal humans, capable of running much faster thanks to deer legs.
  - **[Dream Magic:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lillia#Lilting_Lullaby "Lillia")** Lilia, Having been born from the Dreaming Tree, can sense and interact with dreams. With this ability she can peer into the dreams of others, guide these dreams to the dreaming tree by containing them in her censer, and in some cases even manipulate them to an extent. With this magic she can also utilize ' [dream dust](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lillia#Dream-Laden_Bough "Lillia")' produced from the flower bud on her head, which she can use to induce sleep on others and even affect their memories prior to falling asleep.
    - **Empathy:** By communing with the dreams of others, Lillia can discern the emotions hidden deep within these dreams, such as their deep fears and desires only expressed when they are asleep. Due to her close connection with these dreams, Lillia has an intense sense of empathy and can in a sense feel these emotions by peering into these dreams. Along with that, she can change the emotions of others by manipulating their dreams to an extent.
  - **[Nature Magic:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lillia#Swirlseed "Lillia")** Lillia has shown some capability to manipulate nature itself by affecting the growth of plants, such as how she took the branch holding her dream bud and was able to turn it into a powerful censer staff weapon. Typically, Lillia utilizes this ability by sprouting swirlseeds out of the bud on her censer.
- **[Censer Mastery:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lillia#Watch_Out!_Eep! "Lillia")** Lillia wields the branch holding her dream bud, which she has turned into a powerful censer to utilize in combat. Though she isn't a very skilled fighter and often avoids combat mostly, she's capable of fending off enemies from a moderate distance thanks to her weapon of choice,  [swinging at enemies](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lillia#Blooming_Blows "Lillia") with her censer.

relations.relationship_description:
Lillia's mother, the legendary Dreaming Tree, was directly spawned by the ancient God-Willow tree in [Omikayalan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Omikayalan "Omikayalan"). When Ivern, as a once human barbarian, cut down the God-Willow, he fused with it and became the legendary Green Father as he vowed to tend to and care for all nature and helped nurture many of the God-Willow's spawned seeds including Lillia's mother tree.

Due to the fact that Ivern is essentially fused with the God-Willow and he took the effort to care for the Dreaming Tree, he's considered an ancestor or 'grandfather' figure to Lillia. Their relationship seems very warming, as Lillia states that Ivern sometimes considers her his "favorite sprout."

Though Lillia never directly interacted with Yasuo, it is implied that he could be the figure that fled into the [Garden of Forgetting](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garden_of_Forgetting "Garden of Forgetting") during her first ever encounter with humans.

At some point, Yone met Lillia developed a friendship with her, possibly when the two arrived at [Weh'le](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Weh%27le "Weh'le") during the [Spirit Blossom festival](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Blossom_(Universe) "Spirit Blossom (Universe)"). Yone, considering Lillia as one of the kinder spirits compared to the many [Azakana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Demon "Demon") he faces, has vowed to protect her from any dangers, particularly demons.[[2]](#cite_note-2) It is heavily hinted that the relationship dynamic between Yone and  **Lillia** is meant to mirror the master / student dynamic of  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo") and  [Taliyah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taliyah "Universe:Taliyah").

It's unclear whether or not they have directly met, but Yone states that Nocturne is targeting Lillia and has vowed to stop him from ever crossing paths with her. It's very likely they are at least aware of one another though due to Nocturne's innate connection to nightmares.

structure.trivia:
- Lillia was born from the Dreaming Tree's desires to have an attendant or protector of sorts, so it's very possible that the tree dreamed of the God-Willow's previous protectors, being the ancient [Vastayashai'rei](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya").
  - This may explain her Vastaya-like appearance despite being a unique being separate from the Vastaya, as her appearance is based on the dreams of the Dreaming Tree.
- Lillia speaks with a Scottish accent, as she was heavily inspired by the fairies of the British Isles.

structure.personality: Gangplank is a cruel pirate captain who maintains his power through fear alone. As such, he can be exceedingly brutal in his methods, even torturing members of his own crew should they step out of line. With bone-carving and mutilation, Gangplank also showcases an artistic side in his own sick and twisted way. In his quest to be feared, Gangplank often touts his own reputation to frighten people into submission. He often remarks at how many have tried (and failed) to kill him, and shows a remarkable resistance to pain when he orders a doctor to amputate his arm without a fuss. Gangplank is shown to have little remorse for his cruel behavior, killing  [Sarah Fortune's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") mother without mercy.

relations.relationship_description: Gangplank and  [Illaoi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illaoi "Universe:Illaoi") were in a relationship over a decade ago, but eventually broke up. After subjecting him to a  [Test of Spirit](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Illaoi#Test_of_Spirit "Illaoi") in order to get him back 'in motion',  [the Kraken Priestess](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illaoi "Universe:Illaoi") ordered the Serpent Islander chiefs to support the Saltwater Scourge in retaking Bilgewater. They would lead Gangplank to Buhru artifacts that could control the Black Mist.  [Illaoi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illaoi "Universe:Illaoi") was Gangplank's first love. She would eventually oppose him alongside  [Ahri](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ahri "Universe:Ahri"),  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"),  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune"),  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pyke "Universe:Pyke"), and  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo") in [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruined_King "Ruined King").

Gangplank would enter a partnership with  [Thresh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh") in [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruined_King "Ruined King"), in order to awaken and subjugate  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") to conquer Bilgewater. Viego's power would prove too strong for Gangplank and ended up controlling him instead.

[Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain") and  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") want Gangplank dead for stealing from each of them. Namely, Gangplank stole  [Swain's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Swain "Swain") personal warship known as *the Leviathan* and ransacked the Temple of the Jagged Knife belonging to  [Zed's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed")  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow").

[Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") managed to overthrow and 'kill' Gangplank in revenge for him murdering her mother back when she was a girl. Gangplank had only thought of  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") as the most persistent of bounty hunters, unaware that she is the daughter of the gunsmith he killed when she refused to hand over  [the twin pistols](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Miss_Fortune#Impure_Shots "Miss Fortune") he had commissioned in order to spearhead his rise to Reaver King of Bilgewater.

Miss Fortune would defeat Gangplank again in [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruined_King "Ruined King") and had him detained in order to publicly execute him as a show of power. He would escape before his execution and entered a massive gang war against Fortune.

structure.name: Jarvan_IV
structure.quote: *"Words may make a ruler, but only actions make history."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

#### Childhood

Jarvan IV was born the only son of  [King Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") and his queen, the Lady Catherine. Though his birth was meant to bring great joy to his father and kingdom, the day was also marked with tragedy as Jarvan's mother died in childbirth. Jarvan III grieved and swore to never take another wife, placing all of his hopes and dreams in the future of his infant son, now heir apparent to the throne of Demacia.[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2)

As he grew up, Prince Jarvan received the finest education the kingdom had to offer, and was guarded every moment he spent in the royal court. He learned much about Demacian virtues, including charity, duty, and service to his people, which Jarvan III hoped would raise his son into a good and just leader.[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2)

#### Battle of Kalstead

When Jarvan was still a young boy, his father brought him to the front near the Battle of [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead"), where the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard") won a decisive victory against disorganized  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") conscripts. Many of the Noxians were scattered and taken prisoner, but believing there had been enough bloodshed,  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") offered mercy and freedom to the prisoners should they agree to leave Kalstead in peace.[[3]](#cite_note-XinBio-3) King Jarvan met with each of them in his tent, the prince sitting by his side. When the last of the prisoners arrived, a  [Reckoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") called  ["Viscero"](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"), the King asked him to share his story with them. The man introduced himself as  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"), an  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") from [Raikkon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Raikkon "Universe:Raikkon") before the empire had captured him at sea and brought him to their [capital](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion"). He had not come to Kalstead by choice, having been bought out from the arenas and sent out to die for the empire.[[4]](#cite_note-Sailed-4)

As with the others, King Jarvan offered Xin Zhao enough gold for travel from Kalstead, but he refused, instead requesting he be allowed to join the king's personal guard as thanks for his mercy. When asked how he could prove himself capable, Xin Zhao swiftly defeated the guards present and revealed that he could have killed the King at any point during their conversation. The display frightened the young prince, but Xin Zhao immediately apologized, and King Jarvan was simply impressed. He decreed that Xin Zhao be allowed to return with them to the [Great City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_City_of_Demacia "Universe:The Great City of Demacia"), and took the opportunity to impart an important lesson to his son about mercy: that even outsiders could be inspired by Demacian virtues, and should be given a chance to join their kingdom.[[4]](#cite_note-Sailed-4)

#### Military Training

As Jarvan grew older, he continued his trajectory to become a capable leader.  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"), who was chosen as his father's seneschal, took a central role in the prince's education, sharing his knowledge of the history and politics of  [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valoran "Universe:Valoran"), as well as training him in the arts of war and philosophy.[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2) Among his peers, Jarvan also became close friends with a squire named  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") of  [House Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard"), a family which had defended the royal line for generations.[[5]](#cite_note-GarenBio-5) They relied on each other heavily during this time, with Jarvan looking up to Garen's bravery and determination, and Garen relying on the prince's abilities as a tactician.[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2)

When he came of age, Jarvan's father awarded him the honorary rank of general. Though he was not expected as prince to actually lead the Demacians into battle, Jarvan was determined to prove himself worthy of this title. Jarvan's great-grandfather, King Jarvan I, had been slain by a  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion") in the [first clashes](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:First_Demacian-Noxian_War "Universe:First Demacian-Noxian War") between their nations in the south. Jarvan vowed to answer this insult by contesting the expansion of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") on the eastern frontier, beyond the [Argent Mountains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Argent_Mountains "Universe:Argent Mountains").[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2)

### Stand at Castle Wrenwall

Though his forces won many campaigns, Jarvan was troubled by all the bloodshed he witnessed in the outlying towns. When he heard the [Gates of Mourning](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gates_of_Mourning "Universe:Gates of Mourning") had fallen to the  [Noxians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), Jarvan ignored his lieutenants and decided to advance on the enemy. This decision proved catastrophic, and before they had even reached [Trevale](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trevale "Universe:Trevale") his forces were encircled and decimated, and Jarvan was forced to flee into the forests. The enemy scouts hounded him for days until finally, he was struck in the side with an arrow and left for dead next to a fallen tree, where all he could do was lie alone and reflect on his failure.[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2)

From the brink of death, Jarvan was rescued by  [Shyvana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shyvana "Universe:Shyvana"), who carried him back to the  [Demacians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") at [Wrenwall](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Wrenwall "Universe:Wrenwall") without even knowing who he was. He judged her a kind and worthy companion during his recovery, and though the garrison regarded her appearance with suspicion, she was allowed to stay with them for a time. It was here that Shyvana learned Jarvan's identity as the prince and only heir to the throne. But the brief peace would not last as the Demacians detected a great beast on the horizon: an elemental [dragon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dragon "Universe:Dragon") named [Yvva](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yvva "Universe:Yvva"). As the wounded Jarvan was organizing the defense, he caught Shyvana trying to flee the settlement and confronted her. She confessed that she was the daughter of Yvva, and that her broodmother had been pursuing her for some time. Innocent lives were in danger because of her, but Jarvan refused to let her leave. She had saved his life, and to repay her kindness, he and the Demacians would stand with her and end the beast once and for all.[[6]](#cite_note-ShyvanaBio-6)[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2)

Jarvan and Shyvana proved a deadly team during the battle. The power of her transformation allowed her take the skies, and his leadership of the garrison, its archers, and healers held the line to support her. In the end they were victorious, and as thanks, Jarvan offered Shyvana a place in his personal guard. They returned to the [Great City of Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_City_of_Demacia "Universe:The Great City of Demacia") together and presented the dragon's skull to King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") in the Hall of Valor.[[6]](#cite_note-ShyvanaBio-6) Jarvan's father was overjoyed to learn his son was alive, but the nobles of his court regarded Shyvana with suspicion. Even so, Jarvan made certain she would have a place in Demacia, along with those who fought alongside them at Wrenwall.[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2)

### Death of Xin Zhao

As  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara") was being pursued by monstrous stags just outside the forests of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), Jarvan IV, and a platoon of soldiers, rode atop their [silverwing raptors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silverwing "Universe:Silverwing") to rescue her, crashing into the earth and leaving a  deep crater where the monsters had been. As he dismounted to greet the visitor, Yunara presented to him a spearhead of Demacian steel, which had belonged to his old mentor  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"). Before Jarvan could ask any questions, bells began to toll from the city.[[7]](#cite_note-Salvation-7) Jarvan took Yunara with him on his silverwing and flew her to the royal palace. There, he announced her to his father,  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), and revealed that their Seneschal was now gone.[[8]](#cite_note-8)

### Battle of Evenmoor

:   *Main article: [Ivory, Ebony, Jasper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ivory,_Ebony,_Jasper "Universe:Ivory, Ebony, Jasper")*

As a hostile swarm of creatures known as the [argoth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Argoth "Universe:Argoth") closed in on the village of [Evenmoor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Evenmoor "Universe:Evenmoor"), Jarvan met with his generals to discuss strategy for their defense. General Ibell wanted to fight the argoth head-on, but General Mieser argued against this; so long as the argoth queen was commanding the swarm, any battle against them without reinforcements would amount to suicide. This in mind, Mieser believed their only option was to surrender Evenmoor to the argoth until they had time to regroup. Jarvan refused to abandon the village, however, and came up with a different plan: he and his best warriors would lay an ambush within Evenmoor, and when the queen was in view, they would kill her at the swarm's center before fighting their way out. His generals would lead the second wave, and with their plan set, Jarvan made for Evenmoor to slay the argoth queen.[[9]](#cite_note-Ivory-9)

### Betrothal Ceremony

As time had passed, and the  [King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") had grown older, Jarvan found himself pressured to start looking for potential brides and secure the line of succession. This, Jarvan felt, was part of his duty to the kingdom, the noble houses, and also his father. As the prince, there was no shortage of women who would want to be chosen as his queen. But what Jarvan truly wanted was to marry someone who cared for him as a person, and not just because he was the prince. The  [one](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shyvana "Universe:Shyvana")[[10]](#cite_note-Mageseeker-10) he truly loved remained out of reach.[[11]](#cite_note-Lux2-11)

As he and  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") were training together one day, Jarvan lamented the position the  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") court had put him in. Garen suggested that Jarvan needed to move on and offered a solution: he could marry Garen's sister  [Luxanna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux"), whom he already knew and trusted as a friend. This would surely satisfy Jarvan's father and the noble houses, and Garen convinced him to go ahead with the arrangement. Lux, however, had not been consulted about this, and she refused to attend the betrothal ceremony.[[11]](#cite_note-Lux2-11) Jarvan was left waiting, and the other  [Crownguards](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") were furious that she never showed up, leading to an investigation of her whereabouts.[[12]](#cite_note-Lux3-12)

### Great Mage Rebellion

#### Death of the King

On the day of his scheduled execution, the convicted mage  [Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") narrowly escaped before destroying an entire square and freeing the other mages from the  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") mage prison.[[12]](#cite_note-Lux3-12) Many of them fled the [Great City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_City_of_Demacia "Universe:The Great City of Demacia") through the sewers, but those who wanted vengeance joined Sylas on his march to the Citadel of Dawn, where they planned to publicly humiliate  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") for all they had suffered. Having lost control of several portions of the city, Jarvan IV met with his father and the advisors and began to discuss strategy to defeat Sylas and his insurrection. The King, however, blamed himself for the carnage, claiming that Sylas had only become a threat to Demacia because they had put him in chains.[[13]](#cite_note-Lux4-13)

As Sylas closed in on the palace, Jarvan ordered the guards to bring his father to safety as he went to personally confront the insurrection. His battle with Sylas was tense as he declared that the Citadel, which had stood for centuries, would not crumble to a band of lowborn traitors. But Sylas had studied Demacian history and the old battles of the Winged Protectors. The [petricite](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Petricite "Universe:Petricite") around them held the magic of the  [Veiled Lady](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Morgana "Universe:Morgana") herself, which he used to chain Jarvan to the ground and capture him.[[13]](#cite_note-Lux4-13)

Even as Sylas made his way to capture the king, Jarvan IV insisted that the reinforcements would arrive soon and surround the palace gates. Sylas did not care, believing he had already suffered far worse than anything Jarvan's men could do to him. To both of their surprise, the King was found dead in his inner chamber, surrounded by the bodies of his guards. Jarvan IV cried in horror and rushed to his father's side. He believed Sylas and the other mages were responsible, as the  [actual killer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina")[[14]](#cite_note-Katarina2-14) had escaped the inner chamber undetected. Sylas was equally confused by Jarvan III's death, as he had been planning to publicly humiliate the king before executing him. Since he could no longer do this, Sylas decided to humiliate Jarvan IV in his father's place.[[13]](#cite_note-Lux4-13)

Outside the palace, Sylas arranged a mock trial and execution for the prince, where the rebels declared him and his father complicit in the oppression of mages. Jarvan insisted that these were lies and that his father was a good man, but his pleas were ignored. As his "final meal", Jarvan would be forced to eat a [rat](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rat "Universe:Rat"), as Sylas had for many years in the  [mageseeker](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers") prison.  [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") arrived and rescued the prince from having to do this, wounding Sylas with an arrow to the shoulder and a dagger to the foot. Her intervention also bought enough time for  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") to fight his way through and confront Sylas, who fled the scene. Jarvan, now freed by Lux and defended by his guards, tried to pursue him, but Garen insisted that it was too dangerous; as the sole heir to the throne, the kingdom needed him alive to lead them.[[15]](#cite_note-Lux5-15)

Shortly before his death, Jarvan III had written a letter that would have immediately halted the arrests of mages, in hopes that it would prevent the brewing [conflict](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion"). This letter was never made public, however, and when Jarvan IV found it, he had it destroyed.[[10]](#cite_note-Mageseeker-10) Jarvan III's funeral was held the day after Sylas's escape, where Jarvan IV vowed that as the new king, he would avenge his father and formally declared war against "the scourge of [magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic")." The announcement preceded a massive expansion of the  [mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers") and their arrests, driving Lux and a number of other mages out of the Great City.[[15]](#cite_note-Lux5-15) The kingdom descended further into [turmoil](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Turmoil "Universe:Turmoil"), and overwhelmed with his new responsibilities, Jarvan knew he would need all the guidance he could get. From his father's advisors, such as High Marshal  [Tianna Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tianna "Universe:Tianna"), and from a thorough examination of his conscience and allegiances before he would eventually be crowned king.[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2)

#### The Mageseeker

*(TBA)*
structure.appearance: Jarvan IV was a tall man with fair skin and dark brown hair, which was medium length and slicked back, and light stubble across his face. While leaner than warriors like  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen"), his form was strong and battle-hardened by his years on the field. In his formal wear, Jarvan would often wear clean ceremonial coat of the signature  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") white and blue, black underneath, and gold forming the pauldrons, collar, boots, and belt, as well as the crown on his head. When going into battle, Jarvan would be seen wearing full-body armor of black with gold and silver plating, with long dark spikes on the pauldrons and gauntlets. Jarvan wore a golden helmet while armored, which fashioned to resemble a crown with the face open, golden spikes on the helm, and a blue gemstone above his forehead. In his hands, he carried  [Drakebane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jarvan_IV#Dragon_Strike "Jarvan IV"), a long silver lance adorned with similar gemstones and spikes across its length.
structure.personality:
From a young age, Jarvan IV was raised to be a paragon of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia")'s greatest virtues. As the  [King's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") only heir, he felt a deep sense of responsibility to his father, his people, and the nation's stability, and would fulfill the courtly duties expected of his station, even when it was not what he wanted. The kingdom's future weighed heavily on his shoulders, as did the many expectations placed upon him. Jarvan idolized his father and sought to prove himself worthy of his crown, and would sometimes make rash decisions by ignoring the advice of his lieutenants. Whenever he failed his kingdom, Jarvan would become angry with himself, believing he was too weak to protect the ones he loved.

Jarvan IV was a skilled warrior and had the courage and the tactical brilliance to lead his soldiers from the front lines. If his people were in danger, Jarvan would refuse to abandon them, even if it meant placing himself in harm's way. Honor and commitment to one's fellow soldiers was a core tenet of Demacia, and Jarvan made sure to fight in the service of and inspire those such as  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen"),  [Shyvana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shyvana "Universe:Shyvana"), and others he stood alongside. Those who threatened the people Jarvan cared about would be met with swift and violent retribution, and if Jarvan himself was to blame, he would regret his actions and try to make amends.
structure.abilities:
- **[Leadership](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jarvan_IV#Martial_Cadence "Jarvan IV"):** As the crown prince of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), Jarvan IV was raised in the royal court at a time when the nobility feuded among itself, and saw his  [father's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") efforts to bring stability to the kingdom. He became well read in the history and politics of  [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valoran "Universe:Valoran") under the tutelage of  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao") and royal educators. After his father's death, Jarvan rose to a position where he was in charge of all the kingdom's elite forces, including the king's  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard"), as well as all matters of diplomacy and domestic affairs.
  - **[Strategist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jarvan_IV#Demacian_Standard "Jarvan IV"):** Even during his military training, Jarvan was relied upon by recruits like  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") for his tactical brilliance. He was awarded the honorary rank of general when he came of age, and he used the power of command to lead numerous successful campaigns against enemy nations, like  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), and hostile creatures, including elemental [dragons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dragon "Universe:Dragon") and the [argoth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Argoth "Universe:Argoth").
- **Warrior:** Jarvan IV was personally trained by  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"), a former  [Reckoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") who earned a fearsome reputation in the arenas of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). Jarvan was able to translate Xin Zhao's fighting techniques into his own, and grew into an exceptional warrior in his own right.
  - **[Drakebane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jarvan_IV#Dragon_Strike "Jarvan IV"):** An extendable lance passed down the royal line of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"). Jarvan could use it in close combat, and also leap into the air and  [land heavily](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jarvan_IV#Cataclysm "Jarvan IV") on the terrain to decimate his foes.
- **[Silverwing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silverwing "Universe:Silverwing") Rider:** Jarvan IV was skilled at riding [silverwing raptors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silverwing "Universe:Silverwing"), allowing him to take to the skies and serve as airborne cavalry using his lance.[[7]](#cite_note-Salvation-7)

relations.relationship_description:
Jarvan III was the father of Prince Jarvan, his only child and heir. He once described his son as his "life's joy", and would always try to pass the wisdom and values of the  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") royal family onto him in hopes that he would one day become a good and just king.[[4]](#cite_note-Sailed-4) Jarvan IV loved and admired his father and would frequently try to prove himself worthy of the crown, even without his permission, which led to him nearly being killed by  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") forces.[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2)

Years later, during the [mage rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion"), King Jarvan's death sent the prince into a spiraling grief and rage. His attempts to avenge his father led the kingdom into a full-blown civil war against  [Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") and his rebels, even though Jarvan III had spent his final days trying to stop the brewing conflict and halt the arrests of mages. The absence of his father's guidance led Jarvan down a dark path, but  [Shyvana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shyvana "Universe:Shyvana") eventually convinced Jarvan IV to honor his late father's wishes instead of trying to avenge him.[[2]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-2)[[10]](#cite_note-Mageseeker-10)

Xin Zhao was the devoted protector of Jarvan IV and his father,  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), being chosen as the king's seneschal some time after the Battle of [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead"). Xin Zhao had been a beloved mentor to the prince since he was a young boy, training him in history and politics, as well as the myriad arts of war and the spiritual philosophies of his distant homeland in  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"). Xin Zhao was a trusted advisor and friend to both Jarvans, and the prince considered him like family.

[Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") is looking to overthrow and kill the Demacian elite, including Jarvan. Jarvan IV was almost executed by  [Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") and now is chasing him, believing Sylas is behind his father's death, although the king was already dead by the time he was found.

Jarvan IV met Garen at a young age when they both joined the military, and as brothers-in-arms, they became close friends. Garen looked up to Jarvan's abilities as a tactician, and Jarvan looked up to Garen's raw determination as a soldier. The two made an excellent team, and Garen always knew growing up that as one of the  [Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") family, it would someday be his duty to defend the prince once he was crowned king.[[5]](#cite_note-GarenBio-5) When Jarvan and Garen were older, they frequently went sparring together in the royal palace. Although they were friends, Garen would speak formally with the prince in accordance with protocol, calling him "my liege" even though Jarvan preferred to be called by name. Garen also knew that Jarvan loved  [Shyvana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shyvana "Universe:Shyvana"), but believed the prince needed to move on from not being allowed to marry her.[[11]](#cite_note-Lux2-11)

After Jarvan became king, Garen believed Jarvan was no longer himself as he grieved his  [father's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") assassination, and was disturbed by how the  [mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers") were able to manipulate him. Garen disobeyed some of Jarvan's orders to protect  [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux"), but also felt a great deal of shame for lying to a man who was both his sworn lord and best friend.[[16]](#cite_note-GarenNovella-16) Jarvan, unaware of this, claimed that Garen was a "true Demacian" for being able to put his country first.[[15]](#cite_note-Lux5-15) Though he was intent on defeating  [Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") and the rebellion, Jarvan had no intention of hurting Lux or Shyvana, so when they were threatened by the mageseekers, Jarvan was finally convinced that he had been wrong to trust them. In his office, he confessed everything to Garen; how he had destroyed his father's letter, and how he had been trying this whole time to be a strong king rather than a good one. Garen reassured Jarvan and remained loyal to him, and they resolved to defend the mages in [Terbisia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Terbisia "Universe:Terbisia") against the mageseekers.[[10]](#cite_note-Mageseeker-10)

Jarvan IV was saved by  [Shyvana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shyvana "Universe:Shyvana") after escaping and later helped her in slaying her mother and, out of gratitude, she earned a spot in the Demacian Elite Guard. Jarvan mentioned he loved someone that wasn't so different from the mages.[[13]](#cite_note-Lux4-13) This was later revealed to be Shyvana, and it was her influence that convinced Jarvan to honor his late  [father's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") wishes and dissolve the  [mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers").[[10]](#cite_note-Mageseeker-10)

Jarvan IV was arranged to marry  [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") by her family to protect her from being persecuted for being a mage: as queen, she would have been too powerful to accuse. After she didn't show up for the betrothal ceremony, the matter was apparently dropped.

After his father's death, Jarvan is counsel of many prominent nobles—including Garen’s aunt, High Marshal  [Tianna Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tianna "Universe:Tianna") to prepare him for the days ahead before he can be crowned king.

structure.trivia:
**Jarvan IV, the Exemplar of Demacia**

- Jarvan IV is around 26 years old, or a similar age as  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen").
  - He was around 26 years old when during the events of the [Lux Comics](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux:_Issue_5 "Universe:Lux: Issue 5").
  - He was 6 years old during the events of [What Once Sailed Free](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:What_Once_Sailed_Free "Universe:What Once Sailed Free").
- Jarvan IV's spear,  [Drakebane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jarvan_IV#Dragon_Strike "Jarvan IV"), was crafted by a Demacian weaponsmith named Orlon, the same one who crafted  [Poppy's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Poppy "Universe:Poppy")  [Hammer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Poppy#Hammer_Shock "Poppy").
- 7 [King Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:King_Jarvan_III "LoR:King Jarvan III")'s flavour text in  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra") implies  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") may have been involved in Jarvan's capture by the  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") army.
- A theater play depicting Jarvan IV's coronation was shown at the  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") opera house in [season 2](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series)/Season_2 "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)/Season 2") of  [Arcane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series) "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)").[[17]](#cite_note-17) As revealed in  [Xin Zhao's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao") [champion update](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Champion_update "Champion update"), King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") was still alive at the end of the series,[[18]](#cite_note-18) meaning this performance occurred some years before Jarvan IV's actual coronation.

**Jarvan IV, the Exemplar of Demacia (Old Lore)**

- In the  [old lore](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Old_lore "Universe:Old lore"), Jarvan IV's blood was used by  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Swain "Swain") (his nemesis) and  [Vladimir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vladimir "Universe:Vladimir") to resurrect  [Sion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion"). How they would have gotten the Exemplar's blood was never explored.  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LeBlanc "LeBlanc") is theorized to have impersonated Jarvan IV in order to cause a war between Demacia and Noxus.
