structure.name: Shen
structure.quote: *"The Eye is blind to fear, to hate, to love – to all things that would sway equilibrium."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Shen was born to Great Master  [Kusho](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kusho "Universe:Kusho"), the Eye of Twilight, one of the three leaders of the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order"). As the son of the Great Master, he immersed himself in the order's culture, and its core tenets were as familiar to him as the  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") sunset. He knew the necessity of Pruning the Tree, the determination of Coursing the Sun, but above all, he learned the wisdom of Watching the Stars. He meditated and studied throughout his childhood, and was considered exemplary by all his teachers.[[1]](#cite_note-ShenBio-1)

One evening, Master Kusho took pity on a masterless servant boy,  [Govos](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed"), and invited him to spar with his son. Though Shen easily won each bout, the boy continued to rise and demand rematches. Watching closely, Kusho offered guidance on how to counter Shen's strikes. Seeing Govos's determination and knowing his father's ways, Shen finally allowed the boy to land a hit on him. Impressed, Kusho took Govos under his wing.[[2]](#cite_note-Zed4-2) Shen and Govos trained together thereafter, growing as close as brothers.[[1]](#cite_note-ShenBio-1)

### Hunt for the Golden Demon

When the Council of Zhyun sent an envoy to Great Master Kusho begging for aid in stopping the infamous killer known as the  [Golden Demon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin"), Kusho agreed, taking  [Govos](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") and Shen with him, and began a covert investigation. Together, they tended to families shattered by the killings, dissected the horrific crime scenes, and looked for connections between the murders.[[3]](#cite_note-JhinBio-3)

During this time, Kusho had arranged for Shen to marry Yevnai. As they made their way to Kotha Villega, Shen and Govos talked about his enagement. Though Shen was excited, he was also nervous, but Govos reassured him that Yevnai loved him as well. When they arrived at the village, they found it massacred by the demon. They tried to tend to the survivors, and  [Govos](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") worked desperately to save as many lives as he could, but the scale of the carnage shook him to his core. When they were finished, Kusho tried to comfort Govos. Impressed by his resolve, Kusho named Govos his successor as the Eye of Twilight and granted him a new name, Usan.[[4]](#cite_note-Zed1-4)

Their investigation spanned four long years, leaving all three men changed. Shen, once known for his wit and humor, grew increasingly somber;  [Usan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed"), the brightest star of Kusho's temple, began to struggle with his studies; and Kusho's famous red mane turned white. When Kusho finally discovered a pattern in the killings, he realized they were not hunting a demon, but a wicked man or vastaya. Believing the matter to be beyond the Kinkou's mandate, he sought to hand off the investigation. However, Shen and Usan refused to turn back after all they had endured, and convinced him to continue.[[3]](#cite_note-JhinBio-3)

Three years into the investigation,[[5]](#cite_note-Zed2-5) on the eve of the Spirit Blossom Festival in Jyom Pass, Kusho disguised himself as a renowned calligrapher to blend in among the visiting artists, while Shen and  [Usan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") carefully prepared a trap.[[3]](#cite_note-JhinBio-3) Usan allowed himself to be captured by the Golden Demon, and using his necklace, Kusho and Shen tracked him to his location. As the demon prepared for his performance, Shen burst through the wall to save Usan. Usan seized one of the killer's blades and attempted to strike him down, but Kusho intervened, insisting they take the killer back alive.[[5]](#cite_note-Zed2-5)

In the aftermath, Kusho was proven right, and the so-called demon was revealed to be a human stagehand named  [Khada Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin"). Kusho decided that Jhin should be imprisoned within the monastery prison at Tuula.[[3]](#cite_note-JhinBio-3) While both Shen and  [Usan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") believed Jhin deserved a far harsher punishment, Shen accepted his father's judgment and attempted to comfort a bitter and resentful Usan.[[1]](#cite_note-ShenBio-1)

### Rise of the Order of Shadow

When  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") began its invasion of the First Lands, Masters  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen"),  [Kusho](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kusho "Universe:Kusho"), and  [Mayym](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mayym "Universe:Mayym") ruled to not involve the Kinkou in the war.[[6]](#cite_note-BLS-6) Shen tried to adopt his father's dispassion and appeared to support their decision,[[1]](#cite_note-ShenBio-1) but secretly began sneaking out to train soldiers and attack enemy supply lines. Usan helped cover for him by deliberately throwing his matches, making it appear as though Shen was keeping up with his training.[[7]](#cite_note-Zed5-7) However, Usan had grown disillusioned with the Kinkou and left the Order after they failed to retaliate against Noxus.[[8]](#cite_note-ZedBio-8)

As the war raged on, Shen focused on maintaining Ionia's spiritual harmony. When he sensed an imbalance within the Order, Shen rushed back to their temple and was met by the survivors of a bloody coup. Usan-now calling himself  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed")-had returned with a small band of warriors and usurped the Kinkou's temple, killing many of the Order, including his father. Zed and his followers now wielded dangerous shadow magic and called themselves the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"). Repressing his anguish, Shen led the remaining Kinkou to safety in the mountains. He took up his father's spirit blade and assumed the mantle of the Eye of Twilight, vowing to rebuild the Order. Following the core tenets, Shen began recruiting and training new members in hopes of restoring the Kinkou's strength.[[1]](#cite_note-ShenBio-1) As Shen struggled to lead the fractured Kinkou,  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") helped guide the Order.[[9]](#cite_note-9)

After his father was killed, Shen's engagement to Yevnai was called off.[[5]](#cite_note-Zed2-5)

Several months after Master Kusho's death, the Kinkou retreated to an abandoned temple east of Thanjuul. On the final day of the Spirit Blossom Festival, Shen met with  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") and Mayym to decide the Order's response to the war. Mayym argued that Ionia's recent victory at the Placidium justified taking action against those who disrupted the balance, including both Noxians and Ionians. However, Kennen believed the situation to be more complicated, warning they should choose their battles carefully. When they looked to Shen for guidance, he agreed that Ionians also inflamed the war, notably  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") and his order. However, he believed his judgment was compromised when it came to matters regarding his former brother, choosing to withdraw until he could decide impartially.[[10]](#cite_note-Bow-10)

Not long afer, Shen sensed a disturbance in the spirit realm and alerted Kennen and Mayym. They rushed off to a nearby valley and found Kinkou neophytes being attacked by a corrupted spirit. They quickly dispatched the creature's physical form and Shen entered the spirit realm to deal with it there.[[10]](#cite_note-Bow-10)

When Mayym's daughter  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") came of age at fourteen,[[11]](#cite_note-AkaliBio-11) she began her Kinkou training under Shen's tutelage. Her mother had stood by his father as the Fist of Shadow, and it appeared that Akali would follow the same path. While she showed boundless potential, Shen often found himself urging retraint when Akali faced mortal opponents.[[1]](#cite_note-ShenBio-1)

### End of the Invasion

After the Noxian invasion finally ended, many Ionians celebrated their hard-won victory, but Shen bore the lasting consequences of war. He remained steadfast in his duty, yet in private he wrestled with his hatred for  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") and doubted his ability to lead. The years of conflict had taken a heavy toll on the First Lands, and Shen was uncertain whether the rebuilt Kinkou could ever restore the balance.[[1]](#cite_note-ShenBio-1) Zed and his order reached out to the Kinkou, and though he did not reconcile with Shen, they came to an uneasy accord.[[8]](#cite_note-ZedBio-8)

When the Temple of Twilight suddenly returned to the material,  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") rushed off too confer with Shen.[[12]](#cite_note-12) However, neither he nor Mayym could reach it in time to stop  [Atakhan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Atakhan "Universe:Atakhan") from breaching the Temple's defenses, leading  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara") and  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao") to undergo the Trials of Twilight to stop it.[[13]](#cite_note-13)

Shen went to aid a fisherman who reported that his ship had been attacked by a demon. As Shen took the man's account, a holy man and his acolytes arrived, declaring that they would defeat the spirit themselves. The holy man asked if Shen would aid them, and Shen affirmed that balance would be restored. Shen tracked the demon to its resting place and drew his spirit blade, ready to strike. However, he soon heard the cries of dying spirits and abandoned his quarry to investigate. Teleporting back to the shipwreck, Shen found the holy man and his acolytes destroying innocent spirits. When the holy man offered him the next kill, Shen refused. He sheathed his spirit blade and drew his steel sword instead. Shen apologized to the holy man and leveled his blade against them, intent on restoring balance.[[14]](#cite_note-14)

[Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") eventually proved herself worthy and was named the new Fist of Shadow.[[1]](#cite_note-ShenBio-1) However, Akali's spirit was restless and believed Shen insistence on restraint held her back. She began to argue with and disobey Shen, and before long left the Order. Shen did not stop her, knowing this was a path Akali needed to walk alone.[[11]](#cite_note-AkaliBio-11) With the Fist of Shadow unfilled, only Kennen and Shen remained of the Kinkou triumvirate.[[6]](#cite_note-BLS-6)

Despite leaving the Order, Akali still aided the Kinkou. She accompanied Shen to Navori Province, where they encountered a young Noxian woodsman cutting down a guardian tree. Intent on teaching him a lesson, Akali destroyed his cart, trapping him beneath it. As she confronted the boy, the tree's sap awakened its guardian, furious at the Noxian. Shen shared his ability to peer into the spirit realm with Akali, revealing the source of the guardian's rage. Despite his warnings, Akali rushed to attack the spirit, but was unable to stop it. Shen insisted that balance had to be restored, but Akali pleaded with him to bend the rules to spare the child. As Akali tried to free the boy, she realized what Shen meant and plucked a nearby seed. Using her kunai, she dug a small trench and instructed the boy to bury it. As the spirit prepared to strike, Akali used one of her charms to water the soil, causing the seed to bloom. Appeased, the guardian stayed its hand. Shen then nurtured the growing tree further, and the spirit settled beneath its roots, returning once more to its slumber.[[15]](#cite_note-15)

### The Return of Jhin

When the spirits of the Olgathee Forest were angered, Shen traveled there to pacify them. After slaying one of the spirits,  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") arrived and informed him that  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") and his Order had just slain Master Althon nearby. Knowing which town Zed was heading toward, she brought Shen a horse and urged him to come with her, believing they finally had a chance at capturing him. However, Shen refused, warning against acting out of revenge, but Akali pressed on regardless.[[4]](#cite_note-Zed1-4) Shen followed her to the town, where they learned that Zed was headed north. However, Shen had to leave south to stop a demon attack. Before he departed, Shen warned Akali to not lose herself in the pursuit of vengenace and to not chase Zed alone.[[5]](#cite_note-Zed2-5)

During his journey south, Shen stopped at the White Cliffs Inn to rest. After a waitress brought him his meal, he noticed the shadows behaving strangely and drew his spirit blade. Calling out, he told  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") that he knew his students were here and, soon, Zed entered the inn disguised as a merchant.[[16]](#cite_note-16) Though the Kinkou taught not to act of vengeance, Shen refused to let the opportunity pass. He charged at Zed with blade, but he managed to block and evade his attacks. As they fought, Zed revealed that  [Khada Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") had escaped. Shen thought it impossible, but Zed reminded him of what he was capable of and told him that they were the only two who could stop him again. Frustrated but wary, Shen lowered his weapon to hear him out. Zed believed Jhin was setting a trap, and that the only way to catch him was to work together. Still consumed by anger, Shen refused. Bound by the Code of Tuonn, Shen's honor compelled him to let Zed leave in peace, but he vowed to capture Jhin himself and warned Zed to go into hiding, as when they next meet, he would kill him.[[17]](#cite_note-Zed3-17)

As Zed prepared to depart,  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") confronted him. Shen ordered her to let him leave, but she disregarded him and attacked. Zed effortlessly evaded her strikes, and he and his disciples vanished into the shadows while Shen restrained Akali. Seething with rage, Shen told her this was his fight alone and that he was done waiting. Forsaking the armistice between the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") and the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"), Shen declared war on Zed. Shen and Akali then began pursuing leads on  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") across the region, eventually discovering that he had been targeting enemies of the Kashuri faction of the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood"). They learned that one of the last holdouts in the area was the Elder of Nanthee and rushed to protect him, but were too late.[[17]](#cite_note-Zed3-17)

At the Port of Nanthee, Shen caught sight of  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") and gave chase. However, Zed was pursuing Jhin and tried to warn Shen that Jhin had rigged the town's lanterns with traps, but he refused to listen. Moments later, Jhin's bombs detonated, triggering explosions throughout the port. Zed shoved Shen into the sea, saving him from the blasts, while Jhin marveled at his work and escaped. As Shen began to drown, Zed dove in after him and dragged him to shore.[[2]](#cite_note-Zed4-2)

When Shen regained consciousness, he drew his blade on Zed. Zed gestured to the carnage around them and pleaded that they needed to work together to stop Jhin. Enraged, Shen charged at him, insisting that Jhin had staged the massacre knowing Zed would be watching, and that if Zed had remained hidden as warned, Jhin would have gone after him instead. Zed tried to tell him that Jhin was working for someone else, but Shen didn't believe him. Zed then reminded Shen of his father's lesson on the rule of the scales, though Shen replied that his lesson had more than one part. He told him that they were taught action only when necessary, and accused Zed of failing the Kinkou—and Kusho—because of his impatience. Shen ordered Zed to stand down, but Zed threatened to kill him with his shadow clones. Shen retorted that the clones were shaped by Zed's hatred and guilt, that they did not serve him but controlled him. Gaining the upper hand, Shen began to beat down on Zed and tearfully denounced him for killing his father, declaring that Zed had once been his brother. With Zed unconscious, Shen ordered the Kinkou to bind him, planning to burn away his shadow magic before leaving him to rot in a cell.[[2]](#cite_note-Zed4-2)

#### Working with Zed

Two days after the attack on the port, Shen had Zed restrained and prepared for transport when he received a message from Akali. Shen confronted Zed and told him that he knew he had been holding back and that he allowed himself to be captured. Zed questioned if Shen had discovered who had helped  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") escape, but Shen admitted that he had not and promised to protect Zed if Jhin came for him. Alternatively, Shen offered Zed one final chance to work together to stop Jhin on the condition that he finally tells him the truth about why he had killed his father.[[7]](#cite_note-Zed5-7)

Zed claimed that he needed the power of the Tears of Shadow to stop the Noxians, and that Master Kusho had tried to stop him. Shen saw through his lie, pointing out that Zed could have taken the Tears without killing Kusho. Zed then confessed that he had been jealous of how much Kusho loved Shen and believed he needed shadow magic to become stronger. Again, Shen saw through his lie, as Kusho loved him just as much, and demanded the truth. At last, Zed admitted that Kusho had been right: if the Kinkou became involved in the war, their sacred mission would be corrupted. To save Ionia, a new order had to be born, but if Zed had merely taken the Tears, members of the Kinkou would have followed him. To sever that possibility, he had to become the Kinkou's hated enemy and betray Master Kusho. Shen accepted Zed's answer and freed him. While Shen wanted to capture Jhin, Zed insisted that he had to die. Shen refused, arguing that Jhin did not threaten the balance, but Zed countered he was not a member of the Kinkou. However, Shen refused to let Zed die thinking their father had been wrong and if he wanted his help, this was the price.[[7]](#cite_note-Zed5-7)

As they prepared to depart, Shen informed Zed that Jhin had escaped to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), and that  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") had gone after him. Upon arriving in the City of Progress, they attempted to follow her trail. Zed again pressed Shen on whether he had discovered who had helped Jhin escape, but Shen dismissed it, as the only ones who knew where Jhin was being held were the two of them, Yevnai, and his father. One of Shen's informants eventually guided them an old opera house where Akali had been last spotted. There, they encountered an agent of the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood") who revealed he had led her into Jhin's trap. Shen and Zed then rushed in to save her.[[7]](#cite_note-Zed5-7)

They found Akali on the far side of a bridge, bound to one of Jhin's props and guarded by his traps, while Jhin sat nearby, calmly observing. Shen teleported in to strike him down, but it was only a decoy, and he was caught in a barrage of explosives. The real Jhin then revealed himself and moved to execute Akali, but Zed emerged from the shadows and the two rushed him together. Jhin evaded their attacks and unleashed more traps, incapacitating them both, though Zed managed to free Akali.[[18]](#cite_note-Zed6-18)

As Jhin prepared to finish Shen off, Akali struck, pinning Jhin to the ground and raising his own gun to kill him. Shen pleaded with her to stop, but Zed knocked her aside and demanded to know how Jhin had escaped. Jhin replied that he had not escaped but, rather, he was freed, and that Zed already knew by whom. Enraged, Zed hurled Jhin at Shen's feet and declared their bargain fulfilled before vanishing into the shadows.[[18]](#cite_note-Zed6-18)
structure.appearance:
Shen is a tall, muscular man with fair skin and brown hair. His hair is typically tied back with the sides shaved. His eyes glow white-blue whenever he utilizes his magic.

His signature armor is a full-body ninja regalia in pristine condition. It is dark blue with a silver trim, covering all but his eyes and upper arms. Though he carries a traditional blade on his back, he can also summon a spirit blade composed of ethereal violet magic.
structure.personality: Known for his dispassion, Shen is calm and even-keeled, possessing the aura of esoteric wisdom that befits his station. Extreme events, however, can cause him to become aggressive and emotional, especially in the presence of his despised rivals such as  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") or  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin"). Still, Shen fights honorably, striving to protect the innocent and preserve the balance of  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia").
structure.abilities:
- **[Spirit Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic")** Shen has a deep connection to the Spirit Realm, created through meditation and spiritual practices, allowing him to sense the influences of the Spirit Realm, and use its magic for several purposes. Shen carries the Role of the Eye of Twilight, and wields the powers that comes with it.
  - **Transitory State:** As the bridge between the Material and Spirit Worlds, Shen can shift from the Physical Realm to the Spiritual and vice-versa at will. This allows him to teleport to other's places at will, whether to avoid injuries or to aid his allies.
  - **Spirit Sign:** Shen's spiritual connections allow him to see spiritual forces.

relations.relationship_description: Shen leads the surviving [Kinkou](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kinkou_Order "Kinkou Order") which has a great conflict of interest with  [Zed's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zed "Zed") Order of Shadow and its defiance of Ionia's sacred balance.  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") remains by his side while  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") went rogue. She and  **Shen** parted on neutral terms. Neither hates the other but both disapprove of the other's methods.[[19]](#cite_note-19) After  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") and  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") made their choice, Shen is starting to doubt whether the old way still works.

Shen and  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") are childhood friends and used to consider each other as brother before  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") "murdered" Master Kusho. Master Kusho, Shen, and Zed were responsible for capturing and imprisoning  [Khada Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin"), but were traumatised by the Golden Demon's actions in the process. Later on, when Jhin was set free again, Zed sought out Shen in order to inform him about Jhin's reappearance and to team up with him to stop him. Shen, despite still wishing to avenge his father's death, accepted the truce for the greater good. The duo later saved a captured  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") from  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") and caught him. Shen is torn between killing Zed to avenge his father Kusho (the Kinkou's previous master and wielder of the  [spirit blade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shen#Twilight_Assault "Shen")) and enforcing equilibrium with the spirit realm (his duty takes priority, but he won't hesitate if given the chance). Zed could have revealed the truth about Kusho to Shen but then decided it was better for Shen to be disillusioned with Zed than to be disillusioned with his own father. That's probably not fair, and maybe Shen has a right to know. But Zed is flawed... and blinded by his need to feel he's worthy and honorable.[[20]](#cite_note-20)

Shen was arranged to be married to Yevnai but the engagement was called off after  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") "killed" Master Kusho.  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") and Yevnai were at one point secretly in a relationship even when forbidden by Master Kusho, unknown to Shen though he possibly suspected it.[[21]](#cite_note-21)

structure.trivia:
- *Shen* means spirit, holy, or deity;[[22]](#cite_note-22) from Mandarin *shén* [ʂə̃n˧˥] 神 < [OC](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Old_Chinese) \**m-lin*.[[23]](#cite_note-23)
- *The Eye of Twilight* is the title for the leader of the [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kinkou_Order "Kinkou Order"), entrusted with the sacred duty of Watching the Stars - exercising judgment untainted by prejudice.
  - [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") considers twilight as a time of when dark and light are in balance.
- [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") was originally considered for the title *The Eye of Twilight* before he left the Order, which forced Shen to take it.
  - Shen wanted to leave the [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kinkou_Order "Kinkou Order") to defend  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") from  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") during the first invasion but chose to stay mostly because of  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") leaving the order.[[24]](#cite_note-24)
- He uses 2 blades: the Spirit blade to cut the spirits and the steel saber to cut the living.
  - The spirit blade has a vessel on his back that only comes off when he attacks. He can separate the blades power for his shield without moving the vessel.
- He is between 33– 35 years old.
  - He was the same age as present day  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") (or around 19 years old) when he first caught  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin").
- Shen's  [Ki Barrier](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shen#Ki_Barrier "Shen"), previously known as  [Ki Strike](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shen#Ki_Strike "Shen"), is one of the fighting ways of a combat technique known as Ki.  [Riven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Riven "Universe:Riven") also seems to have mastered the technique of  [Ki Burst](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Riven#Ki_Burst "Riven").

professional_status.occupations:
- Interplanar Guardian
- Primary Leader of the [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kinkou_Order "Kinkou Order")

structure.name: Elise
structure.quote: *"Beauty is power too, and can strike swifter than any sword."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Centuries before the present day, Elise was born to [House Kythera](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noble_Houses_of_Noxus "Universe:Noble Houses of Noxus"), which was one of the oldest bloodlines in  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). When she came of age, Elise was able to manipulate her way into a beneficial political marriage to Berholdt of the much more powerful [House Zaavan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noble_Houses_of_Noxus "Universe:Noble Houses of Noxus"), elevating her own status at Zaavan's expense. Elise's influence continued to grow with time, and it did not go unnoticed by the shadowy forces secretly controlling the empire, nor by her ever more resentful husband, Berholdt.

Jealous of his wife's influence, Berholdt poisoned Elise's wine at the dinner table before demanding she withdraw from society and relinquish her power back to him, the head of their house. Since Berholdt had the poison's antidote, Elise made a show of remorse and begged for his forgiveness, and when he let his guard down, she took a knife from the table and stabbed him through the heart. Elise took the antidote, but the poison's effect was potent, leaving her bedridden and near death for weeks.

During this time, the mysterious Pale Woman  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") approached Elise, revealing the truth about the power behind the Noxian houses and how they were controlled by a secret society called the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"). Berholdt, who had been a pawn in their ranks, was now dead, and since Elise was now leader of Houses Kythera and Zaavan, she would have to take his place as a member of the cabal or risk being removed. Elise saw the Pale Woman's offer as an opportunity to acquire ever more power, and over time, she rose through their ranks, using her cunning and wealth to trounce her rivals and persuade others to do her bidding.

### Transformation

After some time serving as a member of the Black Rose, Elise heard rumors that the skull of an ancient warlord named  [Sahn-Uzal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser") had been hidden long ago on the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles"). To gain the matron's favor, Elise took a ship with several acolytes to the cursed city of [Helia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Helia "Universe:Helia"), venturing deep through the Black Mist and into the city's depths in search of the artifact.

Elise and her servants avoided the undead spirits, but as they navigated the depths, they were suddenly ambushed by an enormous creature from a long-forgotten past known as  [Vilemaw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vilemaw "Universe:Vilemaw"), the Spider God. Vilemaw devoured Elise's crew and sank his fangs into Elise's shoulder, using his venom to enact a violent transformation throughout her body. Several arachnoid legs ripped out from her spine, and when the pain of her transformation subsided, she saw her new master looming above her, and without a word, she understood what he wished from her. She left the [twisted treeline](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Treeline "Universe:Twisted Treeline") and sailed back to Noxus alone, returning to her human shape.

Although Elise hadn't found what she had been looking for, the Pale Woman saw an opportunity in her new abilities, which had given the Black Rose a means to travel freely between Noxus and the Shadow Isles. They struck an accord so that Elise would bring as many unwitting sacrifices as Vilemaw desired, and in return, Elise would be free to recover any ancient artifacts from the ruins of Helia to bring back to Noxus.

### Recent Events

#### Service to Vilemaw

Over the centuries since Elise's transformation, she would sustain her eternal beauty and youth by making continuous sacrifices to the Spider God.[[1]](#cite_note-1) Among these sacrifices were either Black Rose devotees or other hapless aristocrats she had seduced under her will, like 1 [Lord Emet](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Hapless_Aristocrat "LoR:Hapless Aristocrat").[[2]](#cite_note-2)

#### The Silken Danse

:   *Main article: [Masque of the Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Masque_of_the_Black_Rose "Universe:Masque of the Black Rose")*

With the rise of the new Grand General, Elise received instructions to invite a number of notable figures to her home, the manor of House Kythera. Among these were the heroic  [Jarro Lightfeather](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ezreal "Universe:Ezreal"), the  [Zaunite](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") entrepreneur  [Renata Glasc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renata_Glasc "Universe:Renata Glasc"), and the fearless Desert Rose  [Samira](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Samira "Universe:Samira"). The matron also hoped that  [Vladimir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vladimir "Universe:Vladimir") would attend the masquerade ball, as she had need of his boldness for her new plan.

The Silken Danse, however, would be infiltrated by  [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina"), who, on orders from an unknown individual, attended the ball in disguise to assassinate an unknown target. Elise attempted to defend the man and fought Katarina, but Katarina successfully slit her target's throat.[[3]](#cite_note-Welcome_to_Noxus-3)

#### Robbery at the Zaavan Manse

:   *Main article: [The Shuttered Manse](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Shuttered_Manse "Universe:The Shuttered Manse")*

One day, a  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") thief called  [No-Face Nyam](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nyam "Universe:Nyam") was hired by a powerful man to steal an artifact Elise had collected for  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), and he broke into the empty, quiet manse of House Zaavan. Elise was waiting for him in the library, and during their altercation, Nyam accidentally broke the cursed hourglass, unleashing a 6 [Soulgorger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Soulgorger "LoR:Soulgorger") into the room. Elise and Nyam briefly joined forces so they could escape to safety, and she injected him with some of her venom so they could defeat the monster together. After Elise imprisoned the spirits once again, Nyam was relieved that they had both survived, feeling a newfound devotion to Lady Elise. However, Elise believed the hourglass was not a strong enough vessel, so she killed Nyam and sealed the spirits inside his bleached skull, which she then delivered to LeBlanc in exchange for more suitors to sacrifice.
structure.appearance:
Elise is described as a woman of striking beauty. Her human appearance is charming and seductive, designed to attract her victims. She has sharp, defined facial features, dark eyes, and short, dark, slicked-back hair with a distinctive scarlet red sweep along the middle. She usually wears a black cape with scarlet red details, cinched with a cross-like brooch that resembles fangs. Beneath this facade however, she is a monstrous spider-hybrid.

In her spider form, Elise turns to crawl and develops multiple limbs that emerge from her back, maintaining her size but discarding all human proportions. Her skin transforms into a dark, furry, bloated mass with vivid patterns as predator coloration. Although she can fully transform into a spider, she also has an intermediate state in which she maintains a human face, torso and posture, but she assumes quasi-arachnoid characteristics, such as her extremities terminating in pointed edges and additional segmented limbs.
structure.personality: Elise is manipulative, cunning and cruel; from a young age, she discovered how to use her beauty to influence others. After her transformation, her abilities to seduce and deceive improved drastically. She often uses charm and the promise of power or ecstasy to lure her victims into her deadly web, enjoying the control she exercises over them. Although she is completely devoted to  [Vilemaw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vilemaw "Universe:Vilemaw"), Elise is pragmatic, and she uses her alliance with the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") to ensure a constant supply of victims. Despite her monstrous coldness, her human desires—a need for power and eternal youth—motivate her actions.
structure.abilities:
- **Magically Altered Physiology:** After Elise was bitten by Vilemaw, she was turned into a terrible spider hybrid with several strange, mystical powers.
  - **Immortality:** By taking the Vilemaw's venom from time to time, Elise managed to live for centuries, without any major aging. Despite this, she is still susceptible to death.
  - **[Spider Transformation:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Elise#Spider_Form "Elise")** Elise can shift from a human form to that of a monstrous giant spider form. She also can stay in a in between form.
    - **Multiple Limbs:** Elise has multiple extra limbs coming from her back. Those spider legs can be used as an extra arms or weapon against foes.
    - **Wall Crawling:** With her spider limbs, Elise can crawl on vertical surfaces.
    - **[Neurotoxin Venom:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Elise#Neurotoxin "Elise")** Elise can naturally create a powerful neurotoxin that can be used to kill her foes in battle.
    - **[Web Making:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Elise#Cocoon "Elise")** Elise can produce webs to ensnare her foes.
    - **[Parthenogenesis:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Elise#Volatile_Spiderling "Elise")** Elise has several spiderlings that she can produce and will, without the help of other being.

relations.relationship_description:
Elise is a loyal member of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") who primarily resides in  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). She was first recruited by  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), who approached Elise when she was in a bedridden state after killing her husband, after which Elise became an influential aristocrat in the cabal's ranks. Elise's work for the Black Rose led her to the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles"), which culminated in her transformation at the hands of  [Vilemaw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vilemaw "Universe:Vilemaw"). She decided to use her newfound powers to the Rose's advantage, providing acolytes to sacrifice to Vilemaw in exchange for free passage to the Shadow Isles and access to its powerful magical artifacts.

Elise is known to host high-society parties on behalf of the Black Rose, but they are known to be much less extravagant than the ones hosted by  [Lord Vladimir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vladimir "Universe:Vladimir"). In support of the matron's plans, Elise sent a formal invitation to Vladimir in hopes he would attend the Silken Danse. However, Vladimir did not attend and instead sent an  [assassin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina") to kill one of the guests that Elise had been ordered to protect.[[4]](#cite_note-YunaraBio-4)
She worships  [Vilemaw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vilemaw "Universe:Vilemaw") and its venom provides her with eternal youth in exchange for the acolytes as prey.
She has multiple spiderlings living with her in the ruin of House Zaavan's halls.

For her daring feats across the empire, Samira is held in high regard by members of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"), including Samira's handler, Captain  [Indari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Indari "Universe:Indari"). Samira's fearlessness led Elise to view her as a kindred spirit, and because of this, Elise sent a letter to Samira inviting her to the Silken Danse in the Kythera manor. She was not seen in attendance at the masquerade.

As an assassin loyal to the Grand General  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), Katarina is an enemy of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") and frequently assassinates members in their ranks. Elise and Katarina had a direct confrontation at the Silken Danse, where she disguised herself as an attendee and infiltrated the Kythera manor to assassinate an unknown target. Elise tried to defend the man, but Katarina successfully slit his throat during their battle.

The  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") has taken interest in Ezreal's feats of heroism across Runeterra, which he performs under the alias "Jarro Lightfeather." The cabal became interested in him, and because of this, Elise sent Ezreal an invitation to attend the Silken Danse. He was not seen in attendance at the masquerade.

As an influential [businesswoman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons") in  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), Renata Glasc caught the attention of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"), with Elise hoping to establish a working business relationship with her. Renata Glasc was sent a personal invitation by Elise to the Silken Danse, but she was not seen in attendance at the masquerade.

structure.trivia: - **Elise**,  [Hecarim](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hecarim "Universe:Hecarim"),  [Karthus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Karthus "Universe:Karthus"),  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser"), and  [Yorick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yorick "Universe:Yorick") would trigger dedicated lines about themselves when capturing the [Twisted Treeline](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twisted_Treeline "Universe:Twisted Treeline") altars, which can be found [here](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Altar "Altar").

structure.name: Yorick
structure.quote: *"These isles... How they scream."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Yorick grew up in a small fishing village on the edge of the Blessed Isles. He could never find acceptance among his peers, and he eventually learned that he could see the spirits of the dead. While at first he was scared of these spirits, he eventually realized that they were just lost and did not want to hurt him. They wanted to find their way to what lay beyond death, and Yorick helped guide them there. While Yorick was happy to guide them, it was a bittersweet task, as he liked talking to these spirits and helping one reach the beyond meant losing a friend.

### Ruination

Tales of Yorick's visions spread and caught the attention of a small religious order of monks called the Brethren of the Dusk. They inducted Yorick into their ranks and gave him a vial of the Waters of Life to wear around his neck, which was common for members of the order. These Waters of Life were magical in nature and could heal someone of almost any injury or ailment. Despite being part of the order, Yorick found himself alone again, shunned by the other monks because he could easily see what they had spent their entire lives trying to understand.

One day, as he was tending to his daily duties in the cemetery, Yorick saw a dark cloud moving across the surface of the Isles and devouring everything in its path. This was the Black Mist, created when a  [young king](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viego "Viego") tried to revive his  [dead wife](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Isolde "Isolde") in the Waters of Life. As the Mist spread, it caused the monks to pull the vials from their necks before consuming their souls and turning their bodies into corpses. Yorick used all of his willpower to not pull the vial from his neck before being consumed by the Mist.

When he awoke, Yorick had been physically changed, and the Isles had been cleansed of all life. The Black Mist reached for him, but recoiled when it tried to reach for the vial around his neck. He realized that the only thing keeping him alive was the last of the Waters of Life around his neck. Despite searching for days, Yorick found no survivors. In his grief, he talked to the spirits surrounding him. They gravitated to his word, and Yorick realized that he could control them. Determined to free the dead spirits on the Isles, Yorick decided to use these powers to end the curse upon the Isles.

### Sentinels of Light

While on their quest to defeat  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego"), the [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sentinels_of_Light "Universe:Sentinels of Light") visited Yorick to ask for help. Seeing that their goals aligned with his, Yorick gave them some of the drops from his vial along with the  [Maiden of the Mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yorick#Eulogy_of_the_Isles "Yorick"), which was revealed to be a fetter, containing a piece of  [Isolde's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isolde "Universe:Isolde")'s soul.
structure.appearance: Yorick is a muscular man with light blue skin and glowing eyes because of his time spent in the Shadow Isles. He wears a dark blue outfit common for those in his position in the Brethren of the Dusk, with no sleeves, fingerless gloves, black shoes, and elongated shoulder pads. Yorick carries with him a large shovel used for digging graves and as a weapon if need be. Around his neck is a glowing light blue vial, containing some of the last drops of the Waters of Life.
structure.personality: Yorick is a quiet and solemn individual. Resigned to his fate long ago, Yorick dutifully digs graves for those who die and have died on the Shadow Isles. While he often talks to the tormented souls around him because of his loneliness and grief and despite caring for the souls, he is aware that they are being controlled by the Mist. His ultimate goal is to find the  [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viego "Viego") and find a way to let everything in the Shadow Isles die, and in his mind, finally be at peace, including himself.
structure.abilities:
- **[Soul Sense](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Yorick was born with natural magical abilities, specifically the ability to see and speak to the dead.
- **Magical Control:** Yorick can control elements of the Black Mist and the dead to his will.
  - **[Mist walkers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yorick#Shepherd_of_Souls "Yorick"):** Yorick can summon dead souls to do his bidding.
  - **[Maiden of the Mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yorick#Eulogy_of_the_Isles "Yorick"):** A personification of the Black Mist that tries to manipulate him, Yorick can summon and control the Maiden of the Mist to do his bidding.
- **Immortality:** Much to his dismay, Yorick is immortal. There is no known way to permanently kill him.

relations.relationship_description: Illaoi's faith would compel her to kill a man like Yorick, but her recent experiences had given her enough of an open mind to cooperate with the monk. In their philisophical debate, Yorick argues that helping the dead find peace is more important than banishing them back into the cycle of life. Furthermore, his power to compel the dead would align with the Buhru law of motion, either by commanding the Black Mist or rescuing tormented spirits.

Yorick dreamt of destroying the Ruined King that decimated Helia. This pursuit would drive him to sacrifice his lifelines, such as leaving his seat of power with Illaoi in the first attempt, or giving away the Maiden and his Water of Life to the Sentinels that would succeed in the second attempt. Although, he was disappointed to learn that Viego's banishment has no effect on the Black Mist, and therefore his own predicament.

When the Sentinels met Yorick, he became confident that their strength could stop Viego once and for all. He sacrificed his powers—the Maiden and the Water of Life—knowing that they will be critical for victory.

structure.trivia:
- His full name is Yorick Mori, much like his pre-VGU self.

- Yorick's cape is made of thousands of undead souls. It is made from the Mist and is always trying to possess him.
  - The Maiden, Yorick's companion, is the culmination of those souls, held together by a fragment of Isolde's soul.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
  - Yorick's relationship with it was described by a Riot employee as "60% symbiotic/40% parasitic."[[2]](#cite_note-2)
- Yorick believes the only way to free the souls in the Shadow Isles is to see them through to the "true" death.
- While Yorick does use the undead souls to do his bidding, he does not see himself as having enslaved them, as he believes that he gives them some agency in what they do.
- Yorick can always see  [both Lamb and Wolf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kindred "Universe:Kindred"), even though he is not truly dead.

structure.name: Leona
structure.quote: *"By the light of the Sun, the world is beheld."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Leona was born to Sunforgers Iasur and Melia within the  [Rakkor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rakkor "Universe:Rakkor") tribes of  [Mount Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mount_Targon "Universe:Mount Targon"). Along with her younger siblings Aidonel and Kespina, Leona was raised since birth to honor the faith of the  [Solari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Solari "Universe:Solari"), a religious sect of the Rakkor that highly venerated the sun.

Leona took to the Solari faith as easily as breathing, proving excellence in capability, willpower and devotion to the faith. Leona's faith and skill was so strong that her peers grew jealous, as nobody had doubts that she would one day become one of the elite *Ra'Horak* warriors of the Solari.

#### Relationship with Diana

One day, the Solari took in a young orphan named [Diana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Diana "Diana"), who did not follow the Solari's values as easily and instead preferred the moon and the night. The Solari punished Diana constantly and called her a heretic for her blasphemy, but Leona felt pity for her and saw her as a lost soul searching for meaning.

One night, Diana confided a secret to Leona and spoke of the hidden alcove she discovered in the mountain, an ancient place where the walls depicted strange imagery of the moon and forgotten societies dressed in silver armor, proving that the sun and the moon were in fact not enemies at all. Noticing the heresy of what Diana described, she urged her to abandon this search and never speak of her discoveries, seeking to protect Diana from the brutal punishments of the other Solari if they heard of what she found. Diana reluctantly promised Leona that she'd abandon her discoveries and the two never spoke of it again as time passed, while Leona believed that her friend finally came to her senses.

#### Ascending Mount Targon

On one fateful night, Leona caught a glimpse of Diana sneaking out of the temple. Though Leona's first instincts was to tell the elders, she instead decided to protect her friend from their punishments and set off to follow her into the night.

Following Diana, Leona ascended Mount Targon itself and endured a brutal trial unlike anything she'd ever faced before as every fiber of her being was tested to its limits. As she passed frozen bodies embedded into the mountain's slopes, Leona continued her journey and endured thanks to her training, willpower and drive to protect Diana.

Miraculously, to Leona's surprise, she finally reached the peak of the mountain after what felt like an eternity. Exhausted and beholding an uncanny landscape at the peak, she found Diana engulfed in a column of silver light, writhing in agony to Leona's horror. As she rushed to her aid, a second, golden column of light burst from the heavens, fell on her and enveloped her entire body.

#### Becoming an Aspect

Leona felt the sun's powers course through her and sear away her very being, but her indomitable will allowed her to retain her consciousness. Leona expected to be incinerated but instead emerged the new [Host](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aspect_Host "Aspect Host") for the 6 [Aspect of the Sun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Golden_Sister "LoR:The Golden Sister"), realizing that she was destined to protect the Solari in dire times to come.

Diana also emerged as a new Aspect of 6 [the Moon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Silver_Sister "LoR:The Silver Sister"), now clad in silver armor that reflected the golden armor Leona found herself wearing. Diana was overjoyed that the two of them became Aspects together and begged Leona to join her on a new quest to find answers outside of the Solari faith, but Leona demanded that they return home and present themselves for the priests' judgements. The two argued and neither conceded as they engaged in swift combat utilizing their newfound powers. Diana eventually had her crescent blade at Leona's throat but refused to deal the killing blow and fled. Devastated, Leona descended the mountain without Diana and hurried to report to the elders.

Unfortunately, when Leona arrived, she found many Solari priests and Ra'Horak guards slaughtered, seemingly by Diana's hands. The survivors emerged and awed at Leona's arrival, amazed by the arrival of not one but *two* Aspects among them. Now as the new Aspect of the Sun, Leona knew that great threats and changes were coming to Runeterra and vowed to act as a guiding light for her people serving as fierce leader.

### Modern History

Leona continued to lead the Solari as an avatar of their faith and was eventually appointed as the commander for the entire Ra'Horak, gaining complete control and loyalty of all the Solari warriors. Though she seeks to preserve the religious dominance of the Solari, she has sworn to find and locate Diana in fear of what the Aspect of the Moon will do to her if she does not learn to control it.

#### Confronting Diana

*(TBA)* [[1]](#cite_note-1)[[2]](#cite_note-2)[[3]](#cite_note-3)[[4]](#cite_note-4)

#### Facing Atreus

structure.appearance:
Leona is a tall, beautiful woman with lightly tanned skin, light brown eyes and long back-length shiny auburn reddish hair.

Her attire consists of red and gold Solari armor that covers her entire body, a spiked golden crown on her head, and she always carries her sword and shield.
structure.personality:
Leona is a devout and loyal Solari warrior, willing to give her life in the name of the sun and her people. She has an incredibly strong force of will, evidenced by her early schooling, the trials she undertook before being imbued by the Aspect of the Sun, and her commitment to guiding the Solari as host to the Aspect.

She is a warm soul, especially with [Diana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Diana "Diana"), who was her closest friend and lover before her betrayal at the peak of Mount Targon. Many Solari demanded Diana's head due to this betrayal, but Leona instead endeavors to help her control the Moon Aspect's power before it destroys her. She still loves Diana despite her betrayal, but is unable to bring herself to reconcile with her.
structure.abilities:
- **[Aspect Host Physiology:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aspect_Host "Aspect Host")** Leona is the mortal host to the 6 [Aspect of the Sun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Golden_Sister "LoR:The Golden Sister"), blessing her with incredible abilities tied to her aspect as well as enhanced strength, speed, immunity to pain and sickness and a dramatically increased lifespan.
  - **[Solar Magic:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Leona#Solar_Flare "Leona")** Leona's powers are tied to her Aspect, granting her magical abilities tied to the sun. Leona can utilize this magic to summon solar flares from the sky to strike down enemies as well as magically empower her  [sword](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Leona#Zenith_Blade "Leona") and  [shield](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Leona#Shield_of_Daybreak "Leona") with solar energies capable of burning and searing her enemies in solar fire.
- **Combat Training:** Leona was trained in the elite *Ra'Horak,* the highest order of warriors in the  [Solari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Solari "Universe:Solari") faith. Leona's combat expertise was so exceptional that since childhood nobody had doubts that she would one day become a member of the Ra'Horak.
  - **Sword & Shield Proficiency:** Leona is incredibly talented in combat with the traditional Ra'Horak weapons of a sword and shield.
- **[Shield of Daybreak:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Leona#Shield_of_Daybreak "Leona")** Leona wields the Shield of Daybreak, which was summoned into her arms when she first emerged as the Aspect of the Sun. This legendary shield is inherently tied to the Aspect and can be empowered with solar energies, allowing it to create a barrier of solar energy and emitting heat and light.
- **[Zenith Blade:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Leona#Zenith_Blade "Leona")** Leona wields the Zenith Blade, which was summoned into her arms when she first emerged as the Aspect of the Sun. This legendary sword is inherently tied to the Aspect and can be empowered with solar energies, allowing it to emit powerful light and heat capable of instantly searing flesh.

relations.relationship_description:
Despite their disagreements,  [Diana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Diana "Universe:Diana") and  **Leona** were close friends and lovers growing up on Mount Targon, but have since became enemies after becoming Aspects. The two expressed [romantic interest](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rise_with_Me "Rise with Me") during the Festival of the Nightless Eve.
Leona saw the moment Diana was imbued with the moon's power, she rushed to help before being imbued with the sun's power herself and made an Aspect.

[Atreus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pantheon "Universe:Pantheon") climbed Mount Targon to find the power of Aspects when Leona refused to destroy the trespassers that attacked his patrol. After he defeated  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox") and became the new Aspect of War, he opposes her and other Targonian Aspects.
Leona would not move against the Barbarians because she knew  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox") was slaughtering them, which Atreus would only understand later on.[[6]](#cite_note-6)
Soraka refers to [Leona](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Leona "Leona") as "Woman whose face burned like the sun".

As the champion of the [Solari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Solari "Solari"), Alune sees [Leona](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Leona "Leona") as the Lunari's ultimate enemy. However, like most of the [Lunari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lunari "Lunari"), she is not necessarily hostile towards Leona or the Solari.

structure.trivia:
- *Leona* is the modern feminine derivative of Ancient Greek name *Leon* Λέων "[lion](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lion)", from an Afro-Asiatic source[[7]](#cite_note-7) (cf. Proto-Semitic *\*labuʔ ~ \*labiʔ*);[[8]](#cite_note-8)
- Leona has been confirmed to be a lesbian after years of speculation, debuting her kissing Diana in [Rise with Me](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rise_with_Me "Rise with Me")[[9]](#cite_note-9), and later specifically her being a lesbian in [an announcement for 2023 Pride Month](https://www.riotgames.com/en/news/celebrating-pride-community-artists), where she and Diana are depicted with the [Lesbian Flag](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lesbian_flags).

structure.name: Nautilus
structure.quote: *"When consumed by utter darkness, there is nothing left but forward."*
structure.background:
### Origin

*(TBA)*

### Dead in the Water

*(TBA)*
structure.appearance: Even as a human, Nautilus was described as a large man, a "quick-sinking hulk of solid muscle."[[1]](#cite_note-1) After he drowned, Nautilus awoke even larger, a spirit housed without his great metal diving suit that had grown into an enormous, titanic monstrosity who was larger than most ships, with massive metal gauntlets and giant boots that pounded across the seafloor. Having sat beneath the waves for centuries, Nautilus's suit has grown rusted and brown and covered in cracks and barnacles. His eyes are visible from within the dark casing as glowing orange lights, and the cracks in his suit glow with an eerie, ghost-like green colour, emphasizing his nature as an [undead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Undead "Undead"). As a weapon he carries an enormous  [anchor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nautilus#Staggering_Blow "Nautilus") attached to a  [line](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nautilus#Dredge_Line "Nautilus"), which he uses to sink ships below the waves.
structure.personality:
Nautilus was a very superstitious man in life, and he would never set out to sea without first appeasing the  [vast ocean](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nagakabouros "Universe:Nagakabouros") by "paying the tithe".[[2]](#cite_note-2) He maintains this mindset after becoming a [revenant](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Revenant "Revenant"), and will sink any ship that crosses his path should they forget to drop a coin into the ocean. Nautilus never tires of this mission, making him dutiful but also ruthless and vengeful against those who would disrespect the sea, but generally spares those who show the Bearded Lady proper reverence.

Nautilus has a slow, deliberate manner of speaking. He likes to make his voice as deep as possible, so as to intimidate people. He is also a very old and ancient being who appears to miss his youth as he watches the excitable young sea creatures in the ocean around him.
structure.abilities:
- **[Revenant Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Revenant "Revenant"):** As an undead, Nautilus is bound to his armoured diving suit and does not need to eat or breathe, allowing him to remain underwater for as long as he wishes.
  - **[Cursed Diving Suit:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nautilus#Titan's_Wrath "Nautilus")** Nautilus's great metal diving suit, which houses his spirit, has grown to a titanic size, becoming virtually indestructible to all who may seek to destroy him.
- **[Powers of the Ocean:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nagakabouros "Universe:Nagakabouros")** After his death, Nautilus was blessed with an ancient power which allows him to command the  [waves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nautilus#Riptide "Nautilus") from beneath the  [depths](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nautilus#Depth_Charge "Nautilus").
- **[Anchor:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nautilus#Staggering_Blow "Nautilus")** Torn from his captain's ship, Nautilus wields an enormous anchor as a weapon. Should any ship try to escape him, Nautilus can  [extend](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nautilus#Dredge_Line "Nautilus") the anchor's reach by its chain, so that he may pull them to the depths below.

relations.relationship_description: While he was a human, Nautilus was a strong believer in appeasing the  [ocean](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nagakabouros "Universe:Nagakabouros") and would always request that his captains throw a coin overboard in order to appease her. Now, having become the Titan of the Depths, Nautilus continues to carry out his interpretation of the Bearded Lady's will, and shows no signs of growing tired of his mission.

While the  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") -  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") combined armada fought [the Black Mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Black_Mist "The Black Mist") on [Bilgewater's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Bilgewater "Bilgewater") shores (eventually succeeding but at great cost) Nautilus managed to stall and/or defeat the rest of the undead threat a few miles from the port city itself.

Nautilus has a fondness for many of the sea creatures, like the 2 [Coral Creatures](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Coral_Creatures "LoR:Coral Creatures"), 3 [Bubble Bear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Bubble_Bear "LoR:Bubble Bear"), 1 [Admiwal Shelly and Nurtle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Shellshocker "LoR:Shellshocker"). There are some he finds annoying though, like 4 [Zap Sprayfin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Zap_Sprayfin "LoR:Zap Sprayfin"), possibly because she is friends with  [Fizz](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fizz "Universe:Fizz").
Nautilus hates  [Fizz](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fizz "Universe:Fizz") and would like to see him dead.

Nautilus encountered  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune") once before when he arrived to collect the debt of the Moon Serpent and its captain, Aligh. Miss Fortune survived the encounter, but only because Nautilus was after Aligh, not her.*[[3]](#cite_note-3)*

Having nearly been claimed by the depths once before,  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") refuses to pay the Bearded Lady's tithe out of spite, not seeming to believe Nautilus truly exists.

structure.trivia:
- *Nautilus* comes from Greek word for sailor, ναυτίλος.
  - Out of universe, Nautilus is also the name of [a mollusc taxonomic family](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nautilus), the submarine from [Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twenty_Thousand_Leagues_Under_the_Sea) by [Jules Verne](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jules_Verne), and subsequently the first [nuclear-powered submarine](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USS_Nautilus_(SSN-571))
- Nautilus' backstory might be referencing [The Pirates of Dark Water](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Pirates_of_Dark_Water).
- Despite similarities to Nautilus's lore, Riot decided to keep  [Pyke's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Pyke "Pyke") lore the same because they felt there was enough room for two deep sea revenants that desired revenge.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
