- The Titan of the Depths
- Titan of the Deep

structure.name: Boram_Darkwill
structure.background:
### Early Life and Reign

:   *Main article: [Reign of Darkwill](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reign_of_Darkwill "Universe:Reign of Darkwill")*

Boram Darkwill was born into one of the [Great Houses](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noble_Houses_of_Noxus "Universe:Noble Houses of Noxus") of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). During his young adult years, he was able to gain the favor of various other nobles by appealing to their heritage. His favorable position in the empire and the aid of an ancient cabal with long-standing ties to the nobility, known as the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"), eventually allowed him to seize the imperial throne of Noxus and become its Grand General.[[2]](#cite_note-LeBlancBio-2)

Ruling during a time when Noxus had been weakened by its enemies, Darkwill was determent to restore the empire to its former glory. His allies, the Black Rose, had suggested reanimating the old Noxian war hero,  [Sion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion") from the dead. Desperate for a show of power, Darkwill ordered the cabal the resurrect the war hero. Using forbidden magics, the cabal resurrected the war hero and presented him to the Grand General. After a few battles, Sion was deemed uncontrollable, as he slaughtered both friend and foe alike, and Darkwill ordered for his imprisonment. Without slaughter, the blood magic that sustained him quickly engulfed his mind in an all-consuming rage.[[3]](#cite_note-SionBio-3)

Deeming Black Rose to have become unreliable, Darkwill refused the counsel of their hand-picked advisors.[[2]](#cite_note-LeBlancBio-2) Forced to take drastic measures,  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), the leader of the Black Rose, used the noble families involved with the cabal into conspiring against the Grand General. In order to set her plans into action, she orchestrated events so that a young  [Jericho Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain") would discover these conspiring individuals and publicly execute them, faking her own death in the process. As a reward for his efforts, Darkwill appointed Swain as one of his top and most trusted generals, unaware of LeBlanc's manipulations.[[4]](#cite_note-SwainBio-4)

### Medardan Succession War

:   *Main article: [Ambessa: Chosen of the Wolf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa:_Chosen_of_the_Wolf "Universe:Ambessa: Chosen of the Wolf")*

In the years leading up to his long-awaited invasion of  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), Darkwill arranged his annual tribute in his palace at the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion"), which was an extravagant ball themed around battlefield glory. Darkwill brought in dancers from every corner of the empire to perform at his entrance. His Baleful Guard stood at attention to prevent the scheming nobles from causing bloodshed in his home.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)

As the Grand General sat on his throne, leaders from across the empire came to offer their gifts of tribute. Hostlord Menelik, the feared leader of  [House Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda"), had died several months prior, and two of his grandchildren, Ta'Fik and  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"), had made claims to succeed him. Ta'Fik offered Darkwill an army of rune-soldiers, [enhanced](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic") by the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") to be stronger and faster than any Darkwill had ever seen before. Ambessa offered something else: a [vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vastaya "Universe:Vastaya") named Caprian, who knew the hidden ways into the treacherous, magical lands of Ionia. Darkwill did not promise either of them his immediate support, but he was pleased enough by Ambessa's tribute that onlookers in the crowd noticed and began to wonder what she had given him.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)

Caprian proved useful to the Grand General, and he found the hidden route into Ionia. In return for Ambessa's gift, Darkwill gave her the boon of his favor, as well as an imperial fleet and admiral ready at her command.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)

### Search for Immortality

:   *Main article: [Noxian Invasion of Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxian_Invasion_of_Ionia "Universe:Noxian Invasion of Ionia")*

As the years went on, Darkwill slowly became more paranoid about his surroundings, fearful of his own mortality.  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), who had secretly been able to get closer to Darkwill himself, was able to poison the aging Grand General's mind with promises of immortality. Corrupted by LeBlanc's words, Darkwill became obsessed with finding the cure to his own mortality. Driven by his obsession, he commanded his armies to wage relentless campaigns across distant lands, hoping to uncover ancient relics that might prolong his lifespan. His conquests stretched to the northern shores of  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), the [Ironspike Mountains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ironspike_Mountains "Universe:Ironspike Mountains") of the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord"), and, most significantly, the invasion of the  [Ionian mainland](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia").[[2]](#cite_note-LeBlancBio-2)

The invasion began in [Navori](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori "Universe:Navori"), with soldiers ordered to both kill the innocents and ransack any magical artifacts that could be used to help extend one's life. The Ionians, who had upheld pacifist ideals for generations, were forced to resort to violence to protect their homeland. As resistance leaders like  [Karma](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Karma "Universe:Karma") and  [Irelia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Irelia "Universe:Irelia") came out of the wood works, Noxian advances were halted for years.[[5]](#cite_note-IreliaBio-5) As time went by, Darkwill became even more desperate, sending child soldiers to Ionia in hopes that the Ionians would be unwilling to attack them.[[6]](#cite_note-KaynBio-6) One of the worst atrocities was when Darkwill ordered one of his commanders, Emystan, to employ the Zaunite alchemist  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") to create [chemtech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chemtech "Universe:Chemtech") bombs to aid the Noxian cause. As these deadly chemical weapons of mass destruction were released, they would level entire villages, fracturing stone, and torching and corrupting the sacred land of Ionia.[[7]](#cite_note-SingedBio-7) One of these village was known to harbor a  [master swordsman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Master_Yi "Universe:Master Yi") who had been instrumental in the halt of the invasion. The chemical bombing caused the town, its people, and its culture to be wiped from existence, save for the single bladesman.[[8]](#cite_note-MasterYiBio-8)

In his paranoia and with the persuasion of LeBlanc, Darkwill set up his most trusted general,  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), for failure. Under the pretense of securing the [Placidium](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Placidium_of_Navori "Universe:The Placidium of Navori"), Swain was assigned to hold back the local militia at the Placidium by luring them into a trap. However, Darkwill deliberately withheld the reinforcements Swain would need, ensuring his forces were stretched thin. What should have been an assured victory turned into a deadly trap, setting Swain up to be overrun and defeated in disgrace.[[4]](#cite_note-SwainBio-4)[[2]](#cite_note-LeBlancBio-2)

### Death & Legacy

In spite of his dishonorable discharge from the military, former General  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), with the help of  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven") and  [General Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau"), among others, enacted a coup within the Noxian capital, deposing and killing the Grand General in full view of his followers.[[4]](#cite_note-SwainBio-4) This coup would later be known as the **Trifarian Revolution**. In order to ensure that the seat of power in Noxus would not be so easily corrupted, Swain formed a new governing body called the  [Trifarix](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trifarix "Universe:Trifarix"), which divided former powers of the imperial seat into three parts.[[9]](#cite_note-Proclamation-9)
structure.appearance:
In his youth, Darkwill was a man with strong, stern facial features. He had fair skin and shoulder-length brown hair. He used to wear a dark Noxian medium armor that was characterized by his long red cape with fur covering its neck.

At formal events, Darkwill was known to wear impressive clothing with silver boots and shoulder caps, with a long fur-lined cloak. He would also wear a calm, self-satisfied smile on his face to present an air of nobility.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)
structure.personality:
In his youth, Darkwill was charismatic, intelligent, and deeply ambitious. He harbored the natural talent for navigating the complex web of Noxian politics, charming and persuading others by appealing to their pride and heritage. Darkwill had an intense desire for Noxian greatness, genuinely wanting to restore the empire to its former glory. While ambitious, he was politically astute, understanding that he needed allies who shared his vision and who he could trust. However, even in his younger years, there were hints of inclination for ruthlessness and manipulation, although these traits manifested themselves more strategically rather then outright malice.

At the height of his reign, Darkwill was known for having a grandiose personality, who was both larger-than-life and secretive, hiding his true self behind the mask of theatrics. Darkwill's home was extravagantly decorated with portraits of himself, each of them cultivating an image of wisdom, fearlessness, and strength.  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") believed these portraits painted Darkwill as a desperate man, trying to convince himself of something that wasn't true.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)

As Darkwill aged, the paranoia and obsession with his mortality began to consume him. His once pragmatic outlook on Noxus evolved into a tyrannical determination to preserve his power at any cost. He grew increasingly distrustful, often seeing betrayal in others where none existed, leading him to manipulate, oppress, and even sabotage his most loyal generals. Driven by desperation, Darkwill's ruthlessness was left uncontrolled by his usual strategic planning. He resorted to forbidden magic, child soldiers, and weapons of mass destruction, showing no empathy for the lives lost under his orders.
structure.abilities:
- **Master of Diplomacy**: Darkwill was highly skilled at navigating the complex social structures within Noxus. He possessed an acute understanding of the motivations and desires of those around him, particularly among the noble houses. His diplomatic prowess was crucial to his ascent to the imperial seat.
- **Adept Manipulator**: Darkwill was highly perceptive, able to spot the weaknesses, ambitions, and insecurities in others and exploit them to his advantage. However, he was not without flaws. While skilled, he was easily deceived by more cunning manipulators, such as  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), who could play the game at a higher level, especially later in his life.

relations.relationship_description: Darkwill knew Hostlord Menelik Medarda and considered his granddaughter, Ambessa, to be one of  [House Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda")'s best war leaders. After Menelik's death, Darkwill was initially uninterested in getting involved with the matter of succession, but Ambessa convinced him otherwise when she offered him a [vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vastaya "Universe:Vastaya") named Caprian, who held vital information which could help him plan his invasion of  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"). In exchange for this gift, Darkwill gave Ambessa an imperial fleet and admiral to help her defeat her rival in the clan, Ta'Fik.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)

After being victorious against the cloud-fortresses of the [Varju](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Varju_Mountains "Universe:Varju Mountains"), Darius was named the Hand of Noxus by Darkwill. When Darius was away leading a prolonged military campaign in the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord"), Darkwill was killed in a coup led by Swain. Upon Darius return to the capital, many of the noble houses believed that the Hand of Noxus would avenge Darkwill's death. However, Darius chose to align himself with Swain, recognizing his vision for Noxus.[[10]](#cite_note-DariusBio-10)

LeBlanc and her cabal were initially allies of Boram Darkwill. However, when the Black Rose started to slowly lose his favor, LeBlanc decided to fake her own execution to bring the young Grand General back into complacency. As Darkwill became increasingly paranoid with age, LeBlanc took advantage of his growing obsession with his own mortality, making him more erratic, and ultimately leading to his downfall.[[2]](#cite_note-LeBlancBio-2)

Xin Zhao, then known as the  [Reckoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners")  ["Viscero"](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"), was bought out from the arenas by Darkwill and his advisors, who needed more soldiers for their war against  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"). At Darkwill's command, Xin Zhao and his fellows were sent against their will to reclaim [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead") or die for the glory of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). As they were disorganized conscripts, they stood no chance against the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard").[[11]](#cite_note-XinZhaoBio-11)[[12]](#cite_note-Sailed-12)

Darkwill recognized Riven's potential and awarded her a powerful runic blade, symbolizing her loyalty to Noxus. However, Riven quickly became disillusioned with the empire during the invasion of Ionia, where she witnessed the horrific consequences of Noxian aggression, including the use of chemical weapons. This trauma led her to hate the sword Darkwill had given her, which became a reminder of her betrayal.[[13]](#cite_note-RivenBio-13)
On Darkwill's orders, Sion was resurrected to bolster the young Grand General's military might. However, he soon found Sion uncontrollable and had him sealed back up.[[3]](#cite_note-SionBio-3)

After thwarting an attempted coup against Darkwill, Swain was elevated to one of his most trusted generals. However, as Darkwill's paranoia grew, he ultimately betrayed Swain by orchestrating a military operation designed for failure. This betrayal prompted Swain to lead a coup d'état against Darkwill, which resulted in his death and the end of his reign.[[4]](#cite_note-SwainBio-4)
According to one of Swain's voicelines, Singed is one of Boram Darkwill's "loose ends."[[14]](#cite_note-SwainAudio-14)

During the  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") war, a number of Darkwill's commanders conscripted child soldiers. When Kayn was no more than ten years old, he was sent by  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") to die in the province of [Bahrl](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bahrl "Universe:Bahrl") and killed numerous Ionians in the battle, before he was later found and taken in by  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed").[[6]](#cite_note-KaynBio-6)

Near the end of his reign, Darkwill requested the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") and its hemomancers create a new weapon for him: A living golem born from blood, distinguishing it from their previous work on the  [deceased](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion"). The result of this experiment was Briar, who was deemed too dangerous to be used and locked away after her first mission. When the coup against Darkwill began, Briar was set loose to try and kill  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), but she failed in this task, devouring everyone except her target.[[15]](#cite_note-BriarBio-15)

structure.trivia: - Darkwill's appearance was only shown once in ["The Exile" comic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/File:Riven_The_Exile.jpg "File:Riven The Exile.jpg") when he was handing over  [Riven's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Riven "Universe:Riven") runic blade.[[16]](#cite_note-16)

structure.name: Cassiopeia
structure.quote: *"Secrets are sharper than blades…"*
structure.background:
### Early life

Born as a noble of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), Cassiopeia Du Couteau had a sharp mind and wit at an early age, and very early on in her life the Du Couteau family moved to [Urzeris](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Urzeris "Urzeris"),  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"). While her older sister  [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina") trained under their father  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus_Du_Couteau "Universe:Marcus Du Couteau") to be an assassin, Cassiopeia was taught by her mother  [Soreana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Soreana_Du_Couteau "Universe:Soreana Du Couteau") how to use a position of authority. One day, Soreana fell ill as a result of an assassination attempt through poisoning her hairbrush. With Marcus removing the house staff, Cassiopeia tended to her mother, where the two developed a closer bond as Soreana recovered.

When Marcus and Katarina returned to Noxus, Cassiopeia remained in Urzeris with her mother. Soreana told her the truth that she was part of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") cult, which had managed to influence Shurima. As Cassiopeia grew to adulthood, Soreana mentored her to be a cunning and manipulative figure who could use those around her as tools before disposing of them when given the chance. Cassiopeia was initiated into the Black Rose by stealthily assassinating those who plotted Soreana's death.

After gaining her role with the Black Rose's plans, Cassiopeia raided Shuriman ruins with the help of a Shuriman mercenary named  [Sivir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir "Universe:Sivir"). When Soreana received the news that her husband honored  [Jericho Swain's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain") coup against  [Boram Darkwill](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boram_Darkwill "Universe:Boram Darkwill"), she realized that the Black Rose would be in danger, so she instructed Cassiopeia to obtain Shurima's godly power. Swearing to her mother's oath, Cassiopeia raided the underground Tomb of the Forgotten with Sivir. She backstabbed Sivir with her dagger before reaching for the artifact, the Chalikar to open the doors to the tomb and gain the [God-Warriors'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/God-Warrior "God-Warrior") power of Ascension.

However, Cassiopeia was bitten by a stone snake guardian which guarded the tomb, painfully transforming her into a half-human, half-snake hybrid. Falling into despair, Cassiopeia mourned her lost life for weeks, but eventually moved on and accepted her new form, hoping for her newfound Ascended magic to have potential for the Black Rose.

### Contemporary history

### Recent events

:   *Main article: [The Shedding of Skin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Shedding_of_Skin "The Shedding of Skin")*

Getting used to her new form while overlooking Urzeris, Cassiopeia felt an urge to hunt down a Noxian soldier she held contempt for. Lurking out of his view, she admonished him for killing children for drake meat for profit and killing three people while leaving them unrecognizable. Calling out to her to show herself, Cassiopeia revealed her monstrous appearance to him. She wrapped her tail around the soldier, feeling sadistic satisfaction towards his pain. He recognized her as Lady Cassiopeia and taunted her about how she lost her nobility. In response, Cassiopeia released all of her pent-up emotions as she petrified him into stone. Feeling satisfaction that her new cursed form allowed her to take what she wanted, she smashed the petrified soldier as she eagerly plotted to attack her next victim.
structure.appearance: Cassiopeia is a slim woman who wears only a Shuriman headdress, bra and armbands on her elbows. After being transformed by her curse, her legs turned into a long green snake tail merged into her body with a golden belt, and her fingers have become golden with an adorned jewel on the back of each hand. She has black sclera with glowing lime irises and slitted pupils. She has snake-like fangs in place of teeth and a forked tongue.
structure.personality: Cassiopeia is a treacherous, manipulative schemer who takes any opportunity she can to further her goals. She has an individualistic philosophy, seeing others as tools to exploit. After transforming into her cursed form, she initially felt disgust towards her new body and despair from losing her old life as a noble, but embraced her new form as a way to enact her goals herself. Though Cassiopeia's new capabilities have made her sadistic and predatory, she still has moral standards and prefers to hunt those more evil than herself, such as when she admonished and killed a Noxian soldier whom committed inhumane crimes.
structure.abilities:
- **Magically Altered Physiology:** After being bitten by a stone snake guardian that guarded the Tomb of the Forgotten in  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), Cassiopeia was transformed in a monstrous half-human, half-snake hybrid creature with several new powers.
  - **Tail:** Cassiopeia's legs were replaced by a long, snake like tail. She can use her tail to ensnare others, or as a blunt weapon. The tail is also much faster than normal human legs.
  - **[Toxin Creation](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cassiopeia#Noxious_Blast "Cassiopeia"):** Cassiopeia naturally produces powerful toxins that can kill one in a matter of minutes.
  - **[Fangs](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cassiopeia#Twin_Fang "Cassiopeia"):** Cassiopeia has gained fangs that she can use to bite her foes, or shoot as projectiles.
  - **[Petrifying Gaze](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cassiopeia#Petrifying_Gaze "Cassiopeia"):** Cassiopeia's gaze can turn others to stone.

relations.relationship_description: Cassiopeia is  [Katarina's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina") younger sister. The sisters and  [the Blade's Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Talon "Universe:Talon") are members of  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") noble  [House Du Couteau](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Du_Couteau "Universe:House Du Couteau"), whose head (General Marcus, Noxus' finest assassin) is missing and presumed dead.

Cassiopeia was initiated into the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") order by her mother Soreana. One of her missions tasked by her mother was to retrieve godlike powers that had been the key to  [Shurima's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") supremacy in ancient times to help the order defeat Swain's [Trifarix](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Trifarix "Trifarix"). Her father and sister supported  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), which was considered a betrayal by Cassiopeia and her mother. Other members of her house may not be aware of their connection to the organization.

Cassiopeia hired  [Sivir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir "Universe:Sivir") to raid ancient  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") ruins and later stabbed her to steal her blade in order to open an ancient tomb.
 [Renekton](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renekton "Universe:Renekton") and  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") were released thanks to Cassiopeia.

structure.trivia:
- It is possible that the snake statue in the tomb is related to **Naganeka**, a [God-Warrior](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/God-Warrior "God-Warrior") deemed [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin").
- In the old lore,  **Cassiopeia** considers  [Talon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Talon "Universe:Talon") as more of an outsider, while  [Katarina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Katarina "Universe:Katarina") treats him as a brother.

structure.name: Tahm_Kench
structure.quote: *"The whole world's a river, and I'm its king."*
structure.background: *(TBA)*
structure.appearance:
Tahm Kench is a catfish-like humanoid with a large, rotund body, short, stubby limbs, and a tail. His most noticeable feature is his enormous mouth, lined with rows of countless uneven fangs and containing a long, prehensile tongue. He has a thick, mustache-like pair of catfish [barbels](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barbel_(anatomy)) on his upper lip. He has shiny green skin, pale in the front with darker green markings across his back. His wide-set eyes are a sinister, solid yellow. He has three clawed fingers on each hand and four clawed toes on each foot. He also has dark red fins on his tail and elbows.

Tahm attempts to dress as a gentleman, though his clothes appear too small for his massive form, particularly the black human-sized top hat which is dwarfed by his oversized head. The hat features a dark red ribbon edge trim and a golden accessory on the side. He also wears a dark maroon dress shirt and what appears to be two overcoats (one brown and the other dark blue) stitched together into one. The sleeves are missing, seemingly unable to fit his bulky arms, but he still wears the detached cuffs on his wrists with additional wrappings on his hands. The clothes are worn and ragged with faded golden buttons. He also wears a gold ring with a green gem on his left index finger and another gold ring on his left barbel.
structure.personality: Tahm Kench is a voracious being that is constantly hungry and craves nothing more than to indulge himself with as much as he can consume. He is cruel and manipulative, taking advantage of those that are vulnerable to make them make deals with him, using an affable façade to trick others into trusting him, using their desires to lure them to their doom.
structure.abilities:
- **[Demon Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Demon "Demon"):** Kench is a demon, a malevolent spirit that feeds from human emotions. He has no physical form and cannot be harmed by physical weapons (unless it has magical properties). Each demon is linked to a specific emotion, in this case, Tahm Kench feeds from greed and despair.
  - **Emotional Feeding:** Like other demons, Tahm Kench can feed himself from a specific emotion, in his case, addiction. By absorbing the despair and suffering that comes from addiction, Tahm Kench can sustain himself for prolonged periods of time. Tahm Kench instictively knows what are ones vices.
  - **Immortality:** So long as vice and addiction exists, Tahm Kench will exist in some form.
  - **Form Shift:** Like any spirit, Tahm Kench can change his shape depending on peoples emotions.
  - **Amphibious:** Tahm Kench can breathe underwater.
  - **Massive Stomach:** Tahm Kench's stomach is massive and can be used to devour everything in sight. He can also use his massive stomach as a way to hold objects of interest, including living beings, for long periods of time.
  - **Water Teleportation:** Tahm Kench can use water to teleport himself to other places.
  - **Wish Granting:** By listening to the desires of others and making a deal with them, Tahm Kench can warp reality to a small degree.

relations.relationship_description: Tahm Kench [knows](http://na.leagueboards.net/en/c/miscellaneous/Ts4NEAq5-champion-qa-tahm-kench-the-river-king?show=flat&comment=00200000) a lot of champions (both as fellows and adversaries, those who get consumed by their inner demons, and those who overcome them) and all [Yordles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle") have encountered him at various times (easy to manipulate when socially outcast, harder when not so).

He seems to be on friendly terms with, or at least respect,  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox") (Tahm Kench calls him 'brother') given both manipulate mankind (their foibles and their lust for bloodshed, respectively) for personal gain as well as both being timeless entities known across the ages in various names and forms.

Tahm Kench is considered both an equal and a rival by  [Evelynn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Evelynn "Universe:Evelynn"), as they are both long-lived demons that feed on human emotion for sustenance, with Tahm Kench preying on greed and the misery of loss, while Evelynn preys on lust and the pain she causes her victims.

[Kalista](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalista "Universe:Kalista") occasionally comes after him; however, he is safe from her as he technically did not betray his victims, just followed his contracts.

structure.trivia:
- Tahm Kench represents the foibles of mankind, an individual's inner flaws. His name and appearance [change](http://na.leagueboards.net/en/c/miscellaneous/Ts4NEAq5-champion-qa-tahm-kench-the-river-king?show=flat&comment=00070001) from culture to culture, person to person. His current name come from [a Bilgewater gambler](http://na.leagueboards.net/en/c/story-art/9U6qkXVy-the-gambler) who appears in [his teaser video](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_River_King_(Video) "The River King (Video)") while his in-game appearance is based on how people from Bilgewater see him as he is more culturally important and relevant here. He has no real name, no form of his own, only those he takes.
  - There is a  [Freljordian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") demigod who is suspiciously similar to him, who may be the River King itself or at least shares the same source of energy.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
  - Tahm Kench's names, like  [Aatrox's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aatrox "Aatrox") battles, have been carved into [Runeterran history](http://na.leagueboards.net/en/c/miscellaneous/Ts4NEAq5-champion-qa-tahm-kench-the-river-king?show=flat&comment=00ca0003) but he, unlike the Darkin Blade, is too much of a gentleman to make a fuss about it.
  - Tahm Kench refers to himself as a "[monstrous siren](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siren_(mythology)) ", referencing chimeric songstresses who sweetly and sorrowfully lulled sailors into underwater dangers, just like Tahm Kench who deceptively brought desperados to short-term pleasantries but would utterly ruin their lives afterwards.
- Tahm can eat whatever he wants, but his specific appetites are only sated when he [strikes a bargain.](http://na.leagueboards.net/en/c/miscellaneous/Ts4NEAq5-champion-qa-tahm-kench-the-river-king?show=flat&comment=00440001)
- The River King would view the newly flowing rivers in  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") as a new market opening up for fresh deals with naive mortals.

structure.name: Vex
structure.quote: *"Just... ughhhhh."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Vex was born and raised in  [Bandle City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bandle_City "Universe:Bandle City"), and despite her parents' best efforts, Vex never felt like she belonged. She disliked the city's bright colors and she could never really find her "yordle spirit" or any like-minded friends. She spent most of her time sulking in her room, spending time with her shadow, which she liked because it was dark and never said anything.

### Journey to the Shadow Isles

Eventually, the Black Mist came to Bandle City. While the other residents of the city fought back against the Mist, Vex was intrigued by it and followed it to its source, the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles"). Vex loved it, as it was dark, gloomy, and full of dead spirits, which she liked. As she stayed there longer, she noticed that a combination of the Black Mist and her passive yordle magic allowed her  [Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vex%27s_Shadow "Universe:Vex's Shadow") to gain sentience and also changed her magic, allowing her to cast gloomy and dark spells.

After a time, Vex met  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego"), making an alliance with him to plunge the world into darkness and gloom. However, soon Vex found out of Viego's real goal: bringing his  [dead wife](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isolde "Universe:Isolde") back to life. Disgusted by this show of love, Vex left Viego's side to go back to the Bandle City to tell her parents of all she had done and bask in their disapproval. But when her parents told her that they loved her unconditionally, Vex just sighed, told her parents that they were the worst, and left for the Isles once more.
structure.appearance: Vex is a yordle with pale skin, purple eyes, light turqoise hair, and a black nose and mouth. She wears a big purple and black sweater and has a gold emblem of the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles") on her chest.
structure.personality: Vex is a sad and gloomy yordle that finds contentment in misery. She is eternally unhappy, and is content with this unhappiness. She is easily irritated, especially by bright and happy things, and can easily bring down the mood of any creature with her sadness.
structure.abilities:
- **[Yordle Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yordle "Universe:Yordle"):** Vex is a Yordle, a being coming from the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm") and possesses several abilities natural of her species.
  - **Immortality:** Being spiritual beings, Yordles don't age the same way as normal humans, and they can't normally die.
  - **Yordle Magic:** Just like any [Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), Vex is capable of performing yordle magic, which she utilizes in tandem with her skills with shadows and darkness.
- **Shadow Manipulation:** Vex's shadow is sentient and can help her cast spells.

relations.relationship_description: Vex's parents tried to help her find her "yordle spirit" when she was younger, though their positivity only made her resent them. After cutting ties with  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego"), she went back to her parents to boast about her crimes so they would hate her, but to her disappointment they forgave her and claimed that they loved her no matter what. Despite her hatred towards them, Vex created 2 [effigies of her parents](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Family_Reunion "LoR:The Family Reunion") to keep herself company while reenacting her childhood and talking to them while pretending that they're her parents, showing she values their presence to a degree.

Milty is Vex's adoptive uncle. He always tries to understand his niece and influence her positively, but she refuses to deal with him due to his positive attitude. When he came to find Vex on the Shadow Isles, he tried to forcibly take her back to Bandle City, but she decided to crush his positive worldview with her nihilism so he would leave her alone, causing him to leave while crying in despair.

Vex had an alliance with  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") to plunge the world into darkness and gloom until Vex found out that his real motive was to revive his wife from the dead.
Allay has a one-sided friendship towards Vex, referring to her as Vee and organizing birthday parties for her, to Vex's annoyance.

Grimm is in love with Vex and feels infatuated towards her gloomy nature, often making dramatic shows to profess his love towards her. In return, she is shown to genuinely tolerate him despite being disinterested by his displays of love.

structure.trivia:
- Despite having a direct relation and interactions with  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego"), Vex is one of few Shadow Isles champions that have no relation to the origin of the Black Mist or the Ruination.
- Vex presents herself as nonchalant and miserable most of the time, but Shadow seems to show her true emotions, which are indeed much broader (e.g. her liking Viego).
  - In one of her quotes from *League of Legends*, she momentarily shows real excitement ( *"Awesome! I-I mean... Pfft whatever."*).
- Vex is obviously not going through a phase of angst: the [The Meaning in Misery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Meaning_in_Misery "Universe:The Meaning in Misery") story explains the real reason behind her current mood and personality.

structure.name: Alune
structure.background:
### Early life

**Alune** and  [Aphelios](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aphelios "Universe:Aphelios") are twins born to the  [Lunari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lunari "Universe:Lunari") during a lunar convergence, when the moon of the spirit realm eclipsed the physical moon, resulting in them being hailed as children with an important destiny. Aphelios was physically gifted like the moon of stone, while Alune was magically gifted by the spirit moon. They both grew up as loyal believers in their faith, one of mystery, discovery and reflection, and embraced the night not only due to their belief, but as their only shield against the  [Solari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Solari "Universe:Solari"), who considered Lunari heretics and sought to destroy them. As a result, the Lunari hid away until it was thought they no longer existed.

Alune's twin Aphelios was burdened by the weight of expectations. He trained with his moonstone blades until he bled, ready to protect his fellow Lunari. He bonded only with his sister, preferring her company to others'. Alune herself trained as a seer, revealing hidden paths and truths by moonlight. As she grew in power, however, the tasks she undertook required her to leave their home.

### The Temple Opens

With his sister being gone more often, Aphelios grew desperate for purpose. He decided to perform a ceremony which would reveal one's path*.* In doing so, he discovered a pool where poisonous [noctum flowers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Duskpetal "Duskpetal") grew. The blooms could be distilled into a liquid that would open him to the night's power - however, drinking it caused Aphelios to feel so much pain that he became numb to everything else.

One day, the Lunari temple, the [Marus Omegnum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Marus_Omegnum "Marus Omegnum"), began to come into phase to emerge from the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm") for the first time in centuries. Every time the temple opened, a person gifted in magic was chosen to occupy it. Alune was chosen to be the occupant. Lunari from around the mountain to watch, and Aphelios, who was not known for asking for things, asked to attend.

But as the halls of the temple entered the physical realm, the Solari discovered the ceremony. They attacked the Lunari, defeating Aphelios and causing him to reach for the noctum flowers and eat one. Alune rushed deeper into the temple and eventually reached its heart. There, her magical abilities were amplified. Through the poison in Aphelios' blood Alune could give him power and give him new moonstone weapons.

Alune drew herself and the temple back into the spirit realm to keep it safe from the [Solari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Solari "Solari"). Inside, she could send power anywhere, as long as it had a focus, like the poison in Aphelios' blood from eating the noctum flower. With this newfound power, the two of them vowed to protect the [Lunari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lunari "Lunari") at all costs.

### You Are the Weapon

:   *Main article: [You Are the Weapon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/You_Are_the_Weapon "You Are the Weapon")*

[Aphelios](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aphelios "Universe:Aphelios"), along with Alune looking through his senses, was in a cave. Preparing for an attack, Aphelios drank poison from the noctum flowers in order to make sure that Alune could better connect to him through the poison in his body. After preparing, Aphelios scaled Mount Targon with the help of his weapons. He reached his destination, an area on the side of the mountain. This area contained several Solari people, who he quickly killed. On the ground, he found a  [scimitar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Diana#Moonsilver_Blade "Diana"). With this discovery, he and Alune realized that  [its owner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Diana "Universe:Diana") was running. Aphelios picked it up and walked into the night, intent on finding her.
structure.appearance: Alune is a slim, pale-skinned woman with deep purple eyes and long white hair. She wears elegant, flowing robes with a distinct palette of black, purple, and turquoise. A silver diadem ornaments her head and a silver necklace with the  [Lunari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lunari "Universe:Lunari") symbol adorns her chest. Alune wears ceremonial paints in the form of a large, white circle on the center of her face to compliment the crescent moon marking of her  [brother's face](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aphelios "Universe:Aphelios").
structure.personality: Alune is a very devoted and mysterious individual but she is also extremely protective and caring for her twin brother,  [Aphelios](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aphelios "Universe:Aphelios"). She is often faithful to her goddess whom she refers to as 6 [**Mother Moon**](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Silver_Sister "LoR:The Silver Sister"), she always tries to balance her duty as a  [seer of the moon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lunari "Universe:Lunari") and her attention and care for her brother, who counts on her guidance.
structure.abilities:
- **Spiritual Link:** Since birth, she and her brother are spiritually connected. Using her magic, Alune can interact with Aphelios even if they are on different dimensions.
- **[Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic")**: Unlike her brother, Alune was born with natural magical abilities. Being trained since young, Alune is very wise in the ways of the [Lunari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lunari "Lunari") and retains knowledge on performing spells, rituals and is able to draw power from celestial objects, beings and events.
  - **Celestial Magic:**  **Alune**, from her place in [Marus Omegnum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Marus_Omegnum "Marus Omegnum"), is able to draw on the powers of various [celestial beings](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial_(Legends_of_Runeterra) "Celestial (Legends of Runeterra)") to create an [arsenal of mystical weapons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Moon_Weapon_(Legends_of_Runeterra) "Moon Weapon (Legends of Runeterra)") for her  [brother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aphelios "Universe:Aphelios").
  - **Telepathy:** Within the [Marus Omegnum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Marus_Omegnum "Marus Omegnum"),  **Alune** can focus telepathic thoughts on Aphelios, as long as the power has a focus, like the noctum poison Aphelios drinks.
  - **Seer:** Alune can glimpse the future in moonlight.

relations.relationship_description: [Alune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Alune "Alune") and her twin brother  [Aphelios](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aphelios "Universe:Aphelios") have had a deep connection to each other since birth, each relying on the other. Alune refers to him as **Phel**. They have a strong attachment to opposites: light and darkness, physical and spirit, life and death, and so balance each other out.

[Aphelios](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aphelios "Universe:Aphelios") and Alune are currently searching for the Aspect of the Moon,  [Diana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Diana "Universe:Diana").

6 [The Silver Sister](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Silver_Sister "LoR:The Silver Sister") is the celestial of the Moon, it is likely that she is the goddess of the  [Lunari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lunari "Universe:Lunari") which  **Alune** refers to as *Mother Moon*.

Alune is friends with  [Yuumi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yuumi "Universe:Yuumi") and  [Book of Thresholds](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Book_of_Thresholds "Universe:Book of Thresholds"), who visit her periodically in the Spirit Realm.

[Soraka](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Soraka "Universe:Soraka") knows the pain of the  [Lunari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lunari "Universe:Lunari") twins, but tells them not to feel it.  **Alune** considers this denying her and her  [brother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aphelios "Universe:Aphelios") their existence.

**Alune** views  [Kayle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayle "Universe:Kayle") and  [Morgana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Morgana "Universe:Morgana") as her and  [Aphelios' predecessors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aphelios "Universe:Aphelios"), as they are also twins that represent the dark and the light.

As the champion of the  [Solari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Solari "Universe:Solari"),  **Alune** sees  [Leona](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Leona "Universe:Leona") as the Lunari's ultimate enemy. However, like most of the  [Lunari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lunari "Universe:Lunari"), she is not necessarily hostile towards Leona or the Solari.

structure.name: Atakhan
structure.background:
### Bringer of Ruin

:   *Main article: [Bringer of Ruin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bringer_of_Ruin "Universe:Bringer of Ruin")*

A malevolent demon from ancient times, Atakhan held a craving towards violence and conflict. During the reign of  [Sahn-Uzal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mordekaiser/Cosmetics "Mordekaiser/Cosmetics"), Atakhan was drawn to his encampment by the carnage of his ruthless conquests. Sahn-Uzal's loyal general, Khatash-Li, attempted to protect his ruler but lost his life in the process. After Sahn-Uzal struck Atakhan down, he decided not to let Khatash-Li's death go to waste. Using arcane scrolls gathered from his conquests, Sahn-Uzal bound the demon to Khatash-Li's helmet, merging the two. With the two united, Sahn-Uzal's conquest only hastened as the enslaved demon decimated the armies of his enemies.[[1]](#cite_note-Bringer_of_Ruin-1)

When Sahn-Uzal was slain, Atakhan was freed from his control. However, the conqueror would be revived centuries later as the undead revenant  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser"). Atakhan, who had grown used to its freedom, needed to be reminded of who it served and was subjugated once more by Mordekaiser's mages. In the years that followed, Atakhan brought death and destruction upon the land. However, Mordekaiser's enemies would eventually rise up against him with the aid of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") and banished him to [Mitna Rachnun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mitna_Rachnun "Mitna Rachnun"). The bound helmet wounded up in the possession of the cabal's leader,  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc").[[1]](#cite_note-Bringer_of_Ruin-1)

### The Demon's Hand

:   *Main article: [The Demon's Hand](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Demon%27s_Hand "The Demon's Hand")*

After a thousand years of imprisonment, Atakhan was summoned back from the helmet of Khatash-Li by  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") and  [Vladimir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vladimir "Universe:Vladimir").[[1]](#cite_note-Bringer_of_Ruin-1) Now freed, the demon was set loose on a rampage across  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra"), feeding on the carnage in the frozen battlefields of the Noshthay Valley, the peaks of Elmunt, and the forests of [Qualthala](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Qualthala "Universe:Qualthala"). Finally, Atakhan found itself in a familiar place, where a lone [stranger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") offered it a seat at his table and a deck of cards to play. The stranger conversed with both halves of Atakhan—both Khatash-Li and the demon—and they played using sigils until an eclipse blotted out the sun. Atakhan won the game, but the stranger was able to bide their time until the eclipse in order to perform their ritual. The stranger revealed themself to be LeBlanc and subjugated the demon with dark  [ethereal chains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LeBlanc#Ethereal_Chains "LeBlanc"). The illusion shattered around them, revealing their location to be a sleek white room, where LeBlanc and Vladimir demanded that Atakhan reveal the location of a [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin") weapon in exchange for its freedom. The demon obeyed, painting images into the air with a brush of its claws.[[3]](#cite_note-The_Demon's_Hand-3)

The location of the weapon was eventually revealed to be in  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"). However, Vladimir doubted the new Grand General,  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), would launch another campaign to the First Lands. As Atakhan demanded its freedom, LeBlanc whispered something into its helmet, sending it into a frenzy before being restrained by her chains. She responded to Vladimir that the might of Noxus wouldn't be necessary, as a single whisper could deeper then a thousand blades.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

### Twilight's End

LeBlanc dispatched Atakhan to Ionia to hunt down the Darkin weapon hidden within the Temple of Twilight. The Temple's return from the Spirit Realm sent the local demonkin into a frenzy, luring its guardian,  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara"), away from her post. Under the cover of night, Atakhan made its way through the forest toward the temple, crossing paths with  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao") and Yunara as they battled the demons. The pair noticed the creature but chose to leave it be. Atakhan was able to breach the temple's defenses,[[5]](#cite_note-5) before it retreated back into the Spirit Realm. Xin Zhao and Yunara were alerted to the attack on the temple and prepared undergo the Trials of Twilight to reach the Darkin weapon before Atakhan did.[[6]](#cite_note-6)

By the time they reached the glaive,  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") and Atakhan had already claimed it, embedding it within the demon's shadowy flesh. The two tried to fight off Atakhan and free the Darkin glaive, but the combined might of the sorceress and demon proved too much and overwhelmed the duo. As Atakhan bore down on Xin Zhao, he reached out to the weapon and communed with the spirit inside,  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen"). Despite Zaahen's protests, Xin Zhao was able to plead with him to use his power to save them. Taking Xin Zhao as his host, Zaahen returned to the world once more and destroyed Atakhan with a single strike of glaive, forcing LeBlanc to retreat.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
structure.appearance: Atakhan is tall and shrouded in a tattered black cloak, with clawed hands and a jagged, armored silhouette. Its head is crowned with a spiked helmet, and glowing red eyes pierce from the shadows.
structure.personality: Atakhan is resentful, tormented, and fueled by betrayal and rage. It was said to be quick to anger, with its mind fractured between its human and demon halves. The man, Khatash-Li, was  [Mordekaiser's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser") most loyal and faithful general, and was willing to lay down his life for his lord. Khatash-Li was also stated to have been a competent military leader, enjoying strategy games in his spare time. The demon, Atakhan, considered Khatash-Li's soul trapped within it to be a "splinter", but it also found a sense of purpose in serving its new master, who would send it to bring untold carnage and destruction in his bloody conquests. It became utterly obedient to its lord, and was filled with rage and sorrow after Sahn-Uzal's first death, despite its newfound freedom.[[3]](#cite_note-The_Demon's_Hand-3)
structure.abilities:
- **[Demon Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demon "Universe:Demon"):** Atakhan is a demon, a malevolent spirit that feeds from human emotions. It originally had no true physical form, simply following the scent of death to countless battlefields. Each demon feeds on specific emotions; in Atakhan's case, it feeds on  carnage,  weakness, suffering, and bloodshed. The more it consumed, the more "complex" its palate became, and it brought untold destruction trying to sate its hunger.
  - **Human Hybrid:** After its defeat at the hands of  [Sahn-Uzal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser"), Atakhan was forcibly and magically melded to the Unconquered King's general, Khatash-Li, in a dark ritual. Atakhan has the memories of both the man and the demon, and retains several human characteristics like distorted human flesh and a semblance of loyalty to its former master.
  - **Immortality:** Atakhan is well over a thousand years old. After Sahn-Uzal's death, it hungered in his absence and left the mortal plane for the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_Realm "Universe:Spirit Realm").
  - **Shadow Form:** Upon  [Mordekaiser's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser") revival, the Iron Revenant summoned his Bringer of Ruin as a "beast of shadow." Atakhan retains this form in the present.
  - **Demonic Magic:** Like all demons, Atakhan has within itself a large amount of dark magic, though not enough to set itself free from  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser") or  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"). Atakhan was able to paint inky, shadowy images with a swipe of its claw. Its dark power is currently bound within the helm of Khatash-Li to the service of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose").
- **Strategist:** As a human, Khatash-Li led Sahn-Uzal's most successful campaigns and became one of his most trusted advisors. Atakhan retains knowledge of these campaigns and Khatash-Li's intelligence, as it continued to lead Sahn-Uzal's armies and inflicted mass devastation against its master's enemies.

relations.relationship_description: Atakhan was a demon who was drawn by Sahn-Uzal's bloody conquests, hoping to feed on the misery, terror, and death that followed in his wake. Atakhan eventually attacked Sahn-Uzal, but was defeated and later bound to his service when Sahn-Uzal forcibly melded the demon with his most loyal general, Khatash-Li. Atakhan served Sahn-Uzal dutifully and violently, and became known as the warlord's "Bringer of Ruin." When Sahn-Uzal eventually died, Atakhan was free to roam Runeterra once again. When Sahn-Uzal returned as Mordekaiser, he summoned Atakhan as a shadow from his past, gifting the demon a new form to do his bidding. However, Atakhan had grown used to its freedom and refused to serve him, so it was once again bound to its master's will by brutal force. It continued to serve Mordekaiser until his defeat.[[1]](#cite_note-Bringer_of_Ruin-1)

Atakhan and LeBlanc were both servants of  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser"). Having learned the myths of Sahn-Uzal, LeBlanc was aware of Atakhan's past, as well as that of its human host, Khatash-Li. She later witnessed Atakhan's brutal enslavement after Mordekaiser's return from death.[[1]](#cite_note-Bringer_of_Ruin-1) After they defeated Mordekaiser, LeBlanc and  [Vladimir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vladimir "Universe:Vladimir") defeated and imprisoned Atakhan within the helm of Khatash-Li. The demon would lay dormant for a thousand years before LeBlanc summoned it again to rampage through Runeterra, until she deceived Atakhan with an illusion and enslaved it once again, this time to the service of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose").[[3]](#cite_note-The_Demon's_Hand-3)

Tybaulk was another demon in the service of  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser"), and they frequently accompanied the Revenant on his destructive conquests until his defeat. Unlike Atakhan, Tybaulk managed to escape the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") through  [Amoline Kiosar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Amoline "Universe:Amoline"), the mother of  [Annie](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Annie "Universe:Annie").[[8]](#cite_note-Eyes_and_Embers-8)

structure.trivia: - [The Demon's Hand](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Demon%27s_Hand "The Demon's Hand") confirmed that Atakhan was the "beast made of shadow" that once served  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser"), alongside  [Tybaulk](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tybaulk "Universe:Tybaulk"), as described in [The Eyes and the Embers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Eyes_and_the_Embers "The Eyes and the Embers").

structure.name: Milio
structure.quote: *"The light inside us, our inner flame... That's the heart of my fire."*
structure.background:
### Family History

Before Milio was born, his grandmother Lupé and her twin sister Luné both strove to join the Yun Tal through passing the Vidallion's trials, with Lupé being a master of earth while Luné mastered fire. However, Luné was caught plotting treason against the Yun Tal and imprisoned while Lupé and her family faced punishment by proxy of Lupé being her twin. Exiled to the furthest reaches of  [Ixtal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ixtal "Universe:Ixtal"), Lupé and her family lived in a faraway village that would eventually become Milio's birthplace.

### Childhood

As Milio came of age, Lupé started to teach him how to master the elemental axiomata. Unlike the rest of the family, Milio showed great potential as a prodigy of elemental magic but struggled to understand the discipline that came with it. Disappointed, Lupé eventually gave up on Milio's teachings but he still trained his own abilities in private. Abandoning the rigid restrictions of the teachings of his grandmother, Milio eventually learned how to control fire, the only element Lupé avoided out of spite against her twin sister. However, Milio began to question the capabilities of the fire axiom and instead believed it had potential for more positive effects rather than destructive ones.

One night, Milio was chasing a group of fireflies when he noticed a village huntress who was left badly injured and unable to move. Milio rushed to help her by keeping her stable with his fire axiom, but it wasn't enough. Knowing that the healer would've been too far away to arrive on time, Milio tried as hard as he could to shape his powers into a force that could heal. Milio felt the huntress' *inner flame*, a feeling of warmth which he began to sense in the nature all around him. Focusing all of his concentration on that warm and cozy feeling, Milio manifested his fire magic into a small fire elemental which was able to heal the huntress' wounds.

Having discovered a new axiom which he named "soothing flames," Milio went home to tell his family about what he had done and showed off his new ability to summon his signature fire elementals, dubbed " [fuemigos](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fuemigo "Fuemigo")". While his family celebrated, Lupé was astonished by Milio's success in mastering the fire axiom despite going against the traditional teachings and discovering an entirely new axiom. Seeing his potential to undo the burdens placed on the family by her sister Luné, Lupé dedicated herself to teaching her grandson how to master his newfound abilities, preparing him for a journey to [Ixaocan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ixaocan "Ixaocan") in order to restore the family's honor. Though he was nervous to endure the long trip by himself, Milio was motivated purely by the love he had for his family. For his journey, he and Lupé fashioned a backpack to store his fuemigos which he dubbed his "furnasita" and got a new set of clothes made by his family members. At the age of 12, Milio left his village and began his journey to Ixaocan, travelling across Ixtal while sending letters to his family about his adventures.

### Journey to Ixaocan

- A drawing on Milio's first letter to his family, depicting him leaving his home for [Ixaocan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ixaocan "Ixaocan").
- A drawing on Milio's letter depicting his new friendship with  [Nidalee](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nidalee "Universe:Nidalee").
- A drawing on Milio's letter depicting him healing a group of injured villagers.
- A drawing on Milio's letter depicting his encounters with  [Zyra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zyra "Universe:Zyra"),  [Malphite](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Malphite "Universe:Malphite") and  [Neeko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Neeko "Universe:Neeko")

Milio travelled through the jungle when he noticed a young cougar who was injured. Wanting to help, Milio used his fuemigos to heal the cougar and the cat repaid him with affection. They both took a nap under a sun spot until they were found by  [Nidalee](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee "Nidalee"), the fearsome *Kashdaji Queen* as told in scary stories across Ixtal. The young cougar was revealed to be a pakaa and a member of her pack. While initially distrustful towards Milio for being a human, Nidalee began to warm up to him and allowed him travel with the pack for a short while, befriending Nidalee and her pack. Milio eventually left for a nearby village having a bonfire in order to continue his adventure, but hoped to see Nidalee again someday.

At the village, Milio found a lot of hurt people and, using his soothing fire powers, tried healing as many as he can. Unfortunately, Milio was unable to heal everyone and a few villagers were too injured to be saved. Luckily, Milio was able to make their final moments warm and comforting. Despite being able to save lots of people with his powers, Milio began to become discouraged due to the villagers he lost and continued his journey. Throughout his journey, Milio encountered many other sights while hopping around many villages on the pathway to Ixaocan. At one point, he encountered a  [lady made of plants](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zyra "Universe:Zyra") who Milio heard rumors of in a nearby village as well as a  [giant moving rock](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Malphite "Universe:Malphite"). Eventually, a shapeshifting [vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") named  [Neeko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Neeko "Universe:Neeko") smelled the scent of the pakaa on Milio and, becoming curious, attempted to play a prank on him by shapeshifting as Milio himself. Milio eventually befriended Neeko, learning about her tribe and language before continuing on his journey. Throughout his travels, Milio became a legend amongst the Ixtali as "the boy with the soothing flames."[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1)

### Arriving in Ixaocan

Finally making it to Ixaocan, Milio explored the wondrous capital city of Ixtal, amazed by the many sights. However, Milio has begun to notice that people are staring at him; spying on him. Unbeknowst to him, stories about his adventures caught the intrigue of his grandaunt Luné, who has been incarcerated deep below the city all this time without his family's knowledge. Despite all this, Milio eagerly began his training so that he may one day face the Vidalion and hopefully restore the honor of his family.
structure.appearance: Milio is a prepubescent Ixtali boy with tan skin, amber eyes and curly black hair. He wears a red Ixtali poncho made by his family with shoulder guards. On his back, he wears his signature furnasita; a white cone-shaped knapsack with highlights made of green jewels. His furnasita holds a large fuemigo; a round fire elemental with ring-shaped eyes and a crest on its forehead.
structure.personality:
Milio is incredibly compassionate and caring for others, using his abilities to heal and soothe wounds and expresses deep remorse when he's unable to save people. He cares deeply for others and has been capable of befriending lots of people on his journey to Ixaocan. However, he cares the absolute most for his family; his driving force for his whole journey in the first place. Though he has been at odds with his grandmother Lupé at times, especially during his training, he wishes to fulfill her wishes and regain honor to his family even if he seems content with how his family is living currently.[[2]](#cite_note-2) Though a natural prodigy of elemental magic, he lacks the rigid discipline that Ixtali practitioners of magic typically have as he struggles to grasp the rules of his grandmother's training.

Milio is very playful and kind when he speaks to others. He is very forward thinking and focused on his journey to one day best the Vidalion, speaking on how he wants to grow big and strong one day once he grows up and trains his magic enough. Because of his dedication and love for his family, he often mentions and talks about them a lot, especially his parents and his grandmother Lupé.
structure.abilities:
- **[Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic")**: Milio was born with elemental magic abilities, which could grow once he comes of age and trains his abilities further. He was trained by his grandmother in the Ixtali traditions but found it difficult in following its rigid rules. Despite this, he decided to train by himself and developed his own style and understanding of elemental magic.
  - **Fire Axiom**: Milio is a prodigy in the fire axiom and has learned to master the element of fire. Because his grandmother avoided teaching him the fire axiom out of spite against her twin sister, he's completely self taught and uses the axiom in his own unorthodox way.
    - **[Soothing Flames:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Milio#Breath_of_Life "Milio")** Millio has developed an entirely new axiom of his own called *"soothing flames"*, utilizing fire as a source of healing instead of destruction. By connecting himself with the 'inner flame' of living beings he can heal their injuries, offering a sense of comfort and warmth to many people at a time.
    - **[Fuemigo Summoning:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Milio#Ultra_Mega_Fire_Kick "Milio")** Milio's fire magic manifests as round little fire elementals he calls 'fuemigos.' As manifestations of Milio's 'soothing flames' axiom, they are capable of healing wounds and soothing pain with their warmth. Though mostly used for healing, the fuemigos are solid and bouncy, capable of being bounced around like fire balls by Milio.

relations.relationship_description:
Milio has a great bond with all of his family members, ranging from his parents to his siblings as well as his many cousins, all of whom he grew up with in his home village outside of Ixaocan. They celebrated his accomplishment after he discovered an entirely new axiom when healing the wounded huntress. They made him the clothes that he would wear on his journey and continuously praise and encourage him.

Milio speaks about his family very often, speaking highly of them and describing his extremely close and friendly relationship with each of them. He has seemingly befriended almost every member of his family, all of whom act as his driving force and motivate him to continue his journey. During his travels, he exchanged letters with his family to keep in touch with them, inquiring with them about their lives while he was away and often stating how he misses them and wants to make them proud.

#### Lupé

Lupé is Milio's grandmother and the one who initially tried training him in his elemental magic. Though she noticed his natural affinity for magic, Lupé actually stopped training Milio as he couldn't follow the traditional disciplines of the axiomata. Once Milio showed promise in the fire axiom, which she actively refused to teach him out of spite against her sister Luné, Lupé put her grudge aside and saw the potential in her grandson. Lupé helped prepare Milio for his journey to Ixaocan in order to showcase his natural abilities and restore honor to her family, creating his signature 'furnasita' and resuming his training.

Milio very dearly loves his grandma, or 'omele,' and is strictly motivated in making her proud once he restores the family honor. He often mentions her on his travels, stating how proud she'd be to see him now. On top of that, he speaks very highly of his omele, describing her as very strong and similar in personality to  [Nidalee](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nidalee "Universe:Nidalee"), the fearsome Kashdaji queen he met on his travels.[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1) Lupé is almost entirely focused on Milio's potential to restore the family's honor at Ixaocan, perhaps even disregarding her own family's feelings about it.

#### Luné

Luné was imprisoned beneath Ixaocan before Milio was born, meaning she never got to meet her grand-nephew in person. However, after he gained fame across Ixtal as the 'boy with the soothing flames', she caught word of the stories about him and recently found out he made it into Ixaocan after his long journey.

Milio's fuemigos serve as his main companions, as they are literal manifestations of his fire magic come to life. He carries a large one within his furnasita and often deploys smaller ones to heal and soothe wounds with their warmth.

Milio considers his fuemigos as his best friends and, despite their inability to verbally communicate, ventriloquizes the fuemigos with a higher-pitched voice to reinforce his own thoughts.

Milio used to hear stories of Nidalee as a frightening creature to be feared named the Kashdaji queen, but met her in person during his journey to Ixaocan after he healed one of her pakaa. While initially distrustful towards him at first due to his human nature, Nidalee grew a fondness for the boy and allowed him to travel with her pack for a while to the next village. She calls Milio her 'fire bug' and considers him an honorary pakaa. Milio left the pack on friendly terms with Nidalee, noting that she appears as extremely harsh and fearsome on the outside but was capable of seeing the genuine softness underneath her tough exterior.[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1)

Milio encountered Zyra on his travels, having initially heard stories about her in a nearby village and thinking of them as nothing but scary stories to tell to children. Though he saw Zyra from a distance, he immediately noticed how dangerous her plants looked and knew not to greet her and endanger himself. However, he notes in his letter to his parents that, despite her frightening appearance, he wishes he could say hi and befriend her.[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1)

Milio encountered Malphite on his travels, initially noticing the large mountain in his way despite it being nowhere on the map. Milio investigated the strange appearance of a new mountain and discovered Malphite's face and saw him begin to move. He didn't directly greet Malphite however, despite seeing him as extremely friendly, as he didn't wanna risk being stepped on.[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1)

Neeko noticed Milio because of the scent of the pakaa on his clothes, as he traveled with Nidalee's pack temporarily before leaving. Because Neeko was very close with Nidalee, she wanted to investigate and shapeshifted into Milio as a prank, amusing the boy and sparking their friendship. As the two traveled for a bit, Neeko shared lots of details about her language as well as her tribe that she's slowly creating, offering a home to any people in the jungle without one.

Milio considers Neeko a new best friend and notes that he wishes he could help her on her mission to create a new tribe but prioritizes traveling to Ixaocan to restore his family's honor instead, wishing her farewell.[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1)

structure.trivia: - Milio's name is a variant of the name of Latin origin *Emilio* (from the Roman word *Aemilius*, from *Aemulus*; and from the Greek word Αιμίλιος *Aimilios*), meaning "kind" and "affectionate".
