structure.name: Smeech
structure.background:
### Early Life

After  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") took control of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), Smeech made a name for himself as the boss of the  [Scrap Hackers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Scrap_Hackers "Universe:The Scrap Hackers"), an illicit enterprise that specialized in cybernetic modification, and became affiliated with several other crime lords who were also loyal to Silco, creating the first generation of  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons"). At some point during his time, he also had mechanical limbs attached to his hands and feet to make himself as tall as a normal human.[[2]](#cite_note-107boy-2)

### Route to Robbery

Smeech once had a problem with someone from the Lanes who was unable to pay back his debt to him. Smeech sent him a signed note and a warning to not go to his compatriots and made a joke about the man's amputated leg. He then had his henchman break into the man's warehouse to go through the man's things and presumably steal what was believed by the investigators to be a stash of medical equipment. Because the target confronted his docile but strong lackey, the man was killed, with part of the encounter seen by a witness, and became the subject of a homicide investigation.

Because of Silco having the  [Sheriff](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus") in his pocket, and because of the witness' fear of repercussion from the chem-barons, the investigation became an unsolved, cold case. Another enforcer,  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"), found the records of this and kept it as part of an ongoing investigation on the underground's secret  [mastermind](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") and his  [mole](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus") in Piltover. Caitlyn momentarily believed that the ringleader "S" was Smeech before one of their interviewees made it clear that he wasn't, discriminating against Smeech for being a [yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yordle "Universe:Yordle").[[3]](#cite_note-conspiracy-3)

### Border Crisis

After the actions of  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), Silco's adopted daughter, led  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") to shut down the border between Zaun and  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), trade between the two cities came to a sudden halt, causing Smeech' criminal ventures to lose massive profits. Frustrated by the fact that Silco was doing nothing to keep Jinx under control, Smeech and the other chem-barons scheduled an assembly to discuss their next move, in which  [Finn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Finn "Universe:Finn") attempted to convince him to join him in a coup against Silco. However, before he could give him an answer, Silco arrived on the scene and unleashed a toxic gas in the air to remind the barons of the oppressive life that he had saved them from, which was enough to convince Smeech to fall back in line.[[2]](#cite_note-107boy-2)

### Turf War Period

After the deaths of Silco, Finn, and  [Renni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni"), a massive power vacuum opened across each of their former territories, and sensing opportunity, the three remaining chembarons—Smeech,  [Chross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross"), and  [Margot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Margot "Universe:Margot")—began vying to expand their holdings and seize control of the undercity at the expense of each other. Smeech and his henchmen tried to attack one of Margot's stashes to get the upper hand on them both, but his path was hindered by a toxic industrial smog called "the Gray." Smeech sent a henchman,  [Heenot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heenot "Universe:Heenot"), to investigate the area, and Heenot encountered a strike team of  [enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") led by  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"), who were trying to take out the remaining chembarons and locate  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") for her terrorist attack against the Piltover Council. Realizing he and the other barons didn't stand a chance against topside, Smeech decided to sell Jinx out in hopes that he could cut a deal in exchange for her bounty.

After it became clear the turf wars were only leading to more casualties,  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") called an assembly of the three chembarons in an attempt to convince them to unite against topside. Chross and Margot argued, refusing to work with one another, but Smeech interjected, telling them all that their best shot at getting topside off their backs was by handing over Jinx. Sevika refused to go along with Smeech's plan, so he offered her a new cybernetic arm if she helped them capture her. After the meeting adjourned, Smeech and his henchmen waited by The Last Drop for Jinx to show up before following her. After she escaped from Caitlyn and  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), Smeech and his men ambushed her in an alleyway, and he attempted to poke out one of her eyes to prevent her from getting away.[[4]](#cite_note-202watch-4)

### Death

Jinx managed to slip through Smeech's fingers with the help of Sevika, who came to her rescue. Sevika then battled Smeech using a new mechanical arm Jinx had built her, while Jinx battled and killed most of his henchmen. After Sevika ripped off one of his arms, Smeech attempted to make another deal with her, but Sevika refused and brutally dismembered him on the floor of the alleyway.[[4]](#cite_note-202watch-4)
structure.appearance: Smeech was an ugly rat-like [yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yordle "Universe:Yordle") with extendable mechanical arms and legs, which were designed specifically to make him taller, giving him a disjointed, lanky appearance. Smeech's teeth were sharp with an underbite and his ears were damaged, with holes in them. He wore a tall green hat over his coiffed blond hair and a dark business coat over his robot limbs. His gruff appearance was likely a symptom of his constant abuse of [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer").
structure.personality: Smeech was a cunning and sneaky yordle who was not above using underhanded tactics to make a quick buck. Smeech was one of the more talkative, boastful and aggressive of Silco's lieutenants, but he was also cowardly, being easily wrangled back in line after Silco gassed them during their meeting. Despite being power hungry, Smeech was often afraid of getting his own hands dirty if it meant putting himself in harm's way, sending his henchmen to go ahead of him if he believed a situation was too dangerous. Smeech was also very quick to sell out his own cohorts, including Silco's daughter Jinx to their enemies on topside, which was both to save his own skin and to collect her bounty for himself. He was also addicted to shimmer, and is implied to have been insecure about his height, pursuing a trade in body modifications specifically to give himself longer and more powerful limbs than he had originally.
structure.abilities:
- **[Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle") Physiology:** Smeech was a yordle, a being coming from the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm") and possesses several abilities natural of his species.
  - **Immortality:** As spiritual beings, yordles don't age the same way as normal humans, and they typically can't die. The extent of how this ability works is unknown, as Sevika was capable of killing Smeech's physical body.
  - **Yordle Magic:** Just like any yordle, Smeech was presumably capable of performing yordle magic, though examples of him using this ability remain yet to be seen.
- **Chemtech Augments:** Smeech replaced his arms and legs with mechanical [chemtech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chemtech "Universe:Chemtech") augments, which gave him enhanced strength and dexterity in combat, as well as allowing him to climb up and down walls with ease. These augments were capable of extending his height and transforming into spinning blades, which were fast enough to block bullets from a pistol.

relations.relationship_description: Smeech and Silco established a business relationship during his rise as leader of the undercity, and Smeech became one of Silco's top lieutenants along with four other  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons"). Smeech's enterprise thrived under Silco's leadership, but Silco was also not above using fear to keep his lieutenants in line, gassing Smeech and the other chembarons with toxic smog before offering them all gas masks when they appeared to be conspiring against him. After Silco's death, Smeech tried unsuccessfully to seize Silco's chair for himself in a series of turf wars.

Sevika was often present with  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") at the chembaron assemblies, and Smeech was familiar with her. After Silco's death, Sevika tried unsuccessfully to convince  [Chross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross"),  [Margot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Margot "Universe:Margot"), and Smeech to end their turf wars and unite against topside. Smeech made a counteroffer to Sevika, claiming they wouldn't need to worry about topside anymore if they just handed over  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), and he attempted to bribe her with a new chemtech arm to replace the one that had been destroyed by  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"). Ultimately, Sevika refused Smeech's offer on the principle that Zaunites don't hand over their own, and she rescued Jinx before killing Smeech in the alleyway. Sevika mocked Smeech both before and after his death, calling him a "funny-looking rat" who didn't know how to keep his mouth shut.

After  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") death, Smeech and the other two chembarons were all interested in taking his chair for themselves and becoming the new undercity kingpin, and Smeech began fighting with them to expand his holdings at their expense. Smeech took an opportunistic approach to the conflict, letting Chross and Margot fight in the streets as he snuck into their stashes and stole from them with bold, aggressive action.

Smeech didn't seem to be fond of Jinx, calling her "Baby Blue" and believing she wasn't worth protecting against topside, despite the fact that she was  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") daughter. After encountering  [Caitlyn's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") team, Smeech became interested in collecting Jinx's "finder's fee" and attempted to skewer out her eyes so she'd be incapable of fighting back while he turned her in. Jinx seemed unfazed by Smeech's threats and quickly terrified him by revealing that she was the one who killed  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco"). She then killed most of his henchmen and watched gleefully as  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") dismembered him with her new mechanical arm.

Heenot was Smeech's accountant who was later made to accompany him on a raid against  [Margot's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Margot "Universe:Margot") stash, despite the fact that he was only even hired to "run the numbers." When they encountered the Gray, Smeech made Heenot go on ahead of everyone else, where Heenot encountered  [Caitlyn's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") strike team. Heenot accompanied Smeech during his ambush against  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") and was the only survivor among Smeech and his men, being strung up and placed in a trap in the pipeworks to deliver a news of Smeech's death.[[5]](#cite_note-203finally-5)

Caitlyn ran an investigation into Smeech early in her career as an enforcer as she was working to uncover  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") underground criminal conspiracy.[[3]](#cite_note-conspiracy-3) Later in her life, she and her strike team met Smeech personally when he tried to raid one of  [Margot's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Margot "Universe:Margot") stashes. Their encounter left Smeech shaken until the next chembaron assembly, and he became eager to give them  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") as a means to claim her bounty and get topside off their backs.

structure.name: Tryndamere
structure.quote: *" Rage is my weapon."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Tryndamere was part of a nameless barbarian tribe known for their stamina and prowess in combat, which forged blades based on their god's tusks. They fought raiding tribes, the beasts of the mountains and  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") armies trying to claim territory in the Freljord. As he grew up among his tribe, Tryndamere developed into a strong warrior.

One night, the tribe witnessed an unnatural storm from the east, where the [darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin")  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox") stood before them. Some of the barbarians bowed to him under the belief that he was their  [Boar God](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ildhaurg "Universe:Ildhaurg"), but he slaughtered them all. Filled with rage, Tryndamere charged at Aatrox, but was swatted away. As he lay on the verge of death, he was revived by a rage he never felt before, his willpower and thirst for vengeance preventing him from dying.

Tryndamere found his tribe's last remaining survivors, knowing they were doomed with enemies surrounding them throughout the Freljord. Hearing rumors of a tribe which worshipped the reincarnation of Avarosa, they set off to the west where they met the  [Avarosan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Avarosan "Universe:Avarosan"). Eager to gain respect among the tribe, he challenged the Avarosans to duels. However, they began to fear him due to his savage, furious way of fighting and how his wounds regenerated faster the more rage he held. In one duel he was so lost in his fury that he was on the verge of killing his opponent, but  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"), an [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn") allied with the Avarosan, stood in the way with his shield. Tryndamere kept attacking Braum's unbreakable shield until his rage subsided, and the two eventually became friends. Afterward, the tribe's survivors were welcomed into the Avarosan and Tryndamere was arranged to form a political marriage with the Avarosan warmother,  [Ashe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ashe "Universe:Ashe"), but the two slowly grew into a genuine relationship.

### Battling Death

:   *Main article: [Still Here](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Still_Here "Universe:Still Here")*

*(TBA)*
structure.appearance: Tryndamere wears heavy, dark armor that covers his lower body, forearms, and parts of his chest. The armor has a textured, almost metallic look, with sharp, angular edges and layered plating that resembles dragon scales or ancient, battle-worn gear. The dominant colors are black, silver, and teal, giving the armor an ominous, magical appearance. There are glowing accents in the teal hue. His upper body is mostly bare, showcasing his muscular, well-defined physique. There is a band of leather or metal across his chest, connected to the shoulder armor. His skin tone is pale, contrasting sharply with the dark and heavy armor pieces. Tryndamere wears a helmet with large, curved horns that extend outward and upward. The helmet is designed with sharp lines and patterns. His face is mostly obscured by the helmet, but his eyes are intense, and his facial expression looks serious or stern. He has long, flowing black hair that cascades down his back. He wears a gauntlet on his left arm, which are heavily armored, and his hands are partially covered.

structure.abilities:
- **[Blood Magic Empowerment](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Tryndamere#Bloodlust "Tryndamere")**: After the duel with [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aatrox "Aatrox"), Tryndamere was given a bleesing by the Darkin, that granted him abilities far above that of a normal human.
  - **Accelerated Healing**: Tryndamere can regenerate his body from what normally would be fatal wounds through his willpower.
- **[Sword Proficiency](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Tryndamere#Spinning_Slash "Tryndamere")**: Tryndamere is trained in the use of his large sword, being able to easily eviscerate his opponents with just one hand.

relations.relationship_description: [Ashe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ashe "Universe:Ashe") and Tryndamere are Bloodsworn, a political marriage, but the two eventually developed genuine affection for one another. Tryndamere originally married Ashe in exchange for the protection of his remaining tribe after  [Aatrox's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aatrox "Aatrox") massacre. All of this is, in turn, an inside reference at Riot. The name of Riot's co-founder [Marc 'Tryndamere' Merrill's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Marc_%27Tryndamere%27_Merrill "Marc 'Tryndamere' Merrill") wife is [Ashley](https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://na.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?t=1157470).
Tryndamere's nemesis is  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox"), who is the main reason why most of Tryndamere's tribe got destroyed.

[Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum") stopped Tryndamere when he lost control trying to prove his worth to  [Ashe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ashe "Universe:Ashe"). It's rumored that  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum") introduced him to Ashe.

He is hostile towards the Winter's Claw, who disdainfully lumped him into the Avarosa's "decadent lifestyle" even though Tryndamere actually originated from another hardy nomadic tribe, much like  [Sejuani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sejuani "Universe:Sejuani").

structure.trivia:
- Based on his appearance, Tryndamere is between 23 and 30 years old, older than  [Ashe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ashe "Universe:Ashe").
- His original tribe followed a patriarchal system of governance, unlike the norm of the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") which is a matriarchal system.
- Before the 2014 retcon, Tryndamere's sword was passed down from his father, whom in turn received it from his father before him, and so on. Tryndamere said his father's words of wisdom were *"master using it and you can have this"*[[1]](#cite_note-1) - a quote from the original [*Legend of Zelda*](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Legend_of_Zelda_(video_game)) game for the Nintendo Entertainment System, released in 1987. Whether it is still true is unknown.
- Tryndamere draws many parallels with [Conan the Barbarian](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conan_the_Barbarian).
  - His previous story appears to have been based on the opening sequence of the eponymous 1982 movie, in which Conan's entire village is slaughtered and he swears revenge upon those responsible.
  - In the original stories Conan is said to hail from a nomadic people residing in [Cimmeria](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyborian_Age), a northern region in his world, whereas Tryndamere comes from Northern Freljord.
  - Conan is said to have "become a king by his own hand" in the 1982 movie. Tryndamere became "The Barbarian King" by uniting all the peoples of his homeland under his leadership, all thanks to his friendships with most of the Barbarian leaders.
- Historical inspiration might be Mongol military leader Temüjin. Temüjin's [father](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yesugei) was assassinated by the rival [Tatars](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tatar_confederation) & [his clan](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Borjigin) abandoned by erstwhile [allies](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taichiud). Temüjin endured childhood hardship, enslavement, and early military defeats; yet against all odds, he later subdued and united [various warring Mongolic tribes](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khamag_Mongol), ultimately founding the [Mongol Empire](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mongol_Empire) as [Genghis Khan](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genghis_Khan).

structure.name: Willump
structure.quote: *"Pull the fur outta your earholes, Willump! This is gonna be the bestest story ever!"*
structure.background:
Willump was designated the guardian of a crystal which displays the dreams of any nearby mortals. His race was lost when  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra") nearly freed the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Watcher "Universe:Watcher"), who descended into savagery after losing their powers—but the guardian remained, determined to protect the last of their power.

As the last magical yeti, the guardian had perceptive abilities that let him decide who the magic should be gifted to, and he could find nobody worthy. The humans who found him had only death and bloodshed in mind...and he responded in kind, showing the mortals a monstrous being. As time passed, the guardian began to forget those he loved, even his own name.

Once, he knew, there had been song.

When a  [young human boy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nunu "Universe:Nunu") came to his ruined home, the guardian was ready to kill him like the others. The boy raised his flute like a sword, and the stone came alive with visions of heroes and giants. And yet, the boy never struck. He realized the truth of the songs that led him here: the yeti was not a monster...only lonely.

The guardian, prepared to kill, did not expect the first snowball that smashed into his face. Or the second. He became friendlier and furrier, responding not to fear and bloodshed, but to imagination, his growl changing into a laugh.

It lasted until he accidentally broke the boy's flute.

The boy began to cry. The guardian looked to the crystal and saw a sorrow like his. Where before he had looked into it and saw his people's destruction—*the darkness they had buried, betrayal by the  [blind one](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra")*—he now saw a caravan burning. A voice on the wind, a song, and something else within the boy awoke. The guardian had not seen this before, not since the three sisters who had first sought him so long ago. He saw love, fighting back despair.

This child was the Freljord's only hope, the guardian knew, and it was already within the boy, this power of hope. The magic he had guarded was only a tool, meant to be shaped and guarded by the heart the boy had. The crystal's power entered the boy, infusing him with the ability to make what he imagined come true. To fix his flute with True Ice.

To imagine a best friend named Willump.

Rambling wildly across the Freljordian plains, Nunu and Willump can now experience something they never could alone: an adventure. The boy's heart and the yeti's strength let them follow the songs of Nunu's mother on their quest to find her.

But Willump knows that they have a grave responsibility. For the time when Nunu will need to stand strong is nigh, as the Dark Ice which keeps the Watchers trapped at the heart of the Freljord is melting...
structure.appearance: Willump is a huge, lumbering creature covered in white and pastel blue fur. The swirled patterns on his fur seem to bely his magical nature. He has six thick limbs: two legs and four arms, all ending in paws with black claws and pink-skinned pads. He has long, pointed ears, also with pink skin on the inside. He has a black, bear-like nose and an extremely wide mouth. His eyes and fangs glow bright blue. Finally, he has a pair of brown, three-pronged antlers ending in round swirl shapes. When Nunu rides on Willump's back, he often uses these antlers like handlebars.

structure.abilities:
- **Yeti Physiology:** Willump is the last of the Yetis, a powerful race of beings that lived in the Freijord, and carried powerful magic.
  - **Superhuman Strength:** Willump is far stronger than a human being, and could easly kill many humans at the same time.
  - **Superhuman Durability:** Willump can endure much more damage than a normal human such as weapons and the biting Freijord cold.
  - **Longevity:** Yeti can live for centuries. Willump himself has lived for millenia.
  - **Ice Magic**: Willump was blessed by the Demigoddess  [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia"), giving him the ability to use ice magic, being able to create pure ice.

Lissandra betrayed the yetis and stole most of their power.

Ryze may be looking for the crystal, as it may be one of the legendary World Runes.

structure.name: Gwen
structure.quote: *"The wind at my back feels so good. I can’t lose this. I won’t."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Gwen was originally crafted as a doll by a seamstress named  [Isolde](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isolde "Universe:Isolde"), embodying her desire for adventure and royalty. Isolde loved her doll very much and would spend hours sewing and playing with her. Eventually, Isolde would be courted by  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego"), the king of Camavor, and would no longer have time to play with her cherished doll. At first, Gwen could sense that Viego made her creator happy, but their love would sour and become painful. Isolde would fall ill due to an assassin's blade and eventually pass. Viego took Isolde's corpse to the Blessed Isles in hopes of reviving her, but unleashed ruination instead. Without their king, the nation of Camavor would crumble and Gwen would be forgotten for centuries.

### Contemporary history

Gwen would eventually find herself on the Shadow Isles when Viego was awakened by  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") and  [Thresh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh"). Viego would be defeated by  [Ahri](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ahri "Universe:Ahri"),  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"),  [Illaoi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illaoi "Universe:Illaoi"),  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune"),  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pyke "Universe:Pyke"), and  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo") and imprisoned within an amulet. The Ruined King would somehow escape the amulet and resume his search for his queen. The fragments of Isolde's soul scattered across Runeterra and imbued themselves into various fetters, one of them being Gwen. Gwen would be brought to life by the fragment of Isolde's soul and found herself with an oversized pair of scissors, needles, and thread. She would soon be attacked by a swarm of wraiths and remembered the pain associated with Viego, she quickly dispatched the wraiths and knew that they were tied with him. Fascinated by the wonders of life, Gwen would set out to explore the world and stop the pain caused by Viego and the Black Mist.

### The Stranger Who Sews

:   *Main article: [The Stranger Who Sews](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Stranger_Who_Sews "The Stranger Who Sews")*

**Gwen** was watching children play from afar, while she was protected from the Black Mist. The Black Mist threatens to attack the children's house so Gwen unhesitatingly undoes her  [Hallowed Mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gwen#Hallowed_Mist "Gwen") and begins to purge the specters of the Black Mist to protect the children.
Right after the children's mother appears and thanks her, Gwen observes the mother's hands and sees several calluses and wounds. The mother was a seamstress and made dolls for her children to play with, so Gwen felt the affection that  [Isolde](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isolde "Universe:Isolde") had when creating and sewing her.
Gwen then understands that her creator's true magic was love.

### Recent events

Gwen soon found herself at the Sentinels of Light's headquarters where she would meet  [Lucian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lucian "Universe:Lucian"),  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna") and a Rookie. She aided them in repelling a swarm of wraiths and joined them in stopping Viego's global harrowing. She would travel with the Sentinels across Runeterra, chasing after the other fetters and repelling Viego's attacks. Along the way, the Sentinels would recruit more fighters into their ranks and Gwen would give haircuts and tailor new uniforms for  [Diana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Diana/Cosmetics "Diana/Cosmetics"),  [Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Graves/Cosmetics "Graves/Cosmetics"),  [Irelia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Irelia/Cosmetics "Irelia/Cosmetics"),  [Olaf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Olaf/Cosmetics "Olaf/Cosmetics"),  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Pyke/Cosmetics "Pyke/Cosmetics"),  [Rengar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rengar/Cosmetics "Rengar/Cosmetics"),  [Riven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Riven/Cosmetics "Riven/Cosmetics"), and  [Vayne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vayne/Cosmetics "Vayne/Cosmetics"). When Viego obtained most of the fetters, the Sentinels launched one last assault against him on the Shadow Isles. Gwen attempted to bind him within the Hallowed Mist, but Viego quickly dispatched her with a stroke of his blade. He took her, Senna and the Maiden of the Mist to Camavor to resurrect Isolde. Viego tore the fragment of Isolde's soul within Gwen, killing her and the other fetters, and revived his queen. Isolde was horrified at what Viego had done and rejected him. She prompted  [Akshan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akshan "Universe:Akshan") to kill her with his Absolver and revived Gwen, Senna and the Maiden. Gwen then was able to seal him within the Hallowed Mist and the threat of the Ruined King was over. Gwen reckoned with Senna about Isolde being truly gone now, but was ready to live her life to the fullest.

After some time,  **Gwen** continued to clear the black mist on the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles"). As she made her way through the [Black Mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Black_Mist "Black Mist"), she found an opulent mansion in the shadowy woods. As she investigated, Gwen discovered that it was home to the Midnight Revel, a grand ball hosted by friendly spirits, whom invited her in as their guest of honor. She attended the party, protecting it from the Black Mist and dancing the night away.
structure.appearance:
Gwen has the appearance of a pale young woman of medium stature. Her hair is blue and curled up in two long ringlets that are decorated with dark blue ribbons. On her neck and arms she has magical blue marks resembling the stitches of a doll in the same way when she was a normal doll. Her eyes have cross shaped pupils, resembling buttons, with the one on the left being blue and the one on the right being pink.

Gwen typically dresses In a white dress with a black rim and blue chest, decorated with golden details.
structure.personality:
Gwen is a doll given life by the Hallowed Mist and a fragment of Isolde's soul, representing her kindness, love and joy, granting her self awareness and a independent personality.

Having being created as an idealized character by Isolde as a little girl, Gwen has the personality of a idealized princess of fairy tales, highly polite and graceful. She's kind, friendly, and excitable, eager to see the world, curious and in love of everything in it. Having been alive for only a short time, she is terrified of dying.

Although generally friendly and genuine in her niceness, Gwen is not unaware of the darkness of the world. She dutifully fights the evils of the Black Mist to protect the world she was born in, and she has nothing but contempt for the [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shadow_Isles "Shadow Isles")'s most malevolent members, such as  [Thresh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh") and  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego").
structure.abilities:
- **Magically Altered Physiology:** Gwen's body is magically altered and extremely unique due to the circumstances of her birth. Though she was initially a doll created by  [Isolde](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isolde "Universe:Isolde"), she has been fully granted life by her creator thanks to the magic of the mystical  [Hallowed Mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gwen#Hallowed_Mist "Gwen") and is, by all means, considered a human to some extent.
  - **[Hallowed Mist Manipulation:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gwen#Hallowed_Mist "Gwen")** Having been granted life and blessed by the hallowed opposite of the accursed Black Mist, Gwen is capable of manipulating this mist for many capabilities. The Hallowed Mist's main function is to protect both herself and others within her cloud of mist, practically rendering them both hidden and immune from outside dangers. Those under the effect of her Hallowed Mist tend to feel a sense of comfort and calmness to them when it envelops them. As the antithesis of the Black Mist, Gwen has shown that she can utilize the Hallowed Mist to banish and ward off any [undead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Undead "Undead") affected by the mist, being strong enough to imprison the  [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") himself.
    - **[Hallowed Mist Constructs:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gwen#Needlework "Gwen")** Gwen can manipulate the Hallowed Mist into many different shapes, most commonly in the form of common sewing materials and tools. With these constructs, Gwen can use them to attack enemies, most notably any undead.
    - **Enchantment:** Gwen can use the Hallowed Mist to enchant and strengthen other objects to be more capable of fighting off the Black Mist. She can use this in the creation of new objects, such as the many outfits she fashioned for the [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sentinels_of_Light "Sentinels of Light") which she sewed with threads made from the mist itself, or she can enchant common items such as she did with her signature  [scissors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gwen#Snip_Snip! "Gwen").
- **[Scissor Proficiency:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gwen#Snip_Snip! "Gwen")** Gwen typically uses a giant, enchanted pair of scissors in combat which she has enchanted with the Hallowed Mist. Gwen wields these scissors with ease, capable of quickly cutting up entire groups of enemies with speed. Along with that, Gwen has shown that she's able to manipulate the scissors with her mind, telekinetically moving it and allowing it to cut enemies without needing to touch it.
- **Sewing Mastery:** Being a doll created by Isolde, who already had a talent in sewing, Gwen is an supernaturally talented seamstress. Other than the fact that her manipulation of the Hallowed Mist directly reflects her talent as a seamstress, Gwen can create entire, intricate outfits almost instantly when provided enough fabric and materials, just as she did with the Sentinels of Light.

relations.relationship_description:
Gwen was created by  [Isolde](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isolde "Universe:Isolde"),  [Viego's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") wife. After being brought to life, Gwen uses Isolde's tools. Gwen also contains a fragment of Isolde's soul, like  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna").

Gwen travels across Runeterra to fight  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") and the Mist as well as to help people in need.

During the events of [Rise of the Sentinels](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rise_of_the_Sentinels "Rise of the Sentinels"), Gwen accompanied the [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sentinels_of_Light "Sentinels of Light") in the fight against the Black Mist and Viego. She worked as the team' hair stylist and tailor.

**Gwen** and the 4 [Ghostly Paramour](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Ghostly_Paramour "LoR:Ghostly Paramour") seem to have memories of and feelings for each other, both say they've seen each other before but don't remember exactly when. 4 [Ghostly Paramour](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Ghostly_Paramour "LoR:Ghostly Paramour") is likely a reference to 6[Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Viego "LoR:Viego"); a perfect version of the imperfect man she once knew.

structure.trivia:
- Gwen was created somewhere between 47 BN and 30 BN, when  [Isolde](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isolde "Universe:Isolde") was a young girl who dreamed of traveling the kingdom. In an attempt to play out this life, Isolde created her own princess doll that she imagined was the picture of regal elegance. The doll's dress was crafted to match the intricate designs on the  [Camavoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Camavor "Universe:Camavor") warships. *Gwen* sounded perfectly royal for a name.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
- Gwen's biggest fear is death, now that she has begun to experience life.[[3]](#cite_note-Riot_Report-3)
- Gwen can magically change the size of her scissors at will to be any size she wants.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
- Gwen was brought to life shortly after the events of [Ruination (Video)](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ruination_(Video) "Universe:Ruination (Video)").[[3]](#cite_note-Riot_Report-3)
- Gwen was happy for Isolde when her relationship with Viego was good, but when it turned bad, she felt her pain on a deep level.[[5]](#cite_note-5)
- Gwen's weapons are similar in style to relic weapons, as they have the power to destroy wraiths.
- Gwen also wields pure mist, which can hide people from Wraiths and protect against the Harrowing.
- It is unknown if Gwen can transform into her doll form at will like in game.
  - In game, when she's killed transforms into her doll form, but during Viego's uprising in Runeterra she gets killed by him but retained her human form.
- Gwen's acts very much as a high society woman, walking graceful, speaking with manners and keeping her dress accordingly as if she were part of royalty; probably attitudes she learned from both Viego and Isolde.

structure.name: Ashe
structure.quote: *"One tribe, one people, one Freljord."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Ashe was born to  [Grena](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Grena "Universe:Grena"), matriarch of the warlike  [Avarosan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Avarosan "Universe:Avarosan") tribe. From a young age, she was placed under immense pressure to one day succeed her mother as chieftain, leaving her feeling burdened and isolated. Her main respite was another Iceborn girl,  [Sejuani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sejuani "Universe:Sejuani"), the granddaughter of Hejian, chieftain of the  [Winter's Claw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Winter%27s_Claw "Universe:Winter's Claw"), the sister tribe of the Avarosans. Sejuani stayed with them during the summer months and their friendship defined their childhoods. However, their friendship was cut short when they entered their teenage years,[[2]](#cite_note-AsheBio-2) after Hejian severed ties with the Avarosans when Grena questioned her treatment of Sejuani.[[3]](#cite_note-SejuaniBio-3)

### Quest for Avarosa's Bow

:   *Main article: [Ashe: Warmother Comic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warmother:_Issue_1 "Universe:Warmother: Issue 1")*

When Ashe entered teenhood, Grena began her life long search for the Throne of Avarosa, a legendary hoard of treasures and magical items that she hoped would return her people to greatness. However, Grena's search for the throne came with great risks and often led their tribe weakened.[[2]](#cite_note-AsheBio-2) One evening, Ashe's aunt Helnr challenged Grena for control of the tribe, believing they should focus on their dwindling food supply. Grena easily defeated her sister and declared that they would raid the Ice Children, a rival tribe, to replenish their supplies, while Ashe and her tribe's frost priest, Maalcrom, tended to Helnr's wounds.[[4]](#cite_note-WM1-4)

Later, when Ashe entered her mother's hall, she found Grena working on yet another map leading to the Throne of Avarosa. Ashe told her mother that she was concerned with her obsession with the Throne, but Grena deflected the concern and instead asked whether Ashe was ready to be named an [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Iceborn "Universe:Iceborn"). Ashe believed that she was, and Grena presented her with an array of True Ice weapons to wield. Ashe attempted to lift an axe, but the cold quickly overwhelmed her. Grena comforted her daughter and reassured her that one day she would be able to wield True Ice and become a great warmother, however, Ashe saw never herself becoming a warmother.[[4]](#cite_note-WM1-4)

The next morning, the Avarosans prepared for their raid against the Ice Children. Maalcrom feared that the hearthbound of the tribe could not keep pace in the colder lands and asked that Ashe stay behind so they could do the same. Howeverm, Yrael, one of Ashe's oathfathers, dismissed his concerns. As they marched toward the Ice Children's territory, the hearthbound grew exhausted, yet Grena continued to ignore their pleas. They eventually came upon a herd of abandoned elnüks, but Grena refused to stop and ordered them to press onward.[[4]](#cite_note-WM1-4)

Fed up with her neglect, Maalcrom confronted Grena on behalf of the hearthbound, arguing that they now had enough supplies to survive the winter. He criticized her relentless pursuit of the Throne of Avarosa, prompting Grena to raise her weapons and challenge him to a duel. Ashe intervened before they could fight, arguing that the hearthbound were slowing them down. She implored her mother to let them return home, to which Grena reluctantly agreed. Maalcrom urged Ashe to go back with them, but she chose to remain with her mother and the Iceborn.[[4]](#cite_note-WM1-4)

Ashe and the Iceborn continued to follow Grena's lead, but their supplies eventually ran out. When Ashe learned her oathfathers had gone without food for days, she confronted her mother about her relentless quest, believing the Throne to be nothing more than a myth. Grena desperately clung to the notion that the Throne was real, but her resolve began to falter. Ashe tried to comfort her mother, but they were soon ambushed by the  [Frostguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Frostguard "Universe:Frostguard"). Ashe looked to Grena for orders, but her mother told her to run.[[4]](#cite_note-WM1-4)

Yrael was the first to take up arms against the Frostguard, but he was quickly slain by the Draklorn leading them. The Iceborn attempted to hold the enemy at bay, while Grena and Ashe retreated to a nearby ravine. There, Grena handed Ashe her remaining maps and revealed that her search for the Throne of Avarosa had always been for her daughter. With the Frostguard closing in, Grena ordered the remaining Iceborn to take Ashe across the bridge and destroy it. As they carried her away, Ashe watched in horror as her mother was cut down by the Draklorn.[[5]](#cite_note-WM2-5)

By the next morning, only Ashe and two of her oathfathers remained. With the Draklorn still in pursuit and their village defenseless, Ashe decided they had to split up. She ordered her oathfathers to return home and defend their people, while she continued alone toward the Throne of Avarosa. Ashe managed to stay ahead of the Draklorn for a time, but he gained ground with each passing day. When she finally reached the end of her mother's map, all she found was a barren stretch of tundra marked only by a pile of rocks.[[5]](#cite_note-WM2-5)

As the Draklorn and his forces closed in, Ashe rushed to the stones, desperately searching for a weapon to defend herself. When the Draklorn approached, he revealed himself to be Maalcrom. Ashe was shocked by her friend's betrayal, but Maalcrom claimed he had done his best to spare the Avarosans for years, having promised his masters that he would try to stop Grena's search for the Throne of Avarosa. As the sun rose over the horizon, Ashe used its light to launch a desperate attack on the Frostguard, managing to fell two of them before Maalcrom tackled her.[[5]](#cite_note-WM2-5)

As Maalcrom strangled her, Ashe felt the presence of True Ice within the pile of stones. Reaching into them, she found Avarosa's legendary bow. With it in hand, she gained the strength to force Maalcrom off her, and her once-blonde hair turned white. Ashe declared that she was the bow, and loosed an ice arrow in to the frost priest, impaling him icicles.[[5]](#cite_note-WM2-5)

### Reuniting with Sejuani

When Ashe returned to her village, she found it razed to the ground and all the Avarosans killed. With her tribe gone, Ashe ventured into Ursine territory in search of food. She quickly found a dead beast, but it had been bait for a grellfeen. The creature nearly devoured Ashe before she was saved by a girl she to believed to be an Ursine. Though the girl landed several strikes against the grellfeen, she couldn't bring it down. Ashe froze it in place with her bow, allowing the girl to finish it off.[[6]](#cite_note-WM3-6)

With the beast dead, Ashe apologized for intruding on Ursine lands, but the girl revealed herself to be Ashe's childhood friend,  [Sejuani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sejuani "Universe:Sejuani"). Though Sejuani was happy to be reunited with her, she questioned why Ashe was here, to which she revealed the fate of her tribe. Together, they butchered the grellfeen, but were soon beset by real Ursine. They carried the meat onto Sejuani's boat before the Ursine could catch them and escaped into the sea.[[6]](#cite_note-WM3-6)

As they journeyed back to  [Winter's Claw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Winter%27s_Claw "Universe:Winter's Claw"), Ashe explained how her tribe had been betrayed by a frost priest, something Sejuani believed was also happening to her tribe. In the weeks that followed, Ashe and Sejuani reconnected during their voyage, with Sejuani promising one night that they would be sisters.[[6]](#cite_note-WM3-6)

When they reached the waters of the Winter's Claw, Sejuani warned Ashe that they would need to win over the tribe before the frost priests discovered her true identity. They planned to distribute the food they had gathered, but Sejuani's mother, Kalkia, was already waiting for them at the docks. The frost priests cautioned the warmother against trusting outsiders, but Kalkia was willing to grant Ashe shelter if she explained where the food had come from. Ashe lied, claiming that they had hunted the grellfeen in open waters after it attacked her ship, and that Sejuani had saved her. The frost priests saw through the lie, but Sejuani lied to confirm her story. Kalkia demanded to speak with her daughter in private, while Ashe began distributing the meat to the tribe.[[6]](#cite_note-WM3-6)

Later that night, the frost priests confronted Ashe during a feast. They accused her of heresy for pursuing the Throne of Avarosa, but Sejuani declared Ashe her battlesister and would prove her worth in the next hunt. The frost priests objected, but Kalkia allowed her daughter's declaration and would decide what to do with Ashe in the morning.[[7]](#cite_note-WM4-7)

Believing they could not wait, Sejuani brought Ashe to her hunting party. She feared that the frost priests would strike before morning or her mother would turn Ashe over and decided that they should head out now. Ashe considered returning to sea, but Sejuani insisted she stay, wanting to protect her just as Grena had protected her when she was younger. Sejuani drew a knife and cut her palm, swearing a blood oath to Ashe. She promised to protect Ashe and named her her battlesister. Ashe then took the knife and did the same, declaring Sejuani her battlesister in return.[[7]](#cite_note-WM4-7)

### The New Avarosans

Sejuani led the hunting party to the Ebrataal, a neighboring tribe that shared the Winter's Claw hunting grounds. While Ashe believed they intended only to steal supplies, Sejuani sought to end the food shortage permanently and ordered her warriors to burn the village. Appalled as the Winter's Claw began killing the tribespeople, Ashe intervened, firing an ice arrow at one of Sejuani's warriors. She pleaded with Sejuani to stop, but Sejuani revealed that the frost priests had forced her mother into a treaty with the Ebrataal. In order to not be labeled oathbreakers, they could not leave any witnesses alive. Sejuani ordered Ashe to continue, but Ashe refused and turned her bow on Sejuani instead.[[7]](#cite_note-WM4-7)

Ashe pleaded for the villagers' lives, insisting that they could survive at sea, just as she had. Sejuani argued that Ashe had survived only because destiny had led her to her, but Ashe rejected the idea of destiny and loosed her arrows at Sejuani. As they fought, Sejuani declared that it was Ashe's fate to be her battlesister and that the Ebrataal were nothing, sacrifices that had to be made for her tribe to survive. Sejuani told her that Grena was her hero and that she was doing exactly what she would have done, but Ashe declared that her mother was failure, because all lives had meaning.[[7]](#cite_note-WM4-7)

In turn, Sejuani accused Ashe of being the one failed by Grena, telling that she envied how much Grena had loved her when her own mother did not, but that such love had made Ashe soft. She argued that Ashe could not lead if she was unwilling to lie, kill, and make sacrifices, but Ashe reminded Sejuani of her own words: "It is the strong who must try the impossible." Ashe stressed that Sejuani had brought her on the hunt to earn the title of battlesister, but that she could not do so through oathbreaking and the slaughter of an entire village. She promised to help Sejuani become warmother, but as her sister, she begged her to let her honor her words and try to lead the Ebrataal to safety.[[7]](#cite_note-WM4-7)

Sejuani issued a final ultimatum: Ashe could either stand with her as her sister, or watch the Ebrataal fail. Ashe answered that she had to try. Reluctantly, Sejuani allowed Ashe to take the surviving Ebrataal, but warned her that if they ever crossed paths again, she would be considered an enemy. As Sejuani and her warriors departed, Ashe called after her, declaring that she would always be her sister and never her enemy, but Sejuani replied that Ashe would have no choice.[[7]](#cite_note-WM4-7)

In the aftermath, the surviving Ebrataal pledged themselves to Ashe. However, Ashe refused to take them as slaves, and instead declared them Avarosans. Though they had no supplies, Ashe and the new Avarosans set sail south. Along the way, more hearthbound would join the Avarosans. When asked how she wished to be addressed, Ashe declared that she was their warmother.[[7]](#cite_note-WM4-7)

As the Avarosans took in more people, rumors began circulating that Ashe not only wielded Avarosa's bow, but she was also the reincarnation of the legend herself. Ashe leveraged the myth in order to make alliances with the southern tribes to feed her burgeoning tribe and wanted to unite them into a nation that could challenge even the neighboring kingdoms.[[2]](#cite_note-AsheBio-2)

### Saving Tryndamere

With more tribes allying themselves with the Avarosans, Ashe soon found herself in the center of a political feud. As a warmother, she was expected to take a husband from one from one of the major tribes, however, regardless of who she chose it would still anger the others.[[2]](#cite_note-AsheBio-2) Her answer finally came in the form of a warrior from an impoverished tribe named  [Tryndamere](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tryndamere "Universe:Tryndamere"). Seeking the Avarosan's protection for his people, Tryndamere challenged many contenders to duels in order to prove his tribe's worth.[[8]](#cite_note-Trynd-8) During a duel at [Rakelstake](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rakelstake "Universe:Rakelstake"), Tryndamere became consumed by his bloodlust and was only stopped by the timely intervention of  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"), who later introduced him to Ashe.[[9]](#cite_note-9)

Impressed by his ferocity, Ashe decided to take Tryndamere as her first and only bloodsworn. In exchange for adopting his tribe, Tryndamere would serve as her champion, warding off any who sought her hand in marriage or challenged her rule. Though they initially wed out of political gain, true affection began to bloom between the two.[[8]](#cite_note-Trynd-8)[[2]](#cite_note-AsheBio-2) Shortly after they wed, Ashe saved Tryndamere's life as he battled against raiders and  [death](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kindred "Universe:Kindred") itself.[[10]](#cite_note-10)

As more tribes joined Ashe's coalition, it earned the ire of  [Sejuani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sejuani "Universe:Sejuani"), now warmother of the  [Winter's Claw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Winter%27s_Claw "Universe:Winter's Claw"). Believing that Ashe tarnished Grena's legacy, Sejuani sought to destroy the Avarosans and prove that only she was worthy of ruling the Freljord.[[11]](#cite_note-11)
structure.appearance: Ashe is a slender, pale-skinned woman with blue eyes and long white hair. She wears light, elegant robes with a distinct palette of black, dark blue, and gold. She also wields a  Avarosa's True Ice Bow.
structure.personality:
Ashe is smart, stoic, serene and has a calm disposition. She is idealistic as well, believing that by retaking their ancient, tribal lands once more will unite the Freljord.

However, Ashe is implied to have a heated temper and vengeful streak, especially to those who have hurt her allies in the past. Her rage is so intense that she relies on the stinging cold of True Ice to keep her calm.
structure.abilities:
- **[Iceborn Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn"):** Ashe is one of the Iceborn, individuals with a magical alteration to their bodies that makes them inherently resistant to the cold. Because of these resistances, Ashe is capable of wielding [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice"), a magical material that constantly freezes and never melts.
- **[Bow Proficiency:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ashe#Enchanted_Crystal_Arrow "Ashe")** Ashe is extremely talented in the art of archery since childhood, capable of firing arrows with extreme precision at far distances. She currently wields a magical bow made of True Ice, believed to have been previously wielded by the revered  [Freljordian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") goddess Avarosa. Using this bow, Ashe can summon  [frost arrows](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ashe#Ranger's_Focus "Ashe") as ammunition, capable of completely  [freezing](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ashe#Frost_Shot_2 "Ashe") her enemies in an instant.
- **Leadership:** As the current Warmother of the Avarosans, Ashe is a formidable leader and successfully leads the Avarosans on their mission for a newly united and modernized Freljord.
  - **Diplomacy Mastery:** Unlike the rest of the Freljord, Ashe focuses primarily on diplomatic relationships and has become well versed in all manners of negotiation and modern politics. With this, she has successfully made the  [Avarosans](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Avarosan "Universe:Avarosan") one of the largest tribes in the Freljord thanks to the many alliances made on Ashe's behalf.

relations.relationship_description: Ashe and  [Sejuani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sejuani "Universe:Sejuani") were childhood friends but were separated when Ashe's mother offended Sejuani's grandmother about how she was raising Sejuani. They were eventually reunited as teenagers after Ashe's tribe was decimated by  [Lissandra's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lissandra "Lissandra") frost priests, but the two had a falling out during a raid against a neighbor of the Winter's Claw. These neighbors, whom Ashe did not want to kill, would later become the first members of the new Avarosans. The two once saw each other as sisters.

[Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra") cards suggest Ashe's Avarosan and  [Trundle's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trundle "Universe:Trundle") [trolls](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Troll "Troll") are in direct conflict which has resulted in a number of loss for the tribe. For that reason, Ashe wants the race to be exterminated.

[Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia") is the demigod that Ashe prays to the most and the one she has the deepest connection to. This is because she speaks the most to Ashe's hopes and beliefs.[[12]](#cite_note-Ashe_Anivia-12) Rumors say a recently hatched Anivia has met Ashe, and perhaps Anivia sees one who may be able to finally reunite the Freljord.

It is unknown if  [Nunu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nunu "Universe:Nunu") and  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Willump "Willump") support Ashe, but their deeds around the Freljord lead towards the same goal.

**Ashe** and  [Tryndamere](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tryndamere "Universe:Tryndamere") are [Bloodsworn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Bloodsworn_Pledge "LoR:Bloodsworn Pledge"), a political marriage, but the two eventually developed genuine affection for each other. Ashe originally married Tryndamere in order to avoid having to marry multiple suitors from neighboring tribes. All of this is, in turn, an inside reference at Riot. The name of Riot's co-founder [Marc 'Tryndamere' Merrill](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Marc_%27Tryndamere%27_Merrill "Marc 'Tryndamere' Merrill")'s wife is [Ashley](https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://na.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?t=1157470).

Unbeknownst to all,  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra") is the Ice Witch of Freljordian legend, who is actually waiting for the right moment to strike Ashe's and Sejuani's tribes and wipe out any potential incarnations of Avarosa and Serylda in order to take over the Freljord. As revealed by  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra"), she herself is one of the Three Sisters who led the Iceborn uprising against the Watchers. Whether or not she knows Ashe and  [Sejuani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sejuani "Universe:Sejuani") are potentially direct descendants of her sisters (Avarosa and Serylda, respectively) making her their great-aunt-many-times-removed, is unknown.

structure.trivia:
- Ashe's True Ice bow is said to have belonged to her supposed ancestor Avarosa, the ancient [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn") queen of unified [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Freljord "Freljord").
  - However, dialogue from  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain") suggests Ashe has possibly lied about unearthing the bow from Avarosa's tomb. Ashe's comic series, *[Warmother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Warmother:_Issue_1 "Warmother: Issue 1"),* showed her unearthing it from an ancient battlefield; its true origins and original wielder are unknown.
  - Dialogue from  [Taric](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taric "Universe:Taric") suggests the bow is actually a celestial weapon of [Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Targon "Targon") infused with True Ice by one of her ancestors who were "of the stars".
  - According to  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra")'s biography, the only ancestor stated to have ever had any interaction with Targon was Serylda, [Sejuani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sejuani "Sejuani")'s ancestor, which ultimately suggests the bow might actually have been Serylda's. In one of their  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra") interactions, Lissandra calls Ashe "pretender", suggesting the bow may not have belonged to Avarosa.
- Ashe is around 23 years old.
  - Ashe was 15 or 16 in "[Warmother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Warmother_Issue_1 "Warmother Issue 1")", in game she is around 21 to 24.[[13]](#cite_note-13)
- Ashe's hair was originally blonde, but turned white since she picked up the bow.
- [Hawkshot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ashe#Hawkshot "Ashe") is derived from the power of  [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia").[[12]](#cite_note-Ashe_Anivia-12)
- [Yrael](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yrael "Yrael") is likely Ashe's biological father but to emphasize or call that out would be disrespectful to the other [Oathfathers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Oathfather?action=edit&redlink=1 "Oathfather (page does not exist)") and presume greater importance.[[14]](#cite_note-14)
- In the [old lore](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Runeterra_Legacy "Runeterra Legacy"):
  - Ashe directly took the bow from Avarosa's grave.
  - evidence to support Ashe's heritage stemmed from  [Ezreal's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ezreal "Ezreal") uncle Lyte stating her 'striking resemblance' to Avarosa herself, as well as the fact Ashe was supposedly led to Avarosa's grave by a great hawk, where she found her ancestor's True Ice bow. *Warmother* shows us the real story of how she got her bow, though, and her new voiceover makes it clear that Ashe's image as a descendant of Avarosa is an act.
    - Multiple  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra") artworks suggest the Avarosan and Frostguard may enter direct conflicts at some point in the future.
  - The  [Avarosan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Avarosan "Universe:Avarosan") (led by Ashe) are engaged in a civil war with the  [Winter's Claw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Winter%27s_Claw "Universe:Winter's Claw") (led by  [Sejuani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sejuani "Universe:Sejuani")) over sovereignty of the Freljord. The  [Frostguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Frostguard "Universe:Frostguard") (led by  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra")) appears to be political allies of the Avarosan, but in truth they are waiting to strike both tribes in order to make way for the [Watcher](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher")'s return and rule the Freljord.
  - [Anivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anivia "Universe:Anivia"),  [Gragas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gragas "Universe:Gragas"),  [Nunu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nunu "Universe:Nunu") and  [Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Willump "Willump") are allies of the Avarosan.
  - During the events of "[Journey Into The Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Journey_Into_The_Freljord "Journey Into The Freljord")", Ashe met  [Quinn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quinn "Universe:Quinn") and  [Valor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valor "Universe:Valor") when they visited her territory on a scouting mission at  [Jarvan IV's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jarvan_IV "Jarvan IV") behest. Valor has come to like Ashe, a rare display towards anyone other than Quinn herself.
  - There was one scandal involving Ashe and  [Pantheon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pantheon "Universe:Pantheon") due to them being found meeting in the middle of the night, raising concerns of Ashe's infidelity.
  - Ashe married  [Tryndamere](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tryndamere "Universe:Tryndamere") for purely political reasons; however, according to  [Blitzcrank's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blitzcrank "Blitzcrank") dating service, they are a perfect match.
