structure.name: Cho'Gath
structure.quote: *"Your souls will feed the Void!"*
structure.background: Born from the unspeakable darkness of the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void"), Cho'Gath exists solely to consume matter. As a Voidborn, it has been part of a relentless effort to breach the barriers between dimensions and invade Runeterra for millennia. Now, Cho'Gath preys on anyone and anything that ventures near the center of the Void Rift in Icathia.
structure.appearance: Cho'Gath is massive behemoth who towers over its adversaries, growing larger with every creature it devours. Its massive form is covered in a hardened, purplish-red carapace. Its visage features multiple rows of razor-sharp teeth within a gaping maw. Cho'Gath possesses six appendages: two ending in powerful pincers, two ending in scythe-like spikes, and two clawed legs. Flanking its maw are two horns that curve forward towards its face.
structure.personality: Cho'Gath is an entity driven by an unrelenting and insatiable hunger. It embodies the all-consuming desire of the Void to consume all life and bring about chaos and destruction. Despite being primal in nature, Cho'Gath possesses a certain level of intelligence. It revels in the fear and terror it instills in others, taking pleasure in its violent predations.
structure.abilities:
As a [Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidborn "Voidborn"), Cho'Gath is able to evolve and grow, becoming increasingly formidable. Some of its known abilities include:

- **[Rupture](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cho%27Gath#Rupture "Cho'Gath")**: Cho'Gath slams the ground, causing devastating seismic ruptures that erupt beneath enemies, launching them into the air and dealing damage.
- **[Feral Scream](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cho%27Gath#Feral_Scream "Cho'Gath")**: With a terrifying roar, Cho'Gath emits a sonic blast that silences and damages nearby enemies, rendering them unable to cast spells.
- **[Vorpal Spikes](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cho%27Gath#Vorpal_Spikes "Cho'Gath")**: Cho'Gath can unleash a barrage of spikes from its body, impaling and damaging enemies in a wide area.
- **[Feast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cho%27Gath#Feast "Cho'Gath")**: Cho'Gath's signature ability, it devours its enemies, dealing massive damage and growing in size and strength with each kill.

structure.name: Anivia
structure.quote: *"I am the fury of the blizzard, the bite of the wind, and the cold of the ice. I am the [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Freljord "Freljord")."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Anivia is an ancient [demi-god](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/God "God") who represents the eternal cycle of life, death, rebirth and the changing of the seasons. She, along with her many siblings, sprung from  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") during its formation and together they began to forge the lands of the  [Vorrijaard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") itself. Anivia's birth in particular is believed to have brought the first winters into the world, with some even claiming she is responsible for creating [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice").

#### Arrival of Mortal Tribes

When the first mortals arrived in the ancient Vorrijaard, Anivia welcomed them willingly. Witnessing their fragility to the cold weather, she sheltered and guided them to secluded valleys where they would establish their own tribal communities and harden themselves to the elements. While nurturing and watching over these tribes, the mortals would come to revere and worship her and her siblings as gods. Legends state that, though she hoped that these tribes would remain united, blood-feuds and infighting made them susceptible to a massive invasion from a greedy king in the south who marched through the mountains seeking to claim the wild magic of the Vorrijaard for himself. Anivia, angered by the outsiders, summoned a massive snowstorm that lasted a century, obliterating the ancient army.

#### The Three Sisters

A young mortal woman named  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra"), alongside her two sisters Avarosa and Serylda, sought to harness the magics of the world and claim dominion over the entire Vorrijaard. In order to do so, each sister scoured the world for ancient powers to harness with Lissandra seeking to tame the wild magic of the land itself.[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1) Anivia's brothers  [Valhir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear") and 8 [Ildhaurg](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Wrath_of_the_Freljord "LoR:Wrath of the Freljord") however grew angered by Lissandra's defiance and sought to destroy the three sisters for their transgressions. Anivia however, alongside her other siblings, was more inclined to work with the sisters rather than declare a war.[[2]](#cite_note-:1-2)

After the eldest sister Lissandra made a pact with [otherworldly masters](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher"), these three sisters would form a mighty alliance and lead a horde of warriors called the [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn"). These powerful mortals were attuned to elemental magics of the ice, capable of wielding and utilizing the True Ice substance and practically immune to the frigid cold of the Vorrijaard, now called the *Freljord*.[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1)

As Lissandra and her sisters gained power and marched with their armies, they slowly erased the influences of the Freljordian demi-gods in favor of venerating the Three Sisters as goddesses, affecting the worship of Anivia and her siblings over time.

#### Death and Rebirth

It's believed that even death cannot touch Anivia herself, as many stories tell of how she had been struck down a handful of times throughout history, always followed by a magnificent rebirth—for as long as the Freljord exists, her soul remains immortal. Each rebirth may take hundreds or thousands of years before she rises again, but they always coincide with the dawn of a new era for the Freljord, causing her appearance to be both a wondrous blessing as well as an omen of great or terrible changes on the horizon.

Legend has it that Anivia once sacrificed herself against a march of towering [Balestriders](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Balestrider "Balestrider"), colossal and ancient creatures now corrupted by the influence of Lissandra.[[3]](#cite_note-3) Though she was incapable of truly slaying these creatures, she instead plunged into the ice beneath their feet and shattered her own body, entombing them beneath the ice and snow.

### Modern History

#### Myths and Legends

Anivia is ancient enough to have witnessed countless mortal civilizations and is highly revered to by many tribal communities of the Freljord. Many stories and legends have been told in Anivia's honor, cementing her as a staple for most of Freljordian mythology and culture.

One of the oldest stories of Anivia tells of how her brother Ornn felled one of her favorite perching trees to build his house the Horn Hall. Annoyed by this, Anivia sought to prank her brother by tickling his nose with her feathers as he slept, causing him to sneeze out a gout of flame and setting his bedsheets on fire. Anivia, panicked by the blaze of fire building in the wooden house, flapped her wings to fly away and accidentally stoked the fire even hotter within the dry Freljordian air, causing all of Horn Hall to light ablaze. Ornn woke up on top of a pile of ashes in a bad mood, feeling disturbed in his sleep but unaware of the prank Anivia did on him, something she hasn't told him to this day.[[4]](#cite_note-:2-4)

The nomadic [Notai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Notai "Notai") highly revere Anivia, traveling along the waves of frost believed to spill from Anivia's massive wings.[[5]](#cite_note-:3-5) Well known for their songs and storytelling, the Notai have many songs that detail Anivia's magnificent birth; bursting from a giant egg of ice and hurling tiny shards into the sky to eventually fall as snow.

Another tribe, called the Mourncrow, have sagas telling how the frigid winds and blizzards that scour the Freljord actually originate from the first beats of Anivia's wings when she first birthed into the world.

The  [Avarosan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Avarosan "Universe:Avarosan") tribe have a legend about an Iceborn warmother named Ulla Shatter-Spear, who was favored by Anivia herself for saving a young [Hawk](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hawk "Hawk") from a [Rimefang Wolf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rimefang_Wolf "Rimefang Wolf"). Throughout Ulla's life, Anivia protected her from harm until she finally fell in battle after witnessing a hundred winters. After her death, Ulla's soul was welcomed by Anivia herself with wings spread wide.

### Recent events

Anivia has reemerged from her egg once more, marking the start of a new era for the Freljord and bringing great change. She most recently appeared before  [Ashe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ashe "Universe:Ashe"), who continued her deceased mother Grena's search for the mythical *Throne of Avarosa.* Ashe, now the new warmother of the Avarosan tribe, is seen by Anivia as the one who can finally reunite the tribes of the Freljord and thus has somewhat gained the favor of the Cryophoenix.[[6]](#cite_note-:4-6)

With Anivia's return to the Freljord, more and more shamans and spirit walkers of the old demi-gods feel her presence and the new era she heralds to the Freljord, though they are unsure of what great threat she has come to face.
structure.appearance: Anivia is massive eagle-like creature composed entirely of crystalline blue ice. She also has a single fuchsia crystal on her forehead. Her egg form is an icy globe which glows with white magic and appears swaddled in a nest of icy spikes.
structure.personality:
Revered by both the [Notai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Notai "Notai") and the [Yeti](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yeti "Yeti") of old, Anivia is seen as a benevolent guardian deity. In Freljordian legends, she has noteably be an advocate for forgiveness and unity among all of the Freljord's people. The [Notai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Notai "Notai") and the [Yeti](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yeti "Yeti") have been called her "children" by her brothers before, hinting at her more nurturing nature. She also advocates diplomacy before war, as seen when she advises her kin to work together with the Three Sisters.

While she is a peaceful being, she is not a pacifist. She has notably defended the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") from outside forces like Southerners who seek to claim the  [Vorrijaard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vorrijaard "Universe:Vorrijaard") as their own as well as [Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidborn "Voidborn") and the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher") that created them, who threaten  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") itself. While she is unable to die, she is willing to sacrifice herself in order to save the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") from annihilation.
structure.abilities:
- - **[Spirit God Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_God "Spirit God"):** Anivia is an ancient divine being embodying an aspect of the world. In her case, Anivia embodies the concepts of ice, winter, changing of seasons, rebirth and hope in  [Freljordian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") culture. As a spirit god, Anivia is empowered by the belief of her followers and linked to the cultural concepts she embodies.
    - **Winged Flight:** Anivia takes the form of a giant, majestic bird made of ice and snow with massive wings. Though these wings grant her the ability of flight, she may also use these wings to  [summon great blizzards](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Anivia#Glacial_Storm "Anivia") as ice and snow constantly fall off of her wings.
    - **Immortality:** As a spirit goddess, Anivia cannot age or die as long as the concepts she embodies and the Freljord itself still exists. Historically however, Anivia has been struck down in battle several times over thousands of years. Whenever this occurs, Anivia is sure to be reborn and emerge from an  [egg](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Anivia#Rebirth "Anivia") soon after, with her rebirth marking a new era for the Freljord.
    - **[Ice Magic:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Anivia#Glacial_Storm "Anivia")** As a powerful goddess of the winter, Anivia is linked to the elemental magics of ice and frost. Many legends tell of her immense strength and capability in controlling the winter. She is capable of summoning great blizzards, erect  [mighty walls of ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Anivia#Crystallize "Anivia") and is even believed to have created the magical substance [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice").
    - **Empowerment**: Like all spiritual Gods, Anivia has the ability to give parts of her power to her followers and all who worship her.

relations.relationship_description:
Anivia is one of the Freljordian demi-gods responsible for creating and forging the very land itself. All of the gods are siblings with one another, with Anivia being among one of the older ones. Anivia has not shown any true ill will to any of her fellow gods and is related to deities such as the *Seal Sister* and other currently unnamed spirits.

#### [Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn")

Ornn is the eldest of the Freljordian demi-gods, being the god of the forge and magma. Ornn doesn't socialize with his siblings very much but hasn't shown any ill will towards Anivia. However, there are legends within the Freljord that tell of how Anivia, after Ornn felled her favorite perching tree, pulled a prank on Ornn in his sleep, causing him to sneeze a gout of flame and burn his house down. The legend states that he woke up in a grumpy mood, unaware of what Anivia had done.[[4]](#cite_note-:2-4)

#### [Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear")

The mighty Volibear, also known as *Valhir*, is the Freljordian demi-god of storms and warfare. Volibear interacted with Anivia when he called his siblings together to declare war on the ice witch  [Lissandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lissandra "Universe:Lissandra"). Many of the gods, especially Anivia, actually denied Volibear's proposal of war and was more inclined to cooperate with the mortals.[[2]](#cite_note-:1-2) Despite this, and despite his violent nature, Volibear actually highly respects Anivia as a goddess.

Though it's unsure whether or not Anivia has personally interacted with Lissandra, she is the one who moved to make peace with her instead of declaring war like her brother Volibear proposed. Anivia felt the ice witch's presence when she rallied her army of [Iceborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iceborn "Iceborn") to claim dominion over the Freljord, as followers of the old gods began to die out in her crusade to wipe out all of their worshippers.[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1)

Anivia hasn't personally interacted with Ashe, but she did appear before her at the mythical *Avarosa's Throne,* where Ashe found her signature [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice") bow.[[6]](#cite_note-:4-6) Recently, word has spread that Ashe has actually gained the favor of Anivia herself as she sees in Ashe a way to truly reunite the Freljord.

The Notai tribe highly revere Anivia in particular, having many stories and songs passed down for generations that speak of her many deeds and detailing her magnificent birth and rebirth within the world. They are nomadic and travel by following wherever the snow may fall, traveling along the waves of frost believed to fall off of Anivia's wings as she flies.[[5]](#cite_note-:3-5)

#### [Nunu & Willump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Minor_Characters "Universe:Minor Characters")

Nunu hasn't personally met Anivia but was born within the Notai tribe where he heard many stories and songs about her, particularly from his mom Layka.[[5]](#cite_note-:3-5)

As the most powerful spirit walker in the Freljord, Udyr is easily capable of channeling the powers of all the Freljordian spirits including Anivia herself.[[7]](#cite_note-7) When channeling Anivia, Udyr enters his  [Storm Stance](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Udyr#Wingborne_Storm "Udyr"), gaining the ice magic of the Cryophoenix herself.

structure.trivia:
- Anivia is a prehistoric entity, being at least 10000 years old and possibly much older than that.
- As a [Spirit God](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_God "Spirit God"), Anivia acts as a manifestation of cultural ideas, given immense power by the belief of her followers. Because of this, her power can wax and wane depending on her worship or even disappear entirely for a long time.[[8]](#cite_note-8)
- It's most likely that [True Ice's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/True_Ice "True Ice") origins are traced back to Anivia, as  [Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") can obtain ice magic similar to hers when he made contact with True Ice.[[9]](#cite_note-9)
- While in  [egg form](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Anivia#Rebirth "Anivia"), Anivia is often referred to as 1[Eggnivia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Eggnivia "LoR:Eggnivia").
  - In League of Legends, Anivia's in-game name changes accordingly while she is  [resurrecting](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Death#Ways_to_prevent_death_when_reaching_zero_health "Death") with her passive.

structure.name: Kennen
structure.quote: *"I exist across realms, in the space between lightning’s strike and thunder’s call, the true balance within the storm."*
structure.background:
### Ancient Times

Unlike many of his kind, Kennen felt a dissonance within the vibrant chaos of his homeland,  [Bandle City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bandle_City "Universe:Bandle City"). Seeking harmony and balance, Kennen ventured forth from the spirit realm millennia ago, drawn by an insatiable curiosity that led him to traverse the material realm.

His journey eventually brought him to the serene  [First Lands](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:First_Lands "Universe:First Lands"), where [ancient wars that none now remember](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Titan_War "Universe:Titan War") had scarred the landscape, leaving behind a people striving to rebuild amidst the echoes of conflict. Kennen found solace among the inhabitants of the  [First Lands](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:First_Lands "Universe:First Lands"), fascinated by their relentless pursuit of balance and tranquility. Over time, he became deeply woven into the fabric of First Lands, forsaking his ties to Bandle City as he embraced the mortal realm and its inhabitants.

### Acceptance into the Kinkou

As Kennen delved deeper into the affairs of the First Lands, which would become known as  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), he encountered malevolent entities from the spirit realm threatening the delicate equilibrium of the land. Alone, he valiantly battled these disturbances, but soon realized that mere combat was not enough to address the root cause of imbalance. It was then that he discovered the  [Kinkou](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order"), a fledgling order dedicated to preserving harmony between the realms.

Recognizing the need for a unifying force within the order, Kennen proposed himself as an arbiter, a bridge between the introspective Eye of Twilight and the warlike Fist of Shadow. With his affability and diplomacy, he became the Kinkou's first Heart of the Tempest, working alongside the Eye and the Fist to pass judgment and maintain equilibrium.

### War of the False Kanmei

:   *Main article: [Great Darkin War](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Darkin_War "Universe:Great Darkin War")*

In one ancient conflict, the  [First Lands](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:First_Lands "Universe:First Lands") were invaded by a host of malevolent beings known as the  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin"), fallen [god-warriors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:God-Warrior "Universe:God-Warrior") who had ravaged most of [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valoran "Universe:Valoran") and [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shuriman_Continent "Universe:Shuriman Continent") in their conquests. Kennen, alongside the Eye of Twilight  [Bhinan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bhinan "Universe:Bhinan") and the Fist of Shadow Lao, each hoped to preserve the balance against these invaders, but some time after Lao was killed by the bloodweaver  [Xolaani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xolaani "Universe:Xolaani"),[[1]](#cite_note-1) the Kinkou accepted an offer to ally with a Darkin who had turned against his brethren:  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen"). Lao's successor,  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara"), kept an eye on and fought alongside Zaahen for the next three years, until the Fallen Ones were sealed within their weapons. When the war had ended, Zaahen requested he be imprisoned as well for fear of his own nature, and Bhinan tasked Yunara to guard his glaive within the [spirit realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_Realm "Universe:Spirit Realm") for all time.[[2]](#cite_note-Truth-2)

After Yunara and Zaahen were safely banished to the Temple of Twilight, Kennen and the other Kinkou rewrote the history of the Great Darkin War into a wholesome fable known as the [Tale of the Devoted Shrine Maiden](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Devoted_Shrine_Maiden "Universe:The Devoted Shrine Maiden"), which cast Yunara as a humble shrine maiden and Zaahen as her patron kanmei, whom she followed into exile after freeing the world from the armies of false gods. With this story, the people of Ionia would be allowed to forget the hardship of the past and continue their lives in peace for centuries more.[[2]](#cite_note-Truth-2)

### Noxian Invasion of Ionia

:   *Main article: [Noxian Invasion of Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxian_Invasion_of_Ionia "Universe:Noxian Invasion of Ionia")*

In the tumultuous aftermath of the Noxian invasion, as Ionia teetered on the brink of collapse, the Kinkou found themselves torn apart by internal strife and external threats. Despite Kennen's efforts to guide the order through the chaos, the shadow of betrayal loomed large as  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed"), a former acolyte, orchestrated a coup.

In the darkest hour of the Kinkou, Kennen stood steadfast, offering counsel to the new Eye of Twilight,  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"), as he grappled with the burdens of leadership. He urged the Fist of Shadow, Mayym, to recognize  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali"), his protege, as a potential successor. Yet even his wisdom could not prevent Akali's eventual departure from the order, disillusioned by its perceived failure to confront Ionia's enemies.

### Return of Zaahen

#### Spirit Blossom Festival

Some time after being ousted from [Thanjuul](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Temple_of_Thanjuul "Universe:Temple of Thanjuul"), the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") took up residence in the [Temple of Koeshin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Temple_of_Koeshin "Universe:Temple of Koeshin") to rebuild. The  [Noxians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") withdrew from  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") following the rise of a  [Grand General](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), and barely a season after the invaders left, the whole of Ionia bloomed with spirit blossoms, allowing for the first  [Spirit Blossom](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_Blossom "Universe:Spirit Blossom") festival in years.[[3]](#cite_note-Pilgrimage-3)

During the festival, Kennen encountered the  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") seneschal  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao"), who had come seeking wisdom about a Wyldbloom which had sprouted in the royal gardens. Even though he had been born in [Raikkon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Raikkon "Universe:Raikkon"), Xin Zhao confessed he felt like an outsider in Ionia having been gone so long. Kennen offered Xin Zhao wisdom and also invited him toward the Kinkou temple, where the Seneschal planted his Wyldbloom sapling on the mountain.[[3]](#cite_note-Pilgrimage-3)

As Kennen and Xin Zhao were meditating near the peak, they heard a noise of a [demonic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demon "Universe:Demon") incursion into Koeshin. As Xin Zhao went to fight the evil spirits, Kennen left to inform Masters  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") and  [Mayym](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mayym "Universe:Mayym"). After speaking with Shen, Kennen returned to find Xin Zhao had defeated the demonkin with the help of  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara"), who had left her post at the Temple of Twilight to fight the demons. In the distance, they heard the temple had been breached by an  [unknown invader](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Atakhan "Universe:Atakhan").[[4]](#cite_note-4)

#### Trials of Twilight

As they were leaving for the Temple of Twilight,  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao") experienced a [dark vision](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Beginning_of_the_End "Universe:Beginning of the End") of his  [home kingdom](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") in ruins, and he demanded to know what he and the  [Kinkou](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") were up against. As the Seneschal had helped defeat the [demonkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demon "Universe:Demon"), Kennen and  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara") decided Xin Zhao could be trusted, and they informed him [the truth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Truth "Universe:The Truth") of what had transpired in  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") during the [Great Darkin War](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Darkin_War "Universe:Great Darkin War"). Kennen and Yunara both believed the  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin") were behind the attack and that they intended to free  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen") from his prison in the Temple of Twilight.[[2]](#cite_note-Truth-2)

Although Kennen had been ready to lead all the Kinkou acolytes into the temple, they found it had already retreated back to the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_Realm "Universe:Spirit Realm"). This meant only two people at most could enter at once, and they would have to undergo the Trials of Twilight. After learning this, Kennen assigned the acolytes to equip Xin Zhao with  [new armor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xin_Zhao/Cosmetics "Xin Zhao/Cosmetics") and a repaired spear, and he opened the portal to the Spirit Realm so he and Yunara would be able to make it back safely.[[2]](#cite_note-Truth-2)

### Discharging the Raishai Acolytes

:   *Main article: [Between Light and Shadows](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Between_Light_and_Shadows "Universe:Between Light and Shadows")*

Kennen receives an urgent plea for help from the acolytes of the [Temple of Raishai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Temple_of_Raishai "Universe:Temple of Raishai"), on the southern coast of [Zhyun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zhyun "Universe:Zhyun"), whose temple has been corrupted by an [unknown malevolent force](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demon "Universe:Demon"). As he races through varied landscapes, Kennen reflects on the weight of this mission, especially since it involves saving his fellow Kinkou members.

Arriving at the temple, Kennen discovers that the corruption lies not in the physical structure but within the acolytes themselves. They have become vessels for dark entities, fueled by their anguish and despair over the Kinkou's past decisions of non-intervention during times of conflict. Despite their loyalty to the order, their unresolved emotions have allowed these malevolent forces to take hold.

In a poignant moment, Kennen confronts the acolytes, gently revealing the truth of their condition and offering them a path to healing by releasing them from their Kinkou duties. However, some of the acolytes resist, seeing this as a dishonorable act and challenging Kennen. Using his lightning powers, Kennen incapacitates those who resist, not with the intent to harm but to break through their defenses and help them understand the necessity of leaving the order for their own well-being. Through his actions, Kennen not only dispels the immediate threat but also offers the acolytes a chance to find peace and balance once more.

As the former acolytes depart, Kennen reflects on the bittersweet nature of their departure, knowing that it was necessary for their own good and the greater harmony of the world. Despite the sorrow of parting ways, Kennen is resolved to carry their story forward, honoring their sacrifice and ensuring that their struggles are not forgotten.
structure.appearance: Kennen is a cream furred yordle with light brown hair and deep blue eyes. Usually he dresses in a purple ninja outfit with golden details.
structure.personality:
Kennen is a paradoxical being, due to his nature as a Yordle. Simultaneously an ancient being and a unaging spirit, Kennen can shift from a wise master to excitable and childlike in an instant.

When he first arrived on the Mortal Plane, Kennen became fascinated with humans and how they managed to do so much in so little time. After joining the Kinkou Order, Kennen took the responsability of recording the history of the Kinkou, and serving as the mediator of conflicts between the Mortal and Spiritual Planes.
structure.abilities:
- **Yordle Physiology:** Kennen is a Yordle, a being coming from the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm") and possesses several abilities natural of his species.
  - **Immortality:** Being spiritual beings, Yordles don't age the same way as normal humans, and they can't normally die.
  - **Yordle Magic:** Just like any [Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), Kennen is capable of performing yordle magic, which he utilizes in tandem with his skills as a ninja.
- **Electric Magic:** Befitting his title as the Heart of The Tempest. Kennen is a master in electric magic. He can wield electricity from small sparks to immense waves of lightning. Kennen's connection to the powers of the storm is such that he can summon massive electric storms, capable of destroying entire armies, and create a ball of electricity that managed to hurt even  [Sion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion") and bring the juggernaut temporarily down.
  - **Electric Conduction:** One of his main methods of attack is charging his electric power in his shuriken to increase their destructive power, he can also use this same technique to link target to a powerful electric discharge
  - **Flight:** By letting the power of lightning flow through him, Kennen can fly in the air at great speeds, crossing the continent of Ionia in a few hours.
- **Kinkou Order Techniques:** Kennen has been trained in the techniques of the Kinkou order for a thousand of years, and has mastered and become a teacher of them himself, even creating some of them. Being a skilled ninja and fighter, Kennen can dominate much larger opponents, run at great speeds without being seem, use stealth to hide from danger, and master several different weapons.

relations.relationship_description: Kennen,  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali"), and  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") are members of the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order"). Like  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"), his duty is to preserve balance in  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia").

**Kennen** was one of  [Akali's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali "Akali") mentors, teaching her shuriken techniques, and emphasizing speed and agility over strength. He convinced her mother Mayym, the previous Fist of Shadow, to choose her as the successor. Kennen and  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") assisted  [Irelia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Irelia "Universe:Irelia") alongside  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo") and  [Karma](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Karma "Universe:Karma") in her resistance in a seaside village against the  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") army that includes  [Sion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion").

The  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") is at war with  [Zed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zed "Universe:Zed") and his  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"). Kennen is willing to forgive the Master of Shadows should he be willing to seek redemption.[[5]](#cite_note-5)
Kennen is a friend of  [Teemo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Teemo "Universe:Teemo").

structure.trivia:
- Kennen is an ancient being, having arrived in  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") millennia ago.
- *The Heart of the Tempest*s duty is to maintain the balance the *Eye of Twilight* and the *Fist of Shadow* as well as communicate the judgments of the order to those affected by them

structure.name: Nilah
structure.quote: *"Bliss in life, and bliss forever after."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Though her original name is unknown, the girl who would become Nilah was born to a large family in  [Kathkan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kathkan "Universe:Kathkan"); a nation that saw relative peace and no need for warriors after the fall of their violent neighbor  [Camavor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Camavor "Universe:Camavor"). Growing up as a bookworm, the girl became obsessed with reading about the many stories and legends of Kathkani mythology including the fall of Camavoran king  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego"), the creation of the first [dragons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Dragon "Dragon") and the [origin of the universe](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Creation_of_the_Universe "Creation of the Universe"). She was particularly interested in a story called *The Cycle of Ashlesh*, which told of a primordial [demon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Demon "Demon") named  [Ashlesh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ashlesh "Ashlesh") that consumed the extreme forms of joy. According to the legends, the demon was struck down by the [gods](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial "Celestial") when it tried to consume their [realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Celestial_Realm "Celestial Realm"), being imprisoned in a lake within the seventh layer of the Kathkani underworld and guarded by a secret order of heroes.[[1]](#cite_note-NilahBio-1)

The girl was obsessed with finding this mythical order to stand among them as an equal and learn the truths behind the myths. By deciphering the many riddles within the stories of Ashlesh, the girl discovered that the order was hidden right underneath the heart of the Kathkani capital and set out to find them.[[1]](#cite_note-NilahBio-1)

When the girl delved into the heart of the Kathkani capital to search for the order, she went missing and completely disappeared from all public knowledge. Evidence of the girl's existence faded away as written records of her true name evaporated and she faded away from the collective memory of Runeterra. [[1]](#cite_note-NilahBio-1)

#### Reemergence from the Seventh Layer

After ten years, the girl resurfaced and adopted a new name; *Nilah,* named after the legendary river of fate in Kathkani mythology. It's unknown what exactly transpired over those ten years, but some theorize that Nilah found and trained with the mythical order of heroes while others believe she battled the demon Ashlesh for ten years in the darkness. Some even believe that the girl never even reemerged at all and that Nilah is actually a demonic pretender wearing her flesh as a disguise. Nonetheless, Nilah reemerged with an imprisoned Ashlesh granting her both new abilities and a curse of perpetual joy suppressing all other emotions.[[1]](#cite_note-NilahBio-1)

With newfound supernatural strength and a  [liquid blade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nilah#Formless_Blade "Nilah") formed by the power of Ashlesh, Nilah set off on a legendary quest to slay the greatest threats of myths she read about as a child. On her conquest, Nilah faced many foes such as the progenitor dragon Grandmother Viper, the demon of change Imago and the mad demigod Nabavelicus. With the powers of Ashlesh, Nilah faced greater and greater evils that could threaten the safety of her homeland in a flurry of water and color. In doing so, Nilah slowly grew as a legendary hero and monster hunter, hoping to make her name remembered by all that witness her great deeds.[[1]](#cite_note-NilahBio-1)

### Modern History

#### Viego's Imprisonment

After the [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sentinels_of_Light "Sentinels of Light") defeated Viego, they imprisoned him within Camavor's capital city of Alovedra and bound him in Hallowed Mist placed by  [Gwen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gwen "Universe:Gwen").[[2]](#cite_note-2) Nilah noticed Viego's imprisonment from Kathkan and discovered that the magic binding Viego to his prison had begun to fade. Viego's [Ruination magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruination_of_Helia "Ruination of Helia") had adverse side effects that induces a frenzy-like state in all demons, potentially waking up Ashlesh's primordial demon siblings. Discovering this, Nilah sailed westward to find the Sentinels of Light, hoping they can help her find a way to keep Viego imprisoned.[[1]](#cite_note-NilahBio-1)

Traveling across the [Guardian's Sea](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Guardian%27s_Sea "Guardian's Sea"), Nilah arrived in  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater") seemingly overnight and instantly began slaying giant sea serpents around the port city. Word quickly spread about her strange arrival and amazing feats as she became a celebrity monster hunter. Asking around Bilgewater for information about the Sentinels, she eventually rented out a room above Oyster Bill's Oyster Shack. While living at the shack, she would often get into dazzling fights with troublesome monsters or locals, such as a rowdy band of  [Noxians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") that knocked over her bowl of oysters.[[3]](#cite_note-3)

#### Confronting Malcolm Graves

At some point, Nilah learned about the infamous thief  [Malcolm Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Graves "Universe:Graves"), who was one of the Sentinels that helped imprison Viego. Fearing the strange and foreign monster hunter and unsure what she wanted with him, Graves spent weeks avoiding Nilah but eventually faced her in Oyster Bill's Oyster Shack.

While challenging him in combat, Nilah tried interrogating him about Viego and his imprisonment. Graves insisted that Nilah was better off asking his former Sentinel leader  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna") and proceeded to fire his gun  [New Destiny](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Graves#New_Destiny "Graves") at her. As she narrowly avoided it by hiding in a veil of  [magical mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nilah#Jubilant_Veil "Nilah"), their fight was interrupted as a group of mercenaries entered the tavern with some 2 [deep eaters](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Sea_Scarab "LoR:Sea Scarab"). The mercenaries sought to collect the bounty on Nilah's head placed by their bosses, who were unhappy with the effects Nilah had on their serpent-hunting business. However, Nilah looked past the mercenaries and instead became interested in fighting the deep eaters, which she easily slew. After defeating the mercenaries and their monsters, Graves asked Nilah why she was so interested in Viego as she revealed that the magic keeping him imprisoned has begun fading. Graves explained that the Sentinels actually disbanded shortly after Viego's defeat and that he'd already pawned off his Sentinel gear. Knowing that Graves had no more information to give her, Nilah returned to her room to rest and continue her quest another day.[[4]](#cite_note-:0-4)[[5]](#cite_note-5)

### Possible Future

After learning of a new monstrous threat in the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") called the  [Volibear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volibear "Universe:Volibear"), Nilah saw a perfect opportunity to test her skills once more. Setting off for a distant journey to the north, Nilah gathered a crew of fellow Kathkani monster-hunters and departed Bilgewater on her vessel 6 [the Tidedancer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Tidedancer "LoR:The Tidedancer").[[6]](#cite_note-6)

#### Encountering Iascylla

While sailing towards the north, Nilah and her crew faced off against an ancient sea monster named 6 [Iascylla](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Iascylla,_Figurehead_of_the_Deep "LoR:Iascylla, Figurehead of the Deep"), also known as the *Figurehead of the Deep.* As Nilah sought to face more beasts on her journey to the Volibear, she gladly fought against Iascylla alongside her crew.[[7]](#cite_note-7) Though Iascylla proved as a worthy foe, the Tidedancer eventually sailed close to the port city of  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and gained the attention of the spirit goddess  [Janna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Janna "Universe:Janna"), who used her powers over the winds to dispel Iascylla, protecting Nilah and pushing her away from the shores of Piltover.[[8]](#cite_note-8)

#### Battle With the Volibear

After leaving Piltover, Nilah continued sailing to the Freljord and landed on the shores of [Lokfar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lokfar "Lokfar"). From there, Nilah traveled further north to a treacherous mountain pass where the [Ursine](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ursine "Ursine"), Volibear's most loyal followers, resided and offered blood sacrifices.[[9]](#cite_note-9) Finally facing off against the Volibear himself, the two engaged in brutal combat as Nilah personally challenged him to a duel, insulting Volibear as he saw her as a 'puny girl' with feeble power. The two battled as a violent storm raged and shattered stone mountains, which Nilah used to her advantage as she leapt across floating masses of rock.[[10]](#cite_note-10)

#### Meeting The Veiled Lady

After the battle, Nilah traveled to  [Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Targon "Universe:Targon") and met with  [Morgana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Morgana "Universe:Morgana"). Bruised and bleeding after their battle with the Volibear, Nilah and her crew were welcomed in the Veiled Lady's sanctuary, who tended to their wounds and offered them a place to rest from their long journey. Morgana was eager to hear the story of Nilah's adventures across Runeterra, but was interrupted by a group of [Mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers") who sought out runaway mages outcasted from  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia").

#### Seeking Mordekaiser

At some point, Nilah seeks out the undead revenant  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser"), who has been banished to his own personal death realm of [Mitna Rachnun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mitna_Rachnun "Universe:Mitna Rachnun") and bound by his armor currently residing within the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Immortal_Bastion "Immortal Bastion") of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). Though it's unclear what she exactly wants with Mordekaiser, it's implied that she seeks to defeat him as part of her many heroic adventures to slay mythical foes. Nilah first faces 4 [Lord Mallat](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Lord_Mallat "LoR:Lord Mallat"), a servant of Mordekaiser as well as a 8 [member](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Incisive_Tactician "LoR:Incisive Tactician") of the secretive [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Black_Rose "Black Rose"), who were initially responsible for sealing Mordekaiser to his armor. After defeating Lord Mallat, Nilah captures and interrogates him on how to bring Mordekaiser out so that she and her crew may defeat him with the power of Ashlesh. [[11]](#cite_note-11)
structure.appearance:
Nilah is a tall and slender woman with dark skin and an athletic, lanky physique. Her hair is black in color, very long, and braided into two pigtails that meet at the bottom of her back in the shape of a circle. Her eyes are of a violet color that gets brighter when she uses her powers. Due to her curse, she has an almost permanent smile on her face that is seen as somewhat unsettling and even intimidating.

Nilah wears a yellow tunic, baggy dark purple pants with red ropes details adorning it and a brown glove on her right hand and a two-fingers black glove on her left hand. She has two earrings in the shape of large blue orbs on her ears and her left earring connects to a nose ring by a silver chain. Her outfit has many intricate details made of a dark silvery metal and styled with lots of hand imagery, something that ties her back to her home culture of Kathkan. On her hip she has a metal trinket shaped like two hands holding a bright blue orb made of glass and filled with prismatic water; the prison for the demon Ashlesh.
structure.personality:
When Nilah was a young girl she was a shy bookworm constantly daydreaming about the many stories and myths she would read. She took a particular interest in the Cycle of Ashlesh and obsessed over finding the mystical order of heroes that the story spoke of. Having immense knowledge on the many myths of Kathkani culture, she was capable of discovering Ashlesh's prison the Kathkani capital and delved into it in search of knowledge and to become a hero alongside them.

Nilah was very different after her ten year absence; now cursed by Ashlesh with a permanent feeling of intense joy and the suppression of any other emotion. Nilah is actually aware of the emotions that are being suppressed but she cannot outwardly express them, such as how she laments the sorrow of having her very existence erased from her homeland. Despite this, she is a fearless heroine always aiming to save the helpless, especially her homeland. She is incredibly confident and obsessed with slaying giant foes both to reenact the many myths she read as a child as well as to test her own strength.

Nilah speaks with a consistently upbeat tone and happily recites many mantras and prayers from Kathkani culture even in the middle of combat. She has a signature laugh that is known to echo throughout the battlefield whenever she fights a foe.
structure.abilities:
- **[Demonic Bonding:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nilah#Joy_Unending "Nilah")** Nilah is in command of the many abilities of  [Ashlesh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ashlesh "Ashlesh"), one of the ten primordial [demons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Demon "Demon") and the Lord of Joy in Kathkani mythology. She utilizes many abilities granted by Ashlesh, but is cursed with an eternal feeling of joy suppressing all other emotions.
  - **Emotional Feeding:** Like other Demons, Ashlesh feeds itself with emotion, specifically joy. By absorbing the joy of others, Ashlesh, and by extension Nilah, can sustain themselves for prolonged periods of time. To keep from being completely consumed by Ashlesh, Nilah must recite mantras and prayers to keep the demon's influence at bay.
  - **[Water Magic:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nilah#Apotheosis "Nilah")** By drawing on the waters of Ashlesh's prison, Nilah can magically manipulate water in a variety of ways. She has shown abilities ranging from summoning currents to crash into enemies, creating a  [liquid blade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nilah#Formless_Blade "Nilah") out of Ashlesh's magical waters or even shrouding herself in a  [mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nilah#Jubilant_Veil "Nilah") to make her immune to harm.
    - **[Waterwalking:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nilah#Slipstream "Nilah")** Nilah is capable of easily treading across bodies of water as if they were solid ground, capable of sliding, running and jumping when on water.
- **Enhanced Strength and Agility:** When Nilah returned from her ten year absence, she inexplicably possessed a more wiry acrobatic strength after bonding with Ashlesh. She has easily taken down many giant foes without any lethal damage thanks to her capabilities in dodging dangerous attacks with her acrobatics as well as striking enemies with immense strength with her Urumi.
- **[Urumi Proficiency:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nilah#Formless_Blade "Nilah")** Nilah is able to create a formless blade, also known as an [Urumi](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urumi), out of Ashlesh's waters. As her primary weapon in battle, she shows great skill in utilizing it to strike giant foes with immense strength and power.
- **Mythology Mastery:** Since she was a child, Nilah had an immense knowledge on the many myths, legends and stories of Kathkani culture and possibly many other parts of Runeterra. Her knowledge of these many legends has given her a good basis on where to find great mythological foes she wishes to battle.

relations.relationship_description: Nilah initially read stories about Viego's fall and the eventual collapse of  [Camavor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Camavor "Universe:Camavor") in books and myths. After Viego got imprisoned in Alovedra, his influence threatened Kathkan and drew Nilah's attention. She's more concerned with the implications of his ruination magic and how it affects [demons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Demon "Demon"), as Viego's ruinations causes them to go into mad frenzies and could potentially wake up the remaining primordial demons. Discovering Viego's imprisonment is what caused Nilah to travel westward in search of the legendary Sentinels of Light.[[4]](#cite_note-:0-4)

Nilah is on an quest to keep Viego from breaking free in order to save her homeland and stop his ruinations from reawakening the ten primordial demons. To do this, she needs the aid of the legendary Sentinels of Light, whom she only read about in stories.

#### [Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Graves "Universe:Graves")

Nilah encountered Graves in Oyster Bill's Oyster Shack, tracking him down after asking around  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater") for information regarding the Sentinels of Light. Her investigation lead her to Graves, who she fought in an attempt to get information and convince him to help her on her quest. Its revealed that the Sentinels of Light actually disbanded shortly after defeating Viego, as Graves already pawned off his Sentinel gear away.

Nilah regards Graves as a friend and fellow hero of legend. Though its unclear whether or not Graves also regards Nilah as a friend, he has shown to be mostly freaked out by her, intimidated by the encounter but also intrigued as he sees her as a 'neat lady.'[[4]](#cite_note-:0-4)

Fiddlesticks is one of the ten primordial demons that Nilah is concerned with keeping asleep. It is the eldest sibling of Ashlesh, the same demon that Nilah encountered and keeps trapped within a jar on her hip. Though Nilah recognizes Fiddlesticks, as well as all of the primordial demons, as a threat to the world, she is supremely confident in her ability to fight them back utilizing the power of Ashlesh.[[12]](#cite_note-12)

Oyster Bill is an oyster-man in Bilgewater who owns Oyster Bill's Oyster Shack. While gaining status as a famous sea-monster hunter in Bilgewater, she rented out a spare room in the shack and currently resides there. Oyster Bill often tells stories about Nilah and her amazing feats to the visitors of his shack, even allowing visitors to speak to her if they wish.[[13]](#cite_note-:1-13)

structure.trivia:
- Nilah comes from Kathkan, a country on the same eastern continent as  [Camavor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Camavor "Universe:Camavor").[[14]](#cite_note-14)
- Nilah is currently staying in  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater"), renting out the spare room above Oyster Bill's Oyster Shack.[[15]](#cite_note-15)
- Nilah is something similar to an [Aspect Host](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aspect_Host "Aspect Host"), the difference being that her power source is an inhuman & extremely evil monster rather than a Celestial entity. [[16]](#cite_note-16)
- Nilah's outfit features seven hands, in reference to Ashlesh.
- 'Nilah' may come from the South Asian language Telugu, where నీళ్ళు (pronounced NEE-loo) means "water".
- 'Nilah' may come from the South Asian language Tamil, where நிலா (pronounced NIL-ah) means "moon".

structure.name: Qiyana
structure.quote: *"Some day, all this will be Ixaocan. A glorious empire, with an empress to fit."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Qiyana was born into the royal family of Ixaocan, the Yunalai, being the last of her nine sisters in the line of succession and grew up thinking that the throne would never be hers. Wishing to know what her role would be in her family and her place in Ixaocan.

Qiyana was educated in the elemental magical arts of  [Ixtal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ixtal "Universe:Ixtal"), she proved to be one of the best students of her time and not only that but at a very early age she mastered powerful techniques and spells that her older sisters were still struggling to achieve. Seeing the potential within her, Qiyana began to believe that the throne of Yun Tal should be hers.

### Contemporary history

As she grew, Qiyana's magical powers increased enormously, being able to perfectly master three types of elemental magic, Earth, Water and Nature. With her powers, her pride grew more and more, proclaiming herself as the Empress of the Elements.

As time went by, Qiyana began to try to get her parents' attention because she wanted to prove herself and was scandalized when they chose one of her sisters and not her. Inessa, her older sister, clashed with her the most, having very heated arguments until it got to the point where Inessa challenged Qiyana to a ritual combat to teach her sister some humility.

The battle was fierce but finally Qiyana not only emerged victorious but also left Inessa paraplegic. Qiyana expected her reward but her parents were horrified by how she left her sister and refused to give her her reward. Qiyana was quite hurt and resentful by her parents' response, but then she realized that the entire town of Ixaocan was quite impressed with her powers, giving her one of the things she most wanted to have, respect.

#### Massacre of the Piltovan miners

However, Qiyana was not satisfied with recognition from all of Ixaocan. She needed the entire world to know the strength of her city, and more importantly, herself. Qiyana was disgusted by the increasing number of foreign visitors coming to their jungles to drain the land of its natural resources. She believed that if she showed them Ixtal's elemental might, these foreigners would run away in terror, and in her parents' court she proposed a plan of action against the "outlanders".

Qiyana's parents did not approve, of course, stating that making contact with the miners could destroy Ixacoan's hidden, isolationist position in Runeterra, inviting war, disease, and hatred, putting hundreds of years of peace in jeopardy. But Qiyana didn't care what they had to say and disobeyed her parents' orders, raiding a Piltovan mining site, destroying it and killing all the workers but one. She let the last miner go, and told him to spread the message of the elementalist sorceress who destroyed the mine. When she returned, Qiyana told everyone about the massacre, much to her parents' fury, as Qiyana's actions only caused the Piltovans to send even more miners and soldiers to the jungle.

#### Imprisonment and Release

Her parents, full of sadness, were forced to imprison their daughter in the dungeons of Ixaocan to decide how to punish her for the crime she committed against the kingdom. But before her trial began the elementalists of the high court spoke on Qiyana's behalf, stating that, while her actions were reckless, she was one of the most powerful elementalists Ixaocan had ever known. And that it would be foolish to keep her locked up and instead, she should be appointed to defend the city. In addition to the fact that the entire city was full of people who admired Qiyana's skill and talent and that she could inspire them to greatness, this made her parents reluctantly agree to release her but not before making her swear that she would not challenge them again.

#### Becoming Prefect of Tikras
structure.appearance:
Qiyana is a young and attractive Ixtali woman with tanned skin and wavy shoulder-length white hair. She has a round face and button nose, and Amber Eyes. She is of short and curvaceous stature, with a trim waist, broad hips, and pronounced thighs.

She wears a strapless blue-green dress with a black midsection, detailed all over in gold. On her lower half she wears black leggings and a pair of open-toed sandals. She lavishes her appearance with jewellery and makeup, wearing a golden tiara, bracelets on her wrists and upper arms, and a necklace, all of which are inlaid with large green gems. Her eyes are decorated with golden-green eye shadow, and her nails are also painted in her signature green.
structure.personality:
Though she does possess the skill to back it up, Qiyana is a proud and arrogant woman who brags often and loudly for all to hear about her prowess with elemental magic, her ostentatious nature reflected even in her choice of attire. She thinks very highly of herself and is fully convinced she deserves the throne regardless of her place in the line of succession.

She is extremely competitive, proactive, and determined. When challenged by her older sister Inessa to ritual combat, Qiyana displayed a ruthless side by not only rising to the challenge but crippling her sister in the fight to assert how seriously she takes her desire to rise to the top and ultimately become Empress.
structure.abilities:
- **[Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Qiyana was born with natural magical abilities, which can grow the more she trains and expands her knowledge about magic. Qiyana is a natural prodigy in the elemental magics of [Ixtal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ixtal "Ixtal"), proven to be one of the most powerful elementalists in Ixtal. Since childhood, Qiyana has managed to master the most advanced elemental techniques where her sisters struggled to grasp the basics. The most unique part of Qiyana's special talent in elemental magic is that she has learned to master not just a single element, as most of the Yun Tal do, but rather she has mastered  [three](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Qiyana#Royal_Privilege "Qiyana"). Albeit a quote in game might hint at her struggling with fire, this is not a fact backed up by lore, especially given that she wields magma, the explosions in the ability hinting at the usage of fire.
  - **[Water Axiom:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Qiyana#Terrashape_River "Qiyana")** By manipulating water, Qiyana is capable of infusing her weapon with water magic, allowing her to toss out small waves and instantly freeze it to create ice. With this, she can throw out shards of ice at her opponents or freeze them in place.
  - **[Magma Axiom](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Qiyana#Terrashape_Rock "Qiyana")** By manipulating magma and rocks, Qiyana is capable of infusing her weapon with magma magic, allowing her to toss heated stones at her opponents to deal immense damage and cause huge explosions.
  - **[Nature Axiom](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Qiyana#Terrashape_Brush "Qiyana")** By manipulating plants, Qiyana is capable of infusing her weapon with nature magic, allowing her to manipulate grass to restrain enemies and grow large bushes to camouflage her.
- **[Ohmlatl Proficiency:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Qiyana#Edge_of_Ixtal "Qiyana")** Qiyana's primary weapon used in combat is an *ohmlatl*, a traditional ring-shaped Ixtali blade capable of acting as a medium for Qiyana's elemental magic, allowing her to infuse it with magical properties. Qiyana wields it with ease, capable of spinning and tossing it with acrobatic strength.
- **Combat Mastery:** Qiyana is a well versed fighter, especially in ritualistic Ixtali combat. She expressed this during her initial attempt to claim the title of empress within the Yun Tal, challenging her eldest sister Inessa in combat, easily defeating and crippling her.

relations.relationship_description:
Qiyana's parents neglected her due to her being the youngest of her 9 sisters, and thus furthest from [the throne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yun_Tal "Yun Tal").[[1]](#cite_note-1) As a result of her parent's preferential treatment, Qiyana does not have a good relationship with her siblings.

Inessa, the eldest daughter and 12 years Qiyana's senior, sought to humble her by besting her in ritual combat, but was instead defeated and crippled. Mara, the youngest of Qiyana's elder sisters, conceded her prefectship over Tikras after Qiyana exposed the hidden paths between villages in [Ixtal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ixtal "Ixtal"). The [Piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Piltover "Piltover") raid that followed killed about half the populace, and nearly Mara herself. Unbeknownst to Mara, Qiyana planned the entire ordeal in order to take over as prefect, amassing additional power and support from Ixtal citizens.

structure.trivia:
- "Empress of the Elements" is a self proclaimed title Qiyana gave herself, she is only a princess in [Ixtal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ixtal "Ixtal").[[2]](#cite_note-2)
- Qiyana is 20 years old.[[3]](#cite_note-3)
  - She was 7 years old when she mastered advanced elemental techniques.
