- Mecha-Arena Fighter

structure.name: Fizz
structure.quote: *"You people can't even breathe water. You're boring."*
structure.background:
### Early life

In ages past, the oceans of Runeterra were home to civilizations far older than those of the land. In the depths of what is now the [Guardian’s Sea](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Guardian%27s_Sea "Guardian's Sea"), a great city once stood—it was here that the yordle Fizz made his home. He lived alongside the artisans and warriors of that proud, noble race. Even though he was not one of them, they treated him as an equal, and his playful nature and tall tales of adventures in the open sea made him welcome at any gathering.

But the world was changing. The oceans were growing warmer, emboldening fierce predators to rise up from the deepest trenches. Other settlements had fallen silent, but the rulers of the great city could still not agree on how to deal with the threat. Fizz pledged to roam the seas in search of survivors, or anyone who knew what had happened.

Then, one dark day, the [gigalodons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gigalodon "Gigalodon") came.

These huge dragon-sharks stunned their prey with fell shrieking, and the avenues of the great city were soon clouded red. Thousands died in a matter of hours, the immense bulk of their killers crushing towers and temples in a monstrous feeding frenzy. Scenting blood in the water, Fizz raced back, determined to join the fight and save the city.

He was too late. There was nothing left of the city to save. When the debris finally settled, not a single living creature remained, nor any stone upon another, and the ravenous shoal had moved on. Alone in the cold depths, Fizz sank into mournful despair. As his yordle magic began to fade, he let himself be carried by the currents, drifting in a catatonic torpor, dreaming away the millennia…

It was only chance that reawakened him. A handful of copper coins fell from above, scattered to the seabed in the wake of a huge, *wooden* fish that swam upon the surface. This was no gigalodon, but Fizz was alarmed nonetheless—he knew little of the world overhead, but surely no fish could survive up there? He ventured up and peered into the salty air for the first time.

There were people, people who lived outside of the water and sailed in wooden fish of all sizes. Fizz found the thought both frightening and exciting, but the curious gifts they cast into the water made it clear that they wanted to be his friends. In time, following their movements to and fro across the oceans, he came to the port city of Bilgewater.

### Becoming a Legend

To the inhabitants of that lawless place, this strange and slippery creature quickly became something of a legend—the Tidal Trickster, a spirit of the ocean itself. It is said that he can summon great beasts to do his bidding, hole a ship’s hull with his stone trident, and breathe air or water as it suits him. Many a misbehaving child has been warned on a moonless night: “Go quickly to sleep, or the Trickster will come and feed you to the fishes…”
structure.appearance:
Unlike many of his Yordle brethren, Fizz's appearance lacks any fur. Instead, he exhibits more [amphibian](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/amphibian) characteristics, with tentacles resembling [dreadlocks](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/dreadlocks) growing out of his head. Gills on the side of his torso allow him to breathe underwater, and he possesses wider arms and legs than other Yordles, featuring 3-digit hands and feet with webbing that allows for faster movement underwater. His light blue skin transitions into darker hues towards his lower body, adorned with white spots, notably on his stomach.

While Fizz's distinctive appearance is likely a result of his environment, it remains unclear why there aren't more Yordles who share his likeness. Notably, as the oldest known Yordle, predating even  [Gnar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gnar "Universe:Gnar"), Fizz maintains a form reminiscent of a "pre-continental" era, which diverges from the more common furry appearance observed in his Yordle peers.
structure.personality:
In the beginning, Fizz was a proud and headstrong warrior of a ancient aquatic civilization. Like most Yordles, Fizz was greatly attached to his civilization of choice, and dedicated his life to protect it, training to become a powerful warrior against terrible foes.

When that aquatic civilization was destroyed anyway, the trauma made Fizz sank in a despair so big that he hibernated, were he remained for centuries.

After waking up from his coma in Bilgewater. Fizz personality changed greatly. He became the trickster of Bilgewater, a strange and mercurial creature of the seas. Thought generally good natured, Fizz pranks often lead to chaos and destruction, such as the sinking of ships and massive amounts of casualties. In spite of this, Fizz often tends to help the good natured and punish those that try to abuse the oceans.
structure.abilities:
- **Yordle Physiology:** Fizz is a Yordle, a being coming from the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm") and possesses several abilities natural of his species.
  - **Immortality:** Being spiritual beings, Yordles don't age the same way as normal humans, and they can't normally die.
  - **Yordle Magic:** Just like any [Yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), Fizz is capable of performing yordle magic, which he utilizes in tandem with his skills as a trickster.
- **Amphibious Physiology:** Fizz seems to be the only Yordle that's amphibious. He can breathe both air and water without issue, swim at great speeds, and survive the intense pressures of the ocean.
  - **Sea Animal Communication:** Fizz can communicate with aquatic beings.
- **Water Magic:** Fizz is a powerful water mage, having a deep connection to the element thanks to his nature. He control the seas with playful ease, sinking entire ships without problem. He can summon water from nothing, and use it to fight his foes.
  - **Water Teleportation:** Fizz can use water to create portals to other places. He can use that as method of travel, or to summon sea animals to his aid, mainly his shark 4 [Longtooth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Longtooth "LoR:Longtooth").
- **Skilled Fighter:** Fizz is a talented fighter, being able to use his trident to bring down enemies much bigger than him.
- **Seastone Trident:** A powerful trident made of stone. It is said that Fizz can use it to break holes in the hulls of entire ships.[[1]](#cite_note-FizzBio-1)

relations.relationship_description: Fizz is friend with many creatures of the shallow sea surrounding [Serpent Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Serpent_Isles "Serpent Isles") such as 1 [Shellshocker](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Shellshocker "LoR:Shellshocker"), 2 [Coral Creatures](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Coral_Creatures "LoR:Coral Creatures"), 3 [Bubble Bear](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Bubble_Bear "LoR:Bubble Bear"), 4 [Zap Sprayfin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Zap_Sprayfin "LoR:Zap Sprayfin") and  [Longtooth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Minor_Characters "Universe:Minor Characters").
[Nautilus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nautilus "Universe:Nautilus") hates Fizz and would like to see him dead, though Fizz may not be fully aware of that fact.

Fizz and  [Nami](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nami "Universe:Nami") have a friendly relationship, occasionally playing games together or having conversations about sharks. Fizz wants to introduce her to  [Longtooth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Minor_Characters "Universe:Minor Characters").

As a legendary pirate captain,  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") has heard stories about Fizz and believes he is even more dangerous than his own cannons. Because of this, Gangplank tries to avoid him when possible.

Since they both live in the sea,  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pyke "Universe:Pyke") is all too familiar with Fizz and wishes he could be rid of him, since he reminds him of sharks.

[Teemo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Teemo "Universe:Teemo") does not seem to know Fizz, but identifies him as an "aquatic [yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle")" and takes notes on the fact that he  "throws fish."

structure.trivia:
- Fizz is a prehistoric yordle, at the very least older than 10000 years, dating back to a time when there were no massive civilizations on land.
  - He was able to survive for millennia due to hibernation and being a Yordle, a magical race that does not age.
- Before Fizz's reveal in  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra"), his shark was previously called  [Chomper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fizz#Chum_the_Waters "Fizz").[[2]](#cite_note-2) It has since been renamed to 4 [Longtooth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Longtooth "LoR:Longtooth").
- It has been theorized that Fizz's trident is the "favorite eating fork" of  [Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ornn "Universe:Ornn"), which was thrown to the bottom of the Great Sea in [The Lost Tales of Ornn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Lost_Tales_of_Ornn "Universe:The Lost Tales of Ornn"). According to legend, this trident was later found by a mer-king who still uses it to rule his kingdom,[[3]](#cite_note-OrnnTales-3) but it is unclear if this figure is meant to be Fizz.

structure.name: Malzahar
structure.quote: *"We are timeless. We demand sacrifice."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Beneath the glare of the Shuriman sun, there have always been those blessed with the power of foresight. The only son of aging trinket peddlers, Malzahar did not realize his gift until his parents had already succumbed to a wasting sickness, leaving the young, traumatized boy to fend for himself on the city streets of [Amakra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Amakra "Amakra"). He read fortunes in the gutter, for a coin or scraps of bread.

As his auguries proved more and more accurate, his reputation grew. He used his second sight to predict who a curious cameleer might marry, or where throwing daggers would land in games of chance at the bazaar. Soon, he began to receive patrons dressed not in dirtied sandals, but jeweled slippers.

However, for all this, Malzahar could never see his own destiny. His future was hidden.

Increasingly disillusioned with his success, he noted the common disparities of wealth, and witnessed those unhappy with their lives acting out in spiteful violence against one another. It was apparent to him that people were bound up in a never-ending cycle of pain, often of their own making, and no hopeful prophecy seemed able to break it. Malzahar himself soon felt nothing but a sense of emptiness, finally relinquishing his mortal possessions and leaving Amakra for good.

### Contemporary history

For years, he roamed the land, from the trackless wastes of the lesser *sai* to the ruins of old Shurima. By distancing himself from others, he was alone with his thoughts at last. He divined not just how callous people could be, but also how corrupt the world might yet become. Feverish visions began to plague his waking hours, along with otherworldly whispers of war and strife, and endless suffering.

He wandered far, until the sands turned to salt. He could not know that he had arrived in [Icathia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Icathia "Icathia"), a lost city ravaged in the wars of a bygone age. There, gazing into the depths of a ragged abyss, Malzahar opened his unsteady mind, desperate for understanding.

And the Void answered.

That would have been the end of any other tale, and yet somehow Malzahar endured. What lay in the darkness below brushed against the soul of the broken seer, only for an instant, and yet its strange and unknowable energies saturated his mind completely.

The lone figure that eventually strode out of Icathia was no longer just a man, but something greater. Malzahar had seen in the abyss an end to all the suffering he had witnessed in his mortal lifetime. Malzahar was then whispered to by  [Bel'Veth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27Veth "Universe:Bel'Veth"), the Void Empress, who granted him a vision promising the destruction of Runeterra. He realized the future he had believed hidden from him all this time was in fact a vision of his true calling: to accelerate the world toward inevitable oblivion. Malzahar devoted himself completely to the Empress's will, his mind corrupted by the touch of a higher power. He had to return to the people, and spread word of the holy nothingness that would gladly embrace them, the willing and non-believers alike. He would become the herald of the world’s salvation.

Among the nomads of the deep desert, he found his first disciples. Before their astonished eyes, he used his new Void-given powers to rend the very earth itself, summoning chittering, nightmarish creatures to carry away any who dared to deny him. Within a matter of months, strange rumors began to travel with the merchant caravans; rumors of men and women gladly sacrificing themselves to unseen powers, and of powerful quakes opening up the bedrock of Shurima in new fault lines hundreds of miles long.

gathering his followers, the Cult of the Void. Even since, rumors had been told of merchants killing themselves for their "prophet", earthquakes opening up large faults across Shurima, and settlers said to experience horrifying vision, sacrificing their cattle to satisfy the Void, Malzahar grows ever closer to bring about the apocalypse of Runeterra.

In the years since, Malzahar’s legend has spread even to the northern ports. As followers of “the Prophet” grow in number, nearby settlers are said to experience malefic visions grasping at their hearts, and fear gives rise to superstition—even the hardy villagers of the far wastes now make offerings of livestock to appease the voidling creatures below.
structure.appearance: Malzahar is a Shuriman man with dark skin and blue eyes. He dresses himself in desert clothes, with blue shirts and pants, and a pink scarf covering most of his head. His most distinctive characteristic is the top of his head, that thanks to the power of the void, reveals a grotesque hole from where void energy pulses and flows.
structure.personality:
As child, Malzahar lost his family and was forced to live alone, which gave him great sadness and also a sense of empathy towards others less fortunate. After becoming a famous fortune-teller, Malzahar took joy in helping others make choices about their futures and guiding their lives to a better path. In spite of this, he was still unhappy, as his experiences with others made him see more and more of human misery. This made Malzahar lose hope in humanity, which led to him come to Icathia and embrace the Void.

As The Prophet Of the Void, Malzahar is fanatically devoted to the powers of the Void, regularly sacrifing entire cities to the Void.
structure.abilities:
- **[Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Malzahar was born with powerful magical psychic abilities. This mainly manifested in his ability to see the future, which he used to live as a fortune-teller, revealing the future of others. He was also able to feel the call to [the Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Void "The Void"). After being touched by the Void, he is also able to force others to see visions. He mainly uses this to submit them to terrible visions that break the minds of others. He also demonstrated the ability to levitate.
- **[Void adaptation](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Void "Void"):** Malzahar was touched by the Void, which changed his nature into a new strange form, and granted him many powers that few others in Runeterra have. He can survive in Void-infested areas, commune with [the Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidborn "Voidborn"), and developed strange mutations, the more obvious one being the center of his head that seems to have become a hole were void energy constantly pulses.
  - **Energy Manipulation:** Malzahar can freely manipulate raw Void energy, mainly in the form of destructive blasts of power. He also seems to be capable of creating forces fields of this energy, or control the direction of the energy to bring devastation to foes.
  - **Portal Making:** Malzahar can open portals to the Void and let it's influence fester in the physical realm.
  - **Summoning:** With his powers, Malzahar can call fourth Voidborns to do his bidding. This Voidborns are mainly voidlings.

relations.relationship_description: Even though Malzahar (and  [Kassadin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kassadin "Universe:Kassadin")) are both [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima") their ties to [the Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Void "The Void") directs all their focus to the ancient city of [Icathia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Icathia "Icathia") and what lies within it.

Malzahar might be attempting to make Icathia rise again just like  [Azir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir") did with the Ancient Shuriman capital. It is uncertain whether or not he is aware of the  [rise](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir")  [of](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath")  [the](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus")  [Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renekton "Universe:Renekton"). Even if so, making way for the Voidborn takes precedence over a handful of actually mortal demigods that can be overrun by infinite hordes anyway.

Malzahar in turn lured  [Kog'Maw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kog%27Maw "Universe:Kog'Maw") into [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Runeterra "Runeterra"). It could be speculated the hivemind entity is the Mouth of the Abyss' 'Daddy', the 'Terror who is coming'. In short  [Kog'Maw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kog%27Maw "Universe:Kog'Maw") might be foreshadowing a cataclysm on an interdimensional scale so large the Rune Wars will seem a children's brawl in comparison.

[Bel'Veth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27Veth "Universe:Bel'Veth") is Malzahar's master, helping him in his goal to bring the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void") to  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra") in exchange for him providing her with sacrifices to assimilate.

structure.trivia:
- Malzahar's story may be referencing [Abdul Alhazred](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abdul_Alhazred) from the [Cthulhu Mythos](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cthulhu_Mythos) by [H. P. Lovecraft](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/H._P._Lovecraft).
- The "eye" in his forehead is a physical manifestation of Malzahar's connection with the Void.

titles.alias:
- The Prophet of the Void
- The Prophet

structure.name: Zed
structure.quote: *"Balance is a fool's master."*
structure.background:
### Early life

The master assassin who would become known as Zed was born as **Govos** to a peasant family. When he was four years old, his father abandoned his family.[[1]](#cite_note-Zed6-1) Govos spent his days working at the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order")'s Monastery, dreaming of becoming a legendary warrior, though few ever spoke to him. One evening, Master  [Kusho](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kusho "Universe:Kusho"), the Eye of Twilight, took pity on him and invited him to spar with his son,  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"). Though Shen easily won each bout, the boy continued to rise and demand rematches. Watching closely, Kusho offered guidance on how to counter Shen's strikes, until Govos finally managed to land a hit. Impressed by his determination, Kusho took Govos under his wing.[[2]](#cite_note-Zed4-2) Shen and Govos trained together thereafter, growing as close as brothers.[[3]](#cite_note-ShenBio-3) Govos's mother searched for him at the monastery and begged him to return, but he refused to acknowledge her and allowed her to be dragged away.[[1]](#cite_note-Zed6-1)

### Hunt for the Golden Demon

Two years after Govos had been taken in by Kusho,[[4]](#cite_note-Zed1-4) the Council of Zhyun sent an envoy to Great Master Kusho begging for aid in stopping the infamous killer known as the  [Golden Demon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin"). Kusho agreed, taking Govos and  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") with him, and began a covert investigation. Together, they tended to families shattered by the killings, dissected the horrific crime scenes, and looked for connections between the murders.[[5]](#cite_note-JhinBio-5)

As they made their way to Kotha Village, Shen and Govos spoke about how Shen's father had arranged for him to marry Yevnai. Shen was nervous, though he loved Yevnai, he was unsure whether she felt the same way, but Govos reassured him that she did. When they came upon the town, they found it massacred by the demon. They tried to tend to the survivors, and Govos worked desperately to save as many lives as he could, but the scale of the carnage shook him to his core. When they were finished, Kusho tried to comfort Govos and imparted to him the lesson of the scales: sometimes you must lose one to save the many. Impressed by his resolve, Kusho named Govos his successor as the Eye of Twilight and granted him a new name, **Usan**.[[4]](#cite_note-Zed1-4)

Their investigation spanned four long years, leaving all three men changed.  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"), once known for his wit and humor, grew increasingly somber; Usan, the brightest star of Kusho's temple, began to struggle with his studies; and Kusho's famous red mane turned white. When Kusho finally discovered a pattern in the killings, he realized they were not hunting a demon, but a wicked man or vastaya. Believing the matter to be beyond the Kinkou's mandate, he sought to hand off the investigation. However, Shen and Usan refused to turn back after all they had endured, and convinced him to continue.[[5]](#cite_note-JhinBio-5)

Three years into the investigation,[[6]](#cite_note-Zed2-6) on the eve of the Spirit Blossom Festival in Jyom Pass, Kusho disguised himself as a renowned calligrapher to blend in among the visiting artists, while  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") and Usan carefully prepared a trap.[[5]](#cite_note-JhinBio-5) Usan chased the Golden Demon through the harbor, but was ultimately ambushed and knocked unconscious. When Usan awoke, the murderer revealed that he had lured Shen's fiancée Yevnai to the festival and had prepared an array of traps to turn her into his next masterpiece. Unbeknownst to Shen, Usan and Yevnai had developed feelings for one another, and the demon penned a letter to her under his name, inviting her to meet him.[[6]](#cite_note-Zed2-6)

Desperate, Usan begged for her life and revealed that the amulet he carried allowed his master to track him. As the demon prepared for his performance, Shen burst through the wall to save Usan, revealing that he had intentionally allowed himself to be captured as bait. Usan seized one of the killer's blades and attempted to strike him down, but Kusho intervened, insisting they take the killer back alive.[[6]](#cite_note-Zed2-6)

In the aftermath, Kusho was proven right, and the so-called demon was revealed to be a human stagehand named  [Khada Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin"). Kusho decided that Jhin should be imprisoned within the monastery prison at Tuula.[[5]](#cite_note-JhinBio-5) While both  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") and Usan believed Jhin deserved a far harsher punishment, Shen accepted his father's judgment and attempted to comfort a bitter and resentful Usan.[[3]](#cite_note-ShenBio-3) Usan, however, was deeply disturbed and haunted by the horrors he had witnessed. Unable to understand or accept their master's mercy,[[5]](#cite_note-JhinBio-5) resentment took root within him, and hatred bloomed in his heart.[[7]](#cite_note-ZedBio-7)

### Rise of the Order of Shadow

When  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") began its invasion of the First Lands, Masters  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen"),  [Kusho](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kusho "Universe:Kusho"), and  [Mayym](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mayym "Universe:Mayym") ruled to not involve the Kinkou in the war.[[8]](#cite_note-8)  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") secretly began sneaking out to train soldiers and attack enemy supply lines, while Usan helped cover for him by deliberately throwing his matches to make it appear as though Shen was keeping up with his training.[[9]](#cite_note-Zed5-9) Usan, on the other hand, had grown disillusioned and refused to let lofty notions of balance stand in the way of punishing evil. Usan ventured deep into the Kinkou temple's catacombs, where he discovered an ornate black box. When he peered inside, ancient shadow magic enveloped his mind, feeding his bitterness with contempt for the weak. Returning to the light of the temple, he came face to face with Great Master Kusho and demanded that the Kinkou strike the Noxian invaders with every means at their disposal. When Kusho refused, Usan turned his back on the order and left. Unbound by the Kinkou's doctrine, Usan raised a following of warriors to resist Noxus and urged them to embrace the fervor of war. Yet he soon realized that his own abilities would never match his ambitions.[[7]](#cite_note-ZedBio-7)

During the siege of Thanze, Usan—now calling himself **Zed**—struggled to defend the city from the encroaching Noxian army. With Noxus poised to breach the walls by morning, Zed resolved to claim the power necessary to stop them. He led his followers back to the Great Kinkou Temple of Navori in Thanjuul to confront Master Kusho, and demanded the Tears of the Shadow. Kusho refused and warned that the Tears were not of this world and were too dangerous to wield. He laid down his weapon and pleaded with his former student to walk with him to see the Tears' evil and destroy it. Zed entered the catacombs with Kusho and, by nightfall, returned alone. He claimed that he had slayed the Kinkou's master and took the black box for himself, now wielding its shadow magic.[[10]](#cite_note-Zed3-10) Zed led his followers in a bloody coup, slaughtering the Kinkou and seizing their temple, and they established themselves as the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Order "Universe:Shadow Order").[[7]](#cite_note-ZedBio-7) On the night Zed planned to return to the temple, he visited Yevnai one last time and stole a kiss from her, wishing to burn the final bridge to his old life.[[6]](#cite_note-Zed2-6)

In truth, Zed convinced Kusho to fake his death so that the Kinkou's mission could remain pure. They believed a new order had to be born to stop Noxus—one the Kinkou had to despise—so that they would not lose their honor by allying with them. With Kusho's supposed death, they were free to use the Tears' forbidden magic and allowed Kusho to take control of the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood") and guide their nation to safety from behind the scenes.[[1]](#cite_note-Zed6-1) Zed and his order etched their bodies with tattoos from the Tears' ink, allowing them to fight with dark reflections of themselves.[[7]](#cite_note-ZedBio-7)

After Noxian forces massacred Ionian defenders at the [Epool River](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Epool_River "Universe:Epool River"), Zed and the Order of Shadow came upon the grisly scene. Among the survivors was a child soldier, no more than ten years old, who leveled his blade against the master assassin. Seeing the pain and fury in the boy's eyes, Zed believed he could shape him into a weapon against those who had sent him here to die. He extended his hand and offered  [Shieda Kayn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayn "Universe:Kayn") a place within the Order of Shadow.[[11]](#cite_note-KaynBio-11)

Under Zed's tutelage, Kayn mastered every weapon the Order possessed. As his skill grew, so too did his arrogance, and he came to believe that one day he could eclipse even Zed himself. For Kayn's final test, Zed tasked him with locating a  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin") weapon recently uncovered by Noxus and preventing it from being used against the defenders of Ionia. When Kayn returned, he now wielded the Darkin scythe  [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast").[[11]](#cite_note-KaynBio-11)

When the Noxian invasion finally ended, Zed and his order reached out to the Kinkou, and though he did not reconcile with  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"), they came to an uneasy accord.[[7]](#cite_note-ZedBio-7)

### The Return of Jhin

After Master Althon opposed the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood")'s plans to expand militarization, they hired the Yánléi to assassinate him. The Brotherhood lured Althon to the statue of Master  [Kusho](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kusho "Universe:Kusho"), where Zed led  [Kayn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayn "Universe:Kayn") and the rest of his students to ambush him. Zed decided to face Althon alone and ordered his followers to stand down. After killing Althon, Zed and the Order traveled to the Kwol Tavern in Thonx to rest.[[4]](#cite_note-Zed1-4)

While Zed and Kayn discussed the mission, a woman in a rowboat approached them and told Zed that a man in a village north of here wished to speak with him. Zed initially refused, but she produced a scalpel he had once used during his days with the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order"). As she departed, Zed and Kayn were alerted that their fellow acolyte, Jovn, was causing a disturbance inside the inn. After ordering him to calm down, Zed reflected on his history with the scalpel, and how he once used it to treat the victims of Kotha Village during his hunt for  [Khada Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin").[[4]](#cite_note-Zed1-4)

Zed and his students headed north and learned that the village the woman had spoken of was the ruins of Kotha Village. As they searched for the man she claimed wished to meet with Zed, they found the corpses of two women, their faces mutilated into the shape of a flower. One of the victims was the very woman who had lured them there, the other was a woman whose leg Zed had amputated years earlier during Jhin's massacre of the town. Before even seeing the bodies, Zed knew the truth, his old enemy,  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin"), had returned.[[4]](#cite_note-Zed1-4)

Zed ordered his students to search for two more bodies, knowing that Jhin always killed in sets of four, but Jhin opened fire on them. He managed to gun down four Yánléi acolytes, before Zed vanished into the shadows to pursue him. However, Jhin escaped into the crowds of a nearby Spirit Blossom Festival.[[6]](#cite_note-Zed2-6)

#### Reuniting with Shen

Realizing he could not stop Jhin alone, Zed traveled to the Quenjo Estate to seek out his and Shen's former beloved, Yevnai. Her engagement to Shen had been called off after his father's death and she had since married Lord Quenjo. Yevnai's vastaya servant initially tried turning him away, but she invited in. He asked for her help in locating  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") so they could stop Jhin together, but she refused. As he watched Yevnai's children play, Zed noticed one of them having traces of vastayan heritage. After Zed threatened to expose her affair to her husband, Yevnai finally relented and revealed that Shen still wrote to her and had recently mentioned an inn he frequented. Before departing, Zed offered Yevnai protection within one of the Order of Shadow's temples, but she declined. While Zed feared that Jhin might target her, he believed Yevnai was more valuable to him alive, as it pained him more than death that she still lived yet no longer cared for him.[[6]](#cite_note-Zed2-6)

Zed then led his followers to the White Cliffs Inn, a place where  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") liked to stop and rest.  [Kayn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayn "Universe:Kayn") urged his master to eliminate Eye of Twilight so they could return to their work, but Zed refused, believing Shen was the only person capable of helping trap Jhin. He ordered his students to remain outside while he entered the inn alone to confront Shen.[[10]](#cite_note-Zed3-10)

After a waitress brought Shen his meal, he noticed the shadows behaving strangely and drew his spirit blade. He called out to Zed that he knew his students were here and, soon, Zed entered the inn disguised as a merchant.[[12]](#cite_note-12) Shen charged at Zed with blade, but he managed to block and evade his attacks. As they fought, Zed revealed that  [Khada Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") had escaped. Shen thought it impossible, but Zed reminded him of what he was capable of and told him that they were the only two who could stop him again. Frustrated but wary, Shen lowered his weapon to hear him out. Zed believed Jhin was setting a trap, and that the only way to catch him was for them to work together. Still consumed by anger, Shen refused. Bound by the Code of Tuonn, Shen's honor compelled him to let Zed leave in peace, but he vowed to capture Jhin himself and warned Zed to go into hiding, as when they next meet, he would kill him.[[10]](#cite_note-Zed3-10)

As Zed prepared to leave,  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") stopped him.  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") ordered her to let him leave, but she disregarded him and attacked. Zed effortlessly evaded her strikes, and he and his disciples vanished into the shadows while Shen restrained Akali. Seething with rage, Shen decided to forsake the armistice between the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") and the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow") and declared war on Zed.[[10]](#cite_note-Zed3-10)

After retreating, Zed decided he would shadow Shen as he followed Jhin's trail. Kayn warned him that it would be dangerous, as they were now at war with the Kinkou. Zed agreed, and to minimize risk to the Yánléi, he gathered his disciples and swore in Kayn as his successor before setting off alone.[[10]](#cite_note-Zed3-10)

Zed followed Shen and Akali as they pursued leads on  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") across the region. They discovered that he had been targeting enemies of the Kashuri faction of the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood") and learned that one of the last holdouts in the area was the Elder of Nanthee. They rushed to the Port of Nanthee to protect him, but arrived too late. One thing Zed knew that Shen did not was that, although the Brotherhood had hired the Order of Shadow for assassinations, they never mandated the killing of innocents. He believed Jhin's murders were meant to taunt him personally. As he moved through Nanthee, Zed noticed something strange about the town's lanterns, they hung with two strings. When he went to investigate, he realized Jhin had turned them into traps.[[10]](#cite_note-Zed3-10)

#### Tracking Jhin

Knowing that Jhin was still in Nanthee waiting to watch his bombs go off, Zed searched for him. He remembered that this town rang a bell four times when a ship was about to depart and realized that was when they would detonate. He finally found Jhin and gave chase after they bell began to ring, but Shen spotted him and pursued. Zed tried to warn Shen that Jhin had rigged the town's lanterns with traps, but he refused to listen. Moments later, Jhin's bombs detonated, triggering explosions throughout the port. Zed shoved Shen into the sea, saving him from the blasts, while Jhin marveled at his work and escaped. As Shen began to drown, Zed dove in after him and dragged him to shore.[[2]](#cite_note-Zed4-2)

When  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") regained consciousness, he drew his blade on Zed. Zed gestured to the carnage around them and pleaded that they needed to work together to stop Jhin. Enraged, Shen charged at him, insisting that Jhin had staged the massacre knowing Zed would be watching, and that if Zed had remained hidden as warned, Jhin would have gone after him instead. Zed tried to tell him that Jhin was working for someone else, but Shen didn't believe him. He knew that Kusho was the one who had released Jhin, yet Zed his oath to his master prevented him from revealing the truth. Instead, he tried to hint at Kusho's identity by reminding Shen of his father's lesson on the rule of the scales, though Shen replied that his lesson had more than one part. He told him that they were taught action only when necessary, and accused Zed of failing the Kinkou—and Kusho—because of his impatience. Shen ordered Zed to stand down, but Zed threatened to kill him with his shadow clones. Shen retorted that the clones were shaped by Zed's hatred and guilt, that they did not serve him but controlled him. Gaining the upper hand, Shen began to beat down on Zed and tearfully denounced him for killing his father, declaring that Zed had once been his brother. With Zed unconscious, Shen ordered the Kinkou to bind him, planning to burn away his shadow magic before leaving him to rot in a cell.[[2]](#cite_note-Zed4-2)

Two days after the attack on the port,  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") had Zed restrained and prepared for transport when he received a message from  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali"). Shen confronted Zed and told him that he knew he had been holding back and that he allowed himself to be captured. Zed once again tried to hint at Kusho's idenity by questioning if Shen had discovered who had helped  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") escape, but Shen admitted that he had not and promised to protect Zed if Jhin came for him. Alternatively, Shen offered Zed one final chance to work together to stop Jhin on the condition that he finally tells him the truth about why he had killed his father.[[9]](#cite_note-Zed5-9)

Zed claimed that he needed the power of the Tears of Shadow to stop the Noxians, and that Master  [Kusho](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kusho "Universe:Kusho") had tried to stop him.  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") saw through his lie, pointing out that Zed could have taken the Tears without killing Kusho. Zed then confessed that he had been jealous of how much Kusho loved Shen and believed he needed shadow magic to become stronger. Again, Shen saw through his lie, as Kusho loved him just as much, and demanded the truth. At last, Zed admitted that Kusho had been right: if the Kinkou became involved in the war, their sacred mission would be corrupted. To save Ionia, a new order had to be born, but if Zed had merely taken the Tears, members of the Kinkou would have followed him. To sever that possibility, he had to become the Kinkou's hated enemy and betray Master Kusho. Shen accepted Zed's answer and freed him. While Shen wanted to capture  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin"), Zed insisted that he had to die. Shen refused, arguing that Jhin did not threaten the balance, but Zed countered he was not a member of the Kinkou. However, Shen refused to let Zed die thinking their father had been wrong and if he wanted his help, this was the price.[[9]](#cite_note-Zed5-9)

#### Stopping the Killer

As they prepared to depart,  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") informed Zed that Jhin had escaped to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), and that  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") had gone after him. Upon arriving in the City of Progress, they attempted to follow her trail. Zed again pressed Shen on whether he had discovered who had helped Jhin escape, but Shen dismissed it, as the only ones who knew where Jhin was being held were the two of them, Yevnai, and his father. One of Shen's informants eventually guided them an old opera house where Akali had been last spotted. There, they encountered an agent of the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood") who revealed he had led her into Jhin's trap. Shen and Zed then rushed in to save her.[[9]](#cite_note-Zed5-9)

They found  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") on the far side of a bridge, bound to one of  [Jhin's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") props and guarded by his traps, while Jhin sat nearby, calmly observing.  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") teleported in to strike him down, but it was only a decoy, and he was caught in a barrage of explosives. The real Jhin then revealed himself and moved to execute Akali, but Zed emerged from the shadows and the two rushed him together. Jhin evaded their attacks and unleashed more traps, incapacitating them both, though Zed managed to free Akali.[[1]](#cite_note-Zed6-1)

As  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") prepared to finish  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") off,  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") struck, pinning Jhin to the ground and raising his own gun to kill him. Shen pleaded with her to stop, but Zed knocked her aside and demanded to know how Jhin had escaped. Jhin replied that he had not escaped but, rather, he was freed, and that Zed already knew by whom. Enraged, Zed hurled Jhin at Shen's feet and declared their bargain fulfilled before vanishing into the shadows.[[1]](#cite_note-Zed6-1)

Several weeks later, Zed returned to Ionia to confront the Order's patron. As he snuck into his fortress, Zed wished that Shen had picked up on his hints and investigated who had helped Jhin escaped. When he entered, Zed found  [Kayn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayn "Universe:Kayn") at  [Kusho's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kusho "Universe:Kusho") side. Zed demanded to know why he had released Jhin. To which Kusho justified his actions by claiming that the fear Jhin inspired was necessary to unite the nation under the  [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori_Brotherhood "Universe:Navori Brotherhood"). Kusho also knew that Zed had been trying to point Shen in his direction by getting him to figure out how Jhin escaped. Refusing to let his former master plunge Ionia into civil war, Zed turned against him. Kusho ordered Kayn to kill Zed, and Kayn raised his scythe, yet he remained loyal to Zed, revealing that those still loyal to him were waiting nearby. Zed ordered Kayn to deal with the remaining traitors while he confronted Kusho alone.[[1]](#cite_note-Zed6-1)

Kusho consumed the Tears of Shadow, transforming into a monstrous, living shadow, and attacked. He taunted Zed with his failures, but Zed had long since embraced his own darkness. In the end, he struck Kusho down. Holding his former master as he died, Zed realized he had finally committed the very crime he had once been accused of. Outside, Kayn had dispatched the traitors and Kusho's soldiers, but more were coming. He was incredulous that Kusho really thought he would betray Zed after he saved him and gave him a home with the Order. As they left, Zed wished Shen had picked up on his clues regarding Kusho, but was happy they had at least recaptured Jhin.[[1]](#cite_note-Zed6-1)
structure.appearance: Zed is a muscular but slimly built man with brown eyes, fair skin, and shaggy white hair. His signature armor is a menacing ninja regalia, draped with dark red and blue fabrics tucked into dark gray metal with golden accents. The most notable feature is a sinister metal mask with vertical slats over the mouth. Zed's eyes seem to glow red from within. His weapons of choice are a pair of retractable, dual-tipped blades that extend from his forearms. He also carries 2 large shuriken on his back,
structure.personality: Like many Ionians, Zed is deeply dedicated to his homeland. Where he differs, however, is how far he is willing to go in order to protect it. Ruthless and decisive, Zed is willing to master forbidden arts, utilize deception and secrecy, and even betray his allies in his efforts to keep Ionia safe.
structure.abilities:
- **[Shadow Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zed#Reaper_of_Shadows "Zed"):** Zed has absorbed the powers of the Tears of Shadows, a magical ichor that grants him control over the shadows. The power of the Tears was forbidden due to its corruptive nature, making its full scope unknown.
  - **Shadow Teleportation:** Zed can use shadows to go from one place to another. The Teleportation is instanteneous and can be done several times in a short time, allowing him to evade attacks from enemies.
  - **Shadow Clones:** Zed can summon shadows versions of himself and others to serve his purpose. He can use this as a distraction against his foes, or summon shadow warrior to fight against his foes. He can also can switch places with his clones, making attempts to hit him much harder.
- **Combat Techniques:** Zed was once upon a time one of the greatests of the Kinkou, being a terrifyingly skilled fighter.

relations.relationship_description: During their training, Shen and Zed were as close as brothers. However, their relationship was shattered when Zed seemingly killed Kusho and the other Kinkou during his coup. Despite this, Zed still considered Shen the greatest friendship he ever had and sought his aid to hunt down Jhin.

Zed despises Jhin for the horrors he had inflicted on his fellow Ionians. He wished to kill him after they apprehended him, but was stopped by Kusho. Years later, when Jhin escaped, Zed worked with Shen to hunt him down again.
*(TBA)*

Zed found Kayn when he was 10 year old, and took him in as an apprentice. For saving and training him, Kayn became deeply loyal to Zed, but one day wishes to succeed his master as the head of the Order of Shadow.

structure.trivia:
- Zed and  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") trained together in the [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kinkou_Order "Kinkou Order"), led by the latter's father Kusho. Both students saw each other as rivals, but also [respected](http://forums.na.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?p=31131059#31131059) the other, seeing him as a brother and best friend.  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") was even a bit jealous of him (Kusho was less strict towards Zed as he saw Zed having far better potentials than his son). Master Kusho raised Zed as his own son and chose him to be the successor of his title, while Zed also looked up to him and his son as his own family. After Zed obeyed Kusho to betray the order, his relationship with Shen soured and became ambivalent.
  - Zed,  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"), and Kusho worked to discover and capture  [Khada Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") for his brutal murders. All three of them were severely traumatized during the investigation and, when they finally caught the 'Golden Demon', Kusho spared his life. Zed couldn't believe such a monster was offered mercy, finding himself questioning his master's teachings to the point of heavily resenting him.
  - Zed's resentment towards Kusho led him to delve into the shadow arts, founding the Order of Shadow. However, he later convinced Kusho to defend  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") from  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") and helped the later fake his death. While he believes in the necessity of the [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kinkou_Order "Kinkou Order") and their rule of scales, he seeks to abolish the old ways of balance while spreading his 'no restraint' philosophy.
    - He tried to minimize casualties when killing Kinkou members (though he needed enough people dead so the Kinkou would hate him and his new order.) Unfortunately, violence quickly got out of hand into an ugly and brutal feud.[[13]](#cite_note-13)
    - Zed leaving the Kinkou and "murdering" Kusho led to Shen being forced to take up the title *The Eye of Twilight* which he never wanted.
  - In spite of their animosity, Zed sought out Shen and to inform him about Jhin's release, in order to stop him together. They later captured him the second time in  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun").
  - After learning that Kusho was behind Jhin's release, Zed returned to [Zhyun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zhyun "Zhyun") and killed his former mentor.
  - Zed could have revealed the truth about Kusho to Shen but then decided it was better for Shen to be disillusioned with Zed than to be disillusioned with his own father. That's probably not fair, and maybe Shen has a right to know. But Zed is flawed... and blinded by his need to feel he's worthy and honorable.[[14]](#cite_note-14)
- Zed kissed  [Shen's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shen "Shen") fiancé, Yevnai, before leaving the Kinkou Order and later "killing" Master Kusho.
  - At one point they secretly harbored feelings for each other even though Kusho forbade  **Zed** from it.
    - Yevnai once begged Zed to run away with her, but he refused.
  - The engagement of  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") and Yevnai was called off after Zed "murdered" Kusho.
- Zed wants  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") dead after he ransacked the Temple of the Jagged Knife.
- Zed, his  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow"), and the [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Navori_Brotherhood "Navori Brotherhood") are extremists. They believe the magic of Ionia is for the Ionians... meaning they should be able to use it however they like. So limits on using that magic don't sit well with them. The fact that some of the Vastaya tribes fought for Noxus, and many tribes stayed neutral during the war (at least until Noxus started burning down their lands) doesn't sit well. In Zed's view those tribes are traitors and should be killed.[[15]](#cite_note-15)
  - The Brotherhood was originally an ally of the Order before Zed killed Kusho. Now they are enemies.
  - Both  [Rakan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rakan "Universe:Rakan") and  [Xayah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xayah "Universe:Xayah") have encountered  **Zed** and his ninja clan in an attempt to save a grove from losing all its natural magic.
- [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") wants Zed dead for what he did to the Kinkou Order in the past, including the supposed death of her father Tahno.
  - When she was captured by  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin"), Zed and Shen saved her from him.
- Zed favorite pupil is  [Kayn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayn "Universe:Kayn"), whom he treats as his own son and chooses to be his successor.
  - Long ago Zed chose to be the sort of mentor and master he was to Kayn. And that choice is ultimately what separates him from Kusho. Zed realizing he wasn't a malicious or manipulative master that only sought to achieve his own ends regardless of the consequences and actually sincere in his actions as a father figure would be significant moment in his life. Especially because Zed has a lot of guilt. He knows he's damaged mentally. Zed knows what he's doing isn't exactly heroic most of the time... but it had to feel good to really, really know he trained Kayn well and earned his loyalty.[[16]](#cite_note-16)
- *Zed* most likely means "Holy Justice" or "0".[[17]](#cite_note-17)
  - Zed's original name was *Govos*, but was changed to *Usan* "strength of compassion" by Master Kusho. Zed is the name he chose himself.
  - By coincidence, the name *Zed* also resembles:
    - A dialectal English name of [Letter Z](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Letter_Z).
- Zed was born from a peasant family in Kéthé, [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ionia "Ionia"). His father left his family when he was about 4 years old and never returned. He later rejected his own mother to stay with the Kinkou.
- Zed worked as a servant in [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kinkou_Order "Kinkou Order")'s Thanjuul monastery for over 2 years until Master Kusho decided to take him as his student after  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") purposefully let Zed hit him when Kusho wanted to test Zed's potential.
- Zed is using a Forbidden Technique called shadow magic. He is also using shadow's tears which are a magical ichor which gives Zed and his followers the ability to use shadow magic— (when tattooed or ingested). His tattoo can be seen [here](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/File:Zed_Bare_Render.png "File:Zed Bare Render.png").[[18]](#cite_note-18)
  - According to  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen"), Zed's shadow clones are shaped by his guilt and hatred and are controlling him instead of vice versa.
- Zed is around 34 to 35 years old.[[19]](#cite_note-19)
  - Zed is [four years younger](https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://boards.na.leagueoflegends.com/en/c/miscellaneous/WUwqmxEZ-new-champion-qa-jhin-the-virtuoso?show=flat&comment=000b0000) than  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin").
- Zed appears to be ambidextrous.
- Zed was originally considered for the position of the Eye of Twilight before.
- The armor Zed wears in-game is considered his war armor and not what he wears during stealth missions or in his day-to-day life.[[20]](#cite_note-20)
- Zed has a rudimentary understanding of healing from performing surgeries and healing magic.[[21]](#cite_note-21)
- It was believed for a long time that Zed killed Master Kusho to obtain the Tear of the Shadow for the power the  [Order of Shadow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Order_of_Shadow "Universe:Order of Shadow") members needed to fight back the Noxian army. This was later revealed to not really be the case, as Zed convinced Kusho to take part in the war and helped him fake his death.
- Some of the known draft scenes and cut scenes in [his comic series](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zed:_Issue_1 "Zed: Issue 1") include:
  - Zed killing a [Vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") elder that knew Kusho to take his magic in [Zed: Issue 1](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zed:_Issue_1 "Zed: Issue 1"). This was later relented as Marvel editors thought it made him too unlikeable.[[22]](#cite_note-22)
  - A flashback scene where we see  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") being dragged away while her father tries to buy time for her and some other Kinkou members to escape. Zed doesn't think much of Akali's father, and wants others to escape so he sends his weakest student against him. But Akali's father dies anyway.[[23]](#cite_note-23)
  - [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") and Zed had a talk during the war. Shen was worried about Zed (thinking he was taking too many risks), angry at his father's inaction, but also suspected Yevnai had feelings for Zed and that had something to do with the marriage being called off.[[24]](#cite_note-24)
  - Some  [Akali](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akali "Universe:Akali") scenes including a fight between Akali and  [Kayn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayn "Universe:Kayn") and some investigatiion scenes.
  - Some scenes which would have been too hard to do with rating's restrictions.
  - Three different scenes where Zed/Kayn were doing horrible stuff to monks and/or [Vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya").
  - A couple flashbacks with Kusho, specifically one when Zed got banished from the temple for using the ichor while Yvenai and  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") watched helplessly.
  - Two scenes which combined with other clues in the various issues created a little map based mystery where people to use the map to figure out where Jhin was going next—if they put together all the clues.
  - Three scenes across two issues where Zed was scanning the crowd looking for Jhin. And if you put the clues together you could figure out which face was  [Jhin's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jhin "Jhin").[[25]](#cite_note-25)
  - There was no "Kusho is alive" in that draft. The original finale had  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") taking the temple  **Zed** was prisoner in. The comic VO was their convo.  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") arrives—revealing same trap they'd used to catch  [Jhin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jhin "Universe:Jhin") years before.[[26]](#cite_note-26)

structure.name: Zoe
structure.quote: *"I bring a message for you all—a warning, a sigil. But first, I wanna see the sparkleflies!"*
structure.background: Zoe was born thousands of years ago in the  [Rakkor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rakkor "Universe:Rakkor") tribe of  [Mount Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mount_Targon "Universe:Mount Targon"). When she was a teenager, her teachers suffered constant headaches when trying to educate her because although she was a fairly intelligent, bubbly and stubborn girl, she was also quite naughty and distracted.
structure.appearance: Zoe has the appearance of a young girl. She has floating peach-colored hair which transitions into a ethereal purple at its tips. Her left eye is purple while her right one is turquoise. She wears a seafoam green scarf and a teal shirt with a matching belt and pair of shorts respectively. Her sandals are dark green and she wears multiple golden pieces of jewelry such as hair decorations, bracelets, and a necklace.
structure.personality: As the embodiment of mischief, imagination, and change, Zoe is a very mischievous and imaginative girl. She enjoys playing tricks on mortals and has an endless imagination. While she's seen as a threat by humans, Zoe is, in actuality, very friendly and tries to make friends with whoever she can. However, she still won't hesitate to fight back against those who threaten her, as shown when she threw a meteor at several enraged guards who tried to attack her. She's also incredibly bubbly and perky, having incredibly high levels of energy all the time.
structure.abilities:
- **Aspect Empowerment**: Zoe has been chosen as an [Aspect's host](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aspect_Host "Aspect Host"), empowering her with celestial magic correspondent with the Aspect's role. In Zoe's case, she's been chosen by the Aspect of Twilight.
  - **Immortality**: After her ascension, Zoe stopped aging, so she maintains the appearance of a girl between 15 and 17 years old despite being thousands of years old.
  - **[Celestial Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zoe#More_Sparkles! "Zoe")**: Zoe is skilled in making stars, and can bend their power to her will. This can take many forms, including the ability to make miniature stars and powerful blasts of energy at will as well as summon a meteor.
  - **Dimensional and Reality Perception/Travel**: Zoe perceives time across multiple dimensions and realities in addition to the ability to quickly traverse space, she can move freely with her unnaturally long hair due to magic.

relations.relationship_description: [Aurelion Sol](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aurelion_Sol "Universe:Aurelion Sol") and Zoe are sorta friends—but he knows not to trust her. And in fact she is his best hope of getting free—after he learns what he needs.[[1]](#cite_note-1) She protected him from the wrath of  [Pantheon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pantheon "Universe:Pantheon"), the Aspect of War and speaks to him as if he were her dog.

She "borrowed" a chime from  [Bard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bard "Universe:Bard"), or it was given to her. Zoe heralds change while Bard prevents disasters, so they probably meet from time to time.

**Zoe** really likes  [Ezreal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ezreal "Universe:Ezreal"), and as such she considers  [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") her rival.

Based on their interactions in  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra"), Zoe and  [Lulu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lulu "Universe:Lulu") seem to know each other on a friendly term.

She took the key from  [Fiddlesticks](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fiddlesticks "Universe:Fiddlesticks"), which was used to unleash something "beautiful and terrible in its joy"[[2]](#cite_note-2), probably referring to  [Ashlesh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ashlesh "Ashlesh").

The previous Aspect of Twilight, Myisha, led the [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin") Ta'anari to  [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus"). Nasus, in turn, guided Ta'anari to the [Chalicar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir#Trivia "Universe:Sivir"), an ancient blade that once belonged to the Ascended queen Setaka. Ta'anari used the weapon to perform a ritual that reverted the Ascension of nearby Darkins, vaporizing them. Myisha and other Targonian Aspects later gave the mortals the tool to trap the remaining Darkins. As a result, the Darkins who are now roaming free again, especially  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox"), despise every Aspect and their host, most noticeably The Aspect of Twilight/Zoe.

structure.trivia:
- In [Ancient Greek](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ancient_Greek), *Zoe* Ζωή ([IPA](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Phonetic_Alphabet): [zdɔː.ɛ̌ː] > [zo'i]) means "life", as opposed to "death";[[3]](#cite_note-3) while its [cognate](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/cognate) βῐ́ο(το)ς *bio(to)s* means "lifetime" or "the living's world".[[4]](#cite_note-4)
- As mentioned in her lore,  **Zoe** was likely born between 1550 and 1400 years ago, between the [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin") war and  [Mordekaiser](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mordekaiser "Universe:Mordekaiser") second reign. However, the altered perception of time and the immortality given by the powers of her Aspect make her think that barely a year has passed, so she remains physically and mentally a young teenager.
- Zoe is more of a chaotic good character, whereas traditional tricksters are chaotic evil to chaotic neutral. She is generally benevolent; however, she serves the bigger picture at the expenses of some indiviuals or sometimes unknowingly causes destruction.
- She likes eating Chocolate Mooncakes.
  - She also likes butterflies, unicorns, and watching the end of finite realities.
- Her scarf is knitted from the wool of an Erbok.
- Zoe is the second-released champion from the  [Lunari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lunari "Universe:Lunari") order.
- Zoe can change her eye color on a whim.[[5]](#cite_note-5)
- As both a trickster and a herald, many of Zoe's lines have double meanings (including the word "sparkles") and can be broadly interpreted.[[6]](#cite_note-6)
- Narrative Writer [Jared Rosen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jared_Rosen "Jared Rosen") rates her as one of the most knowledgeable known beings in the universe behind  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain") and  [Aurelion Sol](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aurelion_Sol "Universe:Aurelion Sol").[[7]](#cite_note-7)
- The  [Ionians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") use of twilight is separate to the meaning given to it by  [Targonians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Targon "Universe:Targon"). Ionia considers twilight as a time of when dark and light are in balance while Targonians view it as a time of transition or change.
- The key she keeps around her neck, was implied to be tied to pre-rework [Fiddlesticks](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fiddlesticks "Fiddlesticks"), to keep them at bay. The current purpose of the key is unknown.
  - Currently, Surprise Party Fiddlesticks addresses this key, asking if she did not stole it from "someone dangerous".

Myisha, the Aspect of Twilight during the Darkin war[[8]](#cite_note-8)

- Myisha was the host of the Aspect during the Great [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin") war; based on the description from [Twilight of the Gods](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twilight_of_the_Gods "Twilight of the Gods"), she was possibly a young adult when she became its host.
- She was somewhat violating the Prime Directive, giving mortals the power to defeat the Darkin with 'plausible deniability…' of a sort. "Hey, I didn't do it, these mortals did…"
- At the end of [Twilight of the Gods](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twilight_of_the_Gods "Twilight of the Gods"), when Myisha has succeeded in tricking the Darkin and many of them where trapped in their weapons through the use of the  [Chalicar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sivir#Boomerang_Blade "Sivir") she turned the combined power of the Darkin (and aspects) against them, so she 'force multiplied' that moment in the amphitheater to be powerful enough to achieve what she wanted.

structure.name: Eldred
structure.background: Eldred married into the Crownguard family through his wife,  [Tianna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tianna "Universe:Tianna"), the High Marshal of Demacia. During his tenure as leader of the mageseekers, he was responsible for imprisoning Sylas and indoctrinating Wisteria into their ranks. After Sylas escaped from his prison and began his revolution, Eldred ordered Wisteria to apprehend him. Eventually Sylas killed Eldred when his forces assaulted the Great City of Demacia.
structure.appearance: Eldred was a fair-skinned man with greying blond hair. Over his navy blue robes, he wore a golden armor with two petricite Mageseeker crests. He wore a golden mask that covered the right half of his face and part of his chin, and a long, elegant white cape.
structure.personality: As the leader of the  [mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers"), Eldred was exceptionally cruel and had a great disdain for mages, even willing to imprison his own niece. He proved himself a man who desired power above all else, willing to lie to the people of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") in order to secure more power for the mageseekers. He feigned deep admiration for  [Barrett Buvelle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Barrett_Buvelle "Universe:Barrett Buvelle") and twisted his image to his favor during Barret's funeral in order to curry more favor with the noble houses.
structure.abilities:
- **Leadership:** Eldred was the head of the  [mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers"), placing numerous seeker adepts under his command. As leader, he successfully expanded the organization's power and influence, greatly increasing the number of mages arrested under his reign.
- **Manipulation:** Eldred was able to exploit the personal weaknesses of Demacia's most powerful figures for his own gain. He took full advantage of the death of  [Barrett Buvelle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Barrett_Buvelle "Universe:Barrett Buvelle"),[[2]](#cite_note-Fragile-2) and later that of  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), to stoke the old Demacian fears and manipulate the throne to seek out vengeance. He was also able to marry his way into the  [Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") family, greatly increasing his own power and reputation.
- **Musician:** Eldred owned a massive pipe organ in his office. He was seen playing this organ while plotting with his subordinates.[[1]](#cite_note-Mageseeker-1)

relations.relationship_description: Eldred married Tianna Crownguard some time after she was elevated to High Marshal, and he used her reputation as a  [Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Crownguard "Universe:House Crownguard") to convince the [noble houses](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noble_Houses_of_Demacia "Universe:Noble Houses of Demacia") to expand the  [Mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers").[[2]](#cite_note-Fragile-2) Their relationship was somewhat cold and shrouded by formalities.[[3]](#cite_note-GarenBook-3)[[4]](#cite_note-LoRFlavor-4)

In his eulogy for the late  [Barrett Buvelle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Barrett_Buvelle "Universe:Barrett Buvelle"), Eldred deliberately misrepresented the honored lord as an anti-mage figure so as to drum up support for expanding the  [Mageseekers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mageseekers "Universe:Mageseekers"). After the funeral, Eldred used his new powers to audit the Buvelle library and remove any books which portrayed [magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic") as anything less than pure evil. His increased interest in their estate brought the family a lot of unwanted attention, which prompted Lady Lestara and her daughter  [Sona](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sona "Universe:Sona") to leave  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), staying in  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") for a time before eventually returning home.[[2]](#cite_note-Fragile-2)[[5]](#cite_note-SonaBio-5)

Sylas of [Dregbourne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dregbourne "Universe:Dregbourne") was a former mageseeker who was used by the order to locate and hunt other mages. After losing control of his powers, he was locked away for fifteen years under the mageseeker compound, gaining a profound hatred for Eldred and his other jailors.[[6]](#cite_note-SylasBio-6) Sylas's escape marked the beginning of the [Great Mage Rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion"), during which time Eldred sent his subordinates to try and recapture him. They failed, and when Sylas confronted Eldred in his office, the mageseeker leader calmly informed him that his death would mean nothing, as another would simply take his place. Sylas ignored Eldred's words and killed him where he stood.[[1]](#cite_note-Mageseeker-1)

structure.trivia: - Eldred is voiced by [Peter Jessop](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Jessop) in  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra"), who also voices  [Joraal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Joraal "Universe:Joraal").[[7]](#cite_note-7)
