structure.name: Kassadin
structure.quote: *"There are few indeed who may tread the paths between worlds."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Kassadin began his life as nothing more than a lowly orphan, hired as bait for the merchant caravans of [the Great Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Great_Sai "The Great Sai") to distract the predators of the lands away from the more important goods they transported. But to the surprise of many, Kassadin survived every predator attack and instead of being hired as bait, he started being hired as a guide.

He spent many years exploring ancient ruins and guiding his employers through the Great Sai, and it was here finally gained his name; *“Kas sai a dyn?”* or “whom does the desert know?”, often shortened to Kassadin due to his employers inexperience in the language of  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"). It was through this line of work where he wandered into [Zirima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zirima "Zirima") where he fell in love. Kassadin and his new wife decided to settle down, south in the rocky canyons, and the two of them had a  [daughter](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kai%27Sa "Universe:Kai'Sa").

Though he had a wife and daughter, work still required him to travel very far away, always bringing exciting tales back with him. One day though, on his way home from  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), he spotted some terrified, fleeing survivors speaking of a terror that ruined their homes, [the maw of the underworld](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Void "The Void") that opened up to devour everything. Kassadin hurried home as fast as his mount could travel, but when he arrived there was nothing left but rubble and ash.

### The Prophet

After the death of his wife and daughter, and the total ruin of his home, Kassadin fell into a deep depression, spending years drowning his sorrows in Zirima. That was until he heard of some new unspeakable horror bellow the earth and sacrifices being made in its name, by an unholy  [prophet](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Malzahar "Universe:Malzahar"). He knew what happened to  [Icathia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Icathia "Universe:Icathia") and he could not let such utter devestation happen to the rest of Shurima.

He made a vow to himself and his dead wife and child to avenge their deaths by destroying this prophet beckoning the void. Kassadin is well traveled and knows he needs to be as well equiped as possible, so he set off on one last journey to arm himself with the most arcane and esoteric equipment from all over  [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valoran "Universe:Valoran"). He equipped himself with  [Zaunite](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") tech, got blessed by  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") spirit-healers then lastly stole the  [Nether Blade of Horok](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nether_Blade "Nether Blade"), the bladed gauntlet of the first [Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ascended "Ascended") to fight against the void. His last stop now was Icathia where he would have his vengeance, no matter what.

### Recent events

Now Kassadin wanders what was formerly Icathia, killing anything the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void") throws at him, his flesh, mind and spirit slowly corrupting from the dangerous artifacts he carries and from the corrupting nature of the Void, but his resolve unshaking.
structure.appearance: Kassadin's body has been heavily modified . His skin has turned a sickly shade of blue, if that even is his skin anymore. On his head he wears a Zaunite helmet made in a deep metal with purple embellishments and with two large metal horns on either side. The helmet itself resembles a gas mask with two metal tubes that go from the helmet to Kassadin's back. He wears two large spiked shoulder pads in the same metal and with the same embellishments as his helmet, he also wears two metal gauntlets in the same style. Other than that he is shirtless, exposing his blue skin. And to cover his lower body he wears a dark purple skirt which reaches down and covers his feet. On his right arm he wields the  [Nether Blade of Horok](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nether_Blade "Nether Blade").
structure.personality: Kassadin has become a cold and nihilistic man. He is fixated on delivering justice, but equally wishes for the monsters of the void to strike him down so he may join his wife and child. Either way, he will defy the Void until the very end.
structure.abilities: *(TBA)*

relations.relationship_description: Kassadin and  [Malzahar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Malzahar "Universe:Malzahar") are polar opposites. While Kassadin tries to fight the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void"), Malzahar tries to bring it to Runeterra, therefore Kassadin has sworn to kill him.

[Kai'Sa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kai%27Sa "Universe:Kai'Sa") is Kassadin's daughter and - as he mistakenly believes she's dead - one of the 2 main reasons why he embarked on his crusade against the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void").

structure.trivia:
- In-universe, this former pathfinder's by-name *Kassadin* is a modified version of the foreign phrase *“Kas sai a dyn?"* "whom does the desert know?" to describe his talents.
- Even though he is from  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), his ties to his homeland are very weak, due to his preoccupation with the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void").
- [Ezreal's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ezreal "Ezreal") parents may have been the ones who employed Kassadin to search for Ne'Zuk's tomb and found both Horok's tomb and his  [Nether Blade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kassadin#Nether_Blade "Kassadin") but he originally did not dare to take it.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
  - As shown in [Warriors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Warriors "Warriors"), items like this may be used to prevent Void creatures and will trap those inside the tomb once moved. The tomb has since been claimed by the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void"), which may explain their disappearance.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
  - Both Kassadin's  [Nether Blade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kassadin#Nether_Blade "Kassadin") and Ezreal's gauntlet originally belonged to Horok. Ne'Zuk likely took the gauntlet after killing Horok.[[3]](#cite_note-3) As seen in his  [Wild Rift](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/League_of_Legends:_Wild_Rift "League of Legends: Wild Rift") model, Kassadin's gauntlet used to be gold, like Ezreal's.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

structure.name: Mel
structure.quote: *"The wolf, the fox–both necessary, both unrelenting."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Mel was born in [Rokrund](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rokrund "Universe:Rokrund") to the  [Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda") family, one of the [Great Houses](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noble_Houses_of_Noxus "Universe:Noble Houses of Noxus") of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), with the true nature of her birth remaining shrouded by deception and secrecy. Her mother,  [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"), was a respected general and military veteran in their clan, and while Ambessa was off fighting the empire's wars, Mel was raised by her father  [Azizi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azizi "Universe:Azizi"), a brilliant merchant who doted on and cared for her. When Mel's mother was home or taking her on campaigns, Ambessa taught her to live by the Medarda family code, and to embody the virtues of both the desert fox and the fearsome wolf of legend. Mel was always adept at embodying the Fox, as she held an uncanny gift for knowing the emotions of others—how they could be manipulated, won over, or molded to her benefit. However, this same empathy prevented her from embodying the Wolf, as compassion had no place on the battlefield.

When Mel's older brother  [Kino](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino") was dismissed as a possible heir to the family, Ambessa began preparing Mel for this role instead. Mel's political acumen was promising for her age, so Ambessa brought her on a tour to meet the leaders of the great Noxian cities, including the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion"), where they got to see Grand General  [Boram Darkwill](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boram_Darkwill "Universe:Boram Darkwill") from a distance.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4) Ambessa also introduced Mel to the  [Reckoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") arenas to learn the virtues of sacrifice, as they watched the mighty  [Alistar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Alistar "Universe:Alistar") crush each of his opponents in the Noxidi Arena.[[5]](#cite_note-Fourth_Principle-5) Mel was not receptive to Ambessa's teachings in the arena, nor did she enjoy watching what she considered a "blood sport." She felt disturbed by the level of violence that Noxians seemed to worship, when all she could see was a waste of life.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4)

When Mel was fifteen, Ambessa took her on a campaign in the jungles near [Kumangra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kumangra "Universe:Kumangra") for the conquest of an estate owned by the  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") Binan family. When the battle had ended, Mel was summoned to the palace's throne room and given a test by her mother: *She* would have the choice to decide what should be done with the Binan leader,  [Lady Mion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mion "Universe:Mion"). Mel believed it would be wise to spare the prisoner's life and exile her to the far colonies, believing she would cause little trouble for them and that it would convince the local population that they were merciful. Ambessa, however, argued that showing mercy would be a sign of weakness, and she beheaded Mion with her katar. The image of Mion's head and broken necklace covered in blood haunted Mel for over a decade, and thoroughly traumatized, she and her mother returned to meet with their family in [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun").[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4)

### Medardan Succession War

:   *Main article: [Ambessa: Chosen of the Wolf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa:_Chosen_of_the_Wolf "Universe:Ambessa: Chosen of the Wolf")*

#### The Rakkor Painter

The situation in [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun") was grave when Mel and  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") returned. Mel's great-grandfather, Hostlord Menelik, had been critically-wounded during a campaign, and as he lay on his deathbed, factions became to form regarding who should be next to succeed him as leader of  [House Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda"). When Menelik died without naming an heir, Mel left her family's compound for the artists' district, where she met a  [wanderer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rudo "Universe:Rudo") from  [Targon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Targon "Universe:Targon"). The man was a sun worshipper of the  [Rakkor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rakkor "Universe:Rakkor") and a painter, and after confiding in him about how she had disappointed her mother, the man offered any one piece of art from his collection for her to bring home with her. Mel chose the man's golden tattoos, and she later met him at the Golden Drake inn to receive a set of her own.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4)

#### Life in Bel'zhun

After Mel had returned home and washed up that night, her mother summoned their family with urgent news: Ambessa and her cousin Ta'Fik had both made claims to succeed Menelik, and she had just earlier escaped an assassination attempt by one of Ta'Fik's supporters. Ambessa assigned  [Azizi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azizi "Universe:Azizi") and  [Kino](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino") tasks to help sabotage Ta'Fik's operations in Bel'zhun during her absence. She assigned Mel no task, instead ordering her to return home to [Rokrund Citadel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rokrund "Universe:Rokrund"), where Mel would be kept safe under the guard of her uncle, Steward Katye. After Ambessa fled the city on her warships, Kino attempted to obey his mother's order to send Mel on a ship with Katye. Mel refused to go, and when Azizi intervened on her behalf, she was allowed to remain in Bel'zhun under the protection of the Wolf's Reapers.

Having foiled her mother's plan to send her home, Mel was now determined to prove that she could help their family in her own way. She began by taking Kino to watch the  [Reckoners](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") match of their cousin Tivadar—Ta'Fik's youngest daughter, who had also been left behind as just as they were. Though Kino was skeptical of Mel's plan, Mel convinced him to get them a conversation alone together, which he accomplished by inviting Tivadar to his favorite noodle bar to celebrate her victory. After he left, Mel and Tivadar had a short but tense conversation in which Tivadar condemned Ambessa and Menelik for corrupting the Medarda family code so that it would cull the weakest family members. Mel sympathized with Tivadar, and after she had stormed out from their conversation, Mel spent a few more weeks trying to meet with her and eventually succeeded by relating to her feelings of loneliness and inadequacy. For the next few months, the two of them enjoyed a tentative friendship, where they would both spy on one another over tea, lunch, and [tellstones](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tellstones "Universe:Tellstones").[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4)

#### Death of Azizi

It was several months until Mel, Kino, and their father received their first letter from Ambessa, who informed them of her new alliance with [Vindor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vindor "Universe:Vindor") and her plans to seek the aid of  [Boram Darkwill](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boram_Darkwill "Universe:Boram Darkwill"). Azizi and Kino both received tasks from Ambessa, but despite having learned that Mel was still in the city with them, Ambessa again did not assign any task for Mel. Upset by this, Mel was comforted by her father as they took a carriage into town, who informed Mel that she was wise and compassionate, and that her mother loved her more than she realized. Just as she was beginning to cheer up, their carriage was suddenly toppled over in an accident. Azizi was killed in the crash, and Mel suffered a broken arm and was rescued by several onlookers. One of the responders was a girl named  [Elora](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Elora "Universe:Elora"), whom Mel recognized as one of the Golden Drake inn's staff from when she was receiving her tattoos.

When Mel later woke up, Kino was watching over her bedside, and they began to suspect foul play in the crash. In their grief, Mel became suspicious of everyone—including Tivadar and the  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") rebels Ambessa had allied with. However, just one argument with Tivadar convinced Mel that accusing everyone would be unproductive, as a lack of trust would only serve to push her own allies away. As Kino left to begin his investigation alongside the Suns of Bel'zhun rebel group, Mel decided to ally with Elora, who had offered to help Mel write a letter to Ambessa informing her of the incident. She also apologized to Tivadar, and the three of them grew close as they began the hunt for Azizi's murderer.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4)

#### Banishment

Ambessa returned to Bel'zhun many months after she had originally left, and after a tearful reunion, Mel and Kino began to fill her in what they had been doing since Azizi's death. When Mel mentioned Tivadar, Ambessa became angry, claiming that Ta'Fik's daughter was not to be trusted, and that she had already faced Tivadar's sister Gintara in Rokrund, who had been killed during the conflict. To prepare for her confrontation with Ta'Fik, Ambessa intended to hold Tivadar for ransom. However, Mel considered Tivadar a close friend by this point, so she begged Ambessa to give her a chance to properly ally with them instead. Ambessa gave Mel one chance, declaring that *if* Tivadar helped them, then she would be allowed to take her father's place as the next steward of [Tereshni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tereshni "Universe:Tereshni"). Mel relayed this deal to Tivadar, as well as the news of her sister's death. Tivadar was reluctant to help her sister's killer, but Mel convinced her that the war needed to end, and that if she didn't talk her father down from the invasion, then the two of them might very well be next. The next morning, Mel and her mother found Tivadar's room empty, as she had already left for Tereshni. Ambessa was furious with Mel for letting her get away.

Ambessa returned from Tereshni wounded and without Tivadar, and she informed them of Ta'Fik's death, which made her head of House Medarda. Her lack of any comment on Tivadar confirmed Mel's fears: Tivadar was dead. Worse than that, Tivadar had helped Ambessa defeat Ta'Fik, and yet Ambessa had killed her anyway. When Mel confronted her mother about this, Ambessa argued Tivadar's death was a necessary loss, and that Mel's weakness with regards to her had put their entire mission at risk. For that, she was being sent on a ship to the distant city of  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), where she would meet with instructors and defend their family's interests in the region until further notice. Heartbroken, Mel was allowed to say goodbye to Kino and bring one person to accompany her on the journey before setting sail.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4)

### Life in Piltover

:   *Main article: [Arcane (TV Series)](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series) "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)")*

#### Early Adulthood

At the docks of  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), Mel was greeted by  [Jago Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jago "Universe:Jago"),[[6]](#cite_note-MelBio-6) a member of their house responsible for overseeing the operations of the Sun Gates.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4) Mel brought  [Elora](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Elora "Universe:Elora") with her from [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun"), who left her job at the Golden Drake inn to become her assistant. As her mother had predicted, Mel's political acumen made her more than adept at managing the  [Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda") family's business interests in the region, and after securing a deal with  [House Ferros](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Ferros "Universe:House Ferros"), she became the richest person in all of Piltover.[[7]](#cite_note-102mysteries-7) Mel also rose to a seat on the Piltover Council, in large part due to the Medardas' influence in the city.[[8]](#cite_note-203finally-8) Still, Ambessa's words haunted Mel, and she always felt her personal wealth paled in comparison to that of the rest of her family. She began looking for an enterprise that could revolutionize Piltover so that she might restore her honor as a  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), and to convince her family that she was in fact worthy of the Medarda name.

#### Discovery of Hextech

Mel first learned about [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") during the trial of  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce"), a rogue Academy student and aspiring inventor who sought to create magic through science. Jayce's ambitious drive towards innovation intrigued Mel, and though the ethos demanded he be banished from Piltover, Mel instead supported a lighter sentence that resulted in Jayce's expulsion from the Academy, convincing  [Councilor Hoskel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hoskel "Universe:Hoskel") to support the motion as well.[[7]](#cite_note-102mysteries-7) To make the most of this investment, Mel later helped Jayce and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") sneak into  [Heimerdinger's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger") lab, then concealed their activities by distracting the Academy guards.[[9]](#cite_note-103base-9) Heimerdinger arrived too late to thwart the experiment, and with Mel's assistance, the inventors managed to convince the Council to support their enterprise. This decision would lead to the widespread implementation of hextech across the City of Progress, including the construction of the Hexgate, which transformed Piltover into a global shipping lane at the Council's request.[[10]](#cite_note-104progress-10)

#### Piltovan Bicentennial

Years after the invention of hextech had catapulted Jayce to stardom across Piltover, Mel was scheduled to be present for his bicentennial Progress Day speech, and she eagerly awaited his next invention. Before the speech, Jayce confided in Mel that Heimerdinger advised him to delay his showcase so they could work out all the necessary safety measures, and although Mel advised Jayce to simply ignore Heimerdinger, he decided at the last moment to keep his inventions secret from the public. Mel and Elora left the celebration early, irritated that they had nothing to show for the investors.

Later that night, a  [terrorist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") from the undercity bombed the Academy Square and stole a hextech gemstone and several notes from Jayce's laboratory, and fearing the thief might weaponize it, Jayce suggested that the Council shut down all hextech operations. The other councilors refused, as their profits directly depended on the Hexgate. Instead, Mel recommended that Jayce be instated as a Council member so he could safeguard Hexgate directly—a radical suggestion since the Council had, up until that point, only ever held seven seats. Heimerdinger agreed with Mel's proposal, and after putting the matter to a vote, House Talis was elevated to their august body.[[10]](#cite_note-104progress-10) Having increased Jayce's authority, Mel was determined to mold him into a leader who could revolutionize Piltover, without Heimerdinger's interference. Though Jayce was reluctant to get involved in politics, Mel guided Jayce to win the political and financial support of prominent figures like  [Amara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Amara "Universe:Amara"), which he accomplished by offering exclusive, firsthand access to his future inventions. Mel was impressed by how quickly Jayce had adapted, and after expanding their influence, they both bonded on how they would use it to promote good. At night on the balcony, Mel expressed her romantic feelings for Jayce. He reciprocated, and after a night of passion together, Mel woke up to find Jayce had left without so much as a goodbye.[[11]](#cite_note-105everybody-11)

The next morning, Mel was working on her painting of the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion") when Jayce returned to apologize for his sudden disappearance. While initially receiving Jayce coldly, Mel softened after Jayce explained that Viktor was terminally ill, and she moved to comfort him. Jayce confided in Mel about his frustrations; that he had been too distracted with politics to accomplish any of the good he sought out to do with hextech, and that he felt helpless to save his best friend. Mel disclosed that she had been exiled from her family because they thought she was unworthy; a belief which Jayce strongly disagreed with. Mel then reassured Jayce that although he may not be able to save Viktor, he should spend his remaining time with him so he wouldn't feel alone in his final moments.

In the following days, Mel supported Jayce in some of his hardest decisions. When Heimerdinger threatened to obstruct Viktor's hexcore research, Mel was the first to back Jayce's motion to have him removed from the Council, and they voted him out for his failure to prevent the ongoing crisis with the undercity.[[12]](#cite_note-106when-12) Jayce felt guilty about betraying his mentor, but Mel justified his actions by stating Heimerdinger's removal was necessary, and as the Council's new de facto leader, Jayce could finally bring hextech to the masses like he had always dreamed. Mel later received word that her mother would be arriving from  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), and she worried that Jayce was not ready for this kind of attention from overseas. She approached Jayce and Viktor and suggested they start developing hextech weapons for Piltover's defense, having deduced that it was a program Jayce was already considering. Viktor was vehemently against Mel's proposal, but Jayce appeared more conflicted, leading to an argument between the two inventors. Mel left the decision to them before leaving the laboratory.[[13]](#cite_note-107boy-13)

#### Arrival of General Medarda

As the reunion with her mother neared, Mel was woken up by nightmares from her childhood, and later visited the aftermath of another bombing on the Bridge of Progress. When Ambessa arrived on her warship, she was critical of Mel, claiming that  [Kino](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino") had been killed after crossing the "wrong man", and that she had come to give her proper guidance. Ambessa said that Mel's reluctance to quash the undercity's threat had let the situation spiral out of control, and that the solution to this problem was hextech weaponry. This confirmed Mel's fears, and she rejected her mother's advice, as it would necessitate a brutal war that would destroy everything she had built.

At the next Council meeting,  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") and  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") revealed to the Council that a criminal kingpin named  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") was the mastermind behind the ongoing crisis, and that his ultimate goal was establish an independent "Nation of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun")" which would encompass the entire undercity. Mel advocated diplomacy with Silco, and was shocked to hear Jayce was in support of a full-scale retaliation to bring him down by force.[[14]](#cite_note-108oil-14) Mel quickly discovered that her mother had met with Jayce to manipulate him onto the path of war, and she went to confront Ambessa, who dismissed her daughter's anger and revealed the truth of her visit: Kino's killer was a powerful threat to the Medardas, and she needed hextech weapons to be developed to use against them. Ambessa declared that if Mel helped to start a war, she would be allowed to return to Noxus and rule the Medardas by her side. Mel was disgusted that Ambessa would let innocents suffer just to save herself, and she severed ideological ties to their house, defacing her painting of the Immortal Bastion.

After an unsanctioned raid on Silco's [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") factory, Jayce managed to broker a peace with the crime lord in exchange for Zaun's independence. Mel was the first councilor to agree to Jayce's proposal, persuading the rest to follow suit. However, when the meeting was almost done and the crisis nearly resolved, the Council was suddenly caught in a  [terrorist attack](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Super_Mega_Death_Rocket! "Jinx"),[[15]](#cite_note-109monster-15) which left most of its members dead or injured. Though Mel and Jayce had been closest to where the rocket had hit, the area they were standing was the least damaged in the entire room. The situation bewildered them both, but they had no time to question the matter in the face of the gruesome tragedy that lay before them. In the aftermath, Jayce abandoned his spot on the Council to remain in his laboratory with a comatose Viktor, leaving Mel,  [Salo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Salo "Universe:Salo"), and  [Shoola](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shoola "Universe:Shoola") as the only remaining councilors. Mel then learned the details of the attack from Caitlyn, who informed her that  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") was the one responsible, and that Silco was dead.

The remaining Council met to discuss their options for a response to Jinx's attack. Although Mel was reluctant to use force against Zaun, she was overruled by the other two, who demanded an invasion led by the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers"). Realizing her mother was now manipulating Salo, Mel agreed to endorse the invasion in order to present a united front, on the condition that hextech weapons would not be used. Mel's proposal won over Shoola, and they outvoted Salo. At the memorial service for the councilors who had died, Mel was again attacked by one of  [Renni's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni") henchmen, who had arrived to avenge her son who had been killed during Jayce's raid. The  [chembaroness](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons") was killed by Ambessa, who began to take a more active role in managing Piltovan affairs.[[16]](#cite_note-201heavy-16) Worried by her mother's growing influence, Mel sent an informant,  [Lest](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lest "Universe:Lest"), to spy on her, and she learned that Ambessa and Salo were planning a gathering of all the mercantile clans to enact martial law. Before Mel could do anything to stop her mother's plans, she was suddenly kidnapped by the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"), who killed Elora and left no witnesses to Mel's disappearance.[[8]](#cite_note-203finally-8)

#### Awakening as a Mage

Mel awoke in an Oculorum, a special chamber that was designed with a test for imprisonment, as well as a deadly punishment for failure. Here, she was surprised and relieved to learn that Kino was alive and was being held in the same prison as she was. After a happy reunion, the siblings reconnected as Mel worked her way around the chamber, and Kino explained an important discovery he'd made in [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Basilich "Universe:Basilich"): Ambessa had an affair with a powerful mage, and her child had inherited abilities that were of special interest to their captors. Mel, disturbed by Kino's story, realized he wasn't acting like himself and realized he was actually an illusion conjured up by her jailer. The Oculorum dissolved around them, and the shapeshifter attacked her with magical thorns, which she instinctively destroyed by shielding herself in rays of magical light, awakening her latent powers as a [mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic").[[2]](#cite_note-205blisters-2)

With the test completed, Mel was greeted by a  [mysterious sorceress](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), who concealed her true face by taking the form of  [Lady Mion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mion "Universe:Mion") in the Binan throne room. The sorceress congratulated Mel on unlocking her powers, but Mel was still in shock, and demanded to know where her brother was. The sorceress revealed the Kino was in fact dead, but blamed Ambessa's pride for getting him killed. She explained that Ambessa's "thirst for legacy" had blinded her to an extent that her actions were about to unleash a cataclysmic threat, comparable to the ancient [Rune Wars](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rune_Wars "Universe:Rune Wars") in its devastation, and as a result she had to be stopped at all costs. While Mel was reluctant to kill her mother, the sorceress stated that Mel did not have a choice regarding her "new family", and she gave Mel a special amulet to call upon her assistance when the moment was right. After being initiated into the Black Rose, Mel left the fortress and returned to Piltover.

Mel found Jayce in the rebuilt Council chamber, where he reacted aggressively towards her, as he figured out she was a mage and her powers had been used to save him and not the others. Mel pleaded that the original use of her powers was sheer instinct. Jayce also accused her of using him and Viktor for hextech, and Mel defended her sponsorship of the enterprise, listing the positive qualities she saw in Jayce and Viktor that led her to invest in them. While Mel was speaking, Jayce was suddenly plagued by visions, and the two of them were interrupted by a faceless metal humanoid that spoke in Viktor's voice. Viktor informed them that Ambessa was planning an invasion of the city and that he was going to help her if Jayce did not join him in enacting his " [Glorious Evolution](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viktor#Glorious_Evolution "Viktor")" at the Hexgate. Viktor attacked them when Jayce refused his offer, and although Mel used her powers to help destroy the puppet, Jayce and Mel were both shaken, as they had just barely survived.

#### Battle of Piltover

Having learned her mother's intentions, Mel left for Zaun to negotiate with Ambessa. Here, she pleaded that Piltover had nothing to do with Ambessa's feud, and she now had the power to avenge Kino if they both returned to Noxus together. However, Ambessa still did not believe Mel was capable of defeating the Black Rose and instead put her trust into Viktor, who had raised an entire army of metal puppets that Ambessa claimed had no fear of death.[[17]](#cite_note-208killing-17) Having failed to convince her mother from her warpath, Mel returned to Piltover to plan the city's defense.

On the battlefield, Mel defended  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") from being executed, after which Mel continued to try and convince her mother to recognize everything she had sacrificed, including the lives of Kino,  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"), and the entire city Mel had spent years building for them. Mel's pleas failed to sway her mother, and she and Caitlyn dueled Ambessa as Viktor's puppets swarmed their surroundings. Ambessa outmatched them both and managed to cut out one of Caitlyn's eyes, but Caitlyn had in turn stolen Ambessa's  [kaenic rookern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kaenic_Rookern "Kaenic Rookern"), allowing Mel to use the amulet to summon the Black Rose sorceress, who mortally wounded Ambessa with her magic. Mel, however, had no intention of being the Black Rose's puppet and glimpsed the  [Deceiver's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") face before destroying the shadow in a radiant burst of light. As Ambessa lay dying in her daughter's arms, she looked at her with pride before declaring "You are the Wolf."

After the death of her mother, Mel left  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and the Council and took her mother's battle mask, as well as command of her warband. She returned to Noxus on her mother's warship in search of answers.[[18]](#cite_note-209dirt-18)

### Return to Noxus

:   *Main article: [Welcome to Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Welcome_to_Noxus "Welcome to Noxus")*

As her ships entered Noxian waters, the reality of Ambessa's death finally settled in, and Mel decided to write a letter to mourn her, one she ultimately cast overboard. In it, she recounted her banishment to Piltover and how she had once yearned for her mother's love. She reflected on how she lived by the ways of the fox and nearly had Piltover under her control, until her mother's arrival changed everything. Mel conceded that Ambessa had been trying to protect her, now understanding the truth about her own powers. She could scarcely imagine what it had been like for her mother to be hunted by the Black Rose for so many years, yet she knew Ambessa had never feared what they might do to her, only what they might do to Mel and her brother. Mel did not regret protecting her city. After all, Ambessa had always taught that strength comes with sacrifice, but now Mel was the one bearing that weight. She had to confront the many secrets her mother had kept from her: the truth about her father, the death of her brother, and Ambessa's deep grudge against the Black Rose. Mel resolved to uncover everything her mother had hidden. She hoped Ambessa was watching from [Volrachnun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Volrachnun "Universe:Volrachnun") as she returned to their homeland. Mel knew that many did not see her as a true Medarda—not even their own guards—but she would not proudly claim a nation that prized strength yet thrived on bloodshed as her own. She vowed to never abandon the ways of the fox, and though this was not the homecoming Ambessa wanted, Mel had returned nonetheless, determined to make a change.[[6]](#cite_note-MelBio-6)

At the shores of [Rokrund](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rokrund "Universe:Rokrund"), where her mother faced death itself, Mel went to the Noxtoraa and saw a vision of the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Immortal_Bastion "Immortal Bastion"), where she was fighting a pair of Black Rose  [hemomancers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Crimson_Circle "Universe:Crimson Circle") at the gates and was nearly crushed by falling rubble. After receiving the vision, Mel and her soldiers set off for the Noxian capital.[[19]](#cite_note-Welcome_to_Noxus-19)

Mel attended a  [Reckoners](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") match in the Noxidi Arena alongside her cousin, located in the Immortal Bastion's  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") quarter, where she reminisced on a time her mother had attempted to teach her about "sacrifice" as the fourth principle of Noxus, where the mark of a true warrior was a person's willingness to give up anything—even their own allies—to achieve victory. Mel rejected her mother's lesson, standing firm that mercy and compassion were not the weaknesses Ambessa thought them to be.[[5]](#cite_note-Fourth_Principle-5)
structure.appearance:
Mel is an attractive, slender, brown-skinned woman with hazel eyes, which match those of her biological father,  [Rudo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rudo "Universe:Rudo"). She has dark, curly hair with jeweled twists at her hairline. Mel's tattoos, which were painted in golden ink, are made to resemble golden armor and pauldrons, and were deliberately made to match the markings of  [Targonian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Targon "Universe:Targon") sun worshippers.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4)

As a councilor, Mel wore elegant white clothing with golden sun imagery, which was made to reflect the  [Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda") family's roots as traders off the coast of  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), which is also mixed with common  [Piltovan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") patterns.

After learning she was a mage, Mel began wearing a white hooded robe over a black garment with similar golden accents.

Upon returning to  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") on her mother's warship, Mel replaced the white robe with an expensive, long flowing red cape and skirt accented with black and intricate gold patterns, as well as silver armor pieces.
structure.personality:
Mel had a clever and analytical personality, with an ambition born from feelings of inferiority within the powerful and wealthy  [Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda") family. Mel's heightened sense of empathy granted her a keen understanding of the people around her, and though she would be compelled towards compassion, her banishment to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") convinced her to bury these feelings, as she felt that her "weakness" had led her to fall short of Medarda standards. As a politician, Mel became manipulative of the Piltovan upper classes, and she became bored by their lack of new ideas. She also grew somewhat callous towards the suffering of the lower classes, allowing the other councilors to turn the  [undercity](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") upside down without vetoing the motion, and saw little issue with corruption, viewing it as a reality of politics that could be leveraged to expand one's influence. In her efforts to prove herself, Mel sought to avoid Piltover's stagnation at all costs, and she invested heavily in enterprises which would help improve the city's global standing and prosperity.

Mel's relationship with  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce"), as well as the arrival of her  [mother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"), shook Mel's outlook on the Medarda name, as she saw just how much Ambessa's manipulations had damaged Jayce's idealism and brought the city on the brink of all-out war. She grew defiant as she had been in her youth and reaffirmed her commitment to peace with Zaun, and continued to clash with her mother's aggression for the city she built for their family. After Mel had finally defeated Ambessa, she returned to  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") with a renewed sense of purpose, viewing compassion and mercy as a source of her strength.
structure.abilities:
- **[Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"):** Mel was born with natural magical abilities from her biological father  [Rudo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rudo "Universe:Rudo"), who was a celestial mage of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose").[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4) She was able to perceive the puzzle patterns of her prison and believed she could unravel them, and was able to repel the magic of even  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), a powerful and ancient sorceress.
  - **Empath**: Mel possesses a rare and powerful form of magic. As an empath, Mel is attuned to the arcane, with her abilities she is able to sense the inner selves of others and bend their magic as both a "conduit" and a "mirror," which allows her to reflect the magic of others against them.[[17]](#cite_note-208killing-17)
  - **[Solar Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mel#Searing_Brilliance "Mel")**: Mel can manipulate sunlight as a conduit for her magical powers, she is able to generate intense rays of sunlight from her body, which can be used to create  [barriers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mel#Rebuttal "Mel"),  [luminous bolts](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mel#Radiant_Volley "Mel") that can explode and be shaped into whips, and  [orbs](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mel#Solar_Snare "Mel") that radiate solar energy. Mel can also envelop herself in this energy to create a  [radiant destructive supernova](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mel#Golden_Eclipse "Mel").
- **Golden Tattoos:** Mel's tattoos, which were painted in ink to resemble golden armor and pauldrons, were given to her by Rudo in [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun"). They were made in the style of the  [Rakkor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rakkor "Universe:Rakkor"), and were secretly imbued with [rune magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic") designed to inhibit her magical abilities, which prevented the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") from detecting her for over a decade.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4)
- **Diplomacy:** From an early age, Mel can be seen to have a knack at politics. Mel is a consummate political strategist, and she has been able to sway politicians and influential people to conform to her agenda. During her time living in Piltover, she rose to the power of a councilor, despite her position within her own family, and even became the richest person in the entire city.[[7]](#cite_note-102mysteries-7)
- **Painter:** Mel is a talented painter, specifically with egg tempera paintings, having been inspired to pursue this hobby after acquiring a painting from Rudo in the Shimmering Market.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4) Currently all the paintings in her home were done by her.

relations.relationship_description:
Mel was raised in one of the oldest and most powerful noble houses in all of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). Unlike her mother, who saw the Medarda legacy as a source of her own glory and greatness, Mel felt inadequate in her house's shadow, even long before she was exiled to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"). To prove she was capable, Mel went through great lengths to end the Medardan succession war by joining forces with her cousin Tivadar, so that they could end the bloodshed that was bringing their house to ruin. Mel's plan failed as Ambessa did things her way, through a violent takeover of the clan, after which she exiled Mel for showing mercy on their enemies. In Piltover, Mel came to believe she had fallen short of Medarda standards and continued to try and prove herself by investing in [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech"), which could transform Piltover into an influential and prosperous city worthy of her family name. Since she returned to Noxus, Mel now believes that she can rebuild the Medarda legacy with compassion instead of sacrifice; in stark contrast to her mother's teachings.

#### [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa")

A brutal Noxian warlord, Ambessa taught her daughter about the art of war from a very young age in hopes that she would one day succeed her as heir. However, while Ambessa approved of Mel's cunning and statecraft, Ambessa was disappointed by Mel's lack of cutthroat instincts. Mel, in turn, felt stifled by her mother, who was dismissive of her "soft-spined idealism" and refused to allow her to help in matters critical to the survival of their family. She believed that Ambessa's ruthless, violent mindset was a waste of human lives, as Ambessa's refusal to show mercy would deprive her of potential future allies. Ambessa would not tolerate Mel's different worldview, and for fear that Mel's "weakness" would prevent her from keeping their family safe, she finally banished her to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover").

Mel was shown to fear her mother while also resenting her for her past actions, leaving their relationship strained. She would eventually confront her about it, which would lead to Mel symbolically cutting ties with her Noxian roots. After learning the details about Ambessa's feud with the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"), Mel attempted to convince her mother to join her so they could avenge Kino's death together. Ambessa would not relent, still believing Mel was a "fox" for trying to show mercy on Piltover, and therefore incapable of taking on an enemy like the Rose. After a more direct confrontation on the battlefield, Mel would eventually prove Ambessa wrong by besting both her and LeBlanc by pitting them against one another. Though this led to Ambessa's death, she looked at Mel with pride, declaring that she was "the Wolf". After the war in Piltover, Mel would take her mother's place as leader of the warband, seemingly uneasy with her new role and responsibilities.

#### [Azizi Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azizi "Universe:Azizi")

As  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") husband, the general would rely on Azizi to raise her children in her absence, and as a result, both Mel and  [Kino](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino") took after him more than they did her. As Mel's father, Azizi was patient and supportive, and Mel loved him a great deal for listening to her and giving her chances to prove herself when her mother would not. In their final conversation before his death, Azizi reassured Mel that he admired her determination, her wisdom, and her compassion, and he tried to mediate the emotional rift between her and Ambessa. Azizi's death left Mel so devastated that she lashed out at some of the people close to her for a short time, after which she came to terms with it and resolved to find the people responsible.

#### [Kino Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino")

Kino Medarda was Mel's older brother, and they had a typical sibling relationship—bickering on occasion, but always ready to help and comfort one another when it was needed. Kino was said to be gifted with a silver tongue and also believed that he could talk his way out of anything. Kino used to tell Mel that war was "a failure of statecraft", and Mel agreed with this sentiment. Which indicates that Kino was one of the few members of his family for whom Mel had a lot of love and affection. Mel was visibly shocked when Ambessa delivered the news of her brother's death. After she was kidnapped by the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"), Mel encountered a prisoner who bore Kino's appearance and was overjoyed and relieved to learn that her brother was alive. However, Mel was able to recognize her brother's odd behavior during their conversation and deduced that he was merely an illusion summoned by her jailer, a  [shapeshifting sorceress](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), meant to deceive her. Having learned the truth, Mel accepted her brother's death and moved to avenge him by betraying the Rose later on.

#### Tivadar Medarda

Tivadar was Mel's cousin and the daughter of  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") mortal enemy in the clan, Steward Ta'Fik of [Tereshni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tereshni "Universe:Tereshni"). As their parents clashed during the  [Medardan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda") succession war, Mel and Tivadar were both left behind in [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun") and attempted to spy on each other for their parents' benefit. Tivadar was initially cold towards Mel, who at first attempted to form a connection by watching her matches in the  [Reckoner Arena](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners"), but Mel was able to get through to her by relating to her on a personal level, as they both felt their own parents regarded them as useless. Over time, Mel and Tivadar became close friends, playing [tellstones](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tellstones "Universe:Tellstones") and going for lunch together, and Tivadar even helped Mel to investigate the culprits behind her  [father's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azizi "Universe:Azizi") death. After Ta'Fik invaded [Rokrund](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rokrund "Universe:Rokrund"), he ordered Tivadar to kill Mel, and Ambessa ordered Mel to help her take Tivadar hostage. They both refused and formed a separate plan to try and end the conflict peacefully. Ambessa's decision to kill Tivadar irreparably ruined their relationship, as Mel had considered her a true friend.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4)

Rudo was a  [Targonian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Targon "Universe:Targon") agent of the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") who, unbeknownst to Mel, was secretly her biological father. They met only once in the artists' district of [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun"), where Rudo disguised himself as a simple shopkeeper so he would have the opportunity to speak with her and to see what kind of person she had grown up to be. Although she regarded him as a stranger, Mel felt a connection to the man and was inspired by his beautiful artwork, confiding in him about how she always struggled to live up to her  [mother's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") expectations. Rudo offered her helpful advice, as well as one of his paintings to Mel. She chose a set of  [Rakkor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rakkor "Universe:Rakkor") tattoos to match his, which he imbued with powerful runes to keep the powers she had inherited from him hidden from the  [pale woman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"). Rudo also gave Mel one of his paintings anyway, which she kept on display in her room in Bel'zhun. His artwork marked the beginning of her interest in fine art, and Mel eventually took up painting as a hobby.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4)

Elora was Mel's best friend and closest confidante. They first met as teenagers in [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun") at the Golden Drake inn, where Elora was working on the staff and helped prepare Mel to receive her  [Targonian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Targon "Universe:Targon") tattoos. Months later, Elora was among the civilians in the crowd who rescued Mel from the wreckage of her  [father's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azizi "Universe:Azizi") carriage, and she later arrived to check on her. Mel's writing arm had been broken in the crash, so Elora offered to help her with the letter she was struggling to write.  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") had always taught Mel to be wary of who she trusted. Mel decided to break with this mindset, as she sensed that Elora was intelligent, observant, and a potential ally. Elora helped Mel investigate her father's death for the next few months, and they became close friends. After Mel was exiled to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), she was allowed to choose one person from Bel'zhun to accompany her on the trip.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4) Elora finally left her job at the Golden Drake to become Mel's personal assistant in Piltover, and she remained in this position for the rest of her life.

As Mel's assistant, Elora handled many of lady's communications with her business and political associates, including those with  [House Ferros](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Ferros "Universe:House Ferros"). Due to how closely they worked, Elora was aware of many of Mel's grander schemes, as well as her past and relationship with her mother. Elora was highly dedicated to both Mel's political ascent and her emotional well-being, expressing concern whenever something appeared to be troubling Mel and becoming apologetic whenever she felt she had failed her. Mel was later devastated when Elora was killed by the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose").

The true nature of Mel's birth was kept a secret from both her and the Black Rose, as her father  [Rudo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rudo "Universe:Rudo")—one of their agents—knew that the cabal would claim ownership of Mel if they were to learn she was his.[[4]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-4) The Black Rose did not learn Mel's secret until decades later, when Mel's brother  [Kino](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino") unearthed evidence of  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") affair in [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Basilich "Universe:Basilich"), after which they had Kino kidnapped and murdered. The Black Rose also killed Mel's best friend,  [Elora](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Elora "Universe:Elora"), and drove Ambessa to madness in her quest for vengeance, before eventually capturing Mel herself and locking her in a chamber designed to test her magical abilities. As a result of their actions, Mel was not fond of the Black Rose and actively plotted against them as soon as they set her free. When they spoke after the test,  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") referred to Mel as "sister" and manipulated her into joining their ranks, despite Mel's initial reluctance to kill her own mother. After learning the threat Ambessa posed to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), Mel was able to defeat both her mother and LeBlanc by briefly siding with the Black Rose until her mother was defeated, then double-crossing them immediately afterward; a move that was both clever and merciless, which finally earned Mel her mother's approval.

As Mel's abilities as an empath are extremely rare, the Black Rose remains interested in her, with  [Vladimir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vladimir "Universe:Vladimir") continuing to refer to her as an "opportunity" even after she had already turned on them.[[19]](#cite_note-Welcome_to_Noxus-19)

Mel respected Heimerdinger as the founder of Piltover. However, she saw his conservative and stifling ways to be a hindrance to her rise to power, and to the greater prosperity of Piltover as a whole. She would undermine his authority by aiding  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") to complete their experiment, then by legalizing the use of hextech in Piltover. When Heimerdinger convinced Jayce to postpone his gemstone presentation, Mel elevated Jayce to a Council seat, which allowed Jayce to circumvent Heimerdinger and later have him removed from the Council—a measure which Mel was the first to vote in favor of.

While initially using Jayce to gain more wealth and prestige, Mel would eventually have some deeper feelings towards the inventor—even defending him from the self-serving influence of her ambitious  [mother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"). She would be concerned over his issues and would give him sound advice, all while still putting her own goals into consideration. Over time, Mel became less reserved around Jayce and began sharing personal details about herself as well. While Mel's relationship with Jayce started out as a means to an end, it ultimately became sincere love for his ideals and optimism. Mel was crucial in Jayce's meteoric rise to fame: she even swayed the Council to elevate Jayce and grant him a seat on the Council. Jayce credited a large part of his success to Mel, as he felt that nothing was impossible as long as she was around. Mel, in turn, showed a great deal of concern for Jayce's wellbeing, and after he and  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") made clear that developing weapons went against what they stood for, she opposed her mother's attempts to start a war that would force them into this position.

Jayce would eventually confront Mel about her earlier manipulations of him and Viktor, but they would remain on good terms following the argument, with Jayce even reassuring Mel that she would never be a "passenger" in her own life. The two of them were instrumental in the defense of Piltover. After Jayce and Viktor had sacrificed themselves to destroy the hexcore, Mel presumably mourned him before leaving Piltover.

Mel and Viktor, while not close, maintained a working relationship for several years while he and  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") were building [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") inventions at the Council's request. Viktor had always sought to use hextech to help the poor and suffering, but Mel prioritized elevating Piltover's global status, which she achieved by ordering the construction of the Hexgate. When Jayce approached Mel about Viktor's terminal illness, she expressed concern, as she hadn't realized how close the two of them were. Viktor was later outraged when Mel suggested developing hextech weapons, calling her "ridiculous" for floating the possibility. In the name of peace, Mel eventually chose to support Jayce and Viktor's motion for Zaun's independence, and the three of them briefly celebrated before they were caught in  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") terrorist attack. Mel and Jayce were spared from the blast, but Viktor was not.

After Viktor had become the Herald, he attacked Mel and Jayce and was seemingly intrigued by Mel's newfound connection to the arcane. Mel and Jayce were able to defeat the puppet with the help of her magical abilities, but when she went to negotiate with Ambessa, Mel was horrified to see that Viktor had raised an entire army of his evolved soldiers. Upon her return, she and the Piltovan defense made plans to kill Viktor and save the city.

structure.name: Nocturne
structure.quote: *"The darkness is closing in..."*
structure.background:
### Origin

Nocturne was inadvertently created during the tail end of the [Rune Wars](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rune_Wars "Universe:Rune Wars"). Escalating tensions led desperate mages to resort to shadow magic, casting off their flesh and stepping into the [spirit realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_Realm "Universe:Spirit Realm"). Shadow mages became so powerful and pervasive that Nocturne was brought to life within the spirit realm, though the exact details of its manifestation remain a mystery.[[1]](#cite_note-NocturneBio-1)

Nocturne preyed on the mages who entered its domain so thoroughly and brutally that shadow magic become known as a dangerous and forbidden art. As the number of shadow mages dwindled, Nocturne languished in the spirit realm, starving for centuries. Eventually, however, Nocturne found the means to materialize in the physical world, and began to prey on mortal fear wherever it could.[[1]](#cite_note-NocturneBio-1)

Some time after the Rune Wars had ended, Nocturne tormented the nightmares of a  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") historian named Jens Tommen, who witnessed unimaginable horrors during his studies of the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles"). Feeling he might lose himself to paranoia, Tommen purchased transport to the Demacian settlement of [Fossbarrow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fossbarrow "Universe:Fossbarrow"), where he hoped his nightmares would finally end.[[2]](#cite_note-Nocturne_LoR_Flavor_Text-2)

### Haunting of Fossbarrow

According to local legend, a nightmarish [demon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demon "Universe:Demon") once attacked the Demacian settlement of [Fossbarrow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fossbarrow "Universe:Fossbarrow"), where it did battle against Fossian Crownguard, the famed hero for whom the town was originally named. As the story tells, Fossian and the demon fell from the top of the cliff, where he plunged his Demacian steel blade into the creature's black heart and ended its life once and for all. Fossian was mortally wounded after the fall, but the people honored him with a tomb in a cave at the side of the mountain, and celebrated his achievement in the form of a carving upon a marble slab.[[3]](#cite_note-ForDemaciaStory-3)

Unbeknownst to anyone else, Nocturne was still alive, sealed and sleeping in Fossian's tomb as it gathered its strength once more. After many years, Nocturne sensed the nightmares of Luca, the son of the local magistrate and a young mage, fearful of his own growing [magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic") and the hatred of his own neighbors. To Nocturne, these fears were childish and lacking any real substance, yet they proved potent enough to wake the demon from its long slumber. It began to stoke the nightmares within Luca's mind, tormenting him until he eventually made his way to Fossian's tomb, wanting to be near someone who had slain a demon. Here, Nocturne made Luca sleep and fully possessed his body. Luca was soon declared missing, and darkness soon began to spread into the surrounding forests and the city itself, infesting the dreams of every person in Fossbarrow and leaving them hopeless, sleepless, and paranoid in the following days.[[3]](#cite_note-ForDemaciaStory-3)

Fossian's great-granddaughter  [Luxanna Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") arrived in Fossbarrow shortly after Luca's disappearance. She told the guards she had come to honor her fallen forebear, but in truth, she wanted to explore the forests outside the city and learn more about her own magical abilities. On her first night there, Nocturne tormented her with a dream where she was sinking and suffocating in dark mud, with her light being snuffed out forever. While she was out riding the next morning, Nocturne pursued Lux again, urging her to sleep while she was investigating the town's curse and Luca's disappearance. Nocturne's attempt to subdue Lux was unsuccessful, as  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") and four other  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard") found her and interrupted the 2 [darkness](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Unspeakable_Horror "LoR:Unspeakable Horror") from taking hold.[[3]](#cite_note-ForDemaciaStory-3)

As Garen and Lux were searching for Luca, Nocturne used the paranoia of Fossbarrow's townsfolk to turn them against each other, driving a man named Aldo Dayan mad and making him murder his entire family and several of his neighbors. When he was caught, the townsfolk became riled up in a mob and demanded his execution, which was carried out by Garen after Magistrate Giselle gave the order. After Dayan was beheaded, the curse revealed itself and the whole town became flooded with the manifestations of all the inhabitants' worst nightmares, which took the form of monstrous visions and 4 [shadows](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Encroaching_Shadows "LoR:Encroaching Shadows"). Lux, having realized the source of the terror, rode to face Nocturne as Garen and his soldiers held off the creatures' advance.[[3]](#cite_note-ForDemaciaStory-3)

Upon entering Fossian's tomb, Lux found the young Luca, still possessed by the demon. When Lux tried to approach, Nocturne immobilized her by simply wagging a finger, then prepared to crack her head open with a sharp rock so it could feast on her nightmares. As Lux attempted to get through to Luca, Nocturne gloated that the boy could no longer hear her, and that even if he could, his terror was far too powerful to break free from. Nocturne believed Lux should know this all too well, for she was also a mage hiding from her own family and countrymen. In a swift act of defiance, Lux acknowledged her fear and refused to let it control her, building enough of a spark to move and make contact with Luca, expelling the demon with her magic. Nocturne, now loose in the cave, was subsequently defeated by the combined magic of Lux and Luca, but Lux admitted that even though the "nightmare-man" had been banished from the tomb and Fossbarrow, it was likely not gone for good.[[3]](#cite_note-ForDemaciaStory-3)

### Recent Events

#### Encounter with Sylas

:   *Main article: [The Mageseeker](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Mageseeker "The Mageseeker")*

During the [Great Mage Rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion"), Nocturne continued to feed on the nightmares of the  [Demacians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), lurking in the forests and waiting for a chance to strike at unsuspecting travelers. One day, as  [Sylas](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") and another rebel named  [Yops](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yops "Universe:Yops") were passing through in search of mages to join their cause, Nocturne began to stalk them, feeding on their fears. They soon became aware they were being pursued and fought Nocturne, forcing the demon to flee.[[4]](#cite_note-Mageseeker-4)

#### The Shadow Door

:   *Main article: [The Shadow Door](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Shadow_Door "Universe:The Shadow Door")*

One night in  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), Nocturne haunted the dreams of a man named Celwyn, tormenting him with visions of his son Abel being eaten alive after he read him a bedtime story. The nightmare persisted even after Celwyn thought he had already woken up, until Nocturne revealed itself to Celwyn and plunged its wicked blades into his heart. The next morning, Celwyn was nowhere to be found, the only trace of him being a few tendrils of dark mist. Abel, unable to find his father, left the room. The mist began to follow him.[[5]](#cite_note-ShadowDoor-5)
structure.appearance:
Nocturne is made of pure, inky-black darkness, only vaguely humanoid with a head and two arms. Its fingers appear clawed and its head is featureless save for two solid white eyes. From the waist down, its body seems to dissolve into a plume of black smoke.

It is usually seen wearing armor, either purple or red with a gray trim. It wears a breastplate and two large, spiked pauldrons. Its signature weapons are a pair of massive blades attached to either forearm, both viciously curved with numerous points.
structure.personality:
Nocturne is a [demonic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demon "Universe:Demon") entity that thrives on the nourishment derived from fear induced by nightmares. This malevolent being possesses an intimate understanding of individuals' deepest fears, allowing it to expertly exploit and manipulate their vulnerabilities. In its pursuit of sustenance, Nocturne revels in the psychological torment it inflicts upon its victims, creating an atmosphere of profound dread and isolation.

In its insatiable quest for mortal fear, Nocturne revels in the perverse satisfaction derived from plunging the world into shadows. This malefic entity holds an innate disdain for the brilliance of light and seeks to envelop every soul it encounters in an eternal abyss of darkness. In this relentless pursuit, Nocturne spares no mercy for the innocent and remorselessly extinguishes life, all while feeding voraciously on the exquisite banquet of nightmares and the paralyzing grip of terror.
structure.abilities:
- **[Demon Physiology](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demon "Universe:Demon"):** Nocturne is a demon, a malevolent spirit that feeds from human emotions. it has no physical form and cannot be harmed by physical weapons (unless it has magical properties). Each demon is linked to a specific emotion, in this case, Nocturne feeds itself on the fear that comes from nightmares.
  - **Emotional Feeding:** Like other demons, Nocturne can feed itself from an specific emotion, in it's case, the fear that comes from nightmares. By absorbing the fears of others, Nocturne can sustain itself for prolonged periods of time. Nocturne instinctively knows ones nightmares.
  - **Immortality:** So long as nightmares exist, Nocturne will continue existing in some form.
  - **Shadow Form:** Nocturne is composed of pure darkness that it can mold at will.
  - **Dream Control:** Nocturne can control the dreams of others to its will, it can mold the dream escape of its victims to its will, turning even the most pleasant dream in a hellish nightmare.

relations.relationship_description: Nocturne terrorized the Demacian settlement of Fossbarrow until  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") and  [Lux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lux "Universe:Lux") expelled it from the neighboring tomb. It was sealed in the grave of their great-grandfather Fossian, who died during the fight versus Nocturne, before it was woken up by a mage boy named Luca.

Sylas used to hear tales about Nocturne when he was young. During the [Great Mage Rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion"), Sylas encountered Nocturne in the woods, disguising itself as  [Morgana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Morgana "Universe:Morgana") and admonishing him for the blood on his hands. Seeing through the demon's illusion, Sylas defeated Nocturne in battle, reverting to its true form and fading away.

structure.trivia:
- Nocturne came into being around the time of the [Rune Wars](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rune_Wars "Universe:Rune Wars") and is thus estimated to be around 1000 years old.[[1]](#cite_note-NocturneBio-1)[[6]](#cite_note-Realms-6)
- According to Nocturne's flavour text in  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra"), the demon came back to the material realm through the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles") where it haunted the historian Jens Tommen, who tried to escape by fleeing to [Fossbarrow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fossbarrow "Universe:Fossbarrow") in  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia").
  - The location likely references the short story [For Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:For_Demacia "Universe:For Demacia"), where it would become the site of one of Nocturne's most well-known hauntings.

structure.name: Tamara
structure.background:
She acted as a Piltovan apprenta with the intention of getting in to one of the Piltovan Trade Clan’s hextech dealings so she could provide intel for  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). She was discovered by  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") and promptly ejected from Piltover by a Shuriman cargo vessel, but Tamara already figured this as a probable eventuality and the standard Noxian contingency of “always send two warmasons” paid off. Her colleague Colette remained undiscovered, and is still acting within Piltover for Noxus.

Tamara returned to her post in the Noxian military serving as the personal Warmason of Darius. At the city of [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Basilich "Basilich"), she was there to provide intel on the situation for Darius as Noxus prepared to siege the rebellious city, and had a bit of a spat with  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven").

She then returned with Draven to Noxus, but ran through a Bandlewood along the way. She, Draven and the Noxian troops fought against  [Tristana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tristana "Universe:Tristana") and  [Lulu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lulu "Universe:Lulu"). During the scuffle, Tamara was knocked unconscious by Tristana with a magical cannonball to the gut.
structure.appearance: Tamara has straight medium-length brown hair, which she braids into a long ponytail. Tamara has light blue eyes. She's said to be very pretty by her friend. Tamara also seems to take care of her looks. She has a tanner skin tone that gets even stronger when she's constantly working outside or travelling for long weeks.
