structure.name: Renekton
structure.quote: *"Blood! And vengeance!"*
structure.background:
### Early Life

As a child, Renekton was a fearless fighter, often engaging in street fights out of pride and enjoyment. Although his older brother  [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus") disapproved of his behavior, Renekton continued to fight and fight, completely ignoring his brother's thoughts.

Later on in life, when Nasus left to join the prestigious Collegium of the Sun, he concerned about his brother getting killed by the fights he constantly getting himself into with them grew bigger as days passed. Eventually, he was able to help him enter into the  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") army, though he was underage.

### Gatekeeper of Shurima

#### Service to Shurima

In the army, Renekton found a new purpose and fought in numerous battles with the help of his brute strength and  [Nasus'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus") strategic planning, including in the battle of [Zuretta](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zuretta "Zuretta") where he single-handedly fought one to ten and won, successfully held off until Nasus and his reinforcements intervened. He earned the title of "Gatekeeper of Shurima" after the act.

As he served the army for many decades, he earned a reputation for himself, with the aiming to be stronger than any other living entities and even overpower the [God-Warriors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:God-Warrior "Universe:God-Warrior"), but inside that battle-scarred body lies a caring heart and a place for his brother Nasus. When he learned of his brother's impending death due to a curse, he immediately rushed to the [Sun Disc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Sun_Disc "Universe:The Sun Disc"), where Nasus lay barely alive. To save his brother's life, Renekton carried him up the stairs of The Sun Disc, knowing that the process would likely obliterate him. Despite his unworthiness thoughts, Renekton's sacrifice led to the ascension of both brothers, with Renekton becoming a powerful crocodile.

With his new powers, Renekton continued to lead the Shuriman army to victory for centuries, becoming an unstoppable force topping the power of his old-self, following Shurima's footsteps in every victorious battle. Though as the centuries went on, many believe his mortality was lost when he stepped into the light. When [Nashramae](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nashramae "Nashramae") was captured and put under the law of Shurima, the crocodile beast went rampage and destroyed the grand library, completely annihilated it during the siege of the place. Nasus, hearing this, arrived at the scene to confront Renekton, causing his bloodlust dissipated under his brother's stern gaze and he turned away in shame.

#### Collapse of the Sun Disc

During the battle of  [Icathia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Icathia "Universe:Icathia"), Renekton fought alongside  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox"),  [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus"), and several other Ascended beings. However, things took a turn for the worse when the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void") was unleashed during the battle , inflicting the dangerous [Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Voidborn "Universe:Voidborn") upon them.

Around the same time,  [Azir's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir") ascension was sabotaged by  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath"), who killed him and stole his power. When the brothers learned of this, they hurried back to the capital. However, upon their return a few days later, Xerath had absorbed so much energy that he had become nothing but solid energy himself, making him the most dangerous [Baccai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Baccai "Baccai") ever unleashed.

In an effort to contain Xerath's power, the brothers managed to trap him within a sarcophagus but it was not easy since Xerath retaliated. It took a while for the duos to force him down the empire's tomb. Renekton then ordered Nasus to seal the tomb, knowing that he himself would be trapped there with Xerath for eternity. With a heavy heart, Nasus carried out Renekton's order and sealed the tomb, leaving the two trapped in the darkness forever.

#### Tomb of the Emperors

Trapped within the tomb, Renekton continued to battle Xerath in the darkness. However, as centuries passed, the isolation and the unending battle took a toll on Renekton's mind and willpower, causing him to slowly lose his grip on sanity. Xerath, taking advantage of Renekton's weakened state, began to poison his mind and twist his thoughts.

Renekton soon became convinced that Nasus, his own brother, had been jealous of his power and had taken pleasure in locking him in the tomb with Xerath. This delusion only served to fuel Renekton's anger and despair, leading him to lash out at Nasus whenever he thought of him.

### Contemporary History

#### Rebirth of Shurima

:   *Main article: [Descent into the Tomb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Descent_into_the_Tomb "Universe:Descent into the Tomb")*

In the year 989 AN,  [Sivir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir "Universe:Sivir"), a treasure hunter hired by  [Cassiopeia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassiopeia "Universe:Cassiopeia"), ventured into the tomb in search of riches. However, Cassiopeia betrayed Sivir and inadvertently released both Renekton and  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") from their imprisonment.

Upon his release, Renekton, driven by the scent of his brother, immediately set out to find  [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus"). However, he soon discovered that the world he knew eons ago had changed drastically, as he now wandered a desert landscape vastly different from the one he remembered. He surveyed the familiar scorching desert of  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") he once had known and continued his search with a single-minded focus.

#### The Sandthrashers

:   *Main article: [With Teeth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:With_Teeth "Universe:With Teeth")*

As Renekton searched the desert for his brother, he stumbled upon a group called the Sandthrashers led by Sai-Surtha. Upon discovering the group's latest victim, Uksem Heartsplitter, Renekton demanded to know the whereabouts of his brother. Instead of answering his question, Sai-Surtha's challenged Renekton to a duel.

Even when being haunted by memories of Xerath's power, Renekton emerged victorious from the battle, though he was sliced into pieces before re-forging himself and throwing the Sandthrasher's body into the jaws of a nearby predator. Turning his attention to the remaining members of the group, Renekton confronted 7 [Raz Bloodmane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Raz_Bloodmane "LoR:Raz Bloodmane"), who suggested that Nasus might be found near the cliffs of Azuma.

Choosing to spare Raz's life, Renekton left the group behind and continued his search for Nasus.

#### Empire of the Ascended

:   *Note: The following information comes from [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Legends_of_Runeterra "Legends of Runeterra") and may or may not be considered canon to the official timeline.*

While searching for Nasus, Renekton encountered a sand runner who had been sent by Azir to collect a medallion from the Sandthrasher's cavern. Cornering the runner near a sand spire after escaping the 1 [Bloodthirsty Marauder](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Bloodthirsty_Marauder "LoR:Bloodthirsty Marauder"), Renekton attempted to take the medallion, but the runner managed to escape by dodging Renekton's axe and triggering a cave-in.

Later on, Renekton joined forces with the Sandthrashers and found a tower where Nasus was being held. However, upon seeing his brother, Renekton was consumed by the poisonous thoughts that Xerath had implanted in his mind ages ago. He crashed into the wall and found himself in the 3 [Chamber of Renewal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Chamber_of_Renewal "LoR:Chamber of Renewal") with both Nasus and the sand runner from earlier.

In a fit of rage, Renekton attacked Nasus, allowing the scout to use the portal that Nasus had just gone through to escape. As the battle between the two brothers continued, they both grew to a gigantic size, towering over everyone else. The outcome of the battle and their fates remain unknown.
structure.appearance:
Renekton is a hulking monstrosity, being bipedal like a human but with the head of a crocodile. His body is covered in scales, green in the back and pale tan in the front. His beady, yellow-orange eyes seem to glow with pure rage. Each limb has only four digits, all with sharp, black claws. He has a long, reptilian tail.

Renekton generally wears only a few pieces of armor, silver and intricately crafted, on his head, shoulders, neck, forearms, and shins. Aside from this, he wears a faded greenish-brown loin cloth. His weapon of choice is a massive crescent-shaped axe.
structure.personality:
Even when Renekton was still a noble warrior, he has always had a violent side, liking to get into fights as a result of his hotheaded and unpredictable nature. When Renekton became an Ascended, he sometimes embraced his animalistic side while in battle, destroying entire cities in ways that shocked even those who saw him as a hero. While he was renowned for his cruelty and ruthlessness in battle, Renekton was still good at heart and cared deeply for his brother  [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus"), even willing to sacrifice himself to save him, but these traits left Renekton vulnerable to  [Xerath's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") influence in the millennia they were locked away, and ultimately became Renekton's defining traits in his insanity.

While Nasus believes his brother is truly gone, some remain hopeful that the old Ascended hero could one day reclaim his old humanity to defeat his new, tyrannical master.
structure.abilities:
- **[Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ascended "Universe:Ascended"):** Also known as God-Warriors or Sunborn, the Ascended are mortals that were empowered by the [Sun Disc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Sun_Disc "Universe:The Sun Disc") into immensely powerful demigods. Each Ascended has unique powers depending on the individual they were prior to the Ascension.
  - **Regeneration:** Renekton can heal from almost any injury extremely fast or even in seconds.
  - **Superhuman Strength:** Renekton is exponentially stronger than any normal human, being able to destroy buildings by merely punching them, or break a man's entire body with his fists.
  - **Size Shifting:** Renekton can change size to become gigantic and destroy his foes.
  - **Immortality:** The Ascended do not age, and do not need to eat or sleep. Barring beings of similar power, the Ascended cannot be killed.
  - **[Dominus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Renekton#Dominus "Renekton"):** Renekton is able to channel his fury and bloodlust to heal himself of any wound even fatal ones, as seen in his duel against Sai-Surtha. Renekton is also able to increase his size tenfold with this ability.
- **Combat Prowess:** Even before his ascension, Renekton was a powerful and ruthless warrior, with his weapon of choice being a  [crescent blades](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Renekton#Ruthless_Predator "Renekton"). He was the one responsible for training  [Azir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir") in combat, and was able to hold  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") at bay over millennia.

relations.relationship_description: Nasus is the older brother of Renekton and became Ascended at the same time as him. While Nasus planned the battles, Renekton was the one to win the battles. When  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") forced his Ascension, both Renekton and Nasus went to stop him and were the only two God-Warriors there. After a fierce battle, Renekton ordered Nasus to close the Tomb of the Emperors. However, the millennia in darkness with Xerath drove Renekton mad, and he forgot his own sacrifice, being led to believe Nasus had betrayed and abandoned him to his fate. Having now escaped, Renekton is hunting down Nasus in hopes of getting his revenge.
Renekton respects Azir and willingly served him in the past, while also training him in the ways of combat. Azir hopes to help him remember what he has forgotten.

Renekton spent eons battling Xerath within the tomb of the emperors. During this time, Xerath manipulated his slowing breaking his mind to turn him against his brother  [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus"). [Saikhal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Saikhal "Saikhal"), Xerath's birthplace, was conquered by Renekton. Xerath was likely taken as a child slave at that time.
Sivir's interference allowed Renekton to escape the Tomb of the Emperors.

[Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox"), [Varus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Varus "Universe:Varus"), [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast"), [Xolaani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xolaani "Universe:Xolaani"), 2 [Anaakca](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Spear "LoR:The Darkin Spear"), 1 [Baalkux](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Staff "LoR:The Darkin Staff"), 2 [Horazi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Lodestone "LoR:The Darkin Lodestone"), 2 [Ibaaros](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Harpoon "LoR:The Darkin Harpoon"), 2 [Joraal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Aegis "LoR:The Darkin Aegis"),  [Naafiri](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Naafiri "Universe:Naafiri"), 1 [Naganeka](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Ballista "LoR:The Darkin Ballista"), 2 [Praa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Fan "LoR:The Darkin Fan"), 2 [Styraatu](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Harp "LoR:The Darkin Harp"), and 1 [Tarrosh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Halberd "LoR:The Darkin Halberd") were all part of Host of [God-Warriors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/God-Warrior "God-Warrior"), and all served  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") together with Renekton.

structure.trivia:
- Renekton is inspired by the Egyptian god [Sobek](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sobek), specifically based on the military prowess and animal aggression that both share in their lore.
- Renekton is the younger brother of Nasus, being born over 3796 years ago.
  - [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus") fought alongside Setaka for 3 centuries before she died in the battle of Icathia, which happened around 2500 BN.
  - Their Ascensions occurred at the same time, and they are among the later Ascended.
- Renek was one of the nations that belonged to the ancient  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") Empire and was possibly located somewhere near the [Renek River](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Renek_River "Renek River"). The siblings may have originated from here and Renekton may have been named after it.
- As it took several days for Nasus and Renekton to return from  [Icathia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Icathia "Universe:Icathia") to the [Sun Disc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Sun_Disc "Universe:The Sun Disc"), it is assumed that a normal Ascension ritual took a long time, and that  [Xerath's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") was far longer than normal (with his body now being made of arcana magic).
- Renekton is struggling to regain his sanity, constantly slipping back and forth between lucidity and utter madness. It has been speculated that remnants of Renekton's old self remain, despite  [Xerath's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") manipulations.

structure.name: Tobias
structure.background:
### Early Life

Not much is known about Tobias's life in Piltover. He would eventually marry  [Cassandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassandra "Universe:Cassandra") of the influential  [Clan Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman") and have a daughter,  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"). Caitlyn was a gifted sharpshooter and was known to win competitions, and Tobias would celebrate afterwards by showing off his hunting rifle and chatting with other high society Piltovans.[[3]](#cite_note-105enemy-3) At some point, Tobias and his wife saw talent and ambition in young  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") and decided to support his education and research at the Academy as his patrons. They granted him access to their building in the Academy district to serve as his workshop.[[4]](#cite_note-102mysteries-4)

### Era of Hextech

#### Discovery of Hextech

One day, when  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") was helping  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") carry expensive laboratory materials to his workshop, an explosion suddenly shook the building as robbers from the undercity escaped out the balcony. Jayce hit his head as a result of the explosion and was later arrested for owning unauthorized, hazardous materials. Although Caitlyn was not seriously hurt, Tobias was absolutely furious with him for putting her in harm's way and argued with Caitlyn and Cassandra for wanting to defend him at the trial. After the trial exposed the extent of Jayce's crime, which included illegal tampering into the arcane, Jayce was expelled from the Academy in disgrace, and Tobias forbid Caitlyn from being friends with Jayce anymore.[[4]](#cite_note-102mysteries-4) Jayce would quickly prove the Council wrong, however, and after he successfully completed his [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") experiment and proved that the arcane could be safely wielded through technology,[[5]](#cite_note-103base-5) his research was approved and he regained the Kirammans' sponsorship.[[6]](#cite_note-104progress-6)

When Caitlyn became an adult, she decided to pursue a career as an  [enforcer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") so she could see more of the "real world." Her parents disapproved of her career choice and would pull diplomatic and legal strings to have her assigned to menial tasks away from any danger.[[6]](#cite_note-104progress-6)

#### Piltovan Bicentennial

At the fair for Piltover's bicentennial Progress Day, Tobias and Cassandra invited Jayce to their tent to boast about their support for him, and were later present at his speech that night. However, shortly after the speech, a terrorist bombing struck the Academy Square in which Caitlyn was injured and six enforcers were killed. After this, Tobias and Cassandra spoke to the Sheriff,  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus"), and had her removed from the force for her own safety. Caitlyn did not obey any of them and began an independent investigation on her own, and they lost track of her after she disappeared into the undercity.[[6]](#cite_note-104progress-6)[[3]](#cite_note-105enemy-3)

A few days later, Caitlyn returned to the Kiramman mansion with  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), and despite Cassandra's anger at her disappearance, Tobias was overjoyed that she had returned home safe and sound. As Caitlyn had been injured during her adventure, Tobias treated her wounds with a first-aid kit and told her to get some rest, after which Caitlyn and Vi made plans to present the results of her investigation to the Piltover Council.[[7]](#cite_note-108oil"-7)

#### Attack on the Council

Caitlyn disappeared shortly after presenting her findings to the Council, having been kidnapped by  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") as she was taking a shower. Soon after, Tobias' wife, Cassandra, was killed in a  [terrorist attack](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Super_Mega_Death_Rocket! "Jinx") by Jinx that blew up the Piltovan seat of government.[[8]](#cite_note-109monster-8)[[9]](#cite_note-201heavy-9) Tobias was devastated by the loss of his wife and stopped leaving the house, becoming noticeably more disheveled and despondent after his daughter and Vi returned from  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun").

After Cassandra's funeral, Caitlyn received an invitation to the memorial service for the fallen councilors, where they were to reveal a statue to honor her memory. In their living room, Caitlyn sat with her father and confessed that she had a chance to kill Jinx, but hesitated before taking the shot, which would have prevented Cassandra's death. In response, Tobias entrusted his daughter with the Kiramman Key; an heirloom passed down to the head of their clan for generations, which had been left to her in her mother's will. When Vi looked into the room, Tobias angrily asked what she was still doing in their house, and Caitlyn hastily left to go speak with her.[[9]](#cite_note-201heavy-9)

At some point before the memorial, Caitlyn left again to be alone in the arboretum where she and her mother used to walk together. Tobias knew where she was, and when Jayce visited the Kiramman manor to speak with her, he told him where to find her.[[9]](#cite_note-201heavy-9)

### Recent History

Tobias continued to live with his daughter in the Kiramman manor while she was commander during the martial law period. Caitlyn would send her girlfriend at the time,  [Maddie](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Maddie "Universe:Maddie"), to check on him every so often.[[10]](#cite_note-208killing-10)
structure.appearance: Tobias is a fit middle aged man of Ionian ancestry with dark brown eyes, dark blue hair and beard (with gray streaks). He is often seen wearing typical wealthy Piltovan suits. After Cassandra's death, his appearance became more ragged and pale with his hair uncombed, only wearing a robe over his pajamas as he remained in the Kiramman mansion.
structure.personality: Although Tobias did not receive much character development during the first season of the series, he appears to be a caring father who is not as strict as Cassandra. After Cassandra's death, his personality became less cheerful and more heartbroken, seemingly not wanting to leave his house anymore as he remained in his pajamas. He also appeared more hostile towards people from the undercity, despite showing no indication of prejudice beforehand.
structure.abilities:
- **First Aid Knowledge:** Tobias shows some medical knowledge due to being able to mend his daughter's wounds after several violent situations.
- **Hunting:** Just like the rest of his family, Tobias has an interest in hunting as a hobby.
- **Rifle Proficiency:** Like his wife and daughter, Tobias is skilled with a rifle.

relations.relationship_description: Cassandra was the matriarch of the family, and Tobias was a supportive husband and father to their daughter,  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"). Tobias often played the peacemaker between Cassandra and Caitlyn, as the two would frequently quarrel. Despite their differences, Tobias loved his wife very much and was stricken with grief after she died, so much that he stopped taking care of himself and would lash out at others.

Tobias is Caitlyn's father, and as a hunter, he likely held some role in her interest in becoming a marksman. He is very supportive of his daughter and would frequently defend her actions when  [Cassandra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassandra "Universe:Cassandra") would express her disapproval, often playing peacemaker during their quarrels. He cares very much about Caitlyn's well-being and is there to use his medical expertise to heal her when she gets hurt on the job. Tobias was very protective of his daughter and would become angry with anyone who put her in danger, even unintentionally.

After Cassandra's death, Caitlyn and Tobias mourned her together. When Caitlyn blamed herself for failing to take the shot and kill  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), Tobias affirmed his support for her by bestowing upon her the  [Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman") key, reassuring her that it was her "legacy" to lead Clan Kiramman in her mother's place. Tobias would later help  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") to find and comfort Caitlyn, directing him to where she was when he came to visit.

When his daughter, Caitlyn, was with Jayce when his laboratory exploded after a break-in, Tobias was angered that Jayce had apparently put Caitlyn's life at risk. However, Caitlyn and her mother were in agreement to speak in defense of Jayce during his trial, and Tobias deferred to his wife on the matter. After Jayce's expulsion from Piltover Academy (due to him revealing to the Council of his desires to create magic), the Kirammans who sponsored him shunned him since he became a social embarrassment. Caitlyn's parents forbade Caitlyn of any further interactions with Jayce, with Tobias calling him a "misfit." This lasted until Jayce successfully completed his hextech experiment, which proved it was a viable and revolutionary practice. Jayce's services once again became in demand, after which he regained the Kirammans' favor and was yet again sponsored by them.

Tobias first met Vi when he and Cassandra caught Caitlyn sneaking her through her window. He didn't seem to mind Vi's presence, simply expressing relief that his daughter was safe as he tended to her injuries. After Jinx's attack on the Council and Cassandra's death, the grief-stricken Tobias seemed to turn on Vi, angrily questioning why Caitlyn was still keeping her around.

[Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") began a romantic relationship with Maddie during the martial law period, during which time she became a familiar face in the  [Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman") mansion. Caitlyn would sometimes send Maddie to check on her father.[[10]](#cite_note-208killing-10)

structure.background:
### Darkin War

Zaahen was born around 5000 BN - 3400 BN in Shurima. In his adulthood, he became a respected warrior and Ascended into a bird-like form with silver wings. In this time, he selected and directed the Ascensions of many, including:  [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast"),  [Varus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Varus "Universe:Varus"),  [Xolaani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xolaani "Universe:Xolaani") and Setaka. Zaahen swore to fight beside them and guard the light that made them.[[1]](#cite_note-Unsundered-1)

While many of his Ascended kin fell to darkness after witnessing the horrors of the Void during the war with Icathia and the collapse of the Shuriman Empire,[[2]](#cite_note-2) Zaahen was one of the few Ascended who retained much of their sanity and benevolent nature, despite becoming a  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin") himself. Feeling responsible for their fall from grace, Zaahen fought against his corrupted brethren in the [Darkin War](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Darkin_War "Universe:Great Darkin War"), where he and humanity learned how to seal the Darkin into their weapons.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)

With his new knowledge, Zaahen traveled to the  [First Lands](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") to aid in the resistance against Darkin invasion, a conflict known now as the "War of the False Kanmei" by Ionians.[[4]](#cite_note-Devoted-4) In Koeshin, he saved the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") when they struggled to defend their last stronghold. He met with the leaders of the order:  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen"), The Heart of the Tempest;  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara"), The Fist of Shadow; and  [Bhinan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bhinan "Universe:Bhinan"), The Eye of Twilight; and offered his aid. While wary of allying with one of the god-warriors, the Kinkou had no alternative and accepted it after Bhinan judged his intentions. Zaahen shared how to defeat and seal his siblings and for nearly three years, the Kinkou and Zaahen fought back the Darkin invaders, ultimately sealing  [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast"), 9 [Praa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:06IO023T1 "LoR:06IO023T1"),[[5]](#cite_note-YunBio-5)  [Varus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Varus "Universe:Varus"), and  [Xolaani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xolaani "Universe:Xolaani"). While fighting beside him, the Kinkou assigned Yunara to monitor Zaahen and, if necessary, eliminate him should he betray them.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)

During his confrontation with Rhaast, the two fought for many days and nights, even as their mortal allies rested to count their dead. Zaahen offered Rhaast a chance to fight beside him again—as he had with all his brethren he hunted—but Rhaast, like the others, refused, reveling in his newfound power. He questioned why Zaahen had not joined them, declaring that they were the new masters of this world. As they exchanged blows, Zaahen heard Yunara calling to him. He retorted that they were masters of nothing and that, if the Darkin could not be saved, they had to be destroyed.[[1]](#cite_note-Unsundered-1)

After the war ended, Bhinan judged him once more and deemed him safe to return to his homeland. However, Zaahen began to fear that he too would eventually become like his fallen siblings, and asked to be sealed within his glaive in the Temple of Twilight and kept safe within the Spirit Realm. His request was fulfilled, and Yunara stayed with him to protect the Temple for all times.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)

To help their nation heal, the Kinkou spun his and Yunara's tale into a legend about how a shrine maiden and a mighty spirit fought back against malevolent pretenders in the War of the False Kanmei.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)[[4]](#cite_note-Devoted-4)

During Zaahen's long confinement within the Spirit Realm, Yunara often visited the temple, though she never crossed its threshold. He believed she wished to free him, but they both knew that she could not. Inside him, a war still raged between the Darkin and the divine. Still, her presence reminded Zaahen of the better part of his nature: his time as an Ascended, when he and his brethren once fought for good.[[1]](#cite_note-Unsundered-1) His presence would attract azakana to the temple, but Yunara would repel them.[[5]](#cite_note-YunBio-5)

### Return to Runeterra

Centuries later, a disturbance in the Spirit Realm sent the Temple of Twilight and Yunara back to the material realm.[[4]](#cite_note-Devoted-4)  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") sought to claim Zaahen's weapon for her own purposes and subjugated the demon  [Atakhan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Atakhan "Universe:Atakhan") to locate him.[[6]](#cite_note-6)

The Temple of Twilight's return sent the demons of Ionia into a frenzy, prompting them to attack the nearby town of Koeshin, and lured Yunara away from her post. While Yunara and  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao") took up arms to defend the town, Atakhan made his way toward the temple. After defeating the demonic forces, Yunara,  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen"), and Xin were alerted that the temple's defenses had been breached.[[7]](#cite_note-7)

As they advanced toward the temple, Yunara and Kennen revealed to Xin the truth about Zaahen. By the time they arrived, however, the temple had already retreated back into the Spirit Realm, with Atakhan already inside. To reach Zaahen, Xin and Yunara would have to overcome the Trials of Twilight, a test created by the temple to judge the strength and honor of those who entered.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)

Within the temple, Xin Zhao experienced a vision of  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") in ruins and  [Jarvan IV](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV") corrupted by the Darkin. When presented with a Darkin weapon of his own, Zaahen intervened and warned him not to take it, allowing Xin to pass the trial. Upon reuniting with Yunara, she expressed surprise that Zaahen had aided them and believed there was still good left within him. Refusing to abandon him, they rushed off to find his weapon.[[8]](#cite_note-Warning-8)

When they finally reached Zaahen's weapon, they found that LeBlanc had already claimed it—now embedded in Atakhan's shadowy flesh. The two tried to fight the demon and free Zaahen, but were overwhelmed by the combined might of the sorceress and her demonic servant. As Atakhan moved in for the kill, Xin reached out to Zaahen's glaive to commune with its spirit. Within Zaahen's mindscape, the fallen god warned Xin to leave, insisting that mortals should not meddle with the power of gods. He declared that he was not the answer to their problems, only evil deferred. But Xin refused, arguing that they had no other choice and that Zaahen's power would darken the world, with or without his permission. Xin reminded him that he had once sacrificed himself to save the world and urged him to let him do the same. Unable to hold back Atakhan's assault anymore, Xin's strength began to fail, and in his final plea, Zaahen finally relented. Taking Xin Zhao as his host, Zaahen returned to the world once more and destroyed Atakhan with a single, devastating slash of his glaive, forcing LeBlanc to retreat, a faint smile on her lips.[[9]](#cite_note-Twilight-9)

After taking Xin Zhao's body, Zaahen quietly departed. Yunara brought Xin's spear home to  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), but was unable to tell his people the truth about what befell his body and prayed that Zaahen would honor his sacrifice.[[10]](#cite_note-10)
structure.appearance:
Zaahen is a tall and slender humanoid figure. He has glowing red eyes, pale gray skin, and long white hair. He wears no shirt, but his chest and arms are adorned with types of Shuriman amulets and necklaces, and he wears a dark blue cloak around his hips, as well as wings resembling a red cape on his back.

In his Ascended form, Zaahen was a tall humanoid figure with bird-like features. His head is that of a golden falcon with red eyes. He wore robes similar to those of Shuriman priests, in white and gold colors.

When he was human, Zaahen was a brown-skinned man with shaved hair, with a veil on his head, a forehead ornament, and several golden ornaments on his body. He wore robes similar to those of Shuriman priests, in white and gold colors.
structure.personality:
Unlike the other Darkin, who have a clear purpose for their carnage, Zaahen stands apart, aware of their race's malicious nature and opposes them. In his free form, he is incredibly stoic, empathetic, and patient, whereas in his glaive form, he seems to become more mysterious.

Having once guided them as Ascended, Zaahen feels deeply responsible for his siblings' fall from grace. Despite the futility, he offered each Darkin he hunted a chance to fight beside him once more.[[1]](#cite_note-Unsundered-1) A piece of his immortal heart breaks each time he has to kill one of his brothers or sisters.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)
structure.abilities:
- **Darkin Physiology**:As a member of the Darkin, Zaahen possesses a physiology different from that of mortals, such as superior strength, durability, speed, and agility.
  - **Immortality**:As an ancient warrior god, Zaahen is immortal; he does not age or get sick, and he does not need to eat or drink to sustain himself. He can only be sealed within his weapon, as there are very few things that can truly kill a Darkin.
- **Hemomancy**:Like the rest of his siblings, Zaahen knows blood magic and can use it to manipulate the blood, flesh, and bones of both himself and others.
  - **Possession**: Zaahen can possess the bodies of those who wield his spear
- **Combat Abilities**: As an ancient Warrior God, Zaahen is a highly trained warrior with millennia of military experience.
- **[Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ascended "Universe:Ascended"):** Although Zaahen is trapped in his weapon, he is not completely corrupted and can still use his [Sun Disc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Sun_Disc "Universe:The Sun Disc") powers.

relations.relationship_description: When the  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") [god-warriors](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:God-Warrior "Universe:God-Warrior") began their conquests throughout  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra"), Zaahen was saddened to see his kind, the once-noble heroes, fall to the darkness within them. Zaahen felt responsible for the world's suffering and went to slay the Darkin, many of whom he had considered his brothers and sisters. In  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), Zaahen helped to seal numerous Darkin into their own weapons, including  [Rhaast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rhaast "Universe:Rhaast"),  [Varus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Varus "Universe:Varus"), and  [Xolaani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xolaani "Universe:Xolaani"). After the war was over, Zaahen chose to be imprisoned in a similar fashion by the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") for fear he might one day become like the other Darkin.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3)

Zaahen met Yunara when he came to help defend  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") from the Darkin and their followers. Zaahen's power impressed the Kinkou, but also made them wary, so they assigned their Fist of Shadow Yunara to keep an eye on him and be ready to eliminate him if he betrayed them. In time, Yunara came to respect Zaahen as a trusted ally and hero of the First Lands, but he had grown to distrust himself and asked the Kinkou to seal him away in the Temple of Twilight, which was then hidden in the [spirit realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_Realm "Universe:Spirit Realm"). Yunara stood guard in the temple for over a thousand years as its protector to ensure Zaahen would not be freed by malevolent forces. When the temple was eventually breached by  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") and  [Atakhan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Atakhan "Universe:Atakhan"), Yunara and  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao") went to go stop them, at first believing the Darkin had returned to free Zaahen.[[3]](#cite_note-Truth-3) After her trial, in which Yunara heard Zaahen's voice, she decided there was still good in Zaahen and went to rescue him from the invaders.[[8]](#cite_note-Warning-8)

While Xin Zhao first learned of Zaahen from  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") and  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara"), Zaahen first spoke to the Seneschal in a vision during his trial at the Temple of Twilight, where he sternly warned Xin Zhao that claiming a Darkin weapon was "not the answer" he was seeking, which convinced Xin Zhao and Yunara that there was good in him.[[8]](#cite_note-Warning-8) When the battle against  [Atakhan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Atakhan "Universe:Atakhan") and  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") grew dire, Xin Zhao grabbed the glaive from Atakhan and tried to convince Zaahen to take his body, as the Darkin's power was their only hope for victory. When Zaahen urged Xin Zhao that there was no coming back from his decision, the Seneschal had already decided to sacrifice himself to protect the Darkin's power from falling into the wrong hands. As Xin Zhao's spirit crumbled, Zaahen reluctantly took up his spear and claimed his body to rescue Yunara and eliminate the attackers.[[9]](#cite_note-Twilight-9)

structure.trivia:
- Zaahen used  [Xin Zhao](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xin_Zhao "Universe:Xin Zhao")'s body as his host, killing him in the process.
- Zaahen's physical form debuted in the [Twilight's End](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Twilight%27s_End "Universe:Twilight's End") cinematic.
- Zaahen's canonical height is 7 feet or 213.36 centimeters, not including his horns.[[11]](#cite_note-11)
- Zaahen's Ascended form is possibly that of a [Silverwing Raptor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Silverwing "Silverwing"), as it was confirmed to not be based on a "real-life" bird and was hinted in his biography.[[12]](#cite_note-12)
- Based on his role as a mentor of the other Ascended, his shaved head and the circualar 'Sun-Disc' shaped ornament on his forehead, Zaahen is heavily implied to have been a Sun-Priest as a human responsible for determining who was worthy for the rites of Ascension.[[13]](#cite_note-13)
- Zaahen is considered one of the stronger Darkin. When asked who would in a fight between him and  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox"), [Isa Mari 'orkidian' De Leon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Isa_Mari_%27orkidian%27_De_Leon "Isa Mari 'orkidian' De Leon"), Zaahen's narrative writer, believed that they would possibly fight forever and whoever won would "just keel over soon after the battle's done".[[14]](#cite_note-14)

structure.name: Xolaani
structure.background:
### Life Before Ascension

:   *Main article: [The Faceless God](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Faceless_God "The Faceless God")*

Xolaani was the daughter of a healer. Her birth coincided with an auspicious solar cycle, and the presence of a previous incarnation of the **Aspect of the Protector**. At the time, Icathia's mages had begun to rebel against  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), [using the Void as a weapon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Where_Icathia_Once_Stood "Where Icathia Once Stood"). Xolaani followed her parent's path and became a healer, trying to save as many lives as she could with an ancient form of hemomancy. Seeing firsthand the suffering brought by the war, she spoke out against it, holding the leadership accountable for waging pointless wars. While the  [Shuriman emperor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir") would likely have prevented her Ascension, the priests of the [Sun Disc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sun_Disc "Sun Disc") deemed her worthy of Ascension. Xolaani successfully completed the Rite of Ascension, becoming a powerful [Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ascended "Ascended") [God-Warrior](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/God-Warrior "God-Warrior").[[1]](#cite_note-1)  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen") helped guide her during her Ascension, like he did many of his brethren.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

### The Darkin War

:   *Main article: [Great Darkin War](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Great_Darkin_War "Great Darkin War")*

As the Ascended battled in the [ensuing war](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rebellion_of_Icathia "Universe:Rebellion of Icathia") against the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void"), they were gradually consumed by madness, their minds cracking under the strain that could not damage their immortal bodies. After the Shuriman Empire following the death of  [Azir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir"), the Ascended became loss and directionless. The god-warriors began to fall, teaching themselves the forbidden sorcery of hemomancy, and saw themselves as the new masters of the world, becoming the  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin").[[3]](#cite_note-3) Xolaani was not exempt from this, and the once benevolent healer began to use her hemomancy to force her fellow [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin") into her servitude, believing that the only way to end the pointless wars was to forcefully unite the whole world under her control.[[4]](#cite_note-LoR-4) Those she had enthralled were said to have their hearts beat as one,[[5]](#cite_note-Bloodweaver-5) and every thought and muscle were hers to control.[[6]](#cite_note-Altar-6)

Because she attempted enslave her own brethren, the animosity between Xolaani and  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox") eventually boiled over until it sparked a civil war.[[4]](#cite_note-LoR-4) Their conflict threatened Runeterra's very existence.[[7]](#cite_note-7) Xolaani earned the moniker of the Coward of Icathia from Aatrox for her apparent distaste for war.[[8]](#cite_note-Aatrox-8)

According to legends, Xolaani was nearly defeated by  [Taarosh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taarosh "Universe:Taarosh"),[[9]](#cite_note-Taarosh-9) only to be saved by the timely intervention of [The Aspect of Twilight](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Aspect_of_Twilight "The Aspect of Twilight"), sealing away all remaining Darkin.[[10]](#cite_note-10) She, along with several other Darkin, made their way to Ionia to continue their conquest. Xolaani came into conflict with the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order") and slew Master Lao, the Fist of Shadow, after he and  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara") slayed one of her followers.[[11]](#cite_note-11) She was finally sealed in her chain-sickle in Ionia when her old Ascended brother,  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen"), allied himself with the Kinkou and showed them how to defeat the Darkin.[[12]](#cite_note-12) Her chain-sickles would be kept in [Mistfall](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mistfall "Mistfall").[[13]](#cite_note-13)

### The Darkin Saga

:   *This section is a "what-if" scenario in  [Legends of Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Legends_of_Runeterra "LoR:Legends of Runeterra")'s [Darkin Saga](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Darkin_Saga_(Expansion) "LoR:The Darkin Saga (Expansion)") expansion.*

For several centuries, Xolaani was locked away in her 1 [Bloodletters](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:06SH004 "LoR:06SH004"). She would eventually be discovered by  [Master Yi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Master_Yi "Universe:Master Yi") and his order, and sealed away within his temple.[[14]](#cite_note-14)  [Kayn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayn "Universe:Kayn"), who had discovered the weapon's location, attacked the temple, seeking to claim the power of a second Darkin weapon.[[15]](#cite_note-15) This ended in the death of all of Yi's new order, with the exception of his protégé,  [Jun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jun "Universe:Jun"). Unable to handle her failure, she gave in to Xolaani's whispers, taking up the blades to try and save herself and her master.[[16]](#cite_note-16) In an instant, Jun was lost, Xolaani completely claiming her as a vessel.[[17]](#cite_note-17)[[4]](#cite_note-LoR-4)

After acquiring a body, Xolaani would make her way back to Shurima, to grow her power at 2 [The Altar of Blood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Altar_of_Blood "LoR:The Altar of Blood"),[[6]](#cite_note-Altar-6) an ancient temple maintained by her devoted 1 [disciples](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:06SH004T1 "LoR:06SH004T1").[[18]](#cite_note-18) At the same time, Aatrox would attempt to rally an army of Darkin to finally kill their most hated enemy.[[8]](#cite_note-Aatrox-8) This time, Xolaani was able to hold her own, defeating both  [Taarosh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taarosh "Universe:Taarosh")[[9]](#cite_note-Taarosh-9) and  [Anaakca](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Anaakca "Universe:Anaakca")[[8]](#cite_note-Aatrox-8) before they could stop her ritual, breaking their wills and enthralling them. With each Darkin she enslaved, Xolaani's power grew greatly. Her influence was vast enough that when Aatrox arrived, she faced him head-on,[[8]](#cite_note-Aatrox-8) 7 [her new form](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Xolaani_the_Bloodweaver "LoR:Xolaani the Bloodweaver") able to hold him off while still defeating other Darkin.[[5]](#cite_note-Bloodweaver-5)

As the battled waged, Xolaani only grew more powerful, and the very land began to be corrupted. The Aspect of Justice,  [Mihira](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mihira "Universe:Mihira"),[[19]](#cite_note-19) descended to the world with a divine army to end the battle, aided by her daughter  [Kayle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayle "Universe:Kayle").[[20]](#cite_note-20) Sensing the threat posed to the world,  [Ryze](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ryze "Universe:Ryze") would also arrive.[[21]](#cite_note-Ryze-21) Despite holding the power to end the conflict, he hesitated, unsure whether it was right to act. While he racked his mind for the answer, Xolaani would defeat Mihira. Bursting from her physical form, 7 [Xolaani's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Xolaani,_Aspect%27s_Bane "LoR:Xolaani, Aspect's Bane") power would reach its absolute peak.[[22]](#cite_note-22) Ultimately, Ryze would deem that the world deserved to be saved, and would use the power of [The World Runes](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rune "Universe:Rune") to defeat Xolaani.[[21]](#cite_note-Ryze-21)
structure.appearance:
In her original Darkin form, Xolaani donned a golden, two-horned helmet that covered most of her face, leaving only her glowing red eyes visible and had maroon skin. She wore crimson-golden armor with a feathery chestplate and a white skirt with golden trim, resembling to her statue in [Xolan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xolan "Universe:Xolan").

In her neutral form after possessing  [Jun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jun "Universe:Jun"), she look almost identical her host but retaining her white skirt with gold trim. She has pale violet skin and short white hair. Jun's eye patch blends into her face, much like her armor blends into her body. She wears her bloodletters hanging from her arms on chains.

In her Bloodweaver form, she grows a pair of wings and her body fuses even more with her clothing. One of the most notable differences from her previous form is the growth of a crown that resembles a pair of horns.

In her final form, the Aspect's Bane, Xolaani loses any resemblance to a human figure. She becomes a long, massive mass of flesh and blood, with multiple wings sprouting and chains coming out of her body, reminiscent of the form of a dragon.
structure.personality:
As a human healer and later as an [Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ascended "Ascended"), Xolaani was nevertheless a compassionate healer who used her gifts of hemomancy to save countless lives. She worked tirelessly to save as many lives as she could during the [rebellion of Icathia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rebellion_of_Icathia "Universe:Rebellion of Icathia") between the  [Shuriman Empire](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") and Icathia. She despised the endless bloodshed and even stood against the emperor, openly criticizing the pointless wars he waged. Xolaani cherished all life and believed peace could only be achieved by ending the cycle of conflict.

After the fall of the empire and during the [Great Darkin War](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Great_Darkin_War "Great Darkin War"), Xolaani’s ideals began to twist as she grew disillusioned. Her love for life remained, but it transformed into an psychotic obsession with absolute control and forced unity. Xolaani lost her trust in her fellow Ascended and sought to puppeteer all of them into her servitude through hemomancy, convinced it was the only way to end the wars. This is the reason most of the Darkin harbor a deep, violent hatred toward her.
structure.abilities:
- **[Darkin Physiology:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin")** Xolaani is a Darkin, originally one of the many [Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ascended "Ascended") God-Warriors of Shurima in ancient times trapped within a weapon. As a Darkin, Xolaani has vastly enhenced physical strength and can access to some celestial magics.
  - **Immortality:** Because her consciousness is trapped within her indestructible 1 [Bloodletters](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:06SH004 "LoR:06SH004"), Xolaani is immune to aging and is prevented from dying as there is no known way to permanently destroy the weapon or effectively kill her.
- **Hemomancy:** Xolaani possesses unparalleled mastery in blood magic, far surpassing other Darkins. Instead of only using blood magic as a tool to manipulate the flesh and blood of her own or the host's body, Xolaani's utilize it as her main source of power with various uses. She is rumored to have uncovered the innermost secrets of blood magic and can even return the dead to life or to bend and control most of the Darkins and even Aspects like  [Mihira](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mihira "Universe:Mihira") or any living being by manipulating their blood. The subjugated are completely aware of being controlled but absolutely powerless and unable to resist her or break free.[[23]](#cite_note-23) The only known case capable of resisting Xolaani’s control is the strongest-willed among the Darkin, such as  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox").
  - **7 [The Bloodweaver Form](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Xolaani_the_Bloodweaver "LoR:Xolaani the Bloodweaver"):** As her hemomancy power increase, Xolaani can empower her physical form and transform into new more powerful form as the Bloodweaver.
  - **7 [The Aspect's Bane Form](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Xolaani,_Aspect%27s_Bane "LoR:Xolaani, Aspect's Bane"):** Through her hemomancy, Xolaani can absorb and assimilate other beings such as 5 [Mihira, Aspect of Justice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Mihira,_Aspect_of_Justice "LoR:Mihira, Aspect of Justice") and gained overwhelming hemomantic power and a new Aspect — Darkin amalgamation physical form.
- **Chain-sickle Proficiency:** Xolaani is trained in the use of a pair of chain-sickles in combat.
  - **1 [Darkin Bloodletters](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:06SH004 "LoR:06SH004"):** Xolaani has been seen wielding her chain-sickle against various Darkins and Aspects. Such as  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox"),  [Varus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Varus "Universe:Varus"),  [Horazi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Horazi "Universe:Horazi"),  [Taarosh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taarosh "Universe:Taarosh"),  [Mihira](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mihira "Universe:Mihira"),  [Kayle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayle "Universe:Kayle").

relations.relationship_description: While Jun was likely completely erased when she took up the weapons, interactions between the two cards reveal what may be the internal struggle of Jun. Seeing the true goals of Xolaani, Jun feels betrayed, accusing Xolaani of creating a "legacy of lies and blood." Xolaani maintains that she is bringing life and love, and treats Jun as a naive child.

Xolaani's thralls are implied to be survivors from before she was imprisoned, as they could not yearn for a control they did not yet know. They treat her with a deep degree of reverence, their sole existence to serve her; this is represented with their intended use in game as sacrifices to summon Xolaani into play. Xolaani in turn seems to treat them with a degree of kindness, though this does not prevent her from enthralling them all the same.

Aatrox's hatred of "The Coward of Icathia" burns deep, despite them sharing the same goal. Both Xolaani and Aatrox seek to bring about world peace after the horrors of war they experienced fighting the war. Aatrox believes this peace can only be brought about through total annihilation, while Xolaani desires total subservience. Aatrox's grudge with Xolaani is much deeper than a simple disagreement, as he went out of his way to erase all evidence of her existence from history, including the defacing of her statue in Xolan. Xolaani shares this resentment, as Aatrox is the only Darkin she treats with more than mere dismissal.

Xolaani seems to take a sadistic pleasure in subjugating her fellow Darkin, forcing Taarosh to repeat her mantra "Peace, through servitude." While the other Darkin hold the same hatred of Xolaani, she does not seemingly reciprocate, treating them similar to how she treats Jun: a helpless child, who does not know any better.
