structure.name: Samira
structure.quote: *"Virtues, I've got a few. Vices, a few more."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Samira was born in the city of [Amakra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Amakra "Amakra") in Shurima, located at the edge of the [the Great Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Great_Sai "The Great Sai"). She and her parents made a living as street performers, dazzling and beguiling onlookers, which thrilled her but worried her parents who wished for their daughter to have a more stable life.

At the eve of her fourteenth birthday, Amakra was attacked by a massive army of strange cultists that swarmed the city, invoking the name of an  [ancient magus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") and killing innocent villagers before her very eyes. Instead of crying or screaming however, Samira seethed in anger, both at the invaders as well as herself for hiding, as it was the first time she's ever felt crippled by fear despite all the daring stunts she performed as an acrobat. With that, she vowed never to feel scared and helpless again in the face of danger.

#### Taking Refuge in Bel'zhun

Though they were wounded, Samira and her parents escaped to the port city of [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Bel%27zhun "Bel'zhun"), which was currently under  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") occupation. Many Amakrans fled to the city as refugees, seeing it as safe haven provided by the Noxian empire. Samira's parents were too weary and injured to continue performing on the streets, so she decided to perform as a lone acrobat in order to support her family, using it as an opportunity to be fearless and outdoing herself with every stunt. Unfortunately, street performing simply wouldn't be enough to support her parents, so Samira set off to find other opportunities. Samira enlisted to join a Noxian warband, drawn to both the excitement as well as the financial resources it would provide.

As a member of the warband, Samira trained for two years, impressing her peers with her excellence in combat combined with her acrobatic athleticism. However, she faltered in discipline, frusturating her commanding officers due to her reckless attitude. The only officer that saw past her reckless attitude was a former saboteur named  [Indari](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Indari "Universe:Indari"), who valued her fearlessness and offered her a position in her private warband instead; a specialized unit charged with missions too perilous for standard military personnel, to which Samira agreed without hesitation.

Overtime, Samira began to fully embrace Noxian culture, finding her own strength in her dazzling flair and sense of style in battle. Through life-and-death shootouts and breathtaking swordfights, Samira would get tattoos representing her most dangerous feats, showing them off to her family every chance she got.

#### Attack at Rokrund

Under direct orders from the capital, Indari's unit was sent to crush a secessionist uprising at the [Rokrund Plains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rokrund_Plains "Rokrund Plains"). When the warband located the enemy stronghold and found the rebel leader, the fortress exploded with Indari inside. Samira, in an attempt to save her captain, dove headfirst into the stronghold as it collapsed, feeling no sense of fear and wasting no time in recovering her captain. Miraculously, the two of them actually survived the explosion, though Samira suffered a permanent injury to her right eye while Indari lost the ability to use her legs. Frustrated with their failure, Indari gathered as many survivors as she could but officially disbanded the unit.

#### Becoming a Mercenary

Samira, now discharged and sent back to Bel'zhun, continued to desire the life of action she once had while in Indari's warband, no longer pleased with a quiet stable life within the port city. Seeking her former captain out, Samira returned to the Noxian capital and met up with Indari, proposing that they form a new partnership. With Indari's connections to the military and the Noxian noble houses, she could operate behind the scenes while Samira acts as a high-stakes mercenary under Indari's command. Reluctantly, she agreed, but refused to grant Samira any field support in fear of making the same mistakes as she did in Rokrund.

### Modern History

Samira thrived as a mercenary, taking the most daring missions handed to her by Indari, which were originally meant for entire warbands. She happily undertook these missions, gaining a reputation as a daredevil that completed every perilous job no matter the odds against her, even gaining recognition by the Noxian high command.

Some of Samira's most famous feats while taking on these missions included beating a  [Chem-Baron](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons") in hand-to-hand combat, being the lone survivor of a massive  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater") raid, scaling mountains and arm-wrestling outlaws in crowded taverns. With no sense of slowing down, Samira continued her life on the edge, constantly seeking the next thrill.

#### The Hunt for Rell

Samira was eventually assigned a mission to locate a dangerous  [weapon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rell "Universe:Rell") that threatened the Noxian empire, which was located within a compound deep in the southern jungles of [Qualthala](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Qualthala "Qualthala"), and leave no survivors. Before her mission, Samira visited a weapons shop called  *[Lani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lani "Universe:Lani") and  [Miel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miel "Universe:Miel") Munitions*, accompanied by Indari. There, she met two  [Zaunite](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") weaponsmiths named Lani and Miel, who also had apprentices that moonlit as tattoo artists. In the shop, Samira saw a pair of  [notably flashy pistols](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Samira#Flair "Samira") displayed in a glass case and instantly decided to buy them without much thought, which annoyed Indari.

After buying a new set of equipment for the job, Samira set off to the compound in Qualthala, finding a building devoid of markings with wooden doors that were already smashed to pieces as well as strangely warped pieces of metal scattered around. She encountered and killed two guards in the compound before alerting some warmasons and executing them in a  [flurry of gunfire](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Samira#Inferno_Trigger "Samira"). After hopping over a crushed balcony and landing in an open courtyard, Samira noticed another building in the distance that also had its doors smashed apart, noting that someone else must've beat her to the weapon she was assigned to locate.

Two soldiers wielding axes and riding massive [basilisks](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Basilisk "Basilisk") charged towards Samira in the courtyard, making note of a *null kid* and questioning if Rell sent Samira to the compound to 'clean up the mess,' a name that Samira had never heard of but also didn't care much for as she managed to kill one of the riders and mount his basilisk, jousting with the second rider before using her  [specialized blade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Samira#Blade_Whirl "Samira") to pierce through his armor by empowering it with black powder.

Finally entering the building, Samira found a crumbling stairway and followed it into a stone prison cell full of even more warped pieces of metal, with the door completely obliterated while the back wall had a massive hole opened into the jungle. Examining the room more, she noticed a small cot seemingly fit for a child, which was split by jagged shards of metal. Here, she took a seat and drank from her flask, realizing the weapon had gotten away but congratulating it for 'getting her attention,' seemingly vowing to continue her search.

Weeks later, Samira returned to the weapons shop with Indari to get a new tattoo drawn by one of the apprentices in the store. Indari questioned Samira on how her new equipment performed on the mission, to which Samira answered that her new guns were exquisite and revealed she intended to be using them for a long time. After paying for the tattoo and leaving, the tattoo artist revealed himself to actually be  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") in disguise, who had been working with Captain Indari and commanded her to give Samira whatever resources she needs, noting her importance to the empire and the missions she would be sent off on.

### Recent Events

#### The Ruination

Samira was present when the  [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") managed to get a hold of  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna"), causing the Black Mist to spread violently across [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Runeterra "Runeterra"). During this, she was near the Hand of Noxus  [Darius](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darius "Universe:Darius") as he commanded his army the [Trifarian Legion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Trifarian_Legion "Trifarian Legion"). When the Black Mist manifested in Noxus, it appeared atop the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Immortal_Bastion "Immortal Bastion") and nearly got a a hold of her before Darius pushed her out of the way. As the Black Mist quickly spread across the city, hoards of [Wraiths](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Wraith "Wraith") appeared and attacked the Trifarian Legion, causing Samira to join in the fight to assist her fellow Noxians. During this however, the Black Mist took a hold of Darius's mind, controlling him under Viego's will and forcing him to attack Samira, which she narrowly evaded. During the fight, the Black Mist suddenly ceased, allowing Samira and a weakened Darius to recover while looking cautiously at the Immortal Bastion, where the Black Mist poured into Noxus from.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

#### Mission in Navori

At some point, Samira is sent on a mission to the  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") city of Qayanvi, located in the province of [Navori](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Navori "Navori"). Samira was sent to locate a 8 [debt evader](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:The_Old_Timer "LoR:The Old Timer") wanted by the empire, said to be hiding out in Navori and attending a massive fighting pit event being hosted by the Ionian crime boss  [Sett](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sett "Universe:Sett").[[3]](#cite_note-3) This mission however required some backup, as Indari gathered a band of other mercenaries to assist her, including Lani, Miel, 4 [Dashing Dandy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Dashing_Dandy "LoR:Dashing Dandy"), 3 [Dame the Despoiler](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Dame_the_Despoiler "LoR:Dame the Despoiler"), 4 [Inferna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Inferna "LoR:Inferna"), 2 [Father Fury](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Father_Fury "LoR:Father Fury"), a 3 [brazen buccaneer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Brazen_Buccaneer "LoR:Brazen Buccaneer"), a 1 [bladed ballerina](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Elegant_Edge "LoR:Elegant Edge") and even Indari herself. The event is extremely exclusive, being invite-only and with tight security. However, Indari manages to pull a few strings thanks to her many connections, granting Samira and her team an invite to the fighting pits.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

When an infamous Bilgewater boxer named  [Jack](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jack "Universe:Jack") crashes the event and personally challenges Sett, chaos ensues in the fighting pits as Samira's team fights off Jack's crew. During this, their target reveals himself, allowing Samira to pursue him through the chaos and capture her target.
structure.appearance:
Samira is a beautiful woman with tanned skin, she has an athletic and voluptuous physique, a round face with a mole on the right side of her lip, thick lips, wears an eyepatch over her right eye and her left eye is emerald green. Long black hair which she wears braided in a French braid that falls over her right shoulder on which she has woven golden jewels.

She has a slightly revealing uniform of red and black colors with leather boots, a short skirt and a short t-shirt that reveals her abdomen as well as several tattoos on her left arm.
structure.personality: Samira is quite a stubborn and impulsive woman, determined to show that she is not afraid of danger, enjoying the adrenaline rush that it caused her, despite everything she cared a lot about her parents wishing they were safe.
structure.abilities:
- **[Sword Mastery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Samira#Blade_Whirl "Samira")**: Samira has been trained with expert swordmanship as part of the Noxian military. She wields a specialized blade named *Vanquish,* which was built with a trigger that activates an internal mechanism inside the sword. When the trigger is pulled, Samira empowers the blade with black powder, allowing it to strike with much more force capable of cutting through armor. Along with that, Samira has shown a capability of blocking incoming projectiles with her blade.
- **[Firearm Mastery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Samira#Flair "Samira")**: Samira has a talent for marksmanship especially with her signature dual pistols, Blaze & Thorn. These pistols were experimental, specialized weapons crafted by the Zaunite owners of the weapons shop *Lani & Miel Munitions*. These guns allow Samira to fire off a barrage of shots at enemies and she has been shown to even fire at incoming projectiles with precision.
- **[Black Powder Grenades](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Black_Powder_Grenade "LoR:Black Powder Grenade")**: On occassion, Samira utilizes grenades created by Noxus that utilize black powder.
- **[Acrobatics](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Samira#Wild_Rush "Samira")**: Samira grew up as a extremely talented street performer, showing off her acrobatic atheleticism. She utilizes this skill in combat, combining her use of weaponry with her acrobatic skills, making her an extremely mobile and dexterous fighter.
- **[Daredevil Bravery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Samira#Inferno_Trigger "Samira")**: After witnessing the people of Amakra get slaughtered by Xerath's followers, Samira made a vow to never let fear take over her thus gaining an incredible sense of courage and bravery. Samira completely lacks any sense of fear in the sense of immediate danger, choosing to recklessley charge into it instead without any hesitation. This has allowed her to achieve multiple incredible feats ranging from one-on-one duels to scaling dangerous landscapes.

relations.relationship_description: Samira performed in street performances alongside her parents when she was young. While she enjoyed performing, they wished her to live a more stable life. When her family immigrated to Noxus, she had to support her injured parents by herself but struggled to make ends meet. After becoming a mercenary, Samira told her parents about her tattoos and impressive feats. Samira is close to her mother, recalling the stories and advice she gave her when she was young.
Samira was forced to evacuate Amakra after it was attacked by Xerath's followers, and harbors a resentment towards him for his followers' destruction of her hometown.

Indari was impressed with Samira's bravery and commissioned her to be part of her own private warband. When Indari was caught in an explosion that severely wounded her, Samira risked her life to rescue her at the cost of her own eye. Despite Indari's shame towards her own failure, Samira knew that she understood her desire for thrills more than anybody and proposed to work with her again. Indari now supports Samira behind the scenes by providing her with mercenary work and takes pride in Samira's and determination though she can get frustrated at her recklessness causing trouble, though she has actually been conspiring with  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") without Samira's knowledge.
Samira obtained her guns from Lani and Miel, two Noxian gunsmiths.
LeBlanc sees Samira as an important factor in her plans to take over Noxus, so she indirectly manipulates Samira through Indari into carrying out her missions to benefit her own goals.
Samira was unknowingly sent to find Rell under LeBlanc's instruction, by proxy of Indari.
Samira once fought Darius when he was under the influence of the Ruination caused by  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego").

structure.trivia:
- Samira's name comes from either Sanskrit *Samīra* समीर "wind, breeze, air"[[5]](#cite_note-5) or Arabic سميرة *Sāmira* "night-companion, nighttalker", feminine active participle of سَمَرَ *samara* "to spend the night".[[6]](#cite_note-6)
- Samira is 32 years old as of 996 AN (she was born around 964 AN).[[7]](#cite_note-7)
  - She lost her eye in a secessionist uprising in the [Rokrund Plains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rokrund_Plains "Rokrund Plains") that is the same uprising in [The Black Powder Plot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Black_Powder_Plot "The Black Powder Plot"), which happened around 991 AN.[[8]](#cite_note-8)
- Her favorite fruit is pomegranate.[[9]](#cite_note-9)
- Samira is an homage to "character-action" games like *[Devil May Cry](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devil_May_Cry)* and *[Bayonetta](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bayonetta)*.

structure.name: Renni
structure.background:
### Early Life

After  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") took over  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), Renni made a name for herself as the boss of the Sludgerunners, an illicit enterprise that specialized in the production of [chemtech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chemtech "Universe:Chemtech"), and became affiliated with several other crime lords who were also loyal to Silco, creating the first generation of  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons"). At some point she would also have a son and undergo chemical modification, which permanently affixed green tubes to her nose.[[2]](#cite_note-107boy-2)

### In Plain Sight

Renni's side of their businesses involved abducting Zaunite children to experiment on. When an [enforcer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Piltover_Wardens "Piltover Wardens") happened upon one of their laboratories, the enforcers were able to interrogate one of their victims and was able to at least identify the person running things as a woman who wore a suit. At least one found evidence at the scene—an experimental  [suit](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Turbo_Chemtank "Turbo Chemtank")—had her name on it as the intended user.  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus"), due to the then Captain of the enforcers' partnership with Silco, was able to halt the release of information and further investigation on her illicit activities. Another enforcer,  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"), found the records of this and kept it as part of an ongoing investigation on  [the underground's then unknown ruler](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") and his  [mole](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus") in Piltover.[[3]](#cite_note-3)

### Border Crisis

After the actions of  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), Silco's adopted daughter, led  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") to shut down the border between Zaun and  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), trade between the two cities came to a sudden halt, causing Renni's criminal ventures to lose massive profits. Frustrated by the fact that Silco was doing nothing to keep Jinx under control, Renni and the other chem-barons scheduled an assembly to discuss their next move, in which  [Finn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Finn "Universe:Finn") attempted to convince her to join him in a coup against Silco. However, before she could give him an answer, Silco arrived on the scene and unleashed a toxic gas in the air to remind the barons of the oppressive life that he had saved them from, which was enough to convince Renni to fall back in line.[[2]](#cite_note-107boy-2)

### Factory Raid

During an unexpected raid on one of her [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") factories, Renni's son, who was working at the factory at the time and had been the one to sound the alarms, was accidentally killed by  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce").[[4]](#cite_note-4) When Renni arrived, she tearfully mourned her son and demanded justice from Silco. However, when Silco made it clear that he was not going to retaliate and told her that her son had died fighting for the cause, she called him out for the hypocrisy, as he clearly was not willing to sacrifice his daughter for the cause.

### Failed Coup

Silco's refusal to get justice for her son's death led Renni to lose faith in his leadership and ally herself with Finn, who already had plans to overthrow Silco and take control of the undercity in his place. The two of them confronted Silco in his office alongside  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika"), who they believed to be on their side. However, they realized too late that they were mistaken, as Sevika slit Finn's throat with her sword, splattering Renni with his blood and killing him on the spot.

Disgusted by Renni's betrayal, Silco coldly stated that had her son still been alive, he would have him killed for what she did. Despite this, he still allowed her to leave the room alive.[[5]](#cite_note-5)

### Attack on the Memorial

Some time after  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") attack on the Council,  [Ambessa Medarda's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") lieutenant,  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"), approached Renni with a plan to attack the memorial service in Piltover for the fallen councilors[[6]](#cite_note-6), promising justice for her son. With the help of Zaunites disguised as guards, Renni infiltrated and hid behind Jayce during a eulogy from  [Mel Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel"). As a guard attacked Mel on stage and fired a flare gun, signaling for Renni's  [Turbo Chemtanks](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Turbo_Chemtank "Turbo Chemtank") to invade, Renni attempted to kill Jayce with a  [Chempunk Chainsword](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Chempunk_Chainsword "Chempunk Chainsword"). Jayce was heavily injured in the ensuing chase, but was saved by  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") after she retrieved the  [Mercury Hammer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jayce#Transform_Mercury_Hammer "Jayce") from his laboratory to blast Renni away.

Noxian warriors intervened to end the battle and Ambessa appeared in front of Renni, grabbing her. In her final moments, Renni realized that Ambessa had betrayed her, but was unable to do anything before Ambessa slit her throat.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
structure.appearance: Renni was a tall, older woman with a dark auburn buzz cut. She had a noticeable augmented nose piece with green tubes coming out of it on either side. Her black eyeliner and eyeshadow gave her an imposing look. She wore a light cape that had a heavily feathered collar. On her right temple, she had two studded piercings.
structure.personality: Renni ran her business with little morals, having Zaunite children abducted and subjected to inhumane experiments and working conditions and even forcing her own son to work in one of her factories. However, she was still a caring mother towards her son, mourning his death and holding a vendetta towards the one responsible. She held dissent towards Silco for his dependence towards Jinx after she ruined her operations and grew further after he showed indifference towards her son's death, with consideration to betray him though being unable to go through with it out of fear towards his threats. She leapt at the chance to take revenge on  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") for causing the death of her son, maniacally chasing him down with her chainsword willing to kill anyone in her way so she could kill Jayce to avenge her son. However, her desire for revenge would result in her falling for  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") manipulation, leading to her own downfall.
structure.abilities:
- **Leader:** As a chembaron and leader of the  [Sludgerunners](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sludgerunners "Universe:Sludgerunners"), Renni was able to dramatically expand her influence as a crime lord under  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") leadership of the undercity. She had a powerful army of henchmen, including powerful  [chemtank berserkers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Turbo_Chemtank "Turbo Chemtank") whom she sent to invade a Piltovan memorial service.
- **[Chempunk Chainsword](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Chempunk_Chainsword "Chempunk Chainsword"):** Renni was skilled with a chempunk chainsword, which she used in combat against  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce").

relations.relationship_description: Renni had a close relationship with her son, grieving his death and swearing revenge on  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") for killing him. Her grief towards her son's death would lead to her being disillusioned with  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") for his cold indifference for her grief to the point of conspiring to betray him. Later, she was manipulated by  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") into attacking the Council's memorial when she was promised vengeance against her son's killer.

Renni became consumed by vengeance towards Jayce after his actions led to her son being killed. Conspiring with  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"), Renni snuck into Piltover to attack Jayce with her chainsword so she could avenge her son, successfully grazing his shoulder and attempting to kill him before being stopped by  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"). After the aftermath of Renni's attack, Jayce came to the conclusion that [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") was the only way to fight back against the undercity, leading to him supplying hextech weapons to the Enforcers' arsenal.

While initially swearing fealty to Silco as one of the first  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons"), Renni began to question his approach after  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") attack caused a closure of the border that resulted in the interference of her operations, enough to contemplate an offer with Finn to start a coup against Silco. When her son was killed, she demanded Silco to get justice, but he refused and claimed that he had died for the cause, leading to her joining  [Finn's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Finn "Universe:Finn") coup. After the coup failed and Finn ended up getting killed, Silco threatened Renni into submission by telling her that he would've had her son killed for her betrayal had he still been alive. After Silco's death, Renni was once again free to do as she pleased and led an attack at the Councilors' Memorial in a failed attempt to avenge her son.

Renni and Finn were allies who had both become dissatisfied with  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") mishandling of the crisis with Piltover. After  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") and  [Vi's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") attack on the [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer") refinery killed Renni's son, she blamed Silco for his death and joined Finn in his coup, and they both confronted Silco in his office to have him killed. After Finn's death, Renni was terrified and successfully brought back in line, fleeing the office as Silco spared her life.

After the death of Silco, Renni was approached by Ambessa by proxy of  [Rictus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rictus "Universe:Rictus"), allowing her to sneak into Piltover to exact her revenge on  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce"). However, she was only a pawn in Ambessa's plot to mobilize Piltover for her own agenda. In her final moments, Renni realized that Ambessa had set her up to attack the memorial, before being killed for being of no more use to her.

### Early Life

#### Reckoner in Debt

Not much is known about Rictus's youth. At some point, he fell into debt with  [House Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda") and was forced to join the  [Reckoners](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") to pay it back. He was known to have spent a great deal of his early life in [Tereshni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tereshni "Universe:Tereshni"), where he became a frequent patron at the Busted Knuckle tavern and made several "friends" who would participate in illegal activities for coin. Rictus was the owner of a mysterious relic known as a  [rookern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kaenic_Rookern "Kaenic Rookern") which he carried with him always. Whenever he bested his opponents in honorable combat, Rictus would carve their names into the stones, which he would heat over coals in a ritual before entering into combat.

After fighting for some time, another arena opened up in [Rokrund](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rokrund "Universe:Rokrund") on the commission of Hostlord Menelik's granddaughter,  [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"). Rictus went to fight in the Rokrund Reckoner Arena, and after spectating his matches, Ambessa was immediately impressed by with his unshakeable calm before battles, followed by the annihilation of his opponents. Believing his abilities were wasted in the arena, Ambessa bought out Rictus's debts, allowing him to repay her by joining her elite warband, the Wolf's Reapers.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)

#### Service to Ambessa Medarda

Rictus served under Ambessa for many years. Eventually, he had fought off his debt to Ambessa, but impressed by her leadership, he asked to remain in her service. He very quickly rose to the rank of second-in-command, and after enduring numerous campaigns together, Rictus became her most trusted ally, sparring partner, and friend, proving himself worthy of her trust time and again. While most of Ambessa's soldiers would have wished to be named captain of a warband, Rictus refused any title, as his only wish was to be her bodyguard.

While Rictus was serving Ambessa, she was trying to raise her daughter  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") to become a worthy heir, having already written off her son  [Kino](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino") as a possible head of the Medarda family. Mel's "soft" nature, which she displayed in her aversion to the "blood sports" of the arena, led Ambessa to believe she had been too sheltered by her upbringing. After a successful campaign in the jungles of [Kumangra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kumangra "Universe:Kumangra"), in which Ambessa and Rictus conquered the estate ruled by the  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") Binan family and liberated a number of [vastayan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vastaya "Universe:Vastaya") prisoners from the dungeons, Ambessa planned a test for her daughter in which she would have to order the execution of the Binan leader,  [Lady Mion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mion "Universe:Mion"). Rictus sent for Mel, but was not present in the throne room when Ambessa went to introduce her to death. After Lady Binan's execution, Rictus learned that Mel had failed Ambessa's test by trying to spare the prisoner, and Ambessa led them back to [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun") without having named an heir.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)[[2]](#cite_note-108oil-2)

### Medardan Succession War

:   *Main article: [Ambessa: Chosen of the Wolf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa:_Chosen_of_the_Wolf "Universe:Ambessa: Chosen of the Wolf")*

#### Death of Menelik

The situation in [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun") was grave when  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") forces returned. Her grandfather, Hostlord Menelik, had been critically-wounded during a campaign, and as he lay on his deathbed, factions began to form regarding who should be next to succeed him as leader of  [House Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda"). When Menelik died without naming an heir, Ambessa and her cousin Ta'Fik, the steward of [Tereshni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tereshni "Universe:Tereshni"), both claimed leadership of their family, and Rictus accompanied Ambessa as she attempted to gather allies, starting with her brother, Steward Katye of [Rokrund](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rokrund "Universe:Rokrund"). Though Katye promised his support, most of the other cities began to rally around Ta'Fik, with the emissary from [Kilgrove](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kilgrove "Universe:Kilgrove"), Stefana, attempting to assassinate Ambessa in her spectator box at the  [Reckoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") arena. The attempt on her life convinced Ambessa that she needed to flee the city before Menelik's funeral began.

As they prepared to leave, Ambessa and Rictus gathered several more allies. These included the teenage Reckoner champion  [Rell Canwell](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rell "Universe:Rell"), whom they recruited into the Wolf's Reapers, and Valif, the leader of the  [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") rebel movement in Bel'zhun. Ambessa also made plans for an overture to Grand General  [Boram Darkwill](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boram_Darkwill "Universe:Boram Darkwill") in the [Noxian capital](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion"), hoping to gain his support by helping him make an alliance with the [vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vastaya "Universe:Vastaya") of the  [Ionian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") forests.

#### Journey to the Capital

On Ambessa's flagship, the *Golden Dancer*, Rictus acquainted himself with Rell, who was seasick and miserable for the duration of the voyage. He also got better acquainted with Caprian, the vastayan rebel leader they had released from  [Lady Binan's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mion "Universe:Mion") palace, who had offered information which could prove crucial for Darkwill's long-awaited invasion of Ionia. As they were sailing for the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion"), their ship was destroyed by a blockade and they were captured by forces from [Trannit](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trannit "Universe:Trannit"), led by one of Ta'Fik's allies: Steward Smik. Ambessa, Rictus, Rell, and Caprian managed to escape into the mountains, but had to leave the rest of the warband behind. For two months, they made a harrowing journey across the mountains of the [Great Barrier](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_Barrier "Universe:The Great Barrier")—living off rabbits and fending off wild [drakehounds](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Drakehound "Universe:Drakehound")—until they were rescued by a [Vindoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vindor "Universe:Vindor") scouting party, who finally brought them to the city in the north. Steward Amenesce of Vindor was initially neutral in the conflict between Ambessa and Ta'Fik, but after her harbor was blockaded by ships from Trannit and [Fallgren](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Fallgren "Universe:Fallgren"), she declared her full support for Ambessa. Their alliance rode the rest of the way to Darkwill on [swifthorns](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swifthorn "Universe:Swifthorn") so they would make it in time for his tribute.

#### Tribute to Darkwill

They arrived at the Immortal Bastion with a week to prepare for Darkwill's tribute. Ta'Fik was already there, and to ensure Caprian would be safe from him, the vastaya was to remain inside the city's Medarda compound, which had been declared neutral ground by Ambessa's older brother Hanek. Rictus was assigned to guard Caprian while Ambessa and Rell were running errands, but despite his watchfulness, Caprian managed to slip away without permission a day before the tribute. As soon as Rictus realized, he found Caprian on the streets and saved him from armed attackers, bringing him home in a safe but injured state. At Darkwill's palace the next day, Ambessa and Rictus successfully delivered Caprian to the Grand General, and though he did not promise any immediate support, he was pleased enough that onlookers noticed and wondered what it was Ambessa had given him. Shortly after this, they received word that Ta'Fik had sent his forces to attack [Rokrund](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rokrund "Universe:Rokrund").

Rictus accompanied Ambessa, Rell, and Steward Amenesce on swifthorns to the [Varju Mountains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Varju_Mountains "Universe:Varju Mountains"), where they prepared an ambush in the pass for the forces from Trannit who were marching to intercept them. As they were waiting, Rictus approached Rell, as he knew this would be her first time on the battlefield. He and Ambessa had been training Rell since they began their journey to the capital, and despite Rell's insistence that she understood fighting from her time as a  [Reckoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners"), Rictus claimed that what she was about to experience would be completely different, and that she must be prepared and alert for what was to come. After this, Rictus left Rell with Amenesce's aide Tora as they all prepared for the enemy's arrival. The battle was brief but fierce, and it ended in Smik's death.

#### Defense of Rokrund

After another arduous journey through the mountains, Ambessa, Rictus, and Rell regrouped with their forces in Rokrund, where Captain Burnside informed them that Ta'Fik's soldiers—led by his eldest daughter Gintara—were unnaturally strong, and had used their [enhanced strength](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Magic "Magic") to capture the Rokrund saltpetre mines. To secure their resources, Ambessa ordered Rictus to lead a smaller force to attack the forest's entrance, as she, Rell, and Burnside attacked the flanks. Rictus was able to manage the soldiers he was fighting using his  [rookern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kaenic_Rookern "Kaenic Rookern"), and he also discovered a weakness: the rune-soldiers would collapse in pain if they overexerted themselves. Still, this was not enough to turn the tide, as Gintara's soldiers recovered from the ambush and Ambessa's forces found themselves quickly overwhelmed. When Ambessa and Rell were about to be killed by Gintara's [basilisk](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Basilisk "Universe:Basilisk"), Rell suddenly screamed, and all the steel in the area became heavier and began to vibrate. The basilisk's armor collapsed in on itself, crushing the creature to death. This allowed Rictus to rescue Ambessa, and as the general lost consciousness, he called a retreat on her behalf, which was led by Rell.

After the battle, Rictus spoke with Rell, who confided in him that she had killed the basilisk by manipulating the metal around her, which had happened by sheer instinct. Rictus realized that Rell was a [mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic"), and encouraged her to share what she had just learned with Ambessa when she woke up. After Rell demonstrated her new abilities on a metal spear, Ambessa dismissed her from the room so that she and Rictus could talk strategy. Ambessa insisted on fighting to defend Rokrund Citadel from Gintara, despite Rictus's concerns about her injury from the basilisk. Rictus also told Ambessa that he believed Rell was strong enough to lead House Medarda alongside  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") and  [Kino](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino"), and that Ambessa should consider bringing her into the family; a proposal which Ambessa would later agree with.

During the second battle, Rictus held off Gintara long enough for Rell to entrap her in metal cuffs. They held Gintara in the citadel, but while Ambessa was seeing a healer for her injuries, her brother Katye informed them that Ambessa's husband  [Azizi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azizi "Universe:Azizi") had been killed in Bel'zhun. Enraged, Ambessa decided to make Ta'Fik pay in blood, beginning with Gintara, despite Rictus's suggestion to avoid rash action. Ambessa also took Rictus's advice and decided she would adopt Rell, but before they could bring her to Mel and Kino in Bel'zhun, Rell vanished without a trace—kidnapped by a  [shapeshifter](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc") who had been wearing Ambessa's face. In the absence of any leads, Ambessa and Rictus forged ahead to [Tereshni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tereshni "Universe:Tereshni") to confront Ta'Fik in his palace, taking a ship to Bel'zhun to hold Ta'Fik's youngest daughter, Tivadar, for ransom.

#### Confrontation in Tereshni

As they were crossing the Conqueror's Channel, Ambessa and Rictus were attacked by Kilgrovan forces, and were saved by a mage named Rudo, a mysterious stowaway. While Rudo was speaking to Ambessa in the cabin, Rictus learned of their past affair in [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Basilich "Universe:Basilich") and that Rudo was, to his surprise, the biological father of Mel, who was also a mage. Ambessa decided to trust Rictus with the information, and he promised to keep the secret. Rudo had stowed away on their ship, and now offered them information about Ta'Fik's ongoing partnership with the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"). Rudo told them about the horrific experiments of Ta'Fik's advisor Inyene, who was working on a project called ["magical transference"](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Magic "Magic") that left numerous kidnapped subjects in catatonic states as *Null*. Rudo believed Rell was being held in Inyene's laboratory in the desert south of Tereshni. Rictus wanted to rescue her, but was wary about trusting Rudo. Ambessa declared Ta'Fik to be the root of the issue, so they should confront him first before going to the laboratory.

Ambessa and Rictus went to the Bel'zhun Medarda compound and found Mel and Kino, who informed them of what they had been doing the past several months. To Ambessa's chagrin, Mel had become friends with Tivadar, whom they had been planning to take hostage for their confrontation with Ta'Fik. Mel was given one chance by Ambessa to convince Tivadar to join their side in full, but the next morning, Tivadar's room was found empty. After this, Ambessa and Rictus decided to make haste to Tereshni for fear that she was rushing there to warn her father. Before they left, Ambessa also received a letter from Darkwill stating that Caprian had proven useful, and he lent her a fleet and admiral ready at her command. Ambessa ordered the admiral to attack Ta'Fik's warships in Tereshni and those en route to Rokrund before taking her group across the desert.

Ambessa, Rictus, and Rudo rode to [Tereshni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tereshni "Universe:Tereshni"), where Rictus recommended an inn called the Busted Knuckle to be used as their base of operations. As Rictus was enlisting the help of some former friends of his in the city, Ambessa found Tivadar, who offered to help them talk her father down from his invasion of Rokrund, at Mel's request. They used Tivadar's knowledge of the palace layout to engineer a trap to confront Ta'Fik and end his life, hiding their plan from the girl until they were all inside Ta'Fik's home. As Rudo dealt with Inyene and the rune-soldiers in the palace, Rictus held off the guards outside so Ambessa could go confront Ta'Fik. He and Tivadar both found them in the [drakehound](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Drakehound "Universe:Drakehound") kennels, where they saw the end of their duel. After the confrontation, Ambessa stood victorious over Ta'Fik and his daughter, who wept over her father's body. Fearing she may have made an enemy of the girl, Ambessa killed Tivadar as well, ending Ta'Fik's bloodline. She and Rictus went to see healers, and then buried Ta'Fik and his daughter in the traditional  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") fashion. Ambessa also issued a full withdrawal of Ta'Fik's troops, bringing the [Medardan succession war](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Medardan_Succession_War "Universe:Medardan Succession War") to a close.

### Feud with the Black Rose

#### Aftermath of the War

With Inyene and Rudo both dead, Rictus and  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") rushed to the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") laboratory to rescue  [Rell](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rell "Universe:Rell"). They found it empty save for Inyene's research notes, which they burned in a pyre in the desert. There, Ambessa encountered the pale woman,  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), who claimed that Ambessa's efforts had done little to stop her, and that if she couldn't control  [House Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda"), she would simply destroy it instead. The harrowing confrontation left Ambessa vengeful and paranoid about the cabal's influence, and when she returned to [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun"), she ordered Rictus to prepare a ship to send  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") away to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), where magic was outlawed and the cabal was unlikely to have a foothold.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1) Rictus obeyed, and the next day, Ambessa sent her daughter away to  [Jago Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jago "Universe:Jago").[[3]](#cite_note-MelBio-3)

#### Death of Kino

Ambessa's feud with the Black Rose continued for many years after the death of Ta'Fik, during which time Rictus remained the general's trusted and sworn protector. As Ambessa continued to lose allies and territory, she became increasingly desperate to uproot the cabal once and for all.[[4]](#cite_note-203finally-4)  [Kino](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino"), meanwhile, became deeply entangled in the Black Rose's web while investigating the death of his  [father](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azizi "Universe:Azizi"),[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1) and he uncovered evidence in [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Basilich "Universe:Basilich") which revealed Ambessa's affair with Rudo decades prior. Kino's discovery won him the attention of LeBlanc, who abducted and later killed him. Ambessa swore to avenge her son, but with no allies left that she could turn to, she and Rictus were forced to set sail for Piltover to meet with Mel and acquire [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") weapons.[[5]](#cite_note-205blisters-5)[[6]](#cite_note-CL_Clark_interview-6)

### Conspiracy in Piltover

:   *Main article: [Arcane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Arcane "Arcane")*

#### Arrival in the Gilded City

At the docks of  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), Rictus stood guard when  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") stepped off her warship to speak with  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel"). Ambessa did not tell her the whole truth about  [Kino's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino") death, hiding the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose")'s involvement, and as a result Mel was hostile to her mother's advice to develop [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") weapons for Piltover's defense. Later, Rictus stood guard in the bathhouse when Ambessa told  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce"), the city's de facto leader and the inventor of hextech, the story of the Alornian general Sonnem Parlec—a cautionary tale for the Piltover Council. Ambessa's conversation with Jayce successfully manipulated him into acting impulsively against  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"),[[2]](#cite_note-108oil-2) and when Mel came to confront her about it, Rictus left the room, allowing Ambessa a chance to sway her to their side. Mel refused to help Ambessa start a war,[[7]](#cite_note-109monster-7) so after an  [attack](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Super_Mega_Death_Rocket! "Jinx") destroyed the Council chamber, Ambessa began to mold  [Salo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Salo "Universe:Salo") into her puppet instead.

On Ambessa's orders, Rictus went to the undercity to reach out to the  [Chembaroness](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons")  [Renni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni"), secretly instigating the attack on the Councilors' Memorial before they put down the attack by force. While the event failed to bring about the invasion of Zaun, it allowed Ambessa to expand her influence over the city's defense.[[8]](#cite_note-201heavy-8) Rictus was soon called in to bodyguard Ambessa during a meeting with a high-profile Piltovan guild merchant  [Amara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Amara "Universe:Amara"), who was secretly a Black Rose assassin. Ambessa and Rictus managed to kill Amara with the help of his  [rookern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kaenic_Rookern "Kaenic Rookern"), but worried by the fact that the Black Rose had found them, Rictus suggested involving Mel, as he believed Salo was not ready for their plan to take over Piltover. Despite Rictus' advice, Ambessa managed to improvise, blaming Amara's death on Zaunite assassins and using the incident to call a gathering of all of Piltover's mercantile clans, which immediately followed another attack on the city using colorful, painted explosions of the Zaun Grey.

At the actual meeting, Ambessa betrayed Salo, nominating  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") as the city's military commander instead of him. Rictus prevented Salo from interfering with her nomination, and the city fell under martial law.[[4]](#cite_note-203finally-4)

#### Martial Law Period

Over the next several months, Rictus assisted Ambessa in both enacting a brutal occupation of Zaun and in her hextech development program, which struggled due to the fact that the city's leading experts in hextech, including Jayce and  [Heimerdinger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger"), had mysteriously vanished. As Ambessa worked to mold Caitlyn in the Noxian principles, Rictus led the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") in Zaun, hunting for  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") and interrogating her supporters in hopes that one of them would know where she was.

After an attack at a Zaunite checkpoint by a [Jinx copycat](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha"), Rictus captured one of Jinx's blue-haired supporters and beat him until he revealed where to find his other cohorts. The "Jinxer" told Rictus they were gathering at  [Vander's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") statue for a rally, so Rictus took the enforcers there, intending to arrest all the attendees and send them to Stillwater Hold for interrogation. Shortly after this, Stillwater was attacked twice within a short period—first by Jinx, who freed the prisoners, and then by a chemtech abomination known as  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), who savagely murdered a number of the enforcers and prisoners in the hallways.[[9]](#cite_note-204paint-9) Warwick and Jinx both escaped after the rampage, and intrigued by the savagery of this new chemtech weapon, Ambessa recruited the beast's creator,  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed"), to track Warwick down.[[5]](#cite_note-205blisters-5)

Singed led Ambessa, Rictus, and Caitlyn down into the remote depths of the fissures, where they located Warwick in the commune of a Herald named  [Viktor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor"). Viktor's disciple,  [Huck](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Huck "Universe:Huck"), would not let the army pass, so Ambessa's forces made camp outside the commune with plans to invade at nightfall. Singed and Ambessa made plans to capture the beast, and she sent Caitlyn with the doctor as she dealt with a recently captured prisoner,  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"). Although Rictus was pleased with Caitlyn's arrest of Vi, he secretly followed her and Singed to make sure Ambessa's plan went smoothly. As they approached Warwick, Caitlyn suddenly attacked and incapacitated Singed in the commune, and Rictus caught and attempted to kill her for betraying Ambessa. Jinx arrived before he could deal the killing blow, but after a brief battle, he managed to overpower her as well. Warwick awoke, however, and after declaring that Jinx was his "daughter," he hurled Rictus through the wall, leaving him in a daze on the ground.[[10]](#cite_note-206message-10)

### Death & Legacy

Shortly after this, an explosion rocked the commune, and as  [Viktor's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") followers screamed and collapsed, Warwick became enraged and viciously mauled Rictus.  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") arrived just in time to see her friend's lifeless body fall to the ground, and with a vengeful war cry, she sent her garrison to invade and burn Viktor's commune to the ground.[[10]](#cite_note-206message-10) After  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") was unable to save his life, Rictus was given a traditional  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") burial in the commune: Buried upright with his back to the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion").[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1) Ambessa stuck his halberd in the earth over the burial and took his  [kaenic rookern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kaenic_Rookern "Kaenic Rookern"), vowing to avenge his death.[[11]](#cite_note-208killing-11)
structure.appearance: Rictus was an exceptionally large man, being both much taller and more muscular than anyone else in Ambessa's army, including her. He had a thick, dark, well-groomed beard and a short mohawk on the top of his head, as well as dark eyeliner, metal studs, and a small tattoo on his forehead. He was always seen clad in standard  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") armor, with a dark metal chestplate and gauntlets with black and brown leather pants, accentuated with red fabric and stitching. He would normally be carrying a large halberd, which he wrapped with a  [kaenic rookern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kaenic_Rookern "Kaenic Rookern").
structure.personality:
Rictus had a gruff and stoic personality, and he was fiercely loyal to his general,  [Ambessa Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa"). As her lieutenant and most trusted advisor, Rictus was more levelheaded than Ambessa and would not let his emotions get in the way of their larger goals, frequently advising her to do the same, but always following her orders even if she refused his advice. Rictus was unafraid of what he considered honorable combat and always fought his battles in a focused and unshakeable manner, without being afraid to annihilate his opponents or to retreat if it would provide a strategic advantage later on. In social situations, Rictus spoke infrequently but had a sense of humor, which he would make known through visible grunts of amusement.

Rictus was known to be steady, strong, and trustworthy by those who considered him a friend, but also fearsome and merciless towards his enemies. Those who betrayed his trust, or the trust of his general, would be met with violent retribution at his hand, as was the case with  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") when she attempted to save  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"). Rictus also looked down on cowardice, condemning  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") for hiding from the authorities while her supporters all suffered. While he was not above hurting children, he preferred not to fight them if it could be avoided. He was also not above using brutal intimidation and torture tactics if he believed it would serve his general's cause.
structure.abilities:
- **Brute Strength:** As a hulking giant of a man, Rictus was said to embody the Principles of Strength more than any other soldier in  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") warband.[[12]](#cite_note-LoR_Rictus-12) He was capable of effortlessly knocking out a crowd of Zaunite rallygoers with his bare hands.
- **Skilled Melee Combatant:** Rictus was a skilled melee combatant who was said to have fought with an unshakeable calm, with his weapon of choice being an enormous [Vindoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vindor "Universe:Vindor")[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1) halberd which he could strike with and spin in his hands with alarming dexterity. Rictus was shown to have excellent reflexes and was able to go toe-to-toe with  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") despite her [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer")-enhanced speed.
- **Ranged Combatant:** Although Rictus was most skilled in close combat, Rictus could also throw his halberd with excellent force and accuracy, capable of effortlessly pinning  [Sevika's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") mechanical arm against a solid wall and even taking down an enormous  [chemtank berserker](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Turbo_Chemtank "Turbo Chemtank").
- **[Kaenic Rookern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kaenic_Rookern "Kaenic Rookern"):** Rictus' rookern provides a valuable barrier against magical attacks, whether they originate from  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") mages or [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") weapons. Rictus carried the rookern on his person always and inscribed the stones with names of those he defeated in honorable combat.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1) Rictus would keep the runic stones wrapped around his halberd, using them to block  [Amara's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Amara "Universe:Amara")  [ethereal chains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LeBlanc#Ethereal_Chains "LeBlanc") and dissipating a blast from  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx")  [Zapper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Zap! "Jinx"). This same rookern was later used by  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") during her invasion of the Hexgate, which she used to shield herself from  [Caitlyn's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") hextech sniper rifle.[[13]](#cite_note-209dirt-13)
- **Hunting & Cooking:** While not an expert hunter, Rictus was able to catch enough rabbits in the [Great Barrier](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_Barrier "Universe:The Great Barrier") mountains to survive a two month journey, which he would cook into meals for  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") and  [Rell](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rell "Universe:Rell").[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)

relations.relationship_description:
When Ambessa began to build her elite warbands, she commissioned many  [Reckoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") arenas so she could scout out and recruit powerful fighters across the empire. One of the first warriors she recruited was Rictus, a giant of a man with an unstoppable, unshakeable calm in his fighting style. Believing he was wasted in the arena, Ambessa bought out his debts and allowed Rictus to repay her by fighting in her Wolf's Reapers, where he quickly rose to the rank of her second-in-command. When Rictus had fully repaid his dues, he chose to continue serving her, and she grew to trust him as the strongest and most loyal soldier in her army. Rictus refused any titles Ambessa tried to give him, making clear many times that his only wish was to be her bodyguard. Over the course of decades, Rictus served as Ambessa's sparring partner, advisor, and best friend, as well as the only one she could trust with her closely guarded secrets, including  [Mel's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") true nature and her feud with the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"). Rictus would frequently encourage his general to control her emotions and focus on the bigger picture, and he would express concern if Ambessa's plans put herself in harm's way. Even if she ignored his advice, Rictus would always follow her orders, and would become deeply apologetic if he ever failed her in any way.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)

After Ambessa successfully took control of  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), Rictus was a brutal supporter of her and  [Caitlyn's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") regime, as well as a co-conspirator in Ambessa's plot to declare martial law. His death at the hands of  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") enraged Ambessa to such an extent that she invaded and destroyed  [Viktor's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") entire commune. Ambessa would then ask  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") to save Rictus' life, but his injuries were far too severe. At Rictus's burial, Ambessa decided not to mourn his death but instead to avenge it, as she planned her full-scale invasion of Piltover.

As  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") right hand and long-time bodyguard, Rictus was familiar with both her children, including Mel. Rictus was often sent to find Mel whenever Ambessa wished to speak with her, and as Ambessa's sworn protector, he was committed to defending her family line as well. Rictus knew Mel's true nature as a mage long before she did, but kept the secret at Ambessa's request. On Ambessa's orders, Rictus was the one who prepared Mel's ship to leave for  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") shortly before her exile, which he and Ambessa did to ensure the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose") would not be able to find her.[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1)

While in Piltover, Rictus believed Ambessa should loop Mel in on the details of her feud with the Black Rose. Mel, in turn, knew Rictus well enough to recognize his burial in  [Viktor's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") commune just by looking at his halberd. Mel later claimed at the battle of the Hexgate that her mother had sacrificed Rictus in pursuit of her ambition, in an vain attempt to convince her to withdraw her forces.[[13]](#cite_note-209dirt-13)

Rictus's first introduction to Rell was when he and  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") went to the  [Reckoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") arena in [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun") to scout out potential recruits who could strengthen Ambessa's line of succession. Rictus was present when Rell defeated the reigning champion Navus, and he described her as "raw" when Ambessa asked if she would be a good fit for the Wolf's Reapers. After they recruited Rell, Rictus was amused by Rell's seasickness on Ambessa's ship, and by the fact that she cursed more than some of the warband's veterans. The three of them, along with the [vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vastaya "Universe:Vastaya") Caprian, spent months together surviving the dangerous mountains of the [Great Barrier](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_Barrier "Universe:The Great Barrier") and as they rode from [Vindor](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vindor "Universe:Vindor") to the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion"), and it was during this time that Rictus became a mentor to Rell, practicing with her while also giving her lessons on strategic awareness. Rictus came to care for Rell greatly, believing her to be "strong" and expressing silent encouragement for her relationship with Tora. Rell, in turn, looked up to Rictus as a role model, as a former Reckoner who became an excellent soldier. Later, Rictus was the first person she spoke to after her powers of ferromancy manifested, and he also vouched for the good instincts she showed in leading their retreat.

Rictus was the one who suggested that Ambessa should adopt Rell, as he believed she was more than capable of leading the  [Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Medarda "Universe:House Medarda") clan alongside  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") and  [Kino](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kino "Universe:Kino"). When Rell was kidnapped by the  [Black Rose](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Black_Rose "Universe:Black Rose"), Rictus wanted to save her as soon as possible, but obeyed Ambessa when she chose to confront Ta'Fik first. He and Ambessa later found Inyene's laboratory empty, with no sign of Rell anywhere.

Caprian was a horned, goat-like [vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vastaya "Universe:Vastaya") that Rictus and  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") released from  [Lady Binan's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mion "Universe:Mion") palace. In hopes of returning to his native home of  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia"), Caprian agreed to make a deal with  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), and since the information he held was deemed vital for  [Boram Darkwill's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boram_Darkwill "Universe:Boram Darkwill") planned invasion, Ambessa assigned Rictus to protect Caprian so that she could use what he knew to earn the Grand General's favor. As they made the long journey from [Bel'zhun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27zhun "Universe:Bel'zhun") to the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion"), Rictus and Caprian interacted regularly, with Caprian teasing him for being a "nanny goat" and Rictus becoming irritated by Caprian's tendency to put himself into dangerous situations. Rictus saved Caprian's life on several occasions during their months of traveling together. They also went hunting for food together in the [Great Barrier](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Great_Barrier "Universe:The Great Barrier") mountains and faced down wild [drakehounds](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Drakehound "Universe:Drakehound"). They eventually parted ways in Darkwill's palace, with Caprian not being given the chance to say goodbye due to the Grand General's eagerness to speak with him.

Rictus was a long-time enemy of the Black Rose and was the only other person who knew about  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") feud with them, as it was a secret she kept even from her own children. While he first learned about the Black Rose from Rudo, a former member of the order, Rictus's first true encounter with the cabal came earlier, when he faced down the [rune-soldiers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Magic "Magic") they had created. When he learned they were behind  [Rell's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rell "Universe:Rell") kidnapping, Rictus considered it a top priority to save her, and he argued in favor of rescuing her from Inyene's laboratory before confronting Ta'Fik. Rictus's  [rookern](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kaenic_Rookern "Kaenic Rookern") proved a useful ward against the Rose's magic,[[1]](#cite_note-AmbessaBook-1) and in the following years, he would come to depend on it as a vital lifeline when the cabal would send  [assassins](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Amara "Universe:Amara") to try and kill them.

Rictus accompanied Ambessa to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"), where they planned to acquire [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") weapons to be used against the cabal's mages. After Ambessa took control of the city, she and Rictus learned that the Black Rose had kidnapped Mel, but he appeared less paranoid about them than she was, as he doubted that they were behind the disappearances of  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") and  [Heimerdinger](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heimerdinger "Universe:Heimerdinger").

Rictus did not respect Salo, seeing him as a simple pawn for  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") ends. He was made aware of Ambessa's plan to declare martial law and instate Salo as general of the city, but believed he wasn't "ready" for this, suggesting that they should let  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") in on their plan instead. Ambessa shared Rictus' doubts about Salo, so when the time came to nominate the city's commander, she nominated  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") in his place, and Rictus prevented Salo from interfering with the announcement.

While Piltover was under martial law and Zaun placed under occupation, Rictus was a brutal supporter of Caitlyn's regime, which in practice placed the city under  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") control. Rictus would sometimes stand guard while Ambessa was training Caitlyn in close combat and the Noxian principles, and he was known to keep an eye on her to ensure her loyalty to Ambessa. He gave Caitlyn a nod of approval for capturing  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), but was livid with Caitlyn when she betrayed Ambessa to try and save  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"). For this, he expressed regret that Ambessa had misplaced her trust, but was unable to kill her before  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") intervened.

While Zaun was under Piltovan occupation, Rictus led the on-the-ground efforts to try and locate Jinx, harassing civilians and leading interrogations to try and gain more information about her whereabouts. Rictus did not respect Jinx for hiding from the  [Piltover Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers"), believing her to be a coward for refusing to fight while her own people suffered. Jinx eventually came out of hiding as a direct result of Rictus capturing  [Isha](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha"), and when he attempted to kill  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") and capture  [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), Jinx came to their rescue, fighting Rictus with her  [Zapper](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Zap! "Jinx"). Rictus ultimately won their battle, but was unable to kill her before Warwick intervened.

After an attack on Stillwater left numerous  [enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") dead, Rictus traveled into Zaun to help capture the beast for Ambessa, with her army bringing a massive cage to trap him in. When Ambessa went to enact her plan, Rictus secretly followed  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") and  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") to the sleeping Warwick make sure everything went smoothly. However, although Rictus managed to defeat everyone who attempted to prevent Warwick's capture, Warwick himself woke up and angrily tossed Rictus through the greenhouse's wall for hurting his  [daughter](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"). Warwick became enraged shortly after this, and despite Rictus' best efforts to fight back, he was savagely mauled by the beast, ending his life.
