structure.name: Renata_Glasc
structure.quote: *"We don't have to be enemies. Let me change your mind."*
structure.background:
### Early Life

Renata was born in the city of Zaun, her parents were brilliant alchemists who used their knowledge to make medicine, but they had a big heart that even rejected the money they were given, Renata got used to going to bed hungry because of it.

When she was old enough Renata was finally able to join the family business, but she was not as skilled in alchemy as her parents were, but her ambition prompted her to start charging higher class Zaunites.

She proudly gave the money she had earned to her parents, but instead of using it to live more comfortably, they used it to finance research into a new medicine that could prolong life. In Piltover, the leaders of the most powerful clans found out about the Glasc family's experiments and, not wanting a threat, they paid some vigilantes to kill them.

That same night Renata woke up suddenly to the screams of pain and fear from her parents, because they had set fire to their house around her. Renata tried to save them but lost an arm in the process. When the fire was extinguished, Renata was the only survivor, with only her parents' investigation in her hand.
structure.appearance: Renata Glasc is a middle aged, lean, and brown skinned woman. Her hair is black with strains of grey showing. Her eye colors are chemically altered and have a pink and purple hue. Her most notable features are her breather mask that she often wears and an elegantly designed chemtech-augmented left arm infused with [chemicals](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Chemtech "Chemtech"). She wears an expensive white suit, with many intricate patterns and accessories.
structure.personality:
Renata Glasc is a cunning and ruthless woman, determined to achieve her goals no matter what, having built her convictions from her past and doing anything to achieve her goals. Having survived the brutality of Zaun's streets, Renata decided to never again be put down.

Unlike other chembarons, Renata prefers to avoid violence, and instead resorts to manipulation, convincing others to do her bidding and satisfy her desires by tying their interest together, thus putting them in debt towards her. To manipulate the masses, she often feigns benevolence, taking advantage of crisis and tragedies to make herself a savior.

The trauma from her loss has made her deeply resentful of the idea of charity, deeming it foolish. She has a particular hatred towards  [Janna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Janna "Universe:Janna") for not helping her family when she was young.
structure.abilities:
- **Alchemist:** While not as skilled as her parents, Renata has proven to be a talented alchemist in her own way. She was able to synthesize perfume concoctions from various chemicals with desired side-effects.
- **Entrepreneurship:** Renata is a talented businesswoman, able to make secure lucrative deals in both Piltover and Zaun. She amasses considerable wealth through her business ventures, including her perfume company, Glasc Industries.
- **Gun Proficiency:** Renata is sometimes seen using a pistol which she has holstered on her whenever she ventures out in Zaun.
- **Leader:** Renata is a competent leader. Feared and respected amongst Zaunites, she would do whatever was necessary to ensure her visions came to pass.

relations.relationship_description: Renata held a grudge towards her parents for leaving the family in poverty when she was young. After they died, she looked down on her parents' methods of charity and dedicated herself to becoming successful to prove them wrong. However, underneath she still genuinely loves her parents and laments their deaths, wanting revenge on the ones which were involved.
Camille was among the Piltovan nobles responsible for the deaths of Renata's parents in 967 AN.
After being expelled from the University of Piltover and returning back to Zaun, Renata would be responsible for funding Viktor's augment research.
Ekko's parents, Wyeth and Inna, were forced to work in terrible working conditions under Renata's orders.
Renata funded the gunsmiths responsible for selling Samira her guns.

Renata was able to turn Baron Spindlow to her side to do her dirty work, sending him and his men to hunt down  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko") and manage one of the  [chembaron](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chembaron?action=edit&redlink=1 "Universe:Chembaron (page does not exist)") factories.
Zeri is a frequent nuisance to Renata, often sabotaging her operations throughout Zaun.

Elodat began working for Renata since she was twelve, and since then became one of Renata's most reliable devisers, with her providing Elodat's family with funds and jobs. After Renata demonstrated her Decanter in the Vesella Novelty Gala, she let Elodat visit her family after the demonstration.[[1]](#cite_note-1) She also had no problem with Elodat's brother having a same-sex relationship with his male fiancé.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

structure.trivia:
- Renata Glasc utilizes a variety of chemicals developed by her parents as opposed to shimmer.[[3]](#cite_note-3)
- Her name is Latin in origin and means Reborn (Renatus is the original latin name).[[4]](#cite_note-4)
- [Zaun's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") faction icon is based on the Glasc family crest.[[5]](#cite_note-5)
- Renata Glasc bears a striking resemblance to  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") and his position in  [Arcane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series) "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)"). Both are the main rulers of their cities who result in brutal measures to achieve their goals of toppling the supremacy and dependency of Piltover. In fact, Silco served as inspiration for Renata.[[6]](#cite_note-6)
  - While Silco is seen to use [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shimmer "Shimmer"), the name of Renata's purple substance was never mentioned.
  - It is implied that Renata Glasc will try to succeed  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") as leader of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") following the events of the series, based on  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") interaction with her ( '**You'll never fill Silco's shoes...'**).

- Chemtech Decanter

structure.name: Rengar
structure.quote: *"Prey on the weak and you may survive. Prey on the strong and you will truly live."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Rengar hails from a tribe of Shuriman vastaya known as the Kiilash, whose society venerated the honor and glory of the hunt. Rengar was born the runt of the litter to the tribe's chieftain, Ponjaf. Ponjaf believed Rengar's diminutive size would make him a worthless hunter. He ignored his child, assuming the runt would starve to death.

Eventually, the young Rengar fled the camp, ashamed that he had disappointed his father. He subsisted on grubs and plants for weeks until, one day, he was nearly killed by a legendary human hunter named Markon. Upon seeing Rengar's state, he took pity on the creature and let it live. Besides, this was no mighty vastayan warrior worthy of Markon's blade.

Rengar spent months following Markon, feeding off the corpses the hunter left behind. He still hoped to one day rejoin his tribe, and so took great care in observing how Markon took down his quarries.

After some time, Markon grew sick of the pathetic Kiilash following him around. He put a knife to Rengar's throat and informed him that the only way to be a hunter was to hunt. He tossed Rengar the blade and kicked him down a ravine, where he was forced to make his first kill to survive.

From then on, Rengar spent years pushing himself almost to breaking point. He scoured Shurima for the most powerful and dangerous prey. Though he would never be as big as other Kiilash, Rengar was determined to be twice as ferocious. Over time, instead of coming back to his camp each time with fresh scars, he began to come back with trophies. He polished a sandhawk's skull to a sheen; he braided the teeth of a shrieker into his hair.

Then, when he decided the time had come, Rengar returned to his tribe, ready to be accepted as a true hunter.

Ponjaf scoffed at Rengar and his trophies. He decreed that only by bringing back the head of the elusive and legendary Void-abomination known as Kha'Zix would Rengar be welcomed back into the tribe.

Blinded by his eagerness, Rengar allowed this cunning beast to get the drop on him. The Void creature ripped out one of Rengar's eyes and escaped. Furious and defeated, Rengar admitted his failure to Ponjaf. As expected, his father chastised him.

But as Ponjaf spoke, Rengar noticed all the trophies adorning his father's hut were dusty and old. The chieftain had not hunted anything in a long time—he had likely sent Rengar after Kha'Zix because he was too afraid to do it himself.

Rengar interrupted his father and called him a coward. Many Kiilash were blessed with strong bodies or comfortable homes. Rengar, conversely, was born facing death. He had taught himself how to hunt, and had the trophies and scars to prove it. Even his own bloody eye socket was a trophy: proof that though Rengar was born with disadvantages, he never gave up.

Rengar leapt onto his father and gutted him from neck to belly. The fiercest hunters of the tribe crowned him with flame-roses, marking him as their new chieftain.

But Rengar didn't need his village's acceptance. All he needed was adrenaline pumping through his veins as he chased down his prey. He left the village, without even pausing to take a trophy from what was left of Ponjaf—his father was not a kill worthy of remembering. Instead, he set off determined to find and slay the Void creature that had tried to blind him.

Not to satisfy the Kiilash, but to satisfy himself.

### [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sentinels_of_Light "Universe:Sentinels of Light")

During the invasion of the Black Mist, Rengar encountered its spectral manifestations in the jungles of Ixtal. Despite his prowess as a hunter, he found himself ill-equipped to combat these ethereal foes and was overwhelmed. Lucian and a Sentinel recruit intervened, rescuing Rengar from the wraiths. Initially shaken by the encounter, Rengar was reluctant to continue the fight. However, the recruit's encouragement reignited his determination. Recognizing the Mist as a formidable prey, Rengar joined the Sentinels. He was outfitted with relic weapons capable of harming the wraiths and took the Sentinel's oath, committing to the battle against the Ruined King.
structure.appearance:
Rengar is a hulking anthropomorphic lion covered in white fur. He has a hunched, broad-shouldered build, digitigrade legs, and tan claws on every digit. His right eye is blue while his left eye is missing, having been covered with an eyepatch-like device that glows yellow. The fur on his head is usually fashioned into several long braids that drape across his back. He also has a shaggy beard, usually tied off into a single thin lock.

His hunting garb is appropriately brutal, a series of sparse metal plates with leather padding, "decorated" with bones and fangs.
structure.personality: Rengar's as fierce as they come as well as brave, he lives for the hunt and the thrill of it and he roams the land seeking worthy opponents or prey that can put up a fight, those he kills, he puts on display in his trophy collection. but while he is savage he is incredibly intelligent, much to that of a patient predator, he studies his prey for strengths and weaknesses and then start hunting.
structure.abilities:
- **Vastayan Physiology:** Rengar is a Vastaya, an ancient race of demi-humans changed by the magic of the Spirit Realm. The connection to the Spirit Realm increased their longevity so they can live for centuries, and granted them powerful magic. The Vastaya are divided into several different tribes, each one defined by an specific animal. Rengar is a Kiilash, a type of leonine Vastaya.
  - **Enhanced Strength:** Rengar is extremely strong, easily capable of killing a man in seconds.
  - **Enhanced Speed:** Rengar's speed is far greater than that of a normal human.
  - **Enhanced Agility:** Rengar's agility and body cordination allow him to move in ways that others couldn't. He can jump from branch to branch at frightening speed.

relations.relationship_description: Having fought and lost an eye as well as almost his life, Rengar sees  [Kha'Zix](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kha%27Zix "Universe:Kha'Zix") as the ultimate prey and wants to hunt him down and mount  [his head](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rengar#Head_of_Kha'Zix "Rengar") on his den as the ultimate  [hunting trophy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rengar#Bonetooth_Necklace "Rengar").

Rengar was saved by  [Lucian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lucian "Universe:Lucian") and a Sentinel Rookie when the  [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sentinels_of_Light "Universe:Sentinels of Light") came to the jungles Ixtal in search of a fetter, he would later join them in order to hunt  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") to prove that he was still an apex predator.

structure.trivia:
- Rengar belongs to the [Vastaya](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vastaya "Vastaya") race and tribe known as the Kiilash, which is named after Kiila, a Vastayashai'rei hero during the war against a race of titans from the sky. They are the Vastaya inhabitants of [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima").
  - The Kiilash apparently believe that seeing a [yordle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle") during a hunt is a good omen that the hunt will be successful.
- During the events of [Adaptation](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Adaptation "Adaptation"), Rengar lost his left eye to  [Kha'Zix](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kha%27Zix "Universe:Kha'Zix"). Before that he had a pair of blue eyes.
- His  [Kirai Saber](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rengar#Savagery "Rengar") previously belonged to Markon, his former hunting mentor.
- He may be a few hundred years old.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
- [The Hunter Hunted](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Hunter_Hunted "The Hunter Hunted") was originally written from Rengar's point of view; however, with the later established timeline and map settings, the hunter from the story is unlikely to still be him.[[2]](#cite_note-2)

structure.name: Marcus
structure.background:
### Early Life

During his younger years, Marcus joined the Enforcers, with Sheriff  [Grayson](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Grayson "Universe:Grayson") as his superior and developed a hot-blooded and aggressive attitude towards his job. Eventually, he would marry an unknown woman and have a single daughter named  [Ren](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ren "Universe:Ren").

### The Robbery

Marcus had always been overzealous in acting on his duties as an enforcer. He looked down on  [Zaunites](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") in general and aggressively went after them.[[1]](#cite_note-101playground-1)[[2]](#cite_note-102mysteries-2) When four children from the undercity caused an explosion in the workshop of  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce"), Marcus joined Sheriff  [Grayson](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Grayson "Universe:Grayson") in investigating. They went to see  [Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), with whom Grayson had a deal with to maintain the peace between their districts.[[1]](#cite_note-101playground-1) Marcus did not care about their deal however and when pressured by the Council, tried to look for the children on his own; more so when the crime lord  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") approached him with a deal and information about his culprits.

Marcus went to The Last Drop and ordered his men to aggressively search the place. Grayson rebuked him for this later at the police department, believing the undercity would retaliate and trigger a war. However, they received the pneumatic tube capsule she’d given to Vander for when they had someone who would claim responsibility for the explosion, thus giving Grayson hope that they could still maintain the peace deal. Vander's daughter  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") tried to turn herself in,[[2]](#cite_note-102mysteries-2) only for Vander to stop her and surrender himself in her place. Before they could return to the upper city however, Silco had a [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer")-mutated  [Deckard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Deckard "Universe:Deckard") kill Grayson,  [Benzo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Benzo "Universe:Benzo"), and other enforcers in their squad, to Marcus's horror. Silco told Marcus that the terms of their deal had changed and threw him his money, which became covered in the blood on the ground.

Later, Marcus noticed an explosion by the docks, and he found Vi in the area, hidden from view from Silco and his henchmen. Marcus drugged and kidnapped her, telling her she would be killed if Silco heard her, and Vi was arrested.[[3]](#cite_note-3) Silco had expected, and possibly ordered, Marcus to kill her, but he instead threw her into Stillwater Hold without a trial or details of her crimes.[[4]](#cite_note-106walls-4) Marcus had to bribe the warden on at least one occasion to ensure Vi's stay in the prison.[[5]](#cite_note-archives-5)

### Piltovan Bicentennial

Marcus kept up his corrupt dealings with Silco. He was also eventually promoted to Sheriff in the Piltover police department, making him even more useful to Silco. With his position, Marcus and other enforcers managed to aid Silco's criminal business by letting his smuggled shimmer-shipments go through the Hexgate with no problems. He also interfered when other enforcers tried to investigate Silco's dealings and shut them down.[[6]](#cite_note-6)[[7]](#cite_note-7) Marcus also had deals with the merchants in the city, one that was secretly sanctioned by most members of the Council.[[8]](#cite_note-105enemy-8)

He was not without his doubts about his deal with Silco, particularly when Silco's daughter  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") caused the deaths of his officers during a bombing at the Academy Square. Once, he visited Grayson's crypt and described Grayson as a "good woman" when his daughter asked him who she was. Nonetheless, Marcus toed the line of doing right by his men and having to work for Silco, now needing to find someone to answer for the explosion as Silco would be unwilling to give up his daughter. Silco told Marcus to pin the explosion on the  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights"), Silco's enemy in the undercity, and use it as an excuse to hunt the gang down. For a moment, Marcus considered blowing himself up along with Silco by using Jinx's bomb but was ultimately unable to do so.[[8]](#cite_note-105enemy-8)

When  [Jayce Talis](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce"), very recently appointed a Councilor, ordered him to tighten security at the Hexgate, Marcus tried to warn him and advised him to consult the Council first. True enough, Jayce would later need to adapt to the ire from the merchants and Councilors whose businesses suffered from Jayce's security measures. Later, Jayce was not happy about how vulnerable Piltover still was, and Marcus misinformed him about who the culprit was, framing the  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights"). To prevent a future attack, Jayce took Marcus's joking suggestion to form a blockade at the bridge and search everyone who would attempt to pass seriously, and Marcus obeyed the command.[[4]](#cite_note-106walls-4)

Silco eventually learned that Vi was still alive and had begun investigating Silco with a rogue Enforcer named  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"). Silco made a visit to Marcus' home and subtly threatened Marcus' daughter. Under coercion, Marcus used Jayce's blockade as a means to prevent Caitlyn and Vi's escape from the undercity back into Piltover.

### Death

Marcus stopped Caitlyn and  [Ekko](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ekko "Universe:Ekko") at the Bridge of Progress so he could retrieve the stolen hextech gemstone for Silco. When Caitlyn tried to cross the bridge back to Piltover, now with evidence against Silco, Marcus shot Ekko (who was only saved by a bulletproof plate on his chest) and he threatened to shoot her. He hesitated and was ultimately not given the chance to decide whether he would go through with it or not as Jinx's weaponized firelight bombs surrounded them and went off. Marcus survived long enough to try and pass on a message to his daughter through Caitlyn but succumbed to his injuries before he could finish his sentence.[[9]](#cite_note-9)

With this, the Council was finally made aware of his partnership with Silco, and Caitlyn explained that the reason he betrayed was not for what he would gain but for  [what](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ren "Universe:Ren") he had to lose.[[10]](#cite_note-10)
structure.appearance: Marcus is a muscular pale man, with brown eyes and hair (which was graying when he got older), as well as sporting a mustache. He is always seen wearing his Enforcers uniform with navy blue colors and gold trimmings.
structure.personality:
Initially, Marcus was a hot-blooded and aggressive person. He was very overzealous about his job. He always looked down on the people of  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") and was willing to use heavy handed policing on them. However, his ambition to outwit the criminals that eluded him, and also his naivete, made him easy to manipulate; such as when he naively made a deal with  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") which disastrously ended with Silco killing his superior and his fellow Enforcers—something that Marcus always regretted.

After a few years, Marcus became the sheriff of  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover"). He served as a saboteur and plant for Silco in Piltover, and was begrudgingly compliant to Silco. Silco knows that Marcus is impotent in resisting him and puts the screws on Marcus to get him to do his bidding. Although Marcus is vexed that he is subjugated by Silco and is committing wrongs on his behalf, Marcus cannot muster the resolve to refuse him and so Marcus meekly obeys Silco's commands. He cared and loved his daughter more than anything else, even above his moral standards and his sense of duty. He knows his daughter relies on him and thus she was the main reason he continued working with Silco—and did everything he asked him to do.

As the sheriff of Piltover, Marcus was respected by his subordinates and always maintained an image of an honorable and professional man. However, he was harsh and cold to  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") due to her being part of a wealthy, influential family—and so could never fully control her. Caitlyn was a thorn in Marcus' side as she investigated Silco's crimes despite Marcus discouraging her not to. Nevertheless, Caitlyn always respected Marcus because of his position and also because he was seen as a dutiful Enforcer and loving father. As pointed out by Silco, Marcus always saw himself as a martyr to maintain the balance between the top and underground city—and deep down, he wanted to be the hero his daughter always thought he was. However, with the passage of time, Marcus's guilt and remorse for his actions started to consume him and made him doubt if he was actually doing the right thing for Piltover or himself.

Marcus was corrupt but was troubled by his guilt and doubts. His only regret was he could never become the selfless hero that he or his daughter thought he was. In the end, he died without redeeming himself.
structure.abilities: - **Enforcement Skills**: Marcus was an Enforcer, indicating he had skills related to law enforcement, investigation, and maintaining order in the city. He displayed a hot-blooded and aggressive attitude towards his job during his early years as an Enforcer.

relations.relationship_description: Marcus worked under Sheriff Grayson during the burglary of  [Jayce Talis'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") workshop and its resulting explosive incident. They investigated the explosion caused by children from the Undercity and were tasked by the Piltover Council to find the perpetrators and make an example of them. While Grayson had a deal with the Undercity's leader,  [Vander](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick"), and sought to handle their manhunt diplomatically, Marcus chose to be very heavy handed with the Zaunites. Grayson tried to isolate Marcus from the Zaunites and tried to negotiate with Vander privately so as to not exacerbate tensions—but after the Council put pressure on the Enforcers to get results, Marcus was emboldened to agressively search The Last Drop with his men. Grayson rebuked Marcus for his bullying tactics as she thought he could have provoked a war. Unbeknownst to Grayson, Marcus had accepted a deal with  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco")—but Silco apparently changed the terms of their deal at the last minute. To Marcus' shock and dismay, Silco killed Grayson and her accompanying Enforcers during Vander's arrest—an action that Marcus didn't consent to. Nevertheless, Marcus continued to accept bribes from Silco and did his bidding, as he had already involved himself in his corruption and felt he couldn't back out for the sake of his daughter. After Marcus became Sheriff, he would visit Grayson's grave in times when he was troubled by guilt at what he's done. When his daughter inquired about the grave, he tell his daughter about the good woman Grayson was.

Vander had a deal with Sheriff Grayson to maintain peace between Piltover and Zaun. Marcus, however, disregarded this deal and later bullied Vander and his bar when he was searching for the children responsible for the Piltover explosion. Marcus was bigoted against Zaunites, and he saw Vander as just another Zaunite criminal that was maliciously shielding the criminals he was after. However, after Vander made himself the scapegoat for the workshop explosion, Marcus gained some respect for Vander as he kidnapped his adopted daughter,  [Violet](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), in order to prevent Silco from murdering her.

Silco approached Marcus with a deal after the Piltover explosion incident and seems to indicate that the criminals that Marcus is searching for are Vander's children. Silco apparently changed the terms of their deal at the last minute. To Marcus' shock and dismay, Silco killed Grayson and her accompanying Enforcers during Vander's arrest—an action that Marcus didn't consent to. Nevertheless, Marcus continued to accept bribes from Silco and did his bidding, as he has already involved himself in his corruption and felt he couldn't back out for the sake of his daughter,  [Ren](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ren "Universe:Ren"). Marcus kidnapped  [Violet](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi"), Vander's daughter, eventually throwing her into Stillwater Hold Prison without a trial or records for her arrest; all in order to hide her from Silco. For Marcus, it was the only way to save Vi's life—as Silco would murder her—while also preventing her from revealing Marcus' dealings with Silco.

In the following years, Marcus became Sheriff of Piltover and used his authority to cover up Silco's shimmer-distribution operations and misdirecting the Piltover Council's blame to Silco's enemies, the  [Firelights](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Firelights "Universe:Firelights"). Aside from concealing Silco's criminal activities, Marcus also led his Enforcers in killing the Firelights, but became increasingly stressed and frustrated when Silco's favorite subordinate and surrogate daughter,  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx"), orchestrated a series of chaotic massacres in Piltover, killing numerous of his own Enforcers. However, Silco, knowing Marcus was too impotent to ever resist him, was always dismissive of his concerns, refusing to even consider allow the sheriff to arrest his adopted child. In turn, Marcus would fantasize about heroically taking Silco down in a suicide bombing, but he could never muster the resolve to follow through.

Silco eventually learned that Vi was still alive and was investigating Silco with a rogue Enforcer,  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"). Silco made a visit to Marcus' home and subtly threatened his daughter in order to coerce him into eliminating the problem. Marcus was later killed by Jinx while he was following Silco's orders. Though Silco downplayed the damage Jinx's actions caused, even Silco admitted that Marcus was a great asset to him and his loss will set him back, though he assured  [Sevika](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sevika "Universe:Sevika") that they would "buy" another Sheriff.

After Jayce Talis was promoted to a Councilor, Marcus saw him as an inconvenience and a potential threat if he learned too much. Jayce was the only Councilor who was attentive enough to spot the discrepancies created by Marcus' cover ups, implemented security measures that disrupted Silco's criminal enterprise, and was determined to root out the corruption. Fortunately for Marcus, he still had his reputation of a trusted sheriff of Piltover, which he used to mislead Jayce. While Marcus posed as a dutiful and cooperative subordinate under Jayce, he would misinform Jayce by trying to make the Firelights the culprits of Silco's crimes.

Marcus considered Caitlyn Kiramman an upstart, an interloper, and a well-meaning cop. Although Caitlyn believed she is trying to contribute to the Enforcer's cause by doing meaningful police work, Marcus accused her of using her family's status to ignore the chain of command. In truth, Marcus saw her as a problem for his corrupt activities. He tried to keep her distracted with trivial busywork and ordered her to leave the investigations into Silco's crimes alone. However, Caitlyn was determined to uncover Silco's criminal conspiracy and when Silco found her and Vi's investigations into him problematic, he pressured Marcus to eliminate her. Marcus made a plan to murder her at the Bridge of Progress, using her trust in him to lower her guard. Although he managed to put a gun to her, he seemed hesitant to kill her for a moment. Before Marcus could pull the trigger, he was fatally injured by Jinx's insect bombs. In his dying moments, he asked Caitlyn to pass on a message to his daughter, but couldn't finish the message before dying.

structure.background:
### Early Life

Xin Zhao was born in Ionia, raised on a fisherman's ship named *Viscero*. While serving as a cabin boy, Xin Zhao met  [Bo Yang](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bo_Yang "Universe:Bo Yang"), whom he eventually became close with and saw as a brother. One day, they ended up crossing into the waters of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), where a Noxian ship captured them and took them to Noxus. Xin Zhao managed to kill one his captors to protect the crew, impressing the Noxians. When they reached Noxus, they let Xin Zhao and Bo Yang go, while the others were taken to the Reckoning Pits.[[4]](#cite_note-Warning-4) Unfamiliar with this new land, Xin Zhao rose above the ranks with his expert spearmanship, so Noxus offered him a chance to live a better life. He reluctantly accepted and entered the arenas of the  [Reckoners](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") and took the name Viscero after his first home, and Bo Yang followed him.[[5]](#cite_note-Seneschal-5)[[4]](#cite_note-Warning-4)

### The Great Viscero

[Viscero](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xin_Zhao/Cosmetics "Xin Zhao/Cosmetics") was a famous warrior amongst the arena, with the crowd cheering for the carnage he inflicted while the other  [Reckoners](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") grew to fear him. But eventually,  [Boram Darkwill](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boram_Darkwill "Universe:Boram Darkwill") made a decree to privately free  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") mercenaries, prisoners or Reckoners—including Xin Zhao and Bo Yang—to send them to fight for Noxus in other nations. Xin Zhao was transported to  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"), where he faced against the king's elite soldiers in the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard"). Most of his fellow Reckoners ran away, but Xin Zhao stood his ground, taking down many of the  [Demacians](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia"). However,  [Bo Yang](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bo_Yang "Universe:Bo Yang") was killed in battle.[[4]](#cite_note-Warning-4) When he was confronted by soldiers, he welcomed them to execute him, but he was instead spared and imprisoned. At his request, Xin Zhao was taken to meet their king,  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III").[[5]](#cite_note-Seneschal-5)[[3]](#cite_note-Sail-3)

### Service to King Jarvan III

:   *Main article: [What Once Sailed Free](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:What_Once_Sailed_Free "Universe:What Once Sailed Free")*

While Xin Zhao was repeatedly threatened by Sword-Captain  [Tianna Crownguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tianna "Universe:Tianna"),  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") was curious to hear Xin Zhao's story and gave him a chance to speak. After their conversation, he offered Xin Zhao a bag of money to go back to his real home in [Raikkon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Raikkon "Universe:Raikkon"), but since Demacia had shown him the true meaning of the ideals he strove for, he wanted to join his guard, which came as a shock to Tianna. The king asked how Xin Zhao could prove he was capable, so he snatched a guard's spear and fought off the guards before pointing the spear at the king's throat. He apologized and prepared to be killed, but Jarvan III forgave him and accepted him into his ranks. Tianna was still distrustful of him, but Xin Zhao swore an oath to her that if something happened to Jarvan III, she would kill him by her own hand.[[3]](#cite_note-Sail-3)

Years passed, and Xin Zhao grew to become very close friends with Jarvan III, being chosen as his seneschal and bodyguard. Xin Zhao also became a beloved mentor to the young  [Prince Jarvan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV"), hoping to raise him into an honorable king. To this end, Xin Zhao trained Jarvan IV in martial techniques and the myriad arts of war, and shared his knowledge of the spiritual philosophies of his old homeland of  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia").[[6]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-6) Few were as loyal to the crown as Xin Zhao, and he believed that Demacia was where he truly belonged, serving them not for duty, but his own choice.[[5]](#cite_note-Seneschal-5)

As Seneschal, Xin Zhao had a high position and could have chosen any room in the Citadel of Dawn. He chose a small room next to the Palace Gardens, which reminded him of Ionia. Xin Zhao also became acquainted with the palace library, which he perused for knowledge and would share with the king in his spare time.[[7]](#cite_note-Spearhead-7) He became like family to the king and the prince, and was honored as one of the kingdom's finest warriors.[[8]](#cite_note-DR-8)

### Pilgrimage to Ionia

#### Meeting with Master Kennen

:   *Main article: [Pilgrimage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pilgrimage "Universe:Pilgrimage")*

More than thirty years after leaving the land of his birth, Xin Zhao found Spirit Blossoms blooming from a sapling that he tended to in the royal gardens of Demacia, which were believed to never bloom beyond the First Lands. On the advice of his liege-lord Jarvan, Xin Zhao sailed halfway across the world to the [Navori](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Navori "Universe:Navori") province of Ionia, taking a royal vessel and guards with him in search of answers. At the Spirit Blossom Festival, Xin Zhao met  [Kennen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kennen "Universe:Kennen") of the  [Kinkou Order](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kinkou_Order "Universe:Kinkou Order"), who was initially displeased that the Seneschal had brought a weapon into the holy festival. Still, Kennen could see something was troubling Xin and filled him in on all that had happened in Ionia during his absence: [the Noxian invasion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxian_Invasion_of_Ionia "Universe:Noxian Invasion of Ionia"), and the occupation, during which time not a single blossom bloomed.[[1]](#cite_note-Pilgrimage-1) Kennen also discussed with Xin Zhao the [Tale of the Devoted Shrine Maiden](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Devoted_Shrine_Maiden "Universe:The Devoted Shrine Maiden"), who followed her patron spirit into exile after the War of the False Kanmei. Kennen then invited Xin Zhao to the Kinkou [Temple of Koeshin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Temple_of_Koeshin "Universe:Temple of Koeshin"), where he planted the sapling in Ionian soil at the top of the steps.[[9]](#cite_note-9)

#### Battle of Koeshin

:   *Main article: [The Battle of Koeshin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Battle_of_Koeshin "Universe:The Battle of Koeshin")*

As Xin Zhao and Kennen were meditating at the top of the mountain, they were interrupted by a magical surge that heralded an invasion by [demonkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demon "Universe:Demon") from the [spirit realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spirit_Realm "Universe:Spirit Realm"). As Kennen left to speak with Masters  [Shen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shen "Universe:Shen") and  [Mayym](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mayym "Universe:Mayym"), Xin went to fight the creatures on his own. During the battle, he was unexpectedly aided by another Kinkou warrior named  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara"), and he learned of a second, secret temple on the mountain known as the Temple of Twilight. The two of them fought back against the demons and their leader, a demonic pretender who took the form of the  [Grovemother](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Morgana/Cosmetics "Morgana/Cosmetics") from Ionian folklore. Their battles with the pretender led them to defend the villagers, as other  [wicked forces](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Atakhan "Universe:Atakhan") stalked the forests around them.[[10]](#cite_note-Koeshin-10)

At the end of the conflict, Xin Zhao and Yunara had successfully slain the pretender, though the spear given to him by  [King Jarvan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") was broken in the process. They left to confer with Kennen, and though Yunara demanded to speak with Shen, Kennen simply reacted with shock upon seeing her, as her post had been abandoned. Shortly after, a bell rang from the Temple of Twilight, signalling the wards had been breached. As they left to investigate, Yunara warned Xin Zhao that their "true test" lay ahead of them.[[10]](#cite_note-Koeshin-10)

While going to the Temple of Twilight, Xin Zhao started having [dark visions](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Beginning_of_the_End "Universe:Beginning of the End") of a corrupted  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") in ruins.[[11]](#cite_note-11) Disturbed by this, Xin Zhao demanded to know who they were up against, Yunara and Kennen shared the [truth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Truth "Universe:The Truth") about  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen") and the [Great Darkin War](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Darkin_War "Universe:Great Darkin War"). The breach at the temple had convinced them that the  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin") had returned and intended to free Zaahen, and though they urged Xin Zhao to flee and warn Demacia, he chose to stay and fight, as the Darkin posed a threat to the entire world. Arriving at the mountain where the Temple of Twilight had emerged, they discovered it had already returned to the Spirit Realm, and to get access to it they needed to face the Trials of Twilight. Xin Zhao donned new  [garb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xin_Zhao/Cosmetics "Xin Zhao/Cosmetics") and attached his spearhead to a new shaft grown from the sapling he brought to Ionia, after which he and Yunara traveled with the help of Kennen to the Spirit Realm to begin their trials.[[12]](#cite_note-Truth-12)

#### Trials of Twilight

Upon entering the Spirit Realm, Xin Zhao and Yunara got split into their own individual trials. In his own, Xin Zhao went back to his old life on the *Viscero*, seeing visions of his friend  [Bo Yang](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bo_Yang "Universe:Bo Yang"), who recounted the day the young Xin Zhao killed a grown  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") with a mop stick when their ship was captured. Although Xin Zhao and Bo Yang were cut loose when landing in the [capital](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion"), his moment of defiance had sent their entire crew into the  [Reckoning](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") pits where they would meet their deaths, while Xin Zhao himself would carry on to become a Reckoner champion. The vision then turned to Bo Yang's death at the Battle of [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead") against the Demacians, where he questioned Xin Zhao's decision to fight as he died in his arms.[[12]](#cite_note-Truth-12)

In the next vision, Xin Zhao saw his conversation with King  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") right before he was sent to  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") to investigate the Wyldbloom. Their dialogue was not as the Seneschal remembered however, as the king was acting cold, dismissive, and unkind in a way that was unlike him. While King Jarvan was speaking, a  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garen/Cosmetics "Garen/Cosmetics") bearing the form of  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") cut him down with his sword, after which Xin Zhao immediately avenged his liege-lord by driving his three-talon spear into the Darkin's throat. Behind him, another  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jarvan_IV/Cosmetics "Jarvan IV/Cosmetics") bearing the form of Prince  [Jarvan IV](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV") arrived and taunted him by foretelling the doom of Demacia. As he was at the [god-warrior's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:God-Warrior "Universe:God-Warrior") mercy, Xin Zhao saw no other option than to grab the Darkin sword in the ground Garen had left behind, believing it was the only way to win the battle ahead. However, a mysterious voice warned him that it wasn't the answer he was searching and noth the sword and the illusion vanished.[[4]](#cite_note-Warning-4)

When his part of the Trial ended, he regrouped with Yunara within the Temple of Twilight and learned that she too heard the same voices. After talking about it, the two agreed that there was still some good in Zaahen and that they would protect him from whoever was trying to break into his prison.[[4]](#cite_note-Warning-4)

### Death & Legacy

When they finally reached  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen"), they found that  [Atakhan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Atakhan "Universe:Atakhan"), alongside  [LeBlanc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"), had reached him first and embedded his glaive into its shadowy flesh. They fought desperately to free the weapon, but Atakhan's power was overwhelming. Xin Zhao defended  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara") from  [LeBlanc's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc")  [chains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LeBlanc#Ethereal_Chains "LeBlanc") as she pummeled the demon with the Aion Er'na, but one chain managed to strike her. Xin tried to protect her, only to be impaled by Atakhan himself. Realizing there was only one choice left to save the world, Xin reached for the glaive to commune with the spirit within.[[13]](#cite_note-End-13)

Within Zaahen's mindscape, the fallen god warned Xin to leave, insisting that mortals should not meddle with the power of gods. He declared that he was not the answer to their problems, only evil deferred. But Xin refused, arguing that they had no alternative and that Zaahen's power would darken the world, with or without his permission. Xin reminded him that he had once sacrificed himself to save the world and urged him to let him do the same. Unable to hold back Atakhan's assault anymore, Xin's strength began to fail, and in his final plea, Zaahen finally relented. Taking Xin Zhao as his host, Zaahen merged with him and Xin's spirit began to fade. Returned to the world once more, Zaahen destroyed Atakhan with a single strike of his glaive, forcing LeBlanc to flee, while Yunara watched in horror.[[13]](#cite_note-End-13)

In the aftermath,  [Yunara](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yunara "Universe:Yunara") took the remains of his spear home to  [Demacia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") and presented it to prince  [Jarvan IV](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_IV "Universe:Jarvan IV").[[14]](#cite_note-14) Upon seeing this, the prince brought her to meet his father,  [King Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), and she delivered the news that the Seneschal had been slain fighting a  [demon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Atakhan "Universe:Atakhan"). Jarvan III grieved for his lost friend, but recounted fond memories of him, including his love of the palace gardens and library. Jarvan III wanted to give Xin Zhao full honors for his funeral and inquired if if his body could be brought back to Demacia. Yunara worried the king would be unable to bear the news that Xin's spirit had been sundered and his body taken by a  [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darkin "Universe:Darkin"), so she hid the full truth and simply said there was nothing that could be recovered after the battle.[[7]](#cite_note-Spearhead-7)
structure.appearance:
Xin Zhao was a human man with fair skin, brown eyes, and a muscular build. He had long black hair with a white streak, usually tied back in a ponytail.

He was known for wearing Demacian armor in battle, silvery white with gold and blue highlights. However, it was fashioned in a uniquely asymmetrical style, seemingly showing the Ionian influence. For example, his blue Demacian tabard was folded over one shoulder. He also wore pastel purple cloth underneath the armor, which was visible on the unarmored parts of his body, including his thighs and elbows.

As a Reckoner, he wore Noxian gladiatorial armor. In his homeland of Ionia, he has been seen wearing simple, traditional robes. As a child aboard the Viscero, he also wore simple Ionian fishing gear, including tabi and a wide-brimmed straw hat.

His signature weapon was a two-handed tri-tip spear for use in melee combat.
structure.personality: Xin Zhao was a disciplined warrior and fiercely loyal. Having endured a life of hardship, he did not hesitate when called to battle. However, he much preferred the virtuous ideals of Demacia over the needless death and brutality of the Noxian fighting pits. Despite being a fearsome combatant, confident in his martial prowess, he often spoke gently and had an aura of calm. Still, he could show aggression and anger when confronted by his enemies or those who wished to do harm. Overall, he was a thoughtful and conscientious individual who fought primarily to protect the weak and the innocent.
structure.abilities:
- **Skilled Melee Combatant:** Xin Zhao was a skilled melee combatant who was one of the most formidable  [Reckoners](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") in all of  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"). As a child, he had been able to kill a grown man with nothing but a mopstick, and his technique only improved by the time he was a young man. Xin Zhao's mastery of the spear made him an unmatched warrior, and it was rumored that  "Viscero" had never once been defeated in one-on-one combat. Xin Zhao was able to translate these skills on the battlefield and held his own against even the elite forces of the  [Dauntless Vanguard](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Dauntless_Vanguard "Universe:Dauntless Vanguard"), though they eventually were able to defeat him with their superior numbers.
  - **[Three Talon Spear:](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xin_Zhao#Three_Talon_Strike "Xin Zhao")** Xin Zhao's weapon of choice was a three talon spear of  [Demacian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demacia "Universe:Demacia") steel, which he could  [charge](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xin_Zhao#Audacious_Charge "Xin Zhao") with and  [slash](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xin_Zhao#Crescent_Guard "Xin Zhao") in a crescent motion around him. The spearhead had anti-magical properties, and served him well against the powers of [demonkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Demon "Universe:Demon") and  [sorcerers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:LeBlanc "Universe:LeBlanc"). The spear was gifted to him by  [King Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), and Xin Zhao used these skills in service of  [House Lightshield](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:House_Lightshield "Universe:House Lightshield"), the royal family of Demacia.

relations.relationship_description: Xin Zhao and Jarvan III first met after the Battle of [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead"), where the famed  [Reckoner](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Reckoners "Universe:Reckoners") was given a chance to go in peace after sharing how he had been captured and forced to fight for in the  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") arenas in order to survive. Xin Zhao's story had resonated with King Jarvan, who likened it to the tales of Orlon and his followers seeking refuge from the world's many evils. Xin Zhao, too, had been moved by Jarvan's show of mercy, and judging him an honorable man, asked to enter his service as one of his guard. The king granted Xin Zhao's request, and in time, the former Viscero became Jarvan III's honored seneschal and trusted advisor, and one of his best friends.[[3]](#cite_note-Sail-3)[[5]](#cite_note-Seneschal-5)

Xin Zhao was the devoted protector of Jarvan IV and his father,  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III"), being chosen as the king's seneschal some time after the Battle of [Kalstead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalstead "Universe:Kalstead"). Xin Zhao had been a beloved mentor to the prince since he was a young boy, training him in history and politics, as well as the myriad arts of war and the spiritual philosophies of his distant homeland in  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia").[[6]](#cite_note-JarvanBio-6) Xin Zhao was a trusted advisor and friend to both Jarvans, and the prince considered him like family.
Xin Zhao swore an oath to Tianna Crownguard that she may kill him should anything happen to  [King Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III").

structure.trivia:
- Xin Zhao is rendered, in Chinese localization, as 赵信 *[Zhào](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zhao_(surname)) Xìn* [ʈ͡ʂau̯˥˩ ɕin˥˩], coincidentally the name of [a Xiongnu general](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zhao_Xin) who temporarily defected to [Han Chinese](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Han_dynasty) forces, though historical inspiration for Xin Zhao is evidently another Chinese general, [Zhao Yun](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zhao_Yun).
  - 信 *xìn* means "to believe, to trust" < Old Chinese *\*sins* < *\*winʔ* (cf. [Sino-Tibetan](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sino-Tibetan_languages) root *\*yum*[[15]](#cite_note-15) > 允 *yǔn* [ɥyn˨˩˦] "to be proper, to consent"[[16]](#cite_note-16)).
  - As a gladiator, Xin Zhao took the name of the fishing boat *Viscero* < Latin *viscus* "entrails", where he once worked on.
- Xin Zhao is the second champion that is canonically dead in the lore and the second whose death was shown, after his spirit was sundered and his body became the host for  [Zaahen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaahen "Universe:Zaahen"). The first champion to ever canonically and permanently die was  [Ambessa](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") at the events of the [ninth episode](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series)/Season_2/Episode_9 "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)/Season 2/Episode 9") of  [Arcane](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series) "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)") [season 2](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Arcane_(TV_Series)/Season_2 "Universe:Arcane (TV Series)/Season 2").
- Prior to his [champion update](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Champion_update "Champion update"), it was stated in the story [Aftermath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aftermath "Universe:Aftermath") that Xin Zhao had served  [Jarvan III](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jarvan_III "Universe:Jarvan III") for 20 years between the events of [What Once Sailed Free](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:What_Once_Sailed_Free "Universe:What Once Sailed Free") and  [Sylas'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sylas "Universe:Sylas") [mage rebellion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Great_Mage_Rebellion "Universe:Great Mage Rebellion").
  - Following his update, Xin Zhao's involvement in the mage rebellion has been removed from his lore.
- Xin Zhao wears reading glasses, as revealed in the comic [Spearhead](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Spearhead "Universe:Spearhead").

structure.name: Nasus
structure.quote: *"For centuries, I have watched. We approach a time of reckoning."*
structure.background: *(TBA)*
structure.appearance:
Nasus is a humanoid figure with the head of a jackal. He is tall and muscular with glowing blue eyes and a body covered in short black fur.

He wears golden, ceremonial armor with teal highlights, and much of his body is wrapped in pale bandages. His war staff  [Curator's Gatebreaker](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nasus#Siphoning_Strike "Nasus") is teal and gold with a brown leather grip.
structure.personality: Thoughtful and reclusive, Nasus is an imposing, solemn presence, bearing all the power, wisdom, and sorrow that comes with millennia of life. Primarily a keeper of knowledge, he is not one to rush to violence despite being a fearsome combatant.
structure.abilities:
- **[Ascended](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ascended "Ascended"):** Nasus is one of the Ascended, also known as God-Warriors or Sunborn. The Ascended are mortals that were empowered by [The Sun Disc](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Sun_Disc "The Sun Disc") into immensely powerful demigods. Each Ascended has unique powers depending on the individual they were prior to the Ascension.
  - **Immortality:** The ascended do not age, and do not need to eat or sleep. Barring beings of similar power, the Ascended cannot be killed.
  - **Regeneration:** Nasus can heal from almost any injury in a matter of seconds.
  - **Superhuman Strength:** Nasus is much stronger than any normal human, being able to destroy buildings by merely punching them, or break a man's entire body with his fists.
  - **Life Draining:** Nasus has the power of creating a life-draining aura, aging them down at an extremely fast pace and reducing them to dust in a matter of seconds.
  - **Size Shifting:** Nasus can change size to become gigantic and destroy his foes.

relations.relationship_description: When the Shurima Empire still existed, Nasus fought alongside other Ascended hosts including those that would later become the [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin"). Nasus was a warrior scholar who spearheaded the military and cultural uprising of Ancient Shurima, but  [Azir's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Azir "Azir")  [misled](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") [arrogance](https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://boards.na.leagueoflegends.com/en/c/gameplay-balance/qRqERevn-azir-qa-creative?comment=00080000) led to the empire's downfall, costing him his own brother  [Renekton](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renekton "Universe:Renekton"). Nasus was forced to imprison his own brother with the betrayer  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath"), who would later drive Renekton into madness. After being freed, Renekton started to hunt down Nasus, believing he was the cause of all his suffering. Nasus hopes he can cure  [Renekton](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renekton "Universe:Renekton") of his madness, so that the united brothers might defeat  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") and restore Shurima to greatness together with their resurrected emperor  [Azir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir").

Nasus first sought  [Sivir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir "Universe:Sivir") for her royal bloodline and finds in her the hope of a reborn Shurima and the key to defeating  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath"). Nasus would later confront Xerath himself to buy time for her and  [Taliyah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taliyah "Universe:Taliyah") to escape alongside other citizens.

Nasus encountered  [Taliyah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taliyah "Universe:Taliyah") when she was protecting an injured Sivir. Nasus would later confront Xerath himself to buy time for her and  [Sivir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir "Universe:Sivir") to escape alongside other citizens.

Myisha, the previous  [Aspect of Twilight](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zoe "Universe:Zoe"), led the [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin") Ta'anari to Nasus who guided them to the Chalicar, the blade that belonged to the Ascended queen Setaka and belongs to  [Sivir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sivir "Universe:Sivir") in the present day, which Ta'anari later used to perform a ritual that reverted the Ascension of the nearby Darkins, vaporing them.

Long before Shurima rose again from the sands,  [Ryze](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ryze "Universe:Ryze") and Nasus delved into a ruined archive beneath the Great Sai and fought its awakened protector.

structure.trivia:
