structure.name: Yuumi
structure.quote: *"Cats are made of twilight and tricks, dogs are made of barks and sticks! Book's just old trees."*
structure.background:
### Early life

She was born in the realm of the [Yordles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yordle "Yordle"), and blessed with magical powers of protection but she spent most of her days pouncing at sunbeams, and napping near mouse trees, but she joined Nora on her adventures in material and spirit realms should it spark her interest.

Norra spent her time collecting strange objects like broken cups, shards of colored glass, and fabric with funny stitching. She examined each artifact with deep reverence, though Yuumi never understood their purpose. Nevertheless, Yuumi would use her magic to protect Norra from harm, and would warm her feet when they returned home.

The doorways between realms are finicky and seldom open, even to creatures as dexterous as cats. Yuumi watched as other yordles waited for days for the eastern star to align with a particular stone archway, or waded impatiently between marsh-lilies, seeking a silver blossom blooming from the mud—only then would a pathway appear. But Yuumi’s yordle, Norra, possessed the powerful Book of Thresholds, which allowed her to instantly travel anywhere depicted in its pages. When Norra opened a portal, she and Yuumi would gleefully dive into its glowing paper and arrive at their destination, joined a moment later by the book.

Yuumi never paid the book much attention until one starless night, when she returned home from luring moon-moths with her shinylight to find Norra missing. She saw the book on her master’s desk and flipped through its pages in a panic, noticing that some were torn out entirely. Unable to read its title, Yuumi cried out to it in distress, calling it, simply, “Book”. In response, the book wiggled, and Yuumi was surprised to learn she could understand thoughts amidst the rustling paper. Despite not having a voice, Book made itself loud and clear. Yuumi learned that Norra had gone somewhere so perilous, she had destroyed the portal as she traveled.

Yuumi knew she had to rescue Norra, and turned to Book for help. Each of its thousand pages led to a different location along the lines of magic that crossed the material and spirit realms. The page Norra had used to travel was lost, but Book might be able to get them close. Yuumi and Book would have to explore every possible threshold. She became Book’s unlikely Keeper, vowing to protect it with the courage of a lion—if it fell into the wrong hands, the doorways to Bandle City could open to all kinds of unsavory and ravenous intruders.

Yuumi and Book began their arduous journey, visiting dangerous and unfamiliar lands.

### Contemporary history

Yuumi sought Norra’s scent on the wind, to little avail. While Yuumi would sometimes break from their search to follow the scent of a mouse or restore her strength with a quick catnap, Book was frustratingly cautious, grumpy over lost time and nervous about threats they might encounter. Nevertheless, Yuumi and Book were both determined to find their master and bring her home.

### Recent events

When Yuumi especially missed Norra, she often sought out other companions. One of her favorites was a door-carrying shepherd with thick whiskers and a deep laugh like a babbling brook. Yuumi rested on his shoulders for a time, protecting him from angry snow-spirits stirring up flurries in a hailstorm, while he brought her wriggling fish.

Eventually, Yuumi uncovered the scent of her master lingering in a vast Shuriman ruin. Digging deep into the sand, she unearthed a broken shard of blue pottery that looked like a piece from one of Norra’s teapots. Before she could burrow further, a ferocious beast surfaced from the sand, and Yuumi and Book barely escaped. She could only imagine the chaos if a creature like that ripped its claws into Book’s pages.
structure.appearance: Yummi is a house cat with a mystical, otherworldly appearance. She has teal eyes and pastel blue fur with a gold pattern on the end of her tail. She is mostly short-furred with the exception of a large tuft of dark blue fur around her neck and chest. Her golden eyebrows and whiskers are unusually pronounced and curled, alluding to her magical nature. She also appears to have three golden leaves sprouting from the top of her head, resembling a golden headdress. Around her neck, she wears a golden metal collar with a teal gem set into the front.
structure.personality: Yummi is a playful, and curious feline with catlike instincts like chasing mice or red dots, and taking cat naps, plus she dislikes dogs like [Warwick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Warwick "Warwick") or [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nasus "Nasus"). While she can be easily distracted, she can be focused on finding her master Norra along with Book. She does miss Norra, but that doesn't mean she can't find new companions like Braum for example.
structure.abilities:
- **Sapience:** Unlike other cats, Yuumi is fully sapient and is capable of human-like speech.
- **Magical Aptitude:** Yuumi is proficient in magic use, specializing in protective shields. She may also be capable of offensive magic, or this may simply be a property of the Book of Thresholds in her possession.

relations.relationship_description: **Yuumi** and  [Book of Thresholds](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Book_of_Thresholds "Universe:Book of Thresholds") have become fast friends, united by their love for  [Norra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Norra "Universe:Norra").

During their travels, Yuumi and Book have encountered  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"). Yuumi rested on his shoulders for a time, protecting him from angry snow-spirits stirring up flurries in a hailstorm, while he brought her wriggling fish.

Yuumi and Book are friends with  [Aphelios'](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aphelios "Aphelios") sister,  [Alune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Alune "Universe:Alune"), periodically visiting her in the [Spirit Realm](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Spirit_Realm "Spirit Realm").

Yuumi and Book were attacked by  [Rek'Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rek%27Sai "Universe:Rek'Sai") while they were investigating ruins in [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima").

structure.trivia:
- Yuumi is a magical cat familiar to a Yordle Enchantress named Norra.
- Yuumi's name came from when she heard Norra say [“you” and “me”](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deixis) and thought that was her name.[[1]](#cite_note-1)
  - In Solomon Islands Pijin, iumi (pronounced Yuumi) means "you and me".
- The  [Book of Thresholds](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Book_of_Thresholds "Universe:Book of Thresholds") was originally written by a Yordle anthropologist in order to study how Yordle magic works and how Yordles traverse the spirit realm. It has been added over the years by generations of Yordle mages who explored the various gateways to and from [Bandle City](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Bandle_City "Bandle City").[[2]](#cite_note-2)
- The Book of Thresholds was given sentience by one of its previous owners in order to protect itself from those who would use its powers for evil.[[3]](#cite_note-3)[[4]](#cite_note-4) The Book of Thresholds essentially works to allow its keeper to traverse the spirit and physical realms using portals, and bypass the normal requirements for these portals. For example, most portals can only be seen and used by yordles, and only open at certain times of the year or in certain whether or when other characteristics are met. The portals contained in the Book of Thresholds can be used anytime by anyone (who is its Keeper). Every page contains a different portal to a different place. Book will always try to retrieve and repair the pages that were lost so that it can be whole again someday! Norra tore out the page that led to the place where she is trapped because she didn't want Book to follow her—she knew it would be too dangerous for Book, that it might fall into the wrong hands.[[5]](#cite_note-5)
- Yuumi and Book have been looking for Norra for around 4 years.[[6]](#cite_note-6)
- Yuumi is a literal cat so she doesn't understand many human concepts, though she may sense certain things better.[[7]](#cite_note-7)
- Book is much more rational and risk-adverse than Yuumi, and prefers to stay on the path so it can keep itself and its keeper safe. Yuumi is much more playful with an element of unpredictable spontaneity. She is highly distractible, especially by worldly comforts such as food or naps. Plus she's a literal cat, so rational thought doesn't come to her easily. She can't even read.[[8]](#cite_note-8)

structure.name: Maddie
structure.background:
### Early Life

Not much is known about Maddie's early life, except that she was a  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") who at some point moved to  [Piltover](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover "Universe:Piltover") and joined the  [Enforcers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Piltover_Enforcers "Universe:Piltover Enforcers") as a junior officer.[[2]](#cite_note-Amanda_Overton_on_Maddie's_Origin-2)[[3]](#cite_note-201heavy-3)

### Attack on the Councilors' Memorial

Shortly after  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx")  [terrorist attack](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Jinx#Super_Mega_Death_Rocket! "Jinx") on the Piltover Council left most of its members dead or injured, the city organized a memorial service for Councilors  [Bolbok](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bolbok "Universe:Bolbok"),  [Hoskel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hoskel "Universe:Hoskel"), and  [Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassandra "Universe:Cassandra"), which was to be heavily guarded with Piltovan security forces as a preventive measure against another attack.

Before the ceremony, Maddie received word that  [Caitlyn Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") wanted a former Stillwater inmate named  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") to join them, and had threatened to withdraw her family's funding from the police department just to get her a badge. After this Maddie and her on-call partner  [Steb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Steb "Universe:Steb") found Vi drunk on the street with a man named  [Loris](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Loris "Universe:Loris"). Maddie introduced herself as a junior officer and greeted Vi warmly, having heard tales of her crusade against  [Silco](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") and contrasting her heroism with the betrayal of the late Sheriff,  [Marcus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Marcus "Universe:Marcus"). After this, Maddie welcomed Vi into the Enforcers, seemingly unaware that she hadn't accepted the badge yet from Caitlyn.

At the ceremony, Maddie and Steb stood guard and later helped to evacuate Councilors  [Salo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Salo "Universe:Salo"),  [Shoola](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shoola "Universe:Shoola"), and  [Medarda](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel"), which was complicated when their carriage was attacked by an enormous  [chemtank berserker](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Turbo_Chemtank "Turbo Chemtank") working for the  [Chembaroness](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons")  [Renni](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni"). Maddie and Steb fought alongside Caitlyn and Loris as Vi and  [Jayce](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jayce "Universe:Jayce") fought Renni, and the entire attack was eventually put down by  [Ambessa Medarda's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") warband of Noxians.[[3]](#cite_note-201heavy-3)

### Strike Team into Zaun

After the attack on the memorial, Maddie, Loris, and Steb were handpicked by Caitlyn, alongside Vi, to join her in a mission to  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun"), bringing with them new [hextech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hextech "Universe:Hextech") weapons built by Jayce. Their objectives were to locate Jinx, dismantle the production of [shimmer](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shimmer "Universe:Shimmer"), and neutralize the remaining agents of Silco's criminal empire.[[3]](#cite_note-201heavy-3) Maddie proved herself to be a competent officer as they employed brutal tactics against the undercity, including the utilization of a toxic industrial smog called the Gray (which was contained in the  [Kiramman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Clan_Kiramman "Universe:Clan Kiramman") vents) as they hunted down Jinx and the remaining chembarons. At some point, the strike team made a deal with the chembaron  [Smeech](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Smeech "Universe:Smeech") so that he would hand Jinx over to them alive in exchange for her bounty, after which they completely dismantled the operations of  [Margot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Margot "Universe:Margot") and  [Chross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross"), burning all of their shimmer.[[4]](#cite_note-202watch-4)[[5]](#cite_note-203finally-5)

Although they accomplished two out of three of the mission's objectives, Maddie, along with  [Steb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Steb "Universe:Steb") and  [Loris](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Loris "Universe:Loris"), were sent back to Piltover after they recovered  [Heenot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Heenot "Universe:Heenot"), the only survivor among Smeech and his henchmen after they were all killed by Jinx. Once Maddie and the others got back to Piltover, the Gray, mixed with Jinx's paint, was suddenly released from the Piltover ventilation system.

In the wake of this attack, Councilor Salo called an emergency meeting of all the Piltovan mercantile clans, a number of enforcers, and the Noxians, where Ambessa gave a speech urging Piltover to declare martial law. To everyone's surprise, Ambessa nominated Caitlyn to be the city's military commander, and though the rest of her comrades hesitated, Maddie was the first among them to join the Noxians in beating their chests in support for their new leader.[[5]](#cite_note-203finally-5)

### Martial Law Period

Months after Caitlyn was declared commander, Maddie had become Caitlyn's closest confidante among the Enforcers' ranks and had also begun a romantic relationship with her. Ambessa, who had become Caitlyn's military advisor after the declaration of martial law, had continued to expand her influence over the city, including the Masons' Guild, who were irritated by the Noxians' constant requests for new fortifications. When Caitlyn confided in Maddie about this, Maddie reasoned that the Noxians were only trying to keep them safe, and said that if she still had doubts, Caitlyn could easily withdraw from the undercity and reinstate the Council at any time. Maddie claimed that she, the Enforcers, and all of Piltover were loyal to Caitlyn, not Ambessa. However, Caitlyn was apprehensive about turning away Ambessa's support, especially since they hadn't yet captured Jinx.[[6]](#cite_note-204paint-6)

Later that day, an attack at one of the Enforcers' checkpoints in Zaun sparked rumors of Jinx's return, as the colorful paint bombs matched hers almost exactly. However, when Caitlyn and Maddie investigated the details, they quickly realized that the culprit was not Jinx and instead a [copycat](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isha "Universe:Isha"), as the attack had noticeably left zero casualties. Maddie then tried to pick up on their conversation earlier regarding ending the occupation, only to be interrupted by Ambessa. Caitlyn and Ambessa sent Maddie out so they could speak in private, after which Ambessa warned Caitlyn on the "hazards of professional entanglements." That night, Maddie accompanied Caitlyn to her mother's memorial.[[6]](#cite_note-204paint-6) Caitlyn soon embarked on a mission with Ambessa to locate a  [bloodthirsty murderous beast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Warwick "Universe:Warwick") in the lower fissures of Zaun, and when Caitlyn returned home, she and Ambessa had become enemies.[[7]](#cite_note-206message-7)

Caitlyn informed Maddie that she had turned on Ambessa, and that her warships were on the way to burn Piltover to the ground for her betrayal. Maddie suggested negotiation and tried to console Caitlyn, but she pulled away from her, stating that she needed to come up with a plan. They were suddenly interrupted by Vi, who stormed into the room asking why Caitlyn had Jinx arrested after she had saved her life. Maddie attempted to escort Vi out of the room, but Caitlyn sent Maddie out instead to check on her  [father](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tobias "Universe:Tobias"). After she left the room, Maddie pretended to close the door, leaving it open slightly to listen in on Caitlyn and Vi's conversation. Former Councilor Jayce Talis later called an assembly of all of Piltover and Zaun's leaders for a call to arms, and Maddie accompanied Caitlyn to the meeting.[[8]](#cite_note-208killing-8)

### Battle at the Hexgate

At the defense of the Hexgate, Maddie and Steb followed Caitlyn with the mission of destroying  [Viktor's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") cocoon. They launched canisters of the Gray at the advancing Noxians, and Steb retrieved the explosive device from Maddie's bag, running to plant it on the chrysalis. However, the explosive failed to detonate due to a nail jamming the gears of the timer, implied to have been sabotaged by Maddie. Consequently thereafter, Maddie unexpectedly knocked Caitlyn unconscious by striking her in the back of the head, and the entire Enforcers strike force was captured by Ambessa's soldiers. When Caitlyn came to, Maddie revealed herself as her ambusher and presented Caitlyn's hextech rifle as a trophy to Ambessa, who then dismantled it before mocking her for not heeding her advice about "professional entanglement." On Ambessa's orders, Maddie poised to execute Caitlyn with a rifle and fired, with a brief frame revealing her smiling.[[9]](#cite_note-9) However,  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel") intervened by conjuring a spherical barrier around Maddie, which caused the bullet to ricochet back into Maddie's head, killing her instantly. Her lifeless body slumped onto Caitlyn's shoulder for a moment before collapsing onto the ground.[[10]](#cite_note-209dirt-10)
structure.appearance: Maddie Nolen was a young woman with a shorter height and average build. She had short ginger hair, cut into a bob, a tail that was cut at the nape of the neck, and blue-grey eyes. She was usually shown to be wearing the enforcer's uniform: navy blue trimmed with gold. She wore a stylized enforcer hat along with her uniform, and later a blue beret with gold trim during, and after her role as a special operative for the Zaun infiltration team.
structure.personality:
Maddie Nolen was initially presented as a soft-spoken, optimistic, naive, yet loyal individual in the face of mounting challenges. Her warm and optimistic demeanor often acted as a morale booster for those around her, even amidst the chaos of  [Zaun's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun") darkest times. Her courage and competence made her a key asset to her allies, and her general cheerfulness and firm sense of justice let her play a supportive, yet critical, role as a confidante for her allies. Despite being a relatively new officer among the enforcers, Maddie was shown to be quite competent as both a soldier and a fast thinker, making her an asset to Caitlyn's strike team.

Despite her sunny disposition, Maddie was revealed later in the series to either possess a hidden duplicitous nature, or personal feelings of jealousy or envy; either of which led her to commit an ultimate betrayal upon  [Caitlyn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn"), her former partner  [Steb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Steb "Universe:Steb"), and the rest of her strike team comrades, almost directly leading to their deaths.
structure.abilities:
- **Expert Pistol Handling:** Maddie displayed exceptional skill with a standard-issue Enforcer pistol. Her accuracy and composure during chaotic events, such as the  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons")' attack on the Councilors Memorial, highlighted her ability to remain effective under stressful situations.
- **Tactical Thinking:** Maddie had a knack for strategic decision-making in the heat of battle. She was able to coordinate with her partner  [Steb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Steb "Universe:Steb") to protect the councilors during the  [chemtank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Turbo_Chemtank "Turbo Chemtank") assault, using her environment effectively and minimizing casualties.
- **Situational Awareness:** Demonstrating keen observational skills, Maddie was quick to identify threats and react accordingly. This was evident during her participation in  [Caitlyn's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") strike team, where she consistently spotted traps and ensured the team's safety during their operations in  [Zaun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Zaun "Universe:Zaun").
- **Support:** Maddie acted as both a strategic advisor and emotional confidante for Caitlyn during the martial law period, becoming close to her during this time.

relations.relationship_description:
Before they had met, Maddie had heard stories of Caitlyn's adventures with  [Vi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vi "Universe:Vi") in the undercity and claimed to be a big fan of theirs. Along with the drunken  [Loris](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Loris "Universe:Loris") and her on-call companion  [Steb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Steb "Universe:Steb"), she was later part of the group that helped Caitlyn defend the surviving Councilors during  [Renni's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni") attack at the memorial, and having proven herself capable, she would be chosen by Caitlyn to serve on her strike team.[[3]](#cite_note-201heavy-3) Here, Maddie worked closely with the others on her squad and helped to deduce  [Jinx's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") tactics after defeating the  [Chem-Barons](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chem-Barons "Universe:Chem-Barons")  [Chross](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Chross "Universe:Chross") and  [Margot](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Margot "Universe:Margot"). As they closed in on Jinx, Caitlyn and Vi sent Maddie and the others home to keep them safe. When Caitlyn returned, Maddie was an enthusiastic supporter  [Ambessa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ambessa "Universe:Ambessa") decision to appoint Caitlyn as commander, despite the reluctance of others on their squad to support martial law.[[5]](#cite_note-203finally-5)

Months passed, and Maddie became one of Caitlyn's most frequent advisors and confidantes after she had broken up with Vi, where she would be emotionally supportive and would sometimes be wearing Caitlyn's clothes after they slept together in her mansion.[[11]](#cite_note-Caitlyn_shirt-11) Maddie assisted Caitlyn in her pursuit of Jinx, during which time she sometimes floated the idea of ending martial law and restoring the Council at Ambessa's expense. In turn, Ambessa would warn Caitlyn about the dangers of "professional entanglement," referring to Maddie's increasingly frequent visits to the Kiramman mansion.[[6]](#cite_note-204paint-6)

Even so, Caitlyn had never truly moved on from Vi and later got back together with her after the battle at  [Viktor's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viktor "Universe:Viktor") commune. As Ambessa's ships closed in for an invasion, Maddie suggested negotiating with the Noxians, but Caitlyn dismissed her idea and sent her from the room to speak with Vi instead, and Maddie discreetly left the door open to listen in on their conversation.[[8]](#cite_note-208killing-8) Maddie later showed little regret over sabotaging the Piltovan war effort at a critical moment, turning the tide in Ambessa's favor when she attacked Caitlyn from behind and saluted Ambessa as her army approached, then obeyed her order to execute Caitlyn in the middle of the square. As Caitlyn believed she was about to die, Maddie said she "appreciated her warmth," only for the bullet to be ricocheted back into her head by  [Mel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mel "Universe:Mel").[[10]](#cite_note-209dirt-10)

Maddie and Steb first met Vi before the memorial service for the deceased Council members, where Maddie claimed to be a big fan of Vi's. During  [Renni's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Renni "Universe:Renni") attack, Vi helped the Enforcers fight them off, and she would later join them on  [Caitlyn's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Caitlyn "Universe:Caitlyn") strike team to eliminate the remnants of  [Silco's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Silco "Universe:Silco") criminal empire. As squadmates, they worked closely together, but Vi became concerned for their safety as they closed in on  [Jinx](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Jinx "Universe:Jinx") and convinced Caitlyn to send them home. When Caitlyn returned later on, Vi stayed in the undercity, so Maddie did not see her again for several months. When they did reunite, their interaction was not friendly, with Maddie attempting to escort Vi from the room when she stormed in asking why Jinx had been arrested. After this interaction, Maddie left the door open to eavesdrop on Caitlyn and Vi's private conversation.

As a vital part of Caitlyn’s strike team, Maddie collaborated closely with:

- [Steb](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Steb "Universe:Steb"): Maddie’s reliable partner in tactical execution and field operations.
- [Loris](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Loris "Universe:Loris"): A resourceful yet unconventional ally with a strong moral compass.

Together, the team worked to dismantle Zaun's criminal network, with Maddie serving as the tactical linchpin of the group.[[3]](#cite_note-201heavy-3)[[5]](#cite_note-203finally-5) At a critical moment later on, however, Maddie would betray all of them, which would lead directly to her own death.

Maddie was a Noxian[[2]](#cite_note-Amanda_Overton_on_Maddie's_Origin-2) and an early supporter of Ambessa's decision to appoint Caitlyn as commander under martial law, and even starting a romantic relationship with Caitlyn during this time.[[5]](#cite_note-203finally-5)[[7]](#cite_note-206message-7) In her private conversations with Caitlyn, Maddie would express concern with Ambessa's growing influence, and in turn Ambessa warned Caitlyn about the dangers of "professional entanglements," referring specifically to Maddie.[[6]](#cite_note-204paint-6) Once Ambessa and Caitlyn met on the battlefield, Maddie betrayed Caitlyn and the other Enforcers, sabotaging their attack and saluting Ambessa as she approached the area. Ambessa mocked Caitlyn for not heeding her warnings about Maddie and swiftly ordered Caitlyn's execution. Maddie followed Ambessa's order without hesitation, which led to her own death.[[10]](#cite_note-209dirt-10)

structure.name: Ryze
structure.quote: *"Take care with this world. What is made can be unmade."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Born in Noxii territories which would later become  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), in the village of [Khom](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Khom "Khom"), Ryze was a young mage apprentice to  [Tyrus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Tyrus "Universe:Tyrus") of [Helia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Helia "Helia"), a member of a order tasked with gathering and protecting the most dangerous artifacts of  [Runeterra](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra "Universe:Runeterra").

As time passed, Ryze would sometimes overhear Tyrus discussing something known as a [World Rune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rune "Universe:Rune"), a collection of shards that held unbelievable power, but would hush himself if Tyrus ever spotted Ryze listening in. Though Tyrus tried his best to keep it hidden, word eventually got out about the World Runes and paranoia started to spread throughout Runeterra over how these World Runes could be used as weapons. Tyrus and Ryze traveled around  [Valoran](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Valoran "Universe:Valoran") trying to calm people down but the situation only grew more dire. Eventually though, the first shot was fired in what would later be known as the [Rune Wars](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rune_Wars "Rune Wars"), in Noxii, Ryze's old home. Tyrus and Ryze tried and failed to hold a parley in Khom, but had no choice but to flee to the hills and when they looked back to Khom, nothing remained of Ryze's birthplace but a giant hole.

War raged across Runeterra, Ryze wanted to pick a side and help but Tyrus stopped him, Tyrus wanted to guide the world back towards peace, not bring it further into ruin. But the Rune Wars kept going, and Tyrus grew more and more distant. Eventually it got to a point where Ryze had to confront Tyrus, where he noticed Tyrus had come into possession of two World Runes. A big argument ensued, Tyrus argued that he needed the World Runes to stop the people, that there was no other way to stop the war. Ryze no longer saw Tyrus as his mentor, he was now just another man fallen to the temptation of the World Runes, and so Ryze mustered all the magic he was able to and 2 [killed him](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Shard_of_Betrayal "LoR:Shard of Betrayal").

Soon after, the Rune Wars ended, with the greatest civilizations all but having destroyed each other. Ryze realized that as long as any World Runes were unsecured, this could happen again. He decided then that he alone would take on the burden of gathering all the World Runes and storing them away for good, vowing never to fall into temptation like his old master Tyrus.

### Recent events

A battle raged in  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), between the [darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin")  [Aatrox](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Aatrox "Universe:Aatrox") and  [Xolaani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xolaani "Universe:Xolaani"), one which threatened to end all of Runeterra. As Ryze traveled, a 3 [winged being](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Winged_Messenger "LoR:Winged Messenger") appeared from the skies with a plea for help, Ryze recognized the messenger and realised it could only have come from  [Kayle](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kayle "Universe:Kayle") herself. Kayle's mother and the Aspect of Justice,  [Mihira](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Mihira "Universe:Mihira"), had descended from the heavens to join the fight, but had fallen to Xolaani and been 7 [absorbed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Xolaani,_Aspect%27s_Bane "LoR:Xolaani, Aspect's Bane"). As Ryze arrived at the battle, Kayle explained that Ryze alone had the power to stop the battle, by using the World Runes. Ryze hesitated, unsure whether it was right for him to act; and with the World Runes no less. Ryze meditated on the history of Runeterra and ultimately came to the conclusion that Runeterra was worthy to be saved, and activated the World Runes, defeating Aatrox and Xolaani.
structure.appearance: Ryze is a old man with violet skin due to prolonged contact with the World Runes. His body is full of tattoos in runic styles. He is bald but has a scrappy black beard, tied together at the end with a hair ring. Ryze is shirtless except for a a leather shoulder guard with a sash holding it together. A giant scroll is attached to his back, held there by the leather sash. He wears fairly simple, loose, dark blue pants with high leather boots. Around his waist he wears a leather belt with a book tied to it.
structure.personality: Ryze has become tired, longing for the day when all of this is over. Always in a hurry to get anything done as fast as possible. He tends to come across as quite rude, though argues its because he has better things to be doing. Though he is tired, he is steadfast in his goal and will get it done no matter what cost, even if that cost is the life of his friend or the death of a village. Their deaths are nothing compared to what the World Runes could bring. Ryze has a strong control over his emotions, though he often gets mad, he never loses himself in an emotion. The only emotion he cannot control is hope, an emotion he tries desperately to get rid off, but always manages to influence him.
structure.abilities:
- **[Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Magic "Magic"):** Ryze was born with natural magical abilities, he can harness powerful magic capable of creating blasts of energy, energy constructs such as a cage, and is capable of teleportation from one place to another.
  - **Master Sorcerer:** He also has an extensive knowledge of the arcane and the nature of magic itself. He's noted as having an immensely high amount of magical power, to the point of being called a magical being rather than a mage.
  - **[Rune Magic](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ryze#Overload "Ryze"):** Runes are Ryze's signature magic.
- **Biological Immortality:** Before the Ruination of Helia, Ryze drank from the Waters of Life, the sacred pool that created the then blessed, now black mist. This granted him biological immortality, however he can still die by other means.

relations.relationship_description:
Kegan Rodhe, as he was known before he became Brand, was previously Ryze's apprentice, saved by Ryze from freezing to death in the harsh  [Freljordian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord") cold. Ryze saw potential in Kegan and attempted to teach him to control his latent magical abilities. Kegan and Ryze both often became frustrated with eachother, but still held compassion for each other.

Though as Ryze neared the true goal of his journey, to one of the World Runes, Kegan fell to the temptation of the World Rune and Ryze was too late to stop him. Kegan's body and soul was burned away by the World Rune's power and what was left was the entity known as Brand. Brand now hunts down further World Runes and is constantly at odds with Ryze on his mission. Eventually, Ryze and Brand would meet in Shurima in the [City of Gardens](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Burning_Lands "The Burning Lands"), in search of another World Rune, where Ryze would trap Brand beneath the sands, where he remains for now.

Tyrus was Ryze's old master, member of a secret order tasked with storing and protecting the most dangerous of artifacts across Runeterra. Tyrus would later fall into the temptation of the World Runes, and Ryze was forced to kill him.

Long before Shurima rose again from the sands, Ryze and the Ascended scholar Nasus delved into the ruined [World Rune Archives](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/World_Rune_Archives "World Rune Archives") beneath the [Great Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Great_Sai "The Great Sai") in search of a World Rune.
During a shootout between Miss Fortune and a rival captain’s crew, Ryze got caught in their conflict and helped her out.

Sona traveled with Ryze to the [Hirana Monastery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hirana_Monastery "Hirana Monastery") in  [Ionia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ionia "Universe:Ionia") after the Noxian invasion and together fought the [Navori Brotherhood](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Navori_Brotherhood "Navori Brotherhood") who ambushed them.
Ryze once came face to face with Trundle and his [Trolls](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Troll "Troll") while traveling through the Freljord.

In her journey to the Blessed Isles,  [Kalista](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalista "Universe:Kalista") crossed paths with Ryze during his formative years. Initially, she found the young apprentice brimming with arrogance and entitlement, reminiscent of her uncle,  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego"). Their first encounter ended with Ryze's arm twisted, after which Ryze started to be far more respectful towards the Camavoran princess.

When hearing had Kalista sacrificed herself in order to give the people of Helia a chance to escape from the invading Camavorans, Ryze regretted not having had the opportunity to apologize for their initial meeting.

structure.trivia:
- Ryze is between 1025 and 1080 years old, born at some point before the [Ruination of Helia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruination_of_Helia "Ruination of Helia").
- Ryze's official height is 178 cm (5'10).[[1]](#cite_note-1)
- His master, Tyrus of Helia, was from the [Blessed Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blessed_Isles "Blessed Isles")' capital of [Helia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Helia "Helia")
- In the [old lore](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Runeterra_Legacy "Universe:Runeterra Legacy"), Ryze sealed powerful magic and spells into his scroll.

structure.name: Viego
structure.quote: *"No price is too great. No atrocity beyond my reach. For her… I will do anything."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Viego was born centuries ago to the royal family of Camavor, significantly later than his brother. Due to being the fourth born child of the king, he was largely neglected in favor of his brother and spent his childhood in his shadow. Viego was tutored by the greatest minds in the land and learned swordsmanship from his father's generals. Viego's best friend was his own niece,  [Kalista](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kalista "Universe:Kalista"), and she would end up becoming his most trusted general.

When his father had passed, Viego was to be crowned the king, despite being unprepared. Kalista was tasked by Viego's father to monitor his rule and steer him in the right direction. Shortly into his reign, Viego had fallen in love with a peasant seamstress named Isolde. The two had a whirlwind romance and were quickly married. Viego had begun to neglect his kingdom in favor of his queen and his enemies began to conspire against him. They had sent an assassin to kill the wayward king, but they were intercepted by general Kalista. However, Isolde was poisoned in his place. The king ordered the nation's greatest healers and scholars to find a cure for the queen, but when they failed, he sent Kalista to search for one instead. While the king was preoccupied with keeping the queen alive, the kingdom continued to be neglected and uprisings plagued the country. He ordered commander  [Hecarim](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hecarim "Universe:Hecarim") and his knights to quash these insurrections and hundreds were put to death. Eventually, the queen would pass and the king sank into a deep depression. Hecarim proposed invading foreign lands as retribution for the queen and Viego approved. As the armies of Camavor prepared to set sail, Kalista had returned with word of a cure.

Kalista had sailed to the Blessed Isles and learned of the Waters of Life, which could cure any disease. But by the time she had returned, the queen was dead. Kalista did not believe the cure was of any use after the queen had passed, but Viego refused to believe her and had her imprisoned for treason. Kalista was eventually convinced to show the king the location of the cure and he and his armies would sail to the Blessed Isles. The residents of the island refused to grant him access to the waters, so Viego ordered Kalista to slay them, but she refused. Hecarim and his knights would be more then happy to follow the king's orders and clashed with Kalista's forces, while Viego searched for the waters himself. The king fought his way to the waters, guided by the conniving warden who would become  [Thresh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh"). When he made it to the vault, Viego lowered Isolde into the waters' healing properties and watched with hope. The queen revived as a former shadow of herself and attacked the king with his own sword. The magic of Viego's blade and the blessed waters mixed, transforming it into the Black Mist and unleashing ruination. The Blessed Isles would transform into the Shadow Isles and Viego slumbered within his blade for centuries.

### Resurrection

:   *Main article: [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruined_King "Ruined King")*

Viego would eventually be awakened by  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") and  [Thresh](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh"), who planned on using him to conquer Bilgewater. Still weak from his slumber, Viego gathered his strength, fueled by his desire to be reunited with his queen. Eventually Gangplank would try to subjugate Viego with a powerful amulet, but would fall to the king's power. He would possess the pirate and used him to hold off  [Ahri](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ahri "Universe:Ahri"),  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"),  [Illaoi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illaoi "Universe:Illaoi"),  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune"),  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pyke "Universe:Pyke"), and  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo"), while he flew to Bilgewater to search for his queen. The champions of Bilgewater would eventually defeat Viego, weakening him with his own memories and imprisoning him within the amulet. The amulet would be guarded by Illaoi.

Illaoi departs for the Shadow Isles in search of the Brethren of the Dusk, the original creators of the amulet, to find out if she can destroy it, with Viego trapped inside. She is escorted there by Ruven, a captain indebted to Miss Fortune. On Isles, Illaoi meets Yorick, the last member of the brotherhood, who reveals they can destroy the amulet, but requires a heat source hot enough. They decide on a nearby volcano, but as they set sail, Ruven betrays revealing he is the puppet of Bartek, an agent of Thresh. Bartek manages to wrest the amulet from them and returns it to Thresh.

### Ruination

:   *Main article: [Rise of the Sentinels](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rise_of_the_Sentinels "Rise of the Sentinels")*

At some point Viego would escape the amulet and resume his search for Isolde. He would be made aware of a fragment of her soul within  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna") and intercepted her and her husband  [Lucian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lucian "Universe:Lucian"). Viego would unleash Harrowings in Demacia, Ionia, and Noxus while he tried to separate the fragment from Senna. He would manage to pry a portion of the fragment within her before they escaped. Viego soon encountered a gloomy Yordle on the Shadow Isles named  [Vex](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vex "Universe:Vex"). Vex was enamored by Viego's darkness and agreed to help spread the Black Mist across the world. With the help of his new companion, Viego would unleash a global Harrowing to scour the world for the soul fragments.

He would obtain the fragments and bend several champions to his will including  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Draven/Cosmetics "Draven/Cosmetics"),  [Karma](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Karma/Cosmetics "Karma/Cosmetics"),  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Miss_Fortune/Cosmetics "Miss Fortune/Cosmetics"),  [Pantheon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Pantheon/Cosmetics "Pantheon/Cosmetics"), and  [Shyvana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shyvana/Cosmetics "Shyvana/Cosmetics"). Along the way he and his forces would be confronted by the Sentinels of Light. After obtaining most of the fragments, the Sentinels launched a final assault on Viego on the Shadow Isles. There he would obtain the last three fragments within Senna,  [Gwen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gwen "Universe:Gwen") and the Maiden of the Mist. His forces held off the Sentinels while he took the fragments to Camavor to revive his queen. Viego resurrected Isolde, but she was horrified at what he had become. Isolde prompted  [Akshan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akshan "Universe:Akshan") to kill her, reviving Senna, Gwen and the Maiden, and the Sentinels would defeat the king, leaving him imprisoned in Hallowed Mist forever.
structure.appearance:
As a wraith, Viego has a pale complexion, spectral green eyes and white hair. He is adorned by a green, spectral crown and a triangle shaped wound in his chest, where Black Mist pours out. Viego wears a black leather jacket and pants with light armorments and no shirt showing off his bare, sculpted chest. He wields *Sanctity*, the Blade of the King, a spectral two-handed sword that bears the crest of Camavor on its hilt. Viego can also manifest armor made from Black Mist, including a helmet and a chest plate.

In life, Viego's complexion was close to fair, and his skin was slightly tanned. His hair has a brown color. He wore a blue leather jacket and undershirt with black pauldrons and gauntlets with gold accents. He also wore brown pants with black boots. He wielded an uncorrupted version of Sanctity, adorned by gold and jewels.
structure.personality: Viego was an incredibly passionate, yet arrogant man. Due to being raised in nobility, Viego was given everything in life and believed all was his. He was deeply enamored with his wife Isolde, and would dote on her. His devotion to his wife lead him to be highly disinterested in ruling their kingdom and neglect his responsibilities. He has shown himself to be a perfectionist, having high expectations of his queen and would berate her when she couldn't live up to them. When Isolde was poisoned, Viego became obsessed with saving her, using all of the kingdom's resources to try and keep her alive. When the queen had passed, he was willing to slaughter thousands and defy death itself in order to bring her back. Centuries later, his obsession remains, willing to plunge the world into darkness in order to revive his queen.
structure.abilities:
- **[Expert Swordsman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viego#Blade_of_the_Ruined_King "Viego")**: Viego is an adept swordsman, having received instruction from the best fighters of Camavor.
- **[Black Mist Mastery](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viego#Heartbreaker "Viego")**: Having been the source of the Ruination, Viego has control of the Black Mist, which he endlessly generates from a triangle-shaped wound in his chest.
  - **[Possession](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viego#Sovereign's_Domination "Viego")**: Even before he was released from the prison of his  [sword](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blade_of_the_Ruined_King "Blade of the Ruined King"), Viego could use the [Black Mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Black_Mist "Black Mist") to possess and control living beings. This power can be used on any living creature (including flora) and is most effective on those who have been mentally and physically weakened, which can occur at close-proximity to an object connected to Viego's power. Notable victims of Viego's possession include:  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gangplank/Cosmetics "Gangplank/Cosmetics"),  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Miss_Fortune/Cosmetics "Miss Fortune/Cosmetics"),  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Draven/Cosmetics "Draven/Cosmetics"),  [Karma](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Karma/Cosmetics "Karma/Cosmetics"), and  [Shyvana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shyvana/Cosmetics "Shyvana/Cosmetics").
  - **[Shadow Travel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viego#Harrowed_Path "Viego")**: Viego can travel through the Black Mist at incredible speed. A limitation of this ability is that he cannot travel if the Black Mist is interrupted.
  - **Healing**: Viego can restore himself and others with the Black Mist, and can even bring people back from the dead. Notable examples include:  [Pantheon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Pantheon/Cosmetics "Pantheon/Cosmetics") and  [Isolde](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Isolde "Universe:Isolde").
  - **Necromancy:** Viego can summon wraiths from the Black Mist to do his bidding.
  - **Flight**: Viego is able to fly with the aid of the Black Mist.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
- **[Mage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Magic "Universe:Magic")**: Viego was the first member of the royal family to display magical abilities, likely inherited from his mother.
- **Enhanced Strength**: Viego was shown to have strength to rival someone as powerful as  [Pantheon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pantheon "Universe:Pantheon") and could collapse buildings with a single strike.
- **Undead Body**: Viego does not appear to have the same physical limitations as someone who is alive, like the need for rest or nourishment. His body has been preserved to look as it did centuries ago.

relations.relationship_description:
Kalista is Viego's niece and was his most trusted general in life. Despite being her uncle, Kalista was like an older sister to Viego, the two were friends for a long time since he was largely ignored in favor of Kalista's father. When her grandfather died and Viego became king, his negative traits were worsened and they began to drift apart, however she was still loyal to him.

Kalista managed to protect Viego from an assassin, but resulted in Isolde getting poisoned instead. She would set sail in order to find a cure, but found it too late and was imprisoned as a traitor for her failure. She was eventually convinced by  [Hecarim](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Hecarim "Universe:Hecarim") to lead Viego and their army to the Blessed Isles for the Waters of Life. When the masters of the island refused to let them use the water, Viego ordered her to kill anyone who opposed them. Kalista refused and was stabbed by Hecarim before her forces clashed with the Iron Order.

Hecarim was the leader of the Iron Order, a brotherhood of knights which vowed to protect the king's lands. Under Viego, Hecarim and the Iron Order acted as the king's enforcers and quelled growing dissent after Viego began neglecting his duties. Hecarim and his knights accompanied Viego to the Blessed Isles. They held off Kalista's forces and pillaged the city while Viego attempted to heal Isolde.

In [The Despoiler of Havenfall](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Despoiler_of_Havenfall "The Despoiler of Havenfall"), it is revealed that Hecarim does not think highly of Viego and only continues to follow him because he can spread the Black Mist across Runeterra and allows him to pillage the land.

Although Viego calls Vladimir his uncle in game, they are only distantly related due to both descending from the royalty of Camavor.[[3]](#cite_note-3) At some point after being taken by his [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin") master, Vladimir started sending customary, yearly letters to his original kingdom. After Isolde was poisoned, a grief stricken Viego refused to respond, not knowing Vladimir had the power that could have saved her.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

Viego's wife is a seamstress named Isolde. Viego was selfish, self-centered, young, immature, and had a lot of power. So when he saw someone as beautiful as Isolde, he had to have her. She accepted because she was a commoner from a conquered country.[[5]](#cite_note-5) Viego was a perfectionist in his relationship with Isolde, so when she couldn't live up to his expectations, he would berate her. However, the thought of not being the perfect husband for her disturbed him and he would abandon the memories of the times they fought.[[6]](#cite_note-6) It is uncertain if Viego truly loved Isolde or loved that she was his because he was raised to take anything he desired. Regardless, he doted and focused on her and ignored his duties as king. Viego’s love for Isolde is characterized by utter obsession to the exclusion of everything else, and driven by a lack of understanding of any motivations other than his own.[[7]](#cite_note-7)

Isolde stabbed Viego with his own  [blade](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Viego#Blade_of_the_Ruined_King "Viego") after he resurrected her. The magic of the waters and the ancient sword caused Ruination which turned the Blessed Isles into the  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles"). When Viego resurrected Isolde a second time, she was disgusted at what he had become and the atrocities he had committed to bring her back. She would allow  [Akshan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akshan "Universe:Akshan") to kill her again with his Absolver to revive  [Gwen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gwen "Universe:Gwen") and  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna") and weaken Viego.

Gwen was created by Isolde and she associates him with the pain of Isolde being taken away from her. She opposes Viego and sided with the Sentinels of Light to stop the pain he has caused in his search for Isolde's soul fragments. Gwen contained a fragment of Isolde's soul.

Thresh led Viego to the Waters of Life where he resurrected Isolde. Thresh and  [Gangplank](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gangplank "Universe:Gangplank") woke Viego up from his slumber in order to use him to conquer Bilgewater. Thresh plotted against Viego during [Rise of the Sentinels](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rise_of_the_Sentinels "Rise of the Sentinels") and secretly siphoned the excess Black Mist he was producing in order the unbind himself from the Shadow Isles.

Senna was cursed to have a fragment of Isolde's soul within her, leading to her being relentlessly hunted by the mist. Later, she learned the truth about the mist during her time inside  [Thresh's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Thresh "Universe:Thresh") latern. After being freed from it, Senna and her husband  [Lucian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Lucian "Universe:Lucian") were determined to defeat Viego. Upon finding out about  [Senna's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna") relation to Isolde, Viego confronted her and Lucian and partially separated Isolde from her body. She,  [Akshan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Akshan "Universe:Akshan"),  [Gwen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gwen "Universe:Gwen") and a Sentinel Rookie would eventually defeat him in Camavor and leave him restrained in Hallowed Mist.

Viego unleashed a global ruination with the aid of Vex during [Rise of the Sentinels](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rise_of_the_Sentinels "Rise of the Sentinels"). Vex was enamored by Viego's desire to plunge the world into darkness and aided him in causing a global ruination, but would later abandon him when she discovered that he was doing it for love

[Maokai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Maokai "Universe:Maokai") and  [Yorick](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yorick "Universe:Yorick") were hunting for Viego in hope of restoring the Blessed Isles.  [The Maiden of the Mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yorick#Eulogy_of_the_Isles "Yorick") was one of the fetters of Isolde's soul.

During the events of [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruined_King "Ruined King"),  [Ahri](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ahri "Universe:Ahri"),  [Braum](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Braum "Universe:Braum"),  [Illaoi](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Illaoi "Universe:Illaoi"),  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Miss_Fortune "Universe:Miss Fortune"),  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Pyke "Universe:Pyke") and  [Yasuo](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Yasuo "Universe:Yasuo") set sail to the Shadow Isles to confront Viego in order to protect  [Bilgewater](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bilgewater "Universe:Bilgewater"). Viego tried to tempt Miss Fortune into joining with him, promising her the power to rule Bilgewater and even bring back her mother, but her will proved stronger and she would imprison him in a Buhru artifact. Miss Fortune would eventually join Viego during Rise of the Sentinels, after months of fighting over Bilgewater with Gangplank.

Viego would eventually escape the Buhru artifact and unleash harrowings across multiple regions to begin his search for the fragments of Isolde's soul. These harrowings were repelled by multiple champions including:  [Darius](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Darius "Universe:Darius"),  [Karma](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Karma "Universe:Karma"),  [Poppy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Poppy "Universe:Poppy"),  [Samira](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Samira "Universe:Samira"), and  [Vayne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Vayne "Universe:Vayne").

He corrupted multiple champions, such as  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Draven/Cosmetics "Draven/Cosmetics"),  [Karma](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Karma/Cosmetics "Karma/Cosmetics"),  [Pantheon](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Pantheon/Cosmetics "Pantheon/Cosmetics"),  [Miss Fortune](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Miss_Fortune/Cosmetics "Miss Fortune/Cosmetics") and  [Shyvana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shyvana/Cosmetics "Shyvana/Cosmetics"), to aid in his search.[[8]](#cite_note-8) Multiple champions were recruited by the  [Sentinels of Light](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sentinels_of_Light "Universe:Sentinels of Light") to stop him such as  [Diana](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Diana/Cosmetics "Diana/Cosmetics"),  [Graves](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Graves/Cosmetics "Graves/Cosmetics"),  [Irelia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Irelia/Cosmetics "Irelia/Cosmetics"),  [Olaf](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Olaf/Cosmetics "Olaf/Cosmetics"),  [Pyke](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Pyke/Cosmetics "Pyke/Cosmetics"),  [Rengar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rengar/Cosmetics "Rengar/Cosmetics"),  [Riven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Riven/Cosmetics "Riven/Cosmetics") and  [Vayne](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Vayne/Cosmetics "Vayne/Cosmetics").

structure.trivia:
- Viego's sword resembles and may be inspired by the German [Zweihänder](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zweih%C3%A4nder).
- Viego was in his early 20s during the first Ruination.[[9]](#cite_note-9)
- One of the "cures" Viego purchased was a spell that prevented Isolde's corpse from decaying.[[10]](#cite_note-10)
- Camavor is based on a combination of early modern period Spain and Camelot, Viego's name was chosen to reflect this origin.[[11]](#cite_note-11)
  - The country was originally hinted in Viego's voice lines to be called "Camaveia", however that name was cut because it sounded similar to the Brazilian Portuguese words "cama véia" meaning "old bed".[[12]](#cite_note-12) The new official name of the kingdom was later revealed in his champion insight.
- Viego is the "Ruined King" because he was emotionally ruined when Isolde was killed, which caused him to trigger the Ruination.[[13]](#cite_note-13)
- The black mist corrupts people and makes them look altered and monstrous. Viego controls the black mist and not vice versa, so he hasn't been corrupted by it at all and become monstrous like other  [Shadow Isles](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shadow_Isles "Universe:Shadow Isles") beings.[[14]](#cite_note-14)
- As mentioned in the [Riot Report](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dcd6st4YpY4) of February 2021:
  - After being stabbed by Isolde, Viego actually died and fell into the same state as a normal person would, not knowing all the details that happened shortly before. During that state, he still grasped the general ideas (though not in details) of the events that happened.
  - Viego's form is distorted by his delusion and personality.
  - Viego's magic is something he doesn't even fully understand, it is deeply tied to [Helia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Helia "Helia") and the Black Mist. The Black Mist is parasitic in nature and rips life, bringing souls to an undead state.
  - [Sanctity](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blade_of_the_Ruined_King "Blade of the Ruined King") is a royal weapon passed down among kings. When a new king incarnated, it would absorb part of their soul in order to revive them should they get fatal injuries in battles. When Isolde stabbed Viego in the heart, the magic of the blade tried to revive him at the same time with the magic of the blessed water, but due to the soul part inside the blade itself, it could not do it. The cycle of the healing magic caused a feedback loop that became overloaded and finally caused the Ruination.
    - The version of the blade that appears in  [Ruined King](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ruined_King "Ruined King") and  [League of Legends](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/League_of_Legends "League of Legends") is its physical form after being affected by the Ruination, while the blade Viego uses is more of a soul-life version as he remembers it.
      - Viego uses the physical blade in Ruined King. After he was sealed by the Buhru, the whereabouts of the physical blade became unknown.
- Once he was awakened, Viego set out to revive Isolde by gathering the fragments of her soul, which were stored in fetters scattered across Runeterra.
  - The fetters include:  [Senna](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Senna "Universe:Senna"),  [Gwen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Gwen "Universe:Gwen"),  [The Maiden of the Mist](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Yorick#Eulogy_of_the_Isles "Yorick"), a hand mirror, an ivory comb, a wine flagon, a silver flower, a copper sundial, a parasol, a jade mask, a brass bell, and a reed basket.

structure.name: Sivir
structure.quote: *"Coin may buy you skill for a day, but never loyalty."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Sivir was born in Shurima, her childhood was very hard as her parents were killed by looters and she alone had to grow up on the streets along with other orphans stealing food from local markets and delving into ancient ruins in search of trinkets that she could sell.

Sivir sometimes had to fight with the other children to keep some of the loot they found, but she rarely kept anything, after her so-called friend Mira tricked her and stole it, Sivir swore to herself that no one would ever come back to betray.

When she reached adolescence she became the guide and lackey of a group of mercenaries led by the well-known daughter Siharo, although her skill with weapons led her to become Siharo's sergeant, Sivir realized that she was left with most of the treasures even if they were obtained thanks to Sivir. Sivir gathered her fellow mercenaries and rebelled against Siharo, the two duelled and Sivir emerged victorious, but was unable to kill her mentor and abandoned her in the desert wishing her luck to rebuild her life.

### Contemporary history

Sivir and her mercenaries earned a great reputation which was known throughout the desert, they accepted any task offered to them if the pay was very good, one day she and her companions were given the task of recovering an ancient relic known as the Chalikar .Accompanied by the buyer's personal guards, Sivir searched for the relic for several months and finally found it, the weapon left Sivir amazed as it was quite magnificent, the captain of the guard told Sivir to give it to her but she refused and with just one movement of the weapon decapitated him and all his followers and Sivir fled with the weapon in hand. Sivir's reputation grew further and she became known beyond the desert, when the Noxian expeditions heard about her, it was [Cassiopeia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cassiopeia "Cassiopeia") Du Coteau who was most interested in her exploits and proceeded to hire Sivir to sack the ancient city of Shurima.

Little by little they entered the ruins of the city, several of Sivir's companions died due to the constant traps they found, but Cassiopeia refused to back down, when they reached the great door of a tomb surrounded by ancient statues of guardians and reliefs of the warriors of the past ,Sivir was quite captivated by those beast-headed beings and their great fights against monsters of the underworld, taking advantage of Sivir's distraction. Cassiopeia stabbed Sivir with a dagger in the back causing her to scream in pain and collapse soaking the sand her blood, Cassiopeia took the Chalikar from her dying body to open the door to the tomb, unaware that it unleashed a powerful curse. Near death, Sivir watched as the statue of a giant serpent came to life and proceeded to spray Cassiopeia with his poison.

Sivir took her Chalikar and tried to flee from the tomb, but near the exit life began to leave her body and she fell to the ground, the last thing she heard before she fainted was the roars of maddened Gods being released from the tomb .But surprisingly that was not the end because she opened her eyes and realized that her wounds had healed and in front of her was her savior. [Azir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Azir "Azir") the last emperor of Shurima, he explained to her that Sivir is his descendant and that through his veins runs royal blood. He explained to her that the blood he had spilled had awakened her spirit and he took her to the pool of life where he healed her wounds. Azir later began to complete his ascension and Sivir watched in amazement as he became an Ascended and the ancient Shurima began to rise from the sands. Sivir quickly ran out of the pool and saw how the ancient Shurima returned from the grave. Now Sivir, along with [Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nasus "Nasus") and [Taliyah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Taliyah "Taliyah"), is preparing to decide whether to embrace the fate they gave her or forge her own on the sands of Shurima.
structure.appearance: Sivir is possessed of a mercenaries' code of values and isn't motivated by anything as much as material wealth. Causes, nobility and matter of honor pale in her eyes when compared to the alluring clinking of coin. Shaped by a harsh childhood spent trying to surviving and make a living in the Shuriman Sai while always on the lookout for betrayal, Sivir is inherently a distrustful person. This is evidenced by her being slow to let down her guard around Taliyah even though the Stoneweaver had been the one to rescue Sivir and stitch her wounds after finding her bleeding outside Vekaura. Sivir's pragmatic self-interest plays a large part in why she doesn't embrace her role as Azir's heir, preferring her modest life as a mercenary/fortune hunter while avoiding the destiny seemingly placed before her.
structure.personality:
Sivir is a beautiful girl of average height, curvaceous and somewhat toned, she has tan skin, long jet black hair that falls down her back, and shiny blue eyes.

She wears somewhat revealing black and grey clothing, with black boots, gloves, a bra, and a black skirt with gold accents, a white scarf around her neck, and a gold tiara with a turquoise jewel in the center.
structure.abilities:
- **Expert Combatant**: Sivir is a fairly skilled and highly skilled fighter.
- **Chalikar**: Sivir possesses a giant chalikar as a weapon. This weapon acts as a boomerang so that she can throw it and immediately return to it afterward.

relations.relationship_description: [Cassiopeia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cassiopeia "Universe:Cassiopeia") hired Sivir to raid ancient [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima") ruins and later stabbed her to steal her blade in order to open a tomb.

Sivir wants nothing to do with  [Azir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir"), for even though he saved her life she doesn't want to owe him anything, let alone assume the responsibility of uniting Shurima which, in her eyes, will always be a lawless, ruthless land. Sivir seems to have descended from  [Azir's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Azir "Azir") illegitimate child whom he was never aware of.  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath") will hunt her down no matter what, for in her he sees the shackles that still bind him as well as the decadent society that brought him nothing but misery.

[Taliyah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taliyah "Universe:Taliyah") promised the Great Weaver to nurse Sivir back to health and to protect her when she was wounded after leaving the newly risen [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima") city.

[Nasus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Nasus "Universe:Nasus") sees in Sivir the hope of a reborn Shurima and the key to defeating  [Xerath](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xerath "Universe:Xerath").

structure.trivia:
- Based on the [timeline of events](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Timeline "Timeline"), Sivir is possibly in her late 20s- early 30s.
- Sivir does honor her mercenary agreements 99% of the time, but she offers her services to the highest bidder. When she found the crossblade weapon, she felt such an unbreakable connection to the blade that its value to her surpassed the money she'd get from the Lord from [Nashramae](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nashramae "Nashramae").[[1]](#cite_note-1)
  - She does not discriminate working for anyone and killing people including the innocent, so long as she's paid enough to do so.
- Her weapon,  [the Chalicar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sivir#Boomerang_Blade "Sivir"), was previously owned by the [God-Warrior](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/God-Warrior "God-Warrior") queen Setaka.
  - In the story [Twilight of the Gods](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twilight_of_the_Gods "Twilight of the Gods"), it is revealed that  [the Chalicar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sivir#Boomerang_Blade "Sivir") is from the  [Celestial's Kingdom](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Mount_Targon "Mount Targon") above Targon's peak.
    - If funnelled, the weapon is able to cast  [Portal Jump](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zoe#Portal_Jump "Zoe") and allows releasing an empowered form of  [Moonfalling](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Diana#Moonfall "Diana") to reverse the [Ascension](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Ascended "Ascended") away from the [Darkin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darkin "Darkin").
    - At the end of the story, the Chalicar had absorbed the - for want of of a better phrase - Darkin DNA essence, which - combined with Ta'anari's heart - would allow humans to craft the weapons tailored to trap the Darkin at a later date.[[2]](#cite_note-2)
    - Tomb of Emperors is Shuriman, but the events of the story imbued the Chalicar with a resonance to the Ascended, so it acted as a channel between Sivir and her distant ancestor,  [Azir](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Azir "Universe:Azir") which allowed her blood to revive him. As the Alchemists of Old said, "Like attracts like...".[[3]](#cite_note-3)
    - Based on the description in the story, Sivunas Alahair, who is destined to either destroy or unite  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), may be Sivir.
